targets: title: no yolks one pot cheesy taco noodles ingredients: 1/2 12 ounce package no yolks r extra broad noodles 1/2 pound extra lean ground beef 1/2 cup chopped onion 1 package 35 gram sodium reduced taco seasoning 2 cups canned crushed tomatoes 2 cups shredded tex mex cheese blend directions: prepare the noodles according to package directions. drain well and set aside. return the pot to the burner and set over medium heat. add the beef and onion. cook, stirring and breaking up the meat until browned. stir in the seasoning and tomatoes simmer for 10 minutes. stir the noodles and cheese into with the beef mixture until gooey. spoon into bowls and garnish to taste.

inputs: butter, shortening, brown sugar, sugar, baking soda, egg, vanilla, flour, chocolate chips, pecans, chocolate, shortening
targets: title: chocolate chip cookie dunkers ingredients: 1/4 cup butter, softened 1/4 cup shortening 1/2 cup packed brown sugar 1/4 cup granulated sugar 1/4 teaspoon baking soda 1 egg 1 teaspoon vanilla 1 1/4 cups all purpose flour 1/2 cup miniature semisweet chocolate chips 1/2 1/2 cup pecans filberts, optional or 1/2 cup hazelnuts filberts optional 6 ounces semisweet chocolate, chopped 1 tablespoon shortening directions: preheat oven to 350 f line a 9x9x2 inch baking pan with foil, allowing edges to hang over sides of pan set pan aside. beat butter and 1/4 cup shortening in a medium bowl with an electric mixer on medium speed for 30 seconds. add brown sugar, granulated sugar, and baking soda. beat until combined, scraping sides of bowl occasionally. beat in egg and vanilla until combined. beat in as much of the flour as you can with the mixer. stir in any remaining flour. stir in miniature semisweet chocolate pieces and, if desired, nuts. press dough evenly onto bottom of prepared baking pan. bake in preheated oven for 25 to 30 minutes or until crust is evenly golden brown and center is set. cool in pan on a wire rack for 1 hour. reduce oven temperature to 325 f use foil to lift baked mixture out of pan. transfer cookie to a cutting board remove foil. cut baked mixture into 9x1/2 inch slices using a serrated knife. place slices, cut sides down, 1 inch apart on an ungreased cookie sheet. bake in 325 f oven about 20 minutes or until crisp, turning carefully halfway through baking time. cool completely on the cookie sheet on a wire rack. trim ends, if desired. microwave chopped chocolate and 1 tablespoon shortening in a small microwave safe bowl on 50 percent power medium for 2 to 3 minutes or until melted and smooth, stirring twice. brush or spread one end of each cookie stick with melted chocolate mixture let excess drip down sides of cookie. place cookies on parchment paper or waxed paper let stand about 1 hour or until set. makes 18 cookies. to store place cookies in layers separated by waxed paper in an airtight container cover. store at room temperature for up to 3 days or freeze for up to 3 months. thaw cookies, if frozen, before serving.

inputs: mayonnaise, flour, eggs, milk, flaked crabmeat, green onions, parsley, swiss cheese, pastry shell
targets: title: crab quiche ingredients: 1/2 c. mayonnaise 2 tbsp. flour 2 eggs, beaten 1/2 c. milk 2 6 oz. cans flaked crabmeat, drained 1/3 c. chopped green onions 1 tbsp. finely chopped parsley 2 c. 8 oz. shredded swiss cheese 1 unbaked pastry shell 9 inch directions: in mixing bowl, combine mayonnaise, flour, eggs and milk. stir in crab, onion, parsley and cheese. spoon into pastry shell. bake at 350 for 1 hour. yields 6 to 8 servings.

inputs: flour, baking pwdr, salt, mayonnaise, milk
targets: title: biscuits made with mayonnaise recipe ingredients: 1 c. flour 2 teaspoon baking pwdr 1/2 teaspoon salt 3 tbsp. mayonnaise 1/2 c. lowfat milk directions: mix all ingredients. put on floured board and knead very little. roll out into 1/2 layer and cut into biscuits. bake at 400 degrees till brown.

inputs: flour, pumpkin pie spice, sugar, glace cherries, orange marmalade, milk, margarine, marmalade
targets: title: cherry marmalade muffins ingredients: 2 cups self rising flour 1 teaspoon pumpkin pie spice 12 cup sugar 12 cup glace cherries, quartered 2 tablespoons orange marmalade 23 cup milk 4 tablespoons margarine marmalade to glaze directions: preheat oven to 400. lightly grease 12 muffin cups with oil. sift together the flour and spice, then stir in the sugar and glace cherries. mix the marmalade with the milk and beat into the dry ingredients with the margarine. spoon into the greased cups. bake 20 25 minutes, until golden brown and firm. turn out onto a wire rack and brush to tops with warmed marmalade. serve hot.

inputs: sweet potato, butternut squash, white onion, garlic, thyme, maple syrup, soy sauce, black pepper
targets: title: maple glazed sweet potato butternut squash roast ingredients: 1 sweet potato, peeled and diced 2 cups butternut squash, peeled and diced 1/2 cup white onion, minced 3 minced garlic cloves 1 tablespoon thyme 3 tablespoons maple syrup 1 tablespoon soy sauce 1 teaspoon black pepper directions: combine all ingredients. toss into a roasting pan. bake at 425 f for 20 minutes.

inputs: corned beef, butter, green pepper, onion, barbecue sauce
targets: title: corned beef barbecue ingredients: 1 can corned beef 1/2 stick butter 1 small green pepper 1 medium onion barbecue sauce directions: melt butter in saucepan. cook peppers and onions together until onions are clear. add corned beef and barbecue sauce. heat about 15 minutes. serve on bun with cole slaw.

inputs: ground beef, fiesta sauce, water, flour tortillas, vegetable oil, beans, salsa, cheese, green onion, tomato, olives, sour cream
targets: title: mexican pizza ingredients: ground beef chi chi s fiesta sauce water flour tortillas vegetable oil can s refried beans salsa, as desired co jack cheese, as desired green onion, sliced, as desired tomato, diced, as desired ripe olives, chopped, as desired sour cream, if desired directions: brown ground beef drain. add siesta sauce water cook according to package directions. heat tortillas in frying pan with oil until crisp drain on paper towel. spread refried beans onto tortilla. top with ground beef mixture. add another tortilla. spread with salsa. top with cheese, green onions, tomatoes and ripe olives. bake at 375f until cheese is melted. top with sour cream if desired.

inputs: sugar, butter, white corn syrup, water, toasted almond, vanilla
targets: title: almond toffee popcorn ingredients: 1 cup sugar 1/2 cup butter 1/2 cup white corn syrup 1/4 cup water 1 cup toasted almond, chopped 1/2 teaspoon vanilla 1/2 cup popcorn, popped directions: in heavy saucepan, combine sugar, butter, corn syrup, water and almonds. cook over a moderate heat to 280 on a candy thermometer. add the vanilla. stir well and pour over the popped corn.

inputs: chicken cutlets, spinach, garlic, bacon, bread crumbs, garlic
targets: title: chicken florentine quick recipe ingredients: 1 pound chicken cutlets, hammered sliced thin 1 pkg. frzn minced spinach 3 tbsp. minced garlic in extra virgin olive oil jarred 1/2 pound bacon, sliced bread crumbs 2 ounce. garlic/herb cheese, softened mixed with 2 teaspoon lowfat sour cream directions: preheat oven to 350 degrees. defrost frzn spinach. squeeze out excess water. place in bowl and toss in garlic. lay out cutlets. divide spinach proportionately on each cutlet. roll up. wrap 1 piece bacon around rollette to secure. press into bread crumbs all around. bake in shallow racked pan for 45 min or possibly till golden. garnish with cheese mix and parsley just before serving. serves 4 or possibly made smaller as hors doeuvres.

inputs: butter, semi sweet chocolates, sugar, eggs, coconut, nuts, pie shells
targets: title: japanese chocolate pie ingredients: 2 sticks butter 1 c. semi sweet chocolates 2 c. sugar 4 eggs 1 c. coconut 1 c. chopped nuts 3 pie shells directions: melt butter. add chocolate and melt. stir in sugar until well blended. add eggs and mix well. stir in coconut and nuts. pour into pie shells. bake at 350 for 45 minutes.

inputs: olive oil, chicken, all purpose, onion, garlic, white wine, white wine vinegar, tomatoes, chicken stock, tomato paste, brown sugar, black olives, anchovy, parsley, rice
targets: title: chicken cacciatore ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive oil 3 1/3 pounds chicken pieces 1/4 cup all purpose flour seasoned 1 onion sliced 1 clove garlic crushed 1/2 cup dry white wine 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar 14 ounces crushed tomatoes 1/2 cup chicken stock 1 tablespoon tomato paste 1 teaspoon brown sugar 1/2 cup pitted black olives 3 anchovy fillets chopped 2 tablespoons chopped parsley plus extra, to serve cooked rice or pasta, to serve directions: preheat oven to 350 f. heat oil in a large frying pan on high. dust chicken in flour, shaking off excess. cook in 2 batches, 4 5 minutes each batch, until golden all over. transfer to a large casserole dish. in same pan, saute onion and garlic 1 2 minutes, until onion is tender. stir in wine and vinegar. bring to a boil and cook, uncovered, 4 5 minutes, until liquid reduces by half. mix in tomatoes, stock, tomato paste and sugar. season to taste. bring to a boil and cook, stirring, 4 5 minutes. pour over chicken. cover casserole dish and bake 55 60 minutes. stir in olives, anchovies and parsley and bake, uncovered, another 5 minutes. serve topped with extra parsley. accompany with rice or pasta.

inputs: cornish hens, soy sauce, mirin, honey, rice wine vinegar, black beans, sesame chili oil, lime juice, garlic, ground ginger, cilantro, oil, onion, garlic, ginger, carrot, celery, red bell pepper, yellow bell pepper, green cabbage, bok choy, five spice powder, salt, chicken, brown sugar
targets: title: hoisin barbecued game hens with stir fried vegetables ingredients: 3 cornish hens 12 cup reduced sodium soy sauce 14 cup mirin or 14 cup sweet sake or 14 cup riesling wine or 14 cup other sweet wine 2 tablespoons honey 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar 1 tablespoon fermented black beans rinsed and chopped 2 teaspoons sesame chili oil i used half sesame oil, half chili oil 2 teaspoons lime juice 3 garlic cloves, chopped 2 tablespoons ground ginger 13 cup chopped cilantro 3 tablespoons oil 1 cup sliced onion 1 tablespoon minced garlic 1 12 tablespoons peeled minced ginger 1 cup thinly chopped carrot 12 cup diced celery 34 cup julienned red bell pepper 34 cup julienned yellow bell pepper 12 cup thinly chopped green cabbage 8 ounces bok choy, ends trimmed and sliced horizontally 2 teaspoons five spice powder 3 tablespoons reduced salt soy sauce 14 cup chicken stock 1 tablespoon brown sugar directions: remove neck and giblets from hens and rinse them and pat dry. halve hens by cutting firmly through the breast and backbone with a sharp knife. pound each half with the palm of your hand to flatten the hens. marinade . in a medium saute pan or skillet, combine all marinade ingredients and simmer 7 8 minutes. cool in refrigerator or freezer. in a large, resealable plastic bag, marinate hens for 2 3 hours. remove hens from marinade reserve marinade. prepare a charcoal fire. when coals are very hot but not flaming, spearate them to the sides of the grill so the hens can cook in the middle by indirect heat. the coals should be hot enough to cook for one hour, but not so hot as to burn the honey in the marinade. for a gas grill, heat grill and turn flames to low. place hens on grill skin side down and cook, covered, about 25 minutes, basting with marinade. turn and continue to cook and baste for 20 25 minutes, or till juices run clear i don t think mine took quite that long . remove from grill and keep warm. in a large saute pan or wok, heat oil over high heat. add onions, garlic, ginger, carrots, celery, peppers, bok choy and five spice powder. stir fry for 3 4 minutes, tossing constantly. add soy sauce, stock and brown sugar and continue to stir fry for 2 3 minutes more. do not overcook. to serve, divide vegetables evenly on plates and top with game hen halves. if you have marinade left over and want to use it drizzle over the dish, place marinade in a saucepan and bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer for 3 4 minutes.

inputs: hot sauce, garlic, red wine vinegar, onion, green onions, original sauce, pepper, salt
targets: title: marinated, grilled london broil ingredients: 1 1 1/2 lb top sirloin steak london broil 1 teaspoon hot sauce i prefer tabasco 2 heads garlic, minced fine save six little cloves 1/2 cup red wine vinegar 1 small spanish onion, chopped fine 2 sprigs green onions, sliced on the bias finely 1 12 ounce bottle a.1. original sauce 1 teaspoon pepper 1/2 teaspoon salt directions: get the freshest, leanest piece of top sirloin you can find black angus is most recommended . make sure it is deep red in color. place your sirloin in a deep rectangular pan. lightly score the meat with a very sharp knife on both sides to make sure marinade gets into meat. start by sprinkling both sides of meat with the salt and pepper. stuff a few cloves garlic all over meat by cutting little slits. pour in red wine vinegar, a1 sauce, tabasco sauce add the chopped spanish onions. reserve the green onions for later as a garnish . stir and flip the meat to coat evenly on both sides. cover pan with foil or plastic and let sit in refrigerator for at least three hours. preheat charcoal or gas grill for 20 minutes on high setting. place your marinated steak on the hot grill and place a small weight on top. grill for about 1 1/2 minutes, then flip it over and do the same for the other side. reduce heat on grill to a low medium setting, and turn every minute or so, taking care to grill so that you get charcoaled score lines in a criss cross pattern on the steak. do not over cook the steak should be pink inside not brown

inputs: potatoes, garlic, salt, pepper, lemon juice, extra virgin, water, anchovy paste, purple onion, fresh parsley, parmesan cheese
targets: title: caesar potato salad recipe ingredients: 2 lb small, unpeeled, round red potatoes 8 x cloves garlic not peeled 1/4 tsp salt 1/4 tsp pepper 3 tbsp. fresh lemon juice 1 1/2 tbsp. extra virgin extra virgin olive oil 1 tbsp. water 2 tsp anchovy paste 1/3 c. diced purple onion 1/4 c. minced fresh parsley 2 tbsp. grated fresh parmesan cheese directions: place potatotes and garlic in a dutch oven cover with water, and bring to a boil. cover, reduce heat, and simmer 24 min or possibly till potatoes are tender. drain cold potatoes and garlic slightly. peel garlic place in a large bowl, and mash. stir in salt, pepper, lemon juice, extra virgin olive oil, water, and anchovy paste. cut potatoes into quarters add in to garlic mix. add in remaining ingredients, and toss. serve hot, or possibly cover and chill. yield 6 1 c. servings 373 mg cloves garlic not peeled calc 50mg

inputs: ready, cheese, s sweet chocolate, sugar, almond extract, topping, cherry pie filling
targets: title: no bake chocolate, almond cherry cheesecake ingredients: 1/4 cup planters sliced almonds, toasted, divided 1 ready to use vanilla wafer crumb crust 6 oz. 2 pkg. 8 oz. each philadelphia neufchatel cheese, softened 1 pkg. 4 oz. baker s german s sweet chocolate, melted 1/3 cup sugar 1/2 tsp. almond extract 2 cups thawed cool whip lite whipped topping 1 can 21 oz. cherry pie filling directions: reserve 1 tbsp. nuts sprinkle remaining onto bottom of crust. mix next 4 ingredients in medium bowl until blended. gently stir in cool whip. spoon into crust. refrigerate 3 hours. serve topped with pie filling and reserved nuts.

inputs: sour cream, mayonnaise, dill, onion flakes, parsley, beef, onion
targets: title: boat dip ingredients: 1 1/3 c. sour cream 1 1/3 c. mayonnaise 2 tsp. dill seed 2 tbsp. onion flakes 2 tbsp. parsley 2 pkg. 2 1/2 oz. each corned beef or dried beef, chopped up 2 tsp. spice islands beau monde substitute onion and celery paste directions: mix and stir. make one day ahead. on day of use, hollow out bread pumpernickel or rye and fill with the dip made the previous day. use the chunks out of the bread for the dipping.

inputs: pistachios, shallot, vinegar, mayonnaise, lemon juice, garlic, extra virgin olive oil, creme fraiche, flat leaf parsley, tarragon, salt, belgian
targets: title: crudites with creamy pistachio dip ingredients: 1 1/2 cups raw, unsalted shelled pistachios 7 ounces 1 large shallot, minced 1/4 cup champagne vinegar or white wine vinegar 1 cup mayonnaise 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice 1 large garlic clove, minced 1/2 cup extra virgin olive oil 2 cups creme fraiche 1/4 cup minced flat leaf parsley 2 tablespoons minced tarragon salt and freshly ground pepper 10 large belgian endives, preferably red and green varieties, separated into leaves, or very thinly sliced black radishes directions: preheat the oven to 350. spread the pistachios on a large rimmed baking sheet and toast for 8 minutes. let cool. transfer the pistachios to a food processor and pulse until coarsely ground. meanwhile, in a small bowl, soak the shallot in the vinegar for 10 minutes. in a large bowl, whisk the mayonnaise with the lemon juice and garlic. gradually whisk in the olive oil until thickened. drain the shallots and stir them into the mayonnaise along with the creme fraiche, parsley and tarragon. stir in the ground pistachios and season with salt and pepper. scrape the dip into small bowls and serve with the crudites.

inputs: flour, baking powder, salt, brown sugar, butter, walnuts, dates, eggs
targets: title: date nut bars ingredients: 1 1/2 c. flour 1 tsp. baking powder 1 tsp. salt 2 c. brown sugar 1/2 c. melted butter or margarine 2 c. chopped walnuts 2 c. chopped dates 4 well beaten eggs directions: add flour, baking powder, salt and brown sugar to large mixing bowl. mix on low speed until all ingredients are thoroughly mixed. mix melted butter, eggs, nuts and dates together and then add to dry ingredients. make certain all ingredients are completely mixed. pour into well greased 9 x 11 inch pan. bake at 350 for 30 minutes or until dark brown. cut into 1 x 2 inch bars when cool. coat bars with powdered sugar. yields 42 bars.

inputs: komatsuna, shirasu baby sardines, mentsuyu, sugar, sesame oil, much
targets: title: dressed komatsuna and shirasu ingredients: 1 bunch komatsuna 30 grams shirasu baby sardines 2 tbsp mentsuyu 1 pinch sugar 1/3 tbsp sesame oil 1 as much to taste sesame seeds optional directions: boil the komatsuna quickly in hot water with a pinch of salt. cut to 3 cm length, then add the shirasu. pour the mentsuyu, sugar and sesame oil in this order and mix well. if there is any water from the vegetables, drain lightly and serve. lastly, sprinkle the sesame as you rub with fingers so the aroma is released.

inputs: vanilla ice cream, ground ginger, ground cinnamon, nutmeg, cold heavy cream, brandy, panettone, confectioners, vanilla
targets: title: eggnog panettone ice cream cake ingredients: 4 pints vanilla ice cream, slightly softened 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon 1/2 teaspoon freshly grated nutmeg, plus more for topping 2 1/2 cups cold heavy cream 1/4 cup brandy 1 panettone about 2 pounds , cut into 1 inch thick slices 1/4 cup confectioners sugar 1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract directions: mix the ice cream, ginger, cinnamon and nutmeg in a large bowl until combined. cover and freeze until ready to use. combine 1/2 cup heavy cream with the brandy in a small bowl set aside. line the bottom of a 9 inch round springform pan with parchment paper. arrange about one third of the panettone in the pan in a single layer, cutting the pieces as needed to completely cover. brush the panettone lightly with some of the brandy cream. spread half of the spiced ice cream over the panettone layer. repeat with another layer of panettone, brush with more cream and top with the remaining ice cream. cover with the remaining panettone and brush with the remaining cream. cover the pan with foil and freeze until firm, at least 4 hours or overnight. remove the cake from the freezer about 20 minutes before serving. beat the remaining 2 cups heavy cream, the confectioners sugar and vanilla in a large bowl with a mixer on medium high speed until soft peaks form, about 2 minutes. remove the springform ring. cover the cake with the whipped cream and sprinkle with nutmeg. photograph by johnny miller

inputs: shortening, onion, beef, potatoes, gravy, catsup, mustard, salt, pepper
targets: title: old fashioned hash ingredients: 2 tbsp. shortening or oil 1 medium onion, chopped 3 c. finely diced cooked beef 3 c. diced cooked potatoes 1/2 c. gravy 2 tbsp. catsup 1/2 tsp. prepared mustard 1 tsp. salt 1/8 tsp. pepper directions: in large skillet, melt shortening. cook onion in shortening until tender. stir in remaining ingredients. cook until well browned, about 10 minutes. turn and brown other side. makes 6 servings.

inputs: frozen string beans, onion, garlic, cilantro, chili powder, turmeric, cumin, flour, salt, ground black pepper, lemon juice, sesame seeds, oil
targets: title: string bean falafels ingredients: 2 7/8 cups frozen string beans defrosted 1/2 onion diced 2 garlic cloves diced 1 tablespoon cilantro or parsley, chopped 1/2 teaspoon chili powder 1/2 teaspoon turmeric 1 teaspoon cumin 1 tablespoon flour salt ground black pepper lemon juice squeeze of sesame seeds oil for frying directions: add the string beans to a food processor and roughly chop them. add the onion, garlic, cilantro or parsley, chili powder, turmeric, cumin, and flour. blend until everything is well combined. salt and pepper to taste and squeeze in a few drops of lemon juice. pulse together. with wet or oiled hands, pinch out sections from this dough, forming into balls about the size of a tablespoon. then flatten the balls out. sprinkle with sesame seeds. lay out on a baking tray and refrigerate a bit. heat up 2 fingers of oil in a skillet and fry the falafels on both sides until golden. serve with greek yogurt and a drizzle of olive oil.

inputs: ladyfingers, white creme, semi sweet chocolate squares, instant coffee, boiling water, egg yolks, sugar, egg whites, vanilla, heavy cream
targets: title: frozen chocolate charlotte ingredients: 2 pkg. ladyfingers 1/4 c. white creme de menthe or creme de cacao 2 8 oz. pkg. semi sweet chocolate squares 3 tbsp. instant coffee 1/2 c. boiling water 6 egg yolks 1/2 c. sugar 6 egg whites 1 tsp. vanilla 1 1/2 c. heavy cream, whipped or small carton cool whip directions: split ladyfingers but do not separate into individual pieces. brush flat surfaces with liqueur. line sides of 9 inch spring form pan with ladyfingers, rounded sides against pan. separate remaining ladyfingers and line bottom of pan, overlapping to fit. melt chocolate in top of double boiler, stirring. dissolve coffee in boiling water and cool. beat egg yolks in small bowl at high speed until foamy. beat in sugar gradually continue beating until thick. beat in vanilla, coffee and melted chocolate. beat egg whites until stiff. stir one cup of egg white in chocolate and then fold chocolate mixture into remaining egg whites. fold in whipped cream. pour into pan and freeze. garnish with whipped cream and shaved chocolate. serves 12 to 16.

inputs: caramels, water, salt, pecan halves, sweet
targets: title: caramel pecan clusters ingredients: 1/2 lb. kraft caramels 2 tbsp. water 1/4 tsp. salt 4 c. small pecan halves 1 pkg. sweet or semi sweet chocolate directions: place first 3 ingredients in large bowl. microwave, stirring often, until melted. add pecans and coat well. place on greased cookie sheet in small mounds. melt chocolate in glass measuring cup in microwave. pour slowly over pecans mounds.

inputs: cake flour, margarine, cream cheese, sugar, eggs, vanilla
targets: title: cream cheese pound cake ingredients: 3 c. cake flour 3 sticks margarine 1 8 oz. pkg. cream cheese 3 c. sugar 6 large eggs 1 1/2 tsp. vanilla directions: cream margarine and cream cheese add sugar and beat well. add eggs one at a time then add vanilla. fold in flour. bake in greased and floured tube pan at 325 for 1 1/2 hours.

inputs: sugar, oil, eggs, pumpkin, flour, salt, nutmeg, allspice, soda, baking powder, cinnamon, cloves, water, pecans, raisins
targets: title: pumpkin bread ingredients: 3 c. sugar 1 c. oil 4 eggs 1 c. pumpkin 3 1/2 c. flour 2 tsp. salt 1 tsp. nutmeg 1/2 tsp. allspice 2 tsp. soda 1 tsp. baking powder 1 tsp. cinnamon 1/2 tsp. cloves 2/3 c. water 1 c. chopped pecans 1/2 c. raisins directions: cream sugar, oil and eggs. add pumpkin. add flour, salt, nutmeg, allspice, soda, baking powder, cinnamon and cloves. mix alternately with water. add chopped pecans and raisins. bake in 2 loaf pans or a tube pan sprayed with pam for 1 hour at 350 . remove from oven. cool 10 minutes. remove from pan. set on cooling rack. slice and serve.

inputs: barley mix, molasses, tomato puree, water, honey, onions, salt, garlic, turmeric, black pepper
targets: title: baked 7 beans and barley ingredients: 3 cups 7 bean and barley mix, dried 1/2 cup molasses 1/2 cup tomato puree passata 1/2 cup water 3 tablespoons honey 1/4 cup onions diced 1 teaspoon sea salt optional 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder 1/2 teaspoon turmeric 1 dash black pepper optional directions: combine all ingredients and mix well. pour into a baking dish and bake in a preheated 350f 180c . oven for 1 hour, stirring occasionally.

inputs: corn, whole kernel corn, sour cream, mix, margarine
targets: title: spicy mexican corn casserole ingredients: 1 can creamed corn 1 can whole kernel corn 1 8 oz. c. sour cream 1 pkg. mexican cornbread mix 1 stick margarine directions: melt margarine in 9 x 9 inch casserole dish. combine all other ingredients. pour into casserole dish with margarine. do not stir bake at 350 for 1 hour.

inputs: yeast, water, eggs, salt, sugar, butter, sesame seed, flour
targets: title: sesame pan bread ingredients: 1 pkg. yeast 1 1/2 c. warm water 2 beaten eggs 1 tsp. salt 1/4 c. sugar 1 1/2 sticks butter, melted sesame seed 3 1/2 c. flour directions: dissolve yeast in warm water. stir in sugar, salt and 1 stick butter. add eggs and flour. stir together. let rise 1 hour in warm place. stir down and pour into oblong baking pan or 2 loaf pans. cover with 1/2 stick melted butter spread sesame seed on top. let rise 1 hour. bake 20 minutes at 400 . can be reheated in foil in moderate oven.

inputs: tomato, green onions, mint, orange juice, olive oil, salt, freshly ground black pepper, salt, orzo
targets: title: grilled scallops with tomato mint sauce and orzo ingredients: 1 large tomato, seeded and chopped 1/2 cup chopped green onions 1 2/3 ounce package fresh mint leaves, chopped 1/3 cup orange juice 1/3 cup olive oil 1/4 teaspoon salt 1/4 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper 3 pounds sea scallops salt and pepper to taste 2 cups hot cooked orzo directions: combine first 7 ingredients in a bowl, tossing to combine. cover and chill 2 hours. drain and reserve juice from tomato mixture set mixture and juice aside. thread scallops evenly onto wood skewers that have been soaked in water. sprinkle with salt and pepper, and brush scallops with reserved juice. grill scallops, covered with grill lid, over medium high heat 350 to 400 3 to 4 minutes on each side or just until scallops are opaque. serve over cooked orzo, and top with reserved tomato mixture.

inputs: flour, milk, margarine, shortening, sugar, vanilla
targets: title: poor man s frosting ingredients: 5 tbsp. flour 1 c. milk 1 stick margarine 1/2 c. shortening 1 c. sugar 1 tsp. vanilla directions: cook flour and milk on stove until paste forms. cool. beat next four ingredients until mixed. add flour mixture. beat until sugar dissolves.

inputs: zucchini, salmon fillet, lemon zest, fresh basil, parsley, all purpose, vegetable oil, sour cream, dill, lemon juice, olive oil, mixed greens, lemon wedges
targets: title: salmon and zucchini fritters ingredients: 2 none medium zucchini, coarsely grated, excess liquid squeezed out 7 oz salmon fillet, skin and bones removed, finely chopped 1 tbsp lemon zest 2 tbsp fresh basil, finely chopped 2 tbsp fresh flat leaf parsley, finely chopped 1/4 cup all purpose flour 1/2 cup vegetable oil 2/3 cup sour cream 2 tbsp fresh dill, finely chopped 2 tbsp lemon juice 1 tbsp olive oil none none mixed greens, to serve none none lemon wedges, to serve directions: combine zucchini, salmon, lemon zest, herbs and flour. season. shape into 12 patties. cover with plastic wrap. chill for 15 mins. heat 1/4 cup vegetable oil in a large frying pan over medium heat. working in batches, cook patties for 1 2 mins per side, or until golden brown and cooked through. drain on paper towels. meanwhile, whisk together sour cream, dill, lemon juice and olive oil. season. serve fritters with creamy dill sauce, mixed greens and lemon wedges.

inputs: chicken, coconut milk, garlic, panang curry, fish sauce, sugar, lime, basil
targets: title: penang chicken curry penang gai ingredients: 1 cup chicken, cut into bite sized pieces 1/2 cup coconut milk 1 tablespoon chopped garlic 2 3 tablespoons panang curry paste 2 tablespoons fish sauce sugar 3 kaffir lime leaves, shredded 10 15 basil leaves, finely shredded directions: place a wok over medium high heat, and warm the coconut milk, but don t let it boil. add the curry paste, and stir it until the oil begins to separate out and form a thin film, to bring out the maximum flavor. add the remaining ingredients except the lime leaves and basil leaves, and simmer until the sauce is absorbed and thickened. add the lime leaves and basil leaves and stir fry briefly before serving.

inputs: tomato juice, oats, egg, onions, salt, pepper, lean ground beef
targets: title: prize winning meat loaf ingredients: 1 c. tomato juice 3/4 c. quaker oats, uncooked 1 egg, beaten optional 1/4 c. chopped onions 1 tsp. salt 1/4 tsp. pepper 1 1/2 lb. lean ground beef directions: put all ingredients into a pan. mix together. pour into a loaf pan and bake at 350 .

inputs: ground beef, milk, oats, egg, salt, onion, i often, oregano
targets: title: meatballs made with oatmeal ingredients: 1 lb ground beef 1/2 cup milk 1/2 cup quick oats 1 egg salt and pepper onion powder, to taste i often add a pinch or so of the following for more of an italian style meatball oregano, basil, parsley, garlic powder directions: pre heat oven to 350. in a medium or large bowl knead together all ingredients. form into decent size balls and place on a greased cookie sheet or pizza pan. bake for 20 25 minutes, or until browned on outside. baking time may vary for your oven .

inputs: flour, flour, sugar, baking powder, salt, milk, butter, sesame seeds, italian seasoning, garlic salt
targets: title: soft no yeast breadsticks ingredients: 1 cup flour 1/4 wheat flour 2 teaspoons sugar 1 1/2 teaspoons baking powder 1/2 teaspoon salt 2/3 cup milk 3 tablespoons butter, melted 2 teaspoons sesame seeds optional italian seasoning optional garlic salt optional directions: combine dry ingredients and gradually add milk to form a soft dough. knead gently 3 or 4 times on a floured surface. roll out into a rectangle about 10 x 5 inches and cut into 12 sticks or shape into bread sticks with your hands. put the melted butter into a large baking dish i use a 9 x 13 inch rectangular glass dish and turn the breadsticks to coat them with the butter or spray with butter flavored non stick spray for a healthy alternative to butter. sprinkle with sesame seeds, italian seasoning and/or garlic salt, if you like. bake at 450 f for 14 to 18 minutes. serve warm.

inputs: carrots, onions, milk, eggs, salt, sugar, olive oil, bread crumbs
targets: title: carrot ring ingredients: 2 c. shredded carrots 2 small onions, chopped 1/2 c. milk 2 eggs 1 tsp. salt 1 tbsp. sugar 3 tbsp. olive oil 1/2 c. bread crumbs fresh and packed in cup directions: grease ring mold. mix ingredients. place in mold. bake at 350 for 1 hour and 15 minutes with mold sitting in pan of water.

inputs: lemon, sugar, cognac, triple sec, brandy, lemon juice, lemon twist
targets: title: noir sidecar ingredients: 1 lemon wedge superfine sugar ice 1 1/2 ounces cognac 1/2 ounce cointreau or other triple sec 1/2 ounce benedictine brandy based herbal liqueur 1/2 ounce poire william or other pear brandy 3/4 ounce fresh lemon juice 1 lemon twist directions: moisten half of the outer rim of a martini glass with the lemon wedge and coat lightly with superfine sugar. fill a cocktail shaker with ice. add the cognac, cointreau, benedictine, poire william and lemon juice and shake well. strain into the prepared martini glass and garnish with the lemon twist.

inputs: shrimp, kosher salt, baking soda, extra virgin olive oil, garlic
targets: title: sous vide poached shrimp recipe ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds large peeled shrimp about 700g see note kosher salt 1/2 teaspoon baking soda extra virgin olive oil or butter optional aromatics such as garlic, shallots, tarragon, or parsley optional directions: set your sous vide water bath to desired temperature according to the chart above. in a large bowl, toss shrimp with 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt and the baking soda. place shrimp in a heavy duty zipper lock bag or a vacuum bag. if desired, add 1 to 2 tablespoons 15 to 30ml olive oil or butter and aromatics. remove all air from bag using the or a vacuum sealer. press shrimp into a single layer. add bagged shrimp to preheated water bath and cook for at least 15 minutes and up to 1 hour the texture should show very little variation within this time frame . remove shrimp from bag to a paper towel lined plates. serve hot, or chill and serve cold.

inputs: salt, cucumbers, mixed pickling, sugar, water, powdered alum, vinegar
targets: title: sweet icicle pickles ingredients: 1 c. salt 20 cucumbers quartered 1 1/2 tbsp. mixed pickling spices 5 c. sugar 2 qt. water 2 tsp. powdered alum 5 c. vinegar directions: put cucumber strips in a stone jar or stainless steel container. add salt to boiling water. pour over cucumbers. cover with plate. fill quart jar with water and use to hold plate under brine. cover with cloth and let stand for 1 week cool place . remove scum daily.

inputs: broccoli, cauliflower, onion, garlic, vegetable stock, potatoes, stalks celery, marjoram, milk, fresh parsley
targets: title: low fat broccoli and cauliflower soup ingredients: 500 g broccoli 250 g cauliflower 1 onion, chopped 1 garlic clove, crushed 2 cups vegetable stock 100 g potatoes, chopped 2 stalks celery, chopped 1/2 teaspoon dried marjoram 1 cup reduced fat milk 1 tablespoon fresh parsley, chopped directions: cut broccoli and cauliflower into small florets. combine onion and garlic in a large saucepan with 1 tablespoon water, stir constantly over heat until onion is soft. add stock, potato, celery, broccoli and cauliflower. bring to boil, reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes or until potato is tender. add marjoram place in a food processor and blend until smooth. return to pan, add milk and parsley, reheat before serving.

inputs: cream cheese, fruit cocktail, instant vanilla pudding
targets: title: fruit cheese ball ingredients: 2 8 oz. pkg. cream cheese, softened 1 large can fruit cocktail, well drained 2 small pkg. instant vanilla pudding directions: mix all ingredients together. roll in ground pecans. serve with cinnamon graham crackers.

inputs: ground beef, onion, parsley, worcestershire sauce, milk, breadcrumb, butter
targets: title: samhain legendary oven hash ingredients: 1 cup coarse ground beef 1 cup coarsely ground potato 1/4 cup coarsely ground onion 1/4 cup snipped fresh parsley 2 teaspoons worcestershire sauce 1 6 ounce can evaporated milk 1/4 cup fine dry breadcrumb 1 tablespoon butter, melted directions: in frying pan, combine and cook beef, potatoes, onion, parsley, and worcestershire sauce, and evaporated milk. remove from heat and turn out into a 1 qt casserole dish. mix bread crumbs with melted butter and sprinkle on top. bake in oven at 350f for 30 minutes.

inputs: philadelphia cream cheese, milk, crab meat, onions, horseradish, salt, pepper, almonds
targets: title: crab and cream cheese dip ingredients: 8 oz. pkg. philadelphia cream cheese 1 tbsp. milk 6 1/2 oz. can flaked crab meat 2 tbsp. finely chopped onions 1/2 tsp. horseradish 1/4 tsp. salt dash of pepper 1/3 c. slivered almonds directions: blend well. top with slivered almonds. bake in ovenproof dish at 375 for 15 minutes. serve hot with crackers.

inputs: lemon juice, fillet, promise buttery spread, zucchini, carrots, shallots, garlic, chicken broth, flour, capers, ground black pepper
targets: title: tilapia piccata over vegetable ribbons ingredients: 2 tablespoons lemon juice divided 2 tilapia fillet 3 teaspoons promise buttery spread 2 zucchini large, sliced into ribbons 2 carrots 1 shallots 2 cloves garlic finely chopped 1/2 cup fat free reduced sodium chicken broth 1 teaspoon all purpose flour 1 teaspoon small capers, rinsed and drained 1/8 teaspoon ground black pepper directions: sprinkle 1 tablespoon lemon juice over tilapia set aside. melt 1 teaspoon promise r buttery spread in 10 inch nonstick skillet over medium high heat and cook tilapia, turning once, 6 minutes or until tilapia is almost done. remove tilapia and set aside. melt 2 teaspoons spread in same skillet and cook zucchini and carrot, stirring constantly, 2 minutes or until starting to soften. stir in shallot and garlic and cook, stirring occasionally, 2 minutes or until vegetables are tender. remove to serving plates keep warm. reserve 2 tablespoons broth and blend with flour. stir remaining broth, flour mixture and remaining 1 tablespoon lemon juice into same skillet. bring to a boil over high heat. reduce heat to low, then return tilapia to skillet. simmer gently until tilapia flakes with a fork and sauce is thickened. serve tilapia and sauce over vegetables. sprinkle with capers and black pepper.

inputs: hamburger, garlic, onions, parmesan cheese, italian seasonings, tomato paste, tomato sauce, mushrooms
targets: title: spaghetti sauce ingredients: 3 lb. hamburger 4 large cloves garlic 3 medium onions 6 tbsp. fresh parmesan cheese 1 tbsp. italian seasonings 1 large can tomato paste 1 large can tomato sauce 2 cans mushrooms, drained directions: brown hamburger, onions and garlic, drain. add tomato sauce and paste. add 2 cans water with tomato paste can. add italian seasonings and salt and pepper to taste. add mushrooms and cheese. simmer for 2 to 3 hours. stir often. serve over spaghetti.

inputs: chicken breasts, salad dressing, onion soup, apricot preserves
targets: title: firehouse chicken ingredients: 6 to 8 skinless, boneless chicken breasts 1 8 oz. bottle fat free catalina salad dressing 1 envelope onion soup mix 1 12 oz. jar apricot preserves directions: combine dressing, soup and preserves. coat breast with mixture and marinate 4 hours in 9 x 13 inch baking dish, sprayed with cooking spray pam does well . bake at 350 for 30 minutes, covered then 20 to 30 minutes, uncovered.

inputs: orange juice, pineapple juice, orange sherbet, club soda
targets: title: sunshine fizz ingredients: 1 qt. chilled orange juice 1 qt. chilled pineapple juice 1 qt. orange sherbet 1 can club soda directions: mix first three ingredients and process in electric blender until smooth. stir in club soda. pour into soda glasses or punch cups and add a scoop of orange sherbet to each serving.

inputs: flour, pork shoulder, olive oil, yellow onion, tomatoes, green chiles, garlic, oregano, ground cumin, coriander, pico de, ground new mexico chili
targets: title: pork chile verde stew, slow cooker ingredients: 1 cup all purpose flour, seasoned with salt and pepper 5 pounds boneless pork shoulder, cut into cubes 3 tablespoons olive oil one yellow onion, chopped to 2 16 ounce jars salsa verde or one pound tomatillos, roasted, peeled, pureed one 10 ounce can diced tomatoes with juice 8 ounces diced green chiles such as hatch chiles two cloves garlic, minced 2 teaspoons dried oregano 1 teaspoon ground cumin 2 teaspoons coriander 1 tablespoon pico de gallo spice one tablespoon ground new mexico chili directions: spread seasoned flour in shallow bowl. dredge pork cubes. heat olive oil in large skillet, cook and stir onion in hot oil until fragrant, 3 to 5 minutes. add pork. cook and stir until pork is browned on all sides, 5 to 7 minutes. transfer pork and onion mixture to a slow cooker. stir in puraed tomatillos or salsa verde, diced tomatoes, and green chilies, garlic, oregano, cumin, and coriander. cook on low for six hours. serve with warm flour tortillas.

inputs: farro, vegetable broth, brussels, carrots, fennel bulb, rosemary, salt, orange, green onions, lemon juice
targets: title: vegetables with farro ingredients: 1 cup farro, rinsed and drained 1 3/4 cups low sodium vegetable broth 1 cup halved brussels sprouts 4 medium carrots, peeled and sliced 3/4 inch thick 1 1/4 cups 1/2 medium fennel bulb, cored and cut into 1/2 inch dice 1 1/4 cups , fronds reserved 1 1/2 tsp. dried rosemary 3/4 tsp. salt 1 orange, peeled and cut into pieces 1 cup 3 green onions, sliced 1/2 cup 2 tbs. lemon juice directions: stir together farro and broth in slow cooker. cover, and cook on high 1 hour. combine brussels sprouts, carrots, fennel, rosemary, and salt in large bowl, then place vegetables on top of farro. cover with lid, adjust slow cooker setting to low, and cook 2 to 3 hours, or until vegetables are tender. let slow cooker stand, uncovered, 10 minutes. fluff farro mixture with fork, and transfer to serving bowl. garnish with orange pieces, green onions, and fennel fronds, and drizzle with lemon juice.

inputs: will, turkey, salt, black pepper, hearts of romaine lettuce, oil, firm, firm, walnuts, cranberries, sweet oranges, will, olive oil, oil, raspberry vinegar, mustard, lemon, salt, black pepper, walnuts
targets: title: sanjay s leftover turkey salad with apples, pears walnuts ingredients: you will need, for the salad 1 lb leftover turkey, shredded sea salt black pepper 1 2 hearts of romaine lettuce walnut oil i prefer la tourangelle 1 2 firm, ripe bosc pears, peeled, cored and very thinly sliced 1 2 firm, ripe golden delicious apples, peeled, cored and very thinly sliced walnuts, finely chopped dried cranberries 2 3 ripe sweet oranges, peeled and segmented you will need, for the dressing olive oil extra virgin, first press walnut oil i prefer la tourangelle raspberry vinegar i prefer delouis fils dijon style mustard juice of 1 lemon sea salt black pepper gorgonzola, crumbled whole walnuts, for garnish directions: to prepare the salad season the turkey meat with sea salt and/or black pepper set aside. wash the romaine in cold, running water dry thoroughly, and set aside. using a pastry brush, lightly oil six salad plates or bowls with the walnut oil. tear off the romaine leaves, and arrange nicely on the salad plates. arrange the pear apple slices on the romaine leaves. arrange the turkey meat on the pear apple slices. sprinkle generously with the chopped walnuts, cranberries and orange segments. to prepare the dressing in a small bowl, whisk together the olive oil, walnut oil and raspberry vinegar. stir in the mustard, lemon juice, sea salt and black pepper. blend thoroughly, and gently gently spoon over the salad plates. garnish with the gorgonzola and walnuts, and serve immediately. you can substitute truffle oil for the walnut oil, if you re allergic to nuts. you can also use granny smith apples, if you want more of a crisp flavour. if you can t find raspberry vinegar, a good store bought raspberry vinaigrette is perfectly fine.

inputs: ham, apple slices country, brown sugar, flour, eggs, baking powder, butter, black pepper, salt, milk
targets: title: schnitz un gnepp ingredients: 2 3 pounds ham thick sliced, precooked or boiled until tender 1 x dried apple slices country , or unsweetened pieslicedapples 2 tablespoons brown sugar 2 cups flour, all purpose 1 each eggs 4 teaspoons baking powder 3 tablespoons butter melted 1/4 teaspoon black pepper 1 teaspoon salt 1 x milk directions: add apples and their liquid to ham and boil for one hour. if dried apples are used, they should be soaked overnight first. add brown sugar. prepare dumplings by sifting together flour, baking powder, salt and pepper. stir in well beaten egg, butter and enough milk to make a stiff but moist batter. drop batter by large spoonfuls into main dish, cover tightly and steam for about 20 minutes. note frozen oven ready yeast biscuits may be substituted for the dumpling batter.

inputs: pineapple, sugar, strawberry, orange, ginger ale
targets: title: punch ingredients: 1 can pineapple grapefruit juice 2 c. sugar 1 pkg. strawberry kool aid 1 pkg. orange kool aid 1 bottle ginger ale directions: mix together. put in a gallon jug and finish filling jug with water. freeze in a tray and chill the rest. when ready to serve, pour in ginger ale.

inputs: brine, water, kosher salt, brown sugar, chicken, chicken breasts, regular, chicken, barbecue sauce
targets: title: smoked bacon wrapped chicken breasts ingredients: for the brine 4 cups of cold drinking water 1/4 cup kosher salt 1/4 cup brown sugar for the chicken 4 6 chicken breasts boneless and skinless toothpick regular cut bacon 3 slices per breast ribs or chicken, rub barbecue sauce directions: brine pour the water into a pitcher then add the salt. stir until the salt is dissolved and the water returns to clear. add the brown sugar and stir until dissolved. pour the brine over the chicken breasts until covered, cover with lid or plastic wrap and place the bowl in the fridge to keep cold. soak the 6 chicken breasts in a deep glass container for 2 hours flipping them over at the halfway mark to make sure they were evenly submerged. preparing the chicken breasts after rinsing the breasts to make sure there was no extra salt on the outside of the meat, lay the breast down in the brining bowl and cover them with rub. lay 3 strips of bacon butted up against each other on a cutting board or flat surface. lay one of the breasts across the bacon leaving enough bacon on the left side to wrap it over just a little. roll the breast over a couple of times to completely wrap it in the bacon and use toothpicks to hold the bacon in place. smoking the chicken breasts setup the smoker for about 230 degrees for best results, and add dry and soaked wood chips. once the smoker is ready, go get the chicken breasts and place them directly on the grate leaving about 1 inch of space between them to allow the smoke to completely surround them. estimate about 3 hours of cook time but that will depend on the thickness of the chicken breasts that you purchased. about 30 minutes before they are finished, brush a light coating of barbecue sauce all over the top of them. there done when a safe internal temperature of 165 degrees is reached.

inputs: flour, sugar, salt, yeast, warm water, butter, swiss cheese, beef, sauerkraut, egg
targets: title: reuben loaf ingredients: 3 1/4 cups all purpose flour, divided 1 tablespoon sugar 1 teaspoon salt 1 1/4 ounce envelope dry yeast 1 cup warm water 120 f 130 f 1 tablespoon butter or 1 tablespoon margarine, softend 1/4 cup thousand island dressing 4 slices swiss cheese 1 6 ounce package thinly sliced corned beef 1 8 ounce can sauerkraut, drained 1 egg white, beaten directions: preheat the oven to 400 f. combine 2 1/4 cups of the flour with the sugar, salt and yeast in a large mixing bowl. mix well. stir in the warm water, butter and enough of the remaining flour to make soft dough. knead the dough on a lightly floured surface for 4 minutes. roll in to a 10x14 inch rectangle. arrange the rectangle on a lightly greased 11x17 inch baking sheet. spread the salad dressing down the middle. layer the cheese, corned beef and sauerkraut over the salad dressing. fold the sides to the center to enclose the filling and seal the edges. brush with the egg white and cut slits in top. bake 25 minutes or until golden brown. cut into 6 slices and serve hot.

inputs: vegetable oil, mushrooms, fresh ginger, carrots, cabbage, salt, sesame chili oil, wrappers, soy sauce, lime juice, sesame oil, fresh ginger, red pepper, scallion
targets: title: vegetable potstickers ingredients: canola or vegetable oil, for cooking 1 cup mushrooms, minced 2 teaspoons fresh ginger, minced 1 cup carrots, finely shredded 1 cup napa cabbage, shredded salt and pepper, to taste 1/2 teaspoons sesame chili oil 1/2 packages 12 oz. package round wonton wrappers 13 cups soy sauce 2 teaspoons lime juice 1/2 teaspoons sesame oil 1 teaspoon fresh ginger, minced red pepper flakes, to taste 1 whole scallion, sliced, to sprinkle on top of sauce directions: whisk together all of the ingredients for the dipping sauce and sprinkle the scallions on top. set aside. in a large saute pan, heat a little oil over medium heat. add the mushrooms, ginger, carrots and napa cabbage. cook over medium heat until vegetables soften. drain out excess liquid through a fine mesh strainer that is placed over a bowl to catch any liquids this is key to avoiding a soggy potsticker that falls apart . season with a little salt and pepper and drizzle with the chili oil. using a small teaspoon, spoon out the filling onto the middle of a wonton wrapper. wet the edges of the wonton wrap with a little water. seal the potstickers, crimping the edges if desired think pie crust method . if you want to freeze the potstickers, set on a baking sheet and freeze for 2 hours, then transfer to a container and freeze until ready to use. to cook the potstickers, heat a large wok or nonstick pan over medium high heat. add a little canola or vegetable oil and add the potstickers this will take a few batches, depending on the size of your pan . cook until the bottoms turn golden brown and crisp. add 1/3 cup of water and immediately cover the pan with a lid. cook for 3 minutes or until the water has evaporated. transfer the potstickers to a plate, add a little more oil and repeat with the remaining potstickers. serve with the dipping sauce.

inputs: popcorn kernels, extra virgin olive oil, rosemary, kosher salt
targets: title: rosemary popcorn ingredients: 1/2 cup popcorn kernels 2 teaspoons extra virgin olive oil, plus more as needed 1 tablespoon fresh rosemary leaves, finely chopped 1 teaspoon kosher salt directions: pop the popcorn kernels in a popper or on your stovetop according to the package directions. transfer to a very large bowl. drizzle with the oil, then sprinkle with the rosemary and salt. toss until the kernels are evenly seasoned. serve immediately.

inputs: olive oil, onion, green chile pepper, pepper, salt, turmeric, green beans, potatoes
targets: title: yamini s green beans and potatoes ingredients: olive oil onion half, chopped fine green chile pepper one or to taste, chopped pepper salt turmeric heaping 1/2 teaspoon green beans bunch, 1/2 inch long pieces 2 potatoes 1/2 x 1/2 cubes directions: brown in pan olive oil, onion, green chile pepper add pepper, salt, turmeric chop green beans into 1/2 inch long pieces chop potatoes into 1/2 x 1/2 cubes add to pan continue to cook on low heat until soft

inputs: flour, salad oil, brown sugar, sugar, baking soda, ground cinnamon, salt, vanilla extract, ground cloves, orange juice, eggs, carrots, walnuts, raisins, confectioners sugar
targets: title: carrot cake ring ingredients: 2 c. all purpose flour 1 1/4 c. salad oil 1 c. packed dark brown sugar 3/4 c. sugar 2 tsp. baking soda 2 tsp. ground cinnamon 1 tsp. salt 1 tsp. vanilla extract 1/4 tsp. ground cloves 1/2 6 oz. can frozen orange juice concentrate 4 eggs 2 c. shredded carrots about 3 medium carrots 1 c. walnuts, chopped 1/2 c. dark seedless raisins confectioners sugar optional directions: preheat oven to 350 . grease and flour a 10 inch bundt pan. into a large bowl, measure first 11 ingredients. with mixer at low speed, beat ingredients just until mixed, constantly scraping bowl with rubber spatula. increase speed to high. beat 4 minutes, occasionally scraping bowl.

inputs: dates, almonds, bacon
targets: title: devil on horseback ingredients: pitted dates whole almonds bacon directions: stuff almonds in dates. divide bacon strips into thirds. wrap around dates and secure with toothpicks. broil until bacon is done.

inputs: liquid smoke, steak sauce, salt, fresh ground black pepper, garlic, beef brisket, onion
targets: title: the greatest brisket ever ingredients: 3 1/2 fluid ounces hickory flavored liquid smoke 1 10 fluid ounce bottle steak sauce 1 tablespoon salt 1 tablespoon fresh ground black pepper 1 tablespoon garlic powder 1 3 pound beef brisket 1 thinly sliced onion directions: to make the marinade, whisk together the liquid smoke, steak sauce, salt, pepper, and garlic powder in a bowl. line a roasting pan with aluminum foil. place brisket with the fattier side facing upwards in the center of the pan. pour half of the marinade over the brisket. using a food injector, inject the rest of the marinade into the brisket. seal the brisket in the foil and refrigerate for at least 16 hours. preheat oven to 250 degrees f 120 degrees c . open foil and layer onion slices on the brisket. reseal the foil. bake in preheated oven for 6 hours. remove the brisket and slice. reseal the foil and bake the sliced brisket for 1 hour more.

inputs: shell clams, vegetable oil, eggs, milk, salt, cornflour, lemon wedge, tartar sauce, ketchup
targets: title: linda s new england fried clams ingredients: 3 cups soft shell clams or 3 cups long neck clams, drained, and shucked vegetable oil, for deep frying 3 eggs 1 cup evaporated milk 1 teaspoon salt 1/2 cup cornflour not cornmeal lemon wedge tartar sauce ketchup directions: preheat oven to its lowest setting. line a lg. cookie sheet with double thickness of paper towels, and place it in the oven. pour vegetable oil into a deep fryer, or a lg. heavy saucepan, to a depth of about 3 . heat oil to 375 f. in a bowl, beat the eggs until well blended, then stir in the milk and salt. spread the flour on a lg. strip of wax paper. drop the clams into the egg milk mixture, and let them soak for 1 minute. pick up a handful of the soaked clams, and roll them in the flour until well coated. shake off any excess flour before dropping in the oil. immediately drop the floured clams into the hot oil, and deep fry for 1 2 mins., until golden brown. as they brown, transfer them to the towel lined pan, and keep them warm in the oven, while the rest are cooking. serve with lemon wedges, tarter sauce, and ketchup.

inputs: potatoes, onions, leeks, curry, black pepper, turmeric powder, eggs, breadcrumbs, flour, green chilies, salt, oil, water
targets: title: fish rolls ingredients: 500 500 g tuna or 500 g mackerel boiled, bones removed and cut into bite sized pieces 3 boiled potatoes, cut into small pieces 2 onions, peeled,washed and chopped 200 g leeks, washed and chopped 6 fresh curry leaves, washed and torn 3 teaspoons black pepper 1/2 teaspoon turmeric powder 2 eggs 100 g breadcrumbs 2 cups all purpose flour 2 green chilies, chopped salt oil, to fry water, as required directions: heat 2 tbsps. of oil in a pan. add onions, curry leaves, green chillies and leeks to it. mix well and cook for 5 minutes until the onions are golden brown. add salt, pepper and turmeric powders. mix well. add fish, mix well and remove from heat. add potatoes and mix well. to make a pastry, mix the flour, a pinch of turmeric powder, salt to taste, one egg and water till you get a thick batter. in a flat frying pan, prepare pancakes with this batter. put the fish mixture in the middle of these pancakes and roll them out neatly. beat the other egg and dip the rolls completely in it. then roll these in breadcrumbs and fry until golden brown. drain on clean paper kitchen napkins and serve hot.

inputs: eggs, salt, cornstarch, lemon juice, chicken, freshly ground white pepper
targets: title: avgolemono ingredients: 2 eggs, separated salt 1/2 teaspoon cornstarch 6 tablespoons lemon juice 1 cup hot chicken stock, reserved from chicken soup molyvos see recipe freshly ground white pepper to taste directions: in a stainless steel bowl, whip the egg yolks with a pinch of salt. in a separate stainless steel bowl fitted for a double boiler, whip the egg whites with a pinch of salt until fluffy. fold the yolks into the whites, blending well. bring a saucepan or the bottom of a double boiler filled with water to a simmer. in a small bowl, blend the cornstarch into the lemon juice and whisk into the egg mixture. put the bowl over the pot of simmering water, whisking constantly. in about 4 minutes, the mixture will lighten in color and the sauce will thicken. gradually add the reserved cup of hot chicken stock to the egg mixture, whisking constantly. continue cooking and whisking 2 minutes longer, until the avgolemono thickens. keep warm if necessary in the double boiler, off the heat. add to the chicken soup right before serving.

inputs: strawberries, sugar, lemon, milk, vanilla bean, butter, arborio rice, kosher salt
targets: title: risotto style strawberry rice pudding ingredients: 1 quart strawberries, rinsed and hulled 1 cup sugar 1 lemon, zest finely grated and juiced 1 quart milk 1 vanilla bean, seeds scraped 2 tablespoons butter 1 cup arborio rice pinch kosher salt directions: cut strawberries into medium size dice. in a small saucepan over medium low heat, add strawberries, 1/4 cup sugar, and lemon juice. cook until berries are soft and the juices have thickened slightly, about 10 to 15 minutes. set aside to cool. heat the milk in a medium saucepan over medium low heat until it starts to steam. remove one cup of milk, set it aside, and keep it warm. stir into the larger pan of milk the remaining sugar, the vanilla bean and seeds, and the rice. lower heat and cook, stirring constantly, until the rice is tender, about 20 minutes. add the reserved milk, lemon zest, butter, and salt. stir well and remove from the heat. this should have a more liquid consistency than regular risotto. to serve, layer rice pudding and strawberry mixture in tall clear glasses. chill.

inputs: butter, sweet onion, garlic, all purpose, chicken, potatoes, milk, pepper, bacon
targets: title: baked potato soup ingredients: 1/4 cup butter 1/2 cup chopped sweet onion 1 garlic clove, minced 1/4 cup all purpose flour 1 extra large chicken bouillon cube 1 24 oz. package frozen steam and mash potatoes 2 cups milk 1/2 teaspoon pepper toppings cooked and crumbled bacon, shredded sharp cheddar cheese, sliced green onions directions: melt butter in a dutch oven over medium heat add onion and garlic, and cook, stirring often, 5 to 10 minutes or until golden. sprinkle onion mixture with flour, and stir until coated. stir in bouillon cube and 3 cups water. bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring often. reduce heat to medium low, and simmer, stirring occasionally, 10 minutes. meanwhile, microwave potatoes according to package directions. do not add butter or milk. stir potatoes, milk, and pepper into onion mixture. cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, 10 minutes or until thickened. serve with desired toppings. the sandwich combine 1/4 cup mayonnaise 2 tbsp. reduced fat refrigerated pesto sauce and 1/3 lb. peeled, cooked, and chopped shrimp. spoon onto 6 toasted french bread slices. sprinkle with grated parmesan cheese. bake at 400 for 10 minutes or until browned and bubbly.

inputs: rice, water, pepper, chicken, carrot, celery, bell pepper, onion, margarine
targets: title: confetti rice ingredients: 2 c. rice 5 c. water 1/2 tsp. pepper 10 chicken bouillon cubes 1 grated carrot 1 c. chopped celery 1 chopped bell pepper 1 chopped onion 1 cube margarine 1/2 c. directions: in large saucepan, bring rice, water, pepper and chicken bouillon cubes to a boil. then turn down to simmer. add carrot, celery, bell pepper, onion and margarine. mix and cover. cook slow until water is gone and rice is fluffy.

inputs: onions, oleo, flour, water, chicken bouillon, garlic powder, pepper, broccoli, milk, cream, american cheese
targets: title: broccoli soup ingredients: 3/4 cup onions, chopped 1/4 cup oleo 1/3 cup flour 6 cups water or broth 3 tsp. chicken bouillon if water 1 tsp. garlic powder 1/2 tsp. pepper 1 10 oz. frozen chopped broccoli 1 cup milk 1 cup half half cream 8 oz. cut up american cheese directions: saute the onions in margarine 5 minutes, high heat. reduce the heat to medium and stir in the flour. add the broth or water , garlic powder and pepper. bring back to a boil. add broccoli defrosted and simmer 10 minutes. add the milk, half half and cheese and cook until the cheese melts.

inputs: chipotle chiles, butter, onion, green bell pepper, garlic, flour, tomatoes, hot cooked elbow macaroni, cheddar cheese, cottage cheese, milk, parmesan cheese, egg, cooking spray, breadcrumbs
targets: title: chipotle macaroni and cheese ingredients: 1 7 ounce can chipotle chiles in adobo sauce 1 tablespoon butter 1/2 cup finely chopped onion 1/2 cup finely chopped green bell pepper 1 garlic clove, minced 2 tablespoons all purpose flour 1 14 1/2 ounce can diced tomatoes and green chiles, undrained 4 cups hot cooked elbow macaroni about 2 cups uncooked 2 cups 8 ounces shredded reduced fat sharp cheddar cheese 1 cup 1 low fat cottage cheese 1 cup 2 reduced fat milk 1/4 cup 1 ounce grated fresh parmesan cheese 1 large egg, lightly beaten cooking spray 3 tablespoons dry breadcrumbs directions: preheat oven to 350 . remove 1 teaspoon adobo sauce from can set aside. remove 2 chipotle chiles from can finely chop to measure 1 tablespoon. reserve remaining chiles and adobo sauce for another use. melt butter in a dutch oven over medium high heat. add chopped chiles, onion, bell pepper, and garlic cook 4 minutes or until onion is tender, stirring frequently. sprinkle with flour cook 30 seconds, stirring constantly. reduce heat to medium add tomatoes. cook 3 minutes or until thickened. add reserved 1 teaspoon adobo sauce, pasta, cheddar cheese, cottage cheese, milk, parmesan, and egg stir to combine. spoon pasta mixture into a 2 quart baking dish coated with cooking spray top with breadcrumbs. bake at 350 for 30 minutes or until bubbly.

inputs: olive oil, garlic, portobello mushroom caps, salt, milk ricotta cheese, asiago cheese, egg, nutmeg, ground black pepper, low carb marinara sauce
targets: title: portobello mushroom stacked lasagna ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive oil 2 large garlic cloves, minced, divided 8 extra large portobello mushroom caps, stems and gills removed 1 14 teaspoons salt, divided 1 15 ounce container whole milk ricotta cheese 1 10 ounce package frozen chopped spinach, thawed 23 cup coarsely shredded asiago cheese 1 egg, lightly beaten 14 teaspoon freshly grated nutmeg optional 14 teaspoon fresh ground black pepper 34 cup low carb marinara sauce, divided directions: preheat oven to 425f. combine oil and one minced clove of garlic in a small saucepan and heat over medium heat until aromatic and lightly golden. brush oil onto both sides of mushrooms and season with 1 tsp of salt. arrange caps smooth side up in a single layer in a baking pan. bake 10 minutes. meanwhile, stir together ricotta, spinach, asiago cheese, egg, nutmeg if using , 1/4 tsp salt, pepper, and remaining garlic in a large bowl. remove mushrooms from the oven. turn over 4 caps so that the underside is up, and divide the filling evenly among caps. drizzle 1 tb marinara sauce over each cap. top with remaining caps, top side up. alternatively, trim caps into uniform squares and slice them horizontally to make 4 squares out of 2 caps. place 1 square on bottom in pan. spread 1/3 of filling on first layer of mushrooms. repeat layers with remaining ingredients to end with mushroom cap on top. for either version, pour remaining marinara sauce evenly over mushrooms and bake 12 14 minutes more, or until filling is hot and slightly puffy. remove from oven, and using a large spatula, lift stack off baking pan, including any stuffing. serve hot.

inputs: pared, orange marmalade, lemon juice, margarine
targets: title: lemon orange carrots ingredients: 3 c. pared, sliced carrots, cooked and drained 1/2 c. orange marmalade 2 tbsp. realemon lemon juice 2 tbsp. margarine directions: in medium saucepan, combine carrots, marmalade, realemon and margarine. stir to coat evenly. heat through.

inputs: olive oil, onions, chicken broth, water, pearl barley, butternut squash, cilantro freshly, lemon zest freshly, lemon juice, garlic, salt
targets: title: butternut squash and pearl barley pilaf ingredients: 2 teaspoons olive oil, extra virgin 1 medium onions chopped 14 ounces chicken broth, low salt or vegetable broth, about 1 can 1 3/4 cups water 1 cup pearl barley 2 cups butternut squash peeled and cubed, 1 inch cube 1/2 cup cilantro freshly chopped, or parsley leaves 1 teaspoon lemon zest freshly grated 1 tablespoon lemon juice 2 cloves garlic minced, more or less to taste 1 x salt and black pepper to taste directions: heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. add onion and cook, stirring often, until softened, about 3 minutes. add chicken or vegetable broth, water, barley and squash bring to a simmer, reduce heat to medium low and simmer until the barley and squash are tender and most of the liquid has been absorbed, about 48 minutes. add cilantro or parsley , lemon zest, lemon juice, garlic, salt and pepper mix gently. serve warm.

inputs: chorizo sausage, ground, pinto beans, chili powder, cumin, lettuce, tomato, green onion, taco salad shells, shredded cheese mexican, cilantro, garlic, limes, avocado oil, sugar
targets: title: chorizo beef taco salad with lime cilantro dressing ingredients: 1/2 package chorizo sausage 1/2 pound hamburger ground 1 can pinto beans rinsed 1 teaspoon chili powder 1 teaspoon cumin 1 cup lettuce 1 tomato 1/2 bunch green onion 1 box taco salad shells 1 cup shredded cheese mexican blend 1 bunch cilantro 2 cloves garlic 2 limes 1/2 cup avocado oil 1 tablespoon sugar directions: chorizo beef salad ingredients 1 10 add your chorizo, ground hamburger and beans to a pan. sprinkle the cumin and chili powder on top. start sauteing everything together until the sausage and meat are completely cooked through and no longer pink. when cooked put the meat into a strainer to drain off. lime cilantro dressing ingredients 11 15 add all ingredients but the oil. put the top on the food processor. add oil into the top funnel and blend until the consistency you prefer. add all ingredients together enjoy

inputs: flour, baking powder, cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg, salt, walnuts, sugar, pumpkin, lemon juice, eggs, vanilla, powdered sugar, cream cheese, butter
targets: title: pumpkin roll ingredients: 3/4 c. flour 1 tsp. baking powder 2 tsp. cinnamon 1 tsp. ginger 1/2 tsp. nutmeg 1/2 tsp. salt 1 c. chopped walnuts 1 c. sugar 2/3 c. pumpkin 1 tsp. lemon juice 3 eggs 1 tsp. vanilla 1 c. powdered sugar 2 3 oz. cream cheese 4 tbsp. butter directions: beat 3 eggs on high speed 5 minutes. add sugar, pumpkin and lemon juice and stir. sift together flour, baking powder, cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg and salt. fold into pumpkin mixture. spread in a greased paper lined cookie sheet. top with 1 cup walnuts. bake 15 minutes at 375 . turn out on sugared towel. roll and cool. make filing of powdered sugar, cheese, butter and vanilla and spread over cooled, unrolled cake and roll again. sprinkle with powdered sugar.

inputs: flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt, ground cinnamon, ground nutmeg, sugar, eggs, canola oil, pumpkin puree, water, vanilla
targets: title: pumpkin bread foster s market or muffins or bundt cake ingredients: 3 1/2 cups all purpose flour 2 teaspoons baking powder 1 teaspoon baking soda 1 teaspoon salt 1 tablespoon ground cinnamon 1 tablespoon ground nutmeg 2 1/2 cups sugar 4 large eggs 1 cup canola oil or 1 cup safflower oil 1 15 ounce can pumpkin puree 1/2 cup water 1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract directions: preheat the oven to 350 degrees. grease and lightly flour two 9 by 5 by 3 inch loaf pans or one 12 cup bundt pan. or line 24 muffin cups with paper muffin cup liners . sift together the flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt, cinnamon and nutmeg in a large bowl and set aside. whisk together the sugar, eggs, and oil in a separate bowl until well blended. stir in the pumpkin, water and vanilla and mix well. add the flour mixture to the pumpkin mixture and stir just until all the ingredients are moist. do not over mix. pour the batter evenly into the prepared pans and bake about 1 hour or until a toothpick inserted into the center of each loaf comes out clean start checking at about the 45 minute mark . if making muffins, bake for about 15 minutes. let rest for 10 to 15 minutes before removing from the pans.

inputs: sausage, onion, salt, worcestershire sauce, water, tomatoes, sugar, pepper, rice
targets: title: sausage and rice casserole ingredients: 1 lb. sausage 1 medium onion, diced 1 tsp. salt 1/2 tsp. worcestershire sauce 1 c. water or v 8 2 1/2 c. canned tomatoes 2 tsp. sugar pepper 1 c. uncooked rice directions: in a large skillet, brown and crumble sausage drain most of fat off. add onion and saute lightly. add tomatoes, worcestershire, water or v 8, salt, pepper and sugar. mix well over heat until mixture comes to a boil. stir in rice. reduce heat to simmer cover. stir occasionally. cook 25 to 30 minutes, until rice is cooked and all liquid is absorbed. if rice starts to dry out prior to 20 minutes, add more liquid.

inputs: butter, flour, salt, chicken stock, milk
targets: title: chicken ala king recipe ingredients: 2 c. butter 2 c. flour 1 tbsp. salt 6 c. chicken stock 5 c. homogenized lowfat milk directions: add in 1 1/2 c. mushrooms 1 c. pimento 2 c. frzn peas cook till thick butter, flour, salt, chicken stock and lowfat milk. add in remaining ingredients. serves 25 people. serve over biscuits or possibly small pie shells. good for showers.

inputs: tomatoes, shallot, extra virgin olive oil, lemon juice, salt, freshly ground black pepper, egg whites, kosher salt, ground fennel, branzino, zucchini, garlic, basil
targets: title: salt baked branzino with zucchini pistou ingredients: 12 ounces cherry tomatoes, preferably heirloom 1 tablespoon minced shallot 1/2 cup extra virgin olive oil 4 teaspoons fresh lemon juice sea salt freshly ground black pepper 6 large egg whites about 3/4 cup , lightly beaten 7 cups kosher salt about 2 1/2 pounds , plus more for seasoning 1/4 cup ground fennel 2 whole branzino about 1 1/4 pounds each , cleaned 1 1/4 pounds zucchini 2 garlic cloves, thinly sliced 1/2 cup basil leaves, plus more for garnish directions: bring a medium saucepan of water to a boil and fill a bowl with ice water. using a sharp paring knife, score an x on the bottoms of the tomatoes and blanch them in the boiling water for 5 seconds drain immediately and chill in the ice water. drain again. peel the tomatoes. in a small bowl, toss the tomatoes with the shallot, 2 tablespoons of the olive oil and 2 teaspoons of lemon juice and season with salt and pepper. refrigerate. preheat the oven to 400. in a large bowl, stir the egg whites with the 7 cups of kosher salt, the fennel and 3/4 cup of water until the mixture resembles moist sand. spread a scant 1/2 inch thick layer of the salt in an oval baking dish large enough to hold both fish. pat the salt into a neat oval and place the fish belly to belly, on top. pack the remaining salt on top of and around the fish. poke a hole into the crust at the thickest part of the fish, behind the head. bake for 25 to 30 minutes, until an instant read thermometer inserted in the hole registers 135. transfer the dish to a warm place and let the fish rest for 10 minutes. meanwhile, quarter the zucchini lengthwise and cut out the seed cores discard the cores or save for soup. cut each quarter into 2 inch pieces. in a small saucepan, combine the zucchini pieces with the remaining 6 tablespoons of olive oil and the garlic and bring to a boil over high heat. add the 1/2 cup of basil leaves and cook for 1 minute. transfer the mixture to a blender. add the remaining 2 teaspoons of lemon juice and 1 teaspoon of kosher salt and pulse to a chunky puree. run a serrated knife horizontally around the base of the salt mound and carefully remove the top crust. transfer the fish to a work surface and fillet them, removing the skin. transfer to plates. spoon the zucchini pistou around the fish and garnish with the tomatoes. drizzle some of the tomato marinade on top and garnish with basil leaves. serve right away.

inputs: chicken breasts, durkees red hot sauce, olive oil, lemon, salt, pepper, bleu cheese salad dressing, celery
targets: title: buffalo chicken salad sandwich ingredients: 3 chicken breasts 1/4 cup durkees red hot sauce or 1/4 cup tabasco sauce 1/2 cup olive oil 1 lemon, juice of salt pepper 1/2 cup bleu cheese salad dressing 1 cup chopped celery directions: mix the durkees, olive oil, lemon juice, and salt and pepper together. marinate the chicken breasts in this overnight, covered and refrigerated. remove chicken, discard marinade and bake in oven at 350 until juices run clear and no longer pink. allow to cool. slice into tiny pieces, and mix with the celery and blue cheese dressing.

inputs: mixed fruit, fruit mincemeat, butter, brown sugar, freshly squeezed orange juice, semi sweet chocolate chips, eggs, flour, flour, nuts
targets: title: christmas squares ingredients: 2 cups dried mixed fruit 1 jar 15 oz fruit mincemeat 8 tbsp 1 stick butter, chopped 1/2 cup firmly packed dark brown sugar 1 tbsp grated orange peel 1/4 cup freshly squeezed orange juice 1/2 cup semi sweet chocolate chips 2 none eggs, lightly beaten 1 cup flour 1/4 cup self rising flour 1 cup coarsely chopped brazil nuts directions: place dried fruit, fruit mincemeat, butter, sugar, and orange peel and juice in a large saucepan on low heat. stir until sugar dissolves and butter melts. remove from heat cool. preheat the oven to 325 f. lightly grease and line a 12 x 8 inch baking pan with parchment paper, extending paper at long sides for handles. stir chocolate chips and egg into fruit mixture. sift flours over mixture stir to combine. spread mixture into prepared pan. top with nuts. bake for 45 50 mins or until a skewer inserted at center comes out clean. cool in pan on a wire rack. cut into squares to serve.

inputs: sugar, butter, baking soda, sour milk, eggs, bananas, flour, nuts
targets: title: old fashioned banana bread ingredients: 1 cup sugar 1/2 cup butter or 1/2 cup margarine 1 teaspoon baking soda 1 tablespoon sour milk or 1 tablespoon orange juice 2 eggs, beaten 3 ripe bananas, mashed 2 cups flour 1/4 cup chopped nuts directions: preheat oven to 350. mix butter and sugar together until smooth. mix baking soda and sour milk or orange juice, and set aside. add eggs, bananas, baking soda mixture, and flour to butter and sugar mixture, mixing well after each addition. stir in nuts. pour into greased or buttered loaf pan. bake at 350 for 1 hour. cool completely before slicing.

inputs: cocoa, coffee, chocolate curls
targets: title: holiday cocoa java ingredients: 1 envelope instant hot cocoa mix 6 oz. prepared instant or brewed maxwell house coffee or yuban coffee rite aid 5.99 thru 02/06 thawed cool whip whipped topping chocolate curls optional directions: empty contents of 1 envelope instant hot cocoa mix into large cup or mug. add hot prepared coffee stir until dissolved. serve with whipped topping and garnish with chocolate curls, if desired.

inputs: garlic, garlic, extra virgin olive oil, potato, carrot, onions, celeriac, parsnip, water, salt, thyme, heavy cream
targets: title: cream of garlic soup with root vegetables ingredients: 20 garlic cloves, plus 5 garlic cloves 12 cup extra virgin olive oil 1 large potato, peeled and cubed 1 medium carrot, scraped and cubed 2 medium onions, cubed 1 medium celeriac, peeled and cubed 1 small parsnip, peeled and cubed 3 quarts water salt and black pepper 1 sprig fresh thyme 12 cup heavy cream directions: preheat your oven to 375 f. place 20 cloves of peeled garlic in a small baking pan, and pour over 1/4 cup olive oil. bake 30 minutes, or until tender. in a large pot, heat the remaining 1/4 cup olive oil and saute the root vegetables with 5 cloves garlic, 5 to 8 minutes. add water, salt, pepper and thyme, bring to a boil and cook over medium heat 40 minutes. add the baked garlic with its oil to the soup, and grind with a stick blender or food processor. straiin and add the 1/2 cup heavy cream. taste and adust seasonings. serve and enjoy for a decorative presentation, serve with puff pastry croutons, posted seperately. makes 8 servings.

inputs: cookies, butter, gelatin, cream cheese, caster sugar, vanilla essence, cream, peaches, water, water
targets: title: peach melba cheesecake ingredients: 150 g biscuits cookies, shredded wheatmeal suggested 75 g butter melted 2 teaspoons gelatin powdered 500 g cream cheese room temperature, chopped 1/2 cup caster sugar 1 teaspoon vanilla essence 300 ml cream 400 g peaches sliced in juice, drained 85 g jelly crystals jello, raspberry flavoured 1 cup water boiling 200 ml water cold directions: grease and line a 6cm deep, 22cm round springform pan with baking paper. process biscuits to make fine crumbs and then add butter and process until combined. press mix evenly over base of prepared pan and chill till needed. sprinkle gelatine over 2 tablespoons boiling water in a small heatproof jug and stir until completely dissolved, cool slightly. process cream cheese, sugar, vanilla and cream until smooth. with motor running, add gelatine mixture until combined. arrange drained peaches over the biscuit base and spoon cream cheese mixture over peaches and smooth the surface. cover with plastic food wrap and chill for 3 hours or until firm. combine the jelly crystal and 1 cup boiling water in a medium heatproof bowl and stir until jelly is completely disssolved and then stir in 200ml cold water and set aside to cool. pour jelly gently over cheesecake and chill for 3 hours or until set.

inputs: barbecue pork, lima beans, corn, niblets corn, tomatoes, potatoes, onion, worcestershire sauce, lemon
targets: title: brunswick stew ingredients: 1 large can barbecue pork or 3 small cans castlebury s 1 can lima beans, drained 1 can creamed corn 1 can niblets corn, drained 1 can chopped or stewed tomatoes 1 can sliced potatoes, drained 1 large onion, chopped 1 tbsp. worcestershire sauce juice of 1/2 lemon directions: cook in crock pot all day. start on high for 2 hours. turn to low for as long as you want. stir occasionally.

inputs: roses, water, sugar, roses
targets: title: limonada de rosas rose lemonade ingredients: 1 dozen roses only the petals 1 liter boiling water 4 limes, juice of sugar, to taste 1 drop of essence roses optional directions: wash, very softly, the petals. put them in a bowl. pour immediately the boiling water and cover. let it settle for an hour to infuse the water. filter the water and add the lime juice and the sugar. pour a drop of essence if you want a stronger rose taste. serve chilled.

inputs: yellow cake, eggs, cooking oil, water, vanilla instant pudding, sour cream, chocolate, chocolate chips, pecans
targets: title: robert redford cake ingredients: 1 yellow cake mix no pudding 3 eggs 1/3 c. cooking oil 1/2 c. water 1 small box vanilla instant pudding mix 1 c. sour cream 1 6 oz. german chocolate, grated, do not melt 1 6 oz. pkg. chocolate chips 1 c. chopped pecans directions: mix all ingredients except chocolate chips and nuts at one time. sprinkle flour on nuts and chips and add last. beat with electric mixer at high speed for 2 1/2 minutes. bake in greased and floured bundt pan or tube pan at 350 for 55 to 60 minutes or until done.

inputs: chicken, mixed spices, garlic, salt, bread crumbs, parmesan cheese, potatoes, onion, vegetable coating spray
