the topping. sprinkle the inside of each potato with a little salt. ladle a generous amount of mushroom ragout onto each potato, letting the excess spill over the sides and onto the plate yes, it s messy, but it s the best part . finish with a sprinkling of parsley or dill, if desired, and lots of black pepper. serve immediately. isabelle boucher is a well known food blogger who resides in inputs: mushrooms, italian sausage, onion, garlic, provolone cheese, breadcrumbs, egg, butter
targets: title: sausage stuffed mushrooms ingredients: 24 mushrooms, remove and chop stems 12 lb italian sausage 12 cup onion, finely chopped 1 garlic clove, minced 14 cup provolone cheese, shredded 14 cup dry breadcrumbs 1 egg, slightly beaten 2 tablespoons butter, melted directions: in skillet, cook sausage, stirring to separate, add some chopped stems, onions, garlic, salt and pepper and cook until sausage is browned and mushrooms are tender. spoon off fat. if sausage is not separate enough, pulse in cuisinart to separate stir in cheese, bread crumbs and egg. stuff mushrooms and lightly brush with melted butter. arrange on rack in broiler and broil 4 inches from heat until lightly browned.

inputs: lean, rice vinegar, soy sauce, fresh ginger, sesame oil, five spice powder, garlic, cooking spray, water
targets: title: pork roast with plum glaze ingredients: 1 1 1/2 pound lean, boned pork loin roast 2 tablespoons rice vinegar 2 tablespoons low sodium soy sauce 2 teaspoons grated peeled fresh ginger 1 teaspoon sesame oil 1/2 teaspoon five spice powder optional 3 garlic cloves, crushed cooking spray 1/4 cup water plum slices optional sage sprigs optional directions: preheat oven to 425 . unroll roast trim fat. reroll roast secure at 1 inch intervals with heavy string. combine spiced plum butter and next 6 ingredients spiced plum butter through garlic in a bowl. reserve 1/4 cup plum mixture set aside. place the roast on a broiler pan coated with cooking spray. insert a meat thermometer into thickest portion of roast. brush 2 tablespoons of remaining plum mixture over roast. bake at 425 for 50 minutes or until meat thermometer registers 160 slightly pink . baste occasionally with remaining plum mixture. let stand 5 minutes before slicing. strain pan drippings through a sieve into a bowl, reserving 2 tablespoons. discard remaining liquid and solids. combine reserved 1/4 cup plum mixture, pan drippings, and water in a small saucepan. bring to a boil reduce heat, and simmer 2 minutes. serve sauce with roast, and garnish with plum slices and sage sprigs, if desired.

inputs: ground round, green onions, bell pepper, rice, tomato sauce, chili powder, water, black pepper
targets: title: skillet spanish rice ingredients: 1 lb. ground round beef 1/2 c. green onions, chopped 1/2 c. bell pepper, chopped 3 c. cooked rice 1 c. tomato sauce 8 oz. can 1 tbsp. chili powder 1 1/2 c. water black pepper and salt to taste directions: brown beef in skillet. add green pepper and onion until tender. add rest of the ingredients and mix well.

inputs: flour, baking soda, salt, cinnamon, eggs, vanilla, sugar, vegetable oil, carrots, pineapple
targets: title: pineapple carrot bread ingredients: 4 c. flour 2 tsp. baking soda 2 tsp. salt 1 tbsp. cinnamon 6 eggs 4 tsp. vanilla 4 c. sugar 2 c. vegetable oil 2 c. finely grated carrots 2 c. crushed pineapple unsweetened , drained directions: sift the dry ingredients together. beat eggs and sugar until pale and thick. stir in the oil, a little at a time. add carrots, pineapple, vanilla and flour mixture. bake in greased and floured pans at 325 for about an hour test with toothpick. cool in pans for 10 minutes. turn out onto racks. makes 3 or 4 regular sized loaf pans. freezes well.

inputs: unsalted butter, brown sugar, flour, baking powder, baking soda, oats, salt, milk, plain yogurt light, eggs, honey, vanilla, raisins, blueberries
targets: title: oatmeal raisin and blueberry muffins ingredients: 6 tablespoons unsalted butter 1 1/16 cups brown sugar 1 5/8 cups flour 1/2 tablespoon baking powder 1 teaspoon baking soda 1 1/8 cups oats salt 4 7/8 tablespoons milk 5/8 cup plain yogurt light 3 eggs beaten 4 3/4 tablespoons honey 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract 1/8 cup raisins 1/8 cup blueberries directions: preheat the oven to 200 degrees celsius. mix the butter and brown sugar in a bowl with an electric mixer until the ingredients are creamy. on a separate bowl, mix the flour, baking powder, baking soda, oats, and a pinch of salt. in another bowl mix the milk and yogurt. add the eggs and honey to the bowl with the sugar and butter mixture. add the dry ingredients to milk/yogurt mixture. add the butter/sugar mixture and stir well. add the raisins and blueberries and mix everything together. place muffin cups into a muffin baking sheet and pour in the batter in each section. lower the heat from the oven to 180 c. place the muffin pan into the oven and bake for 15 minutes.

inputs: head lettuce, cauliflower, onion, colby cheese, bacon, miracle, sugar
targets: title: overnight salad ingredients: 1 head lettuce 1 head cauliflower, cut fine 1 onion, finely chopped 1 lb. colby cheese mild , shredded 1 lb. bacon, fried crisp and crumbled 3 c. miracle whip 3/4 c. sugar directions: layer in order of ingredients. keep in layers do not mix together. mix in separate bowl miracle whip and sugar. spread on top of salad. cover with lid or foil and let sit in refrigerator at least 24 hours before serving. mix just before serving.

inputs: butter, graham cracker crumbs, condensed milk, chocolate chips, peanut butter
targets: title: double delicious cookie bars ingredients: 1/2 c. butter or margarine 1 1/2 c. graham cracker crumbs 1 14 oz. sweetened condensed milk 1 12 oz. pkg. chocolate chips 1 12 oz. pkg. peanut butter chips directions: preheat oven to 350 . in a 13 x 9 inch baking pan, melt margarine in oven. sprinkle crumbs evenly over margarine. pour sweetened condensed milk evenly over crumbs. top with chips press down firmly. bake 25 to 30 minutes or until lightly browned. cool. cut into bars.

inputs: chicken, flour, butter, milk, cream of mushroom soup, american cheese, salt, pepper, onions, mushrooms, paprika
targets: title: baked chicken that makes its own gravy ingredients: 3 to 3 1/2 lb. frying chicken pieces 1/4 c. flour 1/4 c. melted butter 2/3 c. small can evaporated milk, undiluted 1 10 1/2 oz. can cream of mushroom soup undiluted 1 c. grated process american cheese 1/2 tsp. salt 1/8 tsp. pepper 2 c. 1 lb. can whole onions, drained 1/4 lb. sliced mushrooms optional dash of paprika directions: coat chicken with flour. arrange in single layer with skin sides down in melted butter in 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking dish. bake, uncovered, in moderately hot oven at 425 for 30 minutes. turn chicken, bake until brown, 15 to 20 minutes longer or until tender. remove from oven reduce temperature to 325 . pour off excess fat. add onions and mushrooms to chicken. combine undiluted milk, soup, cheese, salt and pepper. pour over chicken. sprinkle with paprika. cover with foil. return to oven continue baking 15 to 20 minutes.

inputs: cold milk, cookies, thawed cool, blueberries
targets: title: mini lemon blueberry pudding pie bites ingredients: 1 pkg. 3.4 oz. jell o lemon flavor instant pudding 1 cup cold milk 30 square shortbread cookies 1/4 cup thawed cool whip whipped topping 1/2 cup blueberries directions: beat pudding mix and milk with whisk 2 min. pudding will be thick. spoon into resealable plastic bag press excess air from bag, then seal bag. cut small piece from one bottom corner of bag use to pipe pudding onto cookies. top with cool whip and blueberries.

inputs: butter, sugar, eggs , flour, salt, baking powder, tbl, sour cream creme fraiche, heavy cream, buttermilk, cake, batter, ganache
targets: title: cold oven vanilla pound cake recipe ingredients: 8 oz. room temp butter 3c. sugar 5 eggs 2 yolks make sure your eggs are room temp as well..this insures your batter won t curdle 3c. all purpose flour sift flour 3 times before measuring this is very important 1 tsp. salt 1 sp. baking powder 2 tbl. vanilla if you have vanilla beans use 3/4 tsp vanilla scrape 1 vanilla bean with your sugar 1/2 c. sour cream creme fraiche is better 1/2 c. heavy cream for lemon poundcake 1c. buttermilk or 3/4 cup sour cream thinned with 1/4 cup milk zest of 4 lemon. add zest to butter sugar mix. top with lemon glaze. take 2 cups of powdered sugar add lemon juice until a thick but pourable consistency. marbled poud cake remove 1/2 of the batter and add 1/2 cup cocoa powder 1 oz. unsweetened, melted chocolate. i used sharffenberger brand for both . pour 1/2 vanilla base into pans plop spoonfuls of choc batter on top. pour other half of vanilla batter on top. add remaining choc batter. take a knife swirl batter. bake cool. top with choc ganache. melt 12oz.semisweet.add 12 oz scalding cream. whisk together. let cool. pour over poundcake. use any remaining ganache for truffles directions: cream butter sugar until light fluffy about 4 5 minutes. it will look almost white like a frosting. add eggs one at a time. scrape bowl down. add yolks beat until incorporated. scrape bowl down. combine your dry ingredients. whisk together sour cream, vanilla cream. add 1/3 of the flour mixture. add 1/2 the cream mixture. mix scrape down bowl. continue alternating flour cream, ending with flour. pour batter into prepared pans. put into cold oven. turn oven on to 325 bake 45min 1 hour. test with toothpick. it should come out clean the center should spring back when pressed lightly.

inputs: yellow cake mix, eggs, oil, oranges, mandarin oranges
targets: title: mandarin orange cake ingredients: 1 box yellow cake mix 3 eggs 1/2 oil 1 can mandarin oranges with juice 1 can mandarin oranges, drained directions: mix first four ingredients well. fold in last can of drained oranges. pour into two 8 inch round pans. bake at 350 for 30 minutes or until done. let cool.

inputs: sugar, butter, eggs, milk, vanilla, bread cubes, pineapple, brown sugar, pecans
targets: title: scalloped pineapple ingredients: 2 scant c. sugar 1/2 c. soft butter 2 eggs 1/2 c. milk 1 tsp. vanilla 1 qt. bread cubes 1 large can pineapple chunks juice included 1/2 c. brown sugar 1/2 c. pecans directions: mix sugar and butter. add eggs and mix well. stir in pineapple with juice add vanilla and milk. fold in bread cubes. put into buttered 9 x 12 inch pan. sprinkle top with mixture of brown sugar and pecans. bake at 350 for 40 to 50 minutes.

inputs: lasagna noodles, italian sausage, spaghetti sauce, eggs, ricotta cheese, parmesan cheese, mozzarella cheese, zucchini
targets: title: lasagna with zucchini ingredients: 16 oz. lasagna noodles 1 1/2 lb. italian sausage 48 oz. 6 c. spaghetti sauce 2 eggs 2 1/2 c. ricotta cheese 3/4 c. parmesan cheese 1 1/2 lb. mozzarella cheese, thinly sliced 1 lb. zucchini, thinly sliced directions: cook lasagna noodles as directed. drain. brown sausage and rinse with water to remove excess fat. mix eggs and ricotta cheese. spread 2 cups of spaghetti sauce over bottom of 11 x 16 x 2 inch lasagna pan. top with layer of noodles. layer zucchini slices over noodles and cover with 2 cups spaghetti sauce. place layer of noodles over sauce and top with ricotta cheese mixture and half of parmesan and mozzarella cheeses. place a layer of noodles over ricotta cheese. top with sausage and 2 cups of spaghetti sauce. top with remaining noodles and remaining parmesan and mozzarella cheeses. bake at 350 for 1 hour.

inputs: oil, cornmeal, flour, baking powder, egg, milk, corn kernels, milk, parsley
targets: title: fried cakes corn cakes ingredients: neutral oil 3/4 cup cornmeal 1/2 cup flour 2 teaspoons baking powder 1 egg 3/4 cup milk 2 cups corn kernels add milk if needed parsley directions: put neutral oil in a skillet on medium heat. combine 3/4 cup cornmeal, 1/2 cup flour and 2 teaspoons baking powder. beat 1 egg with 3/4 cup milk pour into dry ingredients along with 2 cups corn kernels. add milk if needed. drop spoonfuls into the oil brown on both sides, 4 to 5 minutes total. garnish parsley.

inputs: marshmallows, chocolate ice cream, graham cracker rectangles, chocolate milk
targets: title: s mores shake shots ingredients: 8 large marshmallows 3 cup chocolate ice cream 4 graham cracker rectangles 1 cup chocolate milk directions: set oven control to broil. line a small cookie sheet with sides with cooking parchment paper. place marshmallows on cookie sheet. broil 2 minutes or until toasted. meanwhile, in a blender, place ice cream, milk and 2 graham crackers. cover. blend on medium speed until smooth. crumble remaining graham crackers. sprinkle crumbs evenly into 8 large shot glasses. pour ice cream mixture evenly over crumbs. top each with 1 toasted marshmallow.

inputs: garlic, rosemary, mayonnaise, tapenade, olive oil, balsamic vinegar
targets: title: tapenade rosemary aioli ingredients: 3 garlic cloves, peeled 1 tablespoon chopped fresh rosemary 2/3 cup mayonnaise 3 tablespoons tapenade 2 tablespoons olive oil preferably extra virgin 2 teaspoons balsamic vinegar directions: with machine running, drop garlic and rosemary through feed tube of processor and finely chop. add mayonnaise, tapenade, oil and vinegar and process until well blended. season to taste with salt and pepper. transfer to small bowl. can be made 1 day ahead. cover and chill.

inputs: pineapple, oakfarms butter, pineapple syrup, cornstarch, soy sauce, vinegar, non caloric, tuna, mushrooms, salt, pepper, rice
targets: title: mock oriental dinner ingredients: 1 no. 2 can stokely s pineapple, sliced, cut in bits 1 tsp. oakfarms butter 2/3 c. pineapple syrup 2 tbsp. cornstarch 2 tbsp. soy sauce 2 tbsp. vinegar 3 non caloric sweetened tablets 1 can tuna, flaked 1 3 oz. can mushrooms, sliced and broiled 1/4 tsp. salt dash of pepper durand s quick rice directions: cook pineapple, butter and 1/3 cup pineapple syrup 5 minutes. combine cornstarch and remaining 1/3 cup syrup to make thin paste. gradually stir into pineapple mix. add soy sauce, vinegar and non caloric sweetener. cook, stirring constantly, until thickened and smooth. add tuna and mushrooms, salt and pepper. heat well. prepare durand s quick rice. place in deep platter. top with pineapple mixture. serve at once.

inputs: baking potatoes, peppers, onion, cheddar cheese, sour cream, corn chips
targets: title: twice baked potato ole ingredients: 4 large baking potatoes 4 jalapeno peppers, diced 14 cup onion, diced 1 cup cheddar cheese, shredded 8 tablespoons sour cream 12 cup crushed corn chips directions: slice potatoes length wise and place face down on a greased cookie sheet. place in preheated oven at 400 degrees for approximately 1 hour or until cooked. remove potatoes from oven and scoop the insides of the potatoes into a large mixing bowl. it s not important to get every little bit. leave a little on the skin of the potatoes. place mostly empty skins on cookie sheet scooped side up. place oven on broil and lightly toast inside of of potatoes, about 5 minutes. meanwhile back at the mixing bowl, add sour cream, diced jalapenos, diced onion, cheddar cheese, and crushed corn chips. mix well. don t eat the filling hah, told yah, it s hot isn t it remove skins from oven and fill with filling from mixing bowl. place stuffed skins back in the oven on broil until tops are slightly browned. remove stuffed skins from oven, allow to cool a bit remember how hot the filling was and then serve. recipe can be cut in half for two people or doubled for a larger group.

inputs: papayas, sugar, cornstarch, ground coriander, ground cardamom, ground nutmeg, lemon juice, pastry, flour
targets: title: papaya pie ingredients: 3 pounds firm ripe papayas 3/4 cup sugar 1/4 cup cornstarch 1 teaspoon ground coriander 1/2 teaspoon ground cardamom 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg 2 teaspoons grated lemon peel 3 tablespoons lemon juice 1 package 15 oz. refrigerated pastry for double crust 9 inch pie, at room temperature all purpose flour directions: peel papayas, cut in half lengthwise, and discard seeds. cut papayas lengthwise into 2 to 3 inch wide slices, then cut crosswise into 1/4 inch thick strips. measure 8 cups of fruit reserve extra for other uses. in a large bowl, mix sugar, cornstarch, coriander, cardamom, nutmeg, and lemon peel. add papayas and lemon juice, and mix. unfold 1 pastry round and ease into a 9 inch pie pan. fill pastry with fruit mixture. unfold remaining pastry on a lightly floured board and roll into a 13 inch wide round. center round over fruit. pinch pastry at rim to seal, then fold edge under itself, flush with pan rim, and pinch to flute. slash pastry top decoratively. set pie on a foil lined baking sheet. bake on the bottom rack of a 375 oven until juices bubble near center, 1 hour and 10 minutes to 1 hour and 20 minutes 55 to 65 minutes in a convection oven . if pastry edges get too dark, cover loosely with foil. cool at least 1 hour. cut into wedges.

inputs: pear juice, cherry jello, boiling water, port wine, pear
targets: title: port wine salad recipe ingredients: 1/2 c. pear juice 2 pkg. cherry jello 2 1/2 c. boiling water 1 c. port wine 12 pear halves directions: prepare cherry jello with pear juice and boiling water. let cold 5 10 min. add in wine and pear halves. serve with golden brown dressing. an easy salad to prepare and pretty in a ring mold or possibly in attractive individual molds.

inputs: ingredients, baking powder, nutmeg, salt, coconut sugar, cricket flour, coconut flour, buckwheat flour, ingredients, eggs, vanilla, water, milk, butter, toppings, strawberries, powdered sugar, maple syrup
targets: title: cricket pancakes ingredients: dry ingredients 1 teaspoon baking powder 1/4 teaspoon nutmeg 1/4 teaspoon salt 3 tablespoons coconut sugar 1/4 cup cricket flour 1/3 cup coconut flour 1/3 cup buckwheat flour wet ingredients 3 eggs 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract 1/4 cup water 3/4 cup milk 1 tablespoon butter toppings 1/2 cup chopped or diced strawberries 1 teaspoon powdered sugar 1/4 cup raw maple syrup directions: in a large bowl, combine dry ingredients whisk together wet ingredients heat griddle pan or large skillet over medium heat. tip if you don t have a big griddle pan, heat two large skillets at the same time to move your pancake assembly line into high gear. pour pancakes to desired diameter into warm skillet. flip pancakes when you see the first bubble and slight central puffyness you will see fewer bubbles than regular pancakes pancakes are fully cooked when both sides are a deep golden brown. garnish pancakes with strawberries, powdered sugar, and maple syrup. for dairy free or more paleo version

inputs: onion, kernels, rosemary, butter, sugar, , yellow cornmeal, heavy cream, kosher salt, ground pepper
targets: title: thanksgiving creamed corn ingredients: 1/2 whole medium onion, diced 1 bag 16 oz. frozen corn kernels 1 sprig rosemary, bruised 1 tablespoon butter 1 tablespoon sugar 1/4 teaspoons turmeric 2 tablespoons yellow cornmeal 1 cup heavy cream kosher salt to taste ground pepper to taste directions: put frozen corn out to defrost. in a large saucepan, start to sweat the diced onion in butter. once onions have begun to sweat, add all the corn. add the bruised rosemary and stir. the trick i learned was to just keep stirring this to make sure everything is combined, and use a good whisk. sprinkle on sugar and turmeric stir. then stir in cornmeal until combined. add the cream and stir until combined. let the mixture cook until corn is softened, about 5 minutes. don t forget to remove the rosemary add salt and pepper to taste and serve. enjoy

inputs: ground beef, bacon, onions, garlic, salt, cayenne, beer, beef broth, tomato paste, chili powder, ground oregano, brown sugar, green chilies, cumin
targets: title: chili ingredients: 3 lb. ground beef coarse bacon grease 2 medium onions, chopped 1 tsp. each garlic powder and celery salt 1 tsp. each salt and black pepper 1/2 tsp. cayenne 1 12 oz. can beer 1 14 1/2 oz. can beef broth 1 12 oz. can tomato paste 5 tbsp. chili powder 1 tsp. ground oregano 2 tsp. brown sugar 1 8 oz. can chopped green chilies 1 tbsp. and 1 tsp. cumin directions: brown ground beef in a small amount of bacon grease drain. add onions, garlic powder, celery salt, salt, pepper, cayenne, beer, beef broth and enough water to cover meat. simmer for 30 minutes. add tomato paste, chili powder, oregano, brown sugar and green chilies. simmer about 45 minutes. cool, then add cumin when ready to serve.

inputs: brown rice, butter, garlic, olive oil, salt, fresh ground pepper, bing cherries, walnuts
targets: title: cherry walnut rice ingredients: 1 cup uncooked brown rice, preferably short grain 12 tablespoon butter 12 teaspoon garlic powder olive oil optional 12 teaspoon salt fresh ground pepper 12 15 pitted bing cherries, rough chopped 3 tablespoons toasted chopped walnuts directions: cook the rice according to your package directions. as soon as it is done cooking, transfer the rice to a mixing bowl. add in the butter, garlic powder, a small drizzle of olive oil, 1/2 tsp salt and a pinch of black pepper. stir until well combined. add in the cherries and walnuts and mix again until everything is evenly distributed. enjoy as a side dish to your favorite dinner or you can toss in some cubes of cooked chicken breast and serve it over your favorite salad greens. make this dish vegan by substituting vegan butter, such as earth balance. to toast the walnuts, place in the middle of a 350 oven on a cookie sheet for about 15 minutes.

inputs: red grapes, peppers, fresh gingerroot, cinnamon, star anise, coriander seeds, brown sugar, white wine vinegar, water, red wine, canning salt
targets: title: sweet spicy pickled red seedless grapes ingredients: 5 cups seedless red grapes 4 jalapeno peppers, seeded and sliced 2 tablespoons minced fresh gingerroot 2 cinnamon sticks 3 inches , halved 4 whole star anise 2 teaspoons coriander seeds 2 teaspoons mustard seed 2 cups packed brown sugar 2 cups white wine vinegar 1 cup water 1 cup dry red wine 1 1/2 teaspoons canning salt directions: pack grapes into four hot 1 pint jars to within 1 1/2 in. of the top. divide jalapenos, ginger, cinnamon, star anise, coriander seeds and mustard seed among jars. in a large saucepan, combine brown sugar, vinegar, water, wine and canning salt. bring to a boil cook until liquid is reduced to 3 cups, 15 18 minutes. carefully ladle hot liquid over grape mixture, leaving 1/2 in. headspace. remove air bubbles and adjust headspace, if necessary, by adding hot liquid. wipe rims. center lids on jars screw on bands until fingertip tight. place jars into canner, ensuring that they are completely covered with water. bring to a boil process for 10 minutes. remove jars and cool.

inputs: savoy cabbage, salt, unsalted butter, onions, garlic, sage, eggs, kosher salt, ground allspice, fresh ground black pepper, ground pork, fresh breadcrumb, parsley, thyme, bay leaf, berries, chicken stock, section
targets: title: stuffed whole cabbage ingredients: 1 medium savoy cabbage or 1 small savoy cabbage salt 2 tablespoons unsalted butter 2 onions, diced 3 garlic cloves, minced 20 fresh sage leaves, shredded 2 eggs 2 1/2 teaspoons kosher salt 1 teaspoon ground allspice fresh ground black pepper 1 1/2 lbs ground pork 1 cup fresh breadcrumb 1/4 cup chopped parsley 3 sprigs thyme 1 bay leaf 6 juniper berries, crushed 4 6 cups chicken stock one section of clean cheesecloth directions: remove the coarse outside leaves from the cabbage and trim the base. bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. blanch the cabbage for 7 minutes, then refresh under cold running water, drain well. melt the butter in a large frying pan over medium heat, add the onions, season well and cook until softened. stir in the garlic and sage the set aside to cool. whisk the eggs, salt, allspice and pepper together. pour into a large bowl and add the pork and cooled onion mixture. stir in the bread crumbs, parsley and mix well. fry a small ball of stuffing to check the seasoning. adjust the stuffing if necessary it should be well seasoned, as the cabbage will absorb it. spread a section of clean cheesecloth on the work surface and place the cabbage in the centre. open out the leaves carefully, like a flower until you reach the heart and the leaves are small and too brittle to peel back. starting with the inside circle of leaves, spread about 1 to 2 tbsp 15 to 25 ml of stuffing onto them, then fold them back around the cabbage heart. repeat with each layer of leaves, adding more stuffing to the bigger leaves. if you run out of stuffing before the last layer, don t worry, just fold those leaves to reform the cabbage. bring the cloth up around the cabbage to keep it in place and tie the opposite corners. place the cabbage, thyme, bay leaf and juniper berries into a large saucepan or flameproof casserole, and pour in enough chicken stock to come at least halfway up the side of the cabbage. add a little water if necessary. bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce the heat, cover and simmer for 2 hours. remove the cabbage and let sit for 10 minutes to drain out excess liquid. bring the cooking juices to a boil, skim and boil gently to reduce slightly. remove the cloth from the cabbage. cut the cabbage into wedges, removing the core, if desired, and serve with the some of the cooking juices spooned over.

inputs: mascarpone cheese, heavy cream, powdered sugar, pistachios, orange zest, balsamic vinegar, honey, orange
targets: title: mascarpone stuffed fresh figs and honey balsamic reduction ingredients: 1 pint fresh figs 1/2 cups mascarpone cheese 1/2 tablespoons heavy cream adjust to your preference 2 teaspoons powdered sugar add a teaspoon at a time until it reaches your desired sweetness, or you can omit it 1 tablespoon chopped pistachios for garnish 1 teaspoon orange zest optional 6 tablespoons balsamic vinegar 1 tablespoon honey orange extract optional directions: cut off the top tip of the figs, then quarter each fig but not all the way so that it can hold mascarpone mixture. mix the mascarpone, cream, and powdered sugar optional, add a teaspoon at a time to taste set aside. prepare the honey balsamic reduction. heat up a small sauce pan over medium heat. add balsamic, honey, and orange extract. bring it to boil, then lower it to low heat. simmer it until it reduces by 1/3. remove from heat and let it cool. it should get thicker. scoop mascarpone mixture into a pastry bag. if you dont have it, you can use a ziplock bag and cut a tip off. squeeze the mixture right in the middle of each fig. top with chopped pistachio and orange zest. drizzle honey balsamic on each filled fig and on the side. enjoy

inputs: chicken broth, green onions, ginger, soy sauce, white pepper, salt
targets: title: quick asian chicken broth ingredients: 12 cups chicken broth 2 green onions, cut into 2 inch pieces 4 slices ginger, lightly crushed 2 tablespoons soy sauce 1/8 teaspoon white pepper 1/4 teaspoon salt directions: combine all ingredients in a large pot. bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes. serve or cool and refrigerate for up to a week.

inputs: hamburger, mein, cream of chicken soup, mushroom soup, water, rice, soy sauce
targets: title: chow mein casserole ingredients: 1 lb. hamburger, browned 1 can chow mein 1 can cream of chicken soup 1 can mushroom soup 1 1/2 c. water 3/4 c. minute rice 3 tbsp. soy sauce directions: mix. bake at 350 for 30 minutes. top with chow mein noodles and bake for 30 minutes more.

inputs: cake, butter, caster sugar, chocolate, vanilla essence, eggs, flour, apricot jam, chocolate, icing sugar, water
targets: title: sachertorte ingredients: for the cake 3 ounces butter 4 ounces caster sugar 3 ounces chocolate 1 teaspoon vanilla essence 4 large eggs 3 ounces plain flour sifted for the filling and icing 4 tablespoons apricot jam 4 ounces chocolate 4 ounces icing sugar 2 tablespoons water directions: brush the tin with melted fat and line the base with a piece of greaseproof paper cut to fit. brush the paper lining also. beat the butter to a soft cream, then add half the sugar and cream together until light and fluffy in both colour and texture. break the chocolate for the cake into pieces and put it on a plate, over the pan of hot water. when the chocolate has melted do be very careful that it does not overheat add it to the creamed mixture with the vanilla essence. separate the eggs and beat the yolks into the chocolate mixture. whisk the egg whites until they are stiff and stand in straight peaks then fold in the rest of the sugar. finally, using a metal spoon fold the egg whites and the sifted flour into the other ingredients. turn the mixture into the tin and spread it to the sides. hollow out the centre slightly so that the cake rises evenly. bake the cake in the center shelf of a moderate oven, gas mark 4/350f/180c for about 50 minutes or until it feels firm to the touch and is slightly shrinking away from the sides of the tin. turn the cake on to a wire tray and leave it to cool. split the cake in half and sandwich it back together with half of the jam. sieve the remaining jam into a pan and heat it, then brush it on the sides and top of the cake. break the chocolate into pieces and put into a bowl with the icing sugar and water. suspend the bowl over a pan of hot water and stir the chocolate until it has melted and the icing is smooth and glossy. pour the icing over the cake and guide it down the sides so that it is completely coated, then leave to set. serve with whipped cream.

inputs: salmon, butter, brown sugar, garlic, fresh parsley, roma tomato, green bell pepper, red onion, fresh spring greens, salt
targets: title: alaskan salmon with garlic and brown sugar ingredients: 1 2 lb salmon fillets 1/4 cup butter, slightly melted 1/8 cup brown sugar 1 tablespoon garlic, mince fine 1/2 tablespoon fresh parsley, minced 1 medium roma tomato, slice very thin i call them roma tomas 1/2 large green bell pepper, slice very thin color of your choice 1/4 large red onion, slice very thin fresh spring greens, mix salt pepper directions: take two pieces of aluminum foil, big enough to fold around the fillet. double them up, place spring greens on foil. place fillet on greens and tuck greens under salmon. the greens and foil help the salmon not burn while on the grill, as well as add a little flavor as the greens cook. once salmon and greens are on foil, mix the slightly melted butter with garlic, salt and pepper. spread the butter mixture over the salmon somewhat evenly. you ll want more at the thicker end of the fillet. sprinkle the brown sugar over the fillet, again, more at the thicker end to get maximum flavor thru. slice the tomato, onion and bell pepper as thin as you can in strips. layer the sliced vegetables over the salmon how you like. make sure each vegetable spreads across the whole salmon. wrap salmon with foil and refrigerate if making early in the day, or throw on hot grill. grill should be between 350 and 375. let salmon cook. prepare any side dishes if needed, throw kabobs of choice on grill if desired. salmon should cook for at least twenty 20 minutes until you fold back foil and check if done. when salmon is light pink in the middle, and the white fat of the fillet comes to the top it s ready to eat. carefully pull salmon off grill. place on platter with foil still underneath. fold back all foil, remove vegetable if desired and sprinkle with fresh parsley. if grill is unavailable, you can broil in oven at 375 for the same amount of time.

inputs: pork, dark red kidney beans, beans, wax beans, green beans, onion flakes, garlic, barbecue sauce, bacon
targets: title: barbecue beans crock pot ingredients: 3 cans pork and beans 1 can dark red kidney beans 1 can lima beans 1 can wax beans 1 can green beans 1/2 c. dried onion flakes 1 tsp. crushed garlic 1 bottle smoky barbecue sauce 1/2 jar bacon pieces directions: drain and rinse beans, except pork and beans. mix all ingredients together in crock pot. cook 4 hours or more on low.

inputs: cabbage, melting cheese, sauce, mayonnaise, flour, katakuriko, granules, water, flour, granules, water, sauce
targets: title: melting okonomiyaki with cabbage ingredients: 200 grams cabbage 1 as required easy melting cheese 1 as required okonomiyaki sauce 1 as required mayonnaise 2 tbsp cake flour 1/2 tbsp katakuriko 1/2 tsp dashi stock granules 3 tbsp water 1 tbsp cake flour 1/2 tsp dashi stock granules 3 tbsp water 1 tsp japanese worcestershire style sauce directions: julienne the cabbage. rough or fine. combine batter a ingredients and batter b ingredients in small separate bowls, and mix. pour the batter a in a pan with oil. sprinkle a handful of cheese on top. throw a lot of cabbage on top. you could add more cheese with the cabbage. pour batter b slowly over the cabbage to fill the gaps. when the bottom batter is cooked, flip it over don t hesitate even if the cabbage goes everywhere, you can just push it into the middle. leave it until the cabbage is soft like in the picture. when it s soft, transfer to a plate. spread the okonomiyaki sauce and mayonnaise, then done you can also add ichimi spice, aonori seaweed, and bonito flakes. this is a cross section of the dish. the cheese is melting like this.

inputs: kilo, onion, clove garlic, green cabbage
targets: title: beef brisket with cabbage ingredients: 1 kilo or 2 lb. beef brisket 1 small onion, cut into 4ths 1 clove garlic, crushed 1 small head green cabbage, cut into 6 wedges directions: pour enough cold water in a large casserole enough to cover the meat. add the onion and the garlic. boil, reduce heat, cover and simmer until beef is tender, about 2 hours. remove beef and keep warm. skim fat from broth. add cabbage. heat to boiling reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, for 15 minutes. when ready, cut the meat and garnish with cabbage on a large platter. serves 4.

inputs: ground chuck, cream of mushroom soup, taco seasoning, cheddar cheese, regular
targets: title: nicole s tacos ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. ground chuck 1 can cream of mushroom soup 1 pkg. taco seasoning 16 oz. grated cheddar cheese 12 to 14 regular size flour tortillas directions: brown ground chuck. drain grease. add soup, 1/2 cup water and taco seasoning. heat until mixture is thick. spoon 2 to 3 tablespoons meat mixture in center of flour tortilla and roll. place each taco in a row, in a 9 x 13 inch glass baking dish. top with grated cheese and place in microwave or 400 preheated oven, until cheese is melted.

inputs: chutney, mustard, bread, carrots, turkey, cilantro stem
targets: title: smoked turkey sandwiches ingredients: 3 tablespoons chutney 1 tablespoon dijon mustard 8 slices raisin bread 2 carrots, peeled and grated 8 ounces smoked turkey, thinly sliced fresh cilantro stem, optional garnish directions: in a small bowl combine chutney and mustard and then spread on each slice of bread, top with the carrots. add turkey over 4 of the bread slices, topping with cilantro if desired. cover with remaining bread slices. wrap and refrigerate this can be refrigerated overnight if desired .

inputs: butter, sugar, egg, lemon zest, flour, poppy seeds, baking soda, salt, sour cream, frozen strawberries, sugar, flour, ground nutmeg, sugar, milk
targets: title: strawberry poppy seed cake ingredients: 1/2 cup butter, softened 2/3 cup sugar 1 large egg, room temperature 2 teaspoons grated lemon zest 1 1/2 cups all purpose flour 2 tablespoons poppy seeds 1/2 teaspoon baking soda 1/4 teaspoon salt 1/2 cup sour cream 2 cups sliced fresh or frozen strawberries, thawed and drained 1/3 cup sugar 2 teaspoons all purpose flour 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg 1/3 cup confectioners sugar 2 teaspoons 2 milk directions: preheat oven to 350 . in a large bowl, cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy. beat in egg and lemon zest. combine the flour, poppy seeds, baking soda and salt add to the creamed mixture alternately with sour cream, beating well after each addition. transfer to a greased and floured 9 in. springform pan spread batter slightly up sides of pan, forming a well. combine filling ingredients spoon into the well. bake until crust is golden brown, 40 45 minutes. cool for 10 minutes before removing from pan to a wire rack. in a small bowl, combine confectioners sugar and milk drizzle over cake. serve warm.

inputs: apples, lemon juice, celery, pineapple, walnuts, mayonnaise, sugar, whipping cream, lemon juice, ground nutmeg
targets: title: waldorf salad a la eunice makes 8 to 10 servings ingredients: 4 medium apples 1 tbsp. lemon juice 1/2 c. chopped celery 1/2 c. crushed pineapple 1/2 c. walnuts 1/2 c. mayonnaise or salad dressing 1 tbsp. sugar 1/2 c. whipping cream 1/2 tsp. lemon juice ground nutmeg directions: core and dice apples do not peel . in a large bowl, sprinkle cut up apples with 1 tablespoon of lemon juice to flavor and keep from discoloring. add celery, pineapple and walnuts.

inputs: sugar, flour, oil, eggs, baking soda, baking powder, cinnamon, salt, zucchini
targets: title: zucchini cake ingredients: 2 c. sugar 2 c. flour 1 1/2 c. oil 4 eggs 2 tsp. baking soda 2 tsp. baking powder 3 tsp. cinnamon pinch of salt 2 c. grated zucchini directions: mix all ingredients, except zucchini. blend well, then mix in zucchini. bake in greased and floured 13 x 9 inch pan at 350 for 45 minutes to 1 hour or until toothpick comes out clean.

inputs: yellow cake mix, vanilla pudding, eggs, sour cream, cream sherry, salad oil, poppy seed
targets: title: poppy seed cake ingredients: 1 box yellow cake mix 1 small box instant vanilla pudding mix 4 eggs 1/2 c. sour cream 1/2 c. cream sherry 1/2 c. salad oil 1/4 c. poppy seed directions: combine all ingredients, stirring until just blended. beat at medium speed with electric mixer for 2 minutes. pour batter into a well greased bundt pan or tube pan. bake at 350 for 50 minutes or until done. serve warm or cool. good with or without glaze.

inputs: macaroni, cream of mushroom soup, cheese, pimento
targets: title: cheesy macaroni and spam casserole ingredients: 1 pkg. macaroni and cheese 1 can cream of mushroom soup 2 c. cheese, grated 1 12 oz. can spam, chopped 1 8 oz. jar pimento directions: prepare macaroni and cheese dinner as directed. mix mushroom soup, spam and pimentos together. make layer of mixture spread layer of cheese. repeat layer of mixture and top with more cheese. bake at 350 until cheese is melted. serve.

inputs: fine semolina, flour, whole wheat flour, eggs, baking powder, yeast, sugar, salt, water, milk, vegetable oil
targets: title: algerian beghrir pancake ingredients: 2 cups fine semolina 1 cup plain flour 1 cup whole wheat flour 3 eggs 2 teaspoons baking powder 1 tablespoon instant yeast 2 teaspoons sugar 1 pinch salt 1 cup warm water 2 cups milk 1 tablespoon vegetable oil optional directions: combine all dry ingredients with the eggs. add the water and the milk a little at a time until you achieve a thick but runny consistency. heat a little oil in the frying pan then add just under a ladleful of batter and immediately start swirling it round the pan to get a nice even layer. leave some space near the rim so it can come out easier. watch the holes as they appear and leave it on the heat until the top dries out. traditional beghrir is quite thick and you only cook one side. however i do like them a bit thinner. that also means you are able to turn them and lightly cook the other side. it should not take more than a minute. serve it with honey, jam or nutella.

inputs: chocolate cake, cherry pie filling, oil, eggs
targets: title: black forest cherry cake ingredients: 1 box chocolate cake mix do not use pudding type 2 21 oz. cans cherry pie filling 1/4 c. oil 3 eggs 1 12 oz. cool whip directions: grease and flour a 12 cup bundt pan and preheat oven to 350 . combine cake mix, 1 can pie filling, oil and eggs beat well with mixer until smooth. pour into pan and bake for 45 to 50 minutes. cool in pan 25 minutes invert onto rack to finish cooling. when cool, cut in half to make two layers. using half a can of pie filling, cover first layer, then cover with half the cool whip. repeat with top layer. chill 1 hour and serve.

inputs: chocolate chips, black string decorating, chocolate, cotton
targets: title: halloween creepy crawler spiders ingredients: 2 bags 10 oz. size halloween semi sweet chocolate chips and orange colored morsels 1/2 cups half and half, divided 1 box 6 oz. size black string decorating candy 40 candy eyeballs 2 tablespoons chocolate malted milk powder or ovaltine cotton candy, any color for the spider web garnish directions: for the spider body separate out the chocolate chips from the orange candy morsels. in a medium size microwavable bowl, add just the orange candy morsels, 2 tablespoons of half and half, and stir. heat in the microwave for 60 seconds and then stir until the candy is completely melted. if needed, heat in the microwave for another 15 seconds and stir until the mixture is smooth. cover the bowl with plastic wrap and put it in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours or longer, until the mixture is firm enough to roll into balls. if after being in the refrigerator the mixture is too firm to roll, add a smidgen more half and half, heat again in the microwave, stir together, and let cool again in the refrigerator. next, do the same with the chocolate chips. in a medium size microwavable bowl, add the chocolate chips and remaining half and half. stir together. warm in the microwave for 60 seconds and stir together. warm in the microwave for another 30 seconds and stir until the mixture is completely smooth. cover the bowl with plastic wrap and put in the refrigerator at least 2 hours to harden. if after being in the refrigerator, it s too firm to roll, add a smidgen more half and half, warm in the microwave, stir and let cool again in the refrigerator. for the spider assembly cut the black string candy into about 3 inch long pieces for the spider legs. you ll need 6 pieces per spider. it s okay if they are a bit crooked. it actually appears to make the spider look like it s in motion if the legs aren t exactly the same. set aside. use a small spoon to scoop out the chocolate and roll it into a ball about the size of a large gumball. poke the spider legs into the top 2 sides of each chocolate ball 3 legs on each side . add 2 eyeballs to each spider and top the spider head with chocolate malted milk powder. next, repeat the process for the orange candy. it s best to first finish either the chocolate spiders or the orange spiders so the ball of chocolate or orange candy is still soft enough to poke in the legs and stick to the back of the candy eyeballs. these can be stored for a short while in the refrigerator but they should be set out before serving to soften them up slightly. just before serving, lay out cotton candy to form a spider web on a serving plate or in clear glasses such as martini glasses, and top with the creepy crawler chocolate spiders. cotton candy doesn t last very long when sitting outside of its packaging, so laying out the spider web garnish should be the last thing done before serving. recipe also found on sheknows food and recipes chocolate truffle spiders .

inputs: sugar, butter, flour, salt, eggs, vanilla extract, almond extract, almonds, sanding sugar
targets: title: katie s almond cake ingredients: 1 1/4 c. sugar 3/4 c. butter, melted 1 1/2 c. flour 1/2 tsp. salt 2 eggs 1 1/2 tsp. vanilla extract 1 tsp. almond extract 1/2 c. sliced almonds 2 t. sanding sugar directions: preheat oven to 350 f. grease 9 inch springform pan. in a large bowl, mix butter and sugar. add all other ingredients, mix well. scrape batter into pan sprinkle top with almonds and sanding sugar. bake 30 35 min.

inputs: flour, salt, butter, cold water
targets: title: one crust pie pastry ingredients: 1 cup all purpose flour 1/2 teaspoon salt 1/3 cup plus 1 tablespoon butter flavor crisco 2 3 tablespoons cold water directions: unbaked one crust pie crust . mix flour and salt in medium bowl. cut in shortening, using pastry blender or pulling 2 table knives through ingredients in opposite directions , until particles are size of small peas. sprinkle with cold water, 1 tablespoon at a time, tossing with fork until all flour is moistened and pastry almost leaves side of bowl 1 to 2 teaspoons more water can be added if necessary . gather pastry into a ball. shape into flattened round on lightly floured surface. wrap flattened round of pastry in plastic wrap and refrigerate about 45 minutes or until dough is firm and cold, yet pliable. this allows the shortening to become slightly firm, which helps make the baked pastry more flaky. if refrigerated longer, let pastry soften slightly before rolling. roll pastry, using floured rolling pin, into circle 2 inches larger than upside down 9 inch glass pie plate, or 3 inches larger than 10 or 11 inch tart pan. fold pastry into fourths place in pie plate. unfold and ease into plate, pressing firmly against bottom and side and being careful not to stretch pastry, which will cause it to shrink when baked. trim overhanging edge of pastry 1 inch from rim of pie plate. fold and roll pastry under, even with plate flute as desired. continue with directions in pie recipe. 2. baked pie crust heat oven to 475 f. mix flour and salt in medium bowl. cut in shortening, using pastry blender or pulling 2 table knives through ingredients in opposite directions , until particles are size of small peas. sprinkle with cold water, 1 tablespoon at a time, tossing with fork until all flour is moistened and pastry almost leaves side of bowl 1 to 2 teaspoons more water can be added if necessary . gather pastry into a ball. shape into flattened round on lightly floured surface. wrap flattened round of pastry in plastic wrap and refrigerate about 45 minutes or until dough is firm and cold, yet pliable. this allows the shortening to become slightly firm, which helps make the baked pastry more flaky. if refrigerated longer, let pastry soften slightly before rolling. roll pastry, using floured rolling pin, into circle 2 inches larger than upside down 9 inch glass pie plate. fold pastry into fourths place in pie plate. unfold and ease into plate, pressing firmly against bottom and side. for pie, trim overhanging edge of pastry 1 inch from rim of pie plate. fold and roll pastry under, even with plate flute as desired. for tart, trim overhanging edge of pastry even with top of tart pan. prick bottom and side of pastry thoroughly with fork. bake 8 to 10 minutes or until light brown cool on wire rack.

inputs: flour, brown sugar, butter, molasses, baking soda, boiling water
targets: title: shoo fly cake crustless ingredients: 4 c. flour 2 c. brown sugar 1 c. butter or margarine 1 c. molasses 1/2 c. light mild flavor, 1/2 c. table syrup 2 tsp. baking soda 2 c. boiling water directions: add to crumb mixture. mix well. batter will be thin. pour into a floured and greased 8 x 12 inch pan. sprinkle with remaining crumbs. bake at 350 for 45 minutes.

inputs: white wine vinegar, white wine, shallots, fresh tarragon, salt, egg yolks, butter, lemon, parsley
targets: title: bearnaise sauce ingredients: 1/4 cup white wine vinegar or 1/4 cup tarragon vinegar 1/4 cup white wine or 1/4 cup vermouth 2 teaspoons shallots, minced 1 tablespoon fresh tarragon, minced salt and pepper 2 egg yolks 1/4 lb butter 1/2 lemon, juice of 1 tablespoon parsley, minced or chervil directions: in a small saucepan, bring vinegar, wine, shallots, tarragon, salt and pepper to a boil and reduce to about 2 tablespoons. cool slightly. beat in yolks until smooth. put mixture into a small stainless steel bowl and place in a skillet with about 1 inch of simmering water in it. whisk sauce until it begins to thicken. beat in butter, bit by bit. before serving, add a few drops of lemon juice and parsley.

inputs: ground beef, green bell pepper, quick cooking oats, onion, soy sauce, salt, egg, cooking spray, apricot fruit spread, hoisin sauce, apple cider vinegar, red pepper
targets: title: hoisin glazed mini meatballs ingredients: 1 pound ground beef, extra lean 1/2 cup finely chopped green bell pepper 1/4 cup quick cooking oats 1/4 cup finely chopped onion 3 tablespoons low sodium soy sauce 1/4 teaspoon salt 1 large egg cooking spray 1/4 cup apricot fruit spread such as smucker s simply fruit 3 tablespoons hoisin sauce 1 tablespoon apple cider vinegar 1/8 to 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper directions: preheat oven to 350 . combine first 7 ingredients in a medium bowl. shape into 32 balls. place meatballs on a foil lined broiler pan coated with cooking spray. bake at 350 for 25 minutes or until done. meanwhile, combine apricot fruit spread and next 3 ingredients in a medium saucepan stir well. place over medium high heat, and cook 2 minutes or until thoroughly heated, stirring frequently. remove from heat add meatballs, tossing to coat. serve immediately.

inputs: whole wheat flour, white flour, grape nuts, sugar, baking soda, baking powder, salt, vanilla, egg substitute, bananas
targets: title: fat free banana crunch muffins ingredients: 12 cup whole wheat flour 12 cup white flour 12 cup grape nuts cereal 12 cup sugar 12 teaspoon baking soda 12 teaspoon baking powder 14 teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon vanilla 14 cup egg substitute 2 mashed bananas directions: in a small bowl mix all dry ingredients together. in a larger bowl mix all wet ingredients together. add dry ingrediants to wet ingredients. mix just until combined do not overmix. bake for 20 25 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean in a 350 degree oven.

inputs: fresh broccoli, water, cheese, salt, pepper, cornstarch
targets: title: the black eyed pea s cheese broccoli soup ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. fresh broccoli 1 pt. half and half 2 c. water 1 lb. pasteurized process cheese 3/4 tsp. salt 1/2 tsp. pepper 1/2 c. cornstarch mixed with 1 c. cold water directions: steam broccoli until tender. place half and half and water in the top of a double boiler add cheese, salt and pepper. heat until all the cheese is melted. add steamed broccoli.

inputs: mangoes, unsalted butter, sugar, lemon juice, freshly ground black pepper, passion fruit sauce, sour cream sorbet, coarse black pepper
targets: title: glazed mango with sour cream sorbet and black pepper ingredients: 2 large mangoes, ripe but not soft 4 tablespoons unsalted butter, plus butter for baking sheet 13 cup sugar 13 cup lemon juice freshly ground black pepper 1 cup passion fruit sauce see recipe sour cream sorbet see recipe 1 teaspoon coarse black pepper directions: peel mangoes. cut in thirds horizontally, leaving the pit in middle section. place each portion without pit cut side down on a work surface, and with a large knife cut into 8 slices perpendicular to the cutting board. gently push down on slices so they spread out and overlap slightly. sliver enough mango flesh left around the pits to make 1/2 cup. set slivers aside. butter a baking sheet large enough to hold mangoes in a single layer. heat the broiler. melt remaining butter in a large nonstick skillet. use a spatula to place each sliced mango third in the pan so they keep their shape. cook over medium heat about 5 minutes, sprinkling with two tablespoons sugar, and basting with pan juices. with spatula, transfer mangoes to baking sheet, place under broiler, and broil until edges just start to color. do not overcook. set mangoes aside. add remaining sugar to juices in skillet, and cook over medium heat until juices start to caramelize. add lemon juice, and continue to cook, stirring, until amber colored. season lightly with pepper. spoon on mangoes. place a sliced caramelized mango third in each of 4 shallow soup plates. spoon passion fruit sauce around each, and scatter raw mango slivers around. top each with a large oval scoop of sour cream sorbet, sprinkle 1/4 teaspoon coarse pepper on top and serve at once.

inputs: watermelon rind, lemons, sugar
targets: title: watermelon rind preserves ingredients: watermelon rind lemons sugar directions: peel green shell and pink flesh from firm watermelon rind. cut in pieces about the size of the last two joints of your little finger. cut up several lemons in thin slices. add same amount of sugar, by weight, as you have fruit. let stand several hours or overnight. cook very slowly until thick and clear. seal.

inputs: sugar, lean grnd beef, eggs, jalapeno chilies, red bell pepper, garlic, ketchup, worcestershire sauce, sugar, kosher salt
targets: title: albondigas recipe ingredients: south of the border meatballs makes 60 meatballs these albondigas are meatballs gone south of the border. it s hard to say why they re so very good is it the sugar , but you just cannot stop eating them. they re also very easy to make, so they re perfect party food. 2 lb lean grnd beef 3 x large eggs, beaten 3 x fresh jalapeno chilies, stemmed and diced small wear gloves 1 lrg red bell pepper, stemmed, seeded and diced small 4 lrg cloves garlic, chopped 1/2 c. ketchup 3 tbsp. worcestershire sauce 2 tsp granulated sugar 1 1/2 tsp kosher salt, or possibly to taste preheat the oven to 425 degrees. directions: in a large mixing bowl combine meat, large eggs, jalapenos, onion, bell pepper, garlic, ketchup, worcestershire sauce, sugar and kosher salt mix thoroughly by hand. be careful not to over mix the meatballs or possibly they ll be tough. divide the mix into balls the size of large walnuts, rolling them between the palms of your hands till hard and round. place the albondigas on a lightly oiled baking sheet and bake for about 15 min, or possibly till hard, bubbling and golden brown on the bottoms. serve on a napkin lined plate. note wear gloves when handling fresh chilies the oils can cause a burning sensation on your skin. note when the albondigas bake, they leave a little custard like foot around the base of each meatball, that looks a bit weird. but when you take them off the baking sheet, they look fine. spears and brigit l. binns as printed in the best american recipes

inputs: sugar, light brown sugar, cream, butter
targets: title: homemade caramel ingredients: 1 cup sugar 1 cup light brown sugar 1 cup cream 1 tsp butter directions: cook all together until it forms a soft ball when dropped in cold water. let cool until warm. add 1teaspoon vanilla. beat and spread on cooled cakes or whatever you want to put it on

inputs: mangoes, mango, white rum, lime juice, sugar, mint
targets: title: mango mint rum slush ingredients: 3 cups coarsely chopped peeled mangoes 1 cup ice cube 1 cup mango nectar 34 cup white rum 14 cup fresh lime juice 2 tablespoons sugar 1 tablespoon chopped of fresh mint directions: place mango in freezer for 1 hour. combine mango, ice cubes, and remaining ingredients in a blender process until smooth. serve immediately.

inputs: fresh strawberries, jell o, boiling water, nonfat vanilla yogurt, ready to
targets: title: fluffy strawberry charlotte pie ingredients: 3 qt. fresh strawberries, hulled, divided 1 1/2 cups jell o brand assorted red sugar free gelatin 2 1/4 qt. boiling water 1 1/2 qt. nonfat vanilla yogurt 6 each ready to use vanilla wafer crumb crust directions: reserve 6 of the strawberries for garnish or 1 strawberry for trial recipe . place remaining strawberries in food processor container cover. process until pureed set aside. dissolve gelatin in boiling water. stir in pureed strawberries. refrigerate about 40 minutes or until slightly thickened. place gelatin mixture in large bowl of electric mixer fitted with wire whisk attachment. add yogurt beat on medium speed 1 to 2 minutes until light and fluffy. pour about 3 cups of the gelatin mixture into each crust. refrigerate 2 to 3 hours or until set. garnish each pie with 1 of the reserved strawberries.

inputs: strawberry jello, boiling water, pineapple juice, frozen lemonade, orange juice, ginger ale, vodka
targets: title: punch ingredients: 1 box strawberry jello 1 c. boiling water 1 large can pineapple juice 2 small cans frozen lemonade no water added 3 small cans frozen orange juice no water added 2 large bottles ginger ale 1 pt. vodka or gin directions: mix well and serve over ice. if it tastes too strong, dilute to taste with water if you are serving it immediately. if prepared ahead of time, add ice to chill. as this melts, it will dilute the mixture. it is wise to add the ginger ale right before serving. it makes the punch bubblier.

inputs: packet, maitake mushrooms, enoki mushrooms, japanese, pork chunks, cooking oil, according, sake, stock powder, curry roux, soy sauce, white rice
targets: title: standard dish at my home easy japanese style mushroom curry ingredients: 1 packet shimeji mushrooms 1 packet maitake mushrooms 1 packet enoki mushrooms 1 japanese leek or green onion 300 grams thinly sliced pork chunks 1 tbsp cooking oil 1 according to the curry roux s package instructions water 2 tbsp sake 1 tbsp japanese dashi stock powder 2 to 3 tablespoons miso 1 box solid curry roux 1 dash soy sauce 1 cooked white rice directions: discard the hard end of the shimeji, maitake, and enoki mushrooms. separate the clumps into smaller bits. diagonally cut the japanese leek. heat oil in a frying pan, then add in the pork and stir fry. once the pork gets a nice white colour, add the mushrooms and leek from the previous steps. cook until they soften. add the water, sake, and japanese dashi stock powder. when it boils, skim off the scum and simmer for a further 5 10 minutes over low to medium heat. now dissolve the miso into the mixture. turn heat off, then add the crushed roux. mix them well. once the roux melts, turn down the heat. simmer another 3 5 minutes over low heat and keep stirring. taste it first then drizzle on a little soy sauce. please adjust the soy sauce amount as it might be quite salty depending on the miso. serve rice on the plate then pour curry over it. it s ready to eat if you prefer it spicier, sprinkle on some garam masala. nice if you ve got leftovers, try making curry udon noodles the next day. add the water and mentsuyu japanese noodle dipping sauce to make a soup and then add udon noodles. sprinkle finely chopped green onion and shichimi spice at the end and serve i cooked it with mince meat as a substitute for thinly sliced pork chunks. it was also very yummy try this, too

inputs: cake mix, apple pastry filling, brandy, whipped cream
targets: title: apple filled cake ingredients: 1 spice cake mix 2 c. apple pastry filling 1/3 c. brandy whipped cream for icing directions: prepare box cake mix according to directions, using an angel food cake pan. let cake cool. keeping top whole, slice off 1 inch from top place aside. scoop out center of ring. place cake pieces in bowl and sprinkle with brandy. fill center of cake with pastry filling, alternating with cake pieces. reset top of cake. smooth over entire cake with whipped cream topping. refrigerate 2 hours before serving.

inputs: beets, apple, potatoes, onion, walnuts, sour cream, mayonnaise, sugar, egg, beets, parsley
targets: title: heringssalat rheinischer art rhineland herring salad ingredients: 1 jar pickled herring, drained 1/2 c. diced cooked or canned beets 1 large apple, cored and diced 2 medium potatoes, cooked and diced 1 small onion, minced 1/2 c. chopped walnuts 1/2 c. sour cream 1/2 c. mayonnaise 1 tsp. sugar or to taste 1 hard cooked egg, sliced 6 to 8 small canned whole beets, drained 1 tbsp. minced parsley or dill optional directions: a line shack on the mountain. i cooked a betty crocker apple pie mix. as i took it from the oven, it ended upside down on the hard dirt floor. harvey robinson was there, he dearly loved pie. he looked at that pie on the floor and said, i could just cry he and my nephew preston brunst got forks and sat down on the hard dirt floor and proceeded to eat what they could of the pie before getting to the dirt.

inputs: rice, shrimp, crabmeat, eggs, celery, green pepper, onion, dill pickle, pimiento, mayonnaise, lemon juice, salt, dill weed, pepper, tomatoes
targets: title: seafood stuffed tomatoes ingredients: 2 cups cooked rice 1 cup cooked baby shrimp 2 6 ounce cans crabmeat, rinsed,drained,and flaked 4 hard boiled eggs, chopped 1/2 cup chopped celery 1/2 cup chopped green pepper 1/4 cup chopped onion 1/4 cup dill pickle relish, drained 1 2 ounce jar chopped pimiento, drained 3/4 cup mayonnaise 2 tablespoons lemon juice 1 teaspoon salt 1/2 teaspoon dill weed 1/4 teaspoon pepper 6 8 large tomatoes directions: combine the first 9 ingredients in a bowl set aside. in a small bowl, combine mayonnaise, lemon juice, salt, dill and pepper mix well. pour over rice mixture toss gently. cover and chill for at least 1 hour. just before serving, cut a thin slice from the top of each tomato. scoop out pulp and discard, leaving a 1/2 inch thick shell. fill each tomato with about 1/2 cup of salad. serve immediately.

inputs: fresh raspberries, fresh strawberries, water, sugar, buttermilk, whipping cream, orange juice, fresh raspberries, fresh strawberries
targets: title: berry berry ice cream ingredients: 1 1/2 cups fresh raspberries 1 1/2 cups fresh strawberries 1/4 cup water 1 1/3 cups sugar 2 cups buttermilk 1 cup whipping cream 1/2 cup unsweetened orange juice fresh raspberries optional fresh strawberries optional directions: combine first 3 ingredients in container of an electric blender cover and process until smooth, stopping once to scrape down sides. place berry mixture in a wire mesh strainer press with back of spoon against the sides of the strainer to squeeze out juice. discard pulp and seeds remaining in strainer. add sugar, buttermilk, cream, and orange juice to strained mixture stir well. pour mixture into freezer container of a 1 gallon hand turned or electric freezer. freeze according to manufacturer s instructions. pack freezer with additional ice and rock salt, and let stand 1 hour before serving. garnish with fresh berries, if desired.

inputs: cream cheese, cheddar cheese, blue cheese, pecans, pineapple, parsley, green onion, worcestershire sauce, garlic, curry powder, sesame seeds
targets: title: three cheese ball ingredients: 1 8 ounce package cream cheese, softened 2 cups cheddar cheese, shredded 8 oz 8 ounces blue cheese, crumbled 1 cup pecans, chopped 1 8 ounce can crushed pineapple, drained 1/2 cup parsley fresh 1/4 cup green onion, minced 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder 1/4 teaspoon curry powder 1/4 cup sesame seeds, toasted directions: combine the cream cheese, cheddar cheese, and blue cheese in a medium mixing bowl stir until well blended. add nuts and the next 6 ingredients stir well to combine. shape the cheese mixture into a ball cover and chill at least 1 hour. remove from the refrigerator before serving and roll in toasted sesame seeds. you can toast them in a skillet really quickly . serve with an assortment of crackers.

inputs: sugar, cornstarch, cinnamon, apple cider, lemon juice, margarine
targets: title: cinnamon syrup great on pumpkin waffles ingredients: 12 cup sugar 1 tablespoon cornstarch 1 teaspoon cinnamon 1 cup apple cider 1 tablespoon lemon juice 2 tablespoons margarine or 2 tablespoons butter directions: in small pan, combine sugar, cornstarch and cinnamon. stir in appler cide and lemon juice. cook over medium heat until mixture boils and thickens. remove from heat and stir in margarine until it melts. serve hot over delicious waffles

inputs: potatoes, butter, cream cheese, sour cream, milk, salt, pepper, onion, mushrooms
targets: title: buffet potatoes ingredients: 8 large potatoes, peeled and chopped 6 pounds 1/2 cup butter, divided 1 3 ounce package cream cheese, softened 1/2 cup sour cream 1/4 cup milk 1 1/2 teaspoons salt 1/2 teaspoon pepper 1 medium onion, chopped 12 large fresh mushrooms, sliced directions: bring potato and water to cover to a boil in a large dutch oven boil 15 minutes or until tender. drain and mash. stir in 1/4 cup butter, cream cheese, and next 4 ingredients until smooth. melt remaining 1/4 cup butter in a large skillet over medium heat add onion and mushrooms, and saute until tender. spoon one third of potato mixture into a lightly greased 2 1/2 quart baking dish top with halfof mushroom mixture. repeat layers, ending with potato mixture. bake at 350 for 30 minutes or until lightly browned.

inputs: oil, curry powder, mustard, vinegar, black pepper, cayenne pepper, ketchup, chicken
targets: title: deviled chicken ingredients: 6 tablespoons oil 1 teaspoon curry powder 2 teaspoons prepared mustard 1 tablespoon vinegar 12 teaspoon black pepper 18 teaspoon cayenne pepper 1 tablespoon ketchup 8 chicken legs directions: preheat broiler. mix oil and curry powder until smooth. add rest ingredients except chicken. brush chicken legs generously with sauce. broil about 30 minutes or until tender and brown on both sides. transfer to platter and serve.

inputs: apples, sugar, crisco, eggs, vanilla, soda, flour, cinnamon, salt
targets: title: fresh apple cake ingredients: 2 c. diced apples 2 c. sugar 1 brown, 1 white 1/2 c. crisco 2 eggs, well beaten 2 tsp. vanilla 2 tsp. soda 2 c. flour 2 tsp. cinnamon 1 tsp. salt directions: mix all ingredients together. put in greased pan, 9 x 13 x 2 inch. bake at 350 for 1 hour or until cake is brown and leaves edges of pan.

inputs: black walnuts, sugar, sweet milk, butter, vanilla, soda, sugar
targets: title: caramel icing for black walnut cake ingredients: 1 c. black walnuts 3 c. sugar 1 c. sweet milk 1/2 c. butter or margarine 1 tsp. vanilla 1/8 tsp. soda 1/4 c. sugar take out of the 3 c. sugar directions: brown and make into caramel first by putting 1/4 cup sugar into iron skillet. heat until sugar browns, stirring constantly. add 1/4 cup of water to make syrup. add to other ingredients. boil briskly for 4 minutes, stirring constantly and cooking to soft ball stage. cool in ice water, beating constantly. add vanilla and nuts. spread between layers on sides and top of cake.

inputs: cocoa powder, powdered sugar, water, vanilla
targets: title: low guilt chocolate fix ingredients: 2 tablespoons cocoa powder 12 cup powdered sugar 1 tablespoon hot water vanilla extract very good or orange extract very good or mocha extract very good or cinnamon very good or chili powder very good directions: thouroughly mix cocoa and sugar. mix in hot water. add more hot water if it is too thick, but make sure that it is all dissolved first this gets watery quickly. experiment with adding different flavorings as per your taste. then dig in

inputs: oil, pork chops, onion, cream of celery soup, apple juice, apple, celery, thyme, noodles
targets: title: pork normandy ingredients: 1 tablespoon oil 6 pork chops, 1/2 inch thick 12 cup onion, chopped 1 10 3/4 ounce can cream of celery soup 14 cup apple juice 12 cup apple, chopped 12 cup celery, sliced 14 teaspoon thyme hot cooked noodles directions: in hot oil, brown pork chops and onion for about 10 minutes. spoon off fat. stir in soup, apple juice, apple, celery and thyme. reduce heat to low, cover and simmer 30 minutes, stirring occasionally. serve over noodles.

inputs: vegetable oil, onion, garlic, tomatoes, chicken, ground cumin, , , vermicelli, salt, lime, , avocado
targets: title: mexican noodle soup sopa de fideo ingredients: 3 teaspoons vegetable oil, divided 1 onion, chopped 4 cloves garlic, minced 1 can 14 oz. size tomatoes, chopped or crushed 8 cups chicken or vegetable broth, divided 1 teaspoon ground cumin 1/4 teaspoons ground allspice 1/4 teaspoons cayenne pepper 8 ounces, weight fideo, vermicelli or angel hair noodles, broken into 1 inch pieces salt and pepper, to taste 1 lime, sliced into wedges 1/4 cups chopped cilantro, for garnish 1 avocado, sliced, for garnish directions: in a soup pot, heat 2 teaspoons vegetable oil. cook onion for 5 minutes, until translucent. add garlic and cook for a minute more. transfer the cooked veggies to a blender. add tomatoes, 1 cup of the broth, cumin, allspice, and cayenne pepper. process until smooth. heat the remaining teaspoon oil in the same soup pot. add noodles and cook them for 3 5 minutes, stirring. you have to stir continuously to avoid burning the noodles. when done, they have to be golden brown. now pour the blended veggie mixture into the pot. add remaining broth and bring to a boil. cook for 10 minutes, until noodles are tender. season to taste. either add the lime juice directly into the pot or serve lime wedges individually. garnish with the chopped cilantro and avocado slices.

inputs: flour, corn meal, sugar, salt, egg, milk, butter, milk
targets: title: crusty soft center spoon bread ingredients: 1/4 c. flour 1/2 c. corn meal 1 tbsp. sugar 3/4 tsp. salt 1 beaten egg 1 c. milk 2 heaping tbsp. butter 1/2 c. milk directions: combine and sift flour, corn meal, sugar and salt. add egg and 1 cup milk. blend batter well. melt butter in baking dish. pour in batter. pour generous 1/2 cup milk over top. bake in 375 oven about 45 minutes.

inputs: hamburger, onion, green pepper, tomatoes
targets: title: swiss hamburger ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. hamburger 1 onion, sliced 1 green pepper 1 can tomatoes any size can directions: fry hamburger patties with onions. slice green peppers and saute with hamburger and onions. drain grease. add 1 can whole tomatoes. simmer approximately 30 minutes. salt and pepper to taste.

inputs: lemon, sugar, egg yolks, cornstarch, salt, butter, boiling water
targets: title: lemon pie ingredients: 1 lemon 1 1/2 c. sugar 3 egg yolks 1/4 c. cornstarch 1/2 tsp. salt 1 tbsp. butter 1 1/2 c. boiling water directions: mix sugar and cornstarch stir. add lemon juice and egg yolks. set aside. in a pan, boil water and grated lemon rind. add butter and pinch of salt. add the two together. cook until thick.

inputs: eggs, english mustard, mayonnaise, flat leaf parsley, cream cheese, dill, butter, bread, salt
targets: title: ribbon tea sandwiches ingredients: 3 eggs 1 teaspoon english mustard 4 tablespoons mayonnaise 1 tablespoon flat leaf parsley, chopped 6 tablespoons cream cheese 1 tablespoon dill, chopped 1 1/2 ounces butter, softened 12 slices rye bread 4 ounces gravlax, slices salt and pepper directions: boil the eggs for 8 10 minutes, until hard boiled cool and peel. place the eggs in a bowl and mash with the mustard and mayonnaise. season to taste and stir in the parsley set aside. mix the cream cheese with the chives and a good grinding of black pepper. butter the bread. divide the cream cheese mixture between 2 slices of the buttered bread and top with another 2 slices of bread, to make sandwiches. cover another 2 slices of bread with the slices of gravlax make into sandwiches with another 2 slices of bread. top a further 2 slices of bread with the egg mixture and cover the remaining slices of bread. make 2 stacks. lay a gravlax sandwich on the base of each stack. top each with an egg sandwiches and finally, a cream cheese sandwich. cut each stack in half and secure with cocktail sticks. arrange on plates and serve.

inputs: lobster, cheese sauce, topping, cracker, butter, tomalley, spray
targets: title: the best lobster casserole ingredients: 1 lb cooked lobster meat 1 3/4 cups cheese sauce, hailey s favorite cheese sauce 364959 topping 1 sleeve ritz cracker, crushed fine 1/2 cup butter, melted tomalley optional pam cooking spray directions: preheat oven to 350 degrees. combine ritz crackers butter and tomalley in medium sized bowl. spray each casserole dish with pam. divide the lobster meat into 4 individual casserole dishes. pour cheese sauce over lobster. put the ritz topping on the casseroles. bake uncovered for 20 25 minutes or until cheese sauce is bubbly. put the casseroles under a low broiler for a few minutes to brown the topping being careful not to burn the topping.

inputs: peanut butter, marshmallow ice cream topping, graham cracker pie crusts, caramel ice cream topping, peanuts
targets: title: chocolate peanut butter marshmallow tarts ingredients: 4 1/2 cups creamy peanut butter 2 1/4 qt. prepared jell o chocolate instant pudding 4 1/2 cups marshmallow ice cream topping 36 each mini graham cracker pie crusts 1 1/2 cups caramel ice cream topping 2 1/4 cups prepared dream whip whipped topping 3/4 cup chopped planters cocktail peanuts directions: add peanut butter to pudding stir with wire whisk until well blended. spoon 2 tbsp. of the marshmallow topping into each tart shell top with 1/3 cup of the pudding mixture. refrigerate 2 to 3 hours or until set. top each tart with 2 tbsp. of the caramel topping and 1 tbsp. of the whipped topping sprinkle with 1 tsp. of the peanuts.

inputs: butter, sugar, eggs, flour, cream of tartar, soda, salt, vanilla
targets: title: snickerdoodles ingredients: 1 c. butter 1 1/2 c. sugar 2 eggs 2 3/4 c. sifted flour 2 tbsp. cream of tartar 1 tsp. soda 1/8 tsp. salt 1 tsp. vanilla directions: mix well and roll in small balls. in small bowl, mix 2 tablespoons sugar and 2 tablespoons cinnamon. roll balls in sugar and cinnamon mixture. place 2 inches apart on cookie sheet. bake 10 to 15 minutes in a 350 oven.

inputs: butter, butter, light brown sugar, white sugar, eggs, vanilla, flour, baking soda, cinnamon, cloves, salt, rolled oats, raisins
targets: title: beth s spicy oatmeal raisin cookies recipe ingredients: 1/2 c. butter softened 1/2 c. butter flavored shortening 1 c. light brown sugar 1/2 c. white sugar 2 x large eggs 1 tsp vanilla extract 1 1/2 c. all purpose flour 1 tsp baking soda 1 tsp grnd cinnamon 1/2 tsp grnd cloves 1/2 tsp salt 3 c. rolled oats 1 c. raisins directions: preheat oven to 350 degrees f. in a large bowl, cream together the butter, butter flavored shortening, brown sugar, white sugar, large eggs and vanilla till smooth. combine the flour, baking soda, cinnamon, cloves and salt stir into the sugar mix. stir in the oats and raisins. drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheets. bake 10 to 12 min till light and golden brown. don t over bake. let them cold for 2 min before removing from cookie sheets to cold completely. store in airtight container.

inputs: hoisin sauce, sambal oelek, bunches scallions, red wine, garlic, fresh ginger, fresh ground black pepper, chicken, salt
targets: title: barbecued hoisin chicken ingredients: 2 cups hoisin sauce 4 tablespoons sambal oelek 2 bunches scallions, white and green parts chopped 1 cup dry red wine 12 cup finely chopped garlic 12 cup finely chopped fresh ginger 2 teaspoons fresh ground black pepper 8 chicken pieces i use the thighs with legs salt directions: in a non reactive baking dish, or large ziploc bag just large enough to hold the chicken, combine the hoisin sauce, sambal olek, scallions, wine, garlic, ginger, and pepper and mix. add the chicken, turn to coat, cover, and marinate overnight. next day, remove chicken and discard marinade. heat an outdoor grill or preheat the broiler. spray the grill with nonstick cooking spray. season the chicken with the salt and grill or broil it. turn once, until brown and the juices run clear when pricked with a fork at the joint, about 15 minutes depending on how big your pieces are. serve with a tangy, asian style coleslaw.

inputs: lemon juice, cold water, sugar
targets: title: lemonade ingredients: 1/2 c. lemon juice 3 c. cold water 1/2 c. sugar ice cubes directions: add sugar to juice. stir in cold water and pour over ice in glasses. for hot lemonade, use hot water instead of cold. roll lemons on the table to make more juice.

inputs: butter, cream of coconut, milk, coconut
targets: title: oh so rich coconut cake ingredients: 1 butter recipe yellow or white cake mix 1 can cream of coconut 1 can eagle brand milk 1 large container cool whip 1 7 oz. pkg. coconut directions: bake cake according to package. as soon as it comes out of the oven, pierce heavily with fork. mix cream of coconut and eagle brand milk together. immediately pour mixture slowly over cake, allowing it to absorb. mix cool whip and coconut together. when the cake is cool, spread cool whip and mixture over the top. refrigerate.

inputs: eggs, sugar, lemon juice, butter, pecan halves, golden karo syrup, salt, vanilla, unbaked pie shell
targets: title: pecan pie ingredients: 4 eggs, slightly beaten 1/3 c. sugar 1 tbsp. lemon juice or vinegar 4 tbsp. butter 2/3 c. pecan halves 1 c. golden karo syrup pinch of salt 2 tsp. vanilla unbaked pie shell directions: combine all the ingredients except for the pecan halves. mix thoroughly. stir in pecan halves. pour into pie shell. bake 35 minutes 325 to 350 .

inputs: flank steak, onion, water, pimentos, green peppers, onions, italian bread, garlic, tomato puree, bay leaves, water, peas
targets: title: flank steak ingredients: 2 lb. flank steak london broil , cut into 1 inch strips 1 onion, quartered 3 c. water 1 small jar chopped pimentos 2 green peppers, cut into strips 2 onions, cut in strips italian bread, cut into 1/2 inch slices 4 cloves garlic, crushed 1 10 3/4 oz. can tomato puree 2 bay leaves 1/2 c. water 1 can peas directions: combine steak, onion quarters and water in a pot. bring to a boil. cover, reduce heat and simmer for one hour or until meat is tender. drain reserve 1 1/2 cups of liquid. cool. shred meat or cut into small pieces set aside. cook peppers, onion strips and garlic in 2 tablespoons oil in a large skillet for 3 minutes. stir in meat and reserved liquid 1 1/2 cups . cook 10 minutes. add peas. remove bay leaves. stir well and cook 10 minutes. toast garlic bread and serve with meat mixture.

inputs: broccoli, olive oil, kosher salt, freshly ground black pepper, garlic, lemon juice
targets: title: roasted broccoli ingredients: 1/2 pounds broccoli spears 2 tablespoons olive oil or any other oil will also work kosher salt freshly ground black pepper, to taste 2 cloves garlic, grated 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice directions: preheat oven to 450 degrees. toss broccoli in a tablespoon of olive oil. season with salt and pepper. roast in a pan for 15 minutes. remove pan from the oven. drizzle another tablespoon of olive oil over the broccoli. sprinkle the grated garlic over the broccoli. roast about 5 minutes longer. toss broccoli in lemon juice.

inputs: white chocolate chips, milk, salt
targets: title: white chocolate peppermint fudge ingredients: 3 cups white chocolate chips 1 can 14 oz. size sweetened condensed milk 1 pinch salt 1/2 teaspoons mint extract 1/2 cups crushed peppermint candy or more as needed to taste directions: 1. line an 8 x 8 baking pan with parchment paper. in a medium sauce pan, combine white chocolate, sweetened condensed milk, and salt. heat gently on the stove over low heat while stirring with a heatproof spatula. 2. let the mixture melt until completely smooth while stirring, about 10 15 minutes. take it off heat and stir in mint extract thoroughly. transfer mixture into prepared baking pan, sprinkle crushed peppermint candies liberally on top. 3. cover pan and refrigerate white chocolate peppermint fudge for at least 2 hours to let it set. it can keep for a few days, so you can make it well in advance if needed. when you are ready to serve, just cut the fudge into small cubes and spread the holiday cheer

inputs: flour, sugar, baking soda, salt, cocoa, vanilla, vinegar, oil, cold water
targets: title: wacky cake ingredients: 3 c. flour 2 c. sugar 2 tsp. baking soda 1 tsp. salt 4 tbsp. cocoa 2 tsp. vanilla 2 tbsp. vinegar 2/3 c. oil 2 c. cold water directions: sift together the first 5 ingredients. add the vanilla, vinegar, oil and cold water blend until moist, then beat at medium speed with an electric mixer for 2 minutes. pour into a 9 x 13 inch pan. add the cheese filling.

inputs: irish cream, kahlua, whiskey, white chocolate
