targets: title: the mean fiddler adult alcoholic beverage ingredients: 2 ounces irish cream such as bailey s or irish manor liqueur 1 ounce kahlua 1 ounce chambord raspberry liquor 1 ounce crown royal whiskey 1 ounce white chocolate liqueur such as godiva directions: pour liquid ingredients together in a blender. add ice to the top of the liquid level in the blender, maybe a handful of cubes . blend on high until smooth. pour into chilled martini glasses. optional garnish pour chocolate syrup in stripes from the center outwards, like a sunburst . use a toothpick to swirl the chocolate and create a pinwheel effect. note if you feel the drink is too thick while blending, add a bit of cream or milk to thin it out.

inputs: lemon juice, fresh oregano, extra virgin olive oil, garlic, frozen artichoke, tomatoes, cooking spray, salt, freshly ground black pepper, lemon wedges
targets: title: artichoke and eggplant skewers ingredients: 3 tablespoons fresh lemon juice 1 teaspoon chopped fresh oregano 4 teaspoons extra virgin olive oil 2 garlic cloves, minced 6 frozen artichoke hearts, thawed and quartered 24 1 inch cubes eggplant about 3/4 pound 24 cherry tomatoes cooking spray 1/4 teaspoon salt 1/4 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper lemon wedges optional directions: prepare grill to medium high heat. combine first 4 ingredients in a small bowl stir well with a whisk. thread artichoke hearts, eggplant, and tomatoes alternately onto each of 8 10 inch skewers. place skewers on grill rack coated with cooking spray grill 6 minutes or until tender, turning frequently. place skewers on a platter brush with juice mixture. sprinkle with salt and pepper. serve with lemon wedges, if desired.

inputs: sugar, butter, soda, buttermilk, eggs, bananas, vanilla, nuts, flour
targets: title: banana nut bread ingredients: 1 1/2 c. sugar 1/2 c. butter 1 tsp. soda 4 tbsp. buttermilk 2 eggs 1 c. mashed bananas 1 tsp. vanilla 1 c. nuts 3 c. flour directions: cream together sugar and butter. stir soda into buttermilk, set aside. add eggs and bananas to sugar mixture. alternately add buttermilk mixture and flour. add nuts. bake at 350 degrees, if baked in a loaf pan about 1 hour, or in a layer pan for 30 minutes.

inputs: olive oil, sherry vinegar, kosher salt , tarragon, carrots, center, tarragon, salt
targets: title: grilled tarragon carrots ingredients: 1/3 cup olive oil 3 tablespoons sherry vinegar or lemon juice 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt more to taste 2 tablespoons chopped fresh tarragon 1 1/4 pounds small carrots, greens, ends, amp tips removed 1 slice from the center of a large onion about 1/2 inch thick 1 tablespoon whole fresh tarragon leaves salt and pepper to taste directions: whisk together olive oil, vinegar or lemon juice, salt, and chopped tarragon. lay vegetables in a shallow pan that will hold them snuggly in a single layer. cover vegetables with the vinaigrette, toss to coat, cover and leave at room temperature for about 1 hour to marinate. note you want to keep the onion slice intact. run an extra long toothpick horizontally through the onion if you think it will help. heat a grill to medium. 350 450 using tongs, remove vegetables from the marinade. leave the marinade in the pan. grill the vegetable turning as needed until tender crisp and charred on all sides. 10 20 minutes total. cook time varies with carrot size. remove the toothpick from the onion and return rings to the vinaigrette. cut each carrot into 3 or 4 pieces and add to onion, toss to combine. sprinkle with whole tarragon leaves and serve right away or at room temperature. add salt and pepper to taste.

inputs: rolled oats, almond milk, unsweetened applesauce, pecans, light brown sugar, ground cinnamon, frosting, frosting, yogurt, powdered sugar
targets: title: faux cinnamon bun ingredients: 1 cup rolled oats 1/2 cups almond milk 1/2 cups unsweetened applesauce 2 tablespoons chopped pecans 1 1/2 tablespoon light brown sugar 3/4 teaspoons ground cinnamon for the frosting frosting 4 ounces, fluid 2 greek yogurt 2 tablespoons powdered sugar directions: preheat oven to 375 f. generously spray 2 ramekins with baking spray. in a medium bowl, stir together oats, almond milk, applesauce, pecans, brown sugar, and cinnamon. scoop even portions into each ramekin. bake for 15 20 minutes, then remove from oven and allow to cool for 5 minutes. turn over each ramekin to gently remove each bun . for the frosting, use a handheld mixer to whip powdered sugar into greek yogurt in a small mixing bowl. spoon frosting over buns and sprinkle with additional ground cinnamon. nutrition info per 1 bun with topping 349 calories, 10 g fat, 13 g protein, 49 g carbohydrates, 6 g fiber adapted from baked oatmeal by chocolate covered katie.

inputs: extra virgin olive oil, onion, green bell pepper, ground beef, tomato paste, worcestershire, garlic, oregano, red pepper, tomatoes, chicken broth, salt, water, parmesan cheese, fresh basil
targets: title: one pot spaghetti with meat sauce ingredients: 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil 1 onion medium, chopped fine 1 green bell pepper medium, chopped 1 pound lean ground beef 1/4 cup tomato paste 1 tablespoon worcestershire 4 garlic cloves minced 1 teaspoon dried oregano 1 pinch red pepper flakes 56 ounces crushed tomatoes 14 1/2 ounces low sodium chicken broth or beef broth 1 teaspoon salt 3 cups water 1 pound spaghetti broken in half 1 cup grated parmesan cheese freshly 1/3 cup fresh basil minced, one .66 oz pkg. directions: heat oil in a large soup pot or dutch oven over medium high heat until the oil is shimmering, add the onion and bell pepper. saute until the vegetables start to brown around the edges, about 5 minutes. add the ground beef, cook, breaking the meat up with a wooden spoon until the meat completely looses it s raw color, about another 5 minutes. add the tomato paste, worcestershire, garlic, oregano and red pepper flakes. cook, stirring constantly until the tomato paste is evenly dispersed into the meat, continue to cook, stirring constantly, until the bottom of the pot starts to turn brown, about 3 4 minutes total. add the canned tomatoes and broth. bring to a simmer, cover and reduce heat to medium low. simmer sauce for 15 minutes. add the water and salt, return to a simmer and add the spaghetti. cover the pot and simmer the spaghetti and sauce, stirring thoroughly every few minutes, adjusting the heat as necessary to maintain a lively simmer, about 20 minutes, or until the pasta is tender to your liking. off heat, add the grated parmesan and basil.

inputs: butter, flour, powdered sugar, eggs, sugar, salt, lemon juice, baking powder, flour
targets: title: lemon slices ingredients: 1 c. butter, soft not melted 2 c. flour 1/2 c. powdered sugar 5 eggs 2 c. sugar 1/2 tsp. salt 6 tbsp. fresh only strained lemon juice 1 tsp. baking powder 4 tbsp. flour directions: mix slightly beaten eggs, sugar, salt and lemon juice. mix baking powder and flour and add to egg mixture. spread on warm layer as soon as you take it out of the oven and bake an additional 30 minutes. can be sprinkled with powdered sugar or left plain. cut into bars when cool. freezes well with wax paper in between layers.

inputs: turkey breast, oregano, ground cumin, salt, fresh spinach, feta cheese, bacon
targets: title: bacon wrapped turkey breast stuffed with spinach and feta ingredients: 1 large turkey breast 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin salt and ground black pepper to taste 1 cup fresh spinach, or to taste 1/4 cup crumbled feta cheese 12 slices reduced sodium bacon, or as needed directions: preheat oven to 350 degrees f 175 degrees c . slice turkey breast down the middle and lay it flat. sprinkle oregano, cumin, salt, and pepper on the inside of turkey. arrange spinach leaves in 1 layer on 1 of the pieces of turkey and top with a layer of feta cheese. repeat layering with spinach and feta cheese. fold the other turkey breast half over the feta layer so the filling is sealed. wrap the entire turkey breast with bacon. place wrapped turkey in a baking dish and season with salt and pepper. cook turkey breast until no longer pink in the center and the juices run clear, about 30 minutes. an instant read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 165 degrees f 74 degrees c . turn on oven s broiler and broil wrapped turkey until bacon is crisp on each side, about 2 minutes per side. let turkey rest for 10 minutes before slicing.

inputs: margarine, peanut butter, powdered sugar, light corn syrup, dipping chocolate
targets: title: peanut butter balls ingredients: 1/4 lb. margarine 1/2 lb. peanut butter creamy or crunchy 3/4 lb. powdered sugar 1/4 c. light corn syrup dipping chocolate optional directions: combine all ingredients. mix well. roll into 3/4 inch balls. coat if desired with chocolate or roll in toasted coconut or chopped nuts.

inputs: popsicle, bananas, cookies, like smarties, peanut butter
targets: title: oreo banana treats ingredients: 8 wooden popsicle sticks 4 bananas, halved crosswise 12 oreo cookies, finely chopped 2 tablespoons assorted decorative candies, well crushed like smarties, or m m s plain or peanuts, or any kind of candy that you desire to use 34 cup peanut butter directions: carefully insert one popsicle stick into the end of each cut banana set aside. in a medium bowl, mix chopped cookies and candy sprinkles set aside. carefully spread each banana with peanut butter roll in cookie mixture to coat. put bananas on a cookie sheet place in freezer until firm. if storing in the freezer for more than 8 hours, place the bananas in a covered container. remove from freezer 10 minutes before serving.

inputs: flour, water, vegetable oil, chicken breasts, shrimp, onions, garlic, green peppers, celery, file powder, cayenne pepper, bay leaf, thyme, ground black pepper, ham, green onion, parsley
targets: title: chicken gumbo ingredients: 1 cup flour 3 quarts water or 3 quarts chicken broth 13 cup vegetable oil 4 chicken breasts or 6 chicken legs thighs shelled shrimp optional 2 medium chopped onions 1 garlic clove, chopped 3 green peppers, finely chopped 4 pieces celery, chopped 1 tablespoon file powder fee lay 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper 1 bay leaf 1 teaspoon dried thyme 1 12 teaspoons ground black pepper 12 lb smoked ham or 12 lb sausage, chopped 12 cup green onion, finely chopped 2 tablespoons parsley, finely chopped directions: to make dry roux, heat a large heavy pan over med/high heat. add the flour and stir constantly from the middle out until flour is the color of cinnamon 30 min . take the roux out of the skillet and set aside in a bowl. bring water or broth to a boil and simmer over med/high heat. in a large, heavy skillet heat oil until hot but not smoking. brown chicken until golden 3 min on each side . drain meat on paper towels and add to simmering water or broth. drain all but 3 tbspns. oil from pan and add onions, garlic, peppers, celery, and file powder. cook over med. heat until onions are soft 10 min . the file will become ropy at first, but will liquefy as it cooks. .

inputs: salt, water, honey, pistachios, cherries, milk
targets: title: morning oatmeal with cherries and pistachios ingredients: 1/2 cup steel cut oatmeal, preferably the quick cooking variety salt to taste 1 1/2 cups water 1 to 2 teaspoons honey, brown sugar or agave nectar 1 to 2 tablespoons pistachios, lightly toasted 3 ounces cherries 12 to 14, depending on the size, pitted and halved milk or almond beverage as desired directions: the night before you plan to make this dish, place the oatmeal in a large microwave safe bowl or in a saucepan with the salt. bring the water to a boil, and pour over the oatmeal. cover tightly and leave overnight. in the morning, stir in the honey, pistachios and cherries. cover and microwave three to five minutes, or simmer for 10 minutes or so until the oatmeal has absorbed the liquid remaining in the bowl. stir in milk or almond beverage as desired.

inputs: sugar, butter, butter, vanilla, egg, graham cracker crumbs, flour, salt, marshmallows, semi sweet chocolate chips
targets: title: s more bars ingredients: 23 cup sugar 12 cup butter, plus 1 12 tablespoons butter, divided and softened 12 teaspoon vanilla extract 1 egg 2 13 cups graham cracker crumbs 13 cup flour 12 teaspoon salt 4 12 cups mini marshmallows, divided 2 cups semi sweet chocolate chips directions: preheat oven to 350 degrees f. grease a 9x13 inch baking dish and set aside. in the bowl of your stand mixer, combine the sugar and 1/2 cup butter until light and fluffy, about 3 minutes. add the vanilla and egg, scraping down the side as needed. mix in the graham cracker crumbs, flour, and salt. set aside 1 1/2 cups of the graham cracker mixture for later. using your hands or the bottom of a glass, press the rest of the graham cracker mixture into the bottom of the prepared dish. in a small nonreactive saucepan, melt 3 cups of the marshmallows with the remaining 1 1/2 tbs butter. quickly spread the melted marshmallows over the graham cracker layer. sprinkle the chocolate chips evenly over the layers and toss the remaining 1 1/2 cups marshmallows on top. press bits of the remaining graham cracker mixture in the palms of your hands and scatter them over top of the marshmallows and chocolate chips, pressing lightly. bake for 17 22 minutes or until marshmallows have puffed up and turned lightly brown. allow to cool before serving.

inputs: tuna fish, mayonnaise, crescent rolls, mushroom soup
targets: title: tuna rolls ingredients: 2 cans tuna fish 2 tbsp. mayonnaise 1 can crescent rolls 1 can mushroom soup directions: drain fish and mix with mayonnaise. make 2 long strips with crescent rolls pinch perforated parts together. spread fish mixture on strips and roll jelly roll fashion. cut each roll into 5 slices. heat as instructed. heat soup as instructed. serve hot and cover with soup.

inputs: shortening, brown sugar, eggs, flour, nuts, raisins, soda, spice
targets: title: rock cookies ingredients: 1 c. shortening 2 c. brown sugar, slightly packed 3 eggs 3 1/2 c. flour 1 c. nuts 1 c. raisins 1 tsp. soda mix spice to taste directions: mix well. drop by 1/2 to 1 teaspoon on cookie sheet. bake at 300 for about 15 minutes.

inputs: ground beef, garlic salt, pepper, tomatoes, tomato sauce, mushrooms, oregano, bread, mozzarella cheese, onion rings
targets: title: pizza burger ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. ground beef 1/2 tsp. garlic salt 1/4 tsp. pepper 16 oz. can tomatoes, drained and chopped 8 oz. can tomato sauce 2 1/2 oz. jar mushrooms, drained 1 tsp. oregano leaves 3 individual french bread loaves, baked and split 8 oz. pkg. kraft natural low moisture, part skim mozzarella cheese slices 2 c. onion rings, sauteed directions: combine meat and seasonings. shape into 6 oval patties broil both sides to desired doneness. heat together tomatoes, tomato sauce, mushrooms and oregano simmer 15 minutes. for each sandwich, top bread half with patty spread with sauce. top with cheese, onion and additional sauce broil until cheese melts. yield 6 sandwiches.

inputs: ground beef, onion, whole kernel corn, cream of celery soup, tater, salt, cheese
targets: title: beef and corn casserole ingredients: 1 lb. ground beef 1 medium onion, chopped 1 can whole kernel corn, drained 1 can cream of celery soup 1 box tater tots salt and pepper to taste 3 slices cheese directions: brown ground beef and onion in frying pan until done drain off all fat. place in casserole dish put tater tots on top of ground beef and pour can of corn on top. pour on cream of celery soup and spread all over. bake at 350 for 1 hour. when done, place the slices of cheese on top and let melt.

inputs: all purpose, brown sugar, cocoa, baking soda, salt, water, vegetable oil, white vinegar, vanilla, semi sweet chocolate chips, powdered sugar
targets: title: double chocolate snack cake 2 ingredients: 1 2/3 cups all purpose flour do not use self rising 1 cup packed brown sugar or 1 cup granulated sugar 1/4 cup cocoa 1 teaspoon baking soda 1/2 teaspoon salt 1 cup water 1/3 cup vegetable oil 1 teaspoon white vinegar 1/2 teaspoon vanilla 1/2 cup semi sweet chocolate chips powdered sugar optional, to dust cake directions: heat oven to 350 degrees. mix flour, brown sugar,cocoa, baking soda and salt with a fork in an ungreased 8x8x2in. pan square of course . stir in remaining ingredients except the chocolate chips and powdered sugar. sprinkle the chocolate chips over the batter. bake for 35 to 40 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean when inserted. cool in pan. dust with powdered sugar.

inputs: pork, grainy mustard, fresh ground pepper, paprika, thyme, caraway seed, garlic, honey, olive oil, cider vinegar, apple cider
targets: title: apple cider marinated rack of pork roast ingredients: 4 lbs pork rib roast two ribs per serving 1/2 teaspoon dry grainy mustard 1/2 teaspoon fresh ground pepper 1/4 teaspoon paprika 1/4 teaspoon dried thyme 1/2 teaspoon caraway seed, lightly crushed 1 garlic clove, peeled and crushed 1/2 tablespoon honey 2 tablespoons olive oil 2 tablespoons cider vinegar 1 cup apple cider directions: place all ingredients, except pork, in a bowl and whisk until combined. place roast in a zipper type gallon baggie. pour marinade over pork and close baggie. place in refrigerator for 4 6 hours, turning occasionally. preheat oven to 325 f. spray a medium sized roasting pan and a wire rack to fit pan, with nonstick cooking spray. remove pork from marinade and reserve marinade. place pork on rack in pan and put in oven on center rack. roast 15 minutes per pound, basting occasionally with reserved marinade, until instant read thermometer inserted in center reaches 160 f remove roast from oven and let sit on carving board about 10 minutes. place roasting pan on stove burner, over medium heat, and pour in reserved marinade. stir to loosen browned bits on bottom of pan. heat until marinade and pan juices are hot. slice roast between rib bones and serve, with pan juices drizzled on chops.

inputs: butter, powdered sugar, vanilla, flour, salt, walnuts
targets: title: russian tea cakes ingredients: 1 c. butter, softened by standing at room temperature 1/2 c. powdered sugar 1 tsp. vanilla 2 1/4 c. flour 1/2 tsp. salt 3/4 c. finely chopped walnuts directions: with a spoon, soften butter, gradually creaming in the sugar and vanilla. next, sift together the flour and salt. add walnuts to flour. combine flour and butter mixtures. refrigerate for about 1 hour. roll in hands to 1 inch balls. bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 400 for 20 minutes. roll in powdered sugar while still warm. makes about 3 dozen.

inputs: ground beef, pasta, tomato juice, onion, garlic, italian seasoning
targets: title: goulash ingredients: 1 lb ground beef 2 cups pasta 1 quart tomato juice 12 onion, chopped garlic salt italian seasoning directions: brown ground beef with onions and seasoning, drain and set aside. pour tomato juice into pan, add dry pasta i prefer to use tri colored noodles. add ground beef and cook on medium about 30 minutes. a.

inputs: butter, pita breads, mozzarella cheese, red onion, red, chicken, corn, sweet chili sauce
targets: title: satay pita pizza ingredients: 13 cup kraft smooth peanut butter or 13 cup kraft crunchy peanut butter 2 large pita breads 2 cups shredded reduced fat mozzarella cheese 1 red onion, sliced 1 red capsicum, sliced 12 small rotisserie cooked chicken, shredded 12 cup corn 14 cup sweet chili sauce directions: spread the peanut butter over each pita bread. scatter 1/2 the cheese over the peanut butter, then top with the onion, capsicum, chicken and corn. sprinkle with remaining cheese and drizzle with sweet chilli sauce. bake at 200c for 15 18 minutes or until golden and cooked through. slice and serve immediately.

inputs: frozen hash browns, butter, onion, sour cream, mushroom soup, salt
targets: title: dinner party potatoes ingredients: 2 lb. frozen hash browns 1/2 c. melted butter 3/4 c. chopped onion 16 oz. carton sour cream 1 can mushroom soup 1 jar cheez whiz salt and pepper to taste directions: defrost potatoes. place in buttered 3 quart casserole dish. combine other ingredients. pour over potatoes. combine 1/4 cup softened butter with 2 cups cracker crumbs. spread over potatoes. sprinkle with parsley. cover and bake at 350 for 45 minutes. serves 16.

inputs: potatoes, onion, garlic, chicken broth, water, pepper, salt, frozen broccoli, all purpose, milk, cheddar cheese, fresh parsley
targets: title: broccoli potato soup ingredients: 3 cups cubed peeled potatoes 1 medium onion, chopped 2 garlic cloves, minced 2 cups reduced sodium chicken broth 1 cup water dash pepper 1/8 teaspoon salt 3 cups frozen broccoli florets 3 tablespoons all purpose flour 1/3 cup fat free milk 1/2 cup shredded reduced fat sharp cheddar cheese minced fresh parsley directions: in a large saucepan, combine the first seven ingredients bring to a boil. reduce heat simmer, covered, 10 15 minutes or until potatoes are tender. stir in broccoli return to a boil. in a small bowl, whisk flour and milk until smooth stir into soup. cook and stir 2 minutes or until thickened. remove from heat cool slightly. process in batches in a blender until smooth. return to pan heat through. sprinkle servings with cheese and parsley.

inputs: chicken, ground pork, garlic, asian fish sauce, tapioca, cooked crabmeat, pepper, cilantro
targets: title: thai tapioca soup ingredients: 5 cups chicken stock or 5 cups pork stock 1/2 cup ground pork 1 tablespoon chopped garlic 3 tablespoons asian fish sauce nam pla 1/2 cup tapioca 1/2 cup cooked crabmeat or canned pepper, to taste cilantro, for garnish directions: heat the stock to simmering in a large pan. pour 1/2 cup of the hot stock into a bowl and stir in the pork. return mixture to the pan. add the garlic and fish sauce, then add the tapioca and cook for 5 to 10 minutes. when the tapioca is clear, add the crab meat and season to taste with pepper. remove from the heat. garnish with chopped cilantro before serving.

inputs: parsnips, potatoes, butter, mustard, chard, olive oil, chorizo
targets: title: stamppot dutch parsnip and chorizo mash ingredients: 3 none parsnips, peeled, chopped 6 none potatoes, peeled, chopped 4 tbsp butter 1 tbsp dijon mustard 1 bunch large greens, such as chard, kale, spinach, stalks removed, leaves finely shredded 1 tbsp olive oil 9 oz chorizo directions: bring parsnips and potatoes to a boil in a large pot of salted water. simmer for 20 30 mins, or until tender. drain then return to hot pan to dry out slightly. add butter and mustard. top with greens then cover and set aside until greens wilt. mash roughly with a potato masher. heat oil in a small frying pan over medium high heat. cook chorizo for 1 2 mins, until browned and crispy. serve hot mash in a serving bowl topped with sizzling chorizo. pour rendered chorizo oil over top. serve immediately.

inputs: apples, sugar, cinnamon, shortening, brown sugar, salt
targets: title: apple crumble ingredients: 4 c. sliced apples 6 3 to 4 tbsp. sugar cinnamon 1/4 c. shortening 3/4 c. brown sugar 1/4 tsp. salt directions: put sliced apples in a greased dish. sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon. cream shortening and sugar. add flour and salt mix until crumbly. sprinkle mixture on top of fruit. bake at 375 approximately 25 to 30 minutes.

inputs: rabbits, milk, salt, paprika, flour, oil, cooking wine, butter
targets: title: fried wild rabbits ingredients: 3 rabbits, quartered 3 c. milk 2 tbsp. salt 1 tsp. paprika 1 c. flour oil 1/4 c. cooking wine 1/4 c. butter directions: refrigerate rabbit overnight in milk and salt solution. pat dry. sprinkle pieces with pepper and paprika. roll in flour. fry in oil until brown, approximately 20 minutes. pour off drippings. add wine and butter to skillet. cover tightly and simmer for 15 minutes. serves 6. preparation time 45 minutes.

inputs: mango, banana, honey, pineapple, apples, strawberries, mango, heavy cream, sour cream, mint
targets: title: grilled fruit with mango cream ingredients: 1 overripe mango 1/2 overripe banana 1 tablespoon honey 1 pineapple, sliced 1 inch thick 2 pears, cored and sliced 1/2 inch thick 2 apples, cored and sliced 1/2 inch thick 1 pint strawberries, halved 1 mango, peeled and sliced 6 ounces heavy cream, whipped 4 ounces sour cream 1 bunch mint directions: whip together the overripe mango, banana and honey. fold in the whipped cream and sour cream. grill the pineapple, pears and apples until they start to turn brown. turn. add strawberries, and brown on the second side. arrange a platter with the mango around the outside of the plate. place the pineapple, pear, and apple in the center with the strawberries on top. serve with the mango cream and garnish.

inputs: egg beaters, salsa, onion, green chili, salt, cooking spray
targets: title: pink eggs ingredients: 1 16 ounce carton egg beaters egg substitute 1/3 cup salsa you can add less if you like 1/4 cup chopped onion 1/4 cup green chili salt and pepper cooking spray directions: spray non stick skillet with cooking spray. heat skillet on low. add all of the ingredients and just cook like you would scrambled eggs until mixture is no longer runny and cooked through.

inputs: philadelphia original cream cheese, pineapple juice, jell o, sugar, coconut extract, pineapple, whipped topping, graham cracker crusts, s angel
targets: title: creamy pina colada pie ingredients: 1 loaf philadelphia original cream cheese, softened 1 qt. pineapple juice 1 1/2 cups jell o vanilla instant pudding 3/4 cup sugar 2 tbsp. coconut extract 1 qt. canned crushed pineapple, well drained 1 gal. whipped topping, divided 6 each graham cracker crusts 9 inch 3 cups baker s angel flake coconut, toasted directions: place cream cheese, pineapple juice, dry pudding mix, sugar and extract in 12 qt. bowl of electric mixer fitted with wire whisk attachment or 2 1/2 qt. bowl for trial recipe . beat on low speed 2 min. increase speed to medium beat until well blended, stopping occasionally to scrape side and bottom of bowl. gently stir in pineapple and 2 1/4 qt. of the whipped topping or 1 1/2 cups of the whipped topping for trial recipe . pour 1 qt. of the cream cheese mixture into each crust. spread remaining 2 1/4 qt. whipped topping or remaining 1 1/2 cups whipped topping for trial recipe evenly over filling. refrigerate at least 4 hours or until set. sprinkle each pie with 1/2 cup coconut just before serving.

inputs: pineapple, orange jell o, cottage cheese, oranges
targets: title: orange salad ingredients: 1 large can crushed pineapple 1 large container cool whip 1 small pkg. orange jell o 1 small container cottage cheese 1 small can mandarin oranges, drained directions: combine all ingredients in bowl. stir well. refrigerate until ready to serve.

inputs: cucumber, sour cream, horseradish, bread, salmon
targets: title: smoked salmon and cucumber squares ingredients: 1 english cucumber, peeled 6 tablespoons sour cream 1 1/2 to 2 tablespoons drained bottled horseradish 16 slices pumpernickel cocktail bread 1/4 lb thinly sliced smoked salmon, cut into 1 1/2 inch pieces directions: halve cucumber crosswise and thinly julienne lengthwise, preferably with a mandoline or other manual slicer, working around core. discard core. stir together sour cream, horseradish, and salt and pepper to taste. divide bread into 4 stacks and cut stacks into 1 1/2 inch squares with a serrated knife, discarding crusts. spoon 1/2 teaspoon sour cream onto center of each bread square, then top with a folded piece of salmon. top salmon with a small amount of cucumber, twirled into a mound.

inputs: ground red pepper, ground black pepper, salt, water, cider vinegar, mustard, garlic, sandwich buns
targets: title: grilled chicken sliders with apricot chutney spread ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs skinless boneless, chicken thighs 3/8 teaspoon ground red pepper 1/2 teaspoon ground black pepper 1/8 teaspoon salt 3 apricots, halved and pitted 1 tablespoon water 1 tablespoon cider vinegar 1 tablespoon dijon mustard 2 garlic cloves, chopped 8 mini sandwich buns directions: combine first 3 ingredients in a small bowl. sprinkle chicken with pepper mixture. place a large grill pan over medium high heat, and coat with cooking spray. add chicken to pan, cook 5 minutes on each side or until done. cool slightly, and shred meat. recoat pan with cooking spray, and place apricots cut side down on pan, and cook 6 minutes on medium high heat or until tender and lightly browned, turning after 4 minutes. place apricots and add water, cider vinegar, mustard, and garlic cloves in a food processor, and process until smooth. spread 1/2 teaspoon apricot chutney over cut side of each sandwich bun half. place 1/3 cup chicken on bottom bun, and cover with other half of bun.

inputs: steak, grease, onions, potatoes, mushroom soup, milk, green beans
targets: title: round steak casserole ingredients: 1 round steak a little grease diced onions potatoes 1 can mushroom soup 1 c. milk 1 can green beans directions: take first 2 ingredients and brown the round steak. then cut it into 1 inch squares. put meat on bottom of pan. on top of that, put a layer of onion, then a layer of potatoes. then mix the mushroom soup and milk. put over casserole. bake at 350 for 1 hour. drain green beans, then put them over the top and bake for another 15 minutes.

inputs: cereal, egg, milk powder, baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon, vanilla, applesauce
targets: title: bran muffins diet ingredients: 1/2 c. 100 bran cereal 1 egg 1/3 c. dry milk powder 2 pkg. sweetener equal 1 tsp. baking powder 1/2 tsp. baking soda 1/2 tsp. cinnamon 1/2 tsp. vanilla 1/2 c. applesauce unsweetened or 1/2 c. pumpkin canned or 1/2 banana pick one directions: mix together all dry ingredients. add the rest of ingredients. bake at 375 or until done.

inputs: custard sauce, milk, cornstarch, sugar, egg yolks, vanilla, trifle, poundcake, raspberry jam, sherry, brandy, heavy whipping cream, sugar, raspberries, peach
targets: title: raspberry brandy trifle ingredients: custard sauce 3 cups milk 4 tablespoons cornstarch 2 tablespoons sugar 2 egg yolks 1 teaspoon vanilla trifle 1 loaf purchased poundcake 5x3x3 4 tablespoons raspberry jam 1 cup medium dry sherry 1/4 cup brandy 2 cups heavy whipping cream 2 tablespoons sugar 1/4 cup raspberries 1/4 cup peach, slices directions: custard sauce in a heavy saucepan, combine 1/2 cup milk cornstarch. stir with wire whisk until cornstarch dissolved. add remaining 2.5 cups of milk and sugar. cover over moderate heat. stir until sauce thickens and comes to a boil. in small bowl, stir egg yolks with a fork and stir in 4 5 tbsp of custard sauce. whisk mixture back into remaining sauce. return to boil and boil for 1 minute while stirring constantly. remove from heat and add vanilla. trifle cut pound cake into 1 inch thick slices. spread jam on slices. place slices of cake, jam side up, in glass trifle bowl creating a first layer. combine sherry and brandy. sprinkle first layer with sherry brandy combination. repeat with rest of cake alcohol mixture. let rest for 30 minutes at room temperature. while cake is resting, beat whipping cream in a cold bowl until soft peaks form. add 2 tbsp of sugar to whipping cream and stir. pour custard sauce over top of cake. then top with whipped cream and garnish with fresh fruit. refrigerate.

inputs: carrots, zucchini, flour, sugar, baking soda, baking powder, cinnamon, ginger, pineapple, light brown sugar, egg substitute, oil, vanilla, raisins, sugar
targets: title: carrot cake ingredients: 2 c. shredded carrots 1 c. zucchini, shredded 3 c. sifted flour 1/2 c. sugar 2 tsp. baking soda 1 tsp. baking powder 2 tsp. cinnamon 1/2 tsp. ginger 1 20 oz. can crushed pineapple 1 c. light brown sugar 8 oz. egg substitute, thawed 2/3 c. oil 1 tbsp. vanilla 1 c. raisins 3/4 c. 10x sugar directions: in large bowl, mix flour, sugar 1/2 cup white , cinnamon, soda, baking powder and ginger. drain pineapple well save juice. in medium bowl, mix pineapple, brown sugar, egg substitute, oil and vanilla with fork until smooth. stir pineapple mixture, carrots, zucchini and raisins into flour mixture. stir until moist. pour into greased and floured bundt pan. bake at 350 for 55 minutes, or until toothpick is clean. when cool, you can glaze with powdered sugar and pineapple juice.

inputs: uncle ben, chicken breasts, cream of mushroom soup, cream of chicken soup, cheddar cheese, almonds
targets: title: chicken and wild rice ingredients: 2 boxes uncle ben s long grain and wild rice i use the fast cooking kind 2 pkg. boneless chicken breasts raw , cut in half 1 can cream of mushroom soup, thinned with water 1 can cream of chicken soup, thinned with water 2 c. cheddar cheese, grated slivered almonds directions: cook rice according to package. layer in large pyrex dish or 2 small dishes , rice, chicken and soups. bake for 1 hour at 375 . layer cheese and almonds on top and bake for an additional 5 minutes or until cheese is melted.

inputs: bisquick mix, sugar, margarine, milk, chilled whipping cream, strawberries
targets: title: strawberry shortcakes ingredients: 2 1/3 c. bisquick mix 3 tbsp. sugar 3 tbsp. margarine, melted 1/2 c. milk 3/4 c. chilled whipping cream sliced strawberries, sweetened directions: heat oven to 425 . mix bisquick, sugar, margarine and milk until soft dough forms. gently smooth dough into ball on cloth covered board, dusted with bisquick. knead. roll dough 1/2 inch thick, cut with 3 inch cutter dipped in bisquick. bake on ungreased cookie sheet until golden brown, 10 to 12 minutes. beat whipping cream in chilled bowl until stiff. split shortcakes. spoon strawberries between halves and on tops. top with cream.

inputs: beer, vegetable oil, salt, garlic powder, pepper, flank steaks, butter, paprika, onions, sour cream, horseradish, bread
targets: title: stroganoff steak sandwiches ingredients: 1 cup beer preferably dark, but any beer will do 1/3 cup vegetable oil 1 teaspoon salt 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder 1/2 teaspoon pepper, course ground 4 1/2 lbs flank steaks 2 tablespoons butter 1/2 teaspoon paprika we use smoked spanish paprika 4 cups sliced onions 12 ounces sour cream 1 teaspoon horseradish more or less, to taste 12 slices french bread thick cut, we buy whole loaves and slice, on the diaganol, into 3/4 inch slices directions: combine beer, oil, garlic powder, salt and pepper. place flank steak in marinade. a gallon ziploc bag works great . refridgerate overnight, turning occassionally. in a skillet, melt butter add paprika and a dash of salt, then add onions and saute until tender. in a small saucepan, mix sour cream and horseradish and heat on low until sour cream is warm. drain steak and barbeque or broil 5 7 minutes per side for medium rare. cover and let rest for 10 minutes before slicing. toast french bread slightly. i toast them under the broiler with door slightly open , but you have to watch carefully. don t think you can do anything else, or you ll forget about them and have burned toast . slice meat very thin across the grain, and on an angle. pile meat on toast, cover with onions, some sour cream and a sprinkle of paprika, then top sandwich with other toast.

inputs: shrimp, pasta, bell pepper, celery, green onion, pimento, canola oil, lemon juice, salad supreme seasoning, mayonnaise
targets: title: shrimp and pasta salad ingredients: 1 pkg. cooked shrimp 1 lb. box corkscrew pasta 1 bell pepper bunch celery green onion 1 jar jar diced pimento 1 1/3 tbsp. canola oil 3 tsp. lemon juice 1 tsp. tony s creole seasoning 1 1/2 tsp. mccormick salad supreme seasoning 1 cup mayonnaise directions: rinse and thaw the cooked shrimp. lay out on paper towels to absorb as much moisture as possible. cook corkscrew pasta. drain, rinse well and place in large bowl chop finely bell pepper, celery, green onion and pimento. add to pasta and mix well. mix together in small bowl 4 t. canola oil 3 t. lemon juice 1 t. tony s creole seasoning 1 1/2 t. mccormick salad supreme seasoning 1 cup mayonnaise mix well and our over pasta mixture. add shrimp or other cooked meat, i.e. diced ham, chicken, hard salami, etc and refrigerate overnight for best flavor.

inputs: frozen peas, cream cheese, milk, chicken breasts
targets: title: almost instant tortellini and cheese with chicken better homes ingredients: 1 9 ounce packagerefrigerated cheese tortellini 1 cup frozen peas 1 8 ounce container cream cheese spread garden vegetable flavor or chive and onion 12 cup milk 1 9 ounce packagefrozen chopped cooked chicken breasts directions: in a large saucepan cook tortellini according to package directions. place frozen vegetable in colander. drain the hot pasta over vegetables to thaw return pasta vegetable mixture to pan. meanwhile, in a small saucepan combine cream cheese and milk heat and stir until cheese is melted. heat chicken according to package directions. stir cheese sauce into cooked pasta vegetable mixture. cook and gently stir until heated through. spoon into individual serving bowls. top with chicken. makes 4 servings.

inputs: pie crust, italian sausage, eggs, whipping cream, mozzarella, tomato, oregano, red pepper, salt
targets: title: sausage and tomato quiche ingredients: 1 whole wheat pie crust 1/2 lb italian sausage maybe less 3 eggs 1 1/2 cups whipping cream 1 cup mozzarella 1 tomato, diced 2 tsp oregano 1/2 tsp dried red pepper flakes 1/2 tsp tonys seasoning 1/2 tsp salt directions: preheat oven to 425. place pie crust on cookie sheet. brown italian sausage and drain. sprinkle italian sausage, mozzarella and tomato into pie crust. beat together eggs, salt, red pepper flakes and tonys. mix in whipping cream and pour into pie crust. sprinkle oregano on top. bake 15 minutes at 425. reduce oven temperature to 300 and bake about 40 minutes. let stand before serving.

inputs: salmon, olive oil, brown sugar, garlic, paprika, paprika, chili powder, lemon
targets: title: easy brazilian spiced salmon ingredients: 4 salmon fillets 2 tablespoons olive oil 2 tablespoons brown sugar 4 cloves garlic, minced 1 teaspoon smoked paprika 1 teaspoon paprika 1 teaspoon chili powder 1/2 lemon directions: preheat the oven to 425 degrees f 220 degrees c . grease a baking sheet. place salmon fillets on the prepared baking sheet. mix olive oil, brown sugar, garlic, smoked paprika, paprika, and chile powder together in a bowl. spread mixture over salmon fillets. squeeze lemon juice on top. bake in the preheated oven until fish flakes easily with a fork, 13 to 15 minutes.

inputs: semi sweet chocolate chips, condensed milk, salt, vanilla, nuts
targets: title: foolproof fudge ingredients: 3 6 oz. each pkg. semi sweet chocolate chips 1 14 oz. can sweetened condensed milk dash of salt 1 1/2 tsp. vanilla 1/2 c. chopped nuts optional directions: combine chips, salt, condensed milk and vanilla in large microwave safe bowl. cook on high for up to 3 minutes. stir to melt any whole chips. add nuts if desired. spread evenly into wax paper lined 8 inch square pan. chill 2 hours or more. turn onto board peel off paper. cut in 1 inch squares.

inputs: ground beef, crusty rolls, tomatoes, red peppers, red onions, red wine vinegar, mayonnaise, parmesan cheese, fresh basil, garlic
targets: title: burgers with red relish and herb aioli ingredients: 1 12 lbs ground beef 4 crusty rolls 14 cup diced tomatoes 2 tablespoons roasted red peppers, rinsed,and minced 2 tablespoons finely chopped red onions 2 teaspoons red wine vinegar 13 cup mayonnaise 2 tablespoons shredded parmesan cheese 2 tablespoons finely chopped fresh basil 2 cloves garlic, minced directions: combine relish ingredients cover and chill. combine aioli ingredients in separate bowl cover and chill. shape meat into 4 patties and cook over grill until it is how you want it done. spread aioli on bottom of bun top with burger. spoon relish over and garnish with parmesan pieces thinly sliced.

inputs: lean pork, olive oil, beans, salsa, green chilies, tomatoes, tortilla chips, cheddar cheese, iceberg lettuce, sour cream, black olives
targets: title: skillet taco supreme ingredients: 1 lb lean pork or 1 lb beef, cut into cubes 1 tablespoon olive oil 1 16 ounce can refried beans 1 cup salsa home made or your favorite bottled 1 4 ounce can diced green chilies 2 large tomatoes, diced 2 cups broken tortilla chips 1 cup grated cheddar cheese 2 cups iceberg lettuce, shredded 12 cup sour cream 12 cup black olives directions: using a large skillet, cook the cubed pork over medium high heat for 8 10 minutes in olive oil, until browned and partially cooked. add refried beans, green chiles, and salsa, stirring until blended. cook until mixture reaches a near boil, then lower heat and simmer, stirring frequently to keep pork from sticking to the skillet. check the pork for doneness in 6 10 minutes there should be no pink in the center of the cubed meat . remove from heat. add tomatoes, chips and cheese, in that order. cover just long enough to melt the cheese. top with sour cream, lettuce and olives. serve immediately.

inputs: processed cheese, sausage, cream of mushroom soup, salsa, chili powder
targets: title: zesty sausage con quesa ingredients: 1 32 oz. bar processed cheese 1 16 oz. pkg. medium or hot bulk sausage 1 can cream of mushroom soup use amount for desired consistency 1 11 1/2 oz. jar hot chunky salsa chili powder to taste if desired directions: cook sausage until brown. in a double boiler, melt cheese. add other ingredients, including sausage. serve warm with tortilla chips. also good served over scrambled eggs. a good dish for a buffet or party.

inputs: peanut butter, butter, sugar, corn syrup, eggs, vanilla, flour, baking soda, salt, cocoa powder, butter, marshmallows
targets: title: peanut butter and chocolate cookie sandwich cookies ingredients: 1/2 cup peanut butter chips 1/2 cup butter or margarine, 1 1/4 cups sugar divided 1/4 cup corn syrup, light 1 each eggs 1 teaspoon vanilla extract 2 tablespoons flour, all purpose 2 teaspoons baking soda 1/4 teaspoon salt 1/2 cup cocoa powder 5 tablespoons butter 24 each marshmallows directions: heat oven to 350f 180c . in small saucepan over very low heat, melt peanut butter chips and 3 tablespoons softened butter. remove from heat cool slightly. in large mixer bowl, beat remaining 1/2 cup softened butter and 1 cup sugar until light and fluffy. add corn syrup, egg and vanilla blend thoroughly. combine 2 cups flour, baking soda and salt add to butter mixture, blending well. remove 1 1/4 cups batter and place in a small bowl with wooden spoon, stir in remaining 2 tablespoons flour and peanut butter chip mixture. blend cocoa, remaining 1/4 cup sugar and melted butter into remaining batter. refrigerate both batters 5 to 10 minutes or until firm enough to handle. roll both doughs into 1 inch balls roll in additional sugar. place on ungreased cookie sheet. bake 10 to 11 minutes or until set. cool slightly remove from cookie sheet to wire rack. cool completely. place 1 marshmallow on flat side of 1 chocolate cookie.

inputs: ground beef, tater, onion, mushroom soup, milk, shredded cheese, salt
targets: title: tater tot casserole ingredients: 2 lb. ground beef 2 lb. tater tots 1 c. chopped onion 2 cans mushroom soup 1 soup can milk 1 c. shredded cheese salt to taste directions: brown meat drain off excess fat. layer ingredients in a 9 x 13 inch loaf pan. bake at 350 for 1 hour.

inputs: cabbage, potatoes, carrots, onion, garlic
targets: title: memphis garlic frank dinner ingredients: 1 head cabbage 6 potatoes, peeled and quartered 8 ounces baby carrots 1 medium onion 6 garlic franks directions: chop vegetables and place potatoes/carrots/onions in bottom of large pot and cover with water. i salt and pepper genourously. then place cabbage on top of veggies add more salt and pepper . add 2 tbsp of butter. add 1 tbsp of bacon grease. place garlic franks over cabbage and cover. cook for 45 minutes or until cabbage is soft. sometimes i cook mine in the crockpot because of the pan size. i cook on high for 2 hours in the crockpot. however the garlic franks will bust open like hot dogs in the the crockpot. enjoy

inputs: warm milk, yeast, shortening, sugar, salt, flour
targets: title: yeast rolls in a flash ingredients: 2 cups warm milk 2 packages yeast 1/2 cup melted shortening 1/2 cup sugar 1/2 teaspoon salt 4 cups self rising flour directions: combine milk, shortening and yeast. add sugar, salt and flour. roll out and cut with biscuit cutter. place on greased baking pan, let rise in warm draft free place for 30 minutes. bake at 350 degrees f. for 15 20 minutes.

inputs: chicken parts, ketchup, water, brown sugar, onion soup
targets: title: chicken hurry ingredients: 2 1/2 to 3 lb. chicken parts 1/2 c. ketchup 1/4 c. water 1/4 c. brown sugar, packed 1 pkg. dry onion soup directions: remove skin from the chicken parts. arrange the chicken in casserole. mix together the ketchup, water, sugar and soup mix. spoon over the chicken parts. bake, covered, in a 350 oven for at least 1 hour until tender . this is delicious served with rice.

inputs: carrots washed, potatoes, onion, clove garlic, salt, parsley, chicken
targets: title: carrots creamy soup ingredients: 5 large carrots washed peeled and cut roughly 5 medium potatoes wash peeled and cut roughly 1 large onion cut roughly 2 clove garlic 1 salt and pepper to taste 1 dry parsley and sour cream to garnish 2 chicken stock cubes directions: wash peel and cut all veggies place the in a medium sauce pan cover with water add the stock cubes and season to taste ,cook in medium heat about 40minutes until the veggies are cooked place everything on food processor and pure garnish with sour cream and parsley

inputs: avocado, tomatoes, orange, red onion, bibb lettuce, fresh cilantro, olive oil, lemon, lime, garlic, mustard, chili powder, honey, salt
targets: title: avocado and orange salad ingredients: 1 large avocado, sliced into thin wedges 2 tomatoes, cut into wedges 1 2 orange, peeled and cut into segments 1 red onion, sliced very thin 2 heads bibb lettuce 1 tablespoon chopped fresh cilantro 14 cup olive oil 12 lemon, juice of 1 lime, juice of 2 garlic cloves, mashed 12 teaspoon dry mustard 14 teaspoon good chili powder 14 teaspoon honey salt and pepper directions: mix the dressing ingredients well or in a blender until smooth. on a plate lay the bib lettuce down. arrange the avocado, tomato, orange and onion slices on top. pour over the dressing and garnish with fresh chopped cilantro.

inputs: caramels, milk, layer, butter, walnuts, semi sweet chocolate pieces
targets: title: chocolate caramel nut bars ingredients: 14 oz. caramels 2/3 cup evaporated milk 1 two layer german chocolate cake mix with pudding 1/2 cup butter, melted 1 1/2 cup walnuts, chopped 6 oz. semi sweet chocolate pieces directions: melt caramels with 1/2 cup of milk over low heat, stirring until smooth. combine remaining milk, cake mix and butter. mix well. press half of mixture into bottom of greased 13x9 pan. bake at 350, 6 minutes. sprinkle 1 cup walnuts and chocolate pieces over crust. top with caramel mixture, spreading it to the edges of the pan. top with remaining cake mixture, dropping by teaspoonful. press gently into caramel mixture. sprinkle with remaining walnuts, pressing lightly into top. bake at 350, 20 minutes. cool slightly, refrigerate. cut into bars and serve.

inputs: sugar, butter, eggs, syrup, salt, vanilla, flour, sugar, butter, creme, semi sweet chocolate chips, butter
targets: title: creme de menthe brownies ingredients: 1 c. sugar 1/2 c. butter, melted 4 eggs 1 16 oz. can hershey s syrup 1/2 tsp. salt 1 tsp. vanilla 1 c. flour 2 c. 10x sugar 1/2 c. butter, melted 2 tbsp. creme de menthe ice cream topping 1 c. semi sweet chocolate chips 6 tbsp. butter directions: mix together the 10x sugar, butter and ice cream topping. spread on top of cooled brownies. melt the chocolate chips and butter on stove. pour over brownies in pan and spread smooth. refrigerate. cut into squares with warm knife.

inputs: curry, chicken, thai green curry paste, oil, lime, coconut, ricestick noodles, sugar, lime juice, green onions, coriander, green chili, coconut milk, fish sauce
targets: title: grilled thai chicken fillets with coconut noodles ingredients: curry chicken fillets 4 chicken breast fillets, halved lengthways 2 make thinner chicken fillet pieces 4 teaspoons thai green curry paste, stote purchased bottled sauce is fine check gluten free if required for diet 2 tablespoons oil 1 lime, cut into wedges for serving coconut and coriander cilantro noodles 200 g dried ricestick noodles 2 teaspoons sugar or 8 10 drops of stevia liquid 2 tablespoons lime juice 8 green onions, slice on an angle 1 cup coriander leaves cilantro 1 2 long green chili, sliced 200 ml coconut milk 2 tablespoons fish sauce check gluten free if required for a gf diet directions: to make the noodles place the dried noodles in a large heatproof bowl and cover with boiling water. stand for 10 minutes, or until tender, drain and rinse well until cool. dissolve the sugar or use stevia in the lime juice and pour over the noodles. add the remaining ingredients for the coconut and coriander cilantro noodles and toss gentley to combine. to serve as a cold dish, you can now divide this among the serving plates. this noodle dish can also be served warm either heat gentley in a saucepan or heat using a mcrowave. for the chicken brush the chicken on both sides with the cobined curry paste and the oil to lightly coat. you may need to add a little extra oil if required, depending on how thick the green curry paste is. preheat a char grill, broiler or barbecue plate to high and cook the chicken for 2 3 minutes each side, or until cooked through. serve the chicken with the noodles with wedges of lime and a light sprinkle of coriander/cilantro leaves.

inputs: irish whiskey, bailey irish cream, hot coffee, whipped cream
targets: title: irish coffee ingredients: 1 1/2 ounces irish whiskey 1 ounce bailey irish cream hot coffee, to fill a mug whipped cream directions: add the whiskey and irish cream to a mug stir. fill mug with hot coffee stir. top with whipped cream.

inputs: butter, sugar, eggs, flour, golden syrup, oranges, water
targets: title: eric lanlard s orange upside down sponge recipe ingredients: 200 g 7.1oz unsalted butter 200 g 7.1oz golden caster sugar 5 eggs 200 g 7.1oz self raising flour 50 g 1.8oz golden syrup 4 large oranges if in season blood orange 200 ml 7fl oz water directions: heat the oven to 180c. in a small saucepan bring to the boil 200ml of water and 200grams of sugar. slice the oranges in thin slices keeping the peel on, place in the syrup and allow to simmer for 10minutes. line a shallow 22cm spring form cake tin with paper and grease it. cream the butter and sugar together until light and fluffy. beat in the eggs and then fold in the flour. place the drained slices of oranges into the base of the tin. add the golden syrup, then spoon the cake mixture on top. bake for roughly 30 to 35 minutes or until the cake is cooked thru, prick with a knife or skewer and if it comes out clean it s ready. cool the cake in the tin, turn out and remove the paper. use the poaching syrup to serve.

inputs: margarine, onions, clove garlic, bell pepper, flour, parsley, velveeta cheese, crawfish, fettucine noodles, chachere
targets: title: crawfish fettucine ingredients: 1 1/2 c. margarine 1 to 2 medium onions, chopped 1 clove garlic, minced 1 medium bell pepper, chopped 1/4 c. flour 2 to 4 tbsp. parsley 1 pt. half and half 1 lb. velveeta cheese 2 lb. crawfish 1 lb. fettucine noodles, boiled tony chachere seasoning directions: saute onions, garlic and bell pepper in margarine. cook until onions are translucent. add 1/4 cup flour to vegetables. cover and cook on low 15 minutes. add crawfish and parsley to vegetables and cook 15 more minutes. stir in velveeta and half and half. when thoroughly blended, add boiled fettucine. bake in covered dish at 350 for 15 minutes. can also serve sauce over fettucine instead of casserole style. serves 4 to 6.

inputs: butter, sugar, eggs, flour, cake spice, cloves, cinnamon, soda, buttermilk
targets: title: jam cake ingredients: 1 c. butter 1 c. sugar 4 eggs 2 c. plain flour 1 1/4 c. jam 1 tbsp. cake spice 1 tbsp. cloves 1 tbsp. cinnamon 1 tsp. soda 1 tbsp. buttermilk directions: cream sugar and butter. add eggs and spices. sift flour slowly. add flour, soda and buttermilk and jam. bake for 30 minutes at 350 .

inputs: whole wheat flour, oats, splenda sugar substitute, baking powder, baking soda, salt, nonfat milk, sugar, blueberries
targets: title: sue s somersized muffins ingredients: 1 1/3 cups whole wheat flour 1 1/2 cups oats 3/4 cup splenda sugar substitute or equivalent of 3/4 cup sugar 2 1/2 teaspoons baking powder 1 teaspoon baking soda 3/4 teaspoon salt 1 cup nonfat milk 1 cup fat free sugar free yogurt 1 cup blueberries directions: preheat oven to 375 degrees. in medium bowl mix together all dry ingredients. make a well inthe middle and add yogurt milk. stir until blended. gently toss in blueberries and distribute them as evenly as possible. spoon into muffin tins that have been sprayed with pam. bake at 375 for 25 minutes or until middle is cooked. cool on wire rack. wrap muffins individually and freeze in ziploc bag any portions that will not be eaten within the next day. can be warmed up in the microwave and 2 make a filling carb breakfast. enjoy

inputs: cook pasta, mascarpone, mustard, cheddar cheese, tomatoes, chives, salt
targets: title: super speedy spaghetti bake ingredients: 225 g dried quick cook pasta 250 g mascarpone 1 teaspoon dijon mustard 175 g mature cheddar cheese, grated 6 sun dried tomatoes, finely chopped 2 tablespoons fresh snipped chives salt freshly ground black pepper directions: preheat the oven to 220 c. cook the spaghetti in a large pan of boiling salted water. drain well and return to the pan. add the mascarpone and dijon mustard, stirring until the mascarpone melts around the pasta. stir in the cheddar, sun dried tomatoes and chives and season. turn into an ovenproof dish and bake for 15 minutes until bubbling and golden brown.

inputs: blueberries, lemon zest, maple syrup, , all purpose, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, salt, blueberries, egg, buttermilk, butter, syrup
targets: title: blueberry pancakes with blueberry sauce ingredients: for the sauce 4 cups blueberries 1 teaspoon lemon zest 1 cup maple syrup for the pancakes 1 cup all purpose flour 2 tablespoons sugar 1 teaspoon baking powder 1/2 teaspoons baking soda 1/2 teaspoons salt 1 1/2 cup blueberries 1 whole egg 3/4 cups buttermilk 2 tablespoons butter, melted optional garnish syrup, whipped cream directions: to make the sauce, combine the lemon zest and blueberries in a medium saucepan over medium heat. the blueberries will start to give off their juices so you don t need to add any liquid to the pan. just make sure to stir them often so they don t burn. cook them until all the juices are released, about 7 8 minutes. then press through a sieve to remove the pulp, make sure to press all the juice out. put the juice into a clean sauce pan and add the maple syrup, cook, stirring often until thick and syrupy, about 10 minutes. in a medium mixing bowl, combine the flour, sugar, baking powder, soda and salt, whisk to combine. add the blueberries and toss to coat with the flour mixture. in another small bowl combine the egg, buttermilk and melted butter. add to the flour mixture and stir until mostly smooth. heat a griddle or large skillet to medium, spray with cooking spray and drop about 1/2 cup of batter at a time onto the griddle to make the pancakes. allow to cook until slightly brown on one side, then flip over and brown the other side. to serve place 2 pancakes on a plate, top with syrup and whipped cream if desired.

inputs: carrot, cilantro, salt, olive oil
targets: title: warm bulgur lentil salad ingredients: 1 cup cooked bulgur 1 cup cooked lentils 1 carrot, diced, sauteed in olive oil 3 tablespoons chopped cilantro 1 dash smoked sea salt olive oil directions: combine everything in a salad bowl. drizzle with olive oil and season with smoked sea salt and pepper. this salad is best served warm. it can be a meal in itself or accompany grilled meat, roasted chicken or steamed fish. variations you can always add red onions, roasted peppers and a few splashes of lemon juice to this salad. use this recipe as a template and experiment with different flavors.

inputs: red potatoes, olive oil, thyme, garlic salt, balsamic vinegar, sugar
targets: title: thyme roasted potato w/ balsamic vinegar ingredients: 2 lbs small red potatoes, scrubbed, halved olive oil 4 tablespoons chopped fresh thyme 2 teaspoons garlic salt 1 12 cups balsamic vinegar 3 tablespoons sugar directions: preheat oven to 400f place potatoes in large bowl. generously coat potatoes with olive oil. sprinkle with 3 tablespoons thyme and garlic salt. toss to coat. coat large rimmed baking sheet with olive oil. arrange potatoes, cut side down, on sheet. roast potatoes until tender and golden brown, turning every 15 minutes and roasting about 45 minutes total. meanwhile, stir vinegar and sugar in heavy small saucepan over high heat until sugar dissolves. boil until liquid is reduced to 2/3 cup, about 10 minutes. mix in remaining 1 tablespoon thyme. transfer potatoes to plates. drizzle some balsamic syrup over potatoes.

inputs: creamettes shells, crabmeat, celery, green onions, mayonnaise, sour cream, eggs, salt, pepper
targets: title: crabmeat salad ingredients: 1 7 oz. pkg. creamettes shells 1 7 1/2 oz. can crabmeat, drained and flaked 1 c. thinly sliced celery 1/2 c. sliced green onions 1/2 c. mayonnaise 1/2 c. dairy sour cream 3 sliced, hard cooked eggs 1 tsp. salt 1/8 tsp. pepper 2 c. lettuce, torn in bite size pieces optional directions: prepare shells according to package directions for salad use. combine all ingredients except lettuce. chill. just before serving, toss salad with lettuce. makes 6 servings.

inputs: butter, sugar, brown sugar, eggs, vanilla, flour, baking pwdr, semi sweet chocolate chips
targets: title: dianne s best ever chocolate chip cookies recipe ingredients: 2 sticks 1 c. softened butter 3/4 c. sugar 3/4 c. brown sugar 2 lg. large eggs 1 teaspoon vanilla 2 c. flour 1 teaspoon baking pwdr 2 c. 12 ounce. semi sweet chocolate chips directions: in a bowl with an electric mixer cream the butter add in the sugars and beat till light and fluffy. beat in the large eggs and vanilla. sift together the dry ingredients and add in gradually to the butter mix. stir in the chocolate chips. foil line the baking sheets and drop tbsp. of batter 1 1/2 inches apart onto the sheets. bake for 12 15 min at 325 degrees till brown at edges. let cookies cold on the sheets for 1 minute before lifting them off. makes 28 cookies.

inputs: flour, baking powder, salt, sugar, egg, milk, peanut butter, shortening
targets: title: rosa parks featherlite peanut butter pancakes recipe ingredients: 1 cup flour 2 tablespoons baking powder 1/2 teaspoon salt 2 tablespoons sugar 1 egg 1 1/4 cup milk 1/3 cup peanut butter i used peanut butter co. smooth operator 1 tablespoon shortening or oil for the pan directions: sift together the flour, baking powder, salt, and sugar and set aside. in a separate bowl, blend the egg, milk, and peanut butter together until smooth. combine the dry and wet mixtures. to keep the pancakes tender, don t over mix. a few small lumps are ok. add the oil or shortening to a hot griddle or frying pan ms. parks specified 275 f . and cook for about 60 seconds on each side. enjoy with maple syrup, honey, or a dollop of jam.

inputs: pecans, coconut, flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, salt, buttermilk, heavy cream, butter, vanilla, eggs, pecans, cream cheese, butter, maple syrup, vanilla, powdered sugar, milk
targets: title: italian cream pancakes ingredients: 23 cup finely chopped pecans 12 cup sweetened flaked coconut 2 cups all purpose flour 13 cup sugar 1 teaspoon baking powder 12 teaspoon baking soda 12 teaspoon salt 1 cup buttermilk 34 cup heavy cream 2 tablespoons butter, melted 2 teaspoons vanilla extract 2 large eggs, separated chopped toasted pecans, garnish 4 ounces cream cheese, softened 14 cup butter, softened 14 cup maple syrup 1 teaspoon vanilla extract 1 cup powdered sugar 14 cup milk directions: preheat the oven to 350. bake pecans and coconut in a single layer in a shallow pan. bake 5 7 minutes or until lightly toasted and fragrant, stirring halfway through. stir together flour and next 4 ingredients in a large bowl. whisk together the buttermilk, next 3 ingredients, and 2 egg yolks in another bowl. gradually stir buttermilk mixture into flour mixture just until dry ingredients are moistened. stir in pecans and coconut. beat egg whites at high speed with an electric mixer until stiff peaks form, and fold into batter. pour about 1/4 cup batter for each pancake onto a hot buttered griddle or large nonstick skillet. cook pancakes 3 4 minutes or until tops are covered with bubbles and edges look dry and cooked. turn and cook 3 4 minutes or until done. place pancakes in a single layer on a baking sheet and keep warm in a 200 oven up to 30 minutes. serve with cream cheese syrup beat cream cheese, butter, maple syrup, and vanilla extract at medium speed with an electric mixer until creamy. gradually add powdered sugar, beating until smooth. gradually add milk, beating until smooth. if desired, microwave syrup in a microwave safe bowl at high 10 15 seconds or just until warm, stir until smooth.

inputs: sugar, butter, flour, eggs, vanilla, milk
targets: title: mac s old fashioned pound cake recipe ingredients: 1 pound box confectioner s sugar 4 sticks butter, softened 1 pound plain flour refill the sugar box about 4/5 full 6 large eggs 2 teaspoon vanilla 1/2 c. lowfat milk directions: cream together sugar and butter. add in flour and large eggs alternately, then add in vanilla and lowfat milk. put in greased and floured tube pan and bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour.

inputs: hazelnuts, garlic, fresh cilantro, salt, olive oil, olive oil, parmesan cheese
targets: title: hazelnut cilantro pasta sauce ingredients: 13 cup hazelnuts 3 garlic cloves 1 bunch fresh cilantro 1 14 teaspoons salt 5 tablespoons olive oil 1 tablespoon olive oil parmesan cheese, grated directions: finely chop the hazelnuts. put the nuts, garlic cloves, cilanto, salt and 5 tablespoons of the olive oil in a blender. blend to create the sauce. heat the remaining 1 tablepoon of oil in a small saucepan and add to the sauce. fry very gently until heated through. serve over 12 oz of your favorite cooked pasta. sprinkle with freshly grated parmesan cheese.

inputs: flour, baking powder teaspn, sugar, margarine, butter milk, eggs, orange juice tbspn
targets: title: easy spongy rich cake. ingredients: 1 1/2 cups plain flour 1/2 baking powder teaspn 5 sugar tbspn of white, sugar 4 margarine tbspn of 1/2 cup butter milk 2 large eggs 2 orange juice tbspn of directions: add baking powder ti plain flour nd kip aside. mix margarine and sugar until pluffy,add egg yolk nd kip d white aside. add flour nd milk until well incorporated,add orange juice,mix again,den u add d egg white,and vanilla flavor,and mix again. grease ur baking pan,pour d batter and insert into d oven after preheating,bake for 15 20mins until skewer inserted comes out clean.remove and cool on wire rack.

inputs: cake, all purpose flour, sugar, milk, eggs, butter, baking soda, vanilla, filling, heavy cream, sugar, various fruit
targets: title: japanese sponge cake ingredients: cake 3/4 cup all purpose flour 2/3 cup sugar 1 tablespoon milk 3 eggs 1 1/2 tablespoons butter 1/4 teaspoon baking soda optional, see comments above 1 teaspoon vanilla optional, see comments above filling and topping 1 1/2 cups heavy cream 4 tablespoons sugar use sifted powdered sugar if not serving immediately various fruit strawberries, peaches, cherries, etc directions: preheat oven to 350 f grease and line a 7 inch 18 cm round cake pan with parchment paper. whisk eggs very well in a bowl. place bowl in a larger bowl partially filled with warm water to make a warm water bath. continue to whisk eggs. add sugar a little at a time, whisking all the while. when the egg mixture is a light yellow color, sift the flour and add it to the eggs along with the baking soda if using and mix in lightly. warm the milk in the microwave add butter and stir until melted. add milk mixture and vanilla if using to egg mixture and stir in gently. pour batter into prepared pan and bake at 350 f for 25 35 minutes cake should be springy in center when gently pressed with fingers . remove cake from pan and cool on wire rack. when cake is cool, slice in half horizontally to make 2 layers. in a large bowl, whip cream and sugar together until fairly stiff. divide whipped cream into two portions set one half aside. to remaining half of whipped cream, add chopped fruit as desired. spread fruited whipped cream over the bottom half of the cake. top with upper half, and spread whipped cream over top, and sides of cake if desired or leave them uncovered if preferred . garnish top with additional fresh fruit and serve.

inputs: butter, jumbo shrimp, black olives, green olives, cherry tomatoes, hearts, parsley, tarragon, portion
targets: title: alice s special shrimp recipe ingredients: 1 x or possibly more tb butter 5 x raw jumbo shrimp, shelled/deveined 4 x black olives, pitted 4 x green olives, pitted 4 x ripe cherry tomatoes 3 x artichoke hearts, in oil, lightly liquid removed 3 to 4 1 handf fresh minced parsley and scallions 1 pch dry tarragon, generous crumbled 1 x portion cooked orzo directions: heat the butter in a saute/fry pan over fairly high heat. toss in the remaining ingredients, except the orzo, all at once. let it all sizzle up, turning the shrimp once, and immediately serve over the orzo the moment the shrimp are cooked. it takes just min. in the restaurant, each portion was cooked to order in its own little pan. four or possibly so portions can be prepared at a time in a 12 inch or possibly larger pan. the ingredients shouldn t be crowded. notesthis dish was created for visual and culinary effect. it turned out to be an all time favorite at alice s restaurant. serves 1.

inputs: lime juice, sugar, tequila, orange liqueur, watermelon, coarse salt, lime
targets: title: orange watermelon margarita ingredients: 1/2 cup lime juice 1 tablespoon sugar 1/2 cup tequila 2 tablespoons orange liqueur 4 cups watermelon, cubed and frozen 1/4 cup coarse salt 1 lime, cut into wedges directions: freeze cubed watemelon in a single layer on a cookie sheet, 1 hour. in a blender combine, combine lime juice, sugar, tequila, and orange liquer. add watermelon chunks a few at a time, blending into a thick smooth slush. pous salt onto a small plate. rub glass rims with a lime wedge to moisten. dip rims in salt. pour margaritas mixture into glasses garnish with lie wedges.

inputs: apricots, grapefruit juice, blanched almonds, coconut
targets: title: apricot, almond and grapefruit bars ingredients: 1/2 lb dried apricots 2/3 cup grapefruit juice 3.5 oz whole blanched almonds, roasted 1/3 cup coconut directions: place the apricots in a bowl and add the grapefruit juice. cover and leave to soak for 2 hrs. preheat the oven to 350 f. line a 9 inch square cake pan with parchment paper. place the toasted almonds in a food processor and process until finely ground. add the soaked apricots and liquid and process to a paste. stir in the coconut. place the mixture in the pan and smooth. bake for 20 25 mins. mark into 12 pieces in the pan then return to the oven for a another 8 10 mins. leave to cool then remove from the pan and cut into bars. store in an airtight container.

inputs: corn muffin, egg, oil, water, sausage, cranberry sauce
targets: title: christmas breakfast casserole ingredients: 1 8 1/2 ounce box jiffy corn muffin mix or your favorite corn bread recipe 1 egg oil water 2 8 ounce packages link sausage 2 16 ounce cans whole berry cranberry sauce directions: cook sausages according to package directions and cover the bottom of an 8x8 glass baking dish with the cooked sausage. empty the cranberry sauce into a bowl and break up until spreadable and cover the sausage with the cranberry sauce. mix the corn bread according to the directions and pour over the sausage and cranberries. bake at an over temperature 25 degrees lower than the corn bread directions and bake for approximately 10 minutes longer than the directions, or until completely cooked through. it will be a little wet where it meets the cranberry sauce, but the rest of the corn bread should be done. don t worry if it cracks slightly on the top. serve plain or with warm maple syrup.

inputs: couscous, chicken broth, butter, almonds, cilantro, orange zest, kosher salt
targets: title: almond orange couscous ingredients: 3/4 cup couscous 1 cup chicken broth 1 tablespoon butter 1/4 cup sliced almonds, toasted 2 tablespoons cilantro, chopped 1 tablespoon orange zest, chopped 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt directions: in a medium saucepan, bring the chicken broth to a boil, stir in the couscous and butter cover, turn off heat and allow to sit for 5 minutes. remove lid, fluff couscous with a fork, stir in the almonds, cilantro, orange zest and salt. enjoy

inputs: cornish hens, butter, rice, chicken broth, onion, stalks celery, mushrooms, green pepper, poultry seasoning, salt, pepper
targets: title: delia s cornish game hens or chicken and rice ingredients: 3 cornish hens or one chicken, in pieces, skin on 1/2 cup butter 2 cups rice 4 cups chicken broth 1 onion, chopped 2 stalks celery, chopped 4 ounces mushrooms, sliced 1 green pepper, chopped optional poultry seasoning optional salt pepper directions: chop onion, celery, and green pepper if using, then slice mushrooms. rinse hens or chicken pieces and pat dry. in a 13x9 pan, mix rice, broth, and vegetables. arrange birds on top of the rice, settling them in a bit. melt butter, then drizzle over poultry and rice mixture, using all of it. sprinkle with poultry seasoning, salt and pepper, or any herbs of your choice. cover with foil and bake at 350 for about 45 minutes. remove foil and continue baking until poultry and rice tests done and skins are nicely browned. remove from oven and let cool ten to fifteen minutes before serving.

inputs: flour, baking pwdr, shortening, salt, sugar, eggs, vanilla, mashed ripe bananas
targets: title: a banana cake for any size pan recipe ingredients: 23/4 c. all purpose flour, sifted 31/2 tsp baking pwdr 3/4 c. shortening 1 tsp salt 11/2 c. sugar 3 x large eggs 1 tsp vanilla extract 2 c. mashed ripe bananas, 5 6 bananas directions: preheat oven to 350. grease well and flour 2 9 inch round layer pans 1 1/2 inches deep or possibly 1 13x9x2 inch oblong pan or possibly 2 1/2 dozen medium cupcake pans. sift flour, baking pwdr and salt together. cream shortening till soft. gradually add in sugar, beating till light and fluffy after each addition. add in large eggs and vanilla nad beat till thick and lemon colored. add in dry ingredients alternately with bananas. blend well after each addition. bake 9 inch round layers 30 35 min 13x9x2 oblong 40 45 min cupcakes 15 20 min cake is done if center springs back when touched lightly with finger. cold cakes in pan on rack 10 min before removing from pan and frosting with favorite frosting.

inputs: brown sugar, shortening, eggs, flour, ground cinnamon, ground cloves, ground ginger, baking soda, buttermilk, white vinegar, sugar
targets: title: donna s spanish bars ingredients: 2 cups packed brown sugar 1/2 cup shortening 2 eggs 2 cups all purpose flour 2 teaspoons ground cinnamon 1 teaspoon ground cloves 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger 1 teaspoon baking soda 1 cup buttermilk 1 tablespoon distilled white vinegar 1/3 cup granulated sugar for decoration directions: preheat oven to 350 degrees f 175 degrees c . grease and flour a 9x13 inch baking pan. in a large bowl, cream shortening and sugar. add eggs one at a time and mix until light and fluffy. sift together the flour, cinnamon, cloves, ginger, and baking soda. add dry ingredients to sugar mixture alternately with the buttermilk and vinegar. mix well with an electric mixer for 2 to 3 minutes. pour the batter into the prepared pan and bake in preheated oven for 35 to 40 minutes or until cookie feels firm. after cooling, cut cookie into 2 inch bars. roll each bar in sugar and store in covered tins. this one of my favorite christmas cookie recipes. enjoy

inputs: scallions, jalapeno pepper, tomato sauce
targets: title: susan s easy salsa perfecta ingredients: 1 each cloves, ground 2 each scallions, spring or green onions 6 each jalapeno pepper seeded 28 ounces tomato sauce directions: pulse first 3 ingredients a little. add remaining ingredients and pulse. enjoy.

inputs: bread, salmon filets, broccoli, onion, garlic, mustard, egg whites, lemon, light ranch dressing, mixed salad greens, grape tomatoes, parmesan cheese shaved
targets: title: incredible salmon and broccoli croquettes ingredients: 2 inches bread slices light, made into bread crumbs food processor 1 can salmon filets drained with skin and large bones removed 1 cup broccoli finely chopped 1/2 cup onion minced 1 clove garlic minced 1 teaspoon dijon mustard 1 large egg whites 1/2 lemon small, juiced 8 tablespoons light ranch dressing 8 cups mixed salad greens 2 cups grape tomatoes halved 4 tablespoons parmesan cheese shaved directions: preheat oven to 400. combine salmon, broccoli, onion, garlic, mustard, bread crumbs, egg white and lemon. spray baking sheet with cooking spray and roll salmon mixture into 12 balls. bake for 20 minutes. serve with salad of greens, tomatoes and cheese with ranch dressing.

inputs: water chestnuts, hickory smoked bacon, chili sauce, brown sugar, mustard
targets: title: barbecue bacon chestnuts ingredients: 1 can whole water chestnuts, drained 1 pkg. hickory smoked bacon 6 tbsp. chili sauce or catsup 3 tbsp. brown sugar 1 tbsp. dijon mustard directions: wrap each chestnut with 1/2 slice bacon and secure with toothpick. if necessary, cut chestnuts in half to make the same amount of chestnuts and bacon strips. arrange bacon wrapped chestnuts in shallow baking pan. broil until crispy, about 5 minutes on each side. drain well. blend chili sauce, brown sugar and mustard pour over bacon wrapped chestnuts. bake at 350 for 20 minutes.

inputs: orange jello, orange sherbet, mandarin oranges, colored marshmallows, boiling water
targets: title: orange sherbet mold ingredients: 4 serving size orange jello can use sugar free 1 pt. orange sherbet 1 8 oz. can mandarin oranges, drained 1 to 1 1/2 c. miniature colored marshmallows 10 oz. 1 c. boiling water directions: mix jello with 1 cup boiling water stir in sherbet until dissolved. mix in marshmallows and oranges. let set up about 3 hours in small square casserole dish. makes 8 servings.

inputs: barbecue sauce, brown sugar, butter, sauce, catsup, beer, liquid smoke, worcestershire sauce, red pepper
targets: title: quick smoky barbecue sauce ingredients: 1 4 oz. bottle barbecue sauce smoky 1/3 c. brown sugar 1/3 c. melted butter 1 4 oz. bottle plain sauce 1 4 oz. bottle catsup 1 12 oz. can beer 3 oz. liquid smoke 1 tbsp. worcestershire sauce little red pepper optional directions: mix together and seal in jar. keep in refrigerator. will keep a year.

inputs: sugar, eggs, pumpkin, cooking oil, flour, baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon, , frosting, weight cream cheese, butter, vanilla, milk, powdered sugar
targets: title: pumpkin bars with cream cheese frosting ingredients: 2 cups sugar 4 whole eggs 2 cups canned pumpkin not pumpkin pie filling 3/4 cups cooking oil or applesauce 2 cups flour 2 teaspoons baking powder 1 teaspoon baking soda 1 teaspoon cinnamon 1 cup chopped nuts optional frosting 3 ounces, weight cream cheese 6 tablespoons butter 1 teaspoon vanilla 1 tablespoon milk 3 cups powdered sugar directions: bars mix eggs, sugar, pumpkin and oil or applesauce together. sift flour, baking powder, baking soda and cinnamon. add to the batter. stir in nuts if using. pour batter into a greased and floured jelly roll pan. bake at 325 degrees for 25 minutes. when cool, frost. frosting mix frosting ingredients together and beat until smooth. spread on bars.

inputs: soy sauce, rice wine vinegar, sugar, sesame oil, red pepper, chickens, vegetable oil, gingerroot, garlic, green onions, mushrooms, bell peppers
targets: title: chinese pepper chicken ingredients: 2 tablespoons soy sauce 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar 1 teaspoon sugar 2 teaspoons sesame oil 1/2 teaspoon red pepper sauce 1 3 3 1/2 lb cut up broiler fryer chickens 2 tablespoons vegetable oil 1 teaspoon finely chopped gingerroot 2 garlic cloves, finely chopped 3 green onions, sliced with tops 1 1/2 cups sliced mushrooms 4 ounces 3 medium bell peppers, cut into 1 inch strips directions: mix soy sauce, vinegar, sugar, sesame oil and pepper sauce in sealable heavy duty plastic bag. add chicken seal bag and turn to coat with marinade. refrigerate at least 1 hour but no longer than 24 hours, turning bag occasionally. remove chicken from marinade reserve marinade. heat vegetable oil in 12 inch skillet or dutch oven over medium heat until hot. cook chicken in oil about 15 minutes, turning occasionally, until brown on all sides. cover and cook on low heat about 20 minutes longer or juice is no longer pink when centers of thickest pieces are cut. remove chicken from skillet, using tongs keep warm. drain all but 1 teaspoon drippings from skillet. heat 1 teaspoon drippings and the marinade in skillet over medium high heat. stir in gingerroot, garlic and onions. cook and stir about 30 seconds or until garlic is light golden brown. stir in mushrooms and bell peppers. cook about 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until bell peppers are crisp tender. serve with chicken.

inputs: rocket, balsamic vinegar, brown sugar
targets: title: pear wrapped in proscuitto with warm balsamic dressing ingredients: 4 small ripe pears, halved and cored 8 slices proscuitto 4 handfuls rocket 1/2 cup balsamic vinegar 1/4 brown sugar directions: wrap each pear half with a slice of proscuitto and arrange two halves per person on serving plates with the rocket. in a small saucepan, bring the balsamic vinegar and sugar to the boil. allow to boil for 2 3 minutes or until slightly thickened and then drizzle over the pears. serve immediately.

inputs: spinach, fresh strawberries, goat cheese, olive oil, orange juice, orange zest, white wine vinegar, kosher salt, fresh ground black pepper
targets: title: summer spinach and strawberry salad ingredients: 2 cups fresh baby spinach 1/2 quarts fresh strawberries, hulled quartered 2 tablespoons goat cheese 2 tablespoons slivered almonds 4 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil 2 tablespoons orange juice 1 teaspoon orange zest 1 tablespoon white wine vinegar 1/2 teaspoons kosher salt 1/2 teaspoons fresh ground black pepper directions: toast almonds in a pan over medium low heat until lightly browned and set aside. add orange juice, zest, white wine vinegar, salt, and pepper in a bowl and whisk. pour olive oil in while whisking until dressing is mixed. mix spinach, strawberries and almonds in a separate bowl or serve on a plate and toss with the dressing. top with crumbled goat cheese and serve.

inputs: pumpkin, corn flakes, eggs, white sugar, brown sugar, margarine, nutmeg
