targets: title: vichyssoise a la ritz recipe ingredients: 4 leeks, white part sliced 1 med. onion, sliced 1/4 c. sweet butter 5 med. potatoes, thinly sliced 1 quart. chicken broth 1 tbsp. or possibly less salt 3 c. lowfat milk 2 c. heavy cream minced chives directions: 1. in a deep kettle, brown the leeks and onion very lightly in the butter. add in the potatoes, broth and salt and boil 35 min or possibly till very tender. puree in an electric blender. 2. return blended mix to kettle, add in lowfat milk and 1 c. of the cream and bring to a boil. cold and blend again. chill. 3. add in remaining cream. refrigeratethoroughly and serve garnished with chives. 8 or possibly more servings.

inputs: onion, garlic, thyme, cheese, ground beef, garlic, tomato sauce
targets: title: open faced lone star burgers ingredients: 1/4 cup onion, chopped 2 cloves garlic, minced 1/4 teaspoon dried thyme 1 1/2 cups shredded colby jack cheese, divided 1 1/2 pounds ground beef 6 slices frozen garlic texas toast 1 8 oz. can tomato sauce directions: in a large bowl, combine onion, garlic, thyme and one cup cheese. crumble beef over top and mix well. form into 6 oval shaped patties. in a large skillet, cook patties over medium heat for 5 to 6 minutes per side, to desired doneness. meanwhile, prepare toast according to package directions. drain patties set aside and keep warm. add remaining ingredients to the skillet. bring to a boil cook and stir for 2 minutes, or until slightly thickened. return burgers to skillet turn to coat. sprinkle with remaining cheese. serve burgers on toast.

inputs: hamburger, tomatoes, onion, garlic powder, pepper, oregano, lasagna noodles, mozzarella cheese, tomato paste, hamburger, salt, basil, parmesan cheese
targets: title: lasagna ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. hamburger 12 oz. tomatoes, cut up 1 c. chopped onion 1 tsp. garlic powder 1/2 tsp. pepper 1 tsp. oregano 9 lasagna noodles 2 large pkg. mozzarella cheese 12 oz. tomato paste 2 tbsp. hamburger drippings 2 1/2 tsp. salt 1 tsp. basil 1/4 c. parmesan cheese directions: brown meat and onion drain. add to mixture of tomatoes, tomato paste, spices and meat drippings. simmer 1 hour. cook noodles for 10 minutes. layer noodles, meat sauce and cheese. repeat 2 more times and put 1/4 cup parmesan cheese on top. bake at 350 for 30 minutes. let stand for 10 minutes before serving.

inputs: onion, cloves, chicken, carrot, celery, garlic, bay leaf, peppercorns, thyme
targets: title: one hour chicken stock ingredients: 1/2 large onion 4 cloves 2 pounds chicken wings, cut into 3 or 4 pieces each 1 medium carrot, peeled and chopped 1/2 stalk celery, chopped 1/2 leek, trimmed, well washed and chopped 4 cloves garlic 1 bay leaf 10 peppercorns 3 sprigs thyme directions: stud the onion with the cloves and combine all the ingredients with 6 cups water in a large saucepan. bring to a boil, then lower the heat so that the mixture bubbles steadily but not rapidly. cook, skimming any foam that accumulates, for about 1 hour. cool slightly, then strain. refrigerate you can skim off the fat after the stock cools completely and use within 3 days or see keys to success, notes for storage suggestions.

inputs: butter, flour, milk, salt, ground white pepper, cayenne pepper, cheddar cheese, elbow macaroni, tomatoes, sugar
targets: title: classic baked macaroni and cheese horn hardart s macaroni and cheese ingredients: 4 tbsp 60 ml butter 4 tbsp 60 ml all purpose flour 3 cups 700 ml milk 1 tsp 5 ml salt dash of freshly ground white pepper dash of cayenne pepper 2 cups 475 ml shredded cheddar cheese 1/2 lb .2 kg . elbow macaroni, fully cooked and drained 1/2 cup 125 ml canned tomatoes, drained and chopped 1 tsp 5 ml sugar directions: preheat oven to 350 degrees 175 c. and grease a 2 quarts 1900 ml baking dish. melt the butter in a saucepanover medium low heat. whisk in the flour, then add the milk, salt, and white and cayenne peppers. stir constantly until the mixture thickens and is smooth, about 8 to 10 minutes. add the cheese and cook, stirring until it melts remove the saucepan from the heat. in a mixing bowl, combine the macaroni and the sauce. stir in the tomatoes and sugar. transfer the macaroni mixture to a greased baking dish. bake until the surface is browned, about 30 to 40 minutes.

inputs: onions, ground beef, ketchup, chicken gumbo
targets: title: sloppy joes ingredients: 2 lg. onions, chopped 1 lb. ground beef 3 tbsp. ketchup and mustard 1 can chicken gumbo or tomato soup directions: cook onions and ground beef until soft and browned. crumble with a fork and stir in ketchup, mustard and soup. heat until it bubbles and serve on buns.

inputs: onion, butter, flour, dry mustard, salt, marjoram, milk, chicken bouillon cubes, egg yolks, cheddar cheese, almonds, paprika
targets: title: broccoli casserole ingredients: 1/2 c. chopped onion 6 tbsp. butter 5 tbsp. flour 1 tsp. dry mustard 3/4 tsp. salt 1/8 tsp. marjoram 3 dashes tabasco 3 1/2 c. milk 2 chicken bouillon cubes 5 egg yolks, beaten 1 1/2 c. sharp cheddar cheese slivered almonds paprika directions: cook and drain 2 packages frozen chopped broccoli. place in a large pyrex baking dish. top with 1 4 oz. can mushroom pieces. saute onion in butter until soft blend in flour and seasonings, then add milk and bouillon cubes and cook, stirring constantly, until thick. stir a little hot sauce into egg yolks, then return egg mixture to saucepan. add cheese and stir until melted. spread sauce over broccoli. sprinkle with almonds and paprika. bake 20 minutes at 350 . this makes a big casserole. to serve a smaller group, divide broccoli into two pans, or extra sauce may be frozen.

inputs: vegetable oil, summer, onion, eggs, milk, cheddar cheese, white sugar, flour, salt, ground black pepper, butter
targets: title: squash, egg, and cheese casserole ingredients: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil 3 summer squash, sliced 1 small onion, diced 4 eggs, beaten 2 tablespoons milk 3 cups shredded cheddar cheese, divided 2 tablespoons white sugar 2 tablespoons all purpose flour 1/4 teaspoon salt 1/4 teaspoon ground black pepper 6 tablespoons butter, melted directions: preheat oven to 375 degrees f 190 degrees c . heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium heat, and cook the summer squash and onion until tender, about 10 minutes. stir occasionally. while the squash are cooking, mix together the eggs, milk, 1 cup of cheddar cheese, sugar, flour, salt, and black pepper in a large bowl. stir in the squash mixture and melted butter turn into a 2 quart casserole dish. top with the remaining 2 cups of cheddar cheese. bake in the preheated oven until the casserole is set and the cheese topping is crisp and starting to brown, 35 to 45 minutes. allow to stand for 15 minutes before serving.

inputs: carrots, sugar, oil, vinegar, tomato soup, green pepper, onion
targets: title: marinated carrots ingredients: 2 lb. carrots 3/4 c. sugar 1/3 c. oil 1/3 c. vinegar 1 can tomato soup 1 chopped green pepper 1 small onion, chopped directions: peel and cut carrots into bite size pieces. cook in salted water until tender. do not overcook. drain well. mix sugar, oil, vinegar and tomato soup together in pan. bring to a boil. pour over warm carrots. add green pepper and onion. mix well. chill overnight.

inputs: tomato puree, tomatoes, beef bouillon, tomato soup, oregano, basil, garlic, black pepper, onions, extra virgin olive oil, sugar
targets: title: very easy spaghetti gravy sauce recipe ingredients: 2 lg. cans tomato puree 1 lg. can crushed tomatoes 1 can beef bouillon 1 can tomato soup 1 teaspoon oregano 1 teaspoon basil 1 teaspoon garlic pwdr 1/2 teaspoon black pepper 2 med. onions, finely minced 1 tbsp. extra virgin olive oil some sugar, if desired a teaspoon or possibly so directions: in a large heavy bottom kettle preferably not aluminum , heat extra virgin olive oil. add in onions and cook till onions are done. add in all remaining ingredients. stir and bring to a boil. it s done.

inputs: italian dressing, beef sirloin steak, s, parmesan cheese, black pepper, onion
targets: title: smothered sirloin steak in parmesan peppercorn sauce ingredients: 1/2 cup kraft lite zesty italian dressing, divided 1 boneless beef sirloin steak 1 lb. , well trimmed whole foods 1 lb for 7.99 thru 02/09 1/3 cup breakstone s free or knudsen fat free sour cream 4 1/2 tsp. kraft grated parmesan cheese 1/4 to 1/2 tsp. black pepper 1 onion, thinly sliced, separated into rings safeway 3 lb for 2.99 thru 02/09 directions: pour 1/4 cup dressing over steak in shallow dish turn to evenly coat steak. refrigerate 30 min. to marinate. meanwhile, mix sour cream, 2 tbsp. of the remaining dressing, parmesan cheese and pepper. refrigerate until ready to serve. heat remaining 2 tbsp. dressing in large nonstick skillet on medium heat. add onions cook 7 to 8 min. or until golden brown, stirring frequently. remove onions from skillet set aside. remove steak from marinade discard marinade. add steak to skillet cook on medium heat 3 to 4 min. on each side or until medium doneness 160 degrees f . remove steak from skillet cut into thin strips. serve topped with the sour cream sauce and onions.

inputs: tart apples, sugar, cinnamon, pastry shell, sugar, flour, margarine
targets: title: apple crumb pie ingredients: 4 large tart apples 1/2 c. sugar 1 tsp. cinnamon 1 unbaked pastry shell 1/2 c. sugar 3/4 c. flour 1/3 c. margarine or butter directions: pare apples cut into thin wedges. arrange in unbaked pie shell. in small bowl, mix 1/2 cup sugar and cinnamon. layer apples and cinnamon sugar mix. set aside.

inputs: beef, salt, ground black pepper, buttermilk, flour, steak sauce, honey
targets: title: chicken fried steak bites ingredients: beef cube steaks, cut into 3/4 inch cubes safeway 1 lb for 5.49 thru 02/09 1 1/2 tsp. salt 1 1/2 tsp. ground black pepper 3 cups buttermilk 3 cups flour 3 cups a.1. thick hearty steak sauce 1 cup honey directions: season steak pieces with salt and pepper place in non reactive container. pour buttermilk over steak stir to evenly coat. refrigerate 1 hour. remove steak from buttermilk reserve buttermilk. dredge in flour, then return to buttermilk, turning to evenly coat all sides of each piece. dredge in flour again gently shake off excess flour. add to 350 degrees f oil in deep fryer cook until lightly browned and done. drain. for each serving serve 2 oz. steak with 2 tbsp. steak sauce and 2 tsp. honey.

inputs: whole wheat flour, milk, soy flour, baking pwdr, baking soda, salt, applesauce, egg whites, bananas, pineapple, apricots, golden brown raisins
targets: title: california fruit bread recipe ingredients: 2 c. whole wheat flour 2 tbsp. nonfat dry lowfat milk pwdr or possibly 2 tbsp. soy flour for lowfat milk free diets 2 tbsp. lowfat soy flour 2 tsp baking pwdr 1/2 tsp baking soda 1/4 tsp salt 1/3 c. applesauce 2 x egg whites or possibly 1/4 c. egg beaters or possibly egg sub. equiv 2 sm ripe bananas 7 3/4 1 can crushed pineapple 8 oz juice packed 1/2 c. minced pitted dry apricots 1/2 c. golden brown raisins directions: spray loaf pan with non stick spray. open pineapple and drain off juice. mix dry ingredients together in large bowl. in blender, process together applesauce, egg, bananas and pineapple add in to dry mix, add in apricots and raisins, beat just until well mixed. turn into loaf pan, bake in preheated 350f oven for 60 min or possibly till golden brown and tests done. remove from pan and rest on a board or possibly rack on its side until completely cooled. chill wrapped. freezes well. now for the variables, you may make this recipe with no apricots but with one fresh apple, minced not peeled . you may make this recipe with or possibly without raisins. less sweet but good both ways. if you do not have the soy flour or possibly the dry lowfat milk, just add in the equivalent of flour or possibly oat bran.

inputs: chicken, chicken broth, white onion, garlic, butter, egg, salt, lemon juice
targets: title: lemon chicken soup ingredients: 1 whole cooked rotisserie chicken, any flavor except barbecue 46 ounces, fluid swanson chicken broth 1 whole medium white onion 1 tablespoon minced garlic from a jar 1 tablespoon butter 1 whole large egg, beaten 1 teaspoon salt and pepper 4 tablespoons lemon juice 4 cups cooked white or brown rice directions: start by removing the chicken meat from the rotisserie, both white and dark meat. discard the rotisserie bones when finished. chop the onion into large pieces. in a large dutch oven, heat the butter on medium, then add the onion and saute until almost soft. add the garlic and saute for another minute. add the chicken broth. increase temperature to high to bring the chicken broth to a boil. when the broth boils, decrease temperature to medium low. take the beaten egg and whisk it into the broth. whisk quickly to keep it from hardening before it has a chance to separate. the broth should somewhat resemble egg drop soup. now add the chicken and stir. add salt and pepper to taste. add the lemon juice and stir. you may add more or less lemon juice depending on preference. serve over rice.

inputs: cream cheese, mayonnaise, red pepper, ground cumin, garlic powder, oregano, salad, chunk crabmeat, lime juice, extra virgin olive oil, fresh cilantro, green onions, toppings, wrappers, chorizo, tomatoes
targets: title: latin crab salad dip with crispy wontons ingredients: philly dip philadelphia light brick cream cheese spread 1/2 cup kraft mayo calorie wise real mayonnaise 4 tsp. red pepper sauce 2 tsp. ground cumin 2 tsp. garlic powder 1/2 tsp. dried oregano leaves crab salad 1 cup canned chunk crabmeat, drained, flaked 1/4 cup fresh lime juice safeway 3 ct for 1.00 thru 02/09 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil 1/4 cup fresh cilantro, chopped 4 tsp. green onions, chopped 1 tsp. adobo seasoning toppings 40 each won ton wrappers, cut diagonally in half 1/4 cup mexican chorizo, cooked, crumbled and drained 4 tsp. tomatoes, seeded, small dice directions: philly dip beat ingredients with mixer fitted with paddle attachment until well blended. refrigerate until ready to use. crab salad combine ingredients. refrigerate until ready to use. toppings bake won ton triangles in parchment paper lined full sheet pan or in paper lined half sheet pan for trial recipe in preheated 325 degrees f convection oven 3 to 5 min. or until golden brown. cool in pan on wire rack. for each portion, 4 servings microwave 1/2 cup 125 ml philly dip in small microwaveable serving bowl on high 30 to 40 sec. or just until warmed. place bowl on serving plate. top dip with 1/3 cup 75 ml crab salad, 1 tbsp. 15 ml warm chorizo and 1 tsp. 5 ml tomatoes. arrange 20 won ton chips around bowl of dip.

inputs: margarine, mushrooms, onion, beef broth, catsup, salt, flour, sour cream, garlic powder
targets: title: beef stroganoff ingredients: 1 lb. 1/2 inch thick sirloin steak 2 tbsp. margarine 1/2 lb. mushrooms, sliced 1 onion, minced 1 10 1/2 oz. can beef broth 2 tbsp. catsup 1 tsp. salt 3 tbsp. flour 1 c. sour cream 1/2 tsp. garlic powder directions: cut meat across the grain into 1/2 inch strips 1 1/2 to 2 inches long. melt margarine in skillet and cook onion and mushrooms until tender. remove and cook meat until browned. reserving 1/3 cup of the broth. stir remaining broth, catsup, garlic and salt into the meat. simmer 15 minutes. blend reserved broth with flour, stir into meat. add mushrooms and onion. heat to boiling. stir in sour cream and serve over noodles.

inputs: sugar, hot water, carnation milk, butter, cocoa, vanilla, salt
targets: title: aunt lena s chocolate topping ingredients: 1 1/2 c. sugar 1/2 c. hot water 3/4 c. carnation milk 4 tbsp. butter 3 tbsp. cocoa 1 tsp. vanilla dash of salt directions: mix cocoa, sugar and salt. add hot water first before cream cook for 10 minutes at boil. remove from heat. add butter and vanilla beat with mixer until cool.

inputs: ground beef, salt, onion, green pepper, cheese, elbow macaroni, tomatoes, mustard, mushrooms
targets: title: one dish meal ingredients: 1 lb. ground beef 1 1/2 tsp. salt 1 large onion, chopped 1/2 green pepper, chopped 1/2 lb. cheese, grated 1 c. elbow macaroni 1 pt. tomatoes 1 tsp. prepared mustard 1 small can mushrooms or 1 can mushroom soup directions: cook meat, salt, onion and pepper until meat is brown. cook macaroni until almost tender about 5 minutes . mix all ingredients in casserole and bake at 350 for about 1 hour.

inputs: orange juice, lemon, red wine, brandy, club soda
targets: title: sangria ingredients: 2 cups orange juice 1/4 cup lemon 750 milliliters dry red wine 1/2 cup brandy 2 cups club soda sliced fruit for garnish directions: stir all ingredients in large pitcher with ice except club soda and fruit. add soda and fruit at serving time.

inputs: water, whole wheat pastry flour, cornmeal, apple
targets: title: sweet potato and apple dog treats ingredients: 3/4 cups mashed sweet potato i used canned organic, unsweetened, all natural 3 tablespoons broth or water 2 cups whole wheat pastry flour 1/2 cups cornmeal 1 cup granny smith apple, peeled, cored, grated directions: preheat oven to 325 degrees f. line 2 large baking sheets with parchment paper set aside. in a large bowl, whisk together sweet potatoes and broth or water. add flour, cornmeal, and apples and stir until combined. knead the dough a few times until it holds together. roll out half of the dough on a generously floured surface until about 1/4 inch thick. use 2 inch to 4 inch cookie cutters to cut out treats. transfer to baking sheets reroll and cut the scraps. bake until dried and just slightly golden on the bottoms, 35 to 40 minutes. turn off the oven, leave oven door ajar and let the treats cool and dry out in the oven for 1 to 2 hours. store in an airtight container up to 1 week. calories per cookie 35 calories 0 from fat , 0g total fat, 0g saturated fat, 0mg cholesterol, 5mg sodium, 7g total carbohydrate 1g dietary fiber, 1g sugar , 1g protein

inputs: flour, baking soda, cinnamon, mace, cloves, butter, sugar, orange rind, egg, persimmon pulp, anise
targets: title: persimmon cookies ingredients: 2 c. flour 1 tsp. baking soda 1 tsp. cinnamon 1/2 tsp. mace 1/4 tsp. cloves 1/2 c. butter 1/2 c. sugar 1 tbsp. grated orange rind 1 egg 1 c. persimmon pulp anise seed directions: in a bowl, combine flour, baking soda and spices. in a second bowl or food processor, cream the butter, sugar, orange rind and egg. combine the dry ingredients with the creamed mixture. lightly mix in the persimmon pulp. drop the batter by the tablespoonful on a greased cookie sheet. sprinkle with anise seed and bake for 15 to 20 minutes at 350 . yields approximately 3 dozen cookies.

inputs: bittersweet chocolate, butter, eggs, sugar
targets: title: fishmonger s ex wife s cake ingredients: 8 ounces bittersweet chocolate 8 ounces butter 6 eggs 3 ounces sugar directions: melt the chocolate with the sugar and let cool slightly. whisk the whole eggs with the sugar until really, really fluffy, then add the chocolate mixture. line a large spring loaded tin with parchment, add the batter and bake at 350 for about twenty minutes. the cake should be moist and a little underdone inside. serve individual slices sprinkled with confectioner s sugar.

inputs: ground beef, sauce, lasagna noodle, cream cheese, milk, mozzarella cheese, fresh mushrooms, onion, basil, oregano, garlic
targets: title: lasagna ingredients: 2 lbs ground beef 1 45 ounce jarragu spaghetti sauce 1 1 lb box lasagna noodle 1 8 ounce package cream cheese, cubed 34 cup milk 2 lbs mozzarella cheese, grated 1 cup fresh mushrooms, chopped 1 onion, chopped 1 tablespoon basil 1 tablespoon oregano 1 tablespoon minced garlic directions: brown ground meat in large skillet. drain. add the spaghetti sauce to the meat mixture. simmer. in a small skillet, sautee chopped onion and mushrooms together. add to meat mixture. add basil,oregano and minced garlic to the meat mixture. over low heat, melt cream cheese with milk until smooth. cook lasagna noodles in boiling water until al dente. drain. spead a layer of half ther beef mixture in bottom of a large baking pan. next layer lasagna noodles. then layer with half the mozzarella cheese. next layer with the cream cheese mixture. layer next with lasagna noodles. next layer with the remaining mozzerella cheese. last layer add the remaining meat mixture. bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour or until bubbly. sprinkle with grated parmesean cheese over top.

inputs: frozen broccoli, cream of mushroom soup, cheese, onions, mayonnaise, salt
targets: title: broccoli casserole ingredients: 2 10 oz. pkg. frozen broccoli 1 10 1/2 oz. can cream of mushroom soup 1 c. grated sharp cheese 2 tsp. minced or 1 heaping tsp. dry onions 1 c. mayonnaise salt and pepper to taste directions: cook broccoli by package directions, boiling 5 minutes. don t overcook. drain. mix with soup, onions, mayonnaise, salt and pepper. put into casserole dish. top with cheese. bake at 350 until bubbly.

inputs: head lettuce, tomatoes, onion, avocado, grated cheese, fritos, hot sauce, ground meat, kidney beans, salt
targets: title: mexican chef salad ingredients: 1 head lettuce 4 tomatoes 1 medium onion 1 large avocado 4 oz. grated cheese 1 pkg. fritos or doritos 1 8 oz. bottle thousand island dressing hot sauce to taste 1 lb. ground meat 1 15 oz. can kidney beans, drained 1/4 tsp. salt directions: brown meat and add salt drain excess fat off. simmer meat and beans for 10 minutes. set to one side and chop up the first 4 ingredients and toss well. grate cheese and add to first mixture.

inputs: bulk sausage, chicken noodle, onion, green pepper, rice, water
targets: title: st. paul s rice ingredients: 1 lb. bulk sausage 2 envelopes lipton chicken noodle soup 1 onion, chopped 1 green pepper 1 1/2 c. rice or minute rice water directions: brown sausage drain. mix 4 1/2 cups water, soup mix and boil for 7 minutes. add onion, green pepper and sausage into boiled mixture. place into large casserole bowl and bake covered for 1 hour on 350 .

inputs: corn tortillas, onions, milk, cream of chicken soup, green chilies, chicken, cheese
targets: title: chicken enchilada casserole ingredients: 1/2 pkg. corn tortillas 1/2 c. chopped onions 1 c. milk 1 can cream of chicken soup 1 can chopped green chilies 1 c. chopped chicken 2 c. cheese directions: mix all ingredients together except 1/2 of cheese. place in greased 2 quart casserole dish. top with remaining cheese. bake in oven at 350 for 30 minutes covered with foil. mixture should be bubbly and cheese melted.

inputs: chicken tenders, salt, pepper, chorizo sausage, extra virgin olive oil, garlic, red bell pepper, onion, red potatoes, tomatoes, dark red kidney beans, hot sauce, chicken, red corn tortilla chips, shredded monterey jack pepper cheese, garnishes, scallion, cilantro, thyme
targets: title: chicken, chorizo and tortilla stoup stew like soup ingredients: 1 lb chicken tenders salt pepper 3/4 lb chorizo sausage 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil 3 garlic cloves, smashed 1 red bell pepper, chopped 1 medium onion, chopped 6 small red potatoes, diced 1 15 ounce can chopped fire roasted tomatoes 1 15 ounce can dark red kidney beans 2 teaspoons hot sauce 1 quart chicken stock 1 15 ounce bag red corn tortilla chips or 15 ounce bag blue corn tortilla chips 2 cups shredded monterey jack pepper cheese or any flavor you prefer suggested garnishes chopped scallion chopped cilantro fresh thyme leave directions: preheat medium soup pot over medium high heat. chop tenders into bite size pieces. wash up, then season chicken with salt and pepper. dice chorizo. add evoo and chicken to the pot. lightly brown chicken 2 minutes, then add chorizo and garlic. cook another 2 3 minutes, then add peppers, onions and potatoes. cook 5 minutes, then stir in tomatoes, kidney beans and hot sauce. add chicken stock and bring soup to a bubble. preheat broiler. reduce heat and simmer until potatoes are tender 10 12 minutes . ladle soup into shallow bowls and top each bowl with a generous handful of crushed tortillas and cheese. melt cheese under hot broiler. garnish with scallions and herbs.

inputs: yeast, water, salt, eggs, flour, shortening, sugar
targets: title: refrigerator rolls ingredients: 2 pkg. yeast 2 c. hot water 1 tsp. salt 2 eggs 6 c. flour 4 tbsp. melted shortening 2 tbsp. sugar directions: melt 2 packages yeast in 2 cups hot water. let cool. then add salt, sugar and beaten eggs. add 3 cups flour and stir until well mixed. then add the shortening and mix well. add remaining flour and more if needed to knead well. put in greased bowl and let rise about 2 hours. be sure it is in warm place. then refrigerate until ready to use. take out and let rise again and then roll out and make into your favorite rolls until double in size. bake in 400 oven until brown.

inputs: hamburger, tomato sauce, kidney beans, onions, green peppers, chili powder, black pepper, red pepper
targets: title: chile ingredients: 2 to 3 lb. hamburger 32 oz. tomato sauce 32 oz. kidney beans 2 large onions, diced 4 medium green peppers, diced 3 oz. chili powder 1 tbsp. black pepper 1 tsp. red pepper directions: brown hamburger. add onion and pepper and saute. add beans and tomatoes. add spices. simmer 3 hours.

inputs: chocolate chips, butterscotch chips, peanut butter, margarine, milk, vanilla pudding, powdered sugar, peanuts
targets: title: bun bars ingredients: 12 oz. chocolate chips 12 oz. butterscotch chips 18 oz. jar creamy peanut butter 1 c. margarine 2/3 c. milk 1 small pkg. vanilla pudding not instant 2 lb. powdered sugar 1 lb. peanuts directions: melt chips and peanut butter. spread 1/2 of this mixture over bottom of 15 x 10 inch pan. anything smaller than 15 x 10 inch won t hold it.

inputs: crust, gingersnap crumbs, sugar, ground ginger, ginger, butter, filling, lime juice, egg yolks, condensed milk, lime zest, salt, citric, whipping cream, sugar, lime
targets: title: key lime pie with a gingersnap crust ingredients: for the crust 1 1/4 cups gingersnap crumbs i made them from gingersnap cookies gingersnap cookies 2 tablespoons sugar 1/4 teaspoon ground ginger 1 1/2 teaspoons crystallized ginger, chopped 2 tablespoons melted unsalted butter for the filling 1/2 cup strained fresh key lime juice about 12 14 limes 4 egg yolks 1 14 ounce can sweetened condensed milk 2 tablespoons grated lime zest 1 pinch salt 1 pinch citric acid optional for the topping 1/2 pint whipping cream 3 tablespoons confectioners sugar 1 lime, zest of, to garnish directions: chill a mixing bowl and mixer whip. preheat oven to 350 f. combine gingersnap crumbs, sugar, and ginger in a food processor and pulse to obtain very fine crumbs. pour crumbs into a bowl and mix well with melted butter. butter a 9 inch pie plate and evenly and firmly press gingersnap crumbs along the bottom and sides of pan. par bake crust at 350f for 10 minutes or until nicely browned. allow crust to cool while preparing filling. beat together egg yolks and lime zest in a large non reactive bowl mixture may turn pale green . add condensed milk and continue beating. add salt, citric acid and lime juice, mixing thoroughly. set bowl aside and allow mixture to thicken somewhat. when thickened, evenly pour prepared filling into the crust. bake at 350f for 10 minutes or until mixture sets but is still slightly jiggly. cool pie on a wire rack. using the chilled mixing bowl, beat cream until soft peaks form. add sugar 1 tbsp at a time, and continue to beat until firm peaks form. serve whipped cream on pie as desired, garmished with additional lime zest. refrigerate unused portions.

inputs: flour, sugar, ginger, oil, molasses, eggs, soda, boiling water
targets: title: stack cake ingredients: 2 c. self rising flour 1/2 c. sugar 1 tsp. each ginger, cloves and cinnamon 1/2 c. oil or shortening 1 c. molasses 2 eggs 1/2 tsp. soda 1 c. boiling water directions: mix together sugar, oil and eggs set aside. mix together flour, spices and soda set aside. mix together molasses and boiling water. mix all three mixes together. makes a thin batter. bake in 4 or 5 9 inch pans and bake at 375 until brown. put layers together with dried apples, apple butter or applesauce.

inputs: cold fat free, sugar, vanilla yogurt, cream cheese, sour cream, vanilla extract, cake, blackberries
targets: title: angel berry trifle ingredients: 1 1/2 c. cold fat free milk 1 1 oz. pkg. sugar free instant vanilla pudding mix 1 c. 8 oz. fat free vanilla yogurt 6 oz. reduced fat cream cheese, cubed 1/2 c. reduced fat sour cream 2 tsp. vanilla extract 1 12 oz. carton reduced fat frozen whipped topping, thawed and divided 1 8 inch prepared angel food cake, cut into 1 inch cubes 1 pt. each blackberries, raspberries and blueberries directions: in a small bowl, whisk the milk and pudding mix for 2 minutes or until thickened. in a mixing bowl, beat the yogurt, cream cheese, sour cream and vanilla until smooth. fold in pudding mixture and 1 cup whipped topping. place a third of the cake cubes in a 4 quart trifle bowl. top with a third of the pudding mixture, a third of the berries and half of the remaining whipped topping. repeat layers once. top with remaining cake, pudding and berries. serve immediately or refrigerate. yield 14 servings.

inputs: onion, clove garlic, oregano, olive oil, tomatoes, sugar, salt, extra virgin olive oil, eggplant, olive oil, bulgur wheat, oregano, boiling water, pistachios, feta cheese, clove garlic, thin scallions, capers, egg, cinnamon, feta cheese, drizzle of olive oil, oregano
targets: title: soft and sharp involtini ingredients: 1 onion 1 clove garlic half a teaspoon dried oregano 2 tablespoons olive oil 40 ounces approx. 5 cups canned chopped tomatoes 2 teaspoons sugar salt and pepper to taste 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil 4 eggplant 4 to 5 pounds total olive oil for painting the eggplant have plenty on hand scant 1/2 cup bulgur wheat 1 teaspoon dried oregano 1 1/2 cups boiling water scant 1/4 cup shelled pistachios, roughly chopped 7 ounces feta cheese, crumbled 1 clove garlic, minced 1 fat or 2 thin scallions, finely sliced 2 tablespoons capers drained of brine 1 egg a pinch of cinnamon 3 ounces feta cheese, crumbled drizzle of olive oil fat pinch of dried oregano directions: peel and roughly chop the onion and press on the garlic with the flat of a knife to loosen the skin. remove it and then sling onion, garlic and dried oregano into a food processor and blitz to a pulp. cook in a deep, generous sized pan with a lid in the 2 tablespoons of olive oil, over a medium to low heat, until softenedabout 7 minutes. add the tomatoes and the sugar, stir well, cover and turn down the heat, and let cook for about 20 minutes, checking often to see that the sauce is not bubbling too vociferously and therefore sticking or drying out, or indeed both . taste for seasoning, add salt and pepper or maybe a pinch more sugar if you feel it needs it, then stir again, add the extra virgin olive oil, and take off the heat but keep the cover on. leave till you need it. cut the eggplant in thinnish slices lengthwise and chuck away the two skin covered edges you need to be able to roll the eggplant lengths up later and so you need the full extent. it may sound wasteful, but im happy if i get 45 good slices per eggplant. put some oil into a bowl and using a pastry brush, paint each slice generously with the oil. then cook them on a hot griddle until bronzed, striped without and tender within. or you can just fry the eggplant slices in a pan filled to about half an inch depth of olive oil. in either case, remove the cooked slices to sheets of paper towel to absorb excess oil. cook all the eggplant slices this way and then, when cool, you can either begin the stuffing and rolling, or set them aside until you want to. if im doing this in advance, i line a dish with baking parchment, arrange a layer of eggplant slices on top, then cover with parchment, then another layer of eggplant and so on, until ive packed them all away. cover with a layer of parchment and leave till needed. i tend to stuff the eggplant shortly before cooking them. measure the bulgur wheat into a bowl, add the dried oregano, pour over the water and cover with a plate. leave to steep for 30 minutes. meanwhile, preheat the oven to 375f, and oil your oven proof dish lightly. when the bulgur wheat has had its time, pour it into a large sieve and press down to remove excess water. leave for a few minutes till its cooled a little and then decant to a large bowl. add about two thirds of the chopped pistachios you just need to leave some for sprinkling when serving , the crumbled feta, minced garlic, scallions and capers. stir to mix, but dont be too heavy handed about it a few goes with a fork should be enough to combine everything. beat the egg with the cinnamon and fork this in, too. i find it easier after thats done just to weigh in with my hands, squeezing everything together so youve got a cohesive, nubbly stuffing in front of you. get out the eggplant and, one by one, place them in front of you, stalk end at the top, bulbous bottom nearest you. add a dollop of stuffing at the bottom, roll up lengthwise away from you and put each fat little bundle in the oiled dish as you go. when theyre all sitting there snuggly, pour over the tomato sauce, scatter over the crumbled feta for the topping, drizzle with oil, sprinkle over a little dried oregano and cook for 30 minutes. remove from the oven and let stand at least 15 minutes before serving this shouldnt be piping hot. scatter with the remaining pistachios before bringing it to the table.

inputs: flour, sugar, eggs, oil, baking soda, salt, vanilla, fruit cocktail, sugar, condensed milk, butter, coconut, vanilla
targets: title: fruit cocktail cake ingredients: 2 c. flour 1 1/2 c. sugar 2 eggs 1/2 c. oil 2 tsp. baking soda 1/2 tsp. salt 1 tsp. vanilla 1 medium can fruit cocktail juice too 1 c. sugar 1 can condensed milk 1 stick butter 1 c. coconut 1 tsp. vanilla directions: mix flour, sugar, eggs, oil, baking soda, salt and vanilla together. add fruit cocktail. pour into ungreased 9 x 13 inch pan. bake at 350 for 30 minutes.

inputs: sweet potato, carrots, parsnip, onion, garlic, turmeric powder, cumin powder, salt, vegetable broth, ginger, chili powder, coconut oil, fresh parsley
targets: title: liver cleanse sweet potato and carrot soup ingredients: 1/2 cup cooked lentils 1 sweet potato, peeled and cut in cubes 3 carrots, peeled and roughly chopped 1 parsnip, peeled and roughly chopped 1 onion, peeled and cut in quarters 3 garlic cloves, crushed 1 teaspoon turmeric powder 1 teaspoon cumin powder 1/4 teaspoon sea salt 2 cups low sodium vegetable broth, warm 1 teaspoon grated ginger 1 pinch chili powder 1 teaspoon coconut oil fresh parsley, flaxseed, toasted mixed nuts, coconut milk to garnish directions: heat the oven at 165 c/329 f. line a baking sheet with baking paper, add the sweet potato, carrots, parsnip, onion, garlic, turmeric, cumin, chili, coconut oil, salt and toss to combine. roast for 20 minutes, then transfer into the blender. add the warm broth, grated ginger and cooked lentil and process to obtain a smooth cream serve warm, garnished with mixed nuts and seeds, parsley and coconut milk.

inputs: water, salt, honey, germ, yeast, all bran cereal, whole wheat flour
targets: title: whole wheat bran bread ingredients: 4 1/2 c. warm water 1 tbsp. salt 2 tbsp. honey 1/2 c. wheat germ 2 pkg. yeast, dissolved in water 3 c. all bran cereal 5 c. whole wheat flour directions: melt yeast in warm water. add salt, honey, cereal and wheat germ. add 5 cups of whole wheat flour stir. add flour gradually until dough is pliable and elastic. knead dough about 1 minute. let dough rise until doubled in size. punch down knead for a minute, then put into loaf pans. let rise again until doubled in size. pot it in a 350 oven for 30 to 45 minutes, or until it pulls away from the sides of the pan.

inputs: mayonnaise, buttermilk, lemon juice, worcestershire sauce, onion flakes, garlic
targets: title: creamy garlic salad dressing recipe ingredients: 1 c. mayonnaise 1 c. buttermilk 2 tbsp. lemon juice dash of worcestershire sauce dash of dry onion flakes 2 garlic cloves, crushed directions: combine all ingredients in a jar with a screw on cap. don t use blender. chill up to 4 weeks.

inputs: orzo pasta, chicken stock, water, onion, garlic, olives, tomatoes, feta cheese, olive oil, fresh oregano, mint, lime juice, salt
targets: title: simple orzo salad ingredients: 1 cup dried orzo pasta 1 cup chicken stock 2 cups water 1/4 cup chopped onion 1 garlic clove 5 kalamata olives pitted 6 heirloom plum tomatoes 1/4 cup fresh feta cheese, cubed not crumbles 1 tablespoon olive oil 1 teaspoon fresh oregano 1/4 tablespoon of fresh mint, chopped 1/2 tablespoon fresh lime juice salt directions: in a small skillet combine orzo, garlic, onion, chicken stock and one cup of water. cook the orzo over medium heat in the chicken stock and add water as needed. cook until the orzo is tender. about 10 minutes. drain the orzo and allow to cool for five minutes. combine all ingredients in a bowl, and toss until everything is well mixed. add salt as needed.

inputs: salad oil, celery stalks, onion, green pepper, tomatoes, red kidney beans, pinto beans, green chilies, zucchini, carrot, oregano, salt, red pepper, cheddar cheese
targets: title: all vegetable chili ingredients: 2 tbsp. salad oil 2 medium size celery stalks, chopped 1 medium size onion, chopped 1 medium size green pepper 1 28 oz. can tomatoes 1 15 1/4 to 19 oz. can red kidney beans 1 16 to 19 oz. can pinto beans 1 4 oz. can chopped green chilies 2 small zucchini, diced 1 large carrot, coarsely shredded 1/2 tsp. dried oregano leaves 1/2 tsp. salt 1/4 tsp. crushed red pepper 1 c. shredded cheddar cheese directions: in 5 quart dutch oven, over medium heat in hot salad oil, cook celery, onion and green pepper until tender, stirring mixture occasionally. turn heat to high. stir in tomatoes with their liquid, undrained kidney and pinto beans, green chilies, zucchini, carrot, oregano, salt and crushed red pepper until boiling. reduce heat to medium cover and cook 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. to serve, ladle chili into bowls and top with cheese. makes 5 main dish servings.

inputs: olive oil, onion, leeks, carrots, celery, tomatoes, saffron, water, base, boiling potaotes, zucchini, pasta like orzo, salt
targets: title: vegetable soup ingredients: 1/4 cup olive oil 1 onion, finely diced 1 to 2 leeks, washed and thinly sliced 2 carrots, finely sliced 1 stalk celery finely chopped 2 cups chopped canned plum tomatoes 1/2 teaspoon saffron, optional 3 quarts water 1 soup base 4 servings 2 boiling potaotes, peeled and cut into 1/2 inch dice or 1 cup drained canned white beans 1 cup seeded diced zucchini 1/2 cup pasta like orzo or broken up vermicelli or spaghetti salt and pepper directions: in a large saucepan heat the olive oil. when hot, add the onions, leeks, carrots and celery. cover and simmer for 5 minutes or until tender if at any time the vegetables begin to stick to the bottom of the pan before they become tender, add some water. add the tomatoes, saffron and water bring to a boil and simmer uncovered for 15 minutes or until the vegetables are tender. season to taste with salt and pepper. divide the soup base into 2 containers and freeze until you are ready to use bring soup base to a simmer if there does not appear to be enough liquid in which to simmer all of the additional vegetables, then add some water . add potaotes or white beans, zucchini and pasta, cover and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes or unilt all the ingredients are tender. serve as is or with pistou or rouille see below . 4 servings

inputs: ground meat, bread crumbs, onion, milk, egg, salt, pepper, worcestershire, chili sauce, cranberries, sauerkraut
targets: title: meatballs ingredients: 1 lb. ground meat 1/2 c. dry bread crumbs 1/2 c. diced onion 1/4 c. milk 1 egg 1 tsp. salt 1/8 tsp. pepper 1/2 tsp. worcestershire 12 oz. bottle chili sauce 15 oz. can whole cranberries 15 oz. can sauerkraut directions: mix following ingredients together ground meat, bread crumbs, onions, milk, egg, salt, pepper and worcestershire sauce. shape into meatballs. place on cookie sheet and bake at 350 for 15 minutes or until brown. in slow cooker, put chili sauce, cranberries and sauerkraut. stir. add meatballs and let cook at low temperature, 3 to 4 hours, the longer the better.

inputs: golden delicious apples, water, cold butter, flour, cornstarch, brown sugar, ground cinnamon, salt
targets: title: baked cinnamon apples ingredients: 3 golden delicious apples peeled, cored, and thinly sliced 2/3 cup water 2 teaspoons cold butter, cut into small pieces 1 1/2 teaspoons all purpose flour 1 teaspoon cornstarch 1/2 cup brown sugar 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon 1 pinch salt directions: preheat oven to 350 degrees f 175 degrees c . layer apple slices in the bottom of an 8 inch glass baking dish. mix water, butter, flour, and cornstarch together in a bowl until no lumps remain. stir in brown sugar, cinnamon, and salt until smooth. pour apples in the baking dish. bake in the preheated oven, stirring every 10 to 15 minutes, until soft and juicy, about 45 minutes.

inputs: black olive paste, shallots, red wine vinegar, mustard, extra virgin olive oil, salt, head radicchio, endive
targets: title: mixed greens with olive vinaigrette ingredients: 2 tablespoons black olive paste or finely chopped black olives, such as calamata 2 tablespoons minced shallots 1 tablespoon red wine vinegar 1/2 teaspoon dijon mustard 1/3 cup extra virgin olive oil salt and freshly ground pepper 1 large head radicchio, torn into bite size pieces 1 large endive, cut into bite size pieces 1 large bunch of watercress, tough stems discarded, the rest torn into bite size pieces directions: in a large bowl, whisk the olive paste with the shallots, vinegar and mustard. whisk in the oil in a thin stream. season with salt and pepper. add the radicchio, endive and watercress and toss thoroughly. season the salad with salt and pepper and serve immediately.

inputs: milk, eggs, cheddar cheese, ham, bacon, onion, green pepper, mushrooms, broccoli, dish pie crusts
targets: title: viele good quiche ingredients: 2/3 c. milk or cream 12 eggs 8 oz. sharp cheddar cheese, cubed 2 c. ham, cubed 1 c. crumbled cooked bacon 1 onion, chopped 1 green pepper, chopped 1 can mushrooms 2/3 c. broccoli 2 deep dish pie crusts directions: place cheese, ham, bacon and vegetables in bottom of 2 deep dish pie crusts. whip eggs. add milk to eggs, then pour 1/2 of mixture over each pie crust. bake at 350 for about 45 minutes to 1 hour, until quiche is formed. frozen pie shells work well.

inputs: eggs, spinach, cheddar cheese, onions, green, salt
targets: title: egg, spinach and cheese ingredients: 2 eggs per person 1/2 to 1 can spinach 1/2 block cheddar cheese 1/2 c. onions 1/2 c. green and red peppers bell salt and pepper directions: in a large bowl, crack eggs and pour spinach in bowl. mix well. grate cheese and add to egg and spinach mix. in skillet, brown onions and bell peppers remove and add to egg mix. mix well. in a large baking dish, put in mixture and bake at 350 until eggs are set.

inputs: chicken breasts, unsalted butter, cream cheese, marsala wine, campbell s cream, water, oregano, basil, garlic powder, black pepper
targets: title: easy chicken marsala in the crockpot ingredients: 4 chicken breasts 1/4 cup unsalted butter 8 ounces cream cheese 2/3 cup marsala wine 21 1/2 ounces campbell s cream of mushroom soup 3/4 cup water 1/4 teaspoon oregano 1/4 teaspoon basil 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder 1/4 teaspoon black pepper directions: cube chicken breasts. place chicken, butter and spices in the slow cooker. mix cream cheese, wine, water and mushroom soup. pour over chicken. cover crockpot and cook on high for 4 5 hours. you can cook it on low for 7 8 hours which i did.

inputs: pineapple, rolls, butter, sugar, flour, grated cheese
targets: title: pineapple au gratin ingredients: 2 c. pineapple chunks, drained 2 rolls ritz crackers, crushed 1 stick butter 1 c. sugar 6 tbsp. flour 2 c. grated cheese directions: mix pineapple, flour and sugar. melt butter in casserole dish. pour mixture in, mix cracker crumbs and grated cheese and sprinkle on top. bake at 350 for 30 minutes. this is a vegetable, but tastes like a dessert. everyone wants seconds

inputs: watermelon, tequila, lime juice, simple syrup
targets: title: three sheets to the watermelon ingredients: 1 10 pound watermelon, cut in half lengthwise, from stem 1 cup plus 1 ounce tequila 1/2 ounce fresh lime juice 3/4 ounce simple syrup directions: take one of the watermelon halves and, using a fork or knife, score the red interior in one direction and then the other, creating a grid of squares. refrigerate the remaining half for other uses. slowly pour 1 cup of the tequila into the scored melon half, taking care to spread it around. let melon macerate overnight, or for a few hours, in refrigerator. scoop out 2 heaping tablespoons of the watermelon and add to a cocktail shaker 3/4 filled with ice. be sure to get some liquid as well as chunks of fruit. add the remaining ounce of tequila, the lime juice and the simple syrup. shake vigorously so the melon chunks break up into slush and the drink chills, about 30 seconds. pour into a 10 ounce rocks glass. add more ice if needed. note to make simple syrup, warm 1 cup sugar in 1 cup water in a saucepan over low heat until dissolved. cool to room temperature before using. there will be extra syrup refrigerate if not using immediately.

inputs: broccoli, rotini, olive oil, pancetta, garlic, red pepper, mushrooms, freshly grated pecorino romano, salt, pine nuts, fresh parsley
targets: title: rotini with mushrooms and broccoli ingredients: 1 small bunch broccoli 1 pound rotini or other twisted pasta 2 tablespoons good quality olive oil 1/4 pound pancetta or bacon diced optional 1 teaspoon finely chopped garlic 1/4 teaspoon red pepper flakes 1 pound mushrooms, sliced 1/2 cup freshly grated pecorino romano or locatelli cheese salt and fresh ground pepper to taste 1/4 cup pine nuts, lightly toasted 1/4 cup fresh parsley, finely chopped directions: separate broccoli into florets. discard tough stem, and peel and chop remaining stem into 1 inch pieces. you should have about 2 cups. bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. cook pasta according to package directions. during the last 5 minutes, add the broccoli to the pasta. drain, reserving 1/2 cup liquid. return pasta to cooking pot. while the water is coming to a boil and the pasta is cooking, heat the olive oil in a 10 inch frying pan. add the pancetta or bacon, if using, and saute until crisp. remove from pan and drain on paper towels. reserve oil in pan. add the chopped garlic, red pepper flakes and mushrooms to the reserved oil in saute pan and cook over medium high heat until the mushrooms release their liquid. continue cooking until mushrooms are almost dry. add mushroom mixture to the pasta and broccoli. toss with the grated cheese. add a little of the reserved water if pasta appears dry. add the pancetta or bacon if using. season with salt and fresh ground pepper to taste. transfer to individual shallow bowls and garnish with toasted pine nuts and parsley. pass additional grated cheese.

inputs: frozen broccoli, butter, herb stuffing mix, cream of mushroom soup, milk, salt, grated cheese, onion, breadcrumbs
targets: title: broccoli herb stuffing casserole ingredients: 2 10 ounce packages chopped frozen broccoli 4 tablespoons butter 1 6 ounce package stovetop herb stuffing mix 1 15 3/4 ounce can cream of mushroom soup 1/4 cup milk 1 dash salt and pepper 1 cup grated cheese 1/3 cup chopped onion 1/2 cup breadcrumbs directions: preheat oven to 350 f. cook broccoli according to package directions and drain. mix all ingredients and place in buttered 2 quart casserole. sprinkle breadcrumbs on top. bake 30 40 minutes.

inputs: peanut, raisins, honey, ground cinnamon, rice, bran, margarine, vanilla
targets: title: tavern nut crunch ingredients: 2 c. any type peanut 2 c. wheat chex 1 c. dark seedless raisins 1/4 c. honey 2 tsp. ground cinnamon 2 c. rice chex 2 c. bran chex 1/3 c. margarine 1 1/2 tsp. vanilla directions: in a large bowl, toss together the peanuts, rice, wheat and bran chex cereal and raisins. melt margarine in saucepan. stir in honey, vanilla and cinnamon until well blended. pour syrup over nut cereal mixture and toss to coat all pieces well. spread mixture on a large, ungreased baking sheet. bake at 350 for 10 minutes. turn off oven and leave in oven for another 10 minutes. store in an airtight container.

inputs: butter, carrot, celery, yellow onion, spinach, salt
targets: title: chez panisse spinach soup ingredients: 4 tablespoons butter 1 large carrot, peeled and diced 4 ounces 1 stalk celery, diced 2 1/2 ounces 1 medium yellow onion, diced 6 ounces 18 ounces spinach, de stemmed, washed and drained 2 3 bunches salt, pepper directions: melt the butter in a wide stainless steel pot at least a 5 quart capacity over medium low heat. add three fourths cup of water and the carrot, celery and onion. increase the heat to bring the mixture to a simmer, then reduce the heat to cook at a low simmer, covered, for 20 minutes. add 4 1/2 cups water and bring to a boil over high heat. add the spinach and boil for 1 additional minute, stirring until all of the spinach is well wilted. do not cover the pot volatile acids, which are released when the vegetable is heated, will condense on the lid, fall back into the pot and cause discoloration. puree the entire mixture using an immersion blender, or pour into a blender to puree, and transfer the soup immediately to a hot tureen. do not strain the soup. season with 1 1/2 tsps. salt and a pinch of pepper, or to taste, garnish as desired and serve immediately.

inputs: cooking spray, seedless raspberry, fresh raspberries, blackberries, strawberries, plum, sugar
targets: title: fresh fruit pizza with lemon curd ingredients: 1 18 ounce package refrigerated sugar cookie dough cooking spray 2 tablespoons seedless raspberry jam, melted 2 cups fresh raspberries 2 cups blackberries 1 cup sliced strawberries 1 plum, sliced 2 teaspoons sugar directions: preheat oven to 350 . press dough into a 12 inch pizza pan coated with cooking spray. bake at 350 for 12 minutes or until golden brown. cool completely on a wire rack. preheat broiler. spread jam over crust. spread lemon curd over jam arrange raspberries, blackberries, strawberry slices, and plum slices on top. sprinkle sugar over fruit broil 3 minutes.

inputs: cream cheese, pepperoni, tomatoes, garlic, onion powder, italian spices
targets: title: cold pizza dip ingredients: 8 ounces cream cheese, softened 20 pepperoni slices 4 sun dried tomatoes 1 tablespoon garlic powder 1 tablespoon onion powder 2 tablespoons italian spices directions: beat cream cheese in bowl until creamy. chop pepperoni and tomatoes finally. add all spices and pepperoni and tomatoes into the cream cheese. mix at med high speed until thoroughly combined. serve with crackers corn chips pretzels or even on bagles.

inputs: boiling water, oatmeal, brown sugar, eggs, oleo, sugar, flour, soda, salt, cocoa, nuts, chocolate chips
targets: title: suzanne s oatmeal chocolate chip cake ingredients: 1 3/4 c. boiling water 1 c. oatmeal 1 c. brown sugar 2 extra large eggs 1/2 c. oleo 1 c. sugar 1 3/4 c. flour 1 tsp. soda 1/2 tsp. salt 1 tbsp. cocoa 3/4 c. chopped nuts 12 oz. chocolate chips directions: pour boiling water over oatmeal and let stand 10 minutes. add sugars and oleo. stir until oleo is melted. add eggs and mix well. sift together dry ingredients and add to sugar mixture. mix well. add 6 ounces chocolate chips.

inputs: tropical fruit, orange flavor, water, pecans, low fat
targets: title: tropical fruit cloud salad ingredients: 1 can 15 oz. tropical fruit 1 pkg. 3 oz. orange flavor gelatin 1/4 cup water 1/2 cup chopped pecans optional 3 cups fat free whipped topping, thawed 1 carton 12 oz. low fat or fat free cottage cheese directions: drain and reserve juice from tropical fruit. combine reserved juice, water and orange gelatin. heat until dissolved. fold in whipped topping. mix in tropical fruit, cottage cheese and nuts. chill.

inputs: flour, semi sweet chocolate chips, light brown sugar, butter, sugar, eggs, vanilla, baking soda, salt
targets: title: chocolate chip cookie bars ingredients: 2 1/2 cups all purpose flour 2 cups mini semi sweet chocolate chips 1 cup light brown sugar 1 cup 2 sticks unsalted butter 2/3 cup sugar 2 large eggs 2 1/2 teaspoons vanilla extract 3/4 teaspoon baking soda 1/2 teaspoon salt directions: preheat oven to 325as f and lightly grease a 9a13 inch baking pan with butter or non stick spray. combine flour, baking soda and salt in a medium bowl and mix together. place butter in a medium saucepan over medium heat and melt, stirring frequently, until browned. 5 6 minutes. remove from heat and let browned butter cool. in a large bowl or mixer, beat together butter and sugars until combined then mix in eggs one at a time. add in vanilla extract, then gradually mix in dry ingredients until just incorporated. fold in chocolate chips, then pour cookie dough out into greased baking dish and smooth over the top. if using, lightly sprinkle a pinch of sea salt evenly over the cookie dough, then place baking dish in oven. bake for 25 30 minutes, or until cookie bar is golden brown and the edges have begun to pull away from the sides of the pan. remove from oven and let cool 15 minutes before slicing into bars.

inputs: bacon, sauerkraut, cabbage, carrots
targets: title: sauerkraut with bacon recipe ingredients: 1/2 pound bacon 1 pkg. sauerkraut 1/2 as much shredded cabbage 1/4 c. shredded carrots directions: fry bacon crispy reserving grease. break into bits. save. drain and rinse sauerkraut. in grease, over low heat, cook sauerkraut, slowly. add in shredded cabbage, bacon and carrots. simmer 2 hrs or possibly till cabbage is tender. add in water as needed to keep moist.

inputs: perogies, onion, leftover ham, cream of mushroom soup, broth
targets: title: leftover ham and perogy bake ingredients: 1 kg frozen cheemo perogies 1 onion, thinly sliced 1 cup leftover ham 1 10 ounce can cream of mushroom soup 1/2 cup broth directions: combine cream of mushroom soup and broth together. add spices of your choice at this point, rosemary/saje/marjoram/garlic. toss frozen perogies and ham with soup mixture. bake at 350, covered, for 1 1 1/2hrs. toss gently every 1/2 hour. add a variety of vegetables, or switch protein for a change. i added mozza cheese at the end of one bake.

inputs: sugar, water, made tea, cold water, pineapple juice, grapefruit juice, orange juice, lemon, ginger ale, sugar
targets: title: fruit punch ingredients: 2 c. sugar 1 c. hot water 1 c. made tea 1 c. cold water 1 large can pineapple juice 1 small can grapefruit juice 1 small can frozen orange juice juice of 1 lemon 1 large ginger ale fruit and sugar to taste directions: combine 2 cups of sugar, hot water, tea and cold water. add pineapple juice, grapefruit juice, orange juice, lemon juice and ginger ale. add fruit and more sugar to taste.

inputs: hamburger, onion, water, mustard, ketchup, brown sugar, chili powder, red pepper, vinegar
targets: title: hot dog chili ingredients: 1 lb. hamburger 1 small onion 1/2 c. water 1/3 c. mustard 1/3 c. ketchup 1/2 c. brown sugar 2 tbsp. chili powder 1 tbsp. red pepper 1 tbsp. vinegar directions: brown hamburger and onion drain well. add other ingredients. simmer for 20 minutes. ready to use.

inputs: red potatoes, salt, white wine, olive oil, lemon juice, mayonnaise, pesto, red onion
targets: title: basil pesto potato salad ingredients: 10 small red potatoes, scrubbed 1/2 teaspoon salt 1/4 cup dry white wine 1 1/2 tablespoons olive oil 1 1/2 teaspoons lemon juice 1/2 cup mayonnaise 6 tablespoons pesto, or more to taste 1 small red onion, finely sliced, or to taste directions: place potatoes into a large pot and cover with lightly salted water bring to a boil. reduce heat to medium low and simmer until just tender, about 10 minutes. drain and cool until easily handled, 5 to 10 minutes. peel potatoes and cut into 1/4 inch thick slices. place in a large bowl. sprinkle with salt. add white wine, olive oil, and lemon juice toss lightly to combine. mix mayonnaise and pesto together in a small bowl. pour over potato salad and toss gently. garnish with red onion. chill until serving.

inputs: cream of celery soup, milk, sweet pickle relish, vinegar, onion, salt, pepper, wieners, potatoes
targets: title: tangy skillet potato salad ingredients: 1 10 1/2 oz. can cream of celery soup 1/4 c. milk 2 tbsp. sweet pickle relish 2 tbsp. vinegar 1 tbsp. finely chopped onion 1/2 tsp. salt dash of pepper 5 wieners, bias sliced into 1 inch pieces 3 c. diced, cooked potatoes or 2 16 oz. cans potatoes, drained and sliced directions: in medium skillet, combine soup, milk, relish, vinegar, onion, salt and pepper. cook and stir until boiling. stir in potatoes and franks. heat through. top with snipped parsley, if desired. serves 4 or 5.

inputs: shortening, sugar, carrots, egg, vanilla, orange extract, flour, baking powder, salt, raisins, pecans
targets: title: carrot orange cookies ingredients: 3/4 cup shortening 3/4 cup sugar 1 cup mashed, cooked carrots 1 egg 1 teaspoon vanilla extract 3/4 teaspoon orange extract 2 cups all purpose flour 2 teaspoons baking powder 1/4 teaspoon salt 1/2 cup raisins 1/2 cup chopped pecans directions: cream shortening in a large mixing bowl gradually add sugar, beating until light and fluffy. add carrots, egg, vanilla, and orange extract beat well. combine flour, baking powder, and salt add to creamed mixture, stirring well. stir in raisins and pecans. drop dough by heaping teaspoonfuls 2 inches apart onto greased cookie sheets. bake at 350 for 12 to 15 minutes. remove from cookie sheets, and cool on wire racks.

inputs: whipping cream, crust, eggs, sugar, light corn syrup, cocoa powder, butter
targets: title: chocolate brownie pie ingredients: 1 quart whipping cream, whipped until peaks form 1 9 inch baked pie crust 3 eggs 12 cup sugar 34 cup light corn syrup 12 cup cocoa powder 12 cup butter, melted directions: preheat oven to 350 degrees. in an electric mixer, mix the eggs, sugar, corn syrup, cocoa powder, and butter. pour into the pie shell and bake 45 minutes. serve warm topped with whipped cream.

inputs: lorna doone cookies, butter, milk, instant vanilla pudding, butter
targets: title: shirley s dessert ingredients: 1 pkg. lorna doone cookies 1 stick butter 2 c. milk 2 pkg. instant vanilla pudding 1 8 oz. cool whip 6 heath bars regular 2 qt. butter pecan ice cream directions: melt butter in bottom of pan. crumble cookies. put in butter. make layer on bottom of pan. mix pudding with milk. mix ice cream with pudding slowly. pour on crumble mix layer. put cool whip on top. crush heath bars put them on top. refrigerate overnight.

inputs: long grain wild rice, boiling water, dried apricots, green onions, fresh mushrooms, green peppers, butter, pecans, parsley, pepper, red pepper
targets: title: apricot rice ingredients: 1 6 oz. box long grain wild rice 1/2 c. boiling water 3/4 c. dried apricots, chopped 2 green onions, finely chopped 1/2 c. fresh mushrooms, chopped 1/4 c. green peppers, chopped 2 tbsp. butter 3 tbsp. pecans, chopped 1 tbsp. parsley, chopped 1/8 tsp. pepper dash of red pepper directions: cook rice according to directions on box. pour boiling water over apricots and let stand 20 minutes to soften. drain. saute onions, mushrooms and green peppers in butter until tender. add to the cooked rice, then add apricots, pecans, parsley and seasonings. mix well.

inputs: butter, flour, milk, salt, ground ginger, avocados, heavy cream, preserved gingerroot
targets: title: avocado soup with ginger and orange ingredients: 14 cup butter 14 cup flour 1 quart milk salt 14 teaspoon ground ginger 1 grated orange, rind of 2 avocados 14 cup heavy cream, whipped 1 2 teaspoon minced preserved gingerroot optional directions: melt the butter in the top of a double boiler over hot, hot water. add the flour and blend with a wire whisk. meanwhile, bring the milk to a boil and add all at once to the butter flour mixture, stirring vigorously with the whisk. add the salt, ginger and orange rind and cook, stirring, until the mixture has thickened. mash or sieve one avocado and add to the sauce. stir in thoroughly. chill. serve the chilled soup in chilled soup bowls or cups. garnish with the remaining avocado, cubed, whipped cream and a sprinkling of preserved ginger. note this soup may also be heated before serving.

inputs: butter, sugar, flour
targets: title: scottish shortbread ingredients: 1 cup butter, softened 1 cup superfine sugar 2 12 cups all purpose flour directions: pre heat oven to 275. cream butter in large bowl. add sugar and mix well. add flour gradually, kneading dough on work surface. when dough no longer sticks to surface, roll out 1/4 inch thick. cut into shapes with cookie cutter. arrange cookies on ungreased cookie sheet. bake 45 to 50 minutes or until cookies are lightly browned.

inputs: cheddar cheese soup, white wine, worcestershire sauce
targets: title: quick fondue ingredients: 2 10 oz. cans condensed cheddar cheese soup 1/3 c. dry white wine few drops worcestershire sauce directions: mix well in saucepan over low heat. pour into fondue pot. place over fondue burner. spear with fresh french or sourdough bread squares and dip.

inputs: cranberry sauce, mushrooms, egg, onion salt, garlic salt, pepper, salt, chopped meat, onion
targets: title: sweet and sour meatballs ingredients: 1 medium can whole berry cranberry sauce 1 medium jar spaghetti sauce with mushrooms 1 egg 1/2 tsp. onion salt 1/2 tsp. garlic salt 1/2 tsp. pepper 1/2 tsp. salt 1 1/2 lb. chopped meat 1 large onion directions: preheat frying pan to 350 . heat oil. dice onions in pan until brown. mix chopped meat with garlic, onion, salt, 1 egg and lots of bread crumbs. make meatballs and brown with onions.

inputs: zucchini, lean ground turkey, green bell pepper, onion, egg, bread crumbs, pepper, fresh cilantro, garlic, steak seasoning, ground cumin, thyme, salsa, cheddar cheese
targets: title: southwest stuffed zucchini ingredients: 2 large zucchini, halved and quartered 1 1/4 pounds lean ground turkey 1/2 small green bell pepper, finely chopped 1/4 onion, finely chopped 1 egg 1/4 cup bread crumbs 1 jalapeno pepper, seeded and minced 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro 2 cloves garlic, minced 2 teaspoons steak seasoning such as montreal steak seasoning r 2 teaspoons ground cumin 1 teaspoon dried thyme 1 cup salsa 1 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese directions: preheat oven to 400 degrees f 200 degrees c . scoop flesh out of zucchini using a spoon, creating boats. mix turkey, green bell pepper, onion, egg, bread crumbs, jalapeno pepper, cilantro, garlic, steak seasoning, cumin, and thyme together in a large bowl. fill zucchini boats with turkey mixture. cover with salsa and cheddar cheese. bake in the preheated oven until turkey is no longer pink in the center and zucchini is very tender, about 45 minutes.

inputs: , , , vanilla, , , ground flaxseed, water, cocoa, baking soda, baking powder, oats, salt, chocolate, whipped cream, coconut milk, all natural peanut butter, honey
targets: title: peanut butter brownies with peanut butter whipped cream ingredients: for the brownies 1/4 cups unsweetened almond milk 1/4 cups all natural peanut butter 1/4 cups honey or agave 1 teaspoon vanilla extract 3/4 cups unsweetened applesauce 1/4 cups softened extra virgin coconut oil 1 tablespoon ground flaxseed 3 tablespoons water 1/2 cups cocoa powder 1/2 teaspoons baking soda 1/2 teaspoons baking powder 1 cup gluten free oats, ground into flour 1/2 teaspoons salt 1 ounce, weight dark chocolate, chopped for the whipped cream 1 can full fat coconut milk, 13 ounce can, refrigerated overnight 1 tablespoon all natural peanut butter 1 tablespoon honey or agave directions: for the brownies preheat oven to 350 f. grease an 8x8 baking dish with coconut oil. in a large bowl mix all of the wet ingredients almond milk through coconut oil until combined. in a small bowl, mix together the ground flaxseed and water. add all dry ingredients cocoa powder through salt into the wet ingredients and mix until combined. add the flax and water mixture and mix until combined. pour batter into prepared pan and smooth the top. top the batter with the chopped dark chocolate. bake for 25 30 minutes, or until you can insert a knife in the middle of the brownies and have it come out mostly clean. remove from oven and allow to cool. then cut and serve topped with a scoop of whipped cream. for the whipped cream remove the can of coconut milk from the fridge and flip it over. pour the coconut milk which should be on top into a container for later. spoon the coconut cream which should be solidified at the bottom of the can into a mixing bowl. add peanut butter and honey or agave into the bowl. mix with a hand mixer or kitchenaid mixer on high speed until the mixture is fluffy and smooth, about 30 seconds to 1 minute.

inputs: ground lamb, stale breadcrumbs, milk cheese, parsley, eggs, ground cinnamon, olive oil, spanish onion, bay leaf, red wine, tomatoes, ground allspice
targets: title: braised lamb meatballs in red wine ingredients: 1 1/2 lb ground lamb 3/4 cup stale breadcrumbs 3 oz coarsely grated hard sheep s milk cheese 3/4 cup finely chopped fresh flat leaf parsley leaves 2 none large eggs 2 tsp ground cinnamon 1 tbsp olive oil 1 none spanish onion, finely chopped 1 none bay leaf 1/2 cup dry red wine 1 13.5 oz can diced tomatoes 1 tsp ground allspice directions: combine lamb, breadcrumbs, cheese, 3/4 of the parsley, eggs and cinnamon in a large bowl. season then roll into meatballs. heat olive oil in a deep frying pan over medium high heat. cook meatballs until browned then remove from pan. add onion and bay leaf to pan. cook, stirring, until onion softens. return meatballs to pan along with wine. bring to a boil then reduce heat and simmer until wine has almost evaporated. stir in tomatoes and allspice. simmer, covered, for 15 mins, or until meatballs are cooked through. serve sprinkled with remaining parsley.

inputs: chicken breasts, red wine vinegar, olive oil, garlic, shallot, thyme, salt, freshly ground black pepper, eggplant, red bell pepper, mozzarella, sandwich
targets: title: meat lite eggplant, chicken, and smoked mozzarella sandwiches recipe ingredients: 1 pound boneless skinless chicken breasts 2 medium or chicken breast cutlets 2/3 cup red wine vinegar 1/4 cup olive oil 2 cloves garlic, minced 1 large shallot, minced 4 sprigs of thyme, leaves only, minced 2 teaspoons salt 1/2 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper 1 medium eggplant about 1 pound , sliced into 1/4 inch rounds 1 red bell pepper 8 ounces smoked fresh mozzarella, sliced thin 1 baguette cut into 4 pieces or 4 sandwich hoagie rolls directions: if using full chicken breasts instead or chicken cutlets , slice the meat into 1/2 inch thick strips and then pound each strip thin. make a marinade by whisking together the vinegar, oil, garlic, shallot, thyme, salt, and pepper in a mixing bowl. put the eggplant in a zip top bag or a glass dish. pour half of the marinade over the eggplant. put the chicken in a separate bag or dish and pour the other half of the marinade over it. refrigerate the eggplant and chicken for about an hour. heat a grill to medium high. put the bell pepper on the hot grill and grill each side until blackened all over. remove to a bowl and cover with plastic wrap. when cool enough to handle, peel the charred skin from the pepper and slice into 1 inch strips. grill the marinated eggplant and chicken until the eggplant is tender and the meat is cooked through. arrange slices of smoked mozzarella on each piece of baguette. top with pieces of hot chicken, eggplant and roasted peppers.

inputs: sugar, hot water, butter, baking soda, white syrup, peanuts, vanilla
targets: title: peanut brittle ingredients: 1 1/2 c. sugar 1/2 c. hot water 1/2 stick butter 1 tsp. baking soda 1/2 c. white syrup 2 c. raw peanuts 1 tsp. vanilla directions: cook sugar, syrup and hot water over medium heat until it spins a thread. add peanuts. cook until peanuts are brown and syrup starts to turn. add butter and soda. pour on a greased cookie sheet the thinner on sheet the better .

inputs: gold potatoes, eggs, red wine vinegar, pepper, yogurt, olive oil mayonnaise, sweet pickle, mustard, salt, black pepper, celery, onion
targets: title: low fat american potato salad ingredients: 2 lbs uncooked yukon gold potatoes, peeled, cut into 1 inch chunks es 3 large eggs, hard boiled 2 teaspoons red wine vinegar 3 tablespoons jarred hot pepper juice optional 12 cup plain fat free yogurt, greek style recommended 14 cup olive oil mayonnaise 3 tablespoons sweet pickle relish 2 tablespoons dijon mustard 12 teaspoon table salt 12 teaspoon black pepper, freshly ground 12 cup uncooked celery, diced 13 cup onion directions: place potatoes in a large saucepan and cover with 2 inches of water bring to a boil. reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, until potatoes are fork tender, about 7 to 9 minutes drain and cool slightly. meanwhile, in a large bowl, using a fork, mash yolk from 1 egg with vinegar until smooth. add yogurt, mayonnaise, relish, splenda, salt and pepper stir until blended. add potatoes, celery and onion to bowl toss to mix and coat. chop remaining egg white and egg gently fold into potato salad. cover and refrigerate until chilled. yields about 3/4 cup per serving.

inputs: all purpose, baking powder, salt, sugar, vegetable oil, water
targets: title: flour tortillas ingredients: 3 cups all purpose flour 3 teaspoons baking powder 1 teaspoon salt 1 pinch sugar 3 tablespoons vegetable oil 1 cup water directions: mix together flour, baking powder, salt, sugar and oil. add water and mix with hands or pulse in food processor until dough is formed. divide into 10 small balls. roll each flat with rolling pin and cook on very hot ungreased griddle until lightly brown on each side.

inputs: apples, cranberries, brown sugar, ground cinnamon, topping, flour, toasted wheat germ, brown sugar, jif, walnuts, cream topping, or, sugar
targets: title: apple cranberry peanut butter crisp ingredients: 6 cups peeled, sliced gala apples about 3 large 1/4 cup dried cranberries 1/4 cup firmly packed brown sugar 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon topping 6 tablespoons pillsbury best r all purpose flour 3 tablespoons toasted wheat germ 1/4 cup firmly packed brown sugar 1/2 cup jif r omega 3 creamy peanut butter 1/2 cup chopped walnuts smucker s r caramel sundae syrups ice cream topping optional or smucker s r sugar free caramel sundae syrups ice cream topping directions: heat oven to 375 f. stir apples, cranberries, 1/4 cup brown sugar and cinnamon until coated. spoon evenly in 9 x 9 inch baking pan. mix flour, wheat germ and 1/4 cup brown sugar in medium bowl. cut in peanut butter with fork until crumbs form. stir in walnuts. crumble over apples. bake 35 to 40 minutes or until apples are fork tender and top is golden brown. cool 10 minutes. drizzle with caramel sundae syrup, if desired. serve warm.

inputs: almonds, sesame seed, margarine, ramen noodles, shredded cabbage, oil, sugar
targets: title: oriental salad out of this world ingredients: 1/3 c. slivered almonds 2 tsp. sesame seed 2 tsp. margarine 1 pkg. ramen noodles any flavor 1 1 lb. pkg. shredded cabbage 1/2 c. oil 2 tsp. sugar directions: brown almonds and sesame seed in margarine cool. mix uncooked and crumbled noodles, cabbage or coleslaw mix and cooled nut mixture. combine seasoning package from noodles with oil and sugar. toss with cabbage mixture at last minute and serve. cooked, cubed chicken can also be added with oil mixture.

inputs: boneless beef grilling steak, salt, green sauce, green onions, fresh parsley, fresh cilantro, clove garlic, water, tomato, olive oil, red wine vinegar, lemon juice, salt
targets: title: steak with green sauce ingredients: 2lb boneless beef grilling steak about 1.5 inches thick 1.5 each coarse salt and pepper green sauce 1/2 c. chopped green onions 1/2 c. chopped fresh parsley 1 c. chopped fresh cilantro 1 clove garlic, minced 3 t water 1 tomato, finely diced, 1/3 c. olive oil 3 t red wine vinegar 3 t lemon juice 1/4 t salt directions: sprinkle both sides of steak with salt and pepper press to adhere. grill over med high heat, until medium rare, 8 10 minutes turning once transfer to cutting board, tent with foil and let stand 5 minutes before thinly slicing across the grain. green sauce. combine onions, parsley, cilantro, garlic and water in magic bullet or food processor if available, not entirely necessary though stir in tomato, oil, vinegar, lemon juice and salt. spoon over steak and feast

inputs: bourbon, honey, molasses, percent fruit orange marmalade, nonstick cooking spray, whole cloves
targets: title: bourbon honey glazed ham ingredients: 2/3 cup bourbon or whiskey 1 cup clover honey 1/3 cup molasses 1/2 cup 100 percent fruit orange marmalade nonstick cooking spray 1 5 pound whole bone in smoked ham, fully cooked, unsliced 1/8 cup whole cloves directions: preheat oven to 350 degrees f. in a medium saucepan, heat bourbon, honey, molasses, and marmalade over low heat for 15 minutes or until reduced by half, stirring occasionally. when measuring honey and molasses, spray measuring cup with nonstick cooking spray to keep measurements accurate. set aside. with a sharp knife, cut a diamond pattern on the fatty part of the ham. stud whole cloves in each diamond, at points where lines cross. spread half of the bourbon glaze over the ham and roast for 30 minutes, uncovered. baste occasionally with remaining glaze and continue to roast for another 15 minutes. let ham stand for 20 minutes before slicing.

inputs: fresh salmon, egg, whole wheat bread crumbs, garlic, pack, red onion, fresh arugula, avocado
targets: title: salmon gulf burgers recipe onhealthfood ingredients: 1 1/2 2 lbs. fresh salmon, skin removed 1 egg white 1/4 cup whole wheat bread crumbs 2 cloves garlic 1 tbsp. extra virgin olive oil 1 pack of whole wheat or whole grain hamburger buns slices of red onion fresh arugula 1 avocado 1 tsp. chipotle chili powder salt pepper 1 lemon directions: cut the raw salmon into small 1/2 inch cubes. put in a food processor and pulse a few times to get into smaller pieces. avoid overprocessing because you dont want it to turn into a paste. put the salmon in a big bowl and add the egg white, bread crumbs, and some salt and pepper. mix together with your hands and form burger patties. heat up your grill or stove top grill pan to medium heat and drizzle the olive oil on top. cook patties on a for about 4 minutes on each side until they are golden brown. as soon as they come off the grill, sprinkle fresh lemon juice about 1/2 lemon on top. set aside. mash up the avocado in a bowl and add the chipotle chili powder, a little salt, and a sprinkle of lemon juice. mix well. to make each burger, spread the chipotle avocado spread on one side of the hamburger bun and top with a handful of arugula, a few slices of red onion, one of the salmon burgers, and the other half of the bun. serve with a green vegetable, such as broccoli or asparagus. tip 1 if you dont own a food processor, just cut the salmon into smaller pieces. the egg and breadcrumbs should do their job of holding the burger together. also, if you dont have a grill or grill pan, you can certainly cook the burger patties in a deep saute pan. tip 2 for the buns, i managed to find sprouted grain buns in the refrigerated section of my health food store. do your best with what your local store has to offer, and remember to look for a list of simple ingredients. sometimes your best best is the fresh bread in the bakery.

inputs: unsweetened chocolate, flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt, eggs, sugar, salad oil, zucchini, walnuts
targets: title: chocolate nut zucchini cake ingredients: 3 sq. unsweetened chocolate 3 c. flour 1 1/2 tsp. baking powder 1 tsp. baking soda 1 tsp. salt 4 eggs 3 c. sugar 1 1/2 c. salad oil 3 c. finely grated zucchini 1 c. finely chopped walnuts directions: melt chocolate over hot, not boiling, water or in microwave. let cool. grease and flour 10 inch tube pan. sift flour, powder, soda and salt. set aside. beat eggs at high speed until thick and light. gradually add sugar, 1/4 cup at a time, beating well. add salad oil and cooled chocolate, beat until well blended. at low speed, add sifted dry ingredients, mixing until smooth. add grated zucchini and nuts with wooden spoon. stir until well combined. bake 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350 . cool in pan on wire rack for 15 minutes. remove from pan. cool thoroughly on wire rack. sprinkle with powdered sugar. freezes well and is delicious.

inputs: bacon, eggs, extra virgin olive oil, milk, black pepper
targets: title: danish side dish ingredients: 1 bunch asparagus 10 spears 4 slices un smoked streaky bacon 2 large eggs 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil 4 tablespoons milk black pepper directions: rinse the asparagus under cold running water and pat dry, cut off any woody stems. use the tablespoon of olive oil to grease an oven proof dish use a 6 x 4 dish that holds 3/4 pint of liquid. line the inside of the dish with the bacon to cover completely. lay the asparagus in the dish. whisk the eggs with the milk until frothy and pour the egg mixture over the asparagus. season with black pepper to taste, you won t need to salt as there s enough in the bacon. put into a pre heated oven gas mark 6/400 f 200 c. , middle shelf for about 30 minutes. when cooked, remove from oven and using oven gloves, put a small plate on top of the dish and carefully turn over. cut into 1 slices and divide between 4 plates, slightly overlap the slices.

inputs: strawberry cake, pineapple, bananas, eggs
targets: title: 1 2 3 banana split ice cream cake ingredients: 1 18 ounce box strawberry cake mix 2 cups pineapple sherbet 2 bananas 3 eggs directions: cream together sherbet, bananas, and eggs. mix in the cake mix and beat for approximately two minutes. pour batter into bundt pan sprayed with nonstick cooking spray. bake at 350f for 45 60 minutes until toothpick comes clean when inserted. other great combinations include . spice cake mix and butter pecan ice cream. chocolate cake mix and cookies cream ice cream. vanilla cake mix and orange sherbet.

inputs: chicken broth, chicken broth, oil, onions, leeks, marjoram, russet potatoes, low fat buttermilk, ground black pepper, ground cardamom, fresh white mushroom, carrot, potato
