celery to the pot. over medium heat saute the veggies in the bacon bits and fat until softened about 10 minutes. add the white wine to the pot, scrape up all the nice browned bits. let reduce for 3 5 minutes about half volume add the stock and bring to a boil. add the potatoes, tomatoes, lima beans, green beans, old bay, and worcestershire sauce. bring to a boil and reduce heat to medium. simmer for 20 minutes. add the corn and crab. simmer for another 10 minutes. taste for seasoning old bay is rather salty so i don t add any salt until this point. stir in parsley and serve with a big hunk of crusty bread and extra old bay for spiciness.

inputs: salsa, cilantro, lime zest, lime juice, red chili, brown sugar, ginger, papaya, bass, limes, juice, fish sauce, brown sugar, green onions, bass, cilantro, jasmine rice
targets: title: sea bass with papaya salsa ingredients: salsa papaya 4 tablespoons cilantro leaves fresh, chopped 2 teaspoons lime zest 1 tablespoon lime juice 1 fresh red chili small, seeded, chopped 2 teaspoons brown sugar 1 teaspoon fresh ginger grated 1/2 pound papaya seeded, chopped sea bass 3 limes 1/4 cup juice 2 teaspoons fish sauce 1 teaspoon brown sugar 2 green onions sliced 2 1/2 pounds sea bass gutted, scaled 4 sprigs fresh cilantro jasmine rice steamed, to serve directions: to make the papaya salsa, combine all ingredients in a medium bowl. cover and chill while preparing the fish. whisk together 2 tbsp lime juice, fish sauce, sugar and green onions. set aside. preheat grill plate. make 2 long cuts, about 1/3 inch deep, in thickest part of flesh on each side of fish. drizzle with 4 tbsp lime juice then stuff with lime quarters and cilantro sprigs. cook fish over low heat for 8 mins per side, or until cooked to your liking. transfer fish to a serving platter and drizzle with lime vinaigrette. serve with papaya salsa and steamed jasmine rice.

inputs: ghee, chicken, garam masala, salt, onions, carrots, celery, garlic, ginger, apples, gold potatoes, sweet potatoes, red lentils, chicken, freshly ground black pepper, zucchini, yellow squash, tightly packed baby spinach, unsweetened coconut milk, tomatoes, apple cider vinegar, steamed white basmati rice, cashews, cilantro
targets: title: emeril s mulligatawny soup ingredients: 4 tablespoons ghee or clarified butter 1 1/2 pounds diced boneless, skinless chicken thighs 2 tablespoons garam masala 1 3/4 teaspoons salt 2 cups small diced onions 1/2 cup small diced carrots 1/2 cup small diced celery 2 tablespoons minced garlic 2 tablespoons minced ginger 2 cups peeled, cored and diced granny smith apples 1 cup peeled and diced yukon gold potatoes 1 cup peeled and diced sweet potatoes 1 cup dried red lentils 6 cups chicken or beef stock 3/4 teaspoons freshly ground black pepper 3/4 cup diced zucchini 3/4 cup diced yellow squash 1 cup tightly packed baby spinach 1 14 ounce can unsweetened coconut milk 1 cup peeled, seeded and chopped tomatoes 1 tablespoon apple cider vinegar 3 cups steamed white basmati rice 1/2 cup toasted, finely ground cashews 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro leaves directions: set a 4 or 5 quart saucepan over medium heat and add the ghee. while the ghee is heating, season the chicken with the garam masala and 1/4 teaspoon of the salt. once the ghee is hot, add the chicken and cook, turning often, until golden brown and fragrant, 6 to 8 minutes. transfer the chicken to a plate and set aside to cool. while the chicken is cooling, add the onions, carrots and celery to the hot pan and saute until lightly caramelized, about 4 to 5 minutes. add the garlic, ginger and apples to the pan and saute until the apples are caramelized, about 7 to 8 minutes. add the potatoes, sweet potatoes, and lentils to the pan, along with 4 cups of the chicken stock. raise the heat to high and bring to a boil. reduce to a simmer and cook the soup until the potatoes are tender, about 10 minutes. add the reserved chicken, the remaining 1 1/2 teaspoons salt, the pepper, remaining 2 cups of chicken stock, zucchini, squash, spinach, coconut milk, and tomatoes. continue to cook the soup at a simmer until the lentils and chicken are both tender, 10 to 15 minutes longer. remove from the heat and stir in the cider vinegar. taste and adjust seasoning, if necessary. to serve the soup, place 1/4 cup of the rice in a warmed bowl, and pour 8 ounces of the soup over the rice, garnish with a tablespoon of the cashews, and 2 teaspoons of the cilantro.

inputs: chicken breasts halves, brown onions, garlic, t, generous, lemon, salt
targets: title: easy, easy saffron chicken recipe vickib ingredients: 4 chicken breasts halves, with skin and bone 2 medium brown onions, sliced thin 2 3 cloves garlic, minced 2 t olive oil 1 generous pinch saffron juice from one lemon salt and pepper, to taste directions: preheat the oven to 450 degrees. a well seasoned cast iron skillet is my preferred pan, but a casserole works as well. put 1 t. oil in the bottom of pan, and then layer in the onions. lay the chicken on top of the onions. salt and pepper. sprinkle the garlic over the chicken, and then the saffron. drizzle with remaining olive oil. bake until brown, and chicken is cooked through. in a convection oven with cast iron, about 30 min. with a glass dish, about 45. squeeze the lemon over the skillet. let rest for 5 min. before serving.

inputs: corn bread, bread crumbs, celery, onion, campbell s cream, pan sausage, turkey giblets, celery, salt
targets: title: corn bread dressing ingredients: 3 c. corn bread 3 c. toasted bread crumbs 1/2 c. chopped celery 1/2 c. chopped onion 1 can campbell s cream of chicken soup optional 1 lb. pan sausage turkey giblets 1 tbsp. chopped celery salt, pepper and poultry seasoning directions: cover giblets with water boil until tender. remove from broth and cool. chop giblets, celery, onions and sausage. add to broth and cook until done. add more water if needed. crumble corn bread and bread crumbs. mix all ingredients in large bowl and season to taste using salt, pepper and poultry seasoning. add chopped parsley. if mixture is too dry, add cream of chicken soup. stuff in turkey or bake separately in greased dish at 375 for 45 to 60 minutes.

inputs: milk, shortening, salt, flour, sugar, nutmeg, eggs, flour
targets: title: fastnachts dutch raised ingredients: 2 1/2 c. milk 1/2 c. shortening 2 tsp. salt 5 1/3 c. flour 1 1/2 c. sugar 1/2 tsp. nutmeg 6 beaten eggs additional 4 to 5 c. flour directions: scald milk add shortening and salt. cool to lukewarm, then add 2 yeast cakes and stir. add flour gradually, beating well after each addition. cover with towel put in warm place until full of bubbles. mix sugar and nutmeg. combine with beaten eggs. stir into first mix when ready an additional 4 to 5 cups flour. knead well. cover and let rise for about 1 hour in a warm moist place. when light and high, with floured hands, pull and roll to 1 inch thick. cut with a round can and a thimble to make a doughnut shape. place on cookie sheets in warm place, covered, until all are cut. fry in hot fat at 365 . turn so both sides gently brown. sugar or frost, then enjoy.

inputs: sugar, honey, egg, ground cinnamon, ground cloves, ground ginger, salt, baking soda, water, flour, almonds
targets: title: hard honey cookies ingredients: 1 cup sugar 1/2 cup honey 1 egg 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon 1/2 teaspoon ground cloves 1/4 teaspoon ground ginger dash of salt 1/42 teaspoon baking soda 1 tablespoon water 2 1/4 cups all purpose flour 1/2 cup slivered almonds directions: combine sugar and honey in a large mixing bowl, beating well. add egg, cinnamon, cloves, ginger, and salt beat well. dissolve soda in water add to honey mixture, stirring well. stir in flour and almonds. press dough evenly into a greased and floured 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking pan. bake at 350 for 20 to 25 minutes. cut into 3 x 1 inch bars. remove cookies to wire racks to cool completely. note cookies may be stored 3 to 4 weeks in a cake tin with an apple to mellow.

inputs: canola oil, onion, garlic, cannellini beans, kosher salt, bagged prewashed spinach, tomato, onion, fresh cilantro, lime juice, pepper, corn tortillas, queso fresco
targets: title: white bean and spinach tacos ingredients: 1 tablespoon canola oil 1 1/2 cups vertically sliced onion 4 garlic cloves, chopped 1 15 ounce can cannellini beans, rinsed and drained 3/8 teaspoon kosher salt, divided 8 cups bagged prewashed spinach about 5 1/2 ounces 1 1/2 cups chopped tomato 1/2 cup finely chopped onion 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro 1 tablespoon fresh lime juice 1 sliced jalapeno pepper 12 corn tortillas 2 ounces queso fresco, crumbled about 1/2 cup directions: heat a large skillet over medium high heat. add oil to pan swirl to coat. add sliced onion, and saute 5 minutes or until lightly browned, stirring occasionally. add garlic to pan saute 30 seconds. stir in beans and 1/4 teaspoon salt cook 1 minute. add spinach to pan cook 1 minute or until spinach wilts and beans are thoroughly heated. combine tomato, chopped onion, cilantro, lime juice, 1/8 teaspoon salt, and jalapeno in a small bowl. warm tortillas according to package directions. arrange 1/3 cup bean mixture in center of each tortilla. top each taco with 3 tablespoons tomato mixture and about 1 tablespoon cheese. myrecipes is working with , the partnership for a healthier america, and usda s myplate to give anyone looking for healthier options access to a trove of recipes that will help them create healthy, tasty plates. for more information about creating a healthy plate, visit .

inputs: cake flour, baking powder, salt, unsalted butter, eggs, egg yolk, sugar, vanilla, lemon zest
targets: title: madeleines, buttery french teacake cookies ingredients: 1 1/2 cups sifted cake flour 1/2 teaspoon baking powder 1/4 teaspoon salt 12 tablespoons unsalted butter, cut into small pieces 3 large eggs 1 large egg yolk 3/4 cup sugar 1 1/2 teaspoons vanilla extract 1 teaspoon lemon zest optional directions: have all ingredients at room temperature, 68 to 70 f preheat the oven to 450 f using melted butter, generously grease 2 madeleine pans, each with 12 molds. sift together cake flour, baking powder and salt and return to the sifter. in a medium bowl, mash and beat the butter with a wooden spoon or rubber spatula until very soft and creamy. warm the bowl by dipping it into hot water if necessary to hasten the softening of the butter. in a large bowl, beat the eggs, egg yolk, sugar, vanilla extract and optional lemon zest on high speed until thick and pale yellow, about 2 minutes. sift the flour mixture over the top and fold in with a rubber spatula. fold a dollop of the egg mixture into the butter. scrape the butter mixture back into the remaining egg mixture and fold together. let rest for at least 30 minutes. fill the molds three quarters full set any remaining batter aside. bake unit the cakes are golden on the top and golden brown around the edges, 8 to 10 minutes. immediately loosen each cake with the tip of a slim knife and unmold onto a rack to cool. if necessary, wipe the molds clean, let cool, rebutter them, and repeat the baking process with the remaining batter. these are best the day they are made, but can be stored in an airtight container for a day or two. notes. i have to lower the oven temperature to about 385 and reduce the baking time to 7 minutes or they burn. this can vary according to your oven, pans and how much batter you dollop into each mold. i add the zest of one lemon to the egg/sugar batter while mixing.

inputs: heavy cream, mint, white chocolate chips, chocolate chips, chocolate, chocolate chips, bittersweet chocolate chips, unsalted butter, heavy cream, water, orange liqueur
targets: title: minted white and dark chocolate terrine ingredients: 3 cups heavy cream 2/3 cup finely chopped mint 8 ounces white chocolate chips 8 ounces semisweet chocolate chips chocolate fudge sauce, recipe follows 1/2 cup semisweet chocolate chips 1/2 cup bittersweet chocolate chips 1 tablespoon unsalted butter 1/2 cup heavy cream 2 tablespoons water 2 tablespoons orange liqueur directions: in a saucepan combine 1 1/2 cups of the cream and the mint and bring to a boil. remove from the heat and let cream infuse for at least 1 hour and up to 2 hours. place white chocolate chips in a large bowl and return mint infused cream to a boil. strain hot cream through a fine sieve into the bowl containing the white chocolate. let sit for 1 minute, then whisk until smooth. transfer to the refrigerator to cool, stirring occasionally. place semisweet chocolate chips in another bowl and heat remaining cream in a saucepan to a boil. pour over semisweet chocolate and let sit for one minute, then whisk, or stir, until smooth and thick. transfer to the refrigerator and stir occasionally until thoroughly chilled. when both mixtures are cold and thickened, beat with an electric mixer to soft peaks, then beat the last few strokes by hand with a whisk until thick and firm. be careful not to over whisk, or mixture will become grainy. line an 8 by 4 inch bread pan or terrine mold with aluminum foil, smoothing to remove as many wrinkles as possible. using a spatula, place an even layer of the dark chocolate ganache on the bottom of the prepared terrine mold, using about one quarter of the entire volume. place the terrine in the freezer for 5 to 10 minutes, until the layer of ganache is firm. top the first layer with a layer of the white chocolate ganache, using about one third of the entire volume. chill until firm, then repeat with remaining white and dark chocolate ganaches, alternating layers of each mixture. when terrine is completely assembled, cover and refrigerate at least 3 hours or overnight before unmolding. remove terrine by pulling overhanging aluminum foil out of the mold. carefully peel aluminum foil off the terrine, then slice using a warm, damp knife. serve with chocolate fudge sauce. in the top of a double boiler, melt chocolate chips and butter over simmering water. when chocolate begins to melt, whisk in heavy cream and water. remove from heat when smooth, and stir in the orange liqueur. serve sauce either warm or at room temperature. yield 8 to 10 servings

inputs: irish potatoes, cheddar cheese, sour cream, margarine, crisply cooked bacon, salt
targets: title: hoedown taters ingredients: 6 hot baked irish potatoes 2 c. 8 oz. shredded kraft sharp cheddar cheese 1 c. dairy sour cream 1/4 c. margarine 6 crisply cooked bacon slices salt and pepper directions: slice potatoes in half lengthwise. scoop out centers leaving 1/8 inch shell. combine potatoes, cheese, sour cream and margarine. mix until blended. stir in bacon. season with salt and pepper. fill shells. place on a cookie sheet. bake at 350 for 20 to 25 minutes.

inputs: sugar, oleo, shortening, egg, anise, flour, baking powder, salt
targets: title: mexican cookies ingredients: 1/2 c. sugar 1/4 c. oleo 1/2 stick 2 tbsp. shortening 1 egg 1 tsp. anise 1 1/4 c. flour 1/2 tsp. baking powder 1/2 tsp. salt directions: beat sugar, oleo, shortening, egg and anise together. stir in flour, baking powder and salt. mix until smooth. cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour. roll dough and cut with cookie cutters. sprinkle with colored sugar. bake on greased cookie sheet at 400 for 6 minutes.

inputs: butter, cornmeal, all purpose, sugar, salt, baking powder, eggs, milk, buttermilk
targets: title: custard cornbread ingredients: 2 tbsp. butter 1 1/3 c. cornmeal 1/3 c. all purpose flour 1/4 c. sugar 1 1/2 tsp. salt 1 tsp. baking powder 2 eggs 2 c. milk, divided 1 c. buttermilk directions: preheat oven to 400 . place butter in a 9 inch skillet and heat in the oven. place dry ingredients into a large bowl. add eggs, one cup of milk and buttermilk and mix. pour into hot skillet. very slowly, pour last cup of milk over the top of the batter. do not stir. bake for 50 to 55 minutes.

inputs: italian dressing, onion, garlic, ground annatto, green pepper, tomatoes, ham, cilantro, chicken breasts
targets: title: sofrito chicken ingredients: 1/4 cup kraft zesty italian dressing 1 medium onion, chopped 2 cloves garlic, minced 2 tsp. ground annatto 1 medium green pepper, chopped 1 can 14 1/2 oz. diced tomatoes, undrained 3 oz. oscar mayer ham, any variety, finely chopped 1 cup chopped cilantro 6 small boneless skinless chicken breasts 1 1/2 lb. directions: heat dressing, onions, garlic and annatto in large skillet on medium high heat 2 min. add peppers, tomatoes, ham and cilantro cook 5 min., stirring constantly. reduce heat to medium. place chicken on tomato mixture press lightly. cook 10 min. carefully turn chicken over so that tomato mixture sticks to chicken cover. cook 15 min. or until chicken is cooked through 170f .

inputs: carrot, green apple, sultana, dried apricot, water, apple juice, sugar, cinnamon, flour, bananas
targets: title: low fat carrot and fruit loaf ingredients: 1 cup grated carrot 1 green apple, peeled, diced 3/4 cup sultana 1/2 cup dried apricot, diced 3/4 cup water 3/4 cup apple juice or 3/4 cup orange juice 1/2 cup raw sugar 1 teaspoon cinnamon 1 1/2 cups self raising flour 2 bananas, sliced directions: place carrot, apple, dried fruit, water, juice, sugar and cinnamon in pot. bring to the boil, simmer 15 minutes. set aside to cool. fold in sifted flours and bananas. spoon mixture into greased loaf tin 10 x 20 cms. bake 180 c for 50 60 minutes or until cooked when tested. turn onto wire rack to cool. slice and serve with butter.

inputs: pepper, white wine, onion soup, olive oil
targets: title: eye of round roast ingredients: 3 lbs eye of round roast trimmed of all fat pepper 1 cup dry white wine 1 1 1/4 ounce package dry onion soup mix 1 teaspoon olive oil directions: pepper roast and brown on all sides in 1 t olive oil. remove roast and place in aluminum foil in roasting dish. add onion soup mix and 1 cup white wine to skillet with roast dripping and bring to boil. scrape up any brown bits from bottom of skillet. pour mixture over roast. seal roast completely in aluminum foil. bake at 350 degrees for 2.5 3 hours. remove, open packet and let rest for 15 minutes. slice and serve with gravy.

inputs: cake mix, flaked coconut, butter, apples, water, lemon juice
targets: title: apple custard dessert ingredients: 1 18 ounce boxduncan hines moist yellow cake mix 1 cup flaked coconut 12 cup butter, softened 6 medium apples, peeled and thinly sliced 1 cup water 14 cup lemon juice directions: preheat oven to 350. grease and flour a 13 x9 x2 baking dish i use bakers joy spray . combine cake mix and coconut in large bowl. cut in butter with a pastry knife. put sliced apples in prepared baking dish and spread evenly. sprinkle with crumb mixture. combine water and lemon juice in a 2 cup measure. pour evenly over top top. do not stir. bake at 350 degrees for 45 50 minutes or until is lightly browned and set. cool slightly before serving.

inputs: dressing, onion soup, cranberry sauce, chicken breasts
targets: title: easy chicken ingredients: 1 small bottle french lite dressing 1 pkg. lipton onion soup 1 can whole cranberry sauce boneless chicken breasts directions: place chicken breasts in bottom of a 9 x 13 inch pan. mix the first 3 ingredients together and pour over chicken breasts. bake at 350 for 45 minutes or until done.

inputs: flour, kosher salt, heavy cream, sugar, pints, unsalted butter
targets: title: cream biscuits with sugared strawberries ingredients: 2 1/2 cups self rising flour see know how, below pinch of kosher salt 1 1/2 cups heavy cream, plus more for brushing on the biscuits 1/4 cup sugar less if the strawberries are really sweet , plus more for sprinkling on the biscuits 2 pints about 4 cups ripe strawberries, hulled and sliced 2 tablespoons unsalted butter, cut into slices directions: preheat the oven to 450f. lightly grease a baking sheet. place the flour and salt in a large bowl and stir to mix. add the cream and stir to mix just until the flour is moist. turn the dough onto a lightly floured surface and knead three or four times, just until it comes together, and form into a flat disk. using a lightly floured rolling pin or your hands, roll or pat the dough about 1/2 inch thick. lightly flour a 2 to 2 1/2 inch biscuit cutter and cut the biscuits, leaving as little space between each cut as possible and pressing down just once for each biscuit do not twist the cutter. if the dough begins to stick to the cutter, dip the cutter in a little flour. gather the excess biscuit dough, reroll once, and cut as many biscuits from it as possible. arrange the biscuits on the prepared baking sheet. brush the tops with cream, sprinkle with sugar, and bake until golden brown, 10 to 12 minutes. while the biscuits are baking, combine the strawberries and remaining 1/4 cup of the sugar in a bowl and mash lightly with a fork or your hand to release some of the juices. remove the biscuits from the oven, split in half, and place a pat of butter in the middle, allowing the butter to melt. spoon the strawberries over and serve warm. if you dont have self rising flour in your pantry, you can still avoid a trip to the store by making your own. add 2 teaspoons baking powder or 1 1/2 teaspoons baking powder plus 1/2 teaspoon baking soda to every 3 cups of all purpose flour. if the recipe does not call for salt, add 1/2 teaspoon to the mix as well.

inputs: sugar, shortening, eggs, milk, salt, vanilla, baking powder, flour, ground nuts
targets: title: grandma s nut cake ingredients: 2 c. sugar 1 c. shortening 4 to 5 eggs 1 c. milk pinch of salt 1 tsp. vanilla 3 tsp. baking powder 3 c. flour 1 c. ground nuts directions: beat sugar and shortening add eggs one at a time. slowly blend in milk. mix dry ingredients and add to batter. stir in vanilla and nuts. bake at 350 for at least 1 hour and 20 minutes in bundt or angel food cake pan. may be glazed with icing.

inputs: sugar, margarine, carnation milk, salt, vanilla, semi sweet chocolate chips
targets: title: foolproof fudge ingredients: 5 c. sugar 2 sticks margarine 1 large can carnation milk 1/2 tsp. salt 2 tsp. vanilla 1 12 oz. pkg. semi sweet chocolate chips directions: bring sugar, margarine, milk and salt to a boil. boil for 6 minutes. remove from heat add vanilla and chocolate chips. beat until chips are dissolved. add nuts, if desired. pour into glass pie plate or bowls. makes 3 pounds.

inputs: sugar, strawberry jello, cornstarch, water, strawberries
targets: title: fresh strawberry pie ingredients: 1 c. sugar 3 tbsp. strawberry jello 3 tbsp. cornstarch 1 c. water 1 pt. strawberries directions: combine all ingredients together, except strawberries. bring ingredients to boil and boil for 1 minute. cool completely. add 1 pint sliced strawberries. bananas or peaches may be used, if preferred. place entire mixture in previously baked and cooled pie shell. top with whipped cream.

inputs: white bread, broccoli, cheddar cheese, eggs, milk, worcestershire sauce, dry mustard, salt, onion, bacon
targets: title: cheddar broccoli strata ingredients: 5 c. white bread no crusts , cubed 3 c. broccoli florets and stems 2 c. extra sharp cheddar cheese 5 eggs, beaten 2 1/2 c. milk 1 tsp. worcestershire sauce 1/2 tsp. dry mustard 1/2 tsp. salt 1 medium onion, chopped 1 1/4 c. 4 to 6 slices bacon directions: butter baking dish spread half of bread cubes on bottom. alternate layers of broccoli, cheese and bread ending with cheese. in bowl combine eggs, milk, worcestershire sauce, mustard, salt and onion. pour mixture over other ingredients. cover and refrigerate for 6 hours or overnight.

inputs: apple cider, lemon juice, lemon, sugar, light molasses, cinnamon stick, cloves, whole allspice, orange, cinnamon sticks
targets: title: mulled cider ingredients: 6 c. apple cider or juice 1/4 c. lemon juice 1 lemon 8 slices 2 tbsp. sugar 2 tbsp. light molasses 1 4 to 6 inch cinnamon stick 8 whole cloves 1/4 tsp. whole allspice 1 orange 8 slices cinnamon sticks for garnish optional directions: put cider, lemon juice, lemon slices, sugar, molasses, cinnamon stick, cloves and allspice in medium saucepan. bring to a boil over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until sugar dissolves. reduce heat to low and simmer 5 minutes.

inputs: ground cinnamon, ground cumin, salt, ground ginger, ground mustard, ground nutmeg, cayenne pepper, ground allspice, white sugar, salmon, lime juice, yogurt
targets: title: moroccan spiced salmon served cold ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin 1/4 teaspoon sea salt 1/4 teaspoon ground ginger 1/8 teaspoon ground mustard 1/8 teaspoon ground nutmeg 1/8 teaspoon cayenne pepper 1/8 teaspoon ground allspice 1 1 1/4 teaspoon white sugar 1 1/4 lbs salmon fillets, 1 inch thick 2 teaspoons fresh lime juice plain yogurt directions: combine all ingredients except salmon and lime juice. line a baking sheet with foil. rinse salmon with cold water and pat dry. place skin side down on foil. sprinkle with rub. allow salmon to sit at room temperature for 30 minutes. preheat oven to 450 f sprinkle salmon with lime juice. roast in oven for 12 minutes. remove from oven and let sit for 15 minutes. wrap tightly in foil and refrigerate at least 2 hours before serving. serve with yogurt, if wanted.

inputs: bananas, cake mix, water, eggs, bananas, raisins, almonds slivered, powdered sugar, lemon juice
targets: title: banana gingerbread bars ingredients: 1 each bananas extra ripe 1 package cake mix, gingerbread 14 1/2 ounces 1/2 cup water lukewarm 1 each eggs 1 each bananas peeled, chopped 1/2 cup raisins, seedless 1/2 cup almonds slivered 1/2 cup powdered sugar 1 x lemon juice of one lemon directions: place medium banana in blender. process until pureed, use 1/2 cup fo recipe. combine gingerbread mix, water, 1/2 cup pureed banana and egg in large bowl. beat well. stir in chopped banana, raisins and almonds. spread batter in greased 13x9 inch baking pan. bake in 350f 180c oven 20 to 25 minutes until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. mix powdered sugar and 3 tablespoons lemon juice in medium bowl to make thin glaze. spread over warm gingerbread. cool. cut into bars. sprinkle with additional powdered sugar if desired. makes 32 bars.

inputs: flour, baking powder, salt, shortening, milk, egg
targets: title: feathery light dumplings ingredients: 1 c. flour 1 1/2 tsp. baking powder 1/2 tsp. salt 2 tbsp. shortening crisco 1/3 c. milk 1 egg, beaten directions: sift dry ingredients, cut in shortening. add milk and egg. drop by spoonful on top of boiling meat and juices i use ham . cover tightly and steam 12 minutes without removing cover. makes 6 fluffy dumplings.

inputs: cream cheese, pizza sauce, onion, pizza cheese, pepperoni
targets: title: pizza dip ingredients: 8 oz. cream cheese 14 oz. jar pizza sauce minced onion 2 cups pizza cheese 25 30 slices pepperoni, quartered directions: in 10 inch pie plate, spread cream cheese on bottom. pour pizza sauce over cream cheese. sprinkle with onion. sprinkle with cheese. top with diced pepperoni. add sliced black olives, green onion, sausage, etc. if desired. bake for 25 minutes at 350 or until cheese is bubbly. serve with frito lay scoops.

inputs: roma tomatoes, white onion, garlic, cilantro, salt, white pepper, oregano, serrano peppers, pepper, lime
targets: title: the best salsa ingredients: 12 roma tomatoes 12 large white onion 4 garlic cloves 1 bunch cilantro 1 tablespoon sea salt 12 teaspoon white pepper 14 teaspoon mexican oregano 4 serrano peppers 1 jalapeno pepper 12 lime, juice of directions: roast the 4 serrano peppers on your grill or oven at 350f until they start to blacken and set aside. cut 1/2 of a large white onion into slices and then dice and put in a large mixing bowl. using a garlic press, mince 4 large cloves of garlic and add to the mixing bowl. wash the roma tomatoes and cut each tomato into slices 1/4 thick and then dice each slice and place into mixing bowl. pull the leaves off of the bunch of cilantro and be careful not to include the stems. chop up the cilantro and place in the mixing bowl. next, cut the stems off the serrano peppers and then dice each serrano and add to mixing bowl. now dice the uncooked jalapeno pepper and add to the mixing bowl. cut one lime in half and squeeze all the lime juice from the lime half into the bowl. add the tbs of sea salt, 1/2 tsp of white pepper, and 1/4 tsp of mexican oregano. mix well with a large spoon. next, spoon the now chunky salsa into a blender. very slowly, pulse the blender until you see the color change from vibrant red to a pale red. you are not trying to puree the salsa, you still want to have some small chunks of tomatoes. pour the salsa into a clean bowl and cover and refrigerate until chilled. unlike recipes for salsa that you have seen where it states that the salsa must sit in the refrigerator over night for the salsa to gain enough flavor to eat, the opposite is true here. this salsa will be at the peak of its freshness and flavor on the day you make it. recipes that call for canned tomatoes and tomato juice need all the help they can get in the flavor department which is why they usually call for the 24 hours in the refrigerator rule.

inputs: baking potatoes, butter, cream of chicken soup, parmesan cheese, fresh parsley, chicken
targets: title: chicken in a shell ingredients: 6 baking potatoes 2 tbsp. butter or margarine 1 can cream of chicken soup 1 c. parmesan cheese, grated 3 tbsp. fresh parsley, chopped 1 1/2 c. cooked chicken, cubed directions: bake potatoes until done. cut in half lengthwise. scoop out insides of potatoes and reserve, leaving a thin shell. mash potatoes with butter. add 1/2 cup cheese and remaining ingredients. spoon into potato shells. sprinkle with remaining cheese. arrange potatoes in shallow 3 quart baking dish. bake at 375 for 15 minutes.

inputs: margarine, peanut butter, chocolate chips, rice, powdered sugar
targets: title: puppy chow snack ingredients: 1 stick margarine 1 c. creamy peanut butter 1 c. chocolate chips 8 c. rice chex, corn chex or crispix or mix the cereals 2 1/2 c. powdered sugar directions: melt together the first 3 ingredients. add and stir in the cereal. shake the mixture with the powdered sugar in a large container with a tight lid until cereal mixture is well coated.

inputs: pork shoulder bone, onion, garlic, oregano, cumin seeds, salt, black peppercorns, bay leaves, lard, orange grated, lemon grated, orange bitter
targets: title: roast pork shoulder caribbean style ingredients: 5 pounds pork shoulder bone in 1 onion medium, thickly sliced 1 head garlic peeled 2 tablespoons oregano 2 teaspoons cumin seeds 2 teaspoons salt 1 teaspoon black peppercorns 2 bay leaves 1 tablespoon lard or oil 1 orange grated 1 lemon grated 1 orange bitter directions: using a sharp knife make several shallow cuts about 1/2 inch deep in the pork, place in a glass or ceramic roasting pan. spread the onion slices on the bottom of the pan. place the rest of the ingredients a in a food processor or blender and process to make a paste. rub the pork with the mixture on all sides, making sure it goes into the cuts. place pork on top of the onions. cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for about 4 hours, turning once, leaving the fat side up for cooking. preheat the oven to 450 degrees f. place the pork in the middle rack of the oven. after 30 minutes turn down the temperature to 325 degrees and cook an additional 2 hours, basting every 30 minutes or so with its own juices. cook 30 minutes per pound total, or until the internal temperature as measured with a meat thermometer is 160 degrees f. remove the pork from the oven and allow to rest 15 minutes before carving, discard onions.

inputs: balsamic vinegar, sugar, watermelon, feta cheese, mint leaves
targets: title: watermelon with balsamic and feta ingredients: 1/4 cup good quality balsamic vinegar 1 tablespoon sugar 8 roughly 4 by 2 inch pieces seedless watermelon 4 ounces feta cheese, crumbled 2 tablespoons shredded mint leaves directions: in a small saucepan, whisk together the balsamic vinegar and sugar. cook over medium heat until reduced by half and syrupy, about 4 minutes. stack 2 pieces of watermelon on each plate and drizzle with the balsamic reduction. sprinkle with feta cheese and mint and serve.

inputs: whole wheat flour, flour, zero, granola cereal, parkay margarine, egg, orange juice
targets: title: breakfast cookies ingredients: 12 cup whole wheat flour 34 cup all purpose flour 9 pkts.equal flavored artificial sweetener i use truvia zero calorie, natural sweetener 23 cup granola cereal 12 cup parkay margarine softened 1 egg 2 tablespoons frozen orange juice concentrate 1 tablespoon grated orange peel directions: preheat oven to 350f. in large mixing bowl slowly mix the ingredients together in the order listed. stir until well blended. drop by level tablespoons, 2 inches apart onto parchment lined cookie sheet. gently flatten with either a fork, bottom of a cup or your hand. bake 10 14 minutes, or until golden. remove from oven to wire rack to cool. store in air tight container.

inputs: bars, semi sweet chocolate chips, nuts, sugar, oleo, pet milk, marshmallow cream
targets: title: million dollar fudge ingredients: 10 small or 2 large hershey bars 2 pkg. semi sweet chocolate chips small 2 c. nuts, chopped 4 1/2 c. sugar 1 tbsp. oleo 1 large can pet milk 1 pt. marshmallow cream directions: thoroughly mix the sugar, milk and butter. bring to a boil and boil 5 minutes, no longer, stirring constantly. have hershey bars broken up and everything ready to put in. put chocolate chips in first, then stir in hershey and then marshmallow creme. add nuts last. pour batter into buttered pan.

inputs: red wine, ginger ale, lime
targets: title: red wine punch ingredients: 1 750 ml bottle red wine i like shiraz 1 1 liter bottle margarita mix i like jose cuervo 1 2 quart bottle ginger ale 1 lime directions: mix the first 3 ingredients together, using equal amounts of each. put in the fridge to chill. if making punch freeze some of the leftover ginger ale to use as an ice ring in the punch bowl. if using ice ring put it in the punch bowl. pour punch into bowl. squeeze half the lime over top of the punch. may slice and float lime slices in bowl if desired.

inputs: cucumbers, sugar, white vinegar, pickling salt, celery, turmeric
targets: title: icebox pickles ingredients: cucumbers enough to fill a gal. jar , slice and pack in jar 4 c. sugar 4 c. white vinegar 1/2 c. pickling salt 1 1/2 tsp. celery seed 1 1/2 tsp. mustard seed 1 1/2 tsp. turmeric directions: mix good and pour over packed pickles in gallon jar. no cooking, so make sure sugar is dissolved and solution is mixed well. sliced onion may be used, 2 or 3. pimentos can be added, if desired. store in refrigerator for at least 10 days before using.

inputs: cooking spray, crescent rolls, peanut butter, asian pear, ground cinnamon, cheddar cheese
targets: title: pear pockets ingredients: cooking spray 1 8 ounce package refrigerated crescent rolls 1/4 cup peanut butter, divided 1 asian pear, chopped divided 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon, divided 1/2 cup shredded cheddar cheese, divided directions: preheat oven to 375 degrees f 190 degrees c . spray a baking sheet with cooking spray. combine two crescent roll triangles by overlapping the seams, creating a square. repeat with remaining dough to form 4 squares total. spread 1 tablespoon peanut butter in the center of each square top each with pieces of asian pear. sprinkle 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon atop pear slices top with cheddar cheese. fold one corner of a square over to completely cover the fillings, creating a triangle seal the edges together. repeat with remaining squares. arrange pear pockets on the prepared baking sheet. bake on the preheated oven until dough is lightly browned, 10 to 15 minutes.

inputs: flour, egg, beer, salt, milk
targets: title: neptune s beer batter ingredients: 1 c. flour 1 egg, separated 1/4 c. plus 1 tbsp. beer 1/4 tsp. salt 3 tbsp. milk directions: measure the flour into a bowl. make a well in the flour add the egg yolk, beer and salt. stir until well blended. gradually add milk stir until smooth. fold in stiffly beaten egg white. makes enough to coat 1 pound of fish.

inputs: white cake mix, strawberry jello, oil, mashed strawberries, milk, eggs
targets: title: strawberry cake ingredients: 1 box white cake mix 1 4 oz. box strawberry jello 1 c. oil 1/2 c. mashed strawberries sweet 1/2 c. milk 4 eggs directions: mix together cake mix and jello. add oil, strawberries, milk and eggs. bake at 350 about 25 minutes.

inputs: nuts, walnuts, dates, candied pineapple, red maraschino cherries, white raisins, sugar, eggs, flour, vanilla
targets: title: nanny s fruit cake ingredients: 1 1/2 c. brazil nuts whole 1 1/2 c. walnuts whole 1 7 oz. pkg. pitted dates whole 1/2 c. candied pineapple 1 c. red maraschino cherries whole and 1/2 c. green 1/2 c. white raisins 3/4 c. sugar 3 eggs 3/4 c. flour 1 tsp. vanilla directions: grease a loaf pan. line with wax paper and grease again. place fruit and nuts in large bowl. sift flour and sugar over fruit. add beaten eggs with vanilla mix well. pack in pan. bake for 1 1/2 hours at 250 . use foil over top, if needed the last 30 minutes. let cool 10 minutes in pan. remove from pan. remove wax paper. place in tinfoil and store in fridge. slice very thin to serve.

inputs: granny smith apples, walnut halves, raisins, all purpose, sugar, ground cinnamon, buttermilk, buttermilk, margarine, cream
targets: title: crisscross apple crowns pampered chef copycat ingredients: 4 small granny smith apples 1/2 cup walnut halves, chopped 1/2 cup raisins 3 tablespoons all purpose flour 3/4 cup sugar, divided 1 tablespoon ground cinnamon, divided 1 17 1/3 ounce package pillsbury grands refrigerated buttermilk biscuits or butter milk 8 biscuits 1 10 1/4 ounce package pillsbury grands refrigerated buttermilk biscuits or buttermilk 5 biscuits 1 tablespoon margarine, melted or 1 tablespoon butter ice cream optional directions: preheat oven to 350 f. peel, core and slice apples. cut apple slices into wedges. chop walnuts. place apples, walnuts, raisins, flour, 1/4 cup of the sugar and 1 teaspoons of the cinnamon in a bowl. mix well. microwave apple mixture on high 3 minutes or until hot mix well. separate 12 biscuits. you may discard the remaining or set aside for another use. using a rolling pin or round glass jar , roll each biscuit into a 5 circle. combine remaining sugar and remaining cinnamon in a bowl. sprinkle the sugar/cinnamon mix evenly over the biscuits. divide apple mixture evenly onto center of each biscuit. gather up the edges over the filling, pinching lightly to seal. melt butter in microwave on high 20 seconds, or until melted. holding filled biscuits at the sealed end, dip each biscuit into butter, then into remaining cinnamon/sugar mixute in bowl. place the biscuits, seam side down, into a muffin pan. cut an x pattern crisscross through the top of each biscuit. bake 25 30 minutes or until golden brown. remove from pan. serve with icre cream if you would like enjoy

inputs: filling, cranberries, cranberry juice, frozen rhubarb, sugar, tapioca, cinnamon, salt, coloring, topping , rolled oats, whole wheat flour, all purpose unbleached white flour, brown sugar, salt, baking soda, canola oil, cranberry juice
targets: title: rhubarb cranberry oatmeal bars ingredients: filling 1 cup dried cranberries 1/2 cup cranberry juice 3 cups frozen rhubarb do not thaw 1 cup sugar 1/4 cup quick tapioca 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon 1/8 teaspoon salt 3 drops red food coloring, optional crust topping 2 cups quick rolled oats 1 cup whole wheat flour 1 cup all purpose unbleached white flour 1 cup packed light brown sugar 1/4 teaspoon salt 1/2 tsp baking soda 1/2 cup canola oil 6 tablespoons cranberry juice directions: preheat oven to 350 f. lightly oil a 9 x 13 inch baking pan and set aside. prepare filling in medium sized saucepan, heat 1/2 cup cranberry juice and dried cranberries just until simmering. turn off heat and cover to keep moisture in. let sit 15 minutes to plump cranberries. add frozen rhubarb, sugar, tapioca, cinnamon, salt, red food coloring if using. over med heat, cook slowly stirring occasionally until mixture starts to thicken about 10 minutes . remove from heat. while filling cooks, prepare crust/topping mixture in a large bowl, work together oats, flour, brown sugar, salt and baking soda with your fingertips until brown sugar is blended well with other ingredients and there are not lumps. drizzle oil and cranberry juice over oat mixture and continue blending with fingers until it all comes together. reserve 1 cup of oat mixture for streusel topping. put remaining oat mixture into prepared pan pressing with fingers to evenly cover bottom of pan. pour filling over crust and spread evenly. sprinkle reserved oat mixture over filling. bake at 350 until filling is bubbly and topping is lightly browned. let cool before cutting into bars.

inputs: boned chicken, cream cheese, onion, worcestershire sauce
targets: title: chicken filled biscuits recipe ingredients: 1 5 ounce. can boned chicken, liquid removed 1 3 ounce. pkg. cream cheese with pimientos, softened 1 tbsp. sliced green onion with tops dash worcestershire sauce 1 pkg. refrigerated biscuits 10 biscuits directions: chop chicken combine with cream cheese, onion and worcestershire. on lightly floured surface roll and stretch each biscuit to a 4 inch circle. moisten edges with water. place a rounded tbsp. of chicken mix in center of each biscuit circle. fold up 3 sides and healthy pinch edges to seal. bake on lightly greased baking sheet at 400 degrees till golden brown, 8 to 10 min. serve hot. makes 10 snacks.

inputs: eggplants, olive oil, mozzarella cheese, basil, marjoram, parmesan cheese, butter, flour, milk, salt, pepper, olive oil, onion, garlic, tomatoes, tomatoes, parsley, vegetable stock, sugar, lemon juice, white wine
targets: title: baked eggplants ingredients: 4 eggplants 3 tablespoons olive oil 12 ounces mozzarella cheese, sliced thin 4 slices prosciutto, chopped 1 tablespoon basil, chopped 1 tablespoon marjoram, chopped 13 cup parmesan cheese, grated not canned 2 tablespoons butter 2 tablespoons flour 1 cup milk salt pepper 4 tablespoons olive oil 1 onion, sliced 4 garlic cloves, crushed 14 ounces canned tomatoes, chopped 1 lb tomatoes, peeled seeded and chopped 4 tablespoons parsley, chopped 2 12 cups vegetable stock 1 tablespoon sugar 2 tablespoons lemon juice 12 cup dry white wine or additional broth directions: begin by making a tomato sauce. heat the 4 t. olive oil over medium heat. add onion and garlic and cook until beginning to soften about 5 7 minutes. add the canned and fresh tomatoes, and the next 5 ingredients parsley through wine . simmer for 15 20 minutes, until reduced slightly. meanwhile, prepare the white sauce bechamel . heat the 2t of butter in a skillet over medium heat. after foam has subsided, add 2t flour. stir continually, and cook 2 3 minutes. remove from heat and add milk slowly. return to heat and bring to boil. mixture will thicken, season with salt and pepper. thinly slice eggplants lengthwise. boil in a large saucepan of water for 5 minutes. drain on paper towels and pat dry. prepare the casserole pour half of the tomato sauce into a greased casserole dish. cover with half of the eggplants and 1 t olive oil drizzled . cover with half the mozzarella, prosciutto, and herbs. repeat layers. cover all with bechamel sauce. sprinkle with parmesan. bake at 375 for 35 40 minutes or until golden on top.

inputs: crisco, cabbage, onions, ground beef, tomatoes
targets: title: fried cabbage ingredients: 2 to 3 tbsp. crisco 1 head cabbage, chopped 3 large onions, chopped 1 lb. ground beef, browned 1 can whole tomatoes, chopped directions: in large skillet saute cabbage and onions in crisco until cabbage is very brown. in separate skillet, add tomatoes to browned beef and mix. stir beef mixture into cabbage mixture and serve hot.

inputs: broccoli, onion, butter, mushroom soup, roll garlic, mushrooms
targets: title: broccoli with mushroom cheese sauce ingredients: 2 boxes frozen, chopped broccoli 1 onion, minced 1 block butter 1 10 1/2 oz. can mushroom soup 1 roll garlic cheese 1 can mushrooms small directions: fry onion in butter, then place frozen broccoli in and cook on low fire. melt in saucepan the mushroom soup and garlic cheese add the mushrooms. pour over the broccoli in a casserole dish. fifteen minutes before serving, sprinkle with bread crumbs and pass in oven. can be made ahead of time and put in refrigerator.

inputs: asparagus, salt, butter, gruyere cheese
targets: title: asparagus with gruyere ingredients: 1 12 lbs asparagus 12 teaspoon salt 14 cup butter, melted 12 cup grated gruyere cheese directions: preheat oven to 350f. cut or break off tough ends of asparagus. wash asparagus in cool running water, and drain well. arrange asparagus in single layer in ungreased 11x7 inch baking dish. sprinkle with salt. cover with aluminum foil and bake at 350f for 25 minutes or until asparagus is tender. drizzle melted butter over asparagus sprinkle cheese on top. return baking dish to oven for another 5 to 8 minutes, or until the cheese softens.

inputs: onion, bella mushroom, spinach, egg whites, salsa
targets: title: spinach and mushroom scramble ingredients: 2 tablespoons diced onion 2 tablespoons chopped baby bella mushroom 1 cup baby spinach 4 egg whites 2 tablespoons salsa optional directions: 1. in a non stick pan over medium heat, spray some cooking spray. once pan is hot then add onions. cook about 2 minutes until slightly brown. 2. add mushrooms and cook another 2 3 minutes. 3. add spinach and cook until it s wilted. 4. add eggs and stir to scramble and mix with the other ingredients. add salt and pepper. remove pan from heat once the egg is cooked to your liking. recipe adapted from my fitspiration.

inputs: eggs, sugar, flour, baking powder, butter, milk
targets: title: lazy daisy cake ingredients: 2 eggs 1 c. sugar 1 c. flour 1 tsp. baking powder 1 tbsp. butter 1/2 c. milk directions: beat eggs slowly and add sugar, flour and baking powder. heat milk and butter to boiling and add to mixture. bake in 13 x 9 x 2 5/8 inch pan for 30 minutes at 350 . remove from oven and immediately spread with topping.

inputs: elbow macaroni, milk, egg, green chiles, butter, fresh chunky salsa, pinto beans, pepper, sour cream
targets: title: spanish macaroni skillet ingredients: 1 7 ounce package uncooked dried elbow macaroni 1/2 cup milk 1 land o lakes all natrual egg 1 4 ounce can chopped green chiles, drained 1 tablespoon land o lakes butter 1 cup fresh chunky salsa, drained 1 15 ounce can pinto beans, rinsed, drained 6 3/4 ounce slices land o lakes deli hot pepper jack cheese, coarsely chopped sour cream, if desired directions: cook macaroni according to package directions. drain keep warm. beat milk and egg in medium bowl with fork. stir in cooked macaroni and chiles. melt butter in 10 inch nonstick skillet until sizzling add macaroni mixture. cover cook over low heat 12 15 minutes or until set. remove from heat let stand 5 minutes. meanwhile, heat salsa and beans in 2 quart saucepan over medium heat 5 8 minutes or until heated through. invert onto large serving plate or spoon onto individual serving plates. top with cheese and salsa mixture. dollop with sour cream, if desired.

inputs: italian bread, garlic, tomatoes, ricotta salata, extra virgin olive oil, balsamic vinegar, red onion, fresh basil, salt, ground black pepper
targets: title: tomato and ricotta salata bruschetta ingredients: 1 loaf italian bread, cut into 1/2 inch diagonal slices 6 cloves garlic, halved 6 medium tomatoes, seeded and cut into 1/2 inch pieces 1 4 ounce package ricotta salata, cut into 1/2 inch pieces 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar 1 tablespoon finely chopped red onion 1 tablespoon chopped fresh basil 1/4 teaspoon salt 1/4 teaspoon ground black pepper directions: preheat the oven to 400 degrees f 200 degrees c . place bread slices on a baking sheet. bake in the preheated oven until toasted, about 5 minutes. rub 1 side of the bread with the cut garlic. toss tomatoes, ricotta salata, olive oil, vinegar, onion, basil, salt, and pepper together in a bowl. divide evenly over bread.

inputs: raisins, baking soda, brown sugar, butter, salt, eggs, cinnamon, nutmeg, vanilla, flour, walnuts
targets: title: mom s raisin rock cookies ingredients: 2 cups seedless raisins 1 teaspoon baking soda 1 1/2 cups brown sugar 1 cup butter, softened 1 pinch salt 3 eggs 1 teaspoon cinnamon 1 teaspoon nutmeg 1 teaspoon vanilla extract 3 cups flour 1 1 1/2 cup chopped walnuts directions: put raisins in a large sauce pan. add enough water to the pan to cover the raisins. simmer 5 minutes. remove from heat. add baking soda to pan and let cool. drain when cool. cream butter and sugar together. add salt, eggs, spices, vanilla, flour, walnuts, and drained raisins. mix well. drop by rounded tablespoons on a greased baking sheet. bake at 400 degrees apx 12 minutes per batch.

inputs: ground chicken, red onion, red onions, olive oil, chili powder, garam masala, light coconut milk, natural style peanut butter, hot chili sauce, water, peanuts, salt, whole wheat rolls
targets: title: indian spiced chicken burgers with spicy peanut sauce ingredients: 1 lb ground chicken 14 cup red onion, finely diced 2 tablespoons red onions, finely diced 1 12 tablespoons olive oil, plus more for brushing 2 teaspoons chili powder 1 teaspoon garam masala 14 cup light coconut milk, unsweetened 2 tablespoons natural style peanut butter no sugar added 1 tablespoon hot chili sauce sriracha 2 tablespoons hot water 2 tablespoons salted peanuts, chopped salt 4 whole wheat rolls, toasted lettuce, for serving directions: combine the chicken, 1/4 cup of chopped onion, 1 tablespoon olive oil, 1 teaspoon chili powder, 1/2 teaspoon salt and garam masala. form into 4 patties. in a medium saucepan, heat 1/2 tablespoon olive oil. add 2 tablespoons of chopped onion and 1 teaspoon of chili powder. cook over moderate heat, stirring until onion is softened, about 5 minutes. add the coconut milk and bring to a boil. remove from the heat and whisk in the peanut butter, sriracha and hot water. stir in the peanuts and season with salt. brush the burger patties with olive oil and cook on a grill or grill pan over moderately high heat until cooked through, about 5 minutes on each side. spread the peanut sauce on the rolls. top with burgers and lettuce to serve.

inputs: cranberries, orange, celery, walnuts, pineapple, o, boiling water, sugar
targets: title: cranberry salad ingredients: 1 cup cranberries, coarsely chopped 1 navel orange, chopped with skin on be sure to wash well before chopping 12 cup celery rib, chopped 12 34 cup walnuts, chopped 1 20 ounce can crushed pineapple 1 3 ounce package cherry jell o 1 cup boiling water 1 cup sugar directions: chop cranberries, whole orange, celery, walnuts and pineapple in your food processor. make jello with boiling water. add sugar and stir very well until sugar and jello are dissolved. mix in your chopped ingredients. pour into your serving dish. allow to jell several hours at least 4 or overnight.

inputs: wish bone italian dressing, soy sauce, ground ginger, chicken, peanut butter, green onions, red pepper, sugar
targets: title: skewered chicken satay ingredients: 1 cup wish bone italian dressing 4 teaspoons soy sauce 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger 1 pound boneless, skinless chicken breast halves 1/4 cup skippy creamy peanut butter 1 tablespoon sliced green onions 1/4 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes 1/2 teaspoon sugar directions: for marinade, in medium bowl, whisk together wish bone r italian dressing, soy sauce and ginger. pour 1/4 cup marinade over chicken in large, shallow nonaluminum baking dish or plastic bag turn to coat. cover, or close bag, and marinate in refrigerator, turning occasionally, up to 3 hours. refrigerate 1/4 cup remaining marinade. meanwhile, whisk together remaining 1/2 cup marinade, peanut butter, green onions, red pepper flakes and sugar in small bowl set aside for dipping sauce. remove chicken from marinade, discarding marinade. thread chicken on skewers . grill or broil chicken, turning once and brushing frequently with 1/4 cup refrigerated marinade, until chicken is thoroughly cooked. serve with peanut dipping sauce.

inputs: butter, , cocoa, egg, chocolate cookie, unsweetened coconut, orange frosting, butter, icing sugar, chocolate topping, chocolate chips, butter
targets: title: chocolate orange nanaimo bars ingredients: for the base 1/2 cups butter 1/4 cups granulated sugar 5 tablespoons cocoa powder 1 whole egg, beaten 1 1/2 cup chocolate cookie crumbs like oreo 1 cup unsweetened coconut for the orange frosting filling 1/2 cups butter 2 1/2 tablespoons frozen orange juice concentrate 2 cups icing sugar for the chocolate topping 1 cup chocolate chips, semisweet or dark 2 tablespoons butter directions: base melt butter, sugar and cocoa together, over low heat in a saucepan or in the microwave. remove from heat. add beaten egg, then add oreo crumbs and coconut and mix until well combined. press into the bottom of a parchment paper lined, or greased, 9x9 inch baking pan. refrigerate while you prepare the frosting layer. orange frosting using an electric mixer, beat together the frosting ingredients until smooth. spread evenly over bottom layer, and refrigerate to set for about an hour before adding the chocolate topping. topping melt chocolate and butter together over low heat, or in the microwave microwave the mixture for 30 seconds at a time, stirring in between each heat burst , just until the chocolate is melted. spread quickly and gently over chilled frosting layer. return to fridge until the chocolate sets. i usually set my timer for about 30 minutes so i remember to score the chocolate before it is completely set. this will help to avoid cracked tops...not that they won t taste just as delicious with a couple pieces of cracked chocolate

inputs: eggs, milk, bread crumbs, ground meat, parsley, onion, catsup, brown sugar, mustard
targets: title: meat loaf ingredients: 2 eggs, beaten 3/4 c. milk 1/2 c. bread crumbs 1 1/2 lb. ground meat 2 tbsp. parsley 1 onion, diced fine 1/2 c. catsup 2 tbsp. brown sugar 1 tbsp. dry mustard directions: mix first 6 ingredients together shape into loaf. bake at 350 for 1 1/4 hours. when done, pour off fat. top with catsup, brown sugar and mustard mixed together. bake another 15 minutes.

inputs: bread, milk, onion, celery, worcestershire sauce, dry mustard, pepper, eggs, ground beef, boiling water
targets: title: grandmas best meat loaf ingredients: 4 slices soft bread, cubed 1 cup warm milk 1/2 cups chopped onion 1/2 cups diced celery and tops 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce 1 teaspoon dry mustard 1/4 teaspoons pepper 2 whole beaten eggs 2 pounds ground beef 1/2 cups boiling water directions: 1. preheat oven to 350 f. 2. soak bread cubes in warm milk. 3. add onions, celery, and seasonings to the beaten eggs and combine with the meat and mix thoroughly. 4. add bread cubes to the meat mixture. 5. form into a loaf pan and place on a shallow baking dish and pour hot water around the loaf pan. 6. dent the top with a wooden spoon. still not sure what that means. 7. bake uncovered at 350 f for 60 minutes.

inputs: cheese slices, ground beef, onion, green pepper, crescent rolls, tomato soup, worcestershire sauce, salt
targets: title: hamburger casserole ingredients: cheese slices 3 to 5 lb. ground beef 1 large onion 1 large green pepper 1 can crescent rolls 1 or 2 cans tomato soup worcestershire sauce salt and pepper to taste directions: brown hamburger meat. add pepper, onion and worcestershire sauce. drain. add tomatoes soup, undiluted.

inputs: zucchini, chicken broth, salt, curry, butter, clove garlic, shallots
targets: title: zucchini soup ingredients: 1 lb. zucchini 1 1/2 c. chicken broth 1/2 tsp. salt 1/2 tsp. curry or to taste 2 tbsp. butter 1 clove garlic, chopped 2 tbsp. chopped shallots or onion directions: place all ingredients in a pan. cook until zucchini is soft. put all ingredients into the blender. blend until smooth. return to pan reheat. season to taste.

inputs: shortening, sugar, eggs, tomato soup, baking soda, flour, baking powder, cinnamon, cloves, nutmeg, raisins, walnuts
targets: title: tomato soup cake ingredients: 1/2 c. shortening 1 c. sugar 2 eggs 1 can tomato soup 1 tsp. baking soda 2 c. flour 2 tsp. baking powder 1 tsp. cinnamon 1/2 tsp. cloves 1 tsp. nutmeg 1 c. raisins 1 c. chopped walnuts directions: blend shortening and sugar. add eggs. dissolve soda in tomato soup and add to mixture. sift dry ingredients together and add to mixture. stir in nuts and raisins. bake at 350 for 50 to 60 minutes in loaf pan. remove from oven and let cool.

inputs: ground beef, butter, onion, tomatoes, macaroni, mixed vegetables, salt, oregano, basil, pepper
targets: title: ground beef macaroni medley ingredients: 1 lb ground beef 1 tbsp butter or margarine 1 small onion, minced 1 can 1 lb 12 oz. tomatoes with liquid 1/2 cup uncooked macaroni 1 pkg 10 oz. frozen mixed vegetables optional 1 tsp salt 1/2 tsp dried oregano leaves 1/2 tsp dried basil leaves 1/4 tsp pepper directions: crumble beef into a large skillet with butter, over high heat stir until meat is no longer pink, add onion, turn heat to low, add tomatoes with liquid and macaroni. stir to blend, heat to simmering. add mixed vegetables, cover and cook until vegetables are done and macaroni is tender, about 20 minutes. sprinkle with salt, oregano, basil and pepper. serve with parmesan cheese to spoon over individual servings. good served with a tossed salad and hot bread.

inputs: flour, shortening, cream of tartar, soda, salt, cinnamon, sugar, sugar, eggs
targets: title: snickerdoodles ingredients: 2 3/4 c. flour 1 c. shortening 2 tsp. cream of tartar 1 tsp. soda 1/2 tsp. salt 3 tsp. cinnamon 1 1/2 c. sugar 2 tbsp. sugar 2 eggs directions: sift flour, cream of tartar, soda and salt. mix shortening, sugar and eggs. combine all. chill thoroughly. roll into balls about the size of small walnuts. dip one side into sugar and cinnamon, mixed. place balls, sugar side up, two inches apart, on ungreased cookie sheet. bake 8 to 10 minutes in hot oven 375 until lightly browned. yields 5 dozen.

inputs: lean ground beef, onion, green pepper, pizza sauce, cheddar cheese soup, water, turkey pepperoni, pasta, mozzarella cheese
targets: title: pizza skillet supper ingredients: 1 lb lean ground beef 1/2 cup onion, chopped 1/2 cup green pepper, chopped 1 15 ounce jar pizza sauce 1 11 ounce can cheddar cheese soup campbells 1 cup water 1/2 cup turkey pepperoni, diced 2 cups mafalda pasta mini lasagna noodles 2 ounces mozzarella cheese or 2 ounces cheddar cheese directions: in a large skillet, brown ground beef, onion and bell pepper, drain. stir in pizza sauce and soup, blend well. stir in water and pepperoni. bring to a boil stir in uncooked noodles. cover and cook over medium heat for 10 to 15 minutes or until pasta is tender, stirring frequently. remove from heat sprinkle with cheese. cover, let stand for 5 minutes. makes 5 1 cup servings.

inputs: chicken, cream of chicken soup, eggs
targets: title: easy chicken n dumplings ingredients: approximately 1 qt. boiled, deboned chicken retain broth 2 cans hungry jack biscuits 10 count cans 1 can cream of chicken soup 6 chopped, boiled eggs directions: you ll need approximately 2 quarts broth add soup no extra water . pinch each biscuit in about 4 pieces. drop one by one into hot, boiling broth and soup mixture the dumplings will be bite sized and fluffy. let boil on medium high for approximately 5 to 8 minutes. add cooked eggs and chicken. makes a large pot.

inputs: butterscotch chips, peanut butter, rice krispies, semi sweet chocolate chips, powdered sugar, butter, water
targets: title: crunchy fudge sandwiches ingredients: 1 c. butterscotch chips 1/2 c. peanut butter 4 c. rice krispies cereal 1 c. semi sweet chocolate chips 1/2 c. powdered sugar 2 tbsp. soft butter or oleo 1 tbsp. water directions: melt butterscotch chips with peanut butter in heavy saucepan over low heat, stirring constantly until well blended. remove from heat. add rice krispies, stirring until well coated with butterscotch mixture. press half of mixture into buttered pan 8 x 8 x 2 inch . chill in fridge while preparing fudge mixture. set remaining cereal mixture aside. combine chocolate chips, sugar, water and butter stir over hot water until chocolate melts and mixture is well blended. spread over chilled butterscotch mixture. spread reserved mixture on top press in gently. chill remove from refrigerator for about 10 minutes before cutting.

inputs: garlic, ginger, red pepper, hoisin sauce, soy sauce, cilantro, rice vinegar, lime juice, asian sesame oil, chinese chili garlic, pork baby back ribs
targets: title: asian style baby back ribs ingredients: 6 garlic cloves, coarsely chopped one 4 inch piece of fresh ginger, peeled and coarsely chopped 3/4 cup red pepper jelly see note 1/2 cup hoisin sauce 1/2 cup soy sauce 1/2 cup coarsely chopped cilantro 1/4 cup rice vinegar 6 tablespoons fresh lime juice 2 tablespoons asian sesame oil 2 tablespoons chinese chili garlic sauce six 1 1/2 pound racks of pork baby back ribs directions: in a food processor, combine the garlic, ginger, red pepper jelly, hoisin sauce, soy sauce, cilantro, rice vinegar, lime juice, sesame oil and chili garlic sauce. pulse until smooth. set the racks in a large baking dish and slather with the marinade. cover and refrigerate overnight. bring to room temperature before proceeding. preheat the oven to 400. line 3 large rimmed baking sheets with foil. remove the ribs from the marinade reserve the marinade. cut each rack in half so that each piece has 4 to 5 ribs. set the ribs on the prepared baking sheets, meaty side down, and roast in batches for 30 minutes. baste the ribs with the reserved marinade twice during baking and turn after 15 minutes. preheat the broiler. baste the ribs again and broil 3 inches from the heat for about 3 minutes, or until nicely glazed. let the ribs rest for 10 minutes, then cut down between them and serve.

inputs: cornstarch, sugar, ginger, cinnamon, milk, egg yolks, pumpkin, salt, egg whites, pecans
targets: title: glorified pumpkin pie ingredients: 1 tbsp. cornstarch 3/4 c. sugar 1/4 tsp. ginger 1/2 tsp. cinnamon 1 c. milk 2 beaten egg yolks 3/4 c. cooked pumpkin 1/4 tsp. salt 2 stiffly beaten egg whites 1/3 c. broken pecans directions: mix together cornstarch, sugar, ginger and cinnamon. add milk and beaten egg yolks and cook over hot water until thick, stirring constantly. add pumpkin and salt let cool. fold in whipped cream and beaten egg whites. pour into tray and freeze, stirring twice during the first half hour.

inputs: milk, sugar, butter, salt, yeast, flour, ground cardamom, vanilla flavoring, eggs, candied cherries, candied pineapple, raisins, flour
targets: title: norwegian julekar christmas bread ingredients: 2 c. milk 1 c. sugar 1/2 lb. butter or margarine 1 tsp. salt 3 tbsp. yeast in 1/2 c. warm water 3 c. unsifted flour 2 tsp. ground cardamom 2 tsp. vanilla flavoring 3 eggs, beaten 1 c. candied cherries candied pineapple 1 1/2 c. raisins 4 to 5 c. flour enough to make a soft dough directions: scald milk. add sugar, butter and salt. cool to lukewarm. add yeast mix and 3 cups flour. let rise 1 hour. add cardamom and beaten eggs. mix candied fruit and raisins with 1/4 cup flour. add to dough. add just enough flour to handle. knead dough well on floured surface. let rise until light.

inputs: unflavored gelatin, coffee, hot coffee, vanilla
targets: title: coffee jello ingredients: 1 envelope unflavored gelatin 1/4 c. coffee 2 c. hot coffee 1 tsp. vanilla directions: mix gelatin in cold coffee until dissolved. add 1/3 cup sugar and mix with hot coffee until dissolved add vanilla. let set.

inputs: beans, onion, green pepper, mustard, salt, pepper, ham, water, tomato soup
targets: title: crockpot ham lima beans ingredients: 1 lb dried baby lima beans, soaked overnight 1 large onion, chopped 1 large green pepper, chopped 1 teaspoon dry mustard 1 teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon pepper 1/4 1/2 lb ham or 1/4 1/2 lb bacon, diced 1 cup water 1 10 3/4 ounce can tomato soup, condensed directions: drain baby lima beans and add to crockery cooker along with remaining ingredients. stir together well. cover and cook on lo heat for 7 10 hours or hi heat for 4 5 hours . serve with weges of hot cornbread.

inputs: fresh scallops, flour, salt, pepper, salad oil, garlic, parsley
targets: title: scallops portuguese ingredients: 1 lb. fresh scallops 1/4 c. flour 1/2 tsp. salt 1/2 tsp. pepper 1/4 c. salad oil 1 garlic clove, minced 1/2 c. chopped parsley directions: take fresh scallops, wash well and drain. dust with seasoned flour. heat oil add scallops and garlic. cook quickly about 8 minutes , tossing lightly in hot fat. just before removing pan from heat, add parsley. toss scallops to coat with parsley. makes 3 servings.

inputs: water, all vegetable shortening, flour, eggs, chocolate sauce, condensed milk, semi sweet chocolate chips, coffee, whipped cream, icing sugar
targets: title: cream puffs with chocolate drizzle ingredients: pastry 1 cup water 1/2 cup all vegetable shortening 1 1/4 cups all purpose flour 4 eggs chocolate sauce 1 300 ml can eagle brand sweetened condensed milk 1 cup semi sweet chocolate chips 1/4 cup prepared strong coffee whipped cream icing sugar directions: preheat oven to 425 f line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper. pastry heat water, shortening and salt over high heat to a boil remove from heat. add flour and stir vigorously. reduce to medium heat. cook, stirring briskly for about 1 minute or until mixture comes away from the sides of the pot in a smooth ball transfer to a mixing bowl. mix dough on low for 1 minute to cool slightly. beat in eggs, one at a time, until dough is shiny and smooth. drop level tablespoons of dough onto prepared sheets. bake, one sheet at a time, for 25 minutes or until golden and puffed. do not open oven during baking . transfer puffs to a wire rack to cool completely 30 40 minutes. chocolate sauce blend sweetened condensed milk, chocolate chips and coffee over medium heat cook stirring until melted and glossy. cool to room temperature. reserve. poke a hole in the bottom of each cream puff or slice in half. insert nozzle of whipped cream canister or tip of piping bag to fill each puff. drizzle with chocolate sauce and sprinkle with icing sugar, just before serving. tip reserve any leftover chocolate sauce in the refrigerator for up to one week.

inputs: cucumber, celery, ginger, garlic, red pepper, sake, soy sauce, vegetable oil, sesame oil
targets: title: stir fried squid cucumber ingredients: 1 squid gutted, cleaned, cut into 5 7mm round slices 1 cucumber cut in half lengthwise, cut into 5 7mm slices, sprinkle salt and leave to drain moisture out well 1 stick celery cut into 3cm length 1 tsp ginger chopped finely 1/2 1 tsp garlic chopped finely 1 pinch crushed red pepper 2 tbsp sake 1 tbsp soy sauce 1/2 1 tsp chicken broth chicken stock powder 1 tbsp vegetable oil 1 tsp sesame oil directions: remove water from the squid well, sprinkle salt, peppe and flour, shake off excess. heat the vegetable oil in a pan, stir fry ginger and crushed red pepper with low heat. add squid, celery, cucumber and cook for 1 2 mins over high heat. add seasonings marked with and keep stir frying until the flavor blended. to finish it off, pour sesame oil from the edge of the pan to inside of it, stir once.

inputs: pumpkin pie filling, brown sugar, maple syrup, pumpkin pie spice, oats
targets: title: pumpkin spice oatmeal cookies egg free, milk free, gluten free, ingredients: 1 cup pumpkin pie filling, pure no spices added, i use libby s brand 1/4 cup brown sugar, packed 2 tablespoons maple syrup or honey 1 teaspoon pumpkin pie spice 1 cup quick cooking oats, gluten free directions: preheat oven to 350 f. in a medium bowl, combine pumpkin pie filling, brown sugar, maple syrup and pumpkin pie spice. then stir in oats until thoroughly combined. onto a greased cookie sheet, drop cookie dough by heaping teaspoonfuls. gently flatten cookie mounds to 1/2 inch thickness. bake for 14 16 minutes or until cookie bottoms are light brown, and tops are no longer shiny.

inputs: layer, water, oil, mint chocolate chip ice cream, frosting
targets: title: mint ice cream pies ingredients: 1 2 layer pkg. devils food cake mix 3/4 c. water 1/4 c. oil 6 c. mint chocolate chip ice cream, softened 3/4 c. fudge frosting directions: combine cake mix, water and oil in a large bowl. beat until moistened. spread batter in 2 greased 9 inch plates. bake at 350 for 25 to 30 minutes. cool completely. stir ice cream until smooth and spread in pie shells. heat frosting until softened. spread on top of ice cream. freeze until firm.

inputs: balsamic vinegar, orange juice, mayonnaise, cilantro, cumin, salt, mango, shallots, cilantro, tomatoes, peppers, shrimp, butter, bacon
targets: title: poblanos rellenos camaron ingredients: 1 cup balsamic vinegar 1 cup orange juice 1/2 cups mayonnaise 1/4 cups chopped cilantro 1 tablespoon cumin 1/2 cubes chipotle 1 whole lime, juiced 1/2 teaspoons salt 1 whole mango, cut into small cubes 2 whole shallots, diced 1 teaspoon chopped cilantro 2 whole roma tomatoes, seeded and diced 1/2 whole lime, juiced 4 whole poblano peppers 1 pound fresh shrimp, peeled and deveined 2 tablespoons salted butter 1 tablespoon old bay seasoning 1/2 cups crumbled cooked bacon directions: for the vinaigrette, combine the vinegar and orange juice in a small sauce pan bring to a boil. turn the heat down to about medium low and simmer for about 20 25 minutes, stirring occasionally. let it cool off the burner for about 20 minutes. add the mayo, whisk until dissolved, and then add the remaining ingredients. set aside. preheat oven to 400f and spray a cookie sheet with non stick spray. combine the mango, shallots, cilantro, tomatoes and lime in a small mixing bowl set aside. wash and slice the peppers down the center, halving them lengthwise and remove all seeds. place the pepper halves on the sheet, along with the shrimp all spread out and not touching. in the microwave melt the butter and old bay. coat the shrimp with the melted butter using a pastry brush, then in the oven it goes. at this point, i throw my bacon in the microwave. check on the shrimp after about 5 8 minutes. you might need to remove them from the pan before the peppers are done if so, just set them aside. combine the shrimp with the mango/tomato/shallot mixture. the peppers should be done after about 15 minutesthey should have just slight brown edges. stuff the peppers with the shrimp mixture and pop back in the oven for about 3 5 minutes remove. drizzle the vinaigrette over the peppers and top with the bacon crumbles. enjoy.

inputs: corn, butter, bacon grease, sugar, salt, pepper, whipping cream
targets: title: totally unhealthy skillet corn ingredients: 16 ounces frozen corn 2 tablespoons butter 1 tablespoon bacon grease 1 tablespoon sugar 1 teaspoon seasoning salt 12 teaspoon pepper 14 cup whipping cream directions: in a skillet on medium high heat, melt the butter and bacon grease. add the corn and sugar and saute until golden, about 10 minutes. season with seasoning salt and pepper. at the last minute stir in the whipping cream and simmer 2 minutes on low. do not allow to boil.

inputs: whole chickens, balsamic vinegar, unsalted butter, shallots, kosher salt, garlic, fresh orange zest, ground black pepper, orange, kosher salt
targets: title: whole roasted chicken in salt crust ingredients: 1 3 3 1/2 lb whole chickens, rinsed and patted dry 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar 2 tablespoons unsalted butter or 2 tablespoons margarine, softened 4 shallots, 2 chopped and 2 sliced 1/2 cup 1 teaspoon kosher salt 2 garlic cloves, minced see tip 1/2 teaspoon fresh orange zest 1/4 teaspoon ground black pepper 1 whole orange, quartered and sliced 1/4 cup kosher salt for top directions: preparations. brush chicken on all sides with balsamic vinegar. in small bowl, combine butter, chopped shallots, garlic/morton r kosher salt mixture , orange zest and pepper. spread mixture over chicken. lightly pat to evenly coat chicken. place the chicken on oiled rack in foil lined roasting pan. fill chicken cavity with sliced shallots and orange pieces. sprinkle top of chicken with 1/4 cup morton r kosher salt. cooking. roast uncovered at 425 f for 50 to 60 minutes or until juices run clear and chicken is cooked through and . iinternal temperature reaches 170 f for /white meat and 180 f for /dark meat . let rest 10 minutes remove and discard salt crust. cut into serving pieces. serve with roasted potatoes. tips sprinkle 1 teaspoon morton kosher salt over garlic cloves. chop garlic with morton r kosher salt until minced. proceed with remaining spices as above. .

inputs: all purpose flour, pork, vegetable oil, butter, onion, ketchup, vinegar, worcestershire sauce, brown sugar, mustard, salt, water
targets: title: pork ribs piquant ingredients: 1/2 cup all purpose flour, or as needed 1 1/2 pounds boneless country style pork ribs 1 tablespoon vegetable oil 2 tablespoons butter 1 onion, chopped 1/2 cup ketchup 2 tablespoons vinegar 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce 2 tablespoons brown sugar 2 tablespoons dry mustard 1/2 teaspoon salt 1 cup water directions: preheat oven to 300 degrees f 150 degrees c . spread flour into a shallow dish. dredge ribs in flour to coat. heat vegetable oil in a skillet over medium heat cook ribs in hot oil until completely browned, 2 to 3 minutes per side. remove ribs to a casserole dish. melt butter in the hot skillet. cook and stir onion in melted butter until translucent, about 5 minutes. stir ketchup, vinegar, worcestershire sauce, brown sugar, mustard, and salt with the onion until you have a smooth sauce. pour water into the sauce cook and stir until hot. pour sauce over the ribs. cover dish with aluminum foil. cook in preheated oven, spooning sauce over meat several times during baking, for 90 minutes. turn ribs and continue cooking and basting with sauce until the meat is completely tender, about 90 minutes more.

inputs: chicken, crisp apples, leeks, rosemary, olive oil, salt
targets: title: roasted chicken, apples, and leeks real simple ingredients: 8 small chicken thighs and drumsticks 2.5 lbs 4 small, crisp apples empire or braeburn , quartered 2 leeks, halved crosswise and lengthwise 6 small sprigs of fresh rosemary 2 tab olive oil salt and pepper directions: 1. heat oven to 400 . 2. on a large rimmed baking sheet or in a large roasting pan , toss the chicken, apples, leeks, rosemary, oil, 1 teaspoon salt, and .75 teaspoon of pepper. 3. turn chicken skin side up. 4. roast until chicken is cooked through and the apples and leeks are tender 40 45 min .

inputs: onion, oil, hamburger, salt, bisquick
targets: title: beef pinwheels or meat roll recipe ingredients: 1 onion 2 tbsp. oil hamburger salt pepper bisquick directions: saute/fry 1 onion in 2 tbsp. of oil till brown. add in hamburger and season with salt and pepper. fry till brown. make 1 recipe of bisquick according to box for biscuit dough. shape dough into a rectangle about 9 x 12 and 1/3 inch thick. cover the dough with cooled meat mix, roll up as for a jelly roll. cut into 1 inch slices and lay cut side up on baking sheet that has been greased, or possibly leave in a roll and slash top in several places. bake at 350 degrees for approximately 10 to 12 min till dough is brown. serve with gravy or possibly tomato sauce. i use up leftover gravy from a beef roast this way.

inputs: eggs, white sugar, margarine, milk, coconut, dish pie shell
targets: title: coconut pie 2 ingredients: 4 beaten eggs 1 1/2 c. white sugar 1/2 stick margarine 1 c. milk 1 c. coconut deep dish pie shell directions: melt margarine. add to all remaining ingredients that have been covered in a mixing bowl. cover bowl and store in refrigerator overnight. cook in a deep dish pie shell at 375 for about 40 minutes.

inputs: ground beef, green bell pepper, rice, salt, pepper, tomato juice
targets: title: grandma s meatballs ingredients: 2 2 1/2 lbs ground beef 1 green bell pepper, diced 1 1/2 cups kraft minute rice 1 teaspoon salt 1/2 teaspoon pepper 46 ounces tomato juice directions: in a large bowl mix together the ground beef, bell pepper, rice, salt and pepper. form 6 equally sized meat balls. they will seem large. place in a 3 4qt pot. cover completely with tomato juice. bring to a boil, cover and reduce to simmer. simmer for 1 hour. serve with mashed potatoes and garlic bread sticks. use the tomato juice as gravy. you may add more juice as this will reduce as it cooks. enjoy

inputs: grape juice, sugar, pouch certo, water
targets: title: grape jelly ingredients: 4 c. prepared grape juice 7 c. sugar 1 pouch certo 1 c. water directions: heat grapes, then run them through a colander to remove juice. add 1 cup of water and simmer for 10 minutes. add 7 cups of sugar and certo. pour in jars and seal.

inputs: butter, egg, lemon cake, pecans, cream cheese, powdered sugar, eggs
targets: title: lemon squares ingredients: 1 stick butter or oleo, melted 1 egg 1 box lemon cake mix with pudding in the mix 1 c. chopped pecans 8 oz. cream cheese 1 lb. box powdered sugar 2 eggs directions: mix butter, egg, lemon cake mix and 1 cup of chopped pecans. mix well, then pat in a 9 x 13 inch pan. in a large bowl, beat together until creamy cream cheese, powdered sugar and 2 eggs. pour over crust and bake at 350 until brown. cool, then cut into 1 1/2 inch squares.

inputs: melba, catsup, pepperoni, mozzarella cheese, oregano
targets: title: bambinos ingredients: 4 doz. melba or cracker rounds 3/4 c. catsup about 2 oz. thinly sliced pepperoni 1 c. shredded mozzarella cheese dried oregano leaves directions: heat oven to 400 . spread crackers with catsup. top with pepperoni slice and some cheese. sprinkle oregano on top. bake on ungreased cookie sheet until cheese melts, 3 to 5 minutes. makes 4 dozen canapes.

inputs: ingredients, chicken, cashew nuts, pineapple, green sweet pepper, sweet red pepper, garlic, cayenne pepper, sunflower oil, sugar, salt, water, sunflower oil, marinade, white pepper, chili powder, garlic, soy sauce, sherry wine, cornflour, sunflower oil, oyster sauce, salt, cornflour, pineapple juice
targets: title: stir fried chicken with cashew nuts and pineapple ingredients: ingredients 225 g chicken 70 g cashew nuts or measure the nuts with your baking plate as there should not be overlapping of nuts during baking 1 220 g can pineapple i use pineapple chrunks in juice, drained weight 136g, juice left for seasoning 1/2 large green sweet pepper diced 1/2 large sweet red pepper diced 3 garlic cloves crushed 1/4 cayenne pepper sliced 1 tablespoon sunflower oil 1/2 teaspoon sugar 1/4 teaspoon salt 150 ml water 1 teaspoon sunflower oil or melted butter, for baking cashew nuts marinade 1/4 teaspoon white pepper 1/4 teaspoon chili powder 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder 1/2 tablespoon light soy sauce 1/2 tablespoon sherry wine use shaoxing wine, a chinese rice wine if you can get it 1 teaspoon cornflour 2 teaspoons sunflower oil to coat the diced chicken just before stir fry, so there is less chance that the meat will stick to seasoning 1/2 tablespoon oyster sauce 1/3 teaspoon salt 1/2 teaspoon cornflour 2 tablespoons pineapple juice directions: wash chicken and dice. mix with marinade. leave in a cool place for at least 30 minutes. can be left in the fridge for 2 hours to overnight
