inputs: potatoes, butter, parmesan cheese, garlic powder, paprika
targets: title: cheesy fries ingredients: 3 medium potatoes 3 tbsp. butter 1/4 c. parmesan cheese 1/2 tsp. garlic powder 1/2 tsp. paprika directions: scrub potatoes, leaving skin on. cut each potato into 8 wedges. melt butter in large pie plate. dip wedges into melted butter and arrange in a donut pattern. combine cheese and spices. sprinkle evenly over potatoes. bake at 375 until potatoes are just tender.

inputs: broccoli, cream of mushroom soup, mayonnaise, eggs, sharp cheese, onion, crackers, butter
targets: title: broccoli casserole ingredients: 2 10 oz. pkg. frozen chopped broccoli 1 can cream of mushroom soup 1 c. mayonnaise 2 eggs, well beaten 1 c. sharp cheese, grated 4 tbsp. chopped onion 1/2 c. crushed ritz crackers 4 tbsp. butter directions: cook or steam the broccoli for 5 or 6 minutes drain well. combine soup with the mayonnaise, eggs and cheese. add onion mix well. pepper to taste. add broccoli mix well. spray a casserole dish with cooking spray. pour in mixture. top with crushed ritz crackers. top with margarine. bake for about 30 minutes in a 350 oven.

inputs: eggs, sugar, milk, butter, bread, vanilla, raisins
targets: title: southern bread pudding ingredients: 4 eggs 1/2 c. sugar 2 c. milk 2 tbsp. butter 4 slices bread, cubed 1 tsp. vanilla 1/2 c. raisins directions: beat together 4 eggs and 1/2 cup sugar. scald 2 cups milk and 2 tablespoons butter. butter 4 slices of bread and cube. gradually add hot milk to egg and sugar. add vanilla. add bread and mix well. mix in raisins, mix all very well, then bake at 300 in buttered baking dish 1 1/2 quart in pan of hot water for 1 1/2 hours.

inputs: margarine, flour, salt, paprika, pepper, chicken, cream of chicken soup, milk, refrigerated biscuits, shredded cheese
targets: title: joyce s cheese n chicken dinner ingredients: 14 cup margarine or 14 cup butter 13 cup flour 2 teaspoons salt 1 teaspoon paprika pepper 2 12 3 lbs chicken 1 10 3/4 ounce can cream of chicken soup 1 12 cups milk 1 8 ounce can pillsbury refrigerated biscuits 14 12 cup shredded cheese i use cheddar directions: melt butter in a 9x13 inch pan. in a bag, combine flour, salt, paprika and pepper. add chicken and shake to coat. place chicken skin side down and bake at 425f for 30 minutes. turn chicken pieces, sprinkle with salt and bake another 15 minutes. combine milk and soup and blend until smooth. pour over chicken. push chicken pieces toward center of pan. arrange biscuits around chicken. bake 10 minutes. top each biscuit with shredded cheese. continue baking 5 minutes or until biscuits are golden brown.

inputs: apple, cranberries, water, brown sugar, cinnamon
targets: title: cranberry pear compote low calorie ingredients: 1 medium pear peeled chopped 1 medium apple peeled chopped 1 cup fresh or frozen cranberries 1/4 cup water 3 tbsp. brown sugar 1/2 tsp. cinnamon directions: combine all ingredients and bring to a boil. reduce heat and simmer uncovered until berries pop and sauce thickens about 15 minutes stirring occasionally. serve warm or cold.

inputs: carrots, shallots, butternut squash, brussels, garlic, extra virgin olive oil, salt, fresh ground black pepper, dried lentils, yellow onion, bay leaf, apple cider vinegar, mustard, arugula
targets: title: roasted autumn vegetables daphne oz ingredients: 4 small carrots, halved lengthwise 3 shallots, halved or 1 large red onion, cut in wedges 1 butternut squash, halved, seeded, and cut into 1/2 inch slices 12 lb brussels sprout, halved 4 6 garlic cloves 6 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil salt fresh ground black pepper 12 cup dried lentils, rinsed daphne uses black lentils 12 yellow onion 1 bay leaf 3 tablespoons apple cider vinegar 1 tablespoon dijon mustard 12 lb arugula or spinach directions: preheat oven to 400 f. in a large bowl, combine the carrots, shallots, squash, brussels sprouts, and garlic. drizzle 2 tbls. of the olive oil, and season with salt and pepper. toss to coat. pour vegetables onto a sheet tray and roast in the oven for 30 minutes, tossing once, halfway through. meanwhile, prepare the lentils by putting them into a small saucepan and covering with water by 2 inches. add the onion and bay leaf. bring to a boil, then simmer covered for 20 minutes, or until tender. drain and discard the onion, season with salt and pepper and set aside. once the veggies are finished roasting, remove the garlic. peel and mash the garlic in a small bowl, combine with the remaining 4 tbls. of olive oil, apple cider vinegar, and dijon mustard, and whisk into a vinaigrette. toss the lentils with the vinaigrette, fold in the arugula or spinach leaves, and then top with roasted vegetables to serve. enjoy

inputs: egg noodles, margarine, onion, cream of chicken soup, milk, mustard, ground black pepper, corned beef, bread crumbs
targets: title: jubilation thursday casserole ingredients: 8 oz. egg noodles, cooked and drained 2 tbsp. margarine 1 tbsp. onion, minced 1 10 1/2 oz. can cream of chicken soup 1/2 c. milk 1 tsp. prepared mustard 1/4 tsp. ground black pepper 1 can corned beef, diced 1/2 c. dry bread crumbs, mixed with 2 tbsp. melted margarine directions: in large 10 to 12 inch frying pan, melt margarine. saute onion until golden brown. add soup, milk, mustard and pepper. add noodles and corned beef stir. put mixture in a buttered 2 quart casserole. top with bread crumb margarine mixture. bake in preheated 350 oven for 20 minutes. serves 4 to 5. travels well to pot luck suppers. similar recipe by gertrude stanley.

inputs: flour, cayenne pepper, salt, baking pwdr, sugar, flour, peanut oil, shrimp
targets: title: beer battered shrimp with chipotle honey recipe ingredients: 1 c. all purpose flour 1 1/2 tsp cayenne pepper 1 tsp salt 1/2 tsp baking pwdr 1 tsp granulated sugar 8 ounce beer flour for dusting 4 c. peanut oil for frying 1 1/4 lb rock shrimp or possibly peeled white shrimp chipotle honey dipping sauce see note directions: combine the flour with the cayenne, salt, sugar and baking pwdr in a medium bowl. add in beer all at once and whisk till smooth. set aside at least 1/2 hour. heat oil to deep fry temperature 350 degrees in a large saucepan. test oil by sprinkling a few drops of batter and if they rise to the surface, the oil is ready. toss the shrimps in the flour for dusting and toss to coat proportionately, then pat off excess. drop a few at a time first in the batter then into the warm oil and fry till lightly golden brown and crispy about 2 min. remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels. serve immediately with the chipotle honey dipping sauce. this recipe yields 6 servings.

inputs: ground beef, level cracker crumbs, flour, milk, onion, butter, salt, pepper, egg, cream of mushroom soup
targets: title: swedish meatballs ingredients: 1 lb. ground beef 3/4 c. level cracker crumbs 1 tbsp. flour 3/4 c. milk 1 medium diced onion 2 tbsp. butter 1 tsp. salt 1 tsp. pepper 1 egg, beaten 2 cans cream of mushroom soup directions: mix meat, cracker crumbs, milk, salt, pepper, onion and flour. lightly brown onion in butter add to meat mixture. shape into balls lightly brown in same pan as onion. put in 2 quart casserole dish. cover with soup plus 1/2 can of water . cover and bake at 350 for 30 minutes, then uncover for 10 more minutes.

inputs: squash, cream cheese, mayonnaise, salt, pepper, raisins
targets: title: easy microwave made kabocha squash salad ingredients: 1/4 kabocha squash 50 grams cream cheese 5 tbsp mayonnaise 1 dash salt 1 dash pepper 50 grams raisins optional directions: cut the kabocha squash into about 1.5 cm cubes, place in a microwave safe container, and rinse with water. this time i used 350 g of kabocha squash. i didn t remove the peel since it s packed with nutrition, but the salad is smoother if the peel is removed. of course, if you don t like the peel, go ahead and remove it. also, you could use frozen kabocha squash instead. drain the kabocha squash, leaving it a bit moist, cover with plastic wrap, and microwave for 6 8 minutes at 600 w. if the kabocha squash is not fully cooked, microwave some more. be careful not to burn yourself when removing the plastic wrap once the kabocha squash is tender, mash lightly with a potato masher while it s still hot. cut the cream cheese into 2 cm squares and mix it into the kabocha squash while it s still hot. season with mayonnaise, salt, and pepper. taste, and add sugar if needed be sure to season with pepper lightly, taste, and adjust if needed . once cooled, transfer to a serving plate, and it s done. you could add raisins at step 6 if you d like. i like to add raisins to my salad. the sweetness from the kabocha squash tends to stand out more without the raisins. this is how my child and husband like it.

inputs: oleo, flour, sugar, baking powder, peaches, milk, salt
targets: title: peach cobbler ingredients: 1 stick oleo 3/4 c. flour 3/4 to 1 c. sugar 1 tsp. baking powder 1 lb. can sliced peaches 1/2 c. milk dash of salt directions: melt oleo in baking dish slowly, do not burn . sift dry ingredients together and mix with milk. pour over oleo, then pour fruit over all. bake about 30 to 35 minutes at 325 .

inputs: margarine, yellow onion, carrot, celery, mushrooms, flour, chicken broth, tarragon, thyme, white pepper, black pepper, hot pepper, parsley, cream, lemon juice, chicken
targets: title: chicken mushroom soup ingredients: 14 cup margarine 14 cup diced yellow onion cut into 1/4 inch pieces 14 cup diced carrot cut into 1/4 inch pieces 14 cup diced celery cut into 1/4 inch pieces 3 cups sliced mushrooms about one 8 ounce package, cut into 1/8 inch slices 12 cup flour 5 12 cups chicken broth 1 pinch dried tarragon 14 teaspoon dried thyme 12 teaspoon white pepper 1 teaspoon black pepper 12 teaspoon hot pepper sauce 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley 3 cups half and half cream 1 12 teaspoons lemon juice 34 lb diced cooked chicken directions: melt margarine in large heavy pot. add vegetables and saute until tender over medium low heat. slowly sift flour over vegetables and let cook briefly, stirring regularly. do not let flour brown. slowly add chicken broth to vegetable flour mixture, stirring constantly. add herbs, pepper sauce and parsley and stir well. simmer 10 minutes. stir in half and half, lemon juice and chicken. bring to simmer and cook 10 minutes. serve immediately.

inputs: salmon, gallon water, salt, butter, egg yolks, lemon, tabasco sauce, water
targets: title: poached salmon with hollandaise ingredients: 2 salmon fillets 8 ounces each 1 gallon water 2 tablespoons salt 1 cup clarified butter 4 egg yolks 1 lemon 12 teaspoon tabasco sauce 3 tablespoons hot water directions: in a heavy pan on medium heat, add the two tablespoons of salt to one gallon of water. bring to a light boil. place salmon and 1/2 of a lemon in the water. place a metal bowl on top of the pan containing the salmon. in the bowl, place the three tablespoons of hot water, the egg yolks, tabasco sauce and the juice from the remaining lemon half. stir with a fine whip until yolks start to thicken. still stirring, slowly add 1/2 cup of the clarified butter. if the sauce thickens too much, slowly add more hot water until desired consistency. remove from heat and add remaining 1/2 cup of butter. stir until incorporated. take salmon filet out of water after 6 minutes. top immediately with hollandaise.

inputs: all purpose, light brown sugar, kosher salt, unsalted butter, tahini, black sesame seeds, purple, peaches, granulated sugar, lemon juice
targets: title: peaches and plums with sesame crumble ingredients: 1/2 cup all purpose flour 3 tablespoons packed light brown sugar 1/4 teaspoon kosher salt 4 tablespoons unsalted butter, cut into tablespoons 1 tablespoon tahini 1 1/2 teaspoons black sesame seeds 1 pound about 3 purple plums, thinly sliced 1 1/2 pounds about 3 peaches, peeled with a vegetable peeler and thinly sliced 1/2 cup granulated sugar 1 tablespoon lemon juice, freshly squeezed directions: preheat the oven to 350 and line a baking sheet with parchment paper. in a food processor, pulse the flour with the light brown sugar and salt. add the butter and tahini and pulse until moist crumbs form. add the black sesame seeds and pulse to combine. scatter the tahini crumbs on the baking sheet and bake them for about 20 minutes, until they are golden and crisp. let cool, then break up any big clumps. meanwhile, in a large skillet, combine the plums and peaches with the granulated sugar and lemon juice and cook over moderate heat, stirring occasionally, until the fruit is just softened and the juices are thickened, about 10 minutes. scrape the fruit into a shallow gratin dish or glass pie plate and sprinkle with the crumbs. bake in the center of the oven until the fruit is bubbling, about 10 minutes. let cool for 5 minutes, then serve.

inputs: butter, sugar, flour, baking powder, milk, shortening, eggs, salt, cocoa, vanilla
targets: title: jerome s chocolate pound cake ingredients: 2 sticks butter 3 c. sugar 3 c. flour 1/2 tsp. baking powder 1 c. milk 1/2 c. shortening 5 eggs 1/2 tsp. salt 4 tbsp. cocoa 1 tbsp. vanilla directions: have eggs and butter at room temperature. preheat oven to 325 . grease and flour a 9 or 10 inch tube pan. cream shortening and butter together. add eggs, one at a time, alternating with sugar. sift dry ingredients together add these alternately with milk to creamed mixture. add vanilla. pour into tube pan cook for 80 or 90 minutes.

inputs: butter, sugar, eggs, bananas, flour, salt, baking soda, nuts
targets: title: grandma betty s best banananut bread ingredients: 1/2 cup butter or 1/2 cup margarine 1 cup sugar 2 eggs 2 large bananas 2 cups all purpose flour 1/2 teaspoon salt 1/2 teaspoon baking soda 1/2 cup chopped nuts directions: mix together butter, sugar, eggs, and bananas. add the rest of the ingredients and blend. spray a 9x5 inch pan with oil spray. add mix to pan and bake at 350 degrees for 50 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean. after removing from oven, allow to cool for 5 minutes then let finish cooling on a cooling rack.

inputs: eggs, celery, onion, tomatoes, chili powder, worcestershire sauce, mustard, salt, lean ground beef, hamburger, butter
targets: title: the ultimate grilled burger ingredients: 2 eggs 12 cup finely chopped celery 12 cup finely chopped onion 1 peeled and finely chopped tomatoes 1 teaspoon chili powder 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce 1 teaspoon dijon style mustard salt and pepper 4 lbs lean ground beef hamburger bun butter directions: place ground beef into a large mixing bowl. place on top of ground beef the eggs, celery, onions, tomato, chili powder, worcestershire sauce, mustard, salt and pepper. mix well and form 12 t 16 patties. grill 4 to 6 inches from coals for 14 to 18 minutes or until done to your likeness. split buns and lightly butter on both sides. place buttered buns on grill until they are toasted. add toppings of your choice.

inputs: chicken, green chilies, ginger garlic, chili flakes, white pepper, ground black pepper, cumin, coriander powder, allspice, coconut, lemon juice, white vinegar, yogurt, cream, salt, oil
targets: title: creamy chicken tikka curry ingredients: 1 kg chicken, with bone, cut into medium size pieces 2 teaspoons green chilies, made into a paste 1 1/2 teaspoons ginger garlic paste 1 teaspoon chili flakes 3/4 teaspoon white pepper powder 1/4 teaspoon ground black pepper 1 teaspoon smoked cumin powder 1/2 teaspoon coriander powder 1/2 teaspoon allspice 3/4 teaspoon msg 1 tablespoon desiccated coconut 2 tablespoons lemon juice 2 tablespoons white vinegar 8 tablespoons yogurt 8 tablespoons cream 1 tablespoon salt 2 ounces oil directions: marinate the chicken pieces in all the ingredients leave for atleast 1 hr or over night. put in a pan cook on low heat for 30 60 minutes, the gravy would have thickened by now. now leave a piece of coal directly on the flame of the stove to heat till it is almost white hot. pick this piece of coal with a pair of tongs n put in the middle of the creamy chicken tikka, n pour 2 oz of oil on the coal, it will immidiately start to smoke, so quickly cover with a tight lid leave till the smoke dies down, about 10 minutes. discard the coal piece. serve.

inputs: cream cheese, confectioners sugar, mayonnaise, vanilla extract, peaches, maraschino cherries, fruit cocktail, pineapple, marshmallows, whipped cream
targets: title: rich s magnolia room fruit salad ingredients: 1 8 oz. pkg. cream cheese 1/2 c. confectioners sugar 1/3 c. mayonnaise 2 tsp. vanilla extract 1 6 1/2 oz. can sliced peaches, drained 1/2 c. maraschino cherries, drained 1 26 oz. can fruit cocktail, drained 1 13 oz. can crushed pineapple, drained 2 c. miniature marshmallows 1/2 c. whipped cream directions: place cream cheese in a mixer bowl. add confectioners sugar. blend in mayonnaise. add vanilla. fold in fruit and marshmallows, gently. fold in whipped cream. pour into large paper lined muffin tins freeze. before serving, take out of freezer about 10 to 15 minutes, but do not allow to become soft. remove paper liners before serving.

inputs: oreo cookies, cream cheese, walnuts, powdered sugar
targets: title: oreo dream ingredients: 1 each oreo cookies 1 package, crush until fine 8 ounces cream cheese 1 package 1 x walnuts as needed, finely chopped 1 x powdered sugar as needed, or white chocolate, for dipping directions: in a food processor combine 1 pack of oreos, crush until fine. add 1 8 oc package of cream cheese. blend together. make into balls the size of a walnut. dip into walnuts, or powdered sugar or white chocolate. serve.

inputs: unsalted butter, flour, hot milk, cheddar cheese, fresh jalapenos, scallions, salt, freshly ground black pepper, eggs
targets: title: chili cheese souffle ingredients: 4 tablespoons unsalted butter, softened 4 tablespoons sifted, all purpose flour 1 cup hot milk 1 cup sharp cheddar cheese 2 tablespoons chopped fresh jalapenos 1/4 cup chopped scallions 1/2 teaspoon salt 1/2 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper 5 eggs, separated directions: preheat the oven to 375 degrees. butter a 1 1/2 quart souffle dish. in a heavy bottomed saucepan, bring the milk to a boil, being careful not to allow it to scorch or boil over. remove from the heat and reserve. in a second saucepan, melt the butter over low heat. add the flour, stirring with a wooden spoon, until completely combined. pour 1/3 of the milk into the butter mixture and, using a wire whisk, incorporate it completely before adding the remaining milk. when all of the milk has been added, continue cooking over low heat for 5 minutes. add the cheese to the hot milk mixture, stirring carefully. do not let the mixture boil or the cheese will separate. stir in the jalapeno, salt and pepper and remove from heat. let the liquid cool for 5 minutes, add several tablespoons of liquid to the egg yolks and stir together. then add the yolks to the cheese and milk mixture slowly, stirring with a wooden spoon. transfer the mixture to a mixing bowl and allow to cool completely before finishing the souffle. in a mixing bowl, whisk the egg whites to stiff peaks. fold 1/3 of the beaten whites into the cheese mixture and then carefully fold in the remaining whites, being careful not to deflate the whites. pour the souffle mixture into the souffle dish and bake for 45 minutes. serve immediately.

inputs: scratch, thin slices, fresh basil, gruyere cheese, fontina cheese, olive oil, salt, truffle oil
targets: title: proscuitto basil and truffle oil flat bread ingredients: 1 lb pizza dough ready made or prepared from scratch. frozen dough loaf works great 4 large thin slices of proscuitto 1/2 cup roughly sliced fresh basil leaves 1/2 cup gruyere cheese 1/4 cup fontina cheese olive oil salt black truffle oil directions: to prepare the dough roll out the dough into a rectangle shape about 1/2 inch thick. season with salt and olive oil and place in 400 degree oven for 10 minutes. while dough is baking slice the proscuitto into thin strips. using a cheese plane or sharp knife, cut each type of cheese into thin slices roughly chop the basil and set aside. when bread has come out of the oven, lay out all of the cheese mixing up the types in a thin layer over the entire flatbread. next, place the proscuitto on the bread evenly distributing it on top of the cheese over the entire flat bread. drizzle a little more olive oil over the bread and place back in the oven for 10 15 more minutes or until the crust of the bread is slightly browned and the cheese is melted. remove from oven and sprinkle fresh basil over entire flatbread. finally drizzle the truffle oil to tase a little goes a long way over the entire flatbread. cut into pieces and serve.

inputs: whole wheat, butter, garlic, parsley, parmesan
targets: title: parmesan garlic bread ingredients: 16 ounces italian bread shell you can use whole wheat 1/2 cup butter softened 2 large garlic cloves smashed and minced 1 tablespoon parsley leaves freshly chopped 1/4 cup parmesan, parmigiano reggiano cheese, grated directions: preheat oven to 350f. cut the bread in half, horizontally. mix the butter, garlic, and parsley together in a small bowl. spread butter mixture over the the two bread halves. place on a sturdy baking pan one that can handle high temperatures, not a cookie sheet and heat in the oven for 10 minutes. remove pan from oven. sprinkle parmesan cheese over bread if you want. return to oven on the highest rack. broil on high heat for 2 to 3 minutes until the edges of the bread begin to toast and the cheese if you are using cheese bubbles. watch very carefully while broiling. the bread can easily go from un toasted to burnt. remove from oven, let cool a minute. remove from pan and make 1 inch thick slices. serve immediately.

inputs: chicken breasts, green, onion, mushrooms, linguine noodles, cajun seasoning, vegetable oil
targets: title: cajun style linguine and chicken ingredients: skinless boneless chicken breasts green and red peppers, chopped onion, chopped mushrooms linguine noodles cajun seasoning mccormick cajun quick chicken seasoning vegetable oil directions: stir fry the first four ingredients. cook noodles as usual drain and add a little oil and cajun seasoning to noodles. add cajun seasoning to the other stir fried ingredients, then add them to noodles. either top each serving, or combine it all together.

inputs: green, olive oil, salt, basil, creme fraiche, lemon, salmon heart, eggs, bread, pesto
targets: title: egg casserole with asparagus, smoked salmon, pesto bread fingers ingredients: 1 bunch asparagus green 2 tablespoons olive oil salt 10 basil leaves 3 tablespoons creme fraiche 1 lemon 1 3/4 ounces smoked salmon heart, diced 2 eggs 2 slices bread pesto directions: preheat oven to 200 degrees celsius wash the green asparagus, cut the edges and remove 10 cm from the bottom of each stem. place the asparagus tips on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and sprinkle a tablespoon of olive oil and some coarse salt on top. cook for 10 minutes. mince the stems with a knife. heat a tablespoon of oil in a skillet and saute the asparagus over high heat, stirring regularly. add salt and then remove from heat. add the basil, creme fraiche, and zest of half a lemon. separate this mixture into two jars, ramekins, or casseroles. stick 3 cooked asparagus tips in each of them so that they stick out of the top. place the diced salmon on top of the asparagus mixture and gently break one egg on top of the salmon in each dish. cook for at least 10 minutes, until the white has solidified. toast the slices of bread and spread pesto on the warm toasts, then cut them into strips. serve the casserole on a plate with the toasts and the asparagus tips.

inputs: berries, water, sugar
targets: title: berry iced tea ingredients: 1 1/2 cups berries raspberries, blackberries, blueberries, black currants 3/4 cup water 1/3 cup sugar 6 cups tea, brewed hot directions: simmer berries with 3/4 cup water and sugar until berries break apart. add hot tea steep until cool. strain through a cheesecloth lined sieve, pressing only lightly on the solids to keep the liquid clear. serve in a tall glass with ice cubes.

inputs: basil, extra virgin olive oil, cannellini beans, feta, clove garlic, lemon juice, pita bread, fennel seeds, ground cumin
targets: title: white bean dip with basil oil and spiced pita bread ingredients: 1/2 bunch basil leaves 1 cup extra virgin olive oil, plus more for brushing 14 oz can cannellini beans, rinsed and drained 4 oz feta, chopped 1 clove garlic, crushed 2 tbsp lemon juice 2 pieces pita bread, cut into triangles 2 tsp fennel seeds 1 tsp ground cumin directions: preheat oven to 350 f. for the basil oil, place basil in a large heatproof bowl and cover with boiling water. let stand for 30 seconds then drain. rinse under cold water then process basil and 1/2 cup oil until smooth. transfer to a bowl and cover with cling wrap. for the dip, process beans with feta, remaining oil, garlic and lemon juice until smooth. season to taste and transfer to a serving bowl. place bread on baking sheets, brush with olive oil and sprinkle with fennel seeds and cumin. bake for 8 10 mins, until crisp. drizzle dip with basil oil and serve with the bread.

inputs: butter, sugar, eggs yolks, milk, flour, baking powder, salt, vanilla, cocoa powder
targets: title: marble cake ingredients: 7 tablespoons butter room temperature 3/4 cup sugar 2 large eggs yolks and whites separated 6 tablespoons milk 1 5/8 cups flour 1 tablespoon baking powder 1 pinch salt 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract 2 tablespoons cocoa powder directions: preheat the oven to 180 degrees celsius. line a 20 x 20 centimeter cake pan with parchment paper. beat the butter until light and fluffy. mix in the sugar. beat in the egg yolks and milk until combined. sift in the flour and baking powder. mix until just absorbed. separately, in a bowl whisk the egg whites with a pinch of salt until stiff peaks form. carefully fold them into the first mixture. divide the batter in 2. in 1 half, add the vanilla. in the other half, add the cocoa powder. pour the 2 batters into the cake pan alternating batters. with a knife, insert the tip into the batter and swirl it around between the 2 batters. bake 20 minutes until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.

inputs: sweet mango, freshly squeezed lime juice, peanut butter, water, salt, carrots, cilantro, scallion greens, lime juice, salt, peanuts
targets: title: carrot slaw with mango chutney dressing ingredients: 3 tablespoons sweet mango chutney 3 tablespoons freshly squeezed lime juice 2 tablespoons peanut butter 2 to 3 tablespoons water 1 teaspoon salt 1 pound carrots, peeled and shredded about 4 cups 1/2 cup chopped cilantro 1/3 cup thinly sliced scallion greens additional lime juice, if needed additional salt, if needed 1/4 cup chopped roasted, salted peanuts, for garnish optional directions: in a blender, puree the dressing ingredients, using 2 tablespoons of water, until very smooth. blend in additional water if the dressing is too thick to coat the carrots. in a large bowl, toss the carrots, cilantro, and scallions with the dressing. add more lime juice and salt, if needed. garnish with peanuts, if you wish.

inputs: cranberry juice, concentrate, ginger ale
targets: title: cranberry punch sparkler ingredients: 1 pint cranberry juice 2 6 ounce cans frozen lemonade concentrate 1 liter ginger ale directions: mix the cranberry juice and lemonade nicely together. before serving, pour in the gingerale. serve chilled. enjoy this pretty, delicious and sparkling drink for new year s and other special times

inputs: baking size potatoes, onions, butter, salt, paprika
targets: title: cheese baked potatoes ingredients: 7 baking size potatoes 2 tsp. onions, chopped fine 2 tbsp. butter or margarine salt and pepper to taste paprika directions: bake potatoes until tender. let cool. cut in halves. scrape pulp from skins and mash. add a little milk to make light and fluffy. saute onions in butter. stir with potato mixture along with salt and pepper. pile mixture back in potato shells. cover top with grated cheddar cheese and sprinkle with paprika. put on a cookie sheet and bake at 450 for 25 minutes.

inputs: salt pork, onions, potatoes, salt, pepper, boiling water, milk, milk, butter, parsley
targets: title: fish chowder ingredients: 1/4 lb. salt pork 3 medium onions, sliced 5 medium potatoes, pared, sliced or diced 4 tsp. salt 1/4 tsp. pepper 3 c. boiling water 1 1/2 lb. fresh cod fillets 1 qt. milk, scalded 1 c. evaporated milk 3 tbsp. butter or margarine parsley directions: cut salt pork into 1/2 cubes. cook in large kettle until crispy. remove bits and reserve. to hot pork fat, add onions. cook until tender, stirring often. top with potatoes. sprinkle with salt and pepper. pour on boiling water. top with fish cut into medium pieces. cover and simmer 25 minutes or until potatoes are tender. add milk and evaporated milk. sprinkle with parsley. yields 6 servings.

inputs: shrimp, vegetable oil, garlic, water, chicken broth, tomatoes, salt, liquid red pepper, green onions, dried leaf thyme, pepper, okra, instant white rice, boiled ham, lemon juice
targets: title: shrimp jambalaya ingredients: 12 oz. shrimp, shelled and deveined 1 tbsp. vegetable oil 2 cloves garlic, minced water 1 14 oz. can chicken broth 1 14 1/2 oz. can stewed tomatoes 1/4 tsp. salt 1/2 tsp. liquid red pepper 2 green onions, chopped 1/2 tsp. dried leaf thyme, crushed 1/4 tsp. pepper 1 10 oz. pkg. frozen cut okra 2 c. instant white rice 2 oz. boiled ham, chopped 2 tsp. lemon juice directions: saute shrimp in oil in large nonstick skillet over medium heat until opaque. remove set aside. add garlic to skillet. saute 30 seconds. add enough water to broth to make 2 cups. add tomatoes, broth mixture, salt, thyme and pepper to skillet. bring to boil. add okra. lower heat, cover and simmer 10 minutes or until okra is tender. remove from heat stir in rice, ham, shrimp, lemon juice and red pepper. cover let stand 5 minutes. sprinkle green onions on top. serves 4.

inputs: lemonade concentrate, bacardi superior white rum, water, liquid from maraschino cherry, long stemed maraschino cherries
targets: title: grandmas frozen boozy pink lemonade ingredients: 1 cup lemonade concentrate 1 cup bacardi superior white rum 1 cup tonic water 14 cup liquid from maraschino cherry or just enough to turn liquid to pale pink 6 8 long stemed maraschino cherries 2 4 cups ice as needed directions: mix liquid ingredients into pitcher add enough ice and liquid mixture to blender do not fill beyond half full and blend until drink is frothy and smooth. continue until all the liquid mixture has been blended serve in tall glass with long stemed maraschino cherry as a garnish.

inputs: low salt, unsweetened coconut milk, green onions, curry powder, fresh lemongrass, fresh ginger, chicken, baby spinach leaves, lime juice, fresh cilantro, wedges, cooker
targets: title: curried chicken coconut soup ingredients: 3 cups low salt chicken broth 1 13.5 ounce can unsweetened coconut milk 3/4 cup chopped green onions 2 1/2 tablespoons curry powder 1 1/2 tablespoons minced fresh lemongrass from about 4 stalks 1 tablespoon minced peeled fresh ginger 4 large chicken thighs with bones about 1 1/2 pounds 1 6 ounce package baby spinach leaves 3 tablespoons fresh lime juice 1/4 cup chopped fresh cilantro lime wedges special equipment pressure cooker directions: combine first 6 ingredients in 6 to 8 quart pressure cooker. remove skin from chicken add chicken to cooker. lock lid in place. bring to high pressure over high heat. cook 8 minutes, adjusting heat as necessary to maintain high pressure. remove from heat. let pressure come down naturally 8 minutes. quick release any remaining pressure. slowly release lid, standing back and allowing steam to escape. transfer chicken to work surface cool briefly. remove bones. cut chicken into 1/2 inch cubes. return chicken to soup add spinach. simmer until spinach wilts, about 1 minute. add lime juice. season soup to taste with salt and pepper. ladle soup into bowls sprinkle with cilantro. serve, passing lime wedges separately. available at asian markets and in the produce section of some supermarkets.

inputs: cookie dough, butter, confectioners, egg, vanilla, flour, swedish ruby drops, favorite jelly, colored crystal sugar, nuts, norwegian wreaths, orange zest, egg, sugar, candied red cherries, green glazed cherries
targets: title: cookies around the world 4 of 5 ingredients: basic cookie dough 1 cup butter or 1 cup margarine, softened 1 1/2 cups confectioners sugar 1 egg 1 teaspoon vanilla 2 1/2 cups all purpose flour swedish ruby drops 1/2 cup favorite jelly 1/4 cup colored crystal sugar optional 1/4 cup finely chopped nuts optional norwegian wreaths 1 teaspoon orange zest 1 egg white, slightly beaten 2 tablespoons granulated sugar 12 candied red cherries 12 green glazed cherries or 12 citron directions: basic cookie dough cream butter and sugar. beat in egg and vanilla. add flour slowly, and mix well. divide in two. swedish ruby drops. use 1/2 cookie dough. preheat oven to 375. shape cookie dough by rounded teaspoon into balls. balls can be rolled in colored sugar or dip in slightly beaten egg white and roll in finely chopped nuts. place 1 inch apart on ungreased baking sheet. press thumb deeply into center of each. bake 10 12 minutes or until set but not brown. fill thumbprint with jelly. norwegian wreaths. preheat oven to 375. mix into 1/2 basic dough orange peel. shape dough by rounded teaspoonfulls into pencil like strips about 5 inches long. form strip into a circle, overlapping 1/2 inch at each end. brush tops with slightly beaten egg white. sprinkle with granulated sugar. press bits of red cherries on center of overlap for berries. add leaves chopped from green cherries. bake on ungreased baking sheet 8 10 minutes until set but not brown. immediately remove from baking sheet.

inputs: baking potatoes, extra virgin olive oil, salt, scallions, handful
targets: title: mashed potatoes with olive oil, scallions, and parsley ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds baking potatoes 6 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil salt and pepper about 6 scallions, chopped handful of chopped flat leaf parsley directions: peel and boil the potatoes in salted water until soft. drain, keeping about 1/2 cup of the cooking water. mash the potatoes and beat in the olive oil. add salt and pepper to taste and a little of the cooking waterenough to make a soft, slightly moist texture. then stir in the scallions and the chopped parsley.

inputs: teriyaki marinade, honey, red pepper, chicken
targets: title: spicy teriyaki grilled wings ingredients: 1 5 ounce package teriyaki marinade, divided 2 tablespoons honey 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes 3 lbs chicken wings directions: mix honey, 2 tablespoons of marinade and crushed red pepper in a large bowl. set aside. place chicken wings in large resealable plastic bag. add remaining marinade turn to coat well. refrigerate 30 minutes or longer for extra flavor. remove chicken from marinade. discard any remaining marinade. grill wings over medium heat 20 to 25 minutes or until cooked through, turning occasionally. add wings to bowl with marinade mixture toss to coat well. sprinkle with additional crushed red pepper and sliced green onions before serving, if desired.

inputs: flour, whole wheat flour, sugar, yeast, buttermilk, canola oil
targets: title: whole wheat buttermilk rolls ingredients: 1 1/2 cups self rising flour 1 1/2 cups whole wheat flour 1/3 cup sugar 1 package 1/4 ounce quick rise yeast 1 cup buttermilk 1/4 cup canola oil directions: in a large bowl, combine the self rising flour, 3/4 cup whole wheat flour, sugar and yeast. in a small saucepan, heat buttermilk and oil to 120 130 mixture will appear curdled . add to dry ingredients beat just until smooth. stir in remaining whole wheat flour. turn onto a lightly floured surface knead until smooth and elastic, about 6 8 minutes. cover and let rest for 10 minutes. roll dough to 1/2 in. thickness cut with a floured 2 1/2 in. biscuit cutter. place 2 in. apart on coated with cooking spray. cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled, about 35 40 minutes. bake at 375 for 8 12 minutes or until golden brown. serve warm.

inputs: bread, brown sugar, heavy cream, butter, cinnamon sugar
targets: title: key s cafe famous caramel rolls ingredients: 2 loaves frozen bread dough, thawed 1 lb. 3 cups packed brown sugar 3/4 cup heavy cream 10 ounces butter, melted 1 cup cinnamon sugar mixture directions: blend brown sugar and butter in a 9x13 pan, add cream. spread over bottom of pan. flatten bread dough, sprinkle cinnamon sugar mixture on top and roll up and cut each loaf into 4 pieces. place on top of caramel mixture in pan. let rise in a warm place to double in size or overnight. bake at 350f degrees for about 45 minutes or until brown on top.

inputs: sugar, oleo, milk, minute oatmeal, peanut butter
targets: title: no bake peanut butter cookies ingredients: 2 c. sugar 1/4 lb. oleo 1/2 c. milk 3 c. minute oatmeal 3/4 c. peanut butter directions: bring first 3 ingredients to a boil and boil hard for 1 1/2 minutes. remove pan from heat and add oatmeal and peanut butter. mix fast. drop by spoonful or press in a pan cool.

inputs: oysters, soy sauce, sugar, white vinegar, chicken broth, sesame oil, peanut oil, sweet red bell peppers, scallions
targets: title: steamed oysters with black beans ingredients: 12 each oysters shucked 1 tablespoon soy sauce, tamari 1 1/2 teaspoons sugar 1 tablespoon white vinegar distilled 2 tablespoons chicken broth 2 teaspoons sesame oil 1 tablespoon peanut oil 1 tablespoon sweet red bell peppers minced 1 small scallions, spring or green onions sliced directions: place the oysters on a large heatproof dish. divide the black beans evenly and place atop each oyster. in a small bowl, combine the soy sauce, wine, sugar, vinegar, chicken stock, sesame oil, distribute the mixture over each oyster. in a wok with a steamer rack or in a steamer pot, bring 6 cups of water to a boil over high heat. place the dish on the steamer rack, cover and steam the oysters until plumped and opaque, 2 to 3 minutes. do not overcook or the oysters will be tough. sprinkle the red pepper and scallion on top. place 2 oysters on each of 6 serving plates.

inputs: eggs, tapioca, sugar, rhubarb, cinnamon
targets: title: rhubarb pie ingredients: two eggs 1 tablespoon minit tapioca or flour or cornstarch . about 3/4 cup sugar 4 5 cups thinly sliced rhubarb cinnamon directions: beat eggs in a bowl. add minit tapioca add sugar add rhubarb sprinkle with cinnamon if desired pour into an 8 inch pie shell and bake at 400 for 45 minutes

inputs: dandelion flowers, flour, salt, black pepper, olive oil
targets: title: fried dandelion blossoms ingredients: 4 cups dandelion flowers no stems 1 cup flour or 1 cup breadcrumbs 1/2 teaspoon salt 1/2 teaspoon black pepper olive oil for frying directions: wash dandelion blossoms in salted water about 3 tablespoons in 1 gallon of water rinse throughly and pat semi dry on a towel. mix flour, salt and pepper in large zip lock bag add dandelion blossoms and shake until coated. fry in hot oil until browned. drain on paper towels and salt to taste. don t forget you can use the dandelion leaves in a salad.

inputs: chicken, salt, butter, mushrooms, italian seasoning, onion, sherry, fluffy rice
targets: title: chicken in wine crock pot ingredients: 3 lbs chicken parts preferably breasts thighs, but whatever you want works salt and pepper 2 tablespoons butter 1 4 ounce can sliced mushrooms, drained 1 teaspoon italian seasoning 1 medium onion, sliced 12 cup dry sherry fluffy rice directions: rinse chicken parts and pat dry. season chicken lightly with salt and pepper. in skillet, melt butter and quickly brown chicken parts. place chicken in crock pot. meanwhile, saute onion and mushrooms in skillet. add sherry to skillet and stir, scraping to remove browned bits. pour contents of skillet into crock pot over chicken. sprinkle with italian seasoning. cover and cook on low 8 hours high 4 hrs . serve chicken over fluffy rice and spoon sauce over top.

inputs: red and, pineapple, coconut, pecans, eggs, butter, sugar, flour, rum flavoring, brandy flavoring, vanilla
targets: title: light fruit cake ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. red and green cherries 1 1/2 lb. pineapple white and green 1 lb. coconut 1 1/2 lb. shelled pecans 6 eggs 1/2 lb. butter 2 c. sugar 3 c. plain flour 1 tbsp. rum flavoring 1 tbsp. brandy flavoring 1 tbsp. vanilla directions: cream sugar and butter. add eggs, one at a time beat well. add flour, one cup at a time. beat well after each addition. add flavorings and mix well. cut fruit in small pieces and mix with coconut and nuts. pour batter over fruit and nut mixture and mix well. bake in tube pan. start baking at 300 for 45 minutes. then turn down temperature to 275 for 1 1/2 hours. this cake can be frozen.

inputs: flour, milk, sugar, yeast, water, butter, eggs
targets: title: quick spoon rolls ingredients: 4 c. self rising flour 1 c. instant nonfat dry milk powder 1/2 c. sugar 1 pkg. dry yeast 2 c. water 1 c. butter flavored shortening 2 eggs, slightly beaten directions: combine first 4 ingredients in a large bowl set aside. combine water and shortening in a saucepan heat until shortening melts, stirring occasionally. cool to 120 to 130 . add shortening mixture and eggs to flour mixture stir until blended. cover with heavy duty plastic wrap let stand 30 minutes. spoon into lightly greased muffin pans. bake at 350 for 20 minutes or until golden brown. remove from pans immediately. yield 2 dozen.

inputs: green tomatoes, salt, pepper, white cornmeal, bacon drippings
targets: title: fried green tomatoes ingredients: 2 medium green tomatoes 1/2 tsp. salt 1/2 tsp. pepper 1/2 c. white cornmeal 1/4 c. bacon drippings directions: slice tomatoes 1/4 inch thick sprinkle with salt and pepper. coat tomato slices with cornmeal. add to hot bacon drippings in skillet over medium heat. cook until brown on both sides drain. serves 3.

inputs: bell peppers, salt, ground beef, onion, garlic, mushrooms, oregano, salt, tomatoes, worcestershire sauce, olives, rice, broth, cheddar cheese, pasta sauce, water
targets: title: stuffed bell pepper ingredients: 6 bell peppers any color salt 1 lb ground beef mixture of ground pork, veal and beef 13 cup onion, chopped 2 garlic cloves, minced 8 ounces mushrooms, chopped 2 teaspoons dried italian herb seasoning just use whatever is on hand, basil, oregano etc salt and pepper 1 14 1/2 ounce can diced tomatoes 2 teaspoons worcestershire sauce 1 4 ounce can olives, sliced 12 cup uncooked rice 12 cup broth 2 cups shredded cheddar cheese or any kind of cheese you prefer 2 cups pasta sauce whatever one you like water, as needed directions: bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. cut the peppers in half and remove the seeds and ribs. cook peppers in boiling water for 5 minutes drain. sprinkle salt inside each pepper, and set aside. in a large skillet, saute onions and garlic until translucent. add mushrooms and cook until mushrooms browned and tender. add beef and cook until beef browned. drain off excess fat, and season with salt, pepper and dried herbs. stir in the tomatoes, rice, 1/2 cup broth, sliced olives and worcestershire sauce. cover, and simmer for 20 25 minutes, or until rice is tender. remove from heat, and stir in 1 cup of cheese. preheat oven to 350 degrees f. stuff each pepper with the beef and rice mixture, and place peppers open side up in a baking dish. pour pasta sauce over the peppers. sprinkle with additional cheese. bake covered for 25 to 35 minutes, until heated through and cheese is melted and bubbly.

inputs: stone ground yellow cornmeal, all purpose, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, salt, freshly ground black pepper, eggs, tomato powder, buttermilk, unsalted butter, nonstick cooking spray
targets: title: tomato corn bread ingredients: 1 1/2 cups stone ground yellow cornmeal 1/2 cup all purpose flour 2 tablespoons sugar 1/2 teaspoon baking powder 1/2 teaspoon baking soda 1 1/4 teaspoons fine salt 1/4 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper 2 large eggs 3 tablespoons tomato powder see sources 1 1 /2 cups buttermilk 8 tablespoons 1 stick unsalted butter, melted nonstick cooking spray directions: heat a dry cast iron skillet in the lower third of the oven while preheating the oven to 425f. whisk together the cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, salt, and pepper in a bowl. whisk together the eggs, tomato powder, and buttermilk in a bowl. add to the flour mixture with the melted butter and whisk until just combined. carefully remove the hot pan from the oven and spray the bottom and sides with nonstick cooking spray. scrape the batter into the pan and bake until light golden brown and a tester inserted into the center comes out with a few moist crumbs, about 18 minutes. unmold and let cool slightly on a wire rack before cutting into pieces and serving.

inputs: olive oil, garlic, onion, mushrooms, barley, white wine, vegetable stock, tomato, peas, salt, romano cheese
targets: title: barley risotto ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive oil 2 cloves garlic, minced 1/2 chopped onion 1 cup sliced mushrooms 1 1/2 cups barley 1/4 cup white wine 4 cups vegetable stock 1 cup fresh diced tomato 1 cup peas salt and pepper grated romano cheese directions: in olive oil, saute onion and garlic until softened. add mushrooms, cook until browning. add barley and cook for 5 minutes until lightly toasted. add white wine, add 3 c stock, tomato, salt pepper. bring to boil, cover and simmer 25 minutes, stirring occasionally. add peas and some additional broth if needed, simmer an additional 10 15 minutes stir in cheese, and more salt pepper if needed.

inputs: butter, margarine, oats, sugar, all purpose, corn syrup, milk, vanilla extract, salt, milk chocolate
targets: title: milk chocolate florentine cookies ingredients: 2/3 cup butter margarine 2 cups quick oats, uncooked 1 cup sugar 2/3 cup all purpose flour 1/4 cup corn syrup 1/4 cup milk 1 tsp. vanilla extract 1/4 tsp. salt 1 pkg. 12 oz. nestle toll house milk chocolate morsels directions: preheat oven to 375f. melt butter in medium saucepan over low heat. remove from heat. stir in oats, sugar, flour, corn syrup, milk, vanilla extract and salt mix well. drop by measuring teaspoonfuls, about 3 apart, onto foil lined cookie sheets. spread thin with rubber spatula. bake 5 7 minutes. cool on cookie sheets. peel foil away from cookies. melt nestle toll house milk chocolate morsels over hot not boiling water stir until smooth. spread chocolate on flat side of half the cookies. top with remaining cookies.

inputs: white bread, milk, garlic, salt, pepper, ground beef, american cheese
targets: title: grilled jucy lucy burgers ingredients: 2 slices white bread, hearty and torn into rough pieces 14 cup milk 1 teaspoon garlic powder 34 teaspoon salt 12 teaspoon pepper 1 12 lbs ground beef, 85 lean 1 slice american cheese, from deli 1/2 inch thick and cut into quarters directions: using a potato masher, mash bread, milk, garlic powder, salt, and pepper in large bowl until smooth. add beef and gently knead until well combined. divide meat mixture into 4 equal portions. mold each piece of meat around 1 piece of cheese. transfer patties to plate and refrigerate for 30 minutes or up to 24 hours. grill burgers over medium fire until well browned and cooked through, 6 8 minutes per side. transfer to plate, tent with foil, and let rest 5 minutes. serve. for stovetop . heat 2 teaspoons vegetable oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat until just smoking. add patties and cook until well browned, about six minutes. flip burgers, cover skillet, and continue cooking until well done, about 6 minutes. transfer to plate, tent with foil, and let rest 5 minutes. serve. cooks note . it is essential to completely seal in the cheese. using 1/2 of each portion of meat, encase the cheese to form a mini burger patty. mold remaining 1/2 portion of meat around the mini patty and seal the edges to form a ball. flatten the ball with the palm of your hand, forming a 3/4 thick patty.

inputs: powdered sugar, corn oil, pineapple, vanilla instant pudding
targets: title: pineapple cake ingredients: 1 box duncan hines yellow cake mix 3 tbsp. powdered sugar 3 tbsp. corn oil 1 large can undrained pineapple 1 box vanilla instant pudding 1 large box cool whip directions: combine cake mix, sugar and oil. mix cake according to directions on box. bake. let cool. cut layer in half.

inputs: butter, brown sugar, granulated sugar, egg, vanilla extract, flour, baking soda, salt, semi sweet chocolate chips, pecans, caramels, milk, pecan halves, shortening
targets: title: ultimate turtle cookie bars ingredients: 1/2 cup butter, softened 6 tablespoons brown sugar 6 tablespoons granulated sugar 1 large egg 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract 1 1/4 cups all purpose flour 1/4 teaspoon baking soda 1/4 teaspoon salt 1 cup semi sweet chocolate chips, divided use 1/2 cup pecans, coarsely chopped 24 kraft caramels, unwrapped 1 tablespoon milk 3/4 cup pecan halves 1 teaspoon shortening directions: preheat oven to 350 f. using electric mixer, in a medium bowl, cream butter, brown and white sugars, then egg and vanilla. in another bowl, stir together, flour, baking soda and salt. mix well. add dry ingredients to wet ingredients and mix well until a soft dough forms. stir in 3/4 cup of chocolate chips and 1/2 cup of coarsely chopped pecans. mix until chocolate chips and chopped pecans are evenly distributed in cookie dough. press cookie dough evenly into bottom of an ungreased, 8 inch square baking pan. bake 28 to 33 minutes or until golden brown. remove from oven. meanwhile, in a 1 quart saucepan on stove top, heat 24 caramels and 1 tbs milk over low heat, stirring frequently, until melted and smooth. remove from heat. carefully spread melted caramels evenly over warm cookie bars and sprinkle with pecan halves. cool completely on cooling rack, about 1 hour. in small microwavable bowl, microwave 1/4 cup of semisweet chocolate chips and 1 tsp shortening uncovered on high 30 to 60 seconds, stirring every 15 seconds, until melted and smooth. drizzle over cookie bars. let stand about 30 minutes or until chocolate is set. for bars, cut into 4 rows by 4 rows.

inputs: lemon juice, mustard, anchovy paste, garlic, extra virgin olive oil, farfalle, heart, croutons
targets: title: caesar pasta salad ingredients: 3 tablespoons fresh lemon juice 2 teaspoons dijon mustard 2 teaspoons anchovy paste 1 large garlic clove, minced 1/2 cup extra virgin olive oil 1 lb farfalle bow tie pasta , freshly cooked to tender, rinsed under cold water, and drained 1 romaine heart, chopped 6 cups 2 1/2 oz finely grated parmigiano reggiano 1 1/4 cups 1 cup croutons optional directions: whisk together lemon juice, mustard, anchovy paste, garlic, and olive oil in a large bowl. add pasta, romaine, cheese, and croutons if using, then toss to combine. season with salt and pepper and serve immediately.

inputs: ground sirloin, pepper, butter, mushrooms, onions, worcestershire sauce, philadelphia original cooking creme, italian parsley
targets: title: saucy chopped steak ingredients: 1 lb. ground sirloin 1/2 tsp. pepper 1 tbsp. butter, divided 1 pkg. 8 oz. sliced fresh mushrooms 1/2 cup chopped onions king sooper s 1 lb for 0.99 thru 02/09 1 tbsp. lea perrins worcestershire sauce 1/2 cup philadelphia original cooking creme 2 tbsp. chopped italian parsley directions: mix meat and pepper shape into 4 1/2 inch thick oval patties. melt 1 tsp. butter in large skillet on medium heat. add patties cook 5 min. on each side or until done 160 degrees f . transfer to platter cover to keep warm. melt remaining butter in same skillet. add mushrooms and onions cook and stir 3 min. stir in worcestershire sauce cook and stir 2 min or until onions are crisp tender. add cooking creme cook 2 to 3 min. or until heated through, stirring frequently. spoon over patties top with parsley.

inputs: avocados, lemon juice, salt, pepper, sour cream, mayo, taco seasoning, jalapeno bean, green onions, tomatoes, black pitted olives, cheddar cheese
targets: title: tex mex dip ingredients: 3 medium avocados ripe 2 tbsp. lemon juice 1/2 tsp. salt 1/4 tsp. pepper 1 c. sour cream 1/2 c. mayo 1 pkg. taco seasoning 2 10 oz. cans jalapeno bean dip 1 bunch green onions, chopped 3 medium tomatoes, cored, seeded and chopped 1 6 oz. can black pitted olives, drained and chopped 1 8 oz. pkg. sharp cheddar cheese, shredded directions: peel, pit and mash avocados in medium bowl. add lemon juice, salt and pepper. mix sour cream, mayo and taco seasoning in another bowl. on a large platter, layer as follows bean dip, avocado mix, sour cream mix, onions, olives, tomatoes and cheese. refrigerate until ready to serve. serve with doritos or nacho chips.

inputs: honey, balsamic vinegar, fresh rosemary, olive oil, chicken, salt, black pepper
targets: title: honey rosemary chicken ingredients: 4 tablespoons honey 4 tablespoons balsamic vinegar 4 tablespoons fresh rosemary, chopped 2 tablespoons olive oil 12 skinless chicken thighs 1 teaspoon salt 14 teaspoon black pepper directions: heat oven to 350. in a bowl, combine the honey, vinegar, rosemary and oil mix well. pour half of the marinade into a large resealable plastic bag add the chicken. seal bag and turn to coat refrigerate 2 hours. cover and refrigerate remaining marinade. drain and discard marinade from chicken. place chicken bone side down in a 13x9x2 baking pan. sprinkle with salt and pepper. bake, uncovered, 55 65 minutes, or until juices run clear, basting occasionally with reserved marinade.

inputs: macaroni, lean ground beef, onion, green bell peppers, tomatoes, brooks, sour cream, cheese, crackers
targets: title: chili mac ingredients: 1 box 14 oz deluxe macaroni and cheese with cheese sauce 1 lb lean ground beef 1/2 cup chopped onion 1/2 cup chopped green bell peppers 1 can 14.5 oz petite diced tomatoes 1 can 15.5 oz brooks mild or hot chili beans or bushes chili black beans 1 packages 1.25 oz original chili seasoning mix 1 toppings 1 sour cream 1 shredded cheese 1 crushed crackers directions: prepare shells and cheese according to package directions. in a large skillet over medium heat cook and crumble beef add onions and green peppers and cook till beef is no longer pink. drain and then stir in tomatoes, chill seasoning, beans, and prepared mac and cheese. top with sour cream, cheese and crushed crackers if desired and enjoy.

inputs: chocolate sandwich cookies, cold milk, prehistoric
targets: title: prehistoric pudding ingredients: 1 16 oz. pkg. chocolate sandwich cookies 2 c. cold milk 1 4 serving size pkg. jell o chocolate flavor instant pudding and pie filing 1 8 oz. tub cool whip, thawed 8 to 10 7 oz. paper/plastic prehistoric decorations directions: crush cookies in food processor or zipper style plastic bag with rolling pin. pour milk into large bowl. add pudding mix. beat with wire whisk for 2 minutes. let stand for 5 minutes. stir in whipped topping and 1/2 of the crushed cookies.

inputs: flour, milk, mayonnaise
targets: title: mayonnaise bread ingredients: 1 c. self rising flour 1/2 c. milk 2 tbsp. mayonnaise directions: mix flour and mayonnaise in mixing bowl. add milk, a small amount at a time, mixing well. spoon into well greased muffin pan. bake at 400 for 20 minutes. makes six muffins. they are like rolls.

inputs: pumpkin, butter, sugar, cinnamon, ginger, eggs, milk, water, salt, flour, sugar, cinnamon, ginger, butter, pecans
targets: title: pompuna pumpkin souffle ingredients: 4 12 cups pumpkin canned pumpkin may be used or pompuna 12 cup butter or 12 cup margarine, softened 2 cups sugar 12 teaspoon cinnamon 12 teaspoon ginger 6 eggs 1 12 cups milk 1 can evaporated milk and enough water to make 1 1/2 cups 12 cup water drained from cooked pompuna, or fresh water 12 teaspoon salt 12 cup flour 12 cup sugar 1 teaspoon cinnamon 1 teaspoon ginger 12 cup butter or 12 cup margarine 1 cup pecans, chopped or 1/2 cup wheat germ with nuts optional directions: wash unpeeled pumpkin. cut into small pieces, removing seeds. in saucepan, cover pumpkin with slightly salted water. boil until soft. pumpkin may be roasted, if prefered . remove from water cool and peel. set aside 1/2 cup water that pumpkin was boiled in mash pumpkin slightly. if using canned pumpkin, pick up recipe at this point.... . in large mixing bowl, cream together butter and sugar. add remaining souffle ingredients and mix well. pour mixture into 9x13 or larger baking dish. bake at 350 for 1 hour, or until set in center. combine topping ingredients. after souffle has baked, sprinkle topping over it and broil until golden brown. watch closely

inputs: cream cheese, chili with beans, black olives, ro tel tomatoes
targets: title: chili dip ingredients: 1 8 oz. pkg. cream cheese 1 can chili with beans 1 can black olives, sliced 1/2 can ro tel tomatoes, diced or salsa directions: melt cheese in small crock pot or microwave until softened. add chili and heat, mixing well. add other ingredients mix well. heat as desired. serve with chips.

inputs: penne, onions, olive oil, merguez sausages, tomato paste, chicken broth, fresh parsley, salt
targets: title: tunisian penne ingredients: 375 g penne or 375 g short pasta 2 onions, minced 2 tablespoons olive oil 350 g merguez sausages or 350 g fresh chorizo sausage, cut in diagonal sections of 1 inch 2 tablespoons tomato paste 1 cup chicken broth 3 tablespoons fresh parsley, chopped salt and pepper directions: in a saucepan with salted boilling water, cook pasta until al dente. drain and oil a little bit. set aside. in a large skillet, brown the onions in oil. add salt and pepper. add sausages and cook until they are golden on each sides. add tomato paste and cook 1 minute. add chicken broth and stir well. bring to boil and let simmer slowly until sausages are cooked. add pasta and reheat. add parsley and adjust seasonings.

inputs: tomato paste, water, onion, green pepper, garlic, oil, oregano, sweet basil, bay leaf, sugar, salt, pepper
targets: title: spaghetti sauce ingredients: 3 6 ounce cans tomato paste 7 6 ounce cans water 1 medium onion, chopped 14 cup green pepper, chopped 2 garlic cloves, minced or 12 teaspoon garlic powder 14 cup oil 14 teaspoon oregano 1 teaspoon sweet basil 1 small bay leaf 1 tablespoon sugar 12 tablespoon salt 14 teaspoon pepper directions: in a 8 quart pan saute onion, green pepper and garlic in oil. add tomato paste and water. stir until smooth, then add rest of the seasonings. for meat sauce in addition to the above ingredients, brown 1 pound italian sausage and 1 pound of ground beef and add to sauce. simmer uncovered for 1 to 2 hours.

inputs: extra virgin olive oil, red wine vinegar, mustard, honey, kosher salt, mixed tender greens, torn tender herbs, kosher salt
targets: title: everyday greens salad ingredients: 1 1/2 cups extra virgin olive oil 3/4 cup any combination red wine vinegar, white wine vinegar, and/or apple cider vinegar 1 tbsp. dijon mustard 1 tbsp. honey kosher salt 8 oz. mixed tender greens 1 cup torn tender herbs optional kosher salt directions: combine oil, vinegars, mustard, and honey in a large resealable jar or airtight container cover and shake vigorously until emulsified, about 30 seconds. season with salt. vinaigrette can be made 1 month ahead. cover and chill. shake to re emulsify. drizzle 3 tbsp. vinaigrette into a large bowl, coating sides and bottom of bowl. add greens and herbs if using . using your hands, fold greens, working from the bottom, out and up the sides of the bowl, until evenly coated in vinaigrette. season with salt until greens taste vibrant you may need to season and toss a few times . mound salad, higher than wide, on plates or in shallow bowls.

inputs: chicken livers, onion, chicken, garlic, salt, eggs
targets: title: chopped liver ingredients: 1 lb. chicken livers 1 medium onion, sliced 1/4 c. chicken fat schmaltz garlic to taste salt to taste 2 hard boiled eggs directions: fry onions and liver in chicken fat. grind or process with eggs. season to taste.

inputs: flour, soda, cinnamon, salt, shortening, sugar, brown sugar, eggs, nuts
targets: title: refrigerator cookies ingredients: 3 1/2 c. flour 1 tsp. soda 1 tbsp. cinnamon 1/2 tsp. salt 1 c. shortening 1 c. sugar 1 c. packed brown sugar 2 beaten eggs 1 c. chopped nuts directions: sift first 4 ingredients together. cream shortening and sugars add eggs. add dry ingredients and chopped nuts. divide dough into equal parts shape into long rolls. wrap and put into refrigerator over night. slice 1/4 inch thick and bake on ungreased cookie sheet 5 7 minutes at 425 .

inputs: ground beef, onion, hot sauce, honey, garlic salt, red pepper, black pepper, blue cheese, buns, red pepper, portabella mushrooms
targets: title: blue cheese stampede ingredients: 2 lbs ground beef 14 cup chopped onion 3 tablespoons hot sauce, like tabasco 2 tablespoons honey 1 tablespoon garlic salt 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes 1 teaspoon black pepper 6 ounces blue cheese, cut in 6 pieces 6 hamburger buns, toasted roasted red pepper from a jar 6 portabella mushrooms, grilled directions: pre heat grill to med high heat. combine beef,onion,hot sauce,honey,garlic salt,red pepper flakes and pepper in large bowl. mix well. divide into 6 portions form into patties around the blue cheese. grill 8 10 mins or until done. place patties on buns and top with roasted peppers and mushrooms.

inputs: ground beef, onion, green bell pepper, italian seasoning, salt, tomato paste, water, ricotta cheese, egg, mozzarella cheese, noodles
targets: title: lisa s lasagna ingredients: 1 pound lean ground beef 1 onion, chopped 1 green bell pepper, chopped 1 teaspoon italian seasoning salt and pepper to taste 2 6 ounce cans tomato paste 2 1/4 cups water 1 pint part skim ricotta cheese 1 egg 2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese 8 lasagne noodles, cooked and drained directions: brown meat with onions and bell peppers, and season to taste. add tomato paste and water. let simmer. in a mixing bowl, mix ricotta cheese with beaten egg. set aside. preheat oven to 370 degrees f 190 degrees c . butter a 9 x 13 inch baking dish. begin layering all ingredients beginning with a few spoonfuls of tomato sauce. follow with noodles, then ricotta mixture, and shredded mozzarella. repeat until dish is filled. bake at 375 degrees f 190 degrees c about 35 to 45 minutes, until bubbly. let cool a couple of minutes before cutting.

inputs: broccoli, shrimp, eggs, mayonnaise, vinegar, salt
targets: title: broccoli and shrimp tartare salad ingredients: 1 head broccoli 12 shrimp 2 boiled eggs 5 tbsp mayonnaise 1 tsp whole grain mustard 1 tsp rice vinegar 1 salt and black pepper directions: remove the broccoli from the stump separate into smaller florets or bite sized bunches, steam in the microwave, drain, and sprinkle with salt. boil and peel the shrimp. boil the egg and mix with the chopped ingredients. mix together all the ingredients and season with salt and pepper. broccoli and shrimp salad. avocado and prawn cocktail salad. shrimp caesar salad. deli style kabocha salad. spring cabbage coleslaw.

inputs: philadelphia, garam masala, red chili powder, chicken breasts, yogurt, water, ground coriander, saffron threads, fresh coriander
targets: title: murgh mussallam ingredients: 1 pkg. 300 g frozen chopped spinach, thawed 1/4 cup philadelphia herb garlic light cream cheese product, divided 1 tsp. garam masala, divided 3/4 tsp. red chili powder or cayenne pepper, divided 2 large boneless skinless chicken breasts 1 lb./450 g 2 tbsp. plain low fat yogurt 1/4 cup water 1/2 tsp. each ground coriander, ground cumin, and dried fenugreek leaves 1/4 tsp. saffron threads 2 tbsp. chopped fresh coriander cilantro directions: heat oven to 350 degrees f. add spinach to 1 cup boiling water in saucepan cook 2 min. or until spinach is cooked, stirring frequently. drain in colander press out excess liquid. transfer spinach to medium bowl. add 2 tbsp. cream cheese product and 1/4 tsp. each garam masala and chili powder mix well. make long horizontal cut in thickest side of each chicken breast, being careful to not cut through to opposite side. open up each breast place, cut side up, on work surface. spread with spinach mixture roll up, starting at one long side of each. place, seam sides down, in 8 inch square baking dish sprayed with cooking spray. spray lightly with additional cooking spray sprinkle evenly with 1/4 tsp. each of the remaining garam masala and chili powder. mix remaining cream cheese, seasonings, yogurt, water and saffron until blended spoon over chicken. bake 30 min. or until chicken is done 170 degrees f , basting occasionally with sauce in bottom of dish. transfer chicken to cutting board, reserving sauce in dish. cut chicken crosswise into spirals place on platter. spoon sauce over chicken. top with fresh coriander.

inputs: beef tenders, soy sauce, salad oil
targets: title: beef tenders ingredients: beef tenders soy sauce 1/4 c. salad oil or italian dressing directions: marinate 2 beef tenders for 2 or 3 hours in 1/2 bottle of soy sauce and salad oil or italian dressing. bake in 400 oven not broiler for 30 minutes or longer, depending on degree of rareness desired 30 minutes would be about medium . do not turn meat.

inputs: sugar, butter, egg yolks, milk, bananas, flour, baking powder, salt, nuts, raisins, egg whites
targets: title: banana bread ingredients: 1 c. sugar 3 tbsp. butter 3 egg yolks 3/4 c. milk 1 c. mashed bananas 3 c. flour 3 1/2 tsp. baking powder 1/2 tsp. salt 3/4 c. chopped nuts 1 c. scalded raisins 3 egg whites, stiffly beaten directions: cream butter, egg yolks and sugar. add milk and mashed bananas. mix gradually. combine flour, baking powder and salt. beat well. add nuts and raisins mixed with a little flour. fold in beaten egg whites. pour in 2 bread pans, greased and floured. let stand 15 minutes. bake 1 hour. melt butter on top and rub cinnamon on top.

inputs: acorn, salad oil, green peppers, onion, butter, salt
targets: title: baked acorn squash ingredients: 3 medium size acorn squash salad oil 1/2 c. chopped green peppers 1/2 c. chopped onion 3 tbsp. melted butter salt and pepper to taste directions: cut squash in halves. remove seeds and stringy portions. brush cut surfaces with salad oil. arrange cut side down in baking pan. bake at 400 for 30 minutes.

inputs: zucchini, onion, tomatoes, catsup, oregano, garlic powder, salt, vinegar, brown sugar, onion, red chili pepper, clove garlic, ground ginger
targets: title: summer spaghetti sauce ingredients: 1 zucchini 1/2 onion 3 tomatoes 1/4 c. catsup 1/2 tsp. oregano or italian seasoning 1/4 tsp. garlic powder salt and pepper 1 12 oz. jar plum jam 2 tbsp. vinegar 1 tbsp. brown sugar 1 tbsp. finely chopped onion 1 tsp. seeded and finely chopped dried red chili pepper or 1 tsp. crushed red pepper 1 clove garlic, minced 1/2 tsp. ground ginger directions: in a small saucepan, combine plum jam, vinegar, brown sugar, onion, red chili pepper, garlic and ginger. bring mixture to boiling, stirring constantly. remove from heat and cool slightly. refrigerate, covered, overnight. makes 1 1/4 cups.

inputs: eggs, salt, sugar, vanilla, milk, butter, flour, baking powder
targets: title: butter sponge cake ingredients: 2 eggs 1/4 tsp. salt 1 c. sugar 1 tsp. flavoring vanilla or lemon 1/2 c. milk 1 tbsp. butter 1 c. sifted flour 1 tsp. baking powder directions: beat eggs until very light. beat in salt, sugar and flavoring. beat in milk which has been heated to boiling with the butter. add flour and baking powder which were sifted together. pour very quickly into greased and floured pan 1 large layer pan . bake at 350 for about 25 to 30 minutes or until done.

inputs: chocolate, topping, chocolate syrup, brown sugar
targets: title: melted snowman hot chocolate ingredients: 1 tassimo cadbury hot chocolate 2 tbsp. cool whip whipped topping 1 tsp. chocolate syrup 1 tsp. brown sugar directions: prepare 1 t disc tassimo cadbury hot chocolate in mug or large heatproof glass. top with 2 tbsp. thawed cool whip whipped topping and 1 tsp.brown sugar. drizzle with 1 tsp. chocolate syrup.

inputs: vegetable oil, potatoes, olive oil, red onion, garlic, sweet paprika, cayenne pepper, sugar, tomatoes, eggs, parsley
targets: title: patatas bravas con huevos spanish eggs and potatoes ingredients: none none vegetable oil, to deep fry 2 1/4 lb potatoes, peeled, cut into 3/4 inch pieces 1 tbsp olive oil 1 none medium red onion, finely chopped 2 cloves garlic, minced 1 tbsp sweet paprika 1/4 tsp cayenne pepper 1 tsp sugar 1 13.5 oz can chopped tomatoes 8 none eggs, at room temperature 1 tbsp fresh flat leaf parsley, coarsely chopped directions: preheat oven to 350 f. in a large dutch oven, heat vegetable oil over medium heat. deep fry potatoes, in batches, for 5 mins, or until golden brown. drain on paper towels. meanwhile, heat olive oil in large frying pan over medium heat. add onion and garlic. cook for 3 mins, or until softened. add spices and cook for 1 min. add sugar and tomatoes. bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, for 10 mins, or until sauce thickens. let cool slightly then process until smooth. toss with potatoes. transfer to 2 large ramekins. make 8 indentations in mixture and crack an egg in each. bake for 5 mins. serve sprinkled with parsley.

inputs: shortening, sugar, egg, milk, flour, salt, baking powder, corn meal
targets: title: easy cornbread muffins ingredients: 1/3 c. shortening 1 tbsp. sugar 1 egg 1 1/4 c. milk 1 c. flour 1/2 tsp. salt 4 tsp. baking powder 1 c. corn meal directions: cream shortening and sugar. add egg and milk. add flour with salt and baking powder. add corn meal, stirring only enough to mix. fill greased hot muffin pan 2/3 full. bake in hot oven 425 for 25 minutes. makes 1 dozen muffins.

inputs: egg yolks, sugar, flour, bananas, vanilla wafers, carnation milk, water
targets: title: banana pudding ingredients: 3 egg yolks 2 c. sugar 1 tbsp. flour 6 to 8 bananas 1 box vanilla wafers 1 1/2 small cans carnation milk 1 small can water directions: layer dish with vanilla wafers and bananas repeat until dish is full. beat egg yolks until smooth. add sugar and flour. add milk and water. cook on medium heat until thick. let cool. pour over bananas and vanilla wafers.

inputs: beef, pork, potatoes, leeks, carrots, parsley, butter, beef, salt
targets: title: beefy pichelsteiner ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds beef cubed 1 pound pork cubed 1/2 pound veal cubed 1 pound potatoes cubed 2 leeks cut across in slivers 3 carrots cut in thin circles 1/2 celeriac root peeled and cubed 1 tablespoon parsley chopped 2 tablespoons clarified butter 32 ounces beef stock 1 cup peas optional salt/pepper directions: in a large bowl, combine all the veggies. in another bowl, combine all the meat. in a large pot, melt the butter on low/med. add a layer of meat to the bottom of the pot, then a layer of veggies salt and pepper . continue to layer the meat, then veggies and seasonings until all is used. pour the stock over and just to cover. heat the stew to a simmer, cover and cook on low for about 2 hours. sprinkle with fresh chopped parsley and serve.

inputs: macaroni, onion, green pepper, tomatoes, mayo, salt, shrimp
targets: title: macaroni salad ingredients: 1 pkg. macaroni 1 onion 1 green pepper 3 tomatoes 2 c. mayo salt and pepper 1 small can shrimp directions: cook macaroni drain. add the mayo until it mixes smoothly. chop up onion, green pepper and tomatoes. add to the macaroni. blend until it s mixed together. add the shrimp, salt and pepper and mix thoroughly. chill until served. better if chilled overnight.

inputs: potatoes, eggs, onion, bread, milk, margarine, salt
targets: title: potato filling casserole ingredients: 1 c. mashed potatoes fresh made or leftovers 2 eggs, beaten 1 small onion, diced 4 slices bread fresh or old 1 c. milk 2 tbsp. margarine salt and pepper to taste directions: cube bread and onion and brown in margarine. mix eggs with potatoes and seasonings. combine with bread and onion. spoon into greased casserole and pour milk over all. bake 3/4 to 1 hour in 350 oven. you may also use 1/2 pound ground beef, turkey or chicken. may be browned with onions and bread cubes.

inputs: pack, soy sauce, japanese mustard
targets: title: okra natto ingredients: 3 okra 1 pack natto fermented soy beans 1 soy sauce 1 japanese mustard directions: boil the okra in salted water, cool, and thinly slice. put the natto in a dish and top with the okra. gingery meat soboro. okra and plum chilled tofu. okra stuffed chikuwa for bentos.

inputs: cream cheese, caramel ice cream topping, pecans, tart apple, frozen non dairy topping, keebler wheatables crackers
targets: title: caramel pecan cheese dip ingredients: 1 8 ounce package cream cheese, softened 1/4 cup caramel ice cream topping 1/2 cup pecans, chopped and toasted instructions below 1 cup tart apple, chopped 1 cup frozen non dairy topping, thawed cool whip keebler wheatables crackers for serving directions: toasting pecans spread evenly on baking sheet. bake at 350 for 5 10 minutes or until light golden brown, stirring once or twice. to make dip in medium bowl, stir together cream cheese and ice cream topping. stir in pecans. fold in apple and whipped topping. serve with crackers.

inputs: egg yolks, mustard, lemon, salt, pepper, garlic, apple cider vinegar, oil, poppy seed, onion
targets: title: poppy seed dressing ingredients: 2 egg yolks 1 teaspoon dry mustard 1 lemon, juice of 1/2 teaspoon salt 1/2 teaspoon pepper 1 minced garlic clove 1/4 cup apple cider vinegar 3/4 cup poppy seed oil 1 tablespoon poppy seed 1 tablespoon minced onion directions: in blender combine everything but oil and poppy seeds. blend at high speed for 30 seconds. go to lowest speed. slowly add oil it will get creamy if you don t add oil to fast add poppy seeds.

inputs: carrots, butter, sugar, vodka, water, grapes, salt
targets: title: carrots and grapes ingredients: 2 lb. carrots butter 1/8 tsp. sugar 1 tbsp. vodka 1/2 c. water 1 c. malaga grapes, seeded salt and pepper directions: saute carrots, cut in thick diagonal slices, in butter. sprinkle carrots with sugar. cook, stirring, for 1 to 2 minutes. add vodka and water. when almost tender, add grapes. cover and cook until very tender. season with salt and pepper.

inputs: yellow zucchini, ricotta salata cheese, blossoms, salt, freshly ground black peper, extra virgin olive oil
targets: title: shaved summer squash salad ingredients: 2 pounds small yellow zucchini or other yellow summer squash 1/2 pound ricotta salata cheese or mild feta 12 squash blossoms petals only salt freshly ground black peper 3 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil juice from half a lemon directions: using a mandoline or sharp thin bladed knife, cut zucchini into very thin slices lengthwise put in a large, shallow bowl. with a vegetable peeler, shave ricotta salata cheese into narrow, thin slices. tear squash blossoms into strips. season zucchini lightly with salt and pepper toss gently. drizzle with olive oil, then add juice from lemon. taste and adjust the seasoning. on top, scatter cheese, then blossoms. serve immediately.

inputs: flour, lean ground beef, salt
targets: title: poor boy steak ingredients: 1/2 c. flour 1 lb. lean ground beef 1 tsp. salt directions: sprinkle 1/4 cup flour and 1/2 teaspoon salt in an 8 inch baking pan. place raw ground beef over the flour and salt. flatten the meat by patting or with rolling pin. sprinkle the remaining flour and salt on top of the meat. roll or pat lightly until the meat covers the pan evenly and the flour and salt have been absorbed. cut the meat into 6 steaks. bake at 400 for 20 minutes. drain steaks and place in a baking pan. prepare brown gravy. pour gravy over steaks, cover pan and bake at 400 for 25 minutes. makes 6 servings.

inputs: carrot, zucchini, celery, cabbage, butter, vegetable oil, vegetable stock, tomatoes, water, salt, parmesan cheese
targets: title: italian vegetable soup ingredients: 1 cup thinly sliced carrot 1 cup thinly sliced zucchini 1 cup thinly sliced celery 1 cup thinly sliced cabbage 2 tablespoons butter or 2 tablespoons margarine 2 tablespoons vegetable oil 2 vegetable stock cubes or 2 broth 1 14 ounce can diced tomatoes 8 cups water 12 cup spaghetti, uncooked salt and pepper parmesan cheese directions: saute carrots, zucchini, celery and cabbage in oil. cook for 10 minutes. add water, seasoning and bouillion cubes and bring to boil simmer for 20 minutes. add remaining ingredients breaking the spaghetti in small pieces and simmer 20 minutes longer. serve topped with parmesean cheese.

inputs: brown sugar, margarine, bran cereal, pecans, banana, apple, orange, raisins, nonfat yogurt
targets: title: crunchy fruit and yogurt low fat ingredients: 3 tbsp. firmly packed light brown sugar 2 tbsp. margarine 3/4 c. bran cereal 3 tbsp. finely chopped pecans 1 medium banana, sliced about 1 c. 1 medium apple, chopped about 1 c. 1 medium orange, chopped about 1 c. 1/2 c. seedless raisins 1 c. plain nonfat yogurt directions: in small saucepan over medium heat, heat sugar and margarine until melted and thoroughly combined. stir in bran and pecans, tossing to coat well. cool.

inputs: chicken broth, couscous, golden raisin, curry powder, mayonnaise, ground ginger, lemon juice, chicken, celery, green onion, toasted almond, red grapes, fresh parsley
targets: title: curried couscous and chicken salad. ingredients: 1 cup chicken broth 1 cup couscous 1/2 cup golden raisin 1/2 teaspoon curry powder 1 cup mayonnaise 1 teaspoon ground ginger 2 tablespoons lemon juice 3 cups cooked chicken or 3 cups cooked turkey, cubed 1/3 cup celery, chopped 1/4 cup green onion, chopped 1/3 cup toasted almond, finely chopped 1 cup red grapes, quartered 1 tablespoon fresh parsley, chopped directions: bring chicken broth to a boil in microwave or saucepan. combine couscous, raisins, and curry powder in a medium bowl. stir in broth, cover and let stand 5 minutes. fluff couscous with a fork and let cool to room temperature. in a large bowl mix mayonnaise, ginger, and lemon juice. add chicken, celery, green onions, almonds, and cooled couscous mixture. toss gently. fold in grapes and parsley. refrigerate at least 2 hours before serving.

inputs: baking powder, sugar, margarine, milliliters buttermilk, butter, sweet orange marmalade
targets: title: reginas butter biscuits with orange marmalade butter ingredients: 4 cups/480 grams all purpose flour 1/4 cup/30 grams baking powder 1/4 cup/50 grams sugar 1/2 cup/120 grams 1 stick salted butter, chilled and cut into 1 inch cubes 1 1/2 cups/360 grams 3 sticks salted margarine, chilled and cut into 2 inch cubes 1 3/4 cups/420 milliliters buttermilk, chilled 1/2 cup 1 stick /120 grams salted butter, at room temperature 3 tablespoons sweet orange marmalade directions: put flour, baking powder and sugar in the bowl of a stand mixer with a paddle attachment. turn the machine on low and blend for 15 seconds. add the butter, margarine and buttermilk to flour mixture before turning mixer back on. turn mixer on medium and count to 10. this goes very quickly the key is to not overmix the dough. there will be large chunks of butter and margarine, the size of quarters, in the dough. scrape dough from the bowl onto a generously floured work surface or tea towel and shape into a long vertical rectangle about 2 inches thick. the dough will seem rough and messy. using the edges of the towel, fold the lower part of the dough about one third toward the center, then fold the top
