targets: title: it s a cold night fideo soup ingredients: 7 ounces fideo 15 ounces fire roasted tomatoes 4 cups low sodium vegetable broth 2 cups water 1 bunch kale washed, tough stems removed and chopped 1/2 onion chopped 4 cloves garlic crushed 3 tablespoons oil 1/4 cup white wine 2 cups pinto beans cooked, or 1 15 oz. can of pinto beans, rinsed 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin 1/2 teaspoon chile powder salt to taste. directions: in a large stockpot heat 1 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat. add onions and saute until translucent. next add the crushed garlic and stir until a heavenly scent permeates the room. lower heat to low and add kale to the stockpot, a couple handfuls at a time. stir and salt to taste. once leaves are a vibrant green and slightly wilted turn off heat and transfer to a plate. wipe out pot and return to medium heat. add another tablespoon of oil. once oil begins to shimmer place fideo in the pot and stir frequently being careful not burn. cook until golden brown and opaque and it begins to smell nutty, about 5 minutes. add wine to deglaze the pot, making sure to scrape any bits and pieces stuck to the pan. finally add broth, water, tomatoes, beans, cumin and chile powder and sprinkle more salt if needed. bring to a simmer and reintroduce kale mixture to the pot. continue simmering until the fideo softens and soup is heated through. ladle soup into a bowl, grab a blanket and curl up on the couch.

inputs: hamburger, onion, tater, cream of mushroom soup, cream of chicken soup, cream of celery soup, cheddar cheese
targets: title: hamburger tater tot casserole ingredients: 1 to 1 1/2 lb. hamburger meat ground beef or chuck onion, chopped enough tater tots to line the size casserole you need cream of mushroom soup cream of chicken soup cream of celery soup cheddar cheese directions: brown meat and onion. drain grease. line the bottom of a casserole dish with tater tots. spoon meat and onion mixture on top. mix soups together and spread on top of meat. cook in a 350 oven for about 30 to 35 minutes or until bubbly. sprinkle grated cheese on top. let melt. serve hot. serve with a green vegetable and your meal is complete.

inputs: brussels, shallots, lemon, extra virgin olive oil, kosher salt, garlic, mustard, honey, worcestershire sauce, rosemary needles, chicken, italian sausages
targets: title: one pan chicken, sausage, and brussels sprouts recipe ingredients: 1 pound 450g brussels sprouts, trimmed and halved or quartered if very large 5 medium shallots, peeled and quartered 1 lemon, thinly sliced into rounds, seeds discarded 3 tablespoons 45ml extra virgin olive oil, divided kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper 3 medium cloves garlic, minced or grated 1 1/2 tablespoons 20ml dijon mustard 1 1/2 tablespoons 20ml honey 1 tablespoon 15ml worcestershire sauce 3 teaspoons chopped fresh rosemary needles from about 5 sprigs 4 bone in, skin on chicken thighs about 1 1/2 pounds 680g 4 large italian sausages about 1 1/2 pounds total , hot or sweet, cut into 2 inch lengths directions: position rack in lower third of oven and preheat to 450 f 230 c . combine brussels sprouts, shallots, and lemon with 2 tablespoons 30ml oil in a 12 inch cast iron skillet. alternatively, you can use a rimmed baking sheet. season to taste with salt and pepper and toss to coat. in a small bowl, combine garlic, mustard, honey, worcestershire sauce, rosemary, and remaining 1 tablespoon 15ml oil. season with salt and pepper and stir to form a paste. rub paste all over chicken. nestle chicken and sausage pieces on top of brussels sprouts. roast on lower rack until brussels sprouts are browned and tender and an instant read thermometer inserted into coolest part of the chicken registers at least 165 f 75 c , 25 to 30 minutes. if chicken and sausage are done before sprouts have browned enough, you can transfer the meat to a plate and let the vegetables finish in the oven recombine before serving. serve.

inputs: pork tenderloin, envelopeshake, sweet potato, red potatoes, yellow onion, italian dressing
targets: title: pork tenderloin with roasted vegetables ingredients: 1 1 lb pork tenderloin 1 3 ounce envelopeshake and bake crispy pork coating mix 1 lb sweet potato, peeled cut into 1/2 inch cubes 1 lb red potatoes, unpeeled,cut into 1/2 inch cubes 1 medium yellow onion, cut into 1 inch chunks 12 cup kraft zesty italian dressing directions: preheat oven to 450 degrees f. moisten meat with water shake off excess. coat meat with coating mix as directed on package. toss sweet potatoes, red potatoes and onion with dressing. spread evenly into 10x15 inch baking pan top with meat. bake 25 to 30 minutes. stir vegetables after 15 minutes. let stand 5 minutes. slice meat.

inputs: green peppers, onion, garlic salt, tomato sauce, ground beef, salt, rice
targets: title: stuffed green peppers ingredients: 6 large green peppers 2 tbsp. chopped onion 1/8 tsp. garlic salt 1 15 oz. can tomato sauce 1 lb. ground beef 1 tsp. salt 1 c. cooked rice directions: preheat oven to 350 . wash and remove seeds from peppers and place in baking dish. brown ground beef and onion in skillet. drain. stir in salt, rice, garlic salt and 1 cup tomato sauce. lightly stuff peppers. pour remaining tomato sauce over stuffed peppers. cover and bake 45 minutes. uncover and bake 15 minutes.

inputs: bass, ground cumin, salt, fresh ground pepper, tomatoes, green olives, fresh cilantro, extra virgin olive oil
targets: title: halibut picante ingredients: 1 14 lbs halibut or 1 14 lbs striped bass or 1 14 lbs tilapia fillets, cut into 4 portions 1 teaspoon ground cumin, divided 14 teaspoon salt fresh ground pepper 1 10 ounce candiced tomatoes and green chilies 14 cup sliced pimento stuffed green olives 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro 1 teaspoon extra virgin olive oil directions: preheat oven to 450f coat a baking sheet with cooking spray. arrange fish on baking sheet. season with 1/2 teaspoon cumin, salt and pepper. combine tomatoes, olives, cilantro, oil and the remaining 1/2 teaspoon cumin in a small bowl. spoon over the fish. bake the fish until flaky and opaque in the center, 12 to 15 minutes. serve immediately.

inputs: pork chops, cranberries, breadcrumbs, water, butter, celery, green onion, green pepper, garlic salt, fresh ground pepper, fresh sage, cooking oil, brown sugar, soy sauce, garlic
targets: title: cranberry stuffed pork chops ingredients: 4 extra thick pork chops with pockets 3 c. cranberries 1/2 c. breadcrumbs 1 tbsp. hot water 2 tbsp. butter, melted 2 tbsp. minced celery 2 tbsp. minced green onion 2 tbsp. minced green pepper 1 tsp. garlic salt 1 tsp. fresh ground pepper 1 tsp. fresh sage, chopped 1 tbsp. cooking oil 1/4 c. brown sugar 1/4 c. soy sauce garlic salt and fresh ground pepper directions: in a small bowl, combine 1 cup cranberries, breadcrumbs, hot water, butter, celery, onion, green pepper, garlic salt and pepper. sprinkle pork chops with garlic salt and fresh ground pepper to taste. rub in. stuff pockets with cranberry mixture seal with toothpicks.

inputs: beef steak, wine, soy sauce, cornstarch, black pepper, powdered ginger, garlic, oil, frzn pea pods, mushrooms, thin, thin, water chestnuts
targets: title: venison or beef stir fry recipe ingredients: 2 lbs. venison or possibly beef steak, cut across grain into 1/4 inch strips 2 tbsp. wine or possibly beer 2 tbsp. soy sauce 1 tbsp. cornstarch 1/4 teaspoon black pepper 1/4 teaspoon powdered ginger 1/4 teaspoon garlic pwdr 2 tbsp. oil 2 6 ounce. pkg. frzn pea pods 1 c. sliced fresh mushrooms or possibly 1 8 ounce. can sliced mushrooms 1 c. thin sliced carrots 1/2 to 1 c. thin sliced onions 1 6 ounce. can sliced water chestnuts directions: place meat in shallow pan. in small bowl, combine wine, soy sauce, cornstarch, pepper, ginger, garlic pwdr. pour over meat. marinate 1 hour at room temperature or possibly in refrigerator overnight. when ready to cook, pour oil in wok and preheat to 375 degrees. drain meat, reserve marinade. place half of meat in warm oil and stir fry for 3 min or possibly till brown. remove and add in remaining meat and brown. add in onions and fry for 3 min. push up side or possibly remove. add in carrots and fry for 3 min. add in pea pods and fry till completely thawed. add in mushrooms and fry for 1 2 min. add in sliced chestnuts and fry for 1 minute. return all fried ingredients to wok and add in remaining marinade. stir gently to combine all ingredients. reduce heat to simmer. simmer for 4 to 5 min or possibly till heated through. serve with rice or possibly noodles.

inputs: white hominy, hominy, cumin seeds, coriander seeds, baking soda, chiles, olive oil, onions, garlic, salt, black pepper, oregano, tomatoes, vegetable stock, lime juice, fresh cilantro, queso fresco, pumpkin seeds
targets: title: big sky posole ingredients: 2 cups white hominy 2 cups blue hominy 1 teaspoon cumin seeds 1 teaspoon coriander seeds 2 ounces baking soda 4 dried chiles such as pasilla, ancho, or guajillo or any combination of chiles, as long as there is a little variation for increased complexity 4 tablespoons olive oil 3 cups diced onions 6 cloves garlic, minced 1 teaspoon salt, plus more for seasoning 1 teaspoon black pepper, plus more for seasoning 2 teaspoons dried oregano 2 14 ounce cans diced tomatoes, in juice 1 pound tomatillos, peeled and quartered 1 gallon vegetable stock 1/2 cup lime juice 1/2 bunch chopped fresh cilantro leaves, plus more for garnish crumbled queso fresco, for garnish optional toasted pumpkin seeds, for garnish, optional directions: soak the different colors of hominy in separate bowls of water overnight. in a small, dry skillet over high heat, roast the cumin and coriander seeds until they toast, about 2 minutes. when cool, grind in a food mill, mortar and pestle or clean coffee grinder. strain the hominy and put each color variety in its own pot, generously covering with water. add 1 ounce of the baking soda to each pot, bring to a boil, reduce heat and simmer for about 2 hours. add more water as needed. check hominy for tenderness it does not have to be completely cooked as it will be cooked further in the stew. strain and rinse the hominy. while the hominy is cooking, soak the dried chiles in hot water. when softened, remove the seeds and stems, then dice. in a separate stockpot, heat the olive oil and saute the onions and garlic with the salt, black pepper, oregano, cumin and coriander until the onions are translucent. add the diced tomatoes, tomatillos, chiles, vegetable stock and cooked hominy. bring to a boil, then reduce heat to a simmer for about 1 1/2 hours. the posole is done when the hominy is cooked through. add the lime juice, cilantro, and season with salt and pepper, to taste. posole is also delicious for breakfast, served over cornbread with a poached egg on top. cook s note you may use a combination of different kinds/colors of hominy and cook them together in 1 pot. however, the different colors will cook in slightly different times resulting in different consistencies. the blue or red hominy will break down more during cooking than the yellow or white kind. posole, like many stews, improves with age, so cook ahead of time and reheat. it also freezes well. cook s note native corns are available online and at most latino markets.

inputs: baking potatoes, singles, chives, black olives
targets: title: kraft singles cheesy potato slices ingredients: 2 large baking potatoes, cut into 1/2 inch 2 cm slices 6 kraft singles cheese slice, quartered target 2 for 5.00 thru 02/06 garnishes chopped chives, chopped cherry tomato, sliced black olives or crumbled cooked bacon black olives directions: cut potatoes into 1/2 inch 1.2 cm slices place on well greased baking sheet. bake at 450f 230c for 25 30 minutes or until lightly browned on both sides, turning at half time. remove from oven top with cheese. continue to bake until cheese melts. garnish with olives, tomatoes, chives or bacon.

inputs: butter, flour, water, butter, flour, eggs, almond extract, frosting, powdered sugar, butter, almond, cream
targets: title: swedish kringle ingredients: part 1 1/2 cup butter 1 cup all purpose flour 2 4 tablespoons ice water part 2 1 cup water 1/2 cup butter 1 cup flour 3 eggs 1/2 teaspoon almond extract frosting 1 cup powdered sugar 1 tablespoon soft butter 1/4 teaspoon almond extract 1 2 tablespoon cream or 1 2 tablespoon milk directions: part 1 cut butter into flour and add sufficient cold water to form into pie crust, divide into two balls. flatten each into a 3 wide strip on cookie sheet. part 2 put water and butter in saucepan, and heat to boiling. remove from stove and add flour all at once. stir until smooth. add eggs, one at a time, beating until smooth each time. add almond extract and spread onto the strips. bake 425 degrees f for 15 minutes. then 400 degrees for 30 minutes. cool and frost. cut into 1 strips for serving.

inputs: pumpkin pie filling, ricotta cheese, cannellini beans, clove garlic, salt, wonton wrappers, cooking spray, balsamic vinegar, vegetable broth
targets: title: pumpkin ravioli ingredients: 2 cups pumpkin pie filling 1/2 cup ricotta cheese 1/2 cup canned cannellini beans 1 clove garlic salt and ground black pepper to taste 1 16 ounce package wonton wrappers cooking spray 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar 1/2 cup vegetable broth, or to taste directions: combine pumpkin pie filling, ricotta cheese, cannellini beans, and garlic in a food processor or blender process until completely smooth. season with salt and pepper. fill a small bowl with water. place a damp paper towel over the wonton wrappers. grease a baking sheet with cooking spray. drop teaspoonfuls of the pumpkin filling into the center of each wonton wrapper. dip a finger in the bowl of water and run around the edges. fold wrappers in half, sealing the filling inside. arrange filled ravioli on the baking sheet. chill ravioli until filling is set, 5 to 10 minutes. preheat oven to 250 degrees f 120 degrees c . bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. drop 5 to 8 ravioli in the water cook until they float to the top, 4 to 6 minutes. transfer to a baking sheet with a large slotted spoon and keep warm in the preheated oven. repeat with remaining ravioli. pour balsamic vinegar into a large saucepan. bring to a boil over medium heat reduce heat and simmer, whisking constantly, until reduced by half, about 5 minutes. whisk in vegetable broth until sauce reaches desired consistency. drizzle sauce over ravioli.

inputs: shortening, sugar, boiling water, salt, eggs, yeast, water, flour
targets: title: refrigerator rolls ingredients: 1 c. shortening 3/4 c. sugar 1 c. boiling water 1 tsp. salt 2 eggs 3 pkg. yeast 1 c. warm water 5 c. flour directions: cream shortening and sugar with electric mixer add boiling water and mix until shortening melts. add salt and the eggs, one at a time, beating well. add yeast which had been dissolved in warm water. add flour, 1/2 cup at a time. place in well greased mixing bowl, cover and refrigerate. this will keep several days in refrigerator.

inputs: tomato soup, water, flour, beef chuck, carrots, onions, potatoes, celery, mushrooms, italian seasoning, bay leaf, fresh pepper
targets: title: gone all day stew ingredients: 1 10 3/4 oz. can tomato soup 1 c. water or red wine 1/4 c. flour 2 lb. beef chuck, in 2 inch cubes 3 medium carrots, cut in 1 inch diagonal slices 6 onions, quartered 4 medium potatoes, cut in 1 1/2 inch chunks 1/2 c. celery, cut in 1 inch chunks 12 whole fresh mushrooms 2 beef bouillon cubes 1 tbsp. italian seasoning 1 bay leaf 3 grinds fresh pepper directions: mix together soup, water/wine and flour until smooth. combine with remaining ingredients in covered roasting pan. bake at 275 for 4 to 5 hours. serve over noodles or with crunchy french bread to soak up the gravy .

inputs: almond flour, pecans, coconut flakes, raisins, cocoa, coconut oil, honey, salt, cinnamon, gelatin mixed
targets: title: recipe grain free baked granola bar gaps, paleo, egg free ingredients: 1 cup almond flour where to buy almond flour 1 cup pecans chopped 1 cup coconut flakes where to buy 1 cup raisins chopped organic 1/2 cup cocoa nibs where to buy 2 tbsp coconut oil where to buy coconut oil 1 tbsp honey optional where to buy 1 tsp salt where to buy 1 tsp cinnamon where to buy spices 3 tbsp gelatin mixed in 6 8 tbsp water where to buy directions: in the food processor chop the pecans, coconut flakes and raisins, each separately and set aside in one bowl you want small pieces, but larger than a meal consistency so chop for only a few seconds at a time on pulse in the food processor place the almond flour, honey, salt , cinnamon, coconut oil and combine mix the 3 tablespoons of gelatin with 6 8 tablespoons of water, and quickly add to the processor and mix well if you delay, the gelatin will firm up too much add the bowl of chopped raisin, pecans and coconut flakes and add the cocoa nibs and mix just to combine or you could do this in the bowl so it doesn t get chopped any smaller place in a 9 x 13 baking pan that has been lightly oiled and smooth out take the spatula and press the mixture so that it is as dense as can be firm up the sides and flatten again bake at 250 f for 20 25 minutes or until it is slightly browned on top remove and let cool completely slice with a chef s knife into 12 bars wrap in wax paper and freeze or refrigerate for a quick snack on the go

inputs: sugar, water, syrup, whites
targets: title: seafoam candy ingredients: 4 c. sugar 1/2 c. water 1 c. syrup whites of 2 eggs directions: boil sugar, syrup and water until forms a hard ball. beat egg whites and pour together. beat until it begins to get stiff. then put on wax paper in little balls.

inputs: beef, cream of chicken soup, cheddar cheese, shell pasta, milk, onion, whole wheat bread, butter, beefy onion soup
targets: title: corned beef bake ingredients: 1 12 cups cubed corned beef i use the canned kind as its so much more convenient and quick 1 10 3/4 ounce cream of chicken soup 8 ounces sharp cheddar cheese, cubed 1 cup small shell pasta, cooked and drained 1 cup milk 12 cup chopped onion 2 whole wheat bread, slices cubed small with crusts cut off 2 tablespoons butter or 2 tablespoons margarine, melted 1 1 ounce envelope lipton beefy onion soup mix from a 2 envelope box directions: in bowl, combine corned beef, soup, cheese, pasta, milk, onion and lipton soup mix. transfer to greased 2 quart casserole. toss bread cubes with butter or margarine and sprinkle over top. bake uncovered at 350f for 40 45 minutes or until golden brown. let stand 10 minute before serving.

inputs: fennel seeds, rosemary, garlic, fresh sage, lemon s, fennel pollen, kosher salt, cracked black pepper, extra virgin olive oil, onions, crown roast
targets: title: crown roast of pork with fennel, lemon and garlic ingredients: 2 1/2 teaspoons fennel seeds 4 5 sprigs worth of rosemary leaves 7 8 cloves of garlic, coarsely chopped 1/3 cup fresh sage leaves with tender sprigs 1 lemon s peel in thin strips 2 teaspoons fennel pollen optional 1 1/4 tablespoons kosher salt 1 1/4 teaspoons cracked black pepper 7 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil 4 large onions, peeled and sliced into 1/4 inch slices 1 assembled crown roast 18 ribs directions: i got my roast assembled already, as doing it yourself is quite tricky bring the meat to room temperature for at least 1.5 hours before roasting. in small skillet, toast fennel seeds until fragrant, 1 to 2 minutes. place toasted fennel seeds, rosemary, garlic, sage, lemon peel, fennel pollen if using and all of the salt and pepper in a food processor. pulse processor to chop everything up, then add olive oil slowly, and blend until the mixture becomes a paste, scraping down sides occasionally with a rubber spatula. wipe pork very dry with paper towels, then smear the herb paste all over the meat, making sure to coat the middle and the crevices on the sides of the chops. wrap in plastic wrap and let marinate for 24 hours in the refrigerator. heat oven to 450 degrees. put a thin film of olive oil in the bottom of your roasting pan and spread it around with your fingers. place onion slices down to form a rack for your roast. drizzle a bit of olive oil on top of the onions and salt and pepper them. place your roast on top and roast for 20 minutes at 450 degrees, then turn heat down to 350 and continue roasting until meat registers 145 degrees on an instant read thermometer, about 1 1/2 to 2 hours longer. let rest 20 minutes before carving.

inputs: boneless beef cube, oil, mixed spice, garlic, yellow split peas, red lentil, oats, turmeric, chili powder, salt, garam masala, ginger, onion, cilantro, green chilies
targets: title: gluten free haleem ingredients: 1 lb boneless beef cube 2 tablespoons oil 1 package shan haleem mixed spice use less for less spice 2 tablespoons garlic paste 2 cups yellow split peas yellow split chana 1 cup red lentil masoor daal 2/3 cup oats 1/2 teaspoon turmeric 1 teaspoon chili powder 1 teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon garam masala 4 tablespoons ginger julienne for garnish 1 onion thinly sliced, 4 tbsp for garnish after fried 4 tablespoons cilantro chopped for garnish 5 green chilies chopped for garnish 4 limes garnish directions: soak lentils and oats overnight or for at least 2 hours. fry the meat in oil. add spice mix, garlic,and fry. add 6 8 glasses of water. cover and leave on low flame to tenderize until the meat is extremely soft. meanwhile, put the oats and lentils in a pot with 1 teaspoons salt, 1 tsp chili powder and 1/2 tsp turmeric. add water and cook on low flame till very soft. fry onion in oil for baghar and for garnishing. add the oil to the mixture and keep aside the fried onion for garnishing. fry the onions on medium heat and add salt, making the onions more crispy. when meat and the grains are soft, mix them together, add part of fried onions. leave on a very low flame and keep mixing and mashing. i like to use hand blender. remove from heat and serve with garam masala, chat masala, fresh cilantro leaves, green chilies, ginger, fried onions and limes.

inputs: butter, oranges, wesson oil, eggs
targets: title: pig picken cake ingredients: 1 box duncan hines butter flavor cake mix 1 11 oz. can mandarin oranges and juice 1/2 c. wesson oil 4 eggs directions: mix first 4 ingredients together. pour into 4 8in. cake pans. bake at 325 degrees for 15 minutes. allow to cool completely. frost and refrigerate.

inputs: duck, kosher salt, black peppercorns, peppercorns, cumin seeds, five spice powder, scallions, flour, peanut oil, chinese mandarin, hoisin sauce
targets: title: jean georges vongerichten s crispy aromatic duck ingredients: 16 pound duck 23 cup kosher salt 1/4 cup black peppercorns 5 tablespoons sichuan peppercorns 3 tablespoons cumin seeds 2 tablespoons five spice powder 63 by 1/8 inch slices peeled fresh ginger root 12 scallions, 6 cut into 3 inch lengths, 6 finely shredded flour for dusting 1 to 2 cups peanut oil chinese mandarin pancakes see note hoisin sauce directions: rinse and dry the duck. rub it inside and out with a mixture of salt, peppercorns, cumin and spice powder, then refrigerate in a plastic bag overnight. brush the spices off the duck and stuff the ginger and 3 inch lengths of scallion into the cavity. steam, covered, for 2 hours, adding boiling water as necessary. remove the duck and discard the ginger and scallions. cool until dry, about 2 hours. cut the duck into quarters, dust with flour and shake off excess. fry the legs and thighs in peanut oil for 12 to 15 minutes, breasts 8 to 10 minutes, until crisp. drain, and when cool, shred the meat with a fork. to serve, brush each pancake with hoisin to taste, add some shredded duck and scallions and roll up as for peking duck.

inputs: cucumbers, onion, buttermilk, potatoes
targets: title: cold cucumber soup ingredients: 3 to 4 cucumbers, peeled and thinly sliced 1 small onion, thinly sliced 1 pt. half and half 1 qt. buttermilk diced, cooked potatoes directions: salt onions and cucumbers. let stand in the refrigerator for 2 hours or overnight. add half and half and buttermilk to cucumber mixture mix well. serve over hot potatoes. good on a hot summer day.

inputs: flour, white sugar, shortening, rabbit molasses, boiling water, baking soda
targets: title: aunt alice s shoo fly cake ingredients: 4 c. flour 2 c. white sugar 3/4 c. shortening 1 c. brer rabbit molasses 2 c. boiling water 2 tsp. baking soda directions: mix first 3 ingredients until crumbly. reserve 1 cup crumbs. combine molasses, boiling water and baking soda. add to crumbs pour batter in greased and floured 9 x 13 inch pan. top with 1 cup reserved crumbs. bake at 350 for 40 to 45 minutes.

inputs: eggs, salad oil, sugar, vanilla, zucchini, flour, salt, baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon, nuts
targets: title: zucchini bread ingredients: 3 eggs 1 c. salad oil 2 c. sugar 1 to 2 tsp. vanilla 2 c. grated zucchini 3 c. flour 1 tsp. salt 1/4 tsp. baking powder 1 tsp. baking soda 1 1/2 tsp. cinnamon 1 c. chopped nuts directions: preheat oven to 350 . grease and flour two 9 x 5 x 3 inch loaf pans. in a large bowl with electric mixer, beat eggs until light and foamy. add oil, sugar and vanilla. mix well. slice zucchini and grate in blender, a few slices at a time. add grated zucchini to egg mixture. mix thoroughly. stir together dry ingredients and add to bowl and mix well. bake 1 hour.

inputs: loin, frozen steak, salt, olive oil, fresh rosemary, garlic, fresh coarse ground black pepper
targets: title: rosemary pepper beef with steak fries ingredients: 4 boneless beef top loin steaks, cut 1 inch thick 7 ounces frozen steak, fries salt 1 tablespoon olive oil 2 teaspoons chopped fresh rosemary 2 garlic cloves, smashed 34 teaspoon fresh coarse ground black pepper directions: in a large bowl, combine seasoning ingredients. remove about 2 teaspoons seasoning mixture, press evenly onto both sides of each beef steak. add potatoes steak fries to remaining seasoning mixture in bowl, toss to coat. place steaks in centre of grid over medium ash covered coals, or medium heat . arrange potatoes around steaks. grill uncovered 15 to 18 minutes for medium rare to medium doneness, turn steaks and potatoes occasionally. season potatoes with salt as desired. serve with steaks.

inputs: mayonnaise, green onion, dill, capers, horseradish, pepper, whole wheat bread, butter, salmon, cucumber
targets: title: roseville tea sandwiches ingredients: 1/4 cup mayonnaise 1 tbsp. minced green onion 1 tbsp. chopped fresh dill 1 tbsp. capers 1 1/2 tsp. horseradish 1 dash pepper 8 slices whole wheat bread 1 1/2 tsp. butter, softened 4 slices smoked salmon 12 slices thin cucumber slices directions: combine mayonnaise, onion, dill, cappers, horseradish and pepper. trim crusts from bread spread with butter, then mayonnaise mixture. arrange salmon and cucumber over 4 slices of bread. top with remaining bread cut each sandwich into 4 triangles or squares.

inputs: beef stock, onion, carrots, cabbage, celery, pearl barley, green peas, tomatoes, pork, thyme
targets: title: throw this together soup ingredients: 6 cups beef stock 1 onion 2 carrots 1 cup chopped cabbage 1 stalk celery 12 cup pearl barley 12 cup green peas 1 28 ounce can tomatoes 1 14 ounce can pork and beans 2 beef bouillon cubes 12 teaspoon thyme leaves directions: dice onion, carrot, celery, and cabbage. add to broth along with barley. cook until vegetables are tender. add remaining ingredients and simmer for an hour or so.

inputs: angel hair pasta, mushrooms, carrots, fresh snow peas, sweet yellow, fresh basil, garlic, olive oil, cornstarch, vegetable broth, salt, tomatoes, parmesan cheese
targets: title: angel hair pasta with garden vegetables ingredients: 8 ounces uncooked angel hair pasta 1 cup sliced fresh mushrooms 1 cup thinly sliced fresh carrots 1 cup fresh snow peas 1 cup chopped sweet yellow, red or green pepper 1/3 cup chopped fresh basil 2 garlic cloves, minced 2 tablespoons olive oil 2 teaspoons cornstarch 1 cup vegetable broth or chicken broth 1/4 teaspoon salt 3 medium tomatoes, peeled and chopped 1/4 cup grated parmesan cheese directions: cook pasta according to package directions. meanwhile, in , saute the mushrooms, carrots, snow peas, yellow pepper, basil and garlic in oil for 2 3 minutes or until crisp tender. in a small bowl, combine the cornstarch, broth and salt until smooth gradually stir into the vegetable mixture. bring to a boil. cook and stir for 1 2 minutes or until vegetables are crisp tender and sauce is thickened. remove from the heat stir in tomatoes. drain pasta divide among four plates. top with vegetable mixture sprinkle with cheese.

inputs: salsa, lime juice, red onion, garlic, red bell pepper, yellow bell pepper, flank steak, cooking spray, flour tortillas, salsa, fresh cilantro
targets: title: tex mex flank steak and vegetables ingredients: 1/2 cup bottled chipotle salsa such as pace 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice 4 1/4 inch thick slices red onion about 1 large 2 garlic cloves, minced 1 red bell pepper, quartered and seeded 1 yellow bell pepper, quartered and seeded 1 1 pound flank steak, trimmed cooking spray 8 7 inch flour tortillas 1/4 cup bottled chipotle salsa 2 tablespoons minced fresh cilantro directions: combine first 7 ingredients in a large zip top plastic bag. seal and marinate in refrigerator 4 hours or overnight, turning occasionally. prepare grill or broiler. remove the steak and vegetables from bag discard marinade. place the steak and the vegetables on grill rack or broiler pan coated with cooking spray cook 7 minutes on each side or until desired degree of doneness. cut steak diagonally across the grain into thin slices. cut peppers into thin strips. cut onion slices in half. warm tortillas according to package directions. divide steak, bell peppers, and onion evenly among tortillas roll up. top each serving with 1 tablespoon chipotle salsa and 1 1/2 teaspoons cilantro. serve immediately.

inputs: broccoli rabe, nuts, garlic, capers, lemon zest, parmesan, olive oil, salt, nbsp, olive oil, leeks, cayenne pepper, tomatoes, potatoes, clam juice, light cream, bass fillet
targets: title: striped bass chowder from the catch ingredients: 1 1/4 pounds broccoli rabe, lower stems cut off 1/4 cup toasted pine nuts 1 garlic clove, minced 1 1/2 tablespoons capers, drained and chopped 1 1/2 teaspoons finely grated lemon zest 1/4 cup grated parmesan 1/2 cup plus 1 tablespoon olive oil salt and freshly ground black pepper nbsp 2 tablespoons olive oil 2 medium leeks, white and pale green parts, thinly sliced pinch of cayenne pepper 1 cup canned stewed tomatoes, chopped 1/2 pound yukon gold potatoes, peeled and sliced 1/4 inch thick 3 cups or clam juice 1/4 cup light cream 1 pound striped bass fillet, skinned and cut into 1 1/2 inch pieces directions: in a large pot of boiling water, cook the broccoli rabe until tender, about 2 minutes. drain and cool. cut off all the florets and reserve. chop the stems and leaves and transfer to a food processor. add the pine nuts, garlic, capers, and lemon zest and process to coarsely chop. add the cheese and all the olive oil and puree. season with salt and pepper. in a large pot, heat the olive oil. add the leeks and cook over medium low heat, stirring a few times, until softened, about 7 minutes. add the cayenne and cook for about 20 seconds. add the tomatoes, potatoes, stock, and 1 cup water and bring to a boil. partially cover and simmer over medium low heat until the potatoes are tender, about 10 minutes. add the cream and striped bass and simmer until the fish is just cooked, about 3 minutes. remove from the heat and add the reserved broccoli rabe florets. ladle the chowder into bowls and pass the pesto at the table to stir in. note the broccoli rabe pesto and blanched florets can be refrigerated, separately, overnight. bring to room temperature before using.

inputs: butter, honey, sugar, peanut butter, cereal, chocolate
targets: title: peanutty crispy bars dark chocolate covered peanutty crispy bars ingredients: 1 cup butter 2 cups honey or light corn syrup 2 cups raw or granulated sugar 2 cups peanut butter, smooth or crunchy 12 1/2 cups crispy rice cereal like rice krispies 3 cups well chopped dark chocolate or semi sweet chocolate chips optional directions: line a 13 x18 half sheet pan with parchment paper being sure that the parchment paper extends over at least two of the opposite sides of the pan. that way you can use the parchment paper to remove the uncut bars from the pan more easily. set pan aside. in a large, heavy bottomed stockpot over medium low heat, melt together the butter, honey or corn syrup and sugar. when the butter is fully melted, raise the heat to medium high and bring the mixture to a boil. boil hard for 1 minute. then remove the pot from the heat and quickly stir in the peanut butter until the mixture is smooth. immediately add in all of the crispy rice cereal and gently but quickly use a wooden spoon to combine until the cereal is all coated evenly and there are no pockets of liquid. turn the mixture out onto the prepared pan and use a lightly oiled spatula to evenly distribute then press the mixture into the pan. be sure to push it into the corners before smoothing the top. optional if you d like your bars to be chocolate covered, scatter the chopped chocolate or chocolate chips evenly over the top as soon as you have it pressed into the pan. let it stand at room temperature until all of the chocolate is glossy and melted looking about 5 10 minutes then use an offset spatula or a silicone spatula to spread the chocolate evenly. put the pan into the refrigerator for at least an hour to let the hot bars set up. before cutting into squares or whichever shapes you prefer, let the bars set at room temperature for at least 30 minutes. store bars in an air tight container at room temperature for up to a week.

inputs: cream cheese, velveeta cheese, garlic powder, nuts
targets: title: cheese balls ingredients: 8 oz. cream cheese 16 oz. velveeta cheese 1 tsp. garlic powder 1 c. nuts directions: mix cheese add nuts save some to roll ball in . sprinkle in garlic salt to taste. make long roll, then roll it in paprika and red pepper. chill then slice round slices. put on crackers.

inputs: olive oil, buns, garlic, oregano, ground thyme, basil, salt, ground black pepper
targets: title: old hamburger bun croutons ingredients: olive oil, or as needed 4 hamburger buns, cut into 1 inch cubes 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder 1/8 teaspoon dried oregano 1/8 teaspoon ground thyme 1/8 teaspoon dried basil salt to taste coarsely ground black pepper to taste directions: preheat oven to 350 degrees f 175 degrees c . drizzle olive oil over hamburger bun cubs in a large bowl toss to coat. spread cubes onto a baking sheet. sprinkle garlic powder, oregano, thyme, basil, salt, and black pepper over the cubes. bake in preheated oven until brown and crispy, 8 to 10 minutes. cool completely before storing in airtight container.

inputs: cornbread, eggplant, ground beef, bell pepper, onion, celery, cream of chicken soup, salt
targets: title: eggplant dressing ingredients: 1 small cornbread 1 eggplant 1 lb. ground beef 1 bell pepper, diced 1 onion, diced 1/2 to 3/4 c. celery, chopped fine 1 can cream of chicken soup salt and pepper to taste directions: peel and cube eggplant. boil until tender in small amount of water. saute meat, pepper, onion and celery. crumble cornbread, then add meat mixture, eggplant and soup. add salt and pepper. mix all together. bake in greased pan at 350 for 45 minutes. can be frozen.

inputs: walnuts, honey, red grapes, herbes, ground coriander, orange zest, fresh squeezed orange juice, fresh squeezed lemon juice, salt, goat cheese
targets: title: goat cheese, grape and walnut spread ingredients: 2 cups walnuts, divided 3/4 cup honey 1 cup sliced red grapes 2 teaspoons herbes de provence 1 teaspoon ground coriander 2 tablespoons finely grated orange zest 1 tablespoon fresh squeezed orange juice 1 teaspoon fresh squeezed lemon juice 1/8 teaspoon salt 4 ounces high quality goat cheese, softened directions: coarsely chop 1 cup walnuts chop the remaining cup of walnuts finely. place finely chopped nuts in a large bowl and add the honey, 3/4 cup sliced grapes, herbes de provence, coriander, orange zest, orange juice, lemon juice and salt. slowly mix until all ingredients are incorporated. line an 8 to 10 ounce souffle cup with plastic wrap. soften goat cheese to a spreadable point. use a piping bag or spoon, fill the bottom 1/2 inch of the plastic lined souffle cup this will be the top with the goat cheese. add 1/2 cup of the rough chop walnuts. sprinkle half the remaining sliced grapes over the goat cheese. pipe or spoon more goat cheese on top of the grapes, covering them completely. spoon in about 1/2 inch of the walnut grape mixture. repeat with a layer of goat cheese, the remaining grapes, the remaining rough chop walnuts, and a final layer of goat cheese this will be the bottom . fold the plastic over the contents of the souffle cup. refrigerate overnight. when you are ready to use the spread, open the plastic wrap and invert a plate over the souffle cup. turn the souffle cup over, separating it from the goat cheese spread. serve with crackers or bread.

inputs: margarine, sugar, eggs, milk, flour, lemon rind, baking powder, salt
targets: title: lemon loaf ingredients: 1/2 c. margarine 1 c. sugar 2 eggs 1/2 c. milk 1 1/2 c. flour 1 lemon rind, grated 1 tsp. baking powder 1/4 to 1 tsp. salt directions: cream sugar, margarine and eggs. add milk. mix well. add flour, salt, baking powder and lemon rind. bake at 350 for 1 hour. cover for 10 minutes. mix juice of 1 lemon with 1/4 cup white sugar and pour over cake.

inputs: noodles, onion, mushrooms, sirloin, canola oil, cornstarch, beef bouillon, water, sour cream
targets: title: beef stroganoff ingredients: 12 ounces uncooked noodles 1 large onion 6 ounces fresh mushrooms 1 pound sirloin or chuck steak 1 tablespoon canola oil 1 tablespoon cornstarch 2 teaspoons dried beef bouillon 1 1/2 cups water 1/2 cup sour cream directions: bring a large saucepan of salted water to a boil and add the noodles. cook over medium high heat, stirring occasionally, for 10 minutes, or until al dente. drain the noodles in a colander and keep warm. meanwhile, peel the onion and cut into 1/8 inch thick slices. remove and discard the ends of the mushroom stems and cut into 1/8 to 1/4 inch thick slices. remove and discard any visible fat from the meat and slice into 1/8 to 1/4 inch thick strips. place the canola oil in a large saute pan and add the onion and mushrooms. cook over medium high heat, stirring occasionally, for 10 minutes, or until the onions are lightly browned and soft. add the meat and cook, stirring frequently, for 3 to 4 minutes, until the meat is browned. combine the cornstarch and bouillon in a small bowl and slowly add the water, stirring until smooth. if you put all the water in at once, the cornstarch will get lumpy. slowly stir the cornstarch mixture into the pan and bring to a boil. remove from the heat and stir in the sour cream. serve immediately over the cooked noodles. sirloin and chuck steak both work well in this recipe, so how do you decide which to use sirloin is more expensive, but it is much leaner and therefore has fewer calories. chuck steak also called pot roast is inexpensive and very flavorful because it has more fat. so if you are on a tight budget, use the chuck steak. it is a tougher cut of meat that generally needs to cook for several hours to become tender, but if you slice it as thin as possible across perpendicular to the grain it will be very tender. if you are watching your calories, use the sirloin, fat free sour cream, and cooking spray instead of oil for a low calorie version that tastes as good as the original.

inputs: butter, fresh morels, cremini mushrooms, thyme, shallots, madeira, salt, sour cream, white bread
targets: title: morel pate ingredients: 2 tablespoons butter 4 ounces fresh morels, sliced 4 ounces cremini mushrooms, sliced 2 sprigs fresh thyme 2 shallots, chopped 1/8 cup madeira salt and freshly ground black pepper 1/4 cup sour cream 4 slices white bread, crusts removed, toasted directions: in a medium skillet, over a high heat, melt the butter. saute the morels and mushrooms 3 to 4 minutes. add the thyme and shallots, and cook until translucent. add madeira and reduce. season with salt and pepper. cook until the mixture is fairly dry. cool. transfer mixture into a food processor and puree until smooth. add sour cream and season to taste. place in a crock and serve with toast points.

inputs: water, rice, butter, egg, onion, soy sauce, water
targets: title: quick chinese fried rice ingredients: 1 cup water 1 1/3 cups minute rice 3 tablespoons butter 1 egg, beaten 1/3 cup onion, chopped 3 tablespoons soy sauce 1/3 cup water directions: boil 1 cup water and the rice, stir and let stand for 5 minutes covered. melt butter in skillet. add egg cook until set. add onion and rice brown. mix 1/3 cup water and soy sauce add to rice. simmer 5 minutes serve.

inputs: macaroni, margarine, eggs, cheddar cheese, milk, salt
targets: title: linda s macaroni and cheese ingredients: 1 small box macaroni 1/3 stick margarine 2 eggs 1/2 lb. medium cheddar cheese 1 1/2 c. milk salt and pepper to taste directions: cook macaroni in salt water for about 6 minutes. stir in margarine until melted. mix 2 eggs, salt and pepper to taste and milk in a separate bowl. in a baking dish, alternate layers of macaroni with shredded cheese. make sure macaroni and cheese are covered with the milk and egg mixture. bake at 400 for about 30 to 40 minutes.

inputs: chicken breasts, cream of celery soup, chicken broth, veg all vegetables, flour, sweet milk, butter
targets: title: chicken pie 2 ingredients: 3 to 4 boneless chicken breasts 1 can cream of celery soup 1 can chicken broth 1 can veg all vegetables 1 c. self rising flour 1 c. sweet milk 2 tbsp. melted butter directions: boil chicken and dice. place in bottom of baking dish. mix soups and vegetables pour over chicken. do not mix with chicken. blend well flour, milk and butter until smooth. drizzle flour mixture over chicken and vegetables. do not stir. bake at 350 for 45 minutes. increase heat to 400 for 15 minutes.

inputs: ricotta cheese, parmesan cheese, eggs, parsley, garlic, salt, pepper, onion, garlic, olive oil, tomatoes, sugar, dried basil, oregano, bay leaf, salt, pepper
targets: title: vegetarian manicotti ingredients: 8 manicotti, cooked, drained 1 15 ounce package fat free ricotta cheese 1 cup grated parmesan cheese 2 eggs 1/2 cup parsley, finely chopped 2 garlic cloves, minced 1/2 teaspoon salt 1/4 teaspoon pepper 1 small onion, finely chopped 1 garlic clove, minced 1 tablespoon olive oil 2 15 ounce cans diced tomatoes 1/2 teaspoon sugar 1/2 teaspoon dried basil 1/2 teaspoon oregano 1 bay leaf 1/2 teaspoon salt 1/4 teaspoon pepper directions: cook and drain manicotti shells. make tomato sauce with last 10 ingredients. first, saute garlic and onion in large skillet 2 3 minutes. then add tomatoes and other ingredients bring to a boil. reduce heat and simmer, covered, 20 minutes. remove bay leaf. mix ricotta, 3/4 cup parmesan cheese, eggs, 1/4 cup parsley, 2 cloves garlic, salt and pepper. stuff shells with mixture and arrange in baking dish. spoon tomato sauce over shells. bake at 350 f for 20 25 minutes, covered in tinfoil. add 1/4 cup parmesan cheese and parsley. remove tinfoil and cook for five minutes more.

inputs: flour, shortening, milk
targets: title: peggy s biscuits ingredients: 2 c. self rising flour 2 heaping tbsp. shortening 2/3 c. milk directions: mix flour and shortening by cutting shortening into flour. do this by using two table knives and moving them back and forth until mixture is crumbly. add milk mix well. roll onto floured surface. cut with biscuit cutter. place into greased pan. bake at 450 until the biscuits rise and turn brown, about 10 minutes.

inputs: mayonnaise, sour cream, salt, onion powder, cheddar cheese, salsa, ground red pepper
targets: title: fiesta dip ingredients: 1 cup mayonnaise 1 cup sour cream 1 teaspoon seasoning salt 14 teaspoon onion powder 12 cup cheddar cheese, shredded 2 tablespoons salsa 18 teaspoon ground red pepper optional directions: combine the mayonnaise and sour cream. add the remaining ingredients, mixing well. chill. serve with your favorite tortilla chips or vegetables.

inputs: sugar, vinegar, cornstarch, hot water
targets: title: sauce for harvard beets ingredients: 1/2 c. sugar 1/4 c. vinegar 2 tsp. cornstarch 1/2 c. hot water directions: cook until clear. add 1 teaspoon of butter after sauce is in beets strain beets first . one half of recipe is good for 1 can of beets.

inputs: fresh picked lobster, cr me fraiche, salad, baking potato, extra virgin olive oil, butter, lobster, , , salt
targets: title: lobster caviar tower ingredients: 1 lb fresh picked lobster meat 4 tbsp creme fraiche 8 oz wakame seaweed salad, chopped 123 gram iranian ascetra caviar can be made with any good caviar 1 medium baking potato 3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil 1 tsp butter 1 tsp lobster roe 1/4 cup heavy cream 1/4 cup white wine to taste salt and pepper directions: preheat oven to 400 degrees. place a small oven safe pan on the stove over medium heat with the olive oil. shred the potato and put just enough in the hot pan to cover the bottom, seasoning with salt and pepper. brown the potato on the bottom, then turn with a spatula or flip like a pancake, whichever you are more comfortable with. to finish cooking the potato cake, place the pan in the preheated oven. while the potato is cooking, place the creme fraiche in a bowl with the lobster meat and chopped wakame salad. mix well, seasoning with a bit of salt and pepper. using a ring mold, place a layer of the lobster meat in the bottom of the ring mold on the plate on which you are going to serve this dish and press firmly to keep in place. place some of the caviar on top of the lobster, and then add another layer of lobster mix. note that you do not want to go too high but also you need to go high enough to see the layers of lobster mix and caviar. gently remove the ring mold and set aside. remove your potato cake from the oven and cut into 4 pieces. place the pan back on the stove and add the white wine, lobster roe, cream and butter. reduce this mixture until thick, season with salt and pepper, and spoon gently onto the plate with the lobster tower. place your potato pancakes around the tower. serve.

inputs: chicken, buttermilk, flour, poultry seasoning, paprika, seasoning salt, margarine
targets: title: oven fried buttermilk chicken ingredients: 1 fresh chicken 3/4 cup buttermilk 1 cup flour 1 1/2 teaspoons poultry seasoning optional 1 teaspoon paprika 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt 1/4 cup margarine or 1/4 cup butter directions: prep heat oven to 425f. clean wash hands. place buttermilk in shallow dish. on waxed paper or plate, mix flour, poultry seasoning, paprika and salt. dip chicken in buttermilk to coat completely. dredge in flour mixture to cover completely. place on clean sheet of waxed paper. in foil lined 15 x l0 inch baking pan, melt margarine in oven 3 to 5 minutes or until bubbly. place chicken skin side down in pan. clean wash hands. notes chill refrigerate leftovers immediately. chicken may also be deep fried. cook bake chicken at 425f for 30 minutes. carefully turn chicken over. bake 30 minutes more or until internal juices of chicken run clear. or insert instant read meat thermometer in thickest part ot chicken . temperature should read 170 f for white meat, 180 f for dark meat .

inputs: topping, flour, butter, salt, light brown sugar, sugar, filling, apples, sugar, apple pie spice, brown sugar, flour, salt
targets: title: olive garden apple carmelina ingredients: topping 3/4 cup flour 5 tablespoons butter softened 1/4 teaspoon salt 1/2 cup light brown sugar 1/4 cup sugar filling 2 20 ounce cans sliced apples, drained 1/2 cup sugar 1/2 teaspoon apple pie spice 1/4 cup brown sugar 1/4 cup flour 1/4 teaspoon salt directions: mix apples, 1/2 cup sugar, apple pie spice, 1/4 cup brown sugar, salt, and flour together, stir well. pour into a lightly buttered 8 x 8 baking dish. place the topping ingredients together in a bowl. mix the flour, salt, sugars and blend well. add and work in the softened butter to the topping ingredients. mixture should look like coarse meal. sprinkle over apples and place in a preheated oven at 350f for 30 35 minutes. serve topped with your favorite vanilla ice cream and a drizzle of caramel sauce.

inputs: pork, hawaiian salt, liquid smoke, banana leaf
targets: title: oven baked kalua pork ingredients: 1 pork butt 4 to 7 lb. hawaiian salt to taste 3 to 4 tbsp. liquid smoke 6 to 7 green ti leaves, washed 1 banana leaf, washed directions: completely thaw pork butt. preheat oven to 375 . slice pork butt in four sections about halfway through, then rub down with salt and liquid smoke. wrap with a piece of banana leaf, then in ti leaves. wrap tightly with foil place in a baking pan. bake for 2 hours, then lower heat to 350 and bake another 2 hours. delicious by itself or with cabbage

inputs: chicken, doritos, chicken broth, onion, cheddar cheese, cream of chicken soup, cream of mushroom soup, chili powder, ro tel tomatoes
targets: title: mexican chicken ingredients: 2 1/2 lb. chicken, stewed, boned and cubed 1 10 1/2 oz. bag doritos 1 c. chicken broth 1 medium onion, chopped 1 c. grated cheddar cheese 2 cans cream of chicken soup 1 can cream of mushroom soup 1 1/2 tsp. chili powder 1 can ro tel tomatoes directions: layer crushed doritos on bottom of 9 x 13 inch baking dish. pour chicken broth over this. layer cubed chicken, onion, pepper and 1/2 cup cheese. blend soups with chili powder and pour over cheese. chop ro tel tomatoes and pour over soups. sprinkle remaining cheese on top. bake 45 minutes at 350 .

inputs: ground pork, green bean ingredients, chicken, worcestershire sauce, cheddar cheese, onion, red potatoes, salt, ground sirloin, ground coriander, ground cumin, tomato paste, cheddar cheese, sour cream, scallions, fresh cilantro, lime
targets: title: cheddar studded tex mex meatloaf patties, scallion smashed potatoes, and spicy pan gravy ingredients: ground pork all green bean ingredients 1/4 to 3/4 cup of the chicken stock 2 tablespoons of the worcestershire sauce cheddar cheese all but 1/4 cup chopped onion 2 pounds small red potatoes, quartered coarse salt additional 1/3 pound ground sirloin 1/2 tablespoon ground coriander half a palmful 1/2 tablespoon ground cumin half a palmful 1 rounded tablespoon tomato paste 1/4 pound sharp cheddar cheese, cut into 1/4 inch dice 1/2 cup sour cream 5 scallions, white and green parts, finely chopped 3 tablespoons fresh cilantro leaves a small handful , chopped juice of 1/2 lime directions: for the scallion smashed potatoes, cover the potatoes in water in a medium saucepan. bring the water to a boil, add a little salt, and cook the potatoes for 10 minutes, or until fork tender. mix the meatloaf patties as in the master recipe, 100. form and cook as before. check on the potatoes. when they are tender, turn off the heat under the pan drain the potatoes and return to the hot pan and warm stovetop to dry the potatoes. add 3 tablespoons of the butter, the sour cream, and the scallions to the potatoes and smash to the desired consistency. season the potatoes with salt and pepper. remove the meatloaf patties from the skillet and make the gravy as directed. stir in the cilantro and lime juice, then remove the gravy from the heat. slice the meatloaf patties and drizzle with gravy. pile scallion smashed potatoes alongside.

inputs: butter, egg, bisquick, sugar, milk, apples
targets: title: apple pancake ingredients: 3 tbsp. butter 1 egg 1 1/3 c. bisquick 2 tbsp. sugar 1/3 c. milk 2 apples, peeled and cut in thin slices, sprinkled with cinnamon directions: preheat oven to 350 . add the apple slices to a 10 inch skillet with butter in it. pour the batter over the center of apples it won t cover all the apples or go to edges of skillet . bake for 20 to 25 minutes. it should be golden brown and have reached the sides of the skillet. after it s done, place a plate over the skillet and turn the pancake out on the plate. sprinkle with brown sugar and cinnamon and serve with maple syrup.

inputs: vegetable oil, sugar, eggs, persimmon pulp, flour, baking powder, baking soda, nutmeg, clove, allspice, salt, cinnamon, walnuts, dates
targets: title: persimmon bread ingredients: 3/4 cup vegetable oil 1 1/2 cups sugar 2 eggs, beaten 1 cup persimmon pulp 1 3/4 cups flour 1/2 teaspoon baking powder 1 teaspoon baking soda 1/2 teaspoon nutmeg 1/2 teaspoon clove 1/2 teaspoon allspice 1/2 teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon cinnamon 1/2 cup chopped walnuts 1/2 cup chopped dates optional directions: preheat oven 350 degrees. in a large bowl blend sugar and oil add eggs and persimmon pulp. in a separate bowl, sift together flour, baking powder, baking soda and spices add nuts and dates then mix well. stir flour mixture into persimmon mixture. turn into two greased and floured loaf pans. bake for one hour or until done, testing center with a pick. turn out on wire rack to cool. freezes well.

inputs: cold fat , sugar, chocolate, thawed cool
targets: title: super chocolate chocolate pudding ingredients: 1 1/2 cups cold fat free milk 1 pkg. 4 serving size jell o chocolate flavor sugar free fat free instant pudding 1/2 oz. baker s semi sweet chocolate, chopped 1/2 cup thawed cool whip free whipped topping directions: pour milk into large bowl. add dry pudding mix. beat with wire whisk 2 min. or until well blended. stir in chocolate. gently stir in whipped topping. spoon evenly into 4 dessert dishes. cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour. store leftover desserts in refrigerator.

inputs: eggs, cream cheese, sugar, salt, vanilla extract, almond extract, sour cream
targets: title: company cheese cake ingredients: 3 eggs, well beaten 2 8 oz. pkg. cream cheese, softened 1 c. sugar 1/4 tsp. salt 2 tsp. vanilla extract 1/2 tsp. almond extract 3 c. dairy sour cream directions: combine eggs, cheese, sugar, salt and extracts beat until smooth. blend in sour cream pour into graham nut crust. trim with reserved crumbs. bake at 375 or until just set. cool. chill about 4 to 5 hours. filling will be soft. top with 1 can cherry pie filling. makes 10 servings.

inputs: zucchini, onion, carrots, green pepper, pimento, cream of chicken soup, sour cream, stuffing
targets: title: zucchini casserole ingredients: 4 c. zucchini chunks 1/2 medium onion, sliced 2 carrots, shredded green pepper to taste pimento to taste 1 can cream of chicken soup 1/2 c. sour cream or yogurt 1/2 pkg. pepperidge farm stuffing directions: cook zucchini to maintain crispness and drain. saute onion. mix all ingredients together. place in 9 x 13 inch casserole dish or a 2 quart casserole dish. bake at 350 for 25 minutes. serves 8.

inputs: fruit, butter, sugar, flour, salt, baking soda, milk
targets: title: cobbler ingredients: 2 c. fruit 1 stick butter 1 c. sugar 1 c. flour 1/4 tsp. salt 1 tbsp. baking soda 2/3 c. milk directions: spray pan with pam. mix together all but fruit and butter. melt stick of butter in pan. pour batter in 9 x 13 pan, then pour fruit in the center. bake for 45 minutes to 1 hour. add cinnamon if you like.

inputs: water, sugar, salt, rice, semi sweet chocolate chips, coconut
targets: title: chocolate coconut rice squares ingredients: 1 1/2 c. water 1/4 c. sugar 1/2 tsp. salt 1 1/2 c. minute rice 1 c. baker s real semi sweet chocolate chips 1/2 c. baker s angel flake coconut 1 c. cool whip directions: combine water, sugar and salt in medium saucepan. bring to a full boil. stir in rice. cover remove from heat. let stand 5 minutes. add chips and coconut to hot rice and stir until chips are melted. cover and chill. fold whipped topping into rice mixture. pour into waxed paper lined 8 inch square pan or 9 x 5 inch loaf pan. cover and chill until firm, about 1 hour. remove paper and cut into squares.

inputs: pork chops, salt, olive oil, apple cider vinegar, brown sugar, orange juice, mustard, soy sauce
targets: title: tangy orange glazed pork chops ingredients: 4 boneless pork chops, about 1/4 1/2 inch thickness 1 pinch salt, pepper 1 tablespoon olive oil 12 cup apple cider vinegar 13 cup brown sugar 13 cup orange juice 2 tablespoons dijon mustard 1 tablespoon soy sauce directions: sprinkle chops with salt and pepper. heat olive oil in pan, add pork chops, and brown on both sides for about 4 6 min, until juices run clear. remove pork chops from pan, and add remaining ingredients, do not clean pan. cook over medium heat, stirring consistently until glaze has reached a boil. lower heat a bit, and simmer, while stirring, until glaze has thickened. about 5 min . add pork chops back to pan, cover in sauce and cook an additional minute or two. turn of heat and let sit for 5 minutes. serve with glaze over chops.

inputs: uncle ben s, cream of chicken soup, cream of celery soup, margarine, sherry, milk, fresh mushrooms, chicken breasts, parmesan cheese, almonds
targets: title: chicken parmesan ingredients: 1 box uncle ben s long grain and wild rice with herbs 1 can cream of chicken soup 1 can cream of celery soup 1/2 c. melted margarine 1/2 c. sherry 2/3 c. milk 1/2 lb. fresh mushrooms, sliced 4 chicken breasts, split and boned 1/2 c. parmesan cheese 1/2 c. sliced almonds directions: pour rice evenly over bottom of buttered, 2 quart oblong dish. sprinkle herbs over rice. mix soups, margarine, sherry and milk. pour small amount over rice to moisten. sprinkle with sliced mushrooms. top with chicken. pour remainder of soup mixture over chicken. sprinkle with cheese and almonds. bake in an uncovered dish at 275 for 2 1/2 hours.

inputs: chicken breasts, teriyaki sauce, ranch dressing, chedder cheese, green onions, bacon bits
targets: title: teriyaki ranch baked chicken ingredients: 4 boneless chicken breasts 1/4 cup 60 ml teriyaki sauce 1/2 cup 125 ml ranch dressing 1 cup 225 ml sharp chedder cheese, grated 3 green onions, chopped 1 jar real bacon bits directions: preheat oven to 350 degrees 175 c. . brush teriyaki sauce over chicken breasts. spoon ranch dressing over each breast. put chopped green onions over each breast. top with grated cheese and bacon bits. bake for 45 minutes or until chicken is done.

inputs: salmon , gm, salt , pepper, bread, onion, garlic, dill, gm
targets: title: salmon sweet potato croquettes with chili jam ingredients: fresh salmon 50 gm sweet potato 50 gm salt to taste pepper 5 gm oil for frying 500 ml bread crumb 100 gm onion 25 gm garlic 25 gm dill leaves 05 gm chili jam 50 gm directions: chopped salmon meat saute onion garlic add mashed sweet potato mix well check the seasoning add chopped dill, make a croquette shape and crumb. deep fry the croquette serve with chili jam

inputs: orange flavored gelatin, orange extract, powdered sugar
targets: title: orange swirl cake ingredients: 1 pkg. supermoist yellow cake mix 1 pkg. 4 serving size orange flavored gelatin 1/2 tsp. orange extract powdered sugar directions: heat oven to 350 . grease and flour 12 cup bundt cake pan. prepare cake mix as directed on package. remove 1 1/2 cups of the batter and set aside. pour remaining batter into pan. stir gelatin dry and extract into the 1 1/2 c. batter. drop orange batter by generous tbsp. randomly in 6 to 8 mounds onto batter in pan. cut through batter with knife in s shaped curves in one continuous motion for swirled effect. bake 42 to 47 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean. cool 10 minutes in pan. turn upside down onto heatproof serving plate remove pan. cool cake completely. sprinkle with powdered sugar.

inputs: thin, lemon juiced, extra virgin olive oil
targets: title: asparagus with prosciutto ingredients: 1 1/4 pounds asparagus spears thin, washed, dried 1 lemon juiced extra virgin olive oil for drizzling 1/4 pound prosciutto thinly sliced, di parma directions: for asparagus, snap off tough ends of spears where they naturally give when bent. place spears into 1 inch of boiling water. cover the pan and cook asparagus for 3 or 4 minutes, until spears are just tender but remain bright green in color, about 3 to 4 minutes. drain and cold shock the spears in a colander under cool water. return cooked asparagus to skillet and coat with lemon juice and a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil. remove bundles of several spears at a time from the pan and wrap with sliced prosciutto. pile assembled bundles on a serving plate.

inputs: penne pasta, cream, cayenne pepper, parmesan cheese, vodka, olive oil
targets: title: penne alla panna ingredients: 400 g penne pasta, cooked 250 400 ml cream 200 g cooked ham or 200 g prosciutto, finely sliced and cut into small pieces 1/2 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper 1/2 3/4 cup parmesan cheese 1 1/2 tablespoons vodka optional 1 teaspoon olive oil directions: heat the oil in a skillet. on a high heat, quickly fry the ham or prosciutto until starting to brown, keep stirring it continuously to stop it from burning. turn down to a low heat or if cooking on an electric hob turn it off, pour in 250 ml of cream. add the cayenne pepper and stir in the parmesan. if the sauce seems really thick add some more cream, the pasta shouldn t be dry, but neither should it swim in sauce. stir in the pasta and serve straight away.

inputs: bacon, mayonnaise, mustard, eggs, basil, tomatoes, cucumber, whole wheat pita bread
targets: title: egg and bacon salad pitas ingredients: 3 slices bacon 12 cup mayonnaise 2 teaspoons dijon mustard 6 hard boiled eggs, peeled and chopped 12 basil leaves 1 medium tomatoes, chopped 1 medium cucumber, chopped 4 whole wheat pita bread, cut in half directions: in large skillet over medium high heat, cook bacon. drain and chop. in medium bowl, whisk together mayo and dijon. stir in eggs, bacon, basil, tomato and cucumber. stuff pockets with egg mixture and serve.

inputs: cold milk, jello vanilla, marshmallows, banana, pineapple, orange sections, almonds, flaked coconut
targets: title: ambrosia parfait ingredients: 1 c. cold milk 1 pkg. 4 serving size jello vanilla flavor instant pudding mix 1 c. miniature marshmallows 1 small banana chopped 1 can 8 oz crushed pineapple, undrained 1 can 11 oz. mandarin orange sections, drained 1/2 c. toasted almonds sliced 1/2 c. flaked coconut directions: beat pudding mix and milk with wire whisk 1 to 2 minutes. mix in 1/2 c. marshmallows, the banana and pineapple with juice. spoon some of mixture into parfait glasses. add a layer of the remaining ingredients, alternate with layers of pudding. chill. makes 6 servings.

inputs: sour cream, egg yolks, sugar, flour, raisins, crust
targets: title: aunt helen myhre s sour cream raisin pie from her award winning norske nook restaurant in osseo, wi ingredients: 2 c. sour cream 4 egg yolks save whites 1 3/4 c. sugar 4 heaping tsp. flour 1 1/2 c. raisins 1 baked pie crust directions: stir sour cream and egg yolks together in heavy saucepan. add sugar, flour, then raisins and mix with a wooden spoon. cook over medium heat until raisins plump and filling is glossy about 5 minutes or so . cool filling, slightly, then pour into cooled crust. preheat oven to 400 . prepare meringue and spread on pie. bake 15 to 20 minutes until peaks are golden brown. cool. keep in cool room or eat. refrigerate only if keeping overnight.

inputs: heavy cream, active dry yeast, all purpose, eggs, sugar, vanilla, orange marmalade, egg yolk, eggs, pistachios
targets: title: easter apricot and marzipan coffee cake ingredients: 4 tbsp heavy cream 1 3/4 tsp active dry yeast 2 2/3 cup all purpose flour 2 none eggs, beaten 5 tbsp granulated sugar 1 tsp vanilla extract 5 1/4 oz marzipan, grated 5 1/4 oz dried apricots, chopped 4 tbsp orange marmalade 1 none egg yolk 3 none hard boiled eggs, dyed with food coloring of your choice 2 tbsp pistachios, roughly chopped directions: in a saucepan, warm 2 tbsp cream. stir in the yeast, cover and allow to rest in a warm place for 10 mins. in a mixer fitted with a dough hook, mix the flour, eggs, 3 tbsp sugar, vanilla extract and a pinch of salt. stir in the yeast mixture and knead until the dough is smooth. cover and allow to rest in a warm place for 30 mins. meanwhile, make the filling by mixing the marzipan and apricots. add 2 tbsp marmalade and stir well. in a separate bowl, make the egg wash by beating the egg yolk with 2 tbsp cream. preheat the oven to 325 f. line a baking tray with parchment paper. on a floured work surface, roll out the dough to an 18 x 24 inch rectangle. cut lengthways into 3 equal pieces. spread the marzipan and apricot mixture evenly onto the strips, leaving 1/3 inch space free around the edges. roll the dough up around the filling. squeeze the ends of the 3 dough strips together and braid loosely. place on the baking tray and brush with the egg wash. press the colored hard boiled eggs gently into the top of the braid. allow to rest in a warm place for 20 mins. bake for 35 mins, covering with foil after 20 mins if the bread is browning too quickly. transfer to a wire rack and allow to cool. heat the remaining marmalade in a saucepan and brush over the bread. sprinkle with pistachios and the remaining sugar.

inputs: chicken basil, olive oil, butter, yellow onion, chicken broth, parmesan, cream, salt
targets: title: spaghetti squash with chicken basil sausage ingredients: 1 whole spaghetti squash 2 whole chicken basil sausage links, uncooke 1 tablespoon olive oil 2 tablespoons butter 1/2 whole yellow onion, diced 1 cup low sodium chicken broth freshly grated parmesan, to taste splash of cream or whole milk salt and pepper, to taste directions: cut squash in half lengthwise and remove seeds. cook in microwave cut side down until tender mine took about 15 minutes . while the squash is cooking, remove casing from sausage and brown in nonstick skillet sprayed with cooking spray, until thoroughly done. remove sausage from pan into a paper towel lined bowl. drain excess fat from pan. add olive oil and butter to skillet and heat over medium high heat. add onion to pan and cook until translucent, seasoning with salt. use a fork to scrape out the spaghetti squash flesh and add it to the skillet. return sausage to skillet and toss to combine. add chicken broth and reduce heat to low. add parmesan cheese to taste. reduce most of the liquid, about 5 minutes. add a splash of cream or whole milk and continue to cook until liquid is reduced, about 5 minutes more. season with salt and fresh ground pepper to taste.

inputs: peanut oil, jalapeno peppers, butter, shallot, garlic, kosher salt, pepper, cream cheese, flour, paprika, cayenne pepper, buttermilk, egg
targets: title: country fried jalapeno poppers ingredients: peanut oil, for frying 16 medium jalapeno peppers 2 tablespoons butter 1 small shallot, minced 4 cloves garlic, minced kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper 1 cup grated pepper jack cheese 4 ounces cream cheese, softened 2 cups self rising flour 2 tablespoons smoked paprika 1/2 teaspoon cayenne pepper 1 cup buttermilk 1 egg, beaten directions: preheat your oil in a dutch oven or fryer to 375 degrees f. for tips on deep frying, see page 19. make a long slit from the stem of each jalapeno to the bottom. make another slit across the top of the pepper, creating a t shape. remove the seeds and ribs with a small paring knife, or, if you prefer it fiery hot, leave the seeds and ribs intact. melt the butter in a small saute pan over medium high heat. once it foams, add the shallot and garlic, and saute until tender. season with salt and pepper. scrape the shallot and garlic into a bowl, and let cool. once the shallot and garlic are cool, stir in the pepper jack and the cream cheese. carefully stuff the jalapenos with the cheese mixture, and push the seams closed to seal the cheese mixture inside will stick and hold them shut . whisk together the flour, smoked paprika, cayenne, and a pinch of salt and pepper in a large bowl. whisk together the buttermilk and the egg in a separate, small bowl. dredge the stuffed peppers through the flour, then the buttermilk, and then the flour again. if you like, take a second run through the buttermilk and another dip in the flour, so you have some extra crunch in your popper. working in batches, gently place the jalapenos in the hot oil in the fryer and fry until golden brown, about 2 minutes. drain on a paper towel lined platter, and season with salt and pepper. let cool for just a few minutes before serving. these suckers will be hot

inputs: pumpkin seeds, black kale, feta, red onion, olive oil, lemon, salt
targets: title: kale and feta salad ingredients: 1/2 cup pumpkin seeds 2 bunches black kale, washed and roughly chopped into bite size pieces about 8 cups 8 ounces feta, crumbled 1 small red onion, sliced 1/2 cup olive oil zest of 1 lemon and 1 tablespoon juice salt and freshly ground pepper directions: 1. toast the pumpkin seeds in a medium skillet over medium high heat, watching carefully, stirring until light brown, about 5 minutes. 2. combine the kale, feta, and onions in a large bowl. toss with the olive oil, lemon zest, lemon juice, and season with salt and pepper. scatter the pumpkin seeds over the top and serve. calories 592 total fat 51 grams saturated fat 14 grams total carbohydrate 21 grams protein 18 grams sodium 815 milligrams cholesterol 50 milligrams fiber 4 grams

inputs: syrup, milk, smuckers, vanilla ice cream
targets: title: kathy s delicious strawberry milkshake ingredients: 1/4 cup hershey s strawberry syrup 1/4 cup milk 1/4 cup smuckers strawberry jam 2 cup vanilla ice cream 1 reddi wip dairy whipped topping directions: put all of the ingredients in a blender except the reddi wip. blend the ingredients for about one minute. pour the blended mix into a glass. top with reddi wip or other dairy whipped topping. top with a cherry if desired. serve immediately and enjoy

inputs: orange juice concentrate, lemon juice concentrate, vegetable oil, dill weed, fish steaks
targets: title: marinated fish steak ingredients: 1/4 c. orange juice concentrate, thawed 1/4 c. lemon juice concentrate 1 tbsp. vegetable oil 1/2 tsp. dill weed 4 1 inch fish steaks directions: in large dish or plastic bag, combine juices, oil and dill weed mix well. add fish steaks. cover marinated steaks and place in refrigerator for 2 hours. turn occasionally. grill or broil until fish flakes with fork. frequently baste. makes 4 servings.

inputs: graham cracker crumbs, ground pecans, white sugar, ground ginger, butter, cream cheese, brown sugar, eggs, solid pack pumpkin puree, heavy whipping cream, ground cinnamon, ground ginger, ground nutmeg, ground cloves, salt
targets: title: pumpkin cheesecake pie ingredients: 1 cup graham cracker crumbs 1/2 cup ground pecans 2 tablespoons white sugar 1/8 teaspoon ground ginger 1/4 cup butter, melted 1 8 ounce package cream cheese, softened 3/4 cup packed brown sugar 3 eggs, beaten 1 15 ounce can solid pack pumpkin puree 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves 1/2 teaspoon salt directions: preheat oven to 350 degrees f 175 degrees c . to make crust in a medium bowl combine graham cracker crumbs, ground pecans, white sugar, and 1/8 teaspoon ground ginger. mix well, then pour in melted butter. stir until butter is evenly distributed. press mixture into a 9 inch pie plate. set aside. to make filling in a large mixing bowl combine cream cheese and brown sugar. beat until smooth, then add eggs, pumpkin, and cream. mix well. stir in cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg, cloves, and salt. pour mixture into pie shell. bake in preheated oven for 35 to 40 minutes, until set in center. chill before serving. garnish with whipped cream and pecan halves if desired.

inputs: cranberries, water, sugar, freshly squeezed orange juice
targets: title: cranberry granita ingredients: 3 cups 340 g cranberries, fresh or frozen 1 cup 250 ml water 1 cup 200 g sugar 1/2 cup 125 ml freshly squeezed orange juice from about 2 oranges directions: put the cranberries, water, sugar, and orange juice in a medium, nonreactive saucepan and bring to a boil. cover, remove from the heat, and let stand for 30 minutes. puree the mixture in a blender or food processor until smooth, then press through a mesh strainer to remove the bits of cranberry skin. freeze according to the instructions for freezing granita on page 145. serve with tangerine sorbet page 119 or spicy cinnamon ice cream page 38 .

inputs: white flour, baking powder, sugar, eggs, oil, milk
targets: title: pancakes a la consumers union ingredients: 2 c. white flour 2 tbsp. baking powder 1/4 c. sugar 2 large eggs 2 tbsp. oil 2 c. whole milk directions: let griddle preheat while you prepare the batter. set at 400 or medium high. grease griddle lightly with vegetable oil, margarine or butter.

inputs: frozen hash brown potatoes, condensed cream, cheddar cheese, onion, milk, corn flakes crumbs
targets: title: potatoes au gratin ingredients: 1 16 oz. bag frozen hash brown potatoes 1 10 3/4 oz. can condensed cream of chicken soup 2 c. shredded sharp cheddar cheese 1/3 c. finely chopped onion 1/4 c. milk 1/4 c. corn flakes crumbs directions: combine all ingredients except crumbs mix lightly. pour into a 1 quart casserole. sprinkle with crumbs. bake at 350 for 45 minutes. makes 8 servings.

inputs: dessert topping, water, cocoa
targets: title: five minute chocolate mousse ingredients: 3 ounces dessert topping 1/2 cup ice water 1 tablespoon cocoa directions: beat until stiff peaks form. spoon into dessert dishes. may be garnished with sliced strawberries, mandarin orange slices, shaved chocolate, or whatever else you desire.

inputs: shortening, flour, salt, water, eggs
targets: title: cream puffs diabetic ingredients: 2 tbsp. shortening 1/2 c. flour 1/2 tsp. salt 1/2 c. water 2 eggs directions: combine water, shortening and salt. bring to boil. reduce to low and add flour beat until smooth and ball clings. remove from heat. beat in eggs, one at a time. beat until smooth. drop by spoonfuls on ungreased baking sheet. bake at 375 for 40 minutes or golden brown and almost dry. makes 6 to 8.

inputs: pork sausages, garlic, olive oil, red wine vinegar, mustard, honey, salt, baby spinach, blue cheese, mushrooms
targets: title: sausage mushroom salad ingredients: 4 pork sausages 1 garlic clove 3 tablespoons olive oil 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar 2 teaspoons mustard 2 teaspoons honey 1 pinch salt pepper 6 cups baby spinach leaves 4 ounces blue cheese 2 cups mushrooms directions: remove the casings from the sausage and place in fry pan breaking it up to cook. while sausage is cooking, mix salad dressing. mix together 1 clove of garlic, olive oil, red wine vinegar, mustard, honey and the pinch of salt pepper. shake together to mix well. add the sliced mushrooms to the sausages and cook until done. assemble rest of salad. place spinach in bowl. crumble blue cheese and add to spinach. add the sausage/mushroom to salad. add dressing and toss. can be served individually or in a serving bowl.

inputs: butter, yeast, sugar, milk, flour
targets: title: easy yeast bread ingredients: 1/2 stick butter 1 pkg. dry yeast 5 tbsp. sugar 1 c. milk about 2 1/4 c. self rising flour directions: melt butter in loaf pan. pour 2/3 of the butter into a cup. mix yeast, sugar and milk. add flour. mix well. pour into the loaf pan and pour the butter in the cup over the batter. bake at 325 for 30 to 40 minutes.

inputs: cranberry sauce, sugar, pineapple, nuts, bananas
targets: title: cranberry salad ingredients: 1 large can whole cranberry sauce 1 c. sugar 1 20 oz. can crushed pineapple, drained 1/2 c. chopped nuts 3 large bananas, chopped 1 large container cool whip directions: mix together cranberry sauce, sugar and pineapple and add nuts and bananas. then mix and add cool whip. place in oblong pan and freeze cut into squares.

inputs: pretzels, butter, sugar, cream cheese, sugar, strawberry, boiling water, frozen strawberries
targets: title: pretzel salad ingredients: 2 c. crushed pretzels not too fine 3/4 c. melted butter or margarine 3 tsp. sugar 1 8 oz. cream cheese 1 c. sugar 1 small cool whip 1 large strawberry jell o 2 c. boiling water 2 10 oz. frozen strawberries directions: mix jell o and water. stir until dissolved. add frozen strawberries. let set until slightly set. pour over cream cheese mixture. refrigerate.

inputs: celery, mushrooms, carrots, onion, clove garlic, italian seasoning, tomato sauce, chicken, tomatoes, sugar, ricotta cheese, parmesan cheese, green onions, pepper, mozzarella cheese
targets: title: chicken canneloni ingredients: 3/4 c. thinly sliced celery 1/2 c. sliced fresh mushrooms 1/2 c. thinly sliced carrots 1 small onion, thinly sliced 1 clove garlic, minced 1 1/2 tsp. dried italian seasoning 1 8 oz. can no salt tomato sauce 6 4 oz. boned, skinned chicken breast halves 1 7 1/2 oz. can whole tomatoes, undrained and chopped 3/4 tsp. sugar 1/2 c. lite ricotta cheese 2 tbsp. grated parmesan cheese 1 tbsp. chopped green onions dash of pepper 1/4 c. mozzarella cheese, shredded directions: coat a medium saucepan with vegetable cooking spray place over medium high heat until hot. add next 5 ingredients saute until tender. add 1 teaspoon italian seasoning and next 4 ingredients bring to a boil. reduce heat and cook, uncovered, 20 minutes or until reduced to 2 cups. set mixture aside.

inputs: cranberry juice, lemon juice, pectin, sugar, fresh picked bergamot petals
targets: title: cranberry bee balm jelly ingredients: 4 cups cranberry juice, not low calorie 1/4 cup lemon juice 1 3/4 ounces dry pectin 4 1/2 cups sugar 1/2 cup fresh picked bergamot petals, bee balm, wild oswego tea, horsemint, monarda directions: heat 1/2 cup water pour over the bee balm and let steep 1 hour or over night in the refrigerator then strain. pour steeped bee balm, cranberry and lemon juices into a heavy pot. whisk in the pectin to dissolve. bring to a full rolling boil.over medium high heat. stirring frequently. stir in sugar and return to a full rolling boil and boil hard for 1 minute. skim foam. pour into hot sterilized jars leaving 1/4 inch head space. process in a boiling water bath 5 minutes. remove jars and cool without moving in a draft free place.

inputs: cooking spray, red onion, stalks celery, carrot, garlic, thyme, salt, salt, zucchini, salt, vegetable stock, balsamic vinegar, potatoes, milk, parmesan cheese
