targets: title: pear, cranberry and rosemary compote ingredients: 1 lemon, zest and juice 2/3 cup fresh cranberries 1/2 cup water 2 sprigs fresh rosemary, each 4 long / 3 tbsp sugar 2 bosc pears, peeled and cut into 1/2 pieces directions: in a small saucepan bring water, rosemary sprigs and cranberries to a boil. simmer over low heat until the cranberries have burst. add sugar and stir to dissolve. stir in pear chunks, lemon juice and zest, then cover and simmer over low heat just until pears are tender. if baking further in a crumble/cobbler simmering is unnecessary. remove and discard rosemary sprigs a few loose needles are okay and adjust sugar to your taste and to suit your desired purpose.

inputs: flour, flour wholewheat, powdered sugar, vegetable oil, vinegar, coffee powder, cinnamon powder, baking soda, salt, vanilla essence, curd, coffee
targets: title: cinnamon eggless coffee cake ingredients: 1 cup all purpose flour 1/2 cup flour wholewheat 1 cup powdered sugar 6 tablespoons vegetable oil 1 tablespoon vinegar 1/2 teaspoon instant coffee powder 1 teaspoon cinnamon powder 1 teaspoon baking soda 1/2 teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon vanilla essence 1/2 cup curd or yogurt 1/2 cup strong coffee decoction directions: preheat the oven for 10 minutes at 180 c. grease a rectangular tin for baking the cake and keep it aside. take a big vessel and sift the two kinds of flour with baking powder, coffee, powder, cinnamon powder and salt for at least three times. take another vessel and beat powdered sugar and oil till it is light and fluffy , for about 10 minutes. add the curd, coffee decoction, vanilla essence and vinegar in the sugar and oil mixture and stir it thoroughly. keep 1 tsp. of sugar aside. gently mix in the liquid mix in the dry flour. mix the whole batter very lightly till it resembles a uniform paste. do not over mix, just 10 12 strokes will do. pour the prepared batter in the baking tin and sprinkle 1 tsp. of sugar over it. bake it at 180 c for about 25 30 minutes or till done. insert a clean knife and take it out, if it comes clean the cinnamon tea cake is ready, else bake it for few more minutes. take out of the oven and let it cool on a wire rack. cut it in desired shape and serve with tea or coffee. stays good for a week.

inputs: blanched asparagus, pasta, carrot, red onion, red pepper, italian dressing, celery
targets: title: asparagus pasta salad ingredients: 1 lb. blanched asparagus spears, cut into 1 inch pieces 2 1/2 cups cooked, small shells pasta 1 each sliced carrot, cut into slices 1 each chopped red onion 1 each chopped red pepper 1/2 cup kraft zesty italian dressing 1/2 tsp. celery seed directions: mix asparagus, cooked pasta, onion, pepper and carrot. toss with dressing and celery seed. refrigerate before serving.

inputs: meatloaf, ground beef, ground pork, egg, onion, apple, breadcrumbs, salt, apple glaze, applesauce, nutmeg, apple cider vinegar, mustard, brown sugar
targets: title: autumn apple meatloaf with apple glaze ingredients: meatloaf 1 lb ground beef 1 lb ground pork 1 large egg, beaten 1 small onion, minced 1 small tart apple, peeled, cored and finely chopped 2 cups soft breadcrumbs salt and pepper apple glaze 1 cup applesauce 1/8 teaspoon nutmeg 2 tablespoons apple cider vinegar 1 tablespoon dijon mustard 2 tablespoons brown sugar directions: preheat oven to 350 degrees. in a large bowl, combine beef, pork, beaten egg, minced onion, finely chopped apple, bread crumbs, salt and pepper. blend together well w/ clean hands. shape mixture into loaf and place in a baking dish. mix together all the apple glaze ingredients in a seperate bowl and set aside. bake meatloaf 350 degrees for 45 minutes. after 30 minutes, evenly pour the apple glaze over top of the meatloaf. return to 350 degree oven and continue to cook for about another 45 minutes basting with your glaze every 15 minutes, or until done and no longer pink.

inputs: salt, cream of cheese soup, jalapeno peppers
targets: title: texas peppered steak ingredients: 1 1/2 to 2 lb. round steak salt and pepper to taste 1 can cream of cheese soup undiluted 2 to 3 large jalapeno peppers directions: tenderize steak or have it tenderized. cut into serving pieces. rub on salt and pepper. sear steak just until pink is gone in a small amount of oil in hot skillet. transfer to baking dish. spread soup over steak. slice jalapenos thin and sprinkle over cheese soup. cover with foil. bake at 350 for 40 to 50 minutes.

inputs: cooking spray, onion, garlic, basmati rice, chicken broth, saffron threads, bay leaf, kosher salt, ground cumin, ground cinnamon, paprika, ground coriander, ground cardamom, ground red pepper, rack of lamb, olive oil
targets: title: grilled rack of lamb with saffron rice ingredients: cooking spray 1 cup diced onion 2 garlic cloves, minced 1 cup uncooked basmati rice 2 cups fat free, less sodium chicken broth 1/4 teaspoon saffron threads, crushed 1 bay leaf 3/4 teaspoon kosher salt 1/2 teaspoon ground cumin 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon 1/2 teaspoon paprika 1/8 teaspoon ground coriander 1/8 teaspoon ground cardamom 1/8 teaspoon ground red pepper 1 1 1/2 pound french cut rack of lamb 8 ribs 1 teaspoon olive oil directions: heat a medium saucepan over medium heat. coat pan with cooking spray. add onion and garlic to pan cook 5 minutes or until golden brown, stirring frequently. add rice and next 3 ingredients through bay leaf bring to a boil. cover, reduce heat, and simmer 20 minutes. discard bay leaf. keep warm. prepare grill. combine salt and next 6 ingredients through pepper . brush lamb with oil, and rub with salt mixture. place lamb on grill rack coated with cooking spray grill 10 minutes, turning once or until a thermometer registers 145 medium rare to 160 medium . let stand 5 minutes before slicing into chops. serve lamb with rice. wine note lamb even spicy lamb like this is one of the most flexible meats when it comes to wine. it goes with just about every major red varietal. that said, when spice plays a key role, as it does here, i love to choose a thick, rich, spicy red that will both mirror the spiciness of the dish and act as a soft, thick backdrop. an australian shiraz is perfect. and since this is a special, fairly expensive cut of meat, i ve chosen a wine worthy of it penfolds st. henri 2003 from south australia, karen macneil

inputs: breadcrumbs, milk, butter, fresh mushrooms, flour, salt, cayenne pepper, egg yolks, egg whites, gouda cheese
targets: title: mushroom gouda souffle ingredients: 2 tbs. fine dry breadcrumbs 1 cup 1 low fat milk 2 tbs. unsalted butter 2 cups chopped fresh mushrooms, such as maitake and oyster 8 oz. 3 tbs. all purpose flour 1/2 tsp. salt 18 tsp. cayenne pepper 2 egg yolks 4 egg whites 1/2 cup shredded gouda cheese 2 oz. directions: preheat oven to 375f. set oven rack in lowest position. coat 1.5 qt. souffle dish with cooking spray. dust sides and bottom with breadcrumbs. chill. heat milk in saucepan over medium heat until tiny bubbles form around edge. keep warm. melt butter in separate saucepan over medium heat. add mushrooms, and saute 5 minutes. sprinkle with flour cook 1 minute more, stirring constantly. remove from heat whisk in warm milk. return to burner, and cook 1 minute, or until very thick, whisking constantly. remove from heat whisk in salt and cayenne. whisk in egg yolks one at a time. beat egg whites with electric mixer until stiff peaks form. fold one quarter of egg whites into yolk mixture. repeat with remaining egg whites, gradually sprinkling in cheese. scrape into prepared souffle dish. bake 35 minutes, or until puffy and browned.

inputs: whole kernel sweet corn, green beans, peas, onion, green pepper, pimentos, celery, sugar, white vinegar, oil, salt
targets: title: marinated vegetable salad ingredients: 1 can whole kernel sweet corn 1 can french style green beans 1 can peas 1 onion, diced 1 green pepper, diced 1 small jar pimentos diced celery optional 1 c. sugar 1/2 c. white vinegar 1 c. oil salt and pepper directions: mix together the first 7 ingredients. in a saucepan, heat the sugar, vinegar, oil, salt and pepper to a boil. cool. pour over vegetable mixture. marinate for at least 6 to 8 hours. add other seasonings to taste garlic powder, mixed herbs, etc. .

inputs: cheese, ripe olives, ripe olives, hot sauce, ground chuck, onion, salt, pepper, cheese
targets: title: cheesy cheeseburgers ingredients: 1 12 cups monterey jack cheese, shredded 14 cup ripe olives, chopped 2 tablespoons ripe olives, chopped 18 teaspoon hot sauce 1 34 lbs ground chuck 14 cup onion, chopped 1 teaspoon salt 12 teaspoon pepper 6 slices monterey jack cheese directions: combine the 1 1/2 cups shredded monterey jack cheese, ripe olives 1/4 cup plus 2 tbsp and hot sauce. shape the cheese/olive mixture into 6 balls. set aside. combine the ground chuck, onion, salt, and pepper. stir well and shape into 12 patties. place a cheese ball in the center of 6 patties flatten the cheese balls slightly. top with the remaining 6 patties, pressing the edges to seal. make sure you seal these well. cook, covered with the grill lid, over medium hot coals 350 to 400 degrees for 5 to 6 minutes on each side or until done. during the last 2 minutes of cooking, place a slice of monterey jack cheese on each patty. enjoy

inputs: chicken, onion, red pepper, oil, chicken broth, tomatoes, frozen peas, ground turmeric, red pepper, white rice
targets: title: spanish chicken rice ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken thighs 1 lb. 1 medium onion, chopped king sooper s 1 lb for 0.99 thru 02/09 1 medium red pepper, chopped 1 tbsp. oil 1 can 14 1/2 oz. chicken broth 1 can 15 oz. stewed tomatoes, undrained 1 cup frozen peas 1 tsp. ground turmeric optional 1/2 tsp. crushed red pepper 2 cups minute white rice, uncooked directions: cook chicken, onion and bell peppers in hot oil in large skillet until chicken is browned on both sides, turning chicken and stirring vegetables occasionally. add chicken broth, tomatoes with their liquid, the peas, turmeric and crushed red pepper bring to boil. stir in rice. reduce heat to low cover. cook 5 min. or until rice is tender.

inputs: eggs, bean sprouts, mushrooms, salt, pepper, sugar, flour, onion, oil
targets: title: egg foo yong ingredients: 4 eggs 1 cup bean sprouts 5 mushrooms 1 teaspoon salt 12 teaspoon pepper 1 teaspoon sugar 3 tablespoons flour 1 spring onion oil for frying directions: beat the eggs well and add flour, sugar, salt, pepper and mix well. finely chop the onion and mushroom and chuck in with the eggs. wash and drain the bean sprouts chuck them in the eggs. heat oil in a pan over a medium flame. stir the egg mix and add to the pan cooking until it is set.

inputs: macaroni, ricotta italian cottage cheese, butter, milk, parmesan cheese, salt
targets: title: pasta con ricotta macaroni with ricotta ingredients: 1 lb. any type cut macaroni 1 lb. ricotta italian cottage cheese 1/2 c. butter 1/2 c. milk 1/2 c. parmesan cheese, grated salt to taste directions: cook macaroni about 15 minutes or until tender in 5 quarts of rapidly boiling salted water. drain put back in pot and add butter. mix ricotta with milk in a bowl until smooth. pour over hot macaroni simmer 3 minutes over low flame in covered pot. sprinkle with grated parmesan cheese. serve very hot. serves 4 to 6.

inputs: eggs, salt, cheese
targets: title: best scrambled eggs ever ingredients: 8 eggs 8 tablespoons half and half 1 dash seasoning salt 1 cup cheese, grated directions: crack all the eggs into a mixing bowl. add half and half. beat until well mixed. sprinkle top of the eggs with seasoning salt. stir well. bake on low heat on stovetop until almost done. add the cheese, cook until melted. enjoy

inputs: flour, sugar, brown sugar, baking soda, salt, butter, peanut butter, egg, vanilla, oatmeal, chocolate chips, powdered sugar, peanut butter, milk
targets: title: peanut butter fingers ingredients: 1 c. flour 1/2 c. sugar 1/2 c. brown sugar 1/2 tsp. baking soda 1/4 tsp. salt 1/2 c. soft butter 1/3 c. peanut butter 1 egg 1/2 tsp. vanilla 1 c. quick oatmeal 1 c. chocolate chips 1/2 c. powdered sugar 1/4 c. peanut butter 2 to 4 tbsp. milk directions: mix flour, sugars, soda, salt, butter, 1/3 cup peanut butter, egg, vanilla and oatmeal with a fork or mixer until particles are coarse crumbs. press into greased 9 x 13 inch pan. bake at 350 for 20 to 25 minutes. sprinkle immediately with the chocolate chips. let stand 5 minutes. spread evenly.

inputs: cold heavy cream, sugar, vanilla
targets: title: sweetened whipped cream ingredients: 1 cup cold heavy cream 1 tablespoon sugar 1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract directions: whip the cream in the bowl of an electric mixer fitted with a whisk attachment you can also use a hand mixer . when it starts to thicken, add the sugar and vanilla and continue to beat until firm. don t overbeat

inputs: flour, baking soda, baking powder, salt, butter, sugar, eggs, sour cream, mashed ripe bananas, apple dip, toffee bits
targets: title: banoffee muffins ingredients: 1 3/4 c. flour 1 tsp. baking soda 1 tsp. baking powder 1/4 tsp. salt 1/2 c. butter 3/4 c. sugar 2 eggs 1/2 c. sour cream or yogurt 1 c. mashed ripe bananas 3 large 1 snack size container caramel apple dip 3/4 c. toffee bits such as skor directions: combine dry ingredients in bowl to mix. cream butter with sugar, beat in eggs until well combined. mix in sour cream and bananas, stir well. fold in dry ingredients just until mixed, and stir in 1/2 c. toffee bits. fill greased or lined muffin tins 1/4 full, making indent in center with back of spoon. drop in a dollop about 1/2 tsp of caramel dip, and carefully cover with remaining batter, spreading to cover filling completely. top each muffin with a sprinkle of remaining toffee bits. bake at 400 20 25 minutes till golden brown.

inputs: eggplant, green peppers, rice, chicken broth, tomatoes, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, bay leaf, onions
targets: title: sausage jambalaya ingredients: 3/4 lb. smoked and hot sausage mixed, thinly sliced 1 small eggplant about 1 lb. 1/2 c. chopped green peppers 2/3 c. uncooked rice 1 c. chicken broth 1 c. drained canned tomatoes, chopped or fresh 1/4 tsp. garlic powder 1/2 tsp. salt black pepper 1 small bay leaf 1/2 c. chopped onions directions: in an ovenproof skillet, cook sausage until lightly browned. add eggplant, onions and green peppers. cook until tender crisp. stir in rice, broth, tomatoes and seasonings. bring to a boil. cover and bake at 350 for 30 minutes or until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed. fluff lightly with a fork. remove bay leaf.

inputs: potatoes, grated cheese, onion, milk, sour cream, pimentos, butter, salt
targets: title: potato casserole ingredients: 6 medium potatoes 2 c. grated cheese 3/4 c. chopped onion 1 c. evaporated milk 2 small cartons sour cream 1 small jar pimentos 1 stick butter salt and pepper to taste directions: dice potatoes and boil 10 minutes. drain and add remaining ingredients. bake at 375 for 45 minutes.

inputs: chops, butter, flour, onions, thyme, gala apples, brown sugar, apple cider, cinnamon
targets: title: pork chops with apples ingredients: 6 whole boneless pork chops 4 tablespoons butter 1/4 cups flour 2 whole medium sized onions, sliced 1 teaspoon dried thyme 5 whole gala apples, cored and sliced 4 tablespoons brown sugar 1/4 cups apple cider 1 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon directions: in a large skillet, over medium heat, melt the butter. lightly dredge the pork chops in the flour, shaking off the excess. brown the pork chops on both sides in the butter. salt and pepper them lightly. transfer them to a baking dish. add the sliced onions to the skillet and saute until they have softened and start to turn translucent, about 7 or 8 minutes. add the thyme and a little salt and pepper. pour the onions on top of the pork chops, then place all the sliced apples on top of the onions. dont saute the apples mix the apple cider, brown sugar and cinnamon together and pour over the apples/onions/pork. you can sprinkle on additional cinnamon if you like i always do cover and bake at 425f for about 45 minutes or until the pork chops are done in the middle. uncover for the last 12 15 minutes to brown the apples.

inputs: rice, generous amount, white sesame seeds, shirasu, vinegar, sugar, salt
targets: title: delicious sushi rice without the sushi ingredients: 700 grams rice 3 leaves shiso leaves minced 1 generous amount aonori 1 white sesame seeds 1 shirasu semi dried baby sardines 2 tbsp vinegar 1 1/2 tbsp sugar 1 1 teaspoon salt directions: to make the sushi vinegar, combine the ingredients listed, microwave for about 20 seconds, then stir in the sugar and salt until the grains completely dissolve. stir the sushi vinegar from step 1 into freshly cooked rice, a small amount at a time, using cutting motions as you go. adjust the amount of vinegar to taste. add the minced shiso leaves, aonori, white sesame seeds, and shirasu, and it s ready to serve.

inputs: cactus strips, purple onion, tomato, cilantro, lime juice, queso quesadilla, red wine vinegar, olive oil
targets: title: cactus salad ingredients: 3 cups cactus strips, cooked 1/2 cup chopped purple onion king sooper s 1 lb for 0.99 thru 02/09 1 medium tomato, chopped king sooper s 1 lb for 0.99 thru 02/09 1/4 cup chopped cilantro 2 tbsp. lime juice safeway 3 ct for 1.00 thru 02/09 1 cup kraft shredded queso quesadilla 2 tbsp. red wine vinegar 1/4 cup olive oil directions: toss cactus, onion, tomato, cilantro and lime juice in medium bowl. season to taste. add cheese mix lightly. add a pinch of salt to vinegar in small bowl stir until salt is dissolved. gradually add oil, stirring with wire whisk until well blended. drizzle just enough dressing over the salad to moisten all ingredients toss lightly, serve any remaining dressing on the side.

inputs: cream, milk, milk, vanilla, my, pralines
targets: title: candied bacon praline ice cream ingredients: 3 cups heavy whipping cream 2 cups whole milk 1 can 14 oz. size sweetened condensed milk 2 tablespoons vanilla extract the real stuff, please 7 slices pig candy, chopped see my recipe box 1 cup pig pralines, rough chopped see my recipe box directions: combine the cream, milk, condensed milk and vanilla in a large mixing bowl and whisk well until all of the ingredients are completely incorporated. cover and refrigerate. prepare your ice cream maker and freeze the ice cream per the instructions. gently fold the bacon and pralines into the soft ice cream and freeze in an airtight container until it hardens 3 4 hours . serve and enjoy i served mine with a drizzle of a homemade maple caramel and some additional chopped bacon and pralines.

inputs: cakes, oranges, lemon, sugar, cream, orange slices
targets: title: boodle s orange fool ingredients: 4 6 single trifle sponge cakes, cut into 1 cm slices 2 oranges, juice and zest of 1 lemon, juice and zest of 25 50 g sugar 300 ml double cream orange slices to decorate or orange section to decorate directions: use the sponge slices to line the bottom and halfway up the sides of a deep serving dish or bowl. mix the orange and lemon zests and juices with the sugar and stir until the sugar is dissolved. in another bowl, whip the cream until it just starts to thicken, then slowly add the sweetened fruit juice, whipping the cream as you do so. whip until the cream is light and thickened and all the juice absorbed. pour the mixture over the sponge and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, longer if possible, so that the juice can soak into the sponge and the cream thicken serve decorated with segments or slices of fresh orange.

inputs: pickles, onions, salt, sugar, water, white vinegar, celery
targets: title: one day sweet pickles ingredients: 7 c. pickles, thinly sliced 2 onions, thin sliced 1 tbsp. salt 1/2 c. sugar 1/2 c. water 1 c. white vinegar 1 tsp. celery seed directions: mix salt in well with pickles and onions. let stand 2 hours. drain and squeeze out salt water. in a large bowl, add sugar, water, vinegar and celery seed. stir until sugar is dissolved. add pickles and onions. store in refrigerator overnight. will keep in refrigerator for 1 year.

inputs: ground beef, onion, green pepper, oregano, garlic salt, black pepper, tomato soup, parmesan, elbow macaroni, cheddar cheese, egg, milk
targets: title: pizza macaroni ingredients: 1 lb. ground beef 1 large chopped onion 1 large chopped green pepper 1/2 tsp. crushed oregano 1/2 tsp. garlic salt 1/2 tsp. black pepper 2 10 1/2 oz. cans tomato soup 3 tbsp. grated parmesan 1 12 oz. pkg. elbow macaroni 1/2 lb. cheddar cheese, grated 1 egg 1/2 c. milk directions: spray a 1 inch side pan jelly roll or cookie sheet . brown beef, vegetables and spices in skillet. as soon as vegetables are wilted and meat loses red color, add the soups and grated parmesan cheese. cook 15 minutes. prepare macaroni according to directions. drain and air dry. beat together milk and egg. stir into macaroni and spread in pan greased . cover with beef and tomato mixture. sprinkle 1/2 pound cheddar cheese on top. bake at 350 for 20 minutes. let set and cut into 8 large squares.

inputs: flour, sugar, salt, cold butter, egg yolk, cold water, apples, frozen raspberries, sugar, cornstarch, ground cinnamon, milk, decorating sugar
targets: title: rustic apple raspberry tart ingredients: 1 1/3 cups all purpose flour 1/4 cup sugar 1/8 teaspoon salt 6 tablespoons cold butter 1 egg yolk 3 tablespoons cold water 2 1/2 cups thinly sliced peeled tart apples about 2 medium 1 cup fresh or frozen raspberries 1/4 cup sugar 1 tablespoon cornstarch 3/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon 1 tablespoon milk coarse decorating sugar directions: in a small bowl, combine the flour, sugar and salt cut in butter until mixture is crumbly. gradually add egg yolk and water, tossing with a fork until a ball forms. shape into a disk wrap in plastic and refrigerate for at least 1 hour. on a lightly floured surface, roll out pastry into a 14 in. circle. transfer to a parchment paper lined 14 in. pizza pan. for filling, combine apples and raspberries in a large bowl. combine the sugar, cornstarch and cinnamon. add to the fruit toss gently to coat. spoon over pastry to within 2 in. of edges. fold up edges of pastry over filling, leaving center uncovered. brush folded pastry with milk sprinkle with coarse sugar. bake at 375 for 35 40 minutes or until crust is golden and filling is bubbly. using parchment paper, slide tart onto wire rack to cool.

inputs: sour cream, mayonnaise, fresh chives, white wine vinegar, shallots, sugar, salt, paprika, ground black pepper, green cabbage
targets: title: creamy coleslaw with chives and shallots ingredients: 1 cup sour cream 6 tablespoons mayonnaise 1/4 cup finely chopped fresh chives 3 1/2 tablespoons white wine vinegar 3 tablespoons minced shallots 3 tablespoons sugar 1 teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon paprika 1/2 teaspoon ground black pepper 1 2 pound head green cabbage, thinly sliced about 14 cups directions: blend first 9 ingredients in blender. place cabbage in large bowl. pour dressing over cabbage and toss to combine. cover and refrigerate at least 3 hours and up to 8 hours, tossing occasionally.

inputs: olive oil, head, baby artichokes, tomatoes, shallots, trout, flour, salt, butter, aged balsamic vinegar, lemon zest, parsley, paprika, salt, garlic, black pepper, onion powder, cayenne pepper, dried leaf oregano, thyme
targets: title: grilled butterflied rainbow trout ingredients: olive oil 1 head escarole, cleaned 2 pounds baby artichokes, cleaned and halved 5 plum tomatoes, halved 5 shallots, halved 4 12 to 16 ounce whole rainbow trout, cleaned, head removed, and butterflied 2 cups flour essence, recipe follows salt and freshly ground black pepper 2 tablespoons butter 2 tablespoons aged balsamic vinegar 2 teaspoons very fine grated lemon zest 2 tablespoons minced fresh parsley 2 1/2 tablespoons paprika 2 tablespoons salt 2 tablespoons garlic powder 1 tablespoon black pepper 1 tablespoon onion powder 1 tablespoon cayenne pepper 1 tablespoon dried leaf oregano 1 tablespoon dried thyme directions: preheat a grill. lightly oil the escarole, artichokes, tomatoes, and shallots and place on the grill. grill until tender, removing as they finish and placing on a large platter. press down on the trout to completely open and flatten. season the flour with essence, salt, and pepper and place in a shallow dish. dredge the trout in the seasoned flour. add butter and oil to a hot saute pan. pan fry the trout until golden brown on both sides and cooked through, about 4 minutes per side. place the fish on top of the grilled vegetables and top with balsamic vinegar, lemon zest, and parsley. combine all ingredients thoroughly and store in an airtight jar or container. yield about 2/3 cup recipe from new new orleans cooking , by emeril lagasse and jessie tirsch. published by william and morrow, 1993.

inputs: fingerling potatoes, butter, garlic, fresh chives, lemon, salmon filets, tomatoes, green beans, broccoli, almonds
targets: title: salmon with vegetables and fingerling potatoes ingredients: 1 lb fingerling potatoes, scrubbed 6 tbsp butter 2 cloves garlic, peeled and crushed 2 tbsp chopped fresh chives 1/2 none lemon, juiced 4 none salmon filets, about 1/4 lb each 1/2 lb plum tomatoes 1/3 lb green beans, trimmed and steamed 1/3 lb broccoli, trimmed and steamed 2 tbsp sliced almonds, lightly toasted directions: place the potatoes in a large saucepan of water and bring to a boil. simmer, partially covered for 10 15 mins, until just tender. drain and return to pan. add 3 tbsp of the butter and the garlic, chives and lemon juice. toss to combine. heat remaining butter in a large frying pan on high. cook the salmon for 3 4 mins on each side, until golden and cooked. remove from the pan and set aside. cook the tomatoes in the same pan for 2 3 mins, until they start to soften. serve the fish with the potatoes, tomatoes, green beans and broccoli. drizzle with the pan juices and sprinkle with the almonds.

inputs: angel, clove garlic, thyme, herbs, lemom, salt pepper, butter, olive oil
targets: title: garlic and herb pan fried angel fish ingredients: 1 medium angel fish fillet or any fish of your choice 2 clove garlic 1 tsp thyme 1 tsp mixed italian herbs 1 lemom 1 salt pepper to taste 2 tbsp butter 2 tbsp olive oil directions: season fillet with salt pepper mix herbs with lemon juice and garlic and dress the fillet. allow to marinade for 30mins. heat the olive oil and butter in and pan. heat the olive oil and butter in and pan. place fillet skin side down and cook while pouring hot oil and butter over the top of the of the fish for 7 minutes. flip over an additional 3 minutes and serve with sides of your choice. green salad and spicy rice shown in pic

inputs: eggs, flour, brown sugar, margarine, chocolate chips, sugar, walnuts, shell, whipped cream
targets: title: toll house pie ingredients: 2 eggs 1/2 c. flour 1/2 c. brown sugar 3/4 c. margarine 1 1/2 sticks 1 c. chocolate chips 1/2 c. sugar 1 c. chopped walnuts 1 9 inch unbaked pie shell whipped cream or ice cream optional directions: preheat oven to 325 . in large mixer bowl, beat eggs at high speed until foamy, about 3 minutes. beat in flour, sugar and brown sugar until well blended. beat in softened butter. stir in walnuts and chocolate chips. pour into pie shell. bake 55 to 60 minutes. top will be golden brown. serve with whipped cream or ice cream, if desired.

inputs: unsalted butter, sorghum flour, cornstarch, tapioca flour, guar gum, baking powder, kosher salt, sugar, brown sugar, light brown sugar, ground cinnamon, freshly grated nutmeg, freshly ground ginger, golden delicious apple, pumpkin puree, eggs, vanilla
targets: title: gluten free pumpkin apple muffins ingredients: 12 tablespoons unsalted butter 1 cup sorghum flour 1/2 cup cornstarch 1/2 cup tapioca flour 2 teaspoons guar gum 2 teaspoons baking powder 1/4 teaspoon kosher salt 1 cup granulated sugar 1 tablespoon dark brown sugar, packed dark muscovado 1/2 cup light brown sugar, packed light muscovado 2 1/8 teaspoons ground cinnamon 1/2 teaspoon freshly grated nutmeg 1 1/2 teaspoons freshly ground ginger 1 golden delicious apple, peeled, cored, thinly sliced and then diced 1 15 ounce can unsweetened pumpkin puree 2 large eggs 3 teaspoons pure vanilla extract directions: preheat oven to 350 f and line your muffin tins with 18 muffin/cupcake paper cups and set aside. in a medium sized bowl, combine all the dry ingredients, including the sugars and stir with a wooden spoon until all the ingredients look evenly distributed. in a stand up mixer with the paddle attachment, cream the butter until soft and then add all the dry ingredients at once and mix on low for about 2 minutes. add the eggs, pumpkin and vanilla and mix on medium high speed until light and fluffy, scraping down the sides of the bowl as necessary. lastly, add your diced golden delicious apple and mix for 1 minute more. using an ice cream scoop, fill your muffin cups with your batter and bake at 350 f for 25 minutes. the muffins should have nice fissures traversing the tops and the utmost edges should be slightly darker than the rest of the muffin. a wooden skewer inserted into one of the muffins will come out clean.

inputs: sausage, eggs, milk, salt, white bread, grated cheese
targets: title: egg casserole ingredients: 1 lb. sausage 6 eggs 2 c. milk 1 tsp. salt white bread 1 c. grated cheese directions: cook sausage drain grease. beat eggs, milk and salt. add sausage and cheese. cut bread into chunks and layer casserole dish. pour egg mixture over bread. refrigerate overnight. bake at 350 for 45 minutes.

inputs: vegetable soup, ground meat, potatoes, butter, salt, water
targets: title: shepherd s pie ingredients: 1 can vegetable soup 1 lb. ground meat 1 c. instant potatoes 1 tsp. butter salt and pepper to taste 2 c. water directions: brown the ground meat in frying pan. bring 2 cups water to boil. add the potatoes, butter, salt and pepper mix. in baking dish, add browned meat and vegetable soup, then top with potatoes sealed to edges of dish. bake at 350 until golden brown.

inputs: ground beef, italian sausage, cheddar cheese, buns, pizza sauce, pepperoni
targets: title: meaty buns casserole ingredients: 1/2 pound ground beef 1/2 pound bulk italian sausage 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese 4 hamburger buns, split 1 14 ounce can pizza sauce 2 ounces sliced pepperoni directions: preheat the oven to 375 degrees f 190 degrees c . heat a large skillet over medium heat. add ground beef and italian sausage cook, stirring to crumble, until no longer pink. drain off grease. stir in the pizza sauce. make a layer of hamburger bun halves in the bottom of a 9 inch square baking dish. top with half of the meat sauce and half of the cheese. arrange half of the pepperoni slices on top of the layer. repeat the layers, ending up with cheese and pepperoni on top. bake uncovered for 20 minutes in the preheated oven, or until the cheese is starting to brown.

inputs: bread, eggs, mushrooms, onion
targets: title: spinach salad sandwiches ingredients: 10 slices bread 1/4 c. bottle light thousand island dressing 2 boiled eggs, finely chopped 1/2 c. finely chopped mushrooms onion, finely chopped optional directions: cut each bread slice into assorted shapes. in a small bowl, combine dressing, eggs, spinach and mushrooms. spread evenly on bread. top, if desired, with sliced hard cooked eggs or sliced mushrooms. place on damp cloth and refrigerate covered until serving time.

inputs: yellow cake mix, milk, cream of coconut, frozen coconut
targets: title: refrigerator coconut cake ingredients: 1 pkg. yellow cake mix 1 can eagle brand milk 1 can cream of coconut 1 large container cool whip 2 8 oz. pkg. frozen coconut directions: prepare cake according to directions on box in an oblong pan. while cake is till warm, punch holes in cake with large prong fork. mix milk and cream of coconut pour over cake. top with cool whip and then coconut refrigerate.

inputs: brownie mix, milk, vanilla instant pudding, cherry pie filling
targets: title: brownie torte ingredients: 1 large box brownie mix 1 can eagle brand 1/2 c. milk 1 4 oz. vanilla instant pudding 4 oz. cool whip 1 can cherry pie filling directions: grease two 9 inch cake pans. prepare brownie mix as directed for cake brownies. pour into pans. bake 350 for 20 minutes. cool. mix 1/2 cup milk and pudding. chill 10 minutes. mix eagle brand and cool whip into pudding. spread 1/2 of mixture on brownie layer. spread on 1/2 of fruit. place 2nd brownie layer on this. top with pudding mixture and rest of fruit. store in refrigerator.

inputs: butter, o brien frozen, celery salt, eggs, milk, salt, pepper, green onion, cheddar cheese, bacon bits
targets: title: open face omelet o brien ingredients: 6 tablespoons butter 3 cups o brien frozen potatoes 34 teaspoon celery salt 6 large eggs 14 cup milk 12 teaspoon salt pepper, to taste 14 cup green onion, chopped 12 cup cheddar cheese, shredded bacon bits, to taste directions: melt 3 tablespoons butter in 10 inch skillet over moderate heat. add potatoes in even layer and sprinkle with celery salt. cook, turning frequently, about 10 minutes, until tender and lightly browned. set aside in a dish and keep warm. meanwhile, in a bowl, beat eggs with milk, salt and pepper. melt remaining butter in same skillet. pour in egg mixture and cook over moderate heat, lifting edges as egg sets to allow uncooked portion to run underneath. when omelet is set, spoon the hot potatoes on top, along with cheese, onions and bacon bits. cut into wedges and serve. garnish with sour cream, if desired.

inputs: hot cooked pasta, water, olive oil, garlic, red bell pepper, tomatoes, olive, feta cheese, almonds, parsley, lemon wedge, salt, pepper
targets: title: i heart feta pasta ingredients: 4 cups hot cooked pasta 12 cup reserved pasta water 2 tablespoons olive oil 2 garlic cloves, minced 1 medium red bell pepper, chopped 3 tablespoons sun dried tomatoes, julienned 14 cup pitted kalamata olive, sliced 6 ounces feta cheese, crumbled 14 cup almonds, chopped 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley lemon wedge salt pepper directions: heat olive oil in medium pan. saute garlic and red bell pepper over medium 4 5 minutes. add olives and sun dried tomatoes. heat through. add cooked pasta to skillet. toss to combine adding reserved pasta water as needed to lubricate pasta. transfer to serving dish, add feta and almonds. stir to combine. season with salt and pepper to taste. garnish with fresh parsley and lemons.

inputs: sherbet, almond, white cake, coconut
targets: title: soft sherbet coconut macaroons ingredients: 1 pint sherbet, softened any flavor 2 teaspoons almond extract 1 18 1/4 ounce box white cake mix 6 cups sweetened flaked coconut directions: in a large mixing bowl, combine sherbet, almond extract, and dry cake mix mix well. stir in the coconut. drop by tablespoons 2 inches apart onto greased baking sheets. bake at 350 degrees for 12 15 minutes or until edges are lightly browned. remove to wire racks to cool.

inputs: flour, baking powder, soda, salt, cinnamon, nutmeg, pumpkin, sugar, milk, eggs, butter
targets: title: pumpkin bread ingredients: 2 c. flour 2 tsp. baking powder 1/2 tsp. soda 1 tsp. salt 1 tsp. cinnamon 1/2 tsp. nutmeg 1 c. pumpkin 1 c. sugar 1/2 c. milk 2 eggs 1/4 c. butter directions: sift together the dry ingredients. mix eggs beaten with buttermilk, sugar and pumpkin. last, beat in all of the sifted dry ingredients. bake 45 to 50 minutes at 350 .

inputs: flour, yeast, crisp fried bacon, milk, sugar, salt, bacon grease
targets: title: bacon bread recipe ingredients: 7 1/2 c. flour all purpose 2 pkt yeast 20 x slices crisp fried bacon 2 1/2 c. lowfat milk 2 tbsp. sugar 2 tsp salt 4 tbsp. bacon grease directions: combine 2c flour with yeast and mix well heat lowfat milk, sugar, grease and salt until hot 115 120 deg add in to dry mix beat at low speed 2 minutes. add in 1c flour and beat at medium speed for 3 minutes. by hand add in broken bacon pcs and flour 1c at a time to create moderately stiff dough. let rise until doubled in bulk. split into two parts and place in bread pans. bake at 375 deg f. for 30 minutes. remove from pans and brush with melted butter. makes 2loaves 18 servings 1 slice per loaf.

inputs: caramels, milk, chocolate cake, butter, milk, nuts, chocolate
targets: title: caramel layer choco squares cookies ingredients: 1 14 oz. pkg. caramels 1/3 c. evaporated milk 1 box german chocolate cake mix 1/2 c. butter or margarine 1/3 c. evaporated milk 1 c. nuts 1 c. chocolate morsels 6 oz. directions: grease and flour a 13 x 9 inch baking pan. in mixing bowl, combine dry cake mix, butter, 1/3 cup milk and nuts by hand. stir until dough holds together. press 1/2 of dough into prepared pan. reserve remaining dough for topping. bake at 350 for 6 minutes. sprinkle chocolate pieces over baked crusts. spread caramel mixture over chocolate pieces. crumble reserved dough over caramel mixture. return to oven and bake 15 minutes. cool slightly. refrigerate 30 minutes to set caramel. cut into squares.

inputs: frozen broccoli, margarine, american cheese, crackers
targets: title: easy broccoli casserole ingredients: 2 pkg. frozen broccoli, cooked as on pkg. 1/2 lb. margarine 1/4 lb. american cheese ritz crackers directions: cook broccoli as on package. drain. add margarine and american cheese. cover with ritz crackers. bake 30 minutes at 350 .

inputs: sugar, butter, lemon juice, vanilla, eggs, flour, salt, soda, cream of tartar
targets: title: touch of lemon sugar cookies recipe ingredients: 2 c. sugar 1 c. butter 1 tbsp. grated lemon peel 1/4 c. lemon juice 1 teaspoon vanilla 2 large eggs 3 1/4 c. flour 1 teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon soda 1 teaspoon cream of tartar directions: in large bowl, blend first 6 ingredients till smooth. lightly spoon into measuring c., level off . stir in flour, salt, soda, and cream of tartar. refrigeratefor 1 hour. preheat oven to 325 degrees. form dough into 1 inch balls. roll each in sugar, place 2 inches apart on greased cookie sheets. bake for 15 to 20 min till light golden. cookies will be soft in center.

inputs: brussels, onion, bacon, sour cream, fresh coarse ground black pepper, salt, sprinkling paprika
targets: title: hungarian style brussels sprouts ingredients: 1 1/2 lbs fresh brussels sprouts can substitute frozen, cooked according to package directions 1 small onion, chopped 4 slices bacon, cut into 1 inch pieces 1 cup sour cream 1/8 teaspoon fresh coarse ground black pepper salt, to taste sprinkling paprika optional directions: heat 1 inch salted water to boiling add brussels sprouts. heat to boiling cover and reduce heat. simmer 8 10 minutes, or until tender drain. fry bacon over medium heat until crisp. remove bacon with slotted spoon reserve drippings. cook and stir onions in hot bacon drippings until tender. stir in brussels sprouts, sour cream and pepper salt to taste. heat until hot sprinkle with bacon and paprika if desired .

inputs: sausages, sunflower oil, oregano, garlic, tomatoes, beef stock, black olives
targets: title: sausages with oregano mushrooms and olives ingredients: 8 sausages 1 teaspoon sunflower oil 2 teaspoons dried oregano 2 garlic cloves, chopped 400 g chopped tomatoes 200 ml beef stock 100 g black olives 500 g mushrooms, sliced directions: using kitchen scissors, snip the sauages into meatball size pieces. heat a large pan and fry the pieces in the oil for around 5 mins till goldena ll over. add the oregano and garlic, fry for 1 min more then tip in the tomatoes, stock, olives and mushrooms. simer for 15 mins until the sausages are cooked through and the sauce has reduced a little. serve with mash or pasta.

inputs: oats, sugar, margarine, flour, salt, chocolate chips, boiling water, brown sugar, eggs, baking soda, cocoa
targets: title: oatmeal chocolate chip cake ingredients: 1 c. oats 1 c. sugar 1 stick margarine 1 3/4 c. flour 1/2 tsp. salt 6 oz. chocolate chips 1 3/4 c. boiling water 1 c. brown sugar 2 eggs 1 tsp. baking soda 1 1/2 tbsp. cocoa directions: combine oats and boiling water in a large bowl. let stand 10 minutes. add remainder of ingredients except chocolate chips. mix well. stir 1/2 chips into batter. pour in greased 9 x 13 inch pan. mix rest of chips with coconut and chopped nuts. sprinkle on top of batter. bake at 350 for 30 to 40 minutes.

inputs: crayfish tails, margarine, shallots, shallots, onions, stalks celery, salt, pepper, flour, crayfish fat, golden mushroom soup, parsley
targets: title: crayfish etouffee ingredients: 2 lb. crayfish tails 2 sticks margarine 1 c. shallots green parts 1 c. shallots white parts 1 c. onions 2 stalks celery 2 tsp. salt 1 tsp. pepper 2 tbsp. flour crayfish fat 1 can golden mushroom soup optional parsley, chopped directions: melt margarine and blend in flour cook until mixture turns golden brown. add onion, celery and white of shallots and cook until seasonings soften. add mushroom soup and fat and simmer about 15 minutes. add green onions, salt, pepper and crayfish tails. keep cover on pot and simmer 10 to 15 minutes until done. add parsley serve on rice. crayfish toughen if overcooked.

inputs: cranberry juice cocktail, water, brown sugar, ground cloves, ground allspice, ground cinnamon, ground nutmeg, pineapple juice
targets: title: hot cranberry punch ingredients: 1 48 oz. bottle cranberry juice cocktail 1 c. water 1/2 c. firmly packed brown sugar 3/4 tsp. ground cloves 1/2 tsp. ground allspice 1/2 tsp. ground cinnamon 1/4 tsp. ground nutmeg 1 46 oz. can pineapple juice directions: combine all ingredients, except pineapple juice, in a large dutch oven stir well. bring to a boil, stirring occasionally. add pineapple juice return to a boil. reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes. serve hot. yield 3 quarts.

inputs: cauliflower, oil, green onions, garlic, basil, salt, italian seasoned breadcrumbs, parmesan cheese
targets: title: italian breaded cauliflower ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, broken into bite size pieces 2 tablespoons oil 4 green onions, sliced 4 garlic cloves, minced 1 teaspoon dried basil salt and pepper 1/2 cup dried italian seasoned breadcrumbs 1/4 cup grated parmesan cheese directions: steam cauliflower in microwave or on stovetop until just barely crisp tender. set aside. in large skillet, saute green onions and garlic in oil for 2 minutes. add cauliflower, basil and salt and pepper to pan and mix well. cover and cook on medium low heat for 15 minutes or until cauliflower is at desired doneness. mix together bread crumbs and parmesan cheese. add to pan and stir to mix. serve immediately.

inputs: margarine, sugar, eggs, flour, salt, vanilla, nuts, dates, milk, chocolate
targets: title: date nut brownies ingredients: 1/2 c. margarine 2 c. sugar 4 eggs 1 1/2 c. flour pinch of salt 1 tsp. vanilla 1 c. nuts 1 c. dates, cut up 1/2 c. milk 4 oz. chocolate sq. directions: cream margarine and sugar. mix eggs, flour, salt and milk. add chocolate, vanilla, nuts and dates. grease and flour a 10 x 14 inch pan. bake at 350 for about 30 minutes. let cool and cut into squares. roll in powdered sugar.

inputs: graham cracker crumbs, cream cheese, eggs, cream of tartar, sugar, salt, vanilla, lemon, powdered milk, liquid milk
targets: title: my mom s cheesecake ingredients: 3/4 cup graham cracker crumbs about 5 whole crackers 1 8 ounce package cream cheese 6 eggs, separated 3/4 teaspoon cream of tartar 1 1/2 cups sugar, divided 1/2 teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon vanilla 1 teaspoon lemon extract or 1 teaspoon lemon, zest of 1 cup powdered milk 1/4 cup liquid milk directions: pre heat oven to 325 deg f. butter bottom and sides of a 9x13 inch baking pan and sprinkle with graham cracker crumbs. set aside. cut cream cheese into 12 to 15 chunks and set aside to soften. beat egg whites and cream of tartar, gradually adding 3/4 cup of sugar. beat until stiff peaks form and sugar is dissolved. beat egg yolks with salt, flavorings and remaining 3/4 cup of sugar until thickened and golden in color. add cream cheese to egg yolk mixture one chunk at a time, beating well after each addition. continue to beat until blended. sprinkle powdered milk and liquid milk over yolk mixture and continue beating until well blended. fold in egg white mixture and pour into prepared pan. bake at 325 deg f until brown and puffy, about 40 minutes. cheese cake will collapse as it cools. refrigerate after cooling.

inputs: apples, cinnamon, nutmeg, lemon juice, walnuts, raisins, sugar, flour, butter, cream
targets: title: delicious apple crisp ingredients: 6 medium sized tart apples, peeled, cored and sliced thin 1/2 tsp. cinnamon 1/4 tsp. nutmeg 1 tbsp. lemon juice 1/2 c. chopped walnuts 1 c. raisins 1 c. sugar 3/4 c. flour 6 tbsp. butter or margarine ice cream or whipping cream if dairy meal plenty sweet without it directions: preheat oven to 350 . butter a 6 cup baking dish or 10 inch pie plate. mix apples with cinnamon, nutmeg, lemon juice, walnuts, raisins and 1/2 cup sugar. spread in baking dish. combine remaining sugar with flour in a bowl. cut in margarine or butter with pastry blender or two knives until mixture resembles coarse meal. spread over apples. bake until top is lightly browned, about 45 minutes to 1 hour. serve with ice cream or whipping cream if dairy, but it is plenty sweet without it.

inputs: pear, lemon, milk ricotta cheese, kosher salt, honey, nuts
targets: title: honey ricotta pear ingredients: 1 ripe anjou or bosc pear 1/2 a lemon 1/2 cup whole milk ricotta cheese kosher salt and freshly ground pepper honey, for drizzling 1 tablespoon toasted pine nuts directions: 1. halve and core the pear, then cut into slices, leaving the stem end intact and not cutting through to separate the slices. squeeze the lemon juice over the cut side of the pear halves. 2. season the ricotta with 1/4 teaspoon salt and 1/4 teaspoon pepper, then place in 2 mounds on a plate. top the ricotta mounds with the sliced pear halves, gently fanning out the slices. drizzle the pears with honey and sprinkle with the pine nuts.

inputs: all purpose, sugar, soda, salt, cinnamon, vegetable oil, banana, pineapple, vanilla
targets: title: pineapple banana bread ingredients: 3 c. all purpose flour 2 c. sugar 1 tsp. soda 1 tsp. salt 1 tsp. cinnamon 1 1/2 c. vegetable oil 2 c. mashed banana 1 8 oz. can crushed pineapple, drained 2 tsp. vanilla directions: combine dry ingredients, stir in nuts. add rest of ingredients oil, bananas, eggs and pineapple . stir until moistened. spoon batter into 2 greased and floured 9 x 5 x 3 inch loaf pans. bake for 1hour or until done. cool 10 minutes in pan, then put on rack to cool. bake at 350 .

inputs: olive oil, onion, carrot, celery, flour, tomato paste, chicken broth, pork, potatoes, cheddar cheese
targets: title: shepherd s pie ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive oil 1 onion, chopped 1/2 cup chopped carrot 1/2 cup chopped celery 3 tablespoons flour 2 tablespoons tomato paste 2 cups chicken broth 3 cups cubed, cooked pork 2 cups mashed potatoes made from a box 1/2 cup grated cheddar cheese directions: prep time 10 minutes cook time 10 minutes on stove 40 minutes in oven preheat the oven to 350 degrees. in a large pot, heat oil over medium heat. add onion, carrot, and celery, and cook until soft, about 3 minutes. add flour, tomato paste, and broth, and whisk together. simmer for 7 minutes. add meat and stir to combine. spoon into a 2 quart baking dish or individual ramekins. spread mashed potatoes on top and bake 30 minutes. sprinkle with cheese bake 10 to 15 minutes more, until cheese is melted and golden. how kids can help measure ingredients spread potatoes over meat.

inputs: yellow cake mix, milk, eggs, soda, oil, vanilla, bananas, shredded coconut, graham cracker crumbs
targets: title: banana cake ingredients: 1 pkg. yellow cake mix 1/2 c. evaporated milk 2 eggs, beaten 1/2 tsp. soda 1/4 c. oil 2 tsp. vanilla 1 c. mashed bananas 1/2 c. shredded coconut 3/4 c. fine graham cracker crumbs directions: mix first 7 ingredients. do not overbeat. mix in coconut and crumbs. pour into tube pan. bake at 350 for 1 hour or until done.

inputs: cream cheese, mayonnaise, milk, lemon juice, ground cinnamon, celery, raisins, walnuts, apple wedges
targets: title: waldorf dip ingredients: 1 8 oz. pkg. cream cheese, softened 1/2 c. mayonnaise 3 tbsp. milk 1 tbsp. lemon juice 1/4 tsp. ground cinnamon 1/4 c. finely chopped celery 1/4 c. chopped raisins 2 tbsp. toasted walnuts apple wedges directions: combine cheese, mayo, milk, 1 tablespoon lemon juice and cinnamon in a small bowl beat until smooth. stir in celery and raisins. add more milk until mixture is dripping consistency. chill, covered, for 2 hours. brush apple wedges with lemon juice. sprinkle dip with walnuts.

inputs: ground beef, pork n, bacon bits, onion soup mix, mustard, brown sugar, your favorite, salt
targets: title: ms. theresa s bbq beans ingredients: 1 3/4 lb 90 10 ground beef 1 53 ounce can of pork n beans 1/3 cup bacon bits 1 packet lipton onion soup mix 1 tsp dry mustard 1 cup brown sugar 1 cup your favorite bbq sauce 1/2 tsp salt directions: in a large skillet over medium heat, brown the ground beef and pour off any grease. set aside. in a separate pot, add the can of beans along with the rest of the ingredients. stir to combine and bring to a simmer. add the ground beef to the beans and stir well. allow to simmer for 30 minutes.

inputs: low fat chocolate wafer cookies, brown sugar, canola oil, instant espresso, cream, non fat, cocoa powder, chocolate
targets: title: mississippi mud pie ingredients: 1 cup low fat chocolate wafer cookies from 3 cups cookies 1 tablespoon brown sugar 1 teaspoon canola oil 1 teaspoon instant espresso, mixed with 1 tablespoon hot water, plus 4 teaspoons instant espresso, mixed with 1 tablespoon water 14 ounces puffed marshmallow cream 8 ounces non fat frozen whipped topping, thawed 2 tablespoons cocoa powder 1 ounce semisweet chocolate, shaved directions: in a food processor, combine wafer cookies with brown sugar, canola oil, and 1 teaspoon espresso dissolved in water. process until ground. press mixture into a 9 inch pie pan. place marshmallow cream into a large bowl and fold in the non fat frozen whipped topping. divide the mixture into 2 separate bowls. fold cocoa powder into 1 of the bowls and then spread over crust. fold 4 teaspoons espresso dissolved in water into the second bowl and then spread over filling. refrigerate for 2 hours or until set. slice with a hot, wet knife. top with shaved chocolate.

inputs: chicken breast halves, olive oil, garlic, tomatoes, white wine, chicken broth, heavy cream, fresh basil
targets: title: chicken with sun dried tomato cream sauce ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breast halves 1 1/2 pound total 1 tablespoon olive oil 4 garlic cloves, minced 1/4 cup drained sun dried tomatoes packed in oil 1/2 ounce , patted dry and coarsely chopped 3/4 teaspoon dried hot red pepper flakes 1/4 cup dry white wine 3/4 cup chicken broth 1/4 cup heavy cream 1/4 cup thinly sliced fresh basil directions: pat chicken dry and season with salt and black pepper. heat oil in a 12 inch heavy skillet over moderately high heat until hot but not smoking, then brown chicken, turning once, about 6 minutes total. chicken will not be cooked through. transfer with tongs to a plate. add garlic, tomatoes, and red pepper flakes to skillet and saute, stirring, until garlic is pale golden, about 1 minute. add wine and boil, stirring and scraping up brown bits, until reduced by half, about 1 minute. add chicken broth and bring to a boil, covered. add chicken to skillet with any juices accumulated on plate and simmer, covered, until just cooked through, 4 to 5 minutes. transfer chicken with tongs to a platter and keep warm, loosely covered with foil. stir cream and 2 tablespoons basil into sauce in skillet and bring just to a simmer. transfer sauce to a deep heatproof bowl or 1 quart glass measure and puree with an immersion blender until almost smooth. alternatively, blend sauce in a standing blender. use caution when blending hot liquids. if necessary, add water to thin to desired consistency, then season with salt and pepper. serve sauce over chicken and sprinkle with remaining 2 tablespoons basil.

inputs: broccoli rabe, orecchiette, olive oil, garlic, italian sausage, salt, red pepper, romano
targets: title: orecchiette with sausage and broccoli rabe ingredients: 1 pound broccoli rabe 1 pound orecchiette 2 tablespoons olive oil might need less depending on how fatty the sausage is 2 to 3 cloves garlic, thinly sliced 1 pound italian sausage casing removed salt red pepper flakes to taste pecorino romano or parmesan cheese directions: trim ends of broccoli rabe and peel stems if too thick. in a large pot of rapidly boiling, salted water, blanch the broccoli rabe until tender and cooked through, about 5 to 6 minutes. drain and rinse the broccoli rabe with cold water until cooled. cook the pasta in the same water as the broccoli rabe according to package directions until al dente. before you drain the pasta, reserve 1 cup of cooking liquid. while the pasta is cooking, place 2 tablespoons of olive oil into a cold skillet with garlic. once garlic is slightly brown, and sausage. cook, stirring occasionally, until sausage is cooked through. sprinkle with red pepper flakes. add broccoli rabe and reserved water into pan with sausage. add a little water at a time until desired consistency is achieved should have some liquid in the pan, but not be too watery . when the pasta is cooked, drain it and place back in pot you cooked it in and pour sausage and broccoli rabe over pasta. add salt/red pepper to taste. serve with grated pecorino romano or parmesan cheese.

inputs: chorizo, potatoes, broccoli, onion, oil, pepper, cheddar cheese, sour cream
targets: title: hobo hash recipe ingredients: 8 ounce. chorizo spicy sausage or possibly use ham 1 1/2 c. , precooked 4 lg. potatoes, cooked diced 1 c. broccoli, minced 1 sm. onion, minced 1/3 c. 3 tbsp. veg. oil 1/8 teaspoon pepper 1 c. cheddar cheese, shredded lowfat sour cream directions: crumble sausage into 12 inch skillet. cook till meat is browned. drain. add in potatoes, broccoli, onion, oil and pepper. cook over medium heat for 8 to 10 min or possibly till golden brown on bottom, turning occasionally. sprinkle with cheese. cover and cook over medium heat till cheese melts. serve the warm mix topped with lowfat sour cream. makes 6 servings.

inputs: chicken breast, celery, pineapple, romaine lettuce, black olives, lime juice, orange juice, dill weed, chives
targets: title: tropical chicken salad ingredients: 1 boneless skinless chicken breast, grilled and coarsely chopped 14 cup celery, diced 14 cup pineapple chunk, drained 12 cup romaine lettuce, chopped 1 2 tablespoon black olives, sliced 12 tablespoon lime juice 2 tablespoons orange juice 1 pinch dill weed 1 pinch chives, chopped directions: combine chicken, celery, pineapple, lettuce, and olives toss well. mix lime juice, orange juice, dill weed, and chives in a small bowl. drizzle sauce over salad. enjoy

inputs: tuna, pickles, eggs, onions, mayonnaise, salt
targets: title: tuna relish sandwiches ingredients: 2 cans spring water tuna 2 medium pickles 3 eggs 1/2 c. chopped onions 1/2 c. mayonnaise or miracle whip salt and pepper to taste directions: drain water from the tuna. hard boil the eggs and chop into small pieces. finely chop the pickles. mix all the ingredients together and spread on bread.

inputs: flour, cocoa, baking soda, salt, butter, sugar, eggs, sour cream, milk, red food color, vanilla
targets: title: red velvet cupcakes ingredients: 2 1/2 cup flour 1/2 cup unsweetened cocoa powder 1 tsp baking soda 1/2 tsp salt 1 cup butter, softened 2 cup sugar 4 eggs 1 cup sour cream 1/2 cup milk 1 oz red food color 2 tsp vanilla extract directions: preheat oven to 350f mix flour, cocoa, baking soda, and salt. set aside beat butter and sugar in large bowl on medium speed for 5 minutes. beat in eggs. mix in sour cream, milk, food color and vanilla beat in flour mixture on low speed until blended fill cups 2/3 full bake 20 to 25 minutes cool 5 minutes

inputs: pork loin chops, flour, thyme, kosher salt, ground black pepper, butter, olive oil, sauce, dark beer, sour cream, onion, caraway seed, fresh parsley
targets: title: pork, onions and beer in a creamy caraway sauce ingredients: 4 pork loin chops 1 1/4 1/2 inch thick 1/2 cup flour 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt 1/4 teaspoon ground black pepper 1 tablespoon butter 1 tablespoon olive oil sauce 2 cups dark beer you don t want to do a heavy stout or ale which can be a bit bitter, i prefer michelob dark or amber 2/3 cup sour cream no low fat 1 large onion cut in half and thin sliced 3/4 teaspoon caraway seed you can use a bit more or less according to your taste 1 tablespoon fresh parsley, chopped directions: pork in a large baggie or you can use a small bowl or pie plate and add the flour, salt, pepper and thyme and dredge the pork in it to get a light coating of flour. then in a large heavy saute pan, i like my cast iron, but any heavy pan will work fine. i do not like to use non stick for this. heat up the oil and butter to medium high to high heat and saute the pork on each side until golden brown. don t forget they are going to continue cooking in the beer so it is not necessary to cook them all the way through. sauce remove the chops just for a minute while you lightly saute the onions. they only need to be cooked for just a couple of minutes. then add the beer scraping up the bits from the bottom of the pan. return the pork chops back to the pan and cover and reduce the heat to simmer and cook approximately 30 minutes. the last 5 minutes remove the cover so the beer can reduce a bit. finishing add the sour cream, salt, pepper, caraway seeds and parsley and cook another couple of minutes until everything is heated through. serve as i mentioned, i like to serve this over spaetzle, but butter noodles, potato pancakes, even rice or mashed potatoes. drizzle the sauce and onions over the chops.

inputs: cake, white potatoes, active dry yeast, water, sugar, sugar, butter, salt, eggs, flour, topping, butter, flour, sugar, eggs, milk
targets: title: philly butter cake scratch ingredients: cake 2 medium white potatoes 4 1/2 teaspoons active dry yeast, equals 2 packages 1/4 cup water 1 cup sugar 1 teaspoon sugar 4 tablespoons butter 2 teaspoons salt 2 large eggs, well beaten 3 3 1/2 cups all flour topping 3/4 cup butter 1/2 cup flour 1 1/2 cups sugar 2 large eggs 3 4 tablespoons milk directions: peel potatoes and boil until tender. drain and reserve 3/4 c of cooking water. mash the potatoes and stir in the potato water set aside. dissolve yeast in the warm water and add the 1 teaspoons salt. add the yeast mixture to the potato mixture mix on low speed to blend. cream the butter and add the 1 c of sugar a little at a time along with the salt and beaten eggs. stir in the yeast mix. mix well and add 3 c of the flour 1 c at a time beating vigorously after each cup. dough should be soft but not wet so add up to 1/2 cup more flour if necessary. cover bowl and let rise until doubled, about one hour. grease a 9x13 pan or two 8 square pans. when dough has doubled, punch down and turn onto floured surface and sprinkle top with flour. let rest five minutes. roll to 1/2 to 3/4 thick and as close to the shape of the pan as possible. place in the pan/pans, cover and let rise until doubled. make topping by creaming the butter. beat in the sugar and flour. add eggs, one at a time and beat well after each. add just enough milk to make the mixture easy to spread over the cake it should not be runny. after gently spreading the topping on the risen dough, bake in preheated oven at 350 for 35 45 minutes. let cool in pan.

inputs: unflavored gelatin, milk, coffee, sugar, cocoa powder, coffee, cinnamon, cocoa
targets: title: mochaccino, low fat ingredients: 1 1/4 ounce envelope unflavored gelatin 1 12 ounce can fat free evaporated milk 1 cup hot brewed coffee 12 cup sugar or 12 cup splenda granular 13 cup cocoa powder 3 tablespoons coffee flavored liqueur cool whip optional cinnamon stick optional cocoa optional directions: sprinkle gelatine over milk in blender container let stand 1 minute. add hot coffee cover and blend on medium speed 2 minutes or until gelatine is completely dissolved. add remaining ingredients cover. blend on high speed 2 minutes. poup evenly into 5 mugs or dessert glasses. chill 4 hours or until firm. store leftover desserts in refrigerator. garnish with thawed cool whip, cinnamon sticks and sprinkling of additional cocoa powder if desired.

inputs: frozen broccoli, chicken, cream of chicken soup, cream of celery soup, egg, mayonnaise, lemon juice, shredded cheese, stuffing mix, margarine
targets: title: turkey and broccoli casserole ingredients: 2 pkg. frozen broccoli or 1 bunch fresh broccoli 3 c. or more diced cooked turkey or chicken 2 cans cream of chicken soup 1 can cream of celery soup 1 egg 2/3 c. mayonnaise 1 tbsp. lemon juice 1 c. shredded cheese cheddar 1 small pkg. pepperidge farm stuffing mix 1 stick margarine directions: put broccoli that has been boiled slightly and well drained into a greased 9 x 13 inch baking dish. place turkey on top of broccoli mix soups, egg, mayonnaise and lemon juice. pour over turkey. next add layer of cheese. melt margarine and stir into stuffing mix. put stuffing on top of cheese. bake at 350 uncovered until casserole is bubbling and browning, about 40 to 45 minutes. serves 8 people generously.

inputs: cake mix, milk, margarine, eggs, butter
targets: title: easy chocolate sheet cake ingredients: 1 box moist deluxe chocolate butter fudge duncan hines cake mix 3/4 c. milk 1 stick margarine room temperature 3 eggs 1 tsp. butter flavoring directions: mix according to mix instructions and pour into a greased and floured 10 x 13 inch pan. bake at 350 . cool and ice.

inputs: cream cheese, parmesan cheese, italian seasoning, onion powder, garlic, rolls
targets: title: italian cream cheese pinwheels ingredients: 1 3 ounce package cream cheese, softened 1 tablespoon grated parmesan cheese 2 teaspoons italian seasoning 1 teaspoon onion powder 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder 1 8 ounce can refrigerated crescent dinner rolls directions: preheat oven to 375 degrees f. in a bowl, combine first 5 ingredients mix until smooth. unroll crescent dough into rectangle onto a smooth surface. gently press together perforations. spread cream cheese mixture over dough to within 1/4 inch of the edge. starting with the short end, roll into a log. cut into 12 slices and place on ungreased baking sheet. bake at 375 degrees f for 12 15 minutes. sprinkle with extra parmesan cheese, if desired.

inputs: rice vinegar, sugar, water, kosher salt, ginger, anise, watermelon, lime juice, soy sauce, brown sugar, fish sauce, sriracha, garlic, cilantro, skin, kosher salt, pepper, cucumber, carrot, cilantro, mint, lime juice, scallions
targets: title: grilled chicken lettuce wraps with pickled watermelon rind slaw ingredients: 1 cup unseasoned rice vinegar 1 cup sugar 1/2 cup water 1 tablespoon kosher salt one 1 inch slice of crystallized ginger 1 star anise 1/4 small watermelon, green skin and all but 1/4 inch of the red flesh removed, rind sliced 1 inch thick 1/2 cup fresh lime juice from 4 to 6 limes 1/4 cup plus 2 tablespoons soy sauce 3 tablespoons packed light brown sugar 3 tablespoons asian fish sauce 2 tablespoons sriracha 2 tablespoons minced garlic 1 tablespoon minced cilantro 12 skin on, boneless chicken thighs kosher salt pepper 1 1/2 cups peeled, seeded and julienned cucumber 1 cup julienned carrot 1/2 cup cilantro leaves 1/2 cup torn mint leaves 1/4 cup fresh lime juice 3 scallions, thinly sliced 1 fresno chilehalved, seeded and very thinly sliced lettuce leaves, for serving directions: make the pickled watermelon rind in a medium saucepan, combine the vinegar, sugar, water, salt, ginger and star anise and bring to a boil over high heat. add the watermelon rind and boil for 1 minute, then transfer to a heatproof bowl. let cool, then refrigerate for 3 hours. drain well and julienne the pickled rind. meanwhile, prepare the chicken in a large bowl, whisk the lime juice with the soy sauce, brown sugar, fish sauce, sriracha, garlic and cilantro. add the chicken to the marinade and turn to coat. cover and refrigerate for 3 hours. light a grill and oil the grate. remove the chicken from the marinade and season the thighs with salt and pepper. grill over moderate heat, turning occasionally, until the skin is crispy and the chicken is cooked through, about 15 minutes. transfer the chicken to a cutting board and let rest for 5 minutes. make the slaw in a large bowl, toss the julienned pickled watermelon rind with all of the ingredients except the lettuce leaves. slice the chicken and serve in the lettuce leaves, topped with the slaw.

inputs: crescent rolls, cream cheese, mayonnaise, onion salt, garlic powder, dill weed, peas, celery, broccoli, carrots
targets: title: yummy vegetable pizza ingredients: 2 8 oz. cans crescent rolls 16 oz. cream cheese, softened 2/3 c. mayonnaise 1/2 tsp. onion salt 1/2 tsp. garlic powder 1/2 tsp. dill weed 1 c. peas 1 c. chopped celery 1 c. chopped broccoli 1 c. chopped carrots directions: separate crescent roll dough into rectangles. arrange in nonstick baking pan, pressing edges and perforations to seal. bake at 375 using package directions. combine cream cheese, mayonnaise, onion salt, garlic powder and dill weed in bowl mix well. spread over cooled crust. sprinkle with peas, celery, tomatoes, broccoli and carrots. cut into small wedges.

inputs: celery soup, shrimp, mushrooms, butter, milk, pepper, onion, pimento, catsup
targets: title: shrimp on rice ingredients: 1 can celery soup 1 lb. shrimp 1 4 oz. can sliced mushrooms optional 2 tbsp. butter 1 1/2 soup cans milk 1/4 tsp. pepper 1/2 c. onion, finely chopped 1/4 c. pimento, chopped 1/2 c. catsup directions: saute onions and mushrooms in melted butter in large saucepan. add celery soup and milk. blend well. add shrimp and last 4 ingredients. simmer 10 minutes, stirring often. this is good served on rice with a salad and corn sticks.

inputs: apples, sugar, lemon juice, butter
targets: title: oven baked apple slices ingredients: 6 medium apples granny smith or golden delicious 1/4 c. sugar, blended with 1/4 tsp. cinnamon 2 tbsp. lemon juice 4 tbsp. 1/2 stick butter directions: quarter, core and peel the apples. cut the quarters into lengthwise thirds to make slices about 1/2 inch wide at the outside edge. toss in a bowl with the sugar, then with the lemon juice and finally with the melted butter. let sit 3 or 4 minutes to render juices and absorb flavor. taste and fold in more sugar if needed. preheat oven to 425 . turn apples into 6 x 9 inch baking dish and set in the middle level of the oven, basting every 8 to 10 minutes with accumulated juices. apples are done when slices are tender. if juices have not thickened, remove with bulb baster and boil down in small saucepan. pour over apples.

inputs: espresso beans, chili powder, brown sugar, ground coriander, mustard, salt, black pepper, garlic
targets: title: steak rub ingredients: 4 tablespoons espresso beans, ground fine 4 tablespoons chili powder 4 teaspoons brown sugar 2 teaspoons ground coriander 2 teaspoons dry mustard 2 teaspoons salt 2 teaspoons black pepper 2 teaspoons garlic powder directions: mix all ingredients with a small wire whisk. store in an airtight jar. to use, oil all sides of steak or any kind of beef with olive oil and rub steak rub well into meat surface about 1 3 teaspoons per side, or more depending on size of piece of beef . grill 5 minutes per side per inch for rare, longer for more doneness.

inputs: brown basmati rice, water, almonds, parsley, garlic, lemon juice, t, cucumber, salt
targets: title: nutty green rice ingredients: 1 c brown basmati rice 2 c water 1/2 c almonds 1/2 small bunch parsley 1 garlic clove 1 1/2 t lemon juice 1 1/2 t olive oil 1/2 cucumber, diced salt and pepper to taste directions: bring water to boil and add rice. stir and simmer covered for 45 minutes, do not stir. remove from heat and let sit for another 10 minutes then remove cover and allow to cool. while rice is cooking, blend almonds, parsley, garlic, oil, and lemon juice in food processor. when rice is cool, stir in nut mixture and add cucumber. salt and pepper to taste.

inputs: chuck beef, tenderizer, salt, pepper, thyme, water, cream of celery soup, cream of mushroom soup, kitchen, onion, parsley flakes
targets: title: beef tips and rice ingredients: 3 lb. chuck beef, cubed 2 tsp. meat tenderizer 1/2 tsp. salt 1/2 tsp. pepper 1/2 tsp. thyme 3 c. water 1 can cream of celery soup 1 can cream of mushroom soup 1 tsp. kitchen bouquet 1 large onion, chopped 2 tbsp. parsley flakes directions: sprinkle meat tenderizer, pepper, salt and thyme on beef. turn meat several times to coat evenly. in roaster oven, or large corning dish, cook, uncovered, in oven at 400 for 1 hour to brown, turning only once. add remaining ingredients, stirring thoroughly. cook, uncovered, at 350 for 1 1/2 to 2 hours or until tender. serve over rice.

inputs: eggs, tuna, onion flakes, dry mustard, pepper, salt
targets: title: tuna puffs ingredients: 2 medium eggs, separated 4 oz. tuna, drained and flaked 1 tbsp. onion flakes 1/4 tsp. dry mustard 1/8 tsp. pepper 1/4 tsp. salt directions: preheat oven to 450 . beat egg yolks, mustard and pepper. mix well. beat egg whites with salt until stiff. mix all ingredients. fold together and spoon into 2 cup casserole dish. bake 20 minutes at 450 . serve immediately. makes 2 luncheon servings.

inputs: margarine, shortening, sugar, eggs, flour, salt, baking powder, cocoa, milk, vanilla, nuts
targets: title: chocolate pound cake ingredients: 2 sticks margarine 1/2 c. shortening 3 c. sugar 5 eggs 3 c. plain flour 1/2 tsp. salt 1/2 tsp. baking powder 4 tbsp. cocoa 1 c. milk 1 tbsp. vanilla 1 c. nuts directions: cream real well the margarine, shortening and sugar. add eggs, one at a time. measure, then sift flour, salt, baking powder and cocoa. sift all 2 times, then add milk, vanilla and nuts. bake in tube pan at 325 for 90 minutes.

inputs: butter, brown sugar, sugar, eggs, vanilla, whole wheat flour, baking soda, salt, cooking oats, semi sweet jumbo chocolate chips, pecans
targets: title: yummy chocolate chip oatmeal cookies ingredients: 1 c. butter 3/4 c. firmly packed brown sugar 3/4 c. granulated sugar 2 large eggs 1 1/2 tsp. pure vanilla extract 1 1/2 c. whole wheat flour 1 tsp. baking soda 1 tsp. salt 2 c. quick cooking oats not instant 1 bag pure semi sweet jumbo chocolate chips 1 c. chopped pecans or walnuts optional directions: cream together the butter and sugars. add eggs and vanilla blend thoroughly. in a separate bowl, sift together the flour, baking soda and salt. add to creamed mixture blend thoroughly. add oats, chocolate chips and nuts mix well. drop by tablespoon onto buttered baking sheet s . bake in preheated 375 oven for 8 to 10 minutes, or until evenly browned. let cool on wire rack. makes about 36 fantastic chocolate chip cookies.

inputs: beans, sour cream, cream cheese, taco, cheddar, onion
targets: title: sombrero dip ingredients: 1 16 oz. refried beans 1 c. sour cream 1 8 oz. cream cheese 1 taco seasoning packet 1 c. shredded cheddar onion, green pepper, olives, tomatoes directions: spread beans in an 8 x 8 inch pan or on a platter. blend sour cream, cream cheese and taco seasoning. layer on top of beans. top with shredded cheddar and any other desired toppings. serve cold or warm.

inputs: vegetable broth, white wine, olive oil, arborio rice, mushrooms, sugar snap peas, red bell pepper, parmesan cheese, fresh mint
targets: title: risotto with mushrooms and sugar snap peas ingredients: 3 cups canned vegetable broth 1 cup dry white wine 2 tablespoons olive oil 1 cup arborio rice or medium grain white rice 1 cup chopped mushrooms 3/4 cup sugar snap peas, cut into 1/2 inch pieces 1/2 cup chopped red bell pepper 1/3 cup grated parmesan cheese 1/4 cup chopped fresh mint directions: combine broth and wine in saucepan. bring to simmer over medium heat. heat 1 tablespoon oil in heavy medium saucepan over medium heat. add rice stir 2 minutes. stir in all but 1/4 cup broth wine mixture. stir constantly for 2 minutes. reduce heat to medium low. simmer until rice is tender but still firm to bite, stirring occasionally, about 20 minutes. heat remaining 1 tablespoon oil in medium skillet over medium high heat. add mushrooms, sugar snap peas and bell pepper saute until crisp tender, about 3 minutes. stir into risotto along with cheese and mint. mix in enough remaining broth mixture if needed to moisten. season risotto with salt and pepper.

inputs: cream cheese, ham, red wine, dill pickles, onion, worcestershire sauce, garlic, mustard, cracker
targets: title: cream cheese deviled ham dip / spread with a twist ingredients: 1 8 ounce package cream cheese, softened 1 4 1/2 ounce can deviled ham 14 cup dry red wine 3 tablespoons finely chopped dill pickles 1 teaspoon instant minced onion 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce 14 teaspoon instant minced garlic 14 teaspoon dry mustard cracker directions: beat cream cheese, deviled ham and wine in small mixer bowl until creamy. stir in remaining ingredients. serve immediately as a dip or refrigerate to serve as a spread.

inputs: cream cheese, dill, chipped ham
targets: title: dill pickle bites ingredients: 8 oz. cream cheese, softened 1 jar dill pickle spears 2 pkg. chipped ham directions: lay 2 slices ham side by side, overlapping. spread cream cheese at seams. lay ham over seam. spread cream cheese over all ham. place pickle at end of ham and roll ham and pickle up. chill. slice and serve.

inputs: bay scallops, salt, mushrooms, onion, butter, flour, milk, parmesan cheese, sherry, lemon rind, lemon juice, salt, pepper, breadcrumbs, butter, parsley sprigs, lemon wedges
targets: title: scallops in shells ingredients: 1 pound fresh bay scallops 1/2 teaspoon salt 3/4 cup thinly sliced fresh mushrooms 2 tablespoons finely chopped onion 1/4 cup butter or margarine, divided 2 tablespoons all purpose flour 1 1/2 cups milk 2 tablespoons grated parmesan cheese 2 tablespoons sherry 1/2 teaspoon grated lemon rind 1/4 teaspoon lemon juice 1/4 teaspoon salt dash of pepper 1/4 cup soft breadcrumbs 1 tablespoon butter or margarine, melted fresh parsley sprigs lemon wedges directions: combine scallops and cold water to cover in a large saucepan. let stand 1 hour. drain and rinse scallops. return to saucepan cover with water. bring to a boil. reduce heat cover and simmer 5 minutes. drain sprinkle with 1/2 teaspoon salt. cover and set aside. saute mushrooms and onion in 2 tablespoons butter until tender. stir in scallops. cover and set aside. melt 2 tablespoons butter in a heavy saucepan over low heat add flour, stirring until smooth. cook 1 minute, stirring constantly. gradually add milk cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until mixture is thickened and bubbly. stir in cheese, sherry, lemon rind and juice, remaining salt, and pepper. cook sauce 1 minute. add 1 cup sauce to scallop mixture. spoon scallop mixture evenly into 4 scallop shells. spoon remaining sauce evenly over scallop mixture. combine breadcrumbs and melted butter sprinkle evenly over scallop mixture. bake at 375 for 20 minutes or until lightly browned. garnish with parsley and lemon wedges.

inputs: cream cheese, mayonnaise, mustard powder, garlic, confectioners sugar, salt, cooking sherry, crab meat
targets: title: tina s hot crab meat dip ingredients: 3 8 oz. pkg. cream cheese 1/2 c. mayonnaise 2 scant tsp. prepared mustard powder dash of garlic salt 2 tsp. confectioners sugar 1/2 to 1 tsp. salt 2/3 c. cooking sherry 1 lb. or 3 cans crab meat, drained directions: melt cream cheese in double boiler. add all ingredients except for crab. when smooth, fold in crab. serve hot over sterno with pepperidge farm pumpernickel and cheese cracker sticks.

inputs: cocoa, flour, sugar, milk, vanilla, butter
targets: title: chocolate gravy ingredients: 2 tbsp. cocoa 4 tsp. flour 3/4 c. sugar 2 c. milk 1 tsp. vanilla 1/2 stick butter or margarine directions: put butter and milk in a heavy saucepan over low heat. combine cocoa, flour and sugar. add to milk mixture. stir constantly until it thickens. add vanilla.

inputs: raspberry, boiling water, blueberries, pineapple, sour cream, sugar
targets: title: blueberry jello ingredients: 2 pkg. raspberry jell o 1 1/2 c. boiling water 1 can blueberries with juice 1 16 oz. can pineapple crushed with juice 1 8 oz. sour cream 3 tbsp. sugar directions: mix the jell o with the boiling water. mix well. add the blueberries with juice and the pineapple with juice. pour in a 9 x 13 inch pan until set. mix the sour cream and sugar. spread over jell o. cover with sliced toasted almonds.

inputs: flour, whole wheat flour, cornmeal, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, salt, eggs, egg whites, buttermilk, unsweetened applesauce, canola oil, butter, butter
targets: title: makeover multigrain waffles ingredients: 1 cup all purpose flour 1 cup whole wheat flour 1 cup cornmeal 1 tablespoon sugar 1 tablespoon baking powder 3/4 teaspoon baking soda 1/2 teaspoon salt 3 large eggs 4 large egg whites 3 cups buttermilk 1/2 cup unsweetened applesauce 3 tablespoons canola oil 2 tablespoons butter, melted butter and maple syrup, optional directions: in a large bowl, combine the first seven ingredients. in another bowl, whisk the eggs, egg whites, buttermilk, applesauce, oil and butter whisk into dry ingredients just until blended. bake in a preheated waffle iron according to manufacturer s directions until golden brown. serve with butter and syrup if desired. cool waffles on wire racks. freeze between layers of waxed paper in a resealable plastic freezer bag. to use, reheat waffles in a toaster on medium setting. or, microwave each waffle on high for 30 60 seconds or until heated through.

inputs: mashed sweet potatoes, margarine, sugar, milk, eggs, nutmeg, vanilla, cinnamon, brown sugar, margarine, corn flakes, pecans
targets: title: sweet potato casserole with a crunch ingredients: 3 cups mashed sweet potatoes 6 tablespoons margarine, melted 1 12 cups sugar or 1 12 cups splenda sugar substitute 1 cup evaporated milk or 1 cup skim milk 2 eggs or 2 egg substitute 12 teaspoon nutmeg 12 teaspoon vanilla 12 teaspoon cinnamon 12 cup brown sugar, firmly packed 6 tablespoons margarine, melted 1 cup crushed corn flakes 12 cup coarsely chopped pecans directions: preheat oven to 400. mix all casserole ingredients and place in a small medium glass baking dish. combine all topping ingredients, and cover the potatoes with the topping. bake for 15 20 minutes.

inputs: russet potatoes, butter, sweet paprika, salt, fresh coarse ground black pepper, breadcrumbs
