targets: title: cranberry angel dessert ingredients: 1 cup fresh cranberries 12 unpeeled orange, seeded 3 ounces cranberry jell o gelatin 13 cup boiling water 13 cup cold water 16 ounces angel food cake mix 2 8 ounce containersfrozen fat free whipped topping, thawed 12 teaspoon orange extract fresh cranberries to garnish optional orange zest to garnish optional directions: add to a food processor 1 cup cranberries and orange half process until coarse. place in a small bowl cover and chill. in a medium bowl, combine gelating and boiling watter stir until gelatin dissolves and then stir in cold water. cover bowl and chill up to 2 hours. preheat oven at 350 degrees. line the bottom of a 13 x 9 inch cake pan with wax paper. prepare cake mix according to package directions and pour into lined cake pan. bake 30 to 35 minutes. cake should become golden brown on top and pull away from the sides of pan. cool cake in pan. to finish off dessert, cut cake in half horizontally. place bottom layer on a serving plate. next, spread gelatin mixture over top that was made earlier. top off with other half of cake. for icing, place whipped topping in a medium bowl. add orange extract and fold into topping. now ice cake. garnish sides of serving plate and down the center of cake with cranberries and orange zest.

inputs: heavy cream, sugar, light corn syrup, salt, vanilla, butter
targets: title: the world s best caramel candy ingredients: 2 c. heavy cream, heated to lukewarm 2 c. sugar 1 c. light corn syrup 1/4 tsp. salt 1 tsp. vanilla 1/4 c. butter directions: in deep saucepan mix sugar and syrup. stir until sugar dissolves and mixture boils. cook to 270 on a candy thermometer without stirring. slowly add 1 cup warm cream while mixture never stops boiling. cook to 250 stirring frequently.

inputs: lemon jello, boiling water, water, lemon juice, onion, green pepper, celery, carrots, tomatoes, cucumber
targets: title: molded fresh vegetable salad recipe ingredients: 1 sm. pkg. lemon jello 1 c. boiling water 3/4 c. cool water 1 tbsp. lemon juice or possibly vinegar 1 tbsp. diced onion 1 tbsp. green pepper, diced 1/2 c. celery, diced 1/2 c. grated carrots 1/2 c. diced tomatoes 1/2 c. cucumber, diced directions: dissolve jello in boiling water. add in cool water, lemon juice and stir well. when it begins to thicken add in vegetables and mold.

inputs: lean ground beef, oil, lemon zest, salt, pepper, fresh basil, spinach leaves, buns
targets: title: bhg sun dried tomato burgers ingredients: 1 lb lean ground beef we like ground round 1 tablespoon oil packed sun dried tomato, finely minced 1 teaspoon lemon zest 12 teaspoon salt 14 teaspoon pepper 2 tablespoons fresh basil, coarsely chopped optional 1 cup spinach leaves, whole 4 hamburger buns, lightly toasted directions: in a medium bowl, lightly combine first 5 ingredients. form into 4 patties. grill to desired doneness. place on buns and top with spinich leaves, basil if using , and desired condiments. great served with a cold beer isn t everything .

inputs: lime flavored gelatin, boiling water, mayonnaise, cheese, celery, green pepper
targets: title: one cup cottage ring ingredients: 1 3 oz. pkg. lime flavored gelatin 1 c. boiling water 1 c. mayonnaise or salad dressing 1 c. large curd cream style cottage cheese 1 c. chopped celery 1 c. chopped green pepper directions: dissolve lime flavored gelatin in the boiling water. add mayonnaise or salad dressing and beat with rotary beater until smooth. chill until partially set. fold in the cottage cheese, celery and green pepper. pour into a 4 1/2 cup mold. chill until firm. makes 6 servings.

inputs: hearts, vegetable stock, onion, butter, cream of mushroom soup, feta cheese, salt
targets: title: artichoke spinach soup ingredients: 0.5 10 ounce package spinach thawed 2 13 ounce cans artichoke hearts, drained and chopped 2 cups vegetable stock 1 cup onion chopped 4 tablespoons butter 12 cup half and half i use fat free 1 10 3/4 ounce can cream of mushroom soup undiluted feta cheese low fat salt and pepper directions: in a pot, put spinach and artichokes with vegetable stock, bring to a boil. meanwhile,in a skillet, melt butter and saute onion, add it to vegetable stock. slowly whisk mushroom soup into mixture then slowly whisk in half and half. you may add a small additional amount of half and half if it is to thick. when the soup is made to your desired consistency, remove from heat and add salt and pepper if desired. serve in a soup bowl and top with feta cheese just before serving.

inputs: brown rice noodles, red pepper, radish, onion, carrot, curly chicory, cilantro, handful peanuts, hot sauce, vinegar, lemon juice
targets: title: annie chun s spicy rice noodle salad ingredients: brown rice noodles annie chun s maifun 1 red pepper 1 radish 1 onion 1/3 carrot 4 pieces curly chicory cilantro for garnish 1 handful peanuts 2 tablespoons hot sauce annie chun s gochujang 1/2 tablespoon vinegar 1/2 tablespoon lemon juice directions: slice onion, radish, carrot and red pepper combine the vinegar, lemon juice and gochujang together to make dressing and set aside cook rice noodles in a boiling water about 2 4 minutes according to package directions and drain the water. set aside to cool mix the cooked and cooled noodles with the dressing combine with onion, radish, and red pepper garnish with cilantro and crushed peanuts enjoy

inputs: graham cracker sheets, sugar, unsalted butter
targets: title: graham cracker crust ingredients: 24 graham cracker sheets, finely chopped 1 1/2 cups 1 tablespoon sugar 5 tablespoons unsalted butter, melted directions: preheat the oven to 350f. in a medium bowl, mix together the graham cracker crumbs and sugar. add the melted butter, using your fingertips to incorporate it with the graham cracker mixture. spread the graham cracker mixture evenly across the bottom and sides of a 9 inch pie plate so that it covers the entire dish. there should be no gaps in the crust. bake the crust for about 5 minutes, or until its golden brown. cool the pie shell for 30 minutes before adding your desired filling.

inputs: chicken breasts, celery, almonds, celery, onion, lemon juice, mayonnaise, salt, cheddar cheese, potato chips
targets: title: hot chicken salad ingredients: 6 chicken breasts 1 stalk celery 1/2 c. almonds 1/2 c. chopped celery 1/2 c. chopped onion optional 1 1/2 tbsp. lemon juice 1 c. mayonnaise salt and pepper to taste grated cheddar cheese 1 1/2 c. potato chips directions: cook chicken breasts with celery in broth. remove from bone in medium chunks. mix with almonds, celery, onion, lemon juice, mayonnaise, salt and pepper. spread mix in large baking dish. add a little broth if dry. cover with cheese. crush potato chips. spread over cheese. cook about 1/2 hour until cheese is melted at 350 .

inputs: cheddar cheese, onion, pecans, mayonnaise, cream cheese, strawberry
targets: title: nicoles favorite cheese ball ingredients: 1 pound cheddar cheese, shredded 1 tablespoon onion, grated 1 cup pecans, chopped 1 cup mayonnaise 1 package cream cheese room temperature 1/4 cups strawberry jam directions: mix everything except the jam and roll into a ball. hollow out the middle and fill with jam. serve with crackers. this is great with or without the pecans.

inputs: crab meat, cream cheese, onion, horseradish, milk, salt, pepper
targets: title: hot crab dip ingredients: 1 6 1/2 oz. pkg. crab meat 8 oz. cream cheese, softened 2 tbsp. chopped onion 1/2 tsp. horseradish 1 tbsp. milk 1/4 tsp. salt dash of pepper directions: combine crabmeat with all ingredients in a bowl. mix well. spoon into small baking dish 13 x 9 x 2 inch . bake at 375 for 15 minutes. let stand 5 minutes. scoop with crackers or chips.

inputs: margarine, baking powder, flour, chocolate syrup, vanilla, eggs, salt, sugar, milk
targets: title: chocolate pound cake ingredients: 1 1/2 c. margarine 1/2 tsp. baking powder 3 c. sifted all purpose flour 1 16 oz. can chocolate syrup 2 tsp. vanilla 5 eggs room temperature 1/2 tsp. salt 3 c. sugar 1 c. milk directions: blend margarine and sugar. add eggs, one at a time. mix flour, salt and baking powder. alternate with milk chocolate. add vanilla. cook in tube pan for 1 hour and 30 minutes at 325 . test for doneness.

inputs: mushrooms, butter, butter, shallot, garlic, flat leaf parsley, parmesan cheese, aged gruyere cheese, fresh nutmeg, baguette
targets: title: baked escargot in mushroom caps ingredients: 24 escargot 24 mushrooms, stems removed 1/4 cup butter, melted 1 tablespoon butter 1 tablespoon shallot, minced 1 garlic clove, minced 2 tablespoons fresh flat leaf parsley, chopped very fine 1/2 cup parmesan cheese, grated very fine 1/2 cup aged gruyere cheese, grated very fine fresh nutmeg 1 baguette directions: preheat oven to 375 degrees. stuff one escargot into each mushroom cap. arrange caps on an escargot dish, one to each indentation. in a small saute pan heat 1 tablespoon butter over medium high heat. cook shallots and garlic until softened and beginning to caramelize. using a teaspoon drizzle shallot butter into each mushroom cap. sprinkle with 1 tablespoon flat leaf parsley. cover mushrooms with parmesan and gruyere. bake for 20 minutes or until cheese is completely melted and browned in spots. sprinkle with remaining parsley and grate fresh nutmeg over top. serve immediately with slices of crusty baguette.

inputs: chicken, paprika, dill weed, salt, milk, condensed cream, mushroom stems, parmesan cheese, onion, parsley
targets: title: biscuit nugget chicken bake ingredients: 2 cups cubed cooked chicken or 2 cups cooked turkey or 2 5 ounce cans boneless chicken 1 teaspoon paprika 12 teaspoon dill weed 14 teaspoon salt 1 cup milk 1 10 3/4 ounce can condensed cream of chicken soup or 1 10 3/4 ounce can cream of mushroom soup 1 4 ounce can mushroom stems and pieces, drained 1 10 ounce can hungry jack big flaky refrigerated biscuits 14 cup kraft grated parmesan cheese 1 tablespoon instant minced onion or 14 cup chopped onion 1 teaspoon parsley flakes or 1 tablespoon chopped parsley directions: heat oven to 375 degrees. in medium saucepan, combine chicken,1/2 teaspoon paprika, dill weed, salt, milk, soup and mushrooms heat until hot and bubbly. pour hot chicken mixture into ungreased 8 or 9 inch square baking dish. separate biscuit dough into 10 biscuits cut each into 4 pieces. in medium sized plastic bag, combine remaining 1/2 teaspoon paprika, parmesan cheese, onion and parsley. shake biscuit pieces, 3 or 4 at a time, in cheese herb mixture until coated arrange over hot chicken mixture. sprinkle any remaining cheese mixture over biscuits. bake at 375 degrees for about 15 to 18 minutes or until really deep golden brown.

inputs: butter, chicken, cream of mushroom soup, chicken broth, pimento, egg, flour, milk, salt
targets: title: chicken a la king ingredients: 2 tbsp. butter chicken, cooked and cut 2 cans cream of mushroom soup 1 c. chicken broth 1 small jar pimento 1 egg 3 tsp. flour a little milk salt to taste directions: mix egg with flour and a little milk. mix with chicken and remaining ingredients. cook over low heat for about 5 minutes. serve with rice or toast.

inputs: onions, green pepper, butter, american cheese, catsup, worcestershire sauce
targets: title: hot clam dip ingredients: 1/4 c. chopped onions 1/4 chopped green pepper 1/4 c. butter or margarine 1 7 to 8 oz. can minced clams, drained 1 c. shredded process american cheese about 4 oz. 1/4 c. catsup 1 tbsp. worcestershire sauce directions: cook and stir onions and green pepper in butter until onions are tender. add clams, cheese, catsup and worcestershire sauce cook, stirring constantly, until cheese is melted. makes about 2 cups.

inputs: spam, broccoli, cheddar cheese, white wine vinegar, olive oil, sugar, garlic, mustard, pecans
targets: title: spam broccoli pecan salad ingredients: 1 can spam cut up 3/4 pound broccoli florets broken up 1/4 pound cheddar cheese 1/2 cup radishes sliced 1/4 cup white wine vinegar 3 tablespoons olive oil 2 tablespoons sugar 1 each garlic cloves minced 1 /2 teaspoons dry mustard 1/4 cup pecans toasted directions: in skillet, saute spam over medium heat until lightly browned. in large bowl, combine broccoli, spam, cheese, and radishes. in small bowl, combine vinegar, oil, sugar, garlic, and dry mustard. toss dressing with spam mixture. cover and chill 1 hour. before serving, stir in toasted pecans.

inputs: eggs, sugar, oil, zucchini, vanilla, flour, baking soda, baking powder, salt, cinnamon, nuts
targets: title: zucchini bread ingredients: 2 eggs 2 cups sugar 1 cup oil 2 cups zucchini, grated 1 tablespoon vanilla 3 cups flour 1 teaspoon baking soda 14 teaspoon baking powder 1 teaspoon salt 2 12 teaspoons cinnamon 34 cup finely chopped nuts directions: preheat oven to 350. beat eggs fluffy. add oil, sugar, vanilla, zucchini and mix. combine dry ingredients and add to wet. mix. bake in four mini pans for 40 minutes. bake in 2 regular pans for 1 hour. grease pans well. add waxed paper to bottom of pan and grease the wax paper. also makes good mini muffins.

inputs: sandwich, eggs, heavy cream, salt, freshly ground black pepper, white bread, unsalted butter, canola oil, balsamic vinegar, tomato, handful mushrooms, handful fresh baby spinach, bacon, swiss cheese, hollandaise sauce, butter, egg yolks, lemon juice, salt, freshly ground black pepper, cayenne pepper
targets: title: 8 layer breakfast sandwich ingredients: for the breakfast sandwich 3 large pete and gerry s organic eggs, divided 1 tablespoon heavy cream 1 pinch salt 1 pinch freshly ground black pepper 2 slices white bread 3 tablespoons unsalted butter, divided 1 tablespoon canola oil 1/2 cup balsamic vinegar 2 thick slices tomato 1 small handful mushrooms, sliced about 1/4 cup 1 small handful fresh baby spinach about 1/4 cup 3 slices bacon 2 slices swiss cheese for the hollandaise sauce 2 1/2 sticks butter 2 pete and gerry s organic egg yolks 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice 1/4 teaspoon salt 1/4 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper 1 pinch cayenne pepper directions: make the hollandaise melt the butter on the stove or in the microwave until piping hot. warm the blender bowl by filling with hot water and then emptying and drying the bowl. add the egg yolks, lemon juice, cayenne, salt, and pepper and blend at medium speed. slowly drizzle in the hot melted butter with the machine still running until emulsified. store in a covered container in a warm spot if it start to curdle, add a drop or two of hot water and stir. make the balsamic reduction add the balsamic vinegar to a small saucepan. bring the balsamic vinegar up to a boil, then reduce it to a simmer for about 10 to 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. the sauce should be thick enough to just coat a spoon. store in a covered container in a warm spot. make the savory french toast in a wide bowl, whisk together 1 egg, heavy cream, plus a pinch of salt and pepper. dredge the two slices of white bread to lighty coat them in the mixture you don t want it to soak too long so that it gets mushy in the center. set a large nonstick skillet over medium heat and melt 1 tablespoon butter and the canola oil. once the butter is lightly bubbling, cook the french toast until it is nicely browned on one side. then, flip it and then cook it until it is nicely browned on the other side. do this one at a time if your skillet isn t large enough to hold both slices of bread. once the french toast is done, set aside on a plate. pan roast the tomatoes using the same skillet, turn the heat to medium high, and place the tomato slices in the pan in a single layer they shouldn t overlap . cook for about 2 to 3 minutes on side once they look browned, flip to the other side and cook for 2 to 3 minutes more. set aside on the same plate with the french toast when done. turn the skillet down to medium heat and melt 1 tablespoon of butter. saute the mushrooms until they are just tender, about 3 minutes. add the spinach to the skillet and saute until just barely wilted. season with a pinch of salt and pepper and set aside on the plate. leave the skillet at medium heat and cook the bacon until it s crispy on both sides. set aside the slices of bacon on a paper towel lined plate and cut each slice in half so it fits better in the sandwich . turn off the heat and drain the bacon fat into a heat safe bowl wipe down the skillet with a paper towel you can leave a little bacon fat in there to cook the eggs if you d like . leaving the skillet at medium heat, melt 1 tablespoon of butter. when the butter is bubbling and foamy, carefully crack the 2 eggs into the skillet. cook until the egg whites are just set, but the yolk is still runny. gently flip over and cook for about 10 20 seconds. set aside. turn the heat down to low and assemble the sandwich i like to use this order start with one slice savory french toast, stack tomato, bacon, mushrooms, spinach, 2 slices of swiss cheese, and top with other french toast slice. warm up the sandwich in the skillet and cover, heating it until the cheese is melted. set the sandwich on a plate and top it with the sunny side up eggs. drizzle with hollandaise sauce and balsamic reduction. enjoy you ve earned it.

inputs: bacon, cheddar cheese, milk, eggs, bisquick, salt, pepper, onion, bell pepper, pie shell
targets: title: simplified quiche ingredients: 12 strips bacon, cooked 1/2 c. cheddar cheese or swiss or both 2 c. milk 4 eggs 1/2 c. bisquick 1/2 tsp. salt 1/4 tsp. pepper 1/2 c. onion optional 1/2 c. bell pepper optional 1 large pie shell directions: line bottom of pie shell with bacon, cheese, onion and bell pepper. blend other ingredients in blender on high for one minute. pour over bacon, cheese, etc. bake at 350 for approximately 55 minutes or until a knife comes out clean.

inputs: pork loin, kosher salt, green cabbage, rice vinegar, white miso, scallions, pepper, vegetable, grain mustard, mint leaves, honey, sugar, crusty sandwich rolls
targets: title: grilled pork sandwiches with grilled plum chutney and cabbage slaw recipe ingredients: 1 1/4 pounds boneless pork loin or top sirloin, cut into 8 2 1/2 ounce portions kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper 3/4 pound green cabbage about 1/2 head , cored and thinly sliced 1/3 cup rice vinegar 1 tablespoon plus 1 teaspoon white miso 3/4 pound firm but ripe plums, halved and pitted about 5 small plums 2 scallions, ends trimmed 1 jalapeno pepper vegetable or canola oil 2 teaspoons whole grain mustard 3 tablespoons chopped fresh mint leaves 2 tablespoons honey sugar, to taste 4 crusty sandwich rolls, split directions: working 1 piece at a time, sandwich pork between layers of plastic wrap and pound with a meat pounder or heavy skillet until about 1/4 inch thick. season generously with salt and pepper and set aside. combine cabbage, vinegar, and white miso in a medium bowl and toss. season to taste with salt. set aside. in a large bowl, drizzle plums, scallions, and jalapeno with oil and toss to coat. season with salt. . when all the charcoal is lit and covered with gray ash, pour out and arrange the coals evenly over the charcoal grate. set cooking grate in place, cover grill and allow to preheat for 5 minutes. alternatively, set the burners on a gas grill to the highest heat setting, cover, and preheat for 10 minutes. and the grilling grate. place plums, scallions, and jalapenos directly on the hot side of the grill and cook, turning, until plums, scallions, and jalapeno are charred and softened, 4 to 7 minutes, removing each to a platter or cutting board as they re done. add grilled plums to a large mixing bowl. stem and seed jalapeno, then finely dice and add to plums. chop up scallions and add to plums. stir in mustard, mint leaves, and honey, using the back of a wooden spoon to mash plum. season with salt and pepper, then stir in enough sugar to make the chutney fairly sweet about 2 tablespoons, depending on how sweet the plums were . set aside. grill pork, turning, until just cooked through, 2 to 3 minutes per side. toast bread on grill. to build sandwiches, pile miso slaw on each bottom bun, then top each with 1 piece of grilled pork. spoon some plum chutney on top, then top with remaining grilled pork. spread plum chutney on top buns and close sandwiches. serve.

inputs: sugar, pineapple, cherry, angel food cake
targets: title: angel delight ingredients: 1 c. sugar 1 can chunk pineapple 1 pkg. cherry or strawberry jello 1 can milnot 1 crumbled angel food cake directions: chill milnot 2 hours before whipping. boil sugar and pineapple juice. let cool. mix with whipped milnot. pour over angel food cake crumbs. add pineapple chunks and chill.

inputs: carrots, green pepper, red onion, tomato soup, salad oil, sugar, white vinegar, mustard, salt, worcestershire sauce
targets: title: marinated carrots ingredients: 5 c. carrots fresh or frozen 1 green pepper, chopped 1 red onion, sliced in thin rings 1 can tomato soup 1/2 c. salad oil 2/3 c. sugar 1/2 c. white vinegar 1 tsp. dijon mustard 1 tsp. salt 1 tsp. worcestershire sauce directions: slice carrots on the diagonal or in crinkles, then blanch until crisp tender 6 to 8 minutes . add green pepper and onion. mix together all other ingredients and pour over vegetables. this will keep up to 10 days.

inputs: peaches, oranges, oleo, brown sugar, curry, cornstarch
targets: title: hot fruit ingredients: 1 can each peaches, pears, pineapple, apricots, mixed fruit, red or green cherries 2 cans mandarin oranges 2/3 c. oleo, melted 1 c. brown sugar 1/2 tsp. curry 2 tbsp. cornstarch directions: drain fruit well. i prefer lite mix in oleo, brown sugar and curry. two tablespoons cornstarch that is mixed with sugar and curry. mix all together. let set overnight. bake next day for 1 hour at 325 .

inputs: thin, lemon, butter, olive oil, kosher salt
targets: title: asparagus with lemon butter ingredients: 24 thin asparagus spears 1 lemon 2 tablespoons butter olive oil kosher salt directions: wash asparagus and line them up on a cutting board with the tops even. cut off tough bottom ends. bring a skillet or oval casserole filled half full with salted water to boil. dump in asparagus all at once. when water returns to the boil, cook asparagus until crisp tender, about 1 to 3 minutes, depending on size. drain. return asparagus to hot pan, squeeze lemon juice over top. add butter and a drizzle of olive oil, tossing to coat. add kosher salt, to taste. serve immediately.

inputs: margarine, fresh mushroom halves, onion, tarragon leaves, nutmeg, salt, pepper, parsley
targets: title: savory mushroom saute ingredients: 1/3 c. margarine 3 8 oz. pkg. fresh mushroom halves 2 tbsp. chopped onion 1/2 tsp. tarragon leaves 1/2 tsp. nutmeg 1/4 tsp. salt 1/4 tsp. pepper 1/4 c. chopped parsley directions: in 10 inch skillet melt butter. stir in remaining ingredients except parsley. cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until mushrooms are tender 3 to 4 minutes . stir in parsley.

inputs: baking potatoes, butter, cheddar cheese, garlic, light cream, green onions, crawfish, cheddar cheese
targets: title: stuffed crawfish baked potatoes ingredients: 6 baking potatoes 1 stick butter 4 ounces sharp cheddar cheese 3 pods garlic minced 1 cup light cream 1/2 cup green onions chopped 1 pound crawfish tails, cooked 1/2 cup sharp cheddar cheese new york, grated directions: bake potatoes at 400 degrees for 1 hour. make sauce of butter, 4 oz. sharp cheddar cheese, garlic and cream. cut potatoes in half lengthwise and scoop out. put potatoes and mix with sauce. add green onions and crawfish. put mixture back in potato shells. sprinkle with grated new york sharp and bake at 350 degrees until brown.

inputs: broccoli, almonds, cranberries, red onion, buttermilk, mayonnaise, cider vinegar, sugar, shallots, salt, pepper
targets: title: broccoli slaw ingredients: 2 heads broccoli 1/2 cup thinly sliced almonds, toasted 1/3 cup dried cranberries 1/2 small red onion, finely chopped 1/2 cup buttermilk, well shaken 1/3 cup mayonnaise 2 tablespoons cider vinegar 1 tablespoon sugar 3 tablespoons finely chopped shallots salt pepper directions: trim broccoli and cut it into small pieces. toss the sliced broccoli with the almonds, cranberries and red onion in a large bowl. meanwhile, whisk the dressing ingredients buttermilk, mayo, vinegar, sugar and shallots or use finely chopped red onion in the dressing . add good pinch of salt and pepper to dressing and mix well. pour dressing over the broccoli. season with salt and pepper.

inputs: flour, active dry yeast, water
targets: title: sourdough starter ingredients: 2 c. flour 1 pkg. active dry yeast 1 1/2 c. warm water directions: in a bowl combine yeast and water. let stand for 10 minutes. sprinkle flour into mixture and whisk to form a thick batter. cover and place in a warm place 80 to 85 for 24 hours. the starter can be used at this point but will develop a richer flavor if left in warm place for several days.

inputs: lobsters, boiling water, salt, butter, egg, parmesan cheese, fresh shrimp
targets: title: baked stuffed lobster ingredients: 2 lobsters boiling water sea salt 4 tablespoons butter, melted 1 egg, beaten 1/2 cup of ritz cracker crumb 1 tablespoon grated parmesan cheese 1/2 cup fresh shrimp or 1/2 cup crab directions: parboil lobster for 7 minues in salted water. remove and cool. place the lobster on its back and use a good size, firm knife. start at the lobsters mouth and quickly slice down the middle of the body and tail. use both hands to open the body and remove the stomach located just behind the mouth parts and the tomalley the green liver type organ that will be very obvious . prepare a stuffing of your choice. i like this simple one. fill the body and tail of your lobster with the stuffing mix. preheat oven to 450 degrees f. place the stuffed lobsters on a cookie sheet, and bake for 12 15 minutes or until stuffing is browned.

inputs: egg, water, all purpose, salt, baking powder, egg bread, ham, turkey, swiss cheese, canola oil, confectioners, blackberry preserves
targets: title: blue bayou monte cristo sandwich ingredients: 1 egg 1 3/4 cups plus 2 tablespoons water 1 3/4 cups all purpose flour 1/4 teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon baking powder 8 slices egg bread, sliced 1/2 inch thick challah works well 8 thin slices ham 8 thin slices turkey 8 thin slices swiss cheese 3 cups canola oil confectioners sugar blackberry preserves directions: line a cookie sheet with paper towels set aside. whisk the egg and water together in a mixing bowl. add flour, salt, and baking powder and whisk thoroughly for 2 to 3 minutes or until smooth, scraping sides of bowl. on one slice of bread, arrange 2 slices of ham, turkey, and cheese, covering the bread evenly. place another slice of bread on top and slice each sandwich in half diagonally. heat oil to between 365 degrees f and 375 degrees f in a 10 inch pan. do not let the oil reach a higher temperature than this if the oil starts to smoke, turn the heat down. dip half of the sandwich into the batter, allowing excess to drain, and very carefully place into the oil. repeat with the other sandwich half. cook 3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown. place the cooked sandwich on the prepared cookie sheet in a warm oven until ready to serve. repeat with the other three sandwiches. cook one at a time, and allow the oil to reach the desired temperature between each. sprinkle with confectioner s sugar and serve with blackberry preserves on the side.

inputs: italian dressing, green beans, lemon juice, dill weed, almonds
targets: title: pan seared scallops and green beans amandine ingredients: 3 tbsp. kraft calorie wise zesty italian dressing, divided 1/2 lb. 225 g sea scallops about 6 large 1/2 lb. 225 g fresh green beans 1 tbsp. lemon juice safeway 4 ct for 5.00 thru 02/09 1/4 tsp. dill weed 2 tbsp. sliced almonds, toasted directions: pour 2 tbsp. dressing over scallops in shallow dish stir gently. refrigerate 30 min. to marinate. cook beans in remaining dressing in large skillet on medium high heat 5 min. or until crisp tender, stirring occasionally. add lemon juice and dill toss to coat. cook 1 min., stirring frequently. top with nuts. remove from heat cover to keep warm. remove scallops from marinade discard marinade. heat large nonstick skillet on medium heat. add scallops cook 4 min. on each side or until opaque and lightly browned. serve with the beans.

inputs: water, cornstarch, eggs, pineapples, sugar, vanilla, butter, cinnamon, cherries
targets: title: sunshines pineapple baked ingredients: 1/4 cup water 3 tbsp and 1/4 teaspoon cornstarch 3 eggs beaten 1 can 20.oz crushed pineapples , the hole can 1/2 cup sugar 1 1/2 tsp vanilla extract 2 tbsp butter or margarine sliced very thin 1 dash of cinnamon on top 10 cherries maraschino directions: combine water and cornstarch,mix well in a cup, in a bowl beat 2 eggs very well, pour cornstarch mixture into eggs and mix together well, pour pineapple, sugar and vanilla extract mix into eggs mixture well. useing a 8 pie dish, lightly greased, pour pineapple mixture into the dish, dot with butter, sprinkle ground cinnamon. preheat oven at 350f bake on 350f, in a 8 pie dish, lightly greased , bake for 1hour and 10 minutes. take out of oven to cool, let this pie cool for 4 hours to set and cool. then cut and ready to be served. enjoy this

inputs: yeast, water, shortening, salt, sugar, boiling water, egg, flour, griffin s
targets: title: strawberry kolaches ingredients: 1 yeast cake 1/4 warm water 1/4 c. shortening 1 1/4 tsp. salt 2 tbsp. sugar 1 c. boiling water 1 egg 3 c. flour about griffin s strawberry preserves directions: dissolve yeast in warm water. put shortening, sugar, and salt in large bowl and pour in boiling water. stir until ingredients are dissolved. when they are lukewarm, add the dissolved yeast, beat in the egg and stir in the flour. cover with a clean cloth and let rise until doubled in bulk.

inputs: crab meat, green pepper, pimento, onion, mayonnaise, sugar, lime juice, parsley, black pepper, salt
targets: title: crab salad ultra low fat ingredients: 9 oz. crab meat, cooked 1/4 c. green pepper 2 tbsp. pimento, chopped 1 small onion, chopped 1/4 c. fat free mayonnaise 2 tsp. sugar 1 tsp. lime juice 1 tbsp. fresh chopped parsley black pepper to taste dash of seasoned salt dash of tabasco directions: combine all ingredients in medium sized bowl. chill before serving. makes 4 servings. less than 1 gram of fat per serving and 79 calories per serving. looks pretty served on a lettuce leaf or use as a stuffing for tomatoes. also good as a spread on crackers or a sandwich.

inputs: red pepper, eggplant, potato, carrot, onion, lean organic ground lamb, fresh tomatoes, garlic, beef, breadcrumbs, rock salt, coarse black pepper, olive oil, nutmeg, cinnamon, mozzarella cheese, lasagna noodles, bechamel sauce, flour, butter, hot milk, parmesan cheese, ricotta cheese, eggs
targets: title: moussaka lasagne ingredients: fill 1 red pepper, roasted 1 medium eggplant, par roasted 1 medium potato, par boiled 1/2 carrot, finely diced 1 large onion, diced 450 g lean organic ground lamb or 450 g beef mince 3 diced fresh tomatoes 2 large garlic cloves 1 beef stock cube or 1 lamb stock cube 1/2 cup breadcrumbs 1 teaspoon herbes de provence 1/2 teaspoon rock salt 1 teaspoon coarse black pepper 2 ounces olive oil 1 pinch nutmeg 1 pinch cinnamon 1/2 cup mozzarella cheese 8 slices lasagna noodles for bechamel sauce 2 1/2 tablespoons plain flour 1/4 cup butter 2 cups hot milk 1/2 cup grated parmesan cheese 250 g ricotta cheese 2 eggs, beaten directions: partially peel the eggplant so it looks striped, cut in 5mm rounds and brush each side with olive oil. roast in oven for 15 mins on 400 c. while this is happening, grill skin side up, until blackened the red pepper. peel and dice. peel and cut potato into 5mm rounds and quickly par boil so that the outer rim just begins to soften. drain potato rounds and pour cold water over to stop them from cooking. with the remaining olive oil in a large skillet, fry the diced carrot, red pepper, and onion until translucent. add the beef or lamb mince and fry. add the herbs, stock cube, herbs, salt, black pepper, crushed garlic, diced tomatoes, nutmeg and cinnamon, turn the heat way down after the meat has browned. now for the bechamel sauce in a small saucepan, mix the flour and butter over a low heat until a thick paste forms. making sure it doesn t burn, keep spreading the paste around for a couple mins until the flour cooks off. slowly add hot milk little by little, still stirring. add parmesan and ricotta, keep stirring. let cool for a few minutes before stirring in beaten eggs. in a lasagne dish, place the potato rounds, then a layer of lasagne pasta. next add a layer of eggplant rounds, then half the mince mixture, then the mozzarella. add another layer of pasta, eggplant rounds, then the rest of the mince. pour the bechamel sauce over the top, then pop the whole thing in the oven on 400 c for 40 mins or until lightly browned along the edges. allow to cool off this sets the top layer of custard for 20 mins before cutting into squares and serving. i find tabasco sauce goes great with this amazing dish

inputs: red apples, green grapes, celery, walnut pieces, extra heavy mayonnaise, strawberries
targets: title: strawberry waldorf salad ingredients: 9 each small red apples, cored, chopped 3 cups seedless green grapes, halved target 1 lb for 2.99 thru 02/06 1 1/2 cups celery, thinly sliced 1 1/2 cups walnut pieces 1 1/2 cups kraft extra heavy mayonnaise 3 cups strawberries, sliced safeway 1 lb for 3.99 thru 02/09 directions: mix apples, grapes, celery, walnuts and mayonnaise in large bowl. gently stir in strawberries. serve immediately. or cover and refrigerate until ready to serve.

inputs: orange sections, bananas, pineapple, apple, pecans, cherries, mayonnaise
targets: title: salad surprise ingredients: 1 c. orange sections 2 bananas 1 c. crushed pineapple 1 apple 1/2 c. chopped pecans 1/2 c. cherries, finely chopped 5 tsp. mayonnaise directions: dice apple and bananas. combine with cherries. toss with pineapple, orange sections and nuts. mix in mayonnaise and serve on cool, crisp lettuce leaves.

inputs: fillet, onion, potatoes, paprika, hot paprika, salt, green pepper, tomatoes
targets: title: fisherman s soup halaszle ingredients: 1 kg fish fillet 500 g small fish 1 large onion, thinly sliced 2 potatoes, cubed 1 2 teaspoon paprika hot paprika optional salt, to taste 1 2 green pepper, diced 1 tomatoes, diced directions: cook the cleaned small fish, the cubed potatoes and the rings of onion in water that just covers them. bring to boil and add the paprika. add hot paprika according to your taste. when tender, pass it through a sieve, then add enough water to obtain a thick soup. add the green peppers and the tomato. place the fish fillets into the soup with the salt, and simmer for another 20 30 minutes. serve by carefully removing the fish fillets with a skimmer and placing them in the plates, then ladle the soup cover them.

inputs: herb vinaigrette, white vinegar, mustard, clove garlic, parsley, salt, virgin extra virgin olive oil, artichokes, shrimp, scallion, radicchio, bibb lettuce
targets: title: artichoke cups with seafood salad and herb vinaigrette recipe ingredients: herb vinaigrette 1 tb fresh lemon juice 3 tbsp. white vinegar or possibly sherry vinegar 1 tbsp. dijon mustard 1 sm clove garlic, chopped 2 tbsp. chopped parsley 2 tbsp. shredded basil salt and pepper 2/3 c. virgin extra virgin olive oil 4 whl artichokes, stemmed, top third of each leaf trimmed off 1/2 lb medium shrimp, cooked and peeled 1 x scallion, chopped 1 1/2 c. radicchio, shredded 1 1/2 c. bibb lettuce, shredded directions: 1. for the vinaigrette, whisk lemon juice with white or possibly sherry vinegar, dijon style mustard, and garlic clove. add in parsley and basil and season to taste. whisk in extra virgin olive oil, set aside. 2. heat 1 inch of water to boiling in a large soup kettle. 3. arrange artichokes, stem side up, in a collapsible steamer basket. place basket in kettle, cover, and steam over medium high heat till artichoke base is easily pierced with the tip of a knife, 30 to 40 min. 4. cold slightly, then hollow each artichoke by taking hold of leaves in center and pulling out as a single clump. remove choke hairy material at base of artichoke with a spoon. cover and chill. 5. toss shrimp with crabmeat, scallion, and 1/4 c. of vinaigrette. 6. drizzle an additional 2 tbsp. of vinaigrette onto each artichoke so which each leaf is lightly coated. 7. toss remaining vinaigrette with radicchio and lettuce. 8. arrange a portion of shredded lettuce on each of 4 salad plates, fill each artichoke c. with a portion of seafood salad. place a filled artichoke on top of each bed of lettuce and serve. nationality usa course side dish season any method combo notes serves 4 for lunch or possibly as a substantial first course.

inputs: oranges, lemon, cranberries, sugar, water
targets: title: homemade citrus cranberry sauce ingredients: 2 navel oranges medium 1 lemon 1 pound cranberries fresh or frozen 1 1/4 cups sugar 1/2 cup water directions: finely grate 1 tsp. orange zest and 1 tsp. lemon zest. put in a small bowl. save rest of lemon for other uses. cut rind and outer white membrane from oranges, following the curve of the fruit. cut between inner membranes to remove orange segments. cut each segment into thirds and transfer to bowl with citrus zest. combine cranberries, sugar, and water in a medium saucepan over medium high heat. bring to a boil, stirring occasionally. cook until all cranberries have popped and mixture thickens slightly, 8 10 minutes. stir in orange segments and citrus zest. cool cranberry sauce to room temperature. chill sauce at least 3 hours before serving to thicken.

inputs: streusel topping, all purpose, brown sugar, pecans, cold unsalted butter, cherry pecan, unsalted butter, flour, baking powder, salt, baking soda, sugar, low fat sour cream, eggs, vanilla extract, cherries, pecans
targets: title: mini cherry pecan streusel loaves ingredients: streusel topping 1/2 cup all purpose flour 1/2 cup packed light brown sugar 1/2 cup coarsely chopped pecans 4 tablespoons cold unsalted butter, cut in small pieces cherry pecan batter 1/2 cup unsalted butter, melted 2 1/2 cups all purpose flour 1 1/2 teaspoons baking powder 3/4 teaspoon salt 1/2 teaspoon baking soda 1 1/2 cups granulated sugar 1 cup low fat sour cream 2 large eggs 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract 1 1/2 cups dried cherries 1 cup coarsely chopped pecans directions: preheat oven to 350 f butter and flour six mini loaf pans each 5 3/4 by 3 inches . make streussel topping in a bowl, mix streusel ingredients with fingertips until most clumps form. place in freezer. make cherry pecan batter in a medium bowl, mix flour, baking powder, salt and baking soda. in a large bowl, whisk butter, sugar, sour cream, eggs and vanilla until smooth. mix in dry ingredients until moistened. fold in dried cherries and pecans. divide batter evenly among prepared pans spread to fill corners. place pans on a baking sheet. bake 15 minutes, then remove from oven and quickly sprinkle loaves with streusel topping. return loaves to oven bake until golden and a toothpick inserted in center comes out with only a few moist crumbs attached, 20 to 25 minutes. cool loaves 10 minutes in pans turn out of pans, and cool completely, streusel side up, on a rack.

inputs: ground beef, oats, eggs, tomato sauce, onions, salt, pepper
targets: title: perfect meat loaf ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. ground beef 3/4 c. uncooked oats 2 eggs, slightly beaten 2 8 oz. cans tomato sauce 1/4 c. chopped onions 2 tsp. salt 1/4 tsp. pepper directions: preheat oven to 350 . grease a 5 x 6 inch loaf pan. mix beef, oats, eggs, 1 can tomato sauce, onions, salt and pepper. pack firmly into greased loaf pan. chill until meat loaf is firm. bake 1 hour.

inputs: butter, sour cream, onion, salt, pepper
targets: title: gourmet golden squash ingredients: 3 pounds hubbard squash peeled cubed 2 tablespoons butter or margarine 1 cup sour cream 1/2 cup finely chopped onion 1 teaspoon salt 1/4 teaspoon pepper directions: preheat oven to 400. cook squash until tender, 15 20 minutes drain. mash squash stir in remaining ingredients. mound the squash mixture in an ungreased 1 quart casserole. bake uncovered 20 minutes or until heated through.

inputs: tenderloin, cream of mushroom, water, button mushroom, soy sauce, butter, ground pepper, water
targets: title: beef lengua ingredients: 1/2 kg tenderloin or sirloin beef 1 can cream of mushroom 1 cup water 1 can button mushroom slice 1/3 cup light soy sauce 1/2 stick unsalted butter 1 pinch of ground pepper 2 cup water enough to cover the beef directions: using unsalted butter fry beef in medium heat. do not over fry it. add 2 cups of water and light sauce. simmer until beef tender.sprinkle with ground pepper. in a bowl mix cream of mushroom with 1 can of water. stir until no lumps seen. set aside. pour cream of mushroom when beef is tender. simmer until sauce thicken. add the button mushroom. adjust the taste when needed. have a nice meal .

inputs: cubes, extra virgin olive oil, italian sausage, unsalted butter, yellow onion, fennel bulb, eggs, low salt, frozen spinach, kosher salt, freshly ground black pepper, fennel seeds
targets: title: spinach, fennel, and sausage stuffing with toasted brioche ingredients: 1 loaf brioche or challah about 12 ounces , cut into 1 cubes 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil 1 pound hot italian sausage, casing removed 4 tablespoons unsalted butter, divided, plus more for dish 1 yellow onion, chopped about 1 1/2 cups 1 medium fennel bulb, cored and coarsely chopped about 3 cups 4 large eggs, beaten 2 1/2 cups low salt chicken broth 2 pounds frozen spinach, thawed, well squeezed, coarsely chopped 2 teaspoons kosher salt 1 1/2 teaspoons freshly ground black pepper 1 1/2 teaspoons fennel seeds directions: preheat oven to 350 f. scatter bread on a rimmed baking sheet. toast until golden brown, tossing once, about 15 minutes. let cool completely. do ahead heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. add sausage and cook, breaking up into small pieces with the back of a spoon, until browned and cooked through, 8 10 minutes. drain on a paper towel lined plate let cool. melt 2 tablespoons butter in the same skillet over medium low heat. add onion and fennel and cook, stirring occasionally, until soft, 10 12 minutes.do ahead preheat oven to 350 f. butter a 3 quart shallow baking dish. whisk eggs to blend in a large bowl whisk in broth. stir in sausage, the onion fennel mixture, spinach, salt, pepper, and fennel seeds. add bread toss until evenly distributed and bread has absorbed the liquid. transfer to prepared dish dot with remaining 2 tablespoons butter. bake until stuffing is hot and the top is golden brown, about 40 minutes.

inputs: cream cheese, grated cheese, jalapeno pepper, pimento, lemon juice, worcestershire sauce, onion
targets: title: cheese ball ingredients: 2 8 oz. pkg. cream cheese 1 8 oz. pkg. grated cheese 1 tbsp. jalapeno pepper, chopped fine 1 tbsp. pimento, chopped fine 1 tsp. lemon juice 1 tsp. worcestershire sauce 1 tsp. onion optional , chopped fine directions: cream the cream cheese mix in remaining ingredients. form into ball. pat with chopped pecans. store in refrigerator. may be frozen.

inputs: potatoes, ground pork, onion, vegetable oil, salt, pepper, doubanjiang, sake, oyster sauce, eggs
targets: title: potato and minced meat piccata ingredients: 4 potatoes white or irish 100 grams ground pork 1/2 onion 1 tsp vegetable oil 1/2 tsp salt 1 pepper 1/2 tsp doubanjiang 2 tsp sake 1 tsp oyster sauce 1 eggs directions: boil the potatoes and break them up using a fork. finely chop the onion and stir fry in a sauce pan with a teaspoon of oil over low heat until golden. add the meat to the onion and stir. when the meat is brown, add the salt, pepper, douban jiang, sake and the oyster sauce. mix well. mix the potatoes and the ingredients from the previous step together. once cool, split it into fourths to make into patties. cover each of the patties with beaten egg. cook each side with a frying pan with oil. make scrambled eggs with the left over egg and serve together.

inputs: cranberries, sugar, orange zest, lemon juice from, ground cinnamon, ground allspice, ground nutmeg, ground cayenne pepper, salt, brown sugar, butter
targets: title: cranberry potpourri jam recipe ingredients: 2 pounds frozen or fresh cranberries 1 pound of sugar, divided 1/4 cup orange zest, from 4 to 6 large oranges 3 tablespoons lemon juice from about 2 lemons 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon 1/2 teaspoon ground allspice 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg 1/8 teaspoon ground cayenne pepper 1/4 teaspoon table salt or 1/2 teaspoon kosher alt 1/4 cup brown sugar 1/2 teaspoon butter directions: defrost the cranberries, if using frozen. wash and dry the cranberries, then place them in a bowl. mash them slightly with a potato masher, then sprinkle them with 1/4 cup of sugar. cover and let sit for 30 minutes. while the cranberries are sitting, place a small plate in the freezer so you can test the jam for proper thickness later. add the cranberries, orange zest, lemon juice, cinnamon, allspice, nutmeg, cayenne, and salt to a food processor and pulse a few times until the cranberries are chunky but not completely liquified. make sure your jars are sterilized and ready to go, and start a very large pot of water to boil on the stove for processing your filled jars. keep the pot of water covered tightly. pour the fruit into a large, deep, heavy bottomed pot. add brown sugar and butter, stirring well to combine. cook over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the fruit begins to bubble and spit. use a skimmer to skim off any foam that forms. cook for about 20 minutes, stirring frequently to keep the fruit from sticking to the bottom of the pot. begin testing the jam for doneness. spread 1/2 teaspoon of cooked fruit on the cold plate and place it back in the freezer. wait 30 seconds, then run your finger through the fruit. it should be thick enough to maintain a path when you run your finger through it. if you d like thicker jam, place the plate back in the freezer and cook the fruit for another 3 minutes and test again. repeat until desired thickness is achieved, but be careful about cooking too long or you will alter the taste of your jam. remove pot from heat and use a spoon to skim any foam from the surface of the fruit. ladle jam into sterilized jars, leaving 1/2 inch of headroom, and process them in a hot water bath for 10 minutes. unopened jars will keep at room temperature for up to 6 months. opened jam should be refrigerated.

inputs: pork chops, butter, mushrooms, butter, parsley, red onion, egg, salt, black pepper, cheddar cheese
targets: title: mushroom topped pork chops ingredients: 4 boneless pork chops, 3/4 inch thick 1 tbsp 15 ml butter or margarine 1 cup 225 ml finely chopped mushrooms 1 tbsp 15 ml butter or margarine 1/2 cup 125 ml finely chopped parsley 1/3 cup 80 ml finely chopped red onion 1 egg 1 tsp 5 ml . salt dash black pepper 2 tbsp 30 ml grated cheddar cheese directions: heat the butter in pan. brown pork chops on both sides. place pork chops in an oven proof dish. saute the mushrooms in butter in a skillet until they are no longer moist let cool. mix together mushrooms, parsley, red onion, egg, salt and pepper. place filling on top of pork chops. bake at 350 degrees 175 c. for about 20 minutes. sprinkle with cheese and bake for about another 30 minutes. check for doneness at the side of a pork chop. the juices should run clear when pierced with a fork.

inputs: butter, cream cheese, salt, flour, cold milk, vegetable oil, ground beef, onion, salt, egg, sour cream, blue cheese, black olives, walnuts
targets: title: blue cheese beef roll ingredients: 1/2 cup butter 1/2 cup cream cheese 1/2 teaspoon salt 2 cups sifted all purpose flour 1/4 cup cold milk 1 tablespoon vegetable oil 2 pounds ground beef 1/2 cup chopped onion 2 teaspoons salt 1 egg, beaten 1 cup sour cream 1/3 cup blue cheese, crumbled 1/2 cup chopped black olives 1/2 cup chopped walnuts directions: in a medium bowl, blend together the butter, cream cheese and salt until smooth. stir in the flour, until the mixture is evenly crumbly. sprinkle the milk over the flour mixture one tablespoon at a time, stirring with a fork until the dough is moistened enough to be formed into a ball. press dough together, and knead for just a couple of turns. flatten the ball slightly, wrap and refrigerate. heat the oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. add the ground beef and onion, and cook until the beef is no longer pink. drain off fat, and set aside to cool. transfer the meat mixture to a bowl, and mix in the salt, egg, sour cream, blue cheese, olives and walnuts until well blended. preheat the oven to 425 degrees f 220 degrees c . on a sheet of waxed paper, or between two sheets, roll the pastry out into a rectangle about 10x12 inches. place the meat mixture down the center of the pastry, then bring the sides up around the filling, pinching together to enclose the filling completely. use the waxed paper to pick up the roll, and roll it onto a baking sheet so that it sits with the seam on the bottom. bake for 25 minutes in the preheated oven, or until the pastry is a nice golden brown.

inputs: chicken, butter, parmesan cheese, bread crumbs, oregano, parsley flakes, paprika, salt, black pepper
targets: title: parmesan chicken breasts ingredients: 5 boneless, skinless chicken breast halves 2 tbsp. butter 1/2 c. grated parmesan cheese 1/4 c. dry bread crumbs 1 tsp. dried oregano leaves 1 tsp. parsley flakes 1/4 tsp. paprika 1/4 tsp. salt 1/4 tsp. black pepper directions: heat oven to 400 . spray a 9 x 13 inch pan with nonstick cooking spray. dip chicken in spread coat with combined remaining ingredients. place in prepared pan. bake 20 to 25 minutes or until tender.

inputs: cookies, , sugar, unsalted butter, , filling, milk, sugar, egg yolks, , , chocolate, weight semisweet chocolate, , cream, vanilla, sugar, powdered sugar
targets: title: chocolate cream pie with oreo crust ingredients: for the crust 14 whole oreo cookies 1/4 teaspoons salt 2 tablespoons granulated sugar 4 1/2 tablespoons unsalted butter, melted for the filling 2 cups whole milk 1/2 cups granulated sugar divided in 1/4 cups 3 whole egg yolks 1/4 cups cornstarch 1/4 teaspoons salt 1 ounce, weight unsweetened chocolate 5 ounces, weight semisweet chocolate, chopped for the topping 1 cup heavy whipping cream 1 1/2 teaspoon pure vanilla extract 2 tablespoons granulated sugar 2 tablespoons powdered sugar directions: crust preheat the oven to 350 degrees f. place all 14 whole oreo cookies in a food processor and grind into fine pieces. place in a bowl with salt, sugar and melted butter. mix together until all crumbs are evenly coated. pour mixture into a 9 inch glass pie dish and press with hands into dish to form a crust. place in oven for 8 10 minutes until the crust begins to be aromatic. remove from oven and very carefully, using the bottom of a glass cup, press crust down in the pan to compact it when it s immediately out of the oven. place on a cooling rack and allow to cool completely. chocolate filling in a medium saucepan, combine the milk with 1/4 cup of the sugar and heat over medium heat. heat until bubbles begin to form around the edge and milk is steaming. in the meantime, whisk together the egg yolks with the remaining 1/4 cup sugar, cornstarch and salt. once milk is heated, gradually add it into the egg mixture until just mixed. pour mixture back into sauce pan and on medium heat, whisk continuously at a medium speed until thick and creamy. this will happen fairly quickly, remember to keep whisking . once thick, add in all of the chopped chocolate and stir until well combined and melted. strain chocolate filling into pie crust through a course strainer. use a rubber spatula to push filling through strainer into pie crust. press a piece of plastic wrap over the top of the entire pie, pressing it gently onto the pie filling. place in refrigerator for at least 3 hours before putting on whipped topping. whipped topping whip heavy cream, vanilla extract and both sugars together at high speed until stiff peaks form. spread topping onto pie and serve. pie should stay refrigerated until serving.

inputs: dijon mustard, honey, green onion, soy sauce, hot pepper
targets: title: honey mustard glaze ingredients: 1/3 cup dijon mustard 2 tablespoons honey 1 tablespoon green onion, white parts only 1 teaspoon soy sauce 1/4 teaspoon hot pepper flakes or to taste directions: in a small bowl, combine all the ingredients. cover and chill until ready to use, up to 2 days. use as a glaze, brushing onto the food during the last 5 10 minutes of grilling.

inputs: ingredients, purple cabbage, green cabbage, carrot, yellow onion, black sesame seeds, dressing, olive oil, lemon juice, maple syrup, tahini, water, salt
targets: title: detox slaw ingredients: ingredients 1.5 cups purple cabbage, shredded 1.25 cups green cabbage, shredded 1 medium carrot, shredded 1/8 cup yellow onion, chopped 2 tablespoons black sesame seeds, toasted dressing 1 tablespoon olive oil 1 tablespoon lemon juice 1/2 tablespoon maple syrup or honey or agave nectar 2 tablespoons tahini 1/4 cup water 1 teaspoon salt or to taste directions: in a big bowl, mix all the vegetables together. mix the dressing ingredients together in another small bowl and stir till you get a uniform paste. add more water if needed to achieve the desired consistency. in a hot skillet, add sesame seeds and toast them till they start jumping out of the skillet. pour dressing over the vegetables. garnish with toasted sesame seeds and serve.

inputs: milk, chocolate chips, cinnamon, orange essence, sugar, ground cinnamon, orange rind
targets: title: flamenco delight ingredients: 4 cups milk 100 g chocolate chips or 100 g easy chocolate candy melts 1 cinnamon stick 12 teaspoon orange essence 1 teaspoon sugar 12 teaspoon ground cinnamon 2 teaspoons orange rind, finely grated directions: place 1 cup milk, cinnamon stick chocolate in a saucepan over low heat, stir occasionally until chocolate has melted and then gradually add the remaining milk, stirring until well mixed. meanwhile combine sugar, cinnamon orange rind set aside. when milk has almost reached a boil, remove it from the heat discard cinnamon stick, stir in orange essence and whip with a beater until fluffy. serve hot chocolate in mugs and sprinkle with cinnamon mixture.

inputs: flour, baking powder, salt, sugar, nutmeg, cinnamon, shortening, mashed sweet potatoes, milk
targets: title: sweet potato biscuits ingredients: 1 c. flour 1 1/2 tsp. baking powder 1/2 tsp. salt 1/4 c. sugar 1/2 tsp. nutmeg optional 1 tsp. cinnamon optional 4 tbsp. shortening 1 c. mashed sweet potatoes 1/2 to 3/4 c. milk directions: mix flour, baking powder, salt, sugar and spices. blend in shortening, sweet potatoes and milk. should make a stiff dough. flour counter surface. pat dough to 3/4 inch thickness. cut biscuits with small juice glass or 3 inch cookie cutter. bake at 375 for 20 to 30 minutes or until golden brown.

inputs: cauliflower, onion, salt, parsley greens, flour, paprika, water, carrots, shortening
targets: title: creamed cauliflower soup ingredients: 1 cauliflower, cut in pieces 1/2 onion salt 2 tsp. chopped parsley greens 1 tbsp. flour 1/2 tsp. paprika 2 qt. water 2 carrots 2 tbsp. shortening directions: cook cauliflower and carrots in salted water. in shortening, brown onion and parsley greens. add paprika and flour. add to soup slowly. bring to a boil. make small dumplings from one egg and add to soup, if desired. serve hot.

inputs: rolls, pudding, pecans, brown sugar, margarine
targets: title: sticky buns ingredients: 24 bridgeford frozen parker house rolls 1 small box instant butterscotch pudding coarsely chopped pecans 3/4 c. brown sugar 1/2 stick margarine, melted directions: in bottom of large baking pan, mix sugar, margarine, pudding and nuts. place rolls on top in rows of 8. put in a cold oven overnight. next morning, turn oven on to 325 for 20 minutes. invert onto plate to serve.

inputs: flour, sugar, salt, baking soda, ground cinnamon, eggs, vegetable oil, carrots, vanilla, pineapple, coconut, nuts
targets: title: carrot cake ingredients: 2 c. all purpose flour 2 c. sugar 1/2 tsp. salt 1 tsp. baking soda 2 tsp. ground cinnamon 3 eggs 1 1/2 c. vegetable oil 2 c. finely grated carrots 1 tsp. vanilla 1 c. drained crushed pineapple 1 c. shredded coconut 1 c. chopped nuts directions: combine dry ingredients. add eggs, oil, carrots and vanilla. beat until combined. stir in pineapple, coconut and nuts. pour into greased 13 x 9 inch baking pan. bake at 350 for 50 to 60 minutes or test for doneness. cool cake and frost with cream cheese icing.

inputs: hamburger, carrots, either cream
targets: title: hamburger casserole ingredients: 1 lb. hamburger sliced carrots, onions, potatoes and rice either cream of celery, cream of chicken or cream of mushroom soup, which has been mixed with 1 can water directions: brown hamburger and layer sliced carrots, onions, potatoes and rice. pour soup over all. bake at 350 for 1 hour. use 2 quart casserole.

inputs: whipping cream, light brown sugar, pecans, oleo, vanilla
targets: title: pralines ingredients: 1 c. whipping cream 1 1 lb. box light brown sugar 2 c. pecans 2 tbsp. oleo 1 tsp. vanilla directions: put cream and sugar in 4 quart bowl. microwave on high for 13 minutes. quickly add pecans, margarine and vanilla stir. spoon onto a sheet of foil.

inputs: vinegar, soy sauce, brown sugar, catsup
targets: title: delicious barbecue sauce ingredients: 1/4 c. vinegar 1/4 c. soy sauce 1/2 c. brown sugar 1 c. catsup directions: mix ingredients. pour over chicken, ribs, pork chops or your favorite meat. if you want only a cup, use 1/8 cup vinegar, 1/8 cup soy sauce, 1/4 cup brown sugar and 1/2 cup catsup.

inputs: carrots, garlic, canola oil, unsalted butter, water, maple syrup, salt
targets: title: maple roasted whole carrots ingredients: 1 pound medium carrots, peeled and trimmed 4 large garlic cloves, peeled 1 tablespoon canola oil 1 tablespoon unsalted butter 1/4 cup water 2 tablespoons pure maple syrup salt and freshly ground pepper directions: preheat the oven to 400. combine all of the ingredients in a medium baking dish. cover with foil and roast for 30 minutes, until the carrots are tender. remove the foil and continue roasting for about 30 minutes longer, until the water has evaporated and the carrots are lightly browned. transfer to a platter and serve.

inputs: green peppers, ground beef, rice, kosher salt, ground black pepper, garlic, onion, mushrooms, tomato sauce, mozzarella cheese, water
targets: title: jake s stuffed bell peppers ingredients: 6 green peppers you can use red or yellow too 1 lb ground beef 1 cup cooked minute rice 1 teaspoon kosher salt 12 teaspoon ground black pepper 2 garlic cloves, minced 1 tablespoon minced onion 1 8 ounce packagesliced button mushrooms 1 15 ounce can tomato sauce 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese 8 cups water directions: preheat oven to 350 degrees and in a large pot start the water to boil. cut off the tops of the peppers, remove seeds and wash thoroughly. when water is boiling put peppers in for five minutes to soften. remove peppers and set aside. turn them upside down so excess water drains out. cook the beef, salt, pepper, garlic and minced onions together. when browned add the rice, mushrooms, and half of the tomato sauce. mix well and let sit for about 2 3 minutes to develop the flavor. place peppers in a large casserole dish or you can use a 9 x 13 pan. fill each pepper with the beef mixture until they are all full. if there is any left you can use it around the bases of the peppers to support them. then pour the remaining tomato sauce on top of each pepper. cover with lid or aluminum foil tent, and bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes. sprinkle the mozzarella cheese on top of each pepper and bake for another 15 minutes. enjoy

inputs: fishermans, mayonnaise, traders red, , corn starch, buttermilk, lemon juice, peanut oil, scallions
targets: title: bang bang shrimp ingredients: 2 lbs. harris teeter fishermans market fresh wild shrimp, peeled 1 cup harris teeter mayonnaise 1/2 cup ht traders red chili dipping sauce 1/4 tsp sriracha hot garlic chili sauce, sdd more sriracha hot sauce for more heat if desired corn starch harris teeter buttermilk harris teeter lemon juice harris teeter peanut oil scallions directions: directions mix the above ingredients in a small bowl to max the sauce and set aside. shell and de vein the uncooked fresh shrimp. rise in cold water. soak the shrimp in a small amount of buttermilk with fresh squeezed lemon juice for 30 minutes. dredge the shrimp and coat evenly in the dry cornstarch. deep fry the shrimp in 375 degree peanut oil until lightly brown, about 2 to four minutes. remove the shrimp and drain on a paper towel. place the drained shrimp in a bowl and toss the shrimp with the sauce until completely coated. serve in a lettuce lined bowl and top with chopped scallions.

inputs: pink beans, onion, garlic, ham hock, water, salt
targets: title: beans n ham hocks ingredients: 1 16 ounce package pink beans washed and picked clean of rocks and soaked over night 1 small onion, diced 4 garlic cloves, minced 1 large ham hock, split in half 6 8 cups water or 6 8 cups chicken stock salt and pepper, to taste directions: in crockpot add cleaned beans, onions, garlic and ham hock. cover with water or chicken stock and cook on medium for 6 hours. at about the half way point the meat should come off the ham hock, if not let it cook a little longer until you can. remove the ham hock from beans and let cool. remove the layer of fat from the ham hock and shred the meat into bite size pieces and return to the crockpot. when beans are done add salt and pepper to taste and skim as much fat off the beans as possible.

inputs: lemon balm, honey, blackberries
targets: title: blackberry mint iced tea ingredients: 4 tea bags lipton preferred 6 lemon balm leaves, whole plus more for garnish, or mint 1/2 cup honey, to taste 6 ounces fresh blackberries plus more for garnish directions: in a large pot, boil 4 cups of water. remove from heat, tear the mint leaves in half and add to the pitcher along with the tea bags. stir gently, cover and let steep about 10 15 minutes. meanwhile, puree blackberries in a blender or food processor, strain into a 2 quart pitcher discarding pulp and seeds . strain the water into the pitcher, discarding tea bags and mint. add in honey, tasting and adjusting to your desired sweetness. top with cold water to fill, stirring to incorporate. chill for at least 4 6 hours in the refrigerator. serve over ice and garnish with a mint leaf and some blackberries.

inputs: heavy cream, well, shallot, kosher salt, freshly ground black pepper
targets: title: horseradish sauce for corned beef or brisket ingredients: 1/2 cup heavy cream 3 tablespoons well drained prepared horseradish 1 tablespoon finely minced shallot 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt pinch freshly ground black pepper directions: in a small bowl, beat the heavy cream until it just begins to hold soft peaks. do not overbeat. gently whisk in the horseradish, shallot, salt and pepper. chill until ready to serve. this sauce goes particularly well with leftover corned beef or brisket.

inputs: apricot nectar, pineapple juice, frozen lemonade, bottles ginger ale, lime sherbet
targets: title: apricot mist ingredients: 1 46 oz. can apricot nectar 1 46 oz. can pineapple juice 3 6 oz. cans frozen lemonade 3 28 oz. bottles ginger ale 1 pt. lime sherbet directions: chill all ingredients mix well. spoon scoops of lime sherbet into mixture. makes 40 servings.

inputs: center, salt, garlic, onions, bay leaf, water, soy sauce
targets: title: crock pot roast pork ingredients: 4 5 lbs center cut pork roast or 4 5 lbs end cut pork roast salt and pepper 1 garlic clove, sliced 2 medium onions, sliced 1 bay leaf 1 cup hot water 2 tablespoons soy sauce directions: rub pork roast with salt and pepper. make tiny slits in meat and insert slivers of garlic or just sprinkle on some garlic powder . place in broiler pan and broil about 15 20 minutes to remove excess fat. check frequently. i oftentimes just brown on all sides in frying pan . mix hot water and soy sauce. put one sliced onion in bottom of crockpot. add browned pork roast and remaining onion and other ingredients. cover and cook on high for 4 or so hours. this is how long it takes in my westbend slow cooker . low setting would probably be 6 8 hours. to thicken gravy remove roast to serving platter. blend 2 tablespoons cornstarch with 2 tablespoons cold water to form a smooth paste. stir well and let come to a boil. doesn t get too thick which is how we like it .

inputs: ham bone, yellow onion, garlic, salt, tomatoes, frozen corn, frozen okra, green beans, potatoes, fresh carrots
targets: title: ham and vegetable soup ingredients: 1 picnic ham bone with generous amount ham still on bone spiral hams work great 1 large yellow onion, coarsely chopped 4 cloves fresh minced garlic salt and pepper to taste 2 to 3 cans stewed tomatoes 1 pkg. frozen corn 1 box frozen okra 1 can green beans 1 to 2 cans sliced new potatoes 1 to 2 c. chopped fresh carrots 2 tsp. morton nature s seasons directions: place ham bone, chopped onion, minced garlic and salt and pepper in large stock pot and cover with water. cover and simmer 2 to 3 hours until meat falls from bone. remove bone and meat from stock. allow meat to cool, then remove all fat, gristle and return only lean ham meat to soup stock. add tomatoes to stock and simmer approximately 1/2 hour. add remaining ingredients and simmer approximately 30 minutes to 1 hour. may adjust garlic and other seasonings to taste. may adjust choice of vegetables to taste.

inputs: potatoes, sour cream, cream cheese, margarine
targets: title: company potatoes ingredients: 5 lb. potatoes 2 c. sour cream 8 oz. cream cheese 1/4 lb. margarine directions: wash, peel and cook potatoes until soft. cream potatoes with electric mixer until smooth and add sour cream, cream cheese and margarine. mix until smooth. spoon into a greased 2 quart casserole dish. bake at 375 for 45 minutes or until bubbly. the depth of the casserole dish may cause a variance in the baking time. this recipe may be made days ahead of time and refrigerated.

inputs: flour, butter, salt, eggs, milk
targets: title: grandma fleissner s egg pancakes ingredients: 1/2 c. flour 1 tsp. melted butter 1/4 tsp. salt 2 eggs 1 c. milk directions: put all ingredients in a blender and blend well. heat frying pan and coat with butter. pour in mixture and cook until top is firm and bottom is lightly browned. flip over and brown other side. place on a plate and put on your favorite syrup, or roll up, slice and enjoy makes 4 to 5 6 to 7 inch pancakes.

inputs: butter, brown sugar, flour, brown sugar, eggs, nuts, coconut, flour, baking powder, salt
targets: title: dreams ingredients: 3/4 c. butter 1/3 c. brown sugar 1 1/2 c. flour 1 1/2 c. brown sugar 2 eggs 1 c. chopped nuts 1 c. coconut 2 tbsp. flour 1/4 tsp. baking powder dash of salt directions: crumble together the butter, 1/3 cup brown sugar and 1 1/2 cups flour to an even meal. press evenly over the bottoms and slightly up the sides of a lightly buttered 13 x 9 inch pan. bake in moderate oven until lightly browned. mix together 1 1/2 cups brown sugar, eggs, nuts, coconut, 2 tablespoons flour, baking powder and salt. spread over baked mixture. bake until set. cool and cut in pieces.

inputs: flour, sugar, eggs, baking powder, salt, vanilla, crisco, margarine, butter, milk
targets: title: white pound cake ingredients: 3 c. flour 3 c. sugar 5 eggs 1 scant tbsp. baking powder 1/2 tsp. salt 2 tsp. vanilla 1/2 c. crisco 1 stick margarine 1 stick butter 1 c. milk directions: blend all shortening until fluffy. add sugar and cream well. add eggs, one at a time. add flour, salt and baking powder. add milk alternately with dry ingredients and add vanilla. bake in tube pan for 1 hour at 350 .

inputs: chocolate chips, vegetable shortening, nuts, crackers
targets: title: microwave muddy animal crackers ingredients: 1/2 c. chocolate chips 1 tbsp. vegetable shortening do not use butter or margarine 1/3 c. chopped nuts 1 2 oz. box animal crackers directions: place chocolate chips and vegetable shortening in a medium microwave safe bowl. cover and microwave on high 2 minutes or until chips are melted. stir at 1 minute. stir in nuts. dip animal crackers in the chocolate mixture. remove with a fork. place on waxed paper and refrigerate until cool.

inputs: sugar, almond milk, silken, chocolate, vanilla, ground cinnamon, chili powder, chocolate shavings
targets: title: mexican chocolate shake ingredients: 1/4 cup sugar 2 cups almond milk 1 pound silken lite tofu 12 oz semisweet chocolate, melted 1 tsp vanilla extract 1.5 tsp ground cinnamon optional 0.5 tsp chili powder to taste chocolate shavings directions: 1. put all ingredients except shavings in a blender and puree until smooth. 2. chill at least 30 minutes in freezer. garnish with chocolate shavings before serving.

inputs: raspberry, pomegranate vodka, pomegranate seltzer, lime, cubes
targets: title: razzy pom pom cocktail ingredients: 1 tbsp raspberry schnapps 1 1/2 oz pomegranate vodka 1 1/2 cup pomegranate seltzer 1 lime wedge to squeeze and garnish 6 ice cubes directions: add ice cubes to a tall glass and add all ingredients except lime wedge. stir well with a tall spoon. squeeze lime wedge into cocktail and run along rim of glass. sip and enjoy

inputs: flour, sugar, salt, soda, buttermilk, vegetable oil, eggs, vanilla, red food coloring, vinegar
targets: title: red velvet cake ingredients: 2 1/2 c. all purpose flour 1 1/2 c. sugar 1 tsp. salt 1 tsp. soda 1 c. buttermilk 1 1/2 or 1 3/4 c. vegetable oil 2 eggs 1 tsp. vanilla 2 oz. red food coloring 1 tsp. vinegar directions: cream the sugar, milk, eggs and oil. blend dry ingredients into cream mixture. add vanilla, food coloring and vinegar. grease and flour three 8 inch cake pans. cook for 30 to 35 minutes in a 350 oven.

inputs: flour, sugar, anise seed, eggs, oil, sherry, yeast, warm water
targets: title: italian easter bread ingredients: 7 1/2 c. flour 1 1/2 c. sugar 2 tbsp. anise seed 6 eggs 1/2 c. oil 1/2 c. sherry or white wine 2 pkg. yeast 1/2 c. warm water directions: in a large pot, mix dry ingredients together. form a well in center and add eggs and oil. mix yeast and warm water let sit for 5 to 10 minutes. add yeast to well. knead until dough is firm. place on cookie sheet covered with a clean, dry towel to rise approximately 8 hours . bless dough and bake at 350 for 20 to 25 minutes until golden brown. makes 2 to 3 loaves according to size.

inputs: fusilli pasta, garlic, onion, broccoli, pork, chicken stock, olive oil, salt, pepper
targets: title: pasta, broccoli minced pork stirfry ingredients: 3 cups fusilli pasta, although similar sized pasta e.g. farfelle or gemelli is fine 1 garlic crushed peeled 1/2 onion diced 1 broccoli large, chopped to bite sized chunks 1 cup minced pork 1 cup chicken stock olive oil good quality salt pepper directions: 1. soften the pasta in boiling water mixed with a splash of olive oil and some salt 2. when it s almost done, drain it and fill the pot with the chicken stock and some salt 3. bring to boil and dump the pasta back in until all the stock has been absorbed into the pasta 4. set aside 1. stirfry minced pork with onions and splash of olive oil. set aside. 2. on medium heat in a non stick pan, toast the garlic cloves in some olive oil, then add the broccoli 3. stirfry broccoli until almost cooked, then add the fried minced pork 4. when everything is nice and cooked, add pasta and toss till evenly mixed

inputs: bacon, hamburger, onion, kidney beans, garbanzo beans, beans, pork, chili sauce, brown sugar
targets: title: super bowl beans ingredients: 1 lb. bacon, cut in squares 2 lb. hamburger 1 large onion, diced 1 can kidney beans optional 1 can garbanzo beans 1 can lima beans optional 2 cans pork and beans 1/3 bottle chili sauce 1/2 to 3/4 c. 1/4 to 1/2 c. brown sugar directions: fry bacon until nearly done drain well on paper towel. fry hamburger and onion drain off excess grease. in a large dutch oven or baking dish, combine remaining ingredients. add meats and onion simmer for 4 to 5 hours on the stove, or bake at 300 for 2 to 3 hours.

inputs: butter, sugar, eggs, lemon, lemon juice, vanilla, cake flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt, poppy seeds, buttermilk
targets: title: poppy seed cake ingredients: 6 oz. 1 1/2 stick butter , softened to room temperature 1 2/3 c. sugar 3 eggs grated peel of 1 lemon 2 tbsp. fresh lemon juice 1 1/2 tsp. vanilla 2 2/3 c. sifted cake flour 1 1/2 tsp. baking powder 1/2 tsp. baking soda 1/2 tsp. salt 1 1/2 tbsp. poppy seeds 3/4 c. buttermilk directions: spread butter all around the bottom and sides of a 13 x 9 inch cake pan and set aside. shake out any excess flour. put 6 ounces of butter and the sugar into a medium size bowl and cream until well blended and smooth. scrape down sides with rubber spatula. crack 1 egg at a time and drop directly into the batter. beat well after each addition and continue to beat until batter is smooth. add lemon peel, lemon juice and vanilla and mix well.

inputs: cake, eggs, cream of tartar, sugar, sweet butter, cocoa powder, all purpose flour, filling, heavy cream, semi sweet chocolate chips, instant coffee, rum, chocolate, chocolate, sweet butter, vegetable oil, syrup
targets: title: hungarian chocolate cream bars ingredients: cake 4 large eggs, separated 1/4 teaspoon cream of tartar 2/3 cup sugar, divided 3/4 cup sweet butter, room temp 9 tablespoons cocoa powder 1/2 cup all purpose flour, sifted filling 2 cups heavy cream 12 ounces semi sweet chocolate chips 1 tablespoon instant coffee, powdered 1/8 cup rum optional glaze 5 ounces semisweet chocolate 1 ounce unsweetened chocolate 4 tablespoons sweet butter 1 teaspoon vegetable oil 1 tablespoon karo syrup directions: to make cake preheat oven to 350 f grease a 9 x 13 inch pan. line pan with wax paper and grease the wax paper. beat the egg whites lightly, add cream of tartar and beat at a high speed. when shiny, gradually add 1/3 cup of sugar, continuing to beat until stiff. in a separate mixing bowl, place the egg yolks, remaining sugar and butter and beat until light and fluffy. add the cocoa and mix thoroughly. add a large dollop of egg whites to chocolate mixture and whip until blended. then pour the rest of the egg whites over the chocolate mixture and sprinkle the flour over the egg whites. fold gently with a spatula until the egg whites and flour are incorporated. immediately spread the batter in the prepared pan. smooth out to edges and corners. bake 10 15 minutes at 350 f until cake is done. run a knife around edges and invert cake on a wire rack to cool. to make filling in a saucepan, combine cream, chocolate chips and instant coffee. cook over low heat until mixture is smooth and slightly thickened. cover saucepan and refrigerate until very cold. when chilled, add rum if using and whip in a chilled bowl at medium speed until firm. be careful not to over beat or the filling may separate. to make glaze do not make this until all other steps are completed in a small saucepan, melt all ingredients over a low flame. mix until very smooth. cool for 15 minutes and mix again. use immediately, as the sauce thickens as it cools. to assemble cut cake horizontally into halves. lightly sprinkle bottom half with rum. spread filling over bottom layer. place top layer on bottom half and spread filling over top. refrigerate or freeze until very firm. when very cold, set the cake on a wire rack. pour the warm glaze over the cake. refrigerate again until firm. cut with a sharp knife, wiping the blade after each cut. you can freeze cut squares.

inputs: flour, sugar, baking powder, salt, butter, egg yolks, apples, sugar, flour, cinnamon, egg white
targets: title: apple bars ingredients: 2 c. flour 1/2 c. sugar 1/2 tsp. baking powder 1/2 tsp. salt optional 1 c. butter or margarine 2 beaten egg yolks 4 medium 4 c. apples, cored and sliced 3/4 c. sugar 1/4 c. flour 1 tsp. cinnamon optional 1 slightly beaten egg white directions: combine the 2 cups of flour, 1/2 cup sugar, baking powder and salt. cut in butter until crumbs are the size of small peas. stir in egg yolks. divide mixture in half. press 1/2 in bottom of 9 x 13 x 2 inch baking pan.

inputs: ketchup, light brown sugar, lemon zest, lemon juice, molasses, worcestershire sauce, dry mustard, ground pepper
targets: title: lemon barbecue sauce ingredients: 1 c. ketchup 1/4 c. light brown sugar 1 tsp. finely grated lemon zest 3 tbsp. fresh lemon juice 1 tbsp. molasses 1/2 tbsp. worcestershire sauce 1 tsp. dry mustard 1/4 tsp. ground pepper directions: combine all ingredients in a small saucepan and bring to a boil. simmer sauce until thickened, about 4 minutes. let cool, then refrigerate. this will keep in refrigerator for about one week. will make about 1 1/2 cups.

inputs: masarepa, salt, water, vegetable oil, vegetable oil, shallot, clove garlic, long chili, shrimp, lime, salt, avocado, tomato, scallions
targets: title: sunday brunch shrimp arepas recipe ingredients: 2 cups masarepa 1 teaspoon salt 3 cups hot water vegetable oil for skillet or griddle 1 teaspoon vegetable oil 1 shallot, minced 1 clove garlic, minced 1 small long chili, minced 1 pound peeled and deveined shrimp 1 lime, juiced salt to taste sliced avocado, optional diced tomato, optional thinly sliced scallions, optional bibb lettuce leaves, optional directions: place masarepa and salt in a large bowl and mix to combine. slowly pour hot water into masarepa, mixing with a fork until dough comes together. roll into a log, wrap in plastic, and let rest 20 minutes. once arepas, have rested divide in half, then divide each half into 8 pieces. shape into short cylinders like a hockey puck then wrap individually in plastic wrap if not using right away. preheat oven to 350 f. heat a thin layer of vegetable oil in skillet or griddle over medium high heat and sear each arepa until just beginning to brown, then transfer to oven. allow to bake for 20 minutes. while arepas are in the oven, prepare shrimp by heating oil in a skillet over medium high heat, add shallot, and cook until beginning to soften, about 4 minutes. add garlic and chili and cook until fragrant, about 4 minutes. add shrimp and lime juice and cook until shrimp are pink and starting to become firm, about 7 minutes. season to taste with salt. once arepas are cooked, split and fill with shrimp and any or all of the optional garnishes.

inputs: quinoa, butternut squash, red onion, walnuts, cranberries, balsamic vinegar, salt, olive oil
