targets: title: winter quinoa salad ingredients: 1 cup quinoa, dried 1 whole butternut squash 1/2 whole red onion 5 cups torn/chopped kale 1/2 cups walnuts 1/3 cups dried cranberries 2 tablespoons balsamic vinegar salt and black pepper to taste olive oil for drizzling over the vegetables before roasting directions: 1. preheat the oven to 400 f. 2. cook the quinoa according to box instructions. 3. peel butternut squash, remove the seeds and cut the flesh into bite size pieces. 4. place butternut squash cubes onto a rimmed sheet pan and drizzle with olive oil and season with salt and pepper. make sure all the pieces are coated then put pan into the 400 f oven. 5. bake for about 1/2 hour total, flipping halfway through. 6. cut onion into thin slices, cutting lengthwise. 7. when the squash is ten minutes from being finished, throw the onion slices onto the sheet pan and toss with squash. 8. place kale on another rimmed sheet pan, drizzle with olive oil and season with salt and pepper, toss to coat. 9. place kale into the 400 f oven and bake for about ten minutes, flipping once. 10. toast walnuts for a few minutes until you smell them, either on a sheet pan or on the stove over medium heat. once toasted, remove from heat and chop into small pieces. 11. in a large bowl, mix together quinoa, butternut squash, kale, onions, walnuts and cranberries. 12. add the balsamic vinegar use more or less depending on your love of it . 13. season with salt and pepper to taste. 14. enjoy warm or cold

inputs: green bell pepper, potatoes, onions, baby carrots, sweet potato, butternut squash, stewing beef, beef stock, water, olive oil, garlic, flour, garlic salt, salt, pepper
targets: title: hearty beef stew ingredients: 1 large green bell pepper 3 potatoes 4 small cooking onions 1 12 cups baby carrots 12 sweet potato 1 cup butternut squash 1 lb stewing beef, cubed 2 cups beef stock 1 cup water 3 tablespoons olive oil 1 garlic clove, crushed 4 tablespoons flour 1 teaspoon garlic salt salt pepper directions: blend flour, pinch of salt, pepper and pinch of garlic salt in a bowl garlic powder is just as fine depending on your salt preference . heat oil in deep pan or large pot. add garlic. dredge cubed stewing beef in flour mixture and brown in oil. clean and roughly chop the veggies, adding to browned beef . my preference is onions, peppers and mushrooms first so they can cook down and blend right away with the oil and beef juices. add remaining starchy veg. pour over beef stock and water. add enough water to just cover everything. simmer until all veg are soft, stirring occasionally, adding salt and pepper to taste. blend a bit of flour and a bit of cold water in a glass. add to stew to thicken. continue to simmer to taste.

inputs: unsalted butter, white sugar, eggs, vanilla, flour, baking powder, salt, milk, milk, frosting, cream cheese, unsalted butter, vanilla, sugar, clown faces, chocolate chips, chocolate, gummi worms, orange candy coated milk
targets: title: clown cupcakes ingredients: 7 tablespoons unsalted butter, at room temperature 3/4 cup white sugar 2 eggs 1 teaspoon vanilla extract 1 3/4 cups all purpose flour 1 teaspoon baking powder 1 pinch salt 1/2 cup whole milk 2 tablespoons whole milk frosting 6 ounces cream cheese, cubed 3 tablespoons unsalted butter, at room temperature 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract 3/4 cup confectioners sugar clown faces 24 mini chocolate chips 12 red candy coated milk chocolate pieces such as m m s r 12 gummi worms 1/2 cup orange candy coated milk chocolate pieces such as m m s r directions: preheat the oven to 350 degrees f 175 degrees c . grease a 12 cup muffin tin or line cups with paper liners. combine butter and sugar in a bowl. beat using an electric mixer until creamy. add eggs, 1 at a time, and beat well after each addition. mix in vanilla extract. stir flour, baking powder, and salt together in a separate bowl. alternate adding flour mixture and all the milk in small amounts, mixing well after each addition. spoon batter into the prepared muffin cups, filling each 3/4 full. bake in the preheated oven until tops spring back when lightly pressed, about 20 minutes. cool in the tin for 5 minutes. transfer to a wire rack and let cool completely, about 20 minutes. combine cream cheese and butter in a bowl. beat using an electric mixer until creamy. add confectioners sugar 2 tablespoons at a time and mix. add vanilla extract after 1/2 the confectioners sugar has been incorporated. frost each cooled cupcake with a layer of cream cheese frosting. place 2 chocolate chips for eyes, 1 red m m r candy for the nose, and 1 gummy worm for the mouth on each cupcake. place 2 rows of orange m m s r on top to make the hair.

inputs: flour, brown sugar, butter, pecan, chocolate chips
targets: title: butter pecan bars ingredients: 1 3/4 c. flour 1 1/4 c. firmly packed brown sugar, divided 1 c. butter or margarine, divided 1 6 oz. bag 1 1/2 c. pecan pieces 1 c. hershey s semi sweet chocolate chips directions: beat flour, 3/4 cup brown sugar and 1/3 cup butter for 2 to 3 minutes at medium speed of mixer until particles are fine. pat firmly into greased 13 x 9 inch pan. sprinkle with pecans and press lightly. heat remaining 1/2 cup brown sugar and 2/3 cup butter until mixture boils. boil 1 minute, stirring constantly drizzle over pecans. bake at 350 for 20 minutes or until caramel layer is bubbly. remove from oven sprinkle with chocolate chips. let stand 2 minutes using knife lightly swirl melted chips into caramel. cool cut into bars. makes 36 bars.

inputs: onion, garlic, curry, paprika, cumin, olive oil, tomatoes, baby spinach, chickpeas, vegetable broth, salt, ground pepper
targets: title: vegetarian spinach curry ingredients: 1 cup medium onion, chopped 2 garlic cloves, minced 1 tbsp curry powder hot 1/2 tsp indian paprika 1/2 tsp turmenic 1/2 tsp cumin 1 tbsp olive oil 1 14.5 oz can of organic diced tomatoes 10 oz of fresh baby spinach 1 15 oz can of chickpeas, rinsed and drained 1 cup vegetable broth 1/4 tsp sea salt 1/4 tsp ground pepper directions: in a nonstick skillet, cook onion,garlic until brown for 3 5 minutes add curry,paprika,turmeric, cumin,salt and pepper. stir in mixture. stir in diced tomatoes, spinach and 1 cup of chickpeas in a blender, combine the vegetable broth and remaining chickpeas. stir mixture into skillet and heat for 10 minutes and let simmer for 5 additional minutes. optional balsamic brown rice for side dish

inputs: mushrooms, green pepper, sweet red pepper, white onion, red onion, canola oil, garlic, lean ground beef, italian link sausage, cornmeal, bread, tomato sauce, parsley, italian seasoning, garlic, pepper, turkey pepperoni, olives, mozzarella cheese, cheddar cheese
targets: title: loaded pizza ingredients: 1 1/2 cups sliced fresh mushrooms 1/4 cup chopped green pepper 1/4 cup chopped sweet red pepper 1/4 cup white onion 1/4 cup red onion 1 tablespoon canola oil 2 garlic cloves, minced 1/4 lb lean ground beef 4 ounces italian link sausage, casing removed 2 teaspoons cornmeal frozen bread dough, thawed 1 8 ounce can tomato sauce 2 tablespoons minced fresh parsley 2 teaspoons italian seasoning 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder 1/8 teaspoon pepper 15 turkey pepperoni, slices 2 tablespoons sliced ripe olives 1 1/4 cups shredded part skim mozzarella cheese 1/4 cup shredded reduced fat cheddar cheese directions: in a non stick skillet, saute mushrooms, peppers, and onions in oil until almost tender. add garlic, saute 1 minute longer, remove and set aside. in the same skillet, cook beef, and sausage over medium heat until no longer pinkfor 8 10 minutes or until crust is golden, drain. coat a 14 inch pizza pan with cooking spray, and sprinkle with cornmeal. on a lightly dloured surface, roll dough into a 15 inch circle, and transfer to a prepared pan. build up edges slightly, and prick dough thoroughly with a fork. bake at 400 degrees for 8 10 minutes, or until lightly browned. in a large bowl, combine the tomato sauce, parsley, italian seasoning, garlic powder, and pepper, spread over crust. top with vegetables, meat mixture, pepperoni, and olives. sprinkle with cheeses. bake for 8 10 minutes or until crust is golden brown, and cheese is melted.

inputs: nonfat milk, unbleached flour, whole wheat flour, olive oil, dried basil, salt, egg, egg whites, freshly grated parmesan cheese
targets: title: savory parmesan popovers healthier ingredients: 1 cup nonfat milk 2/3 cup unbleached flour or 2/3 cup all purpose flour 1/3 cup whole wheat flour 1 teaspoon olive oil 3/4 teaspoon dried basil 1/4 teaspoon salt 1 egg 2 egg whites 3 tablespoons freshly grated parmesan cheese directions: place the oven rack on the next to lowest shelf of the oven. preheat the oven to 450 . coat 6 popover cups, deep muffin cups, or custard cups with nonstick spray. in a medium bowl, stir together the milk, unbleached or all purpose flour, whole wheat flour, oil, basil, and salt. vigorously whisk in the egg and egg whites. spoon the batter into the prepared cups. sprinkle with parmesan evenly over the batter in the cups. bake for 15 minutes. reduce the oven temperature to 350 . do not open the oven door. bake for 15 20 minutes longer, or until deep golden brown and puffed up. remove the popovers from the oven and cool in the cups on a rack for 5 minutes. carefully remove from the cups and serve.

inputs: orange juice concentrate, lemonade concentrate, cold water, lemon lime drink
targets: title: sparkling orange punch ingredients: 12 oz. orange juice concentrate 6 oz. lemonade concentrate 6 c. cold water 1 fifth lemon lime drink directions: in a large container, combine orange juice, lemonade and water. chill mixture. add lemon lime drink just before serving. makes 24 1/2 cup punch cup servings.

inputs: tortillas, tomato, onion, shredded cheese, beans, ground beef, shredded lettuce, salsa
targets: title: beef and bean homemade burritos quick and easy ingredients: 1 pkg. 10 tortillas 1 large ripe tomato, diced 1/2 onion, chopped 1 pkg. shredded cheese 1 large can refried beans 1 lb. ground beef shredded lettuce salsa or picante sauce directions: in skillet brown ground beef. salt and pepper to taste. add can of refried beans. stir until thoroughly mixed. simmer. heat tortillas individually. add meat mixture and toppings.

inputs: cabbage, butter, onion, garlic, potatoes, egg, salt, all purpose flour
targets: title: cabbage and dumplings halushky recipe ingredients: 1 head cabbage, about 2 pounds, finely minced 3 tbsp. butter 1 sm onion, finely diced 1 x cloves garlic, crushed, optional up to 2 salt and pepper to taste 2 lrg potatoes, finely grated 1 lrg egg 1 tsp salt 3 c. all purpose flour, approximately directions: saute/fry onion and garlic in butter. add in cabbage. season with salt and pepper. fry slowly till lightly browned about 20 min . don t burn set aside till ready for use. keep hot. dumplings for halusky grate potatoes. add in egg, salt, and flour to potatoes and mix well. dough shouldn t be thin. more or possibly less flour may be used according to size of potatoes. put dough on plate. use knife to cut off small portion at a time into boiling water. boil about 15 min. keep stirring to prevent scorching. drain in colander. rinse once with water. don t let halushky get cool. place in bowl. pour cabbage mix over halushky. serve warm. my girlfriend, does not make her own halushky dumplings all the time. she uses a bag of prepared, frzn italian gnocchi. these work just as well, if you don t want to go through all the hassle of making your own dumplings.

inputs: tomatoes, garlic, basil, olive oil, chicken breasts, pancetta, avocado, arugula, nuts, italian dressing
targets: title: italian style chicken, bacon avocado salad ingredients: 10 ounces cherry tomatoes, halved 2 garlic cloves, minced 20 basil leaves, torn 2 tablespoons olive oil 4 chicken breasts skin on 6 slices pancetta or 6 slices streaky bacon 1 ripe avocado, sliced 3 ounces arugula 2 ounces pine nuts, toasted optional 3 tablespoons italian dressing directions: heat oven to mark 300f arrange the tomatoes on a baking tray with the garlic and basil. drizzle with 1tbsp oil and cook for 1 hours leave to cool. drizzle the chicken with remaining oil and broil for 20 mins turn halfway through. cool, then remove the skin and slice. broil the bacon until crispy, then break into chunks. toss the chicken and pancetta or bacon with the avocado, tomatoes, arugula, pinenuts and dressing.

inputs: cremini mushrooms, breadcrumbs, parmesan cheese, chicken sausage, onion, red bell pepper, pepper
targets: title: sausage stuffed cremini mushrooms ingredients: 12 large cremini mushrooms 3/4 cup plain breadcrumbs 2 tablespoons grated parmesan cheese 2 ounces chicken sausage, casings removed 1 large onion, finely chopped 1 small red bell pepper, finely chopped 1/4 teaspoon pepper directions: preheat oven to 400f degrees. remove stems from mushrooms and finely chop stems. mix 2 tablespoons bread crumbs and parmesan in small bowl. lightly coat large nonstick frypan with nonstick cooking spray and set over medium heat. cook sausages until they begin to brown, about 5 minutes, breaking up with the side of spoon. stir in onion, red pepper, and mushroom stems, and then cook until veggies are soft, about 5 minutes. stir in remaining bread crumbs and black pepper. remove from heat. mound stuffing in mushrooms and arrange, stuffing side up, in 13 x 9 inch baking dish. sprinkle with parmesan mixture. bake until heated through, about 9 minutes.

inputs: chicken, green grapes, almonds, celery, onion, celery salt, cholesterol free mayonnaise, lemon yogurt, white wine, mustard, eggs, salt, sugar, walnuts, bread crumbs
targets: title: chicken salad veronique ingredients: 3 c. cooked chicken, cubed 1 c. seedless green grapes, halved 1/2 c. toasted slivered almonds 1/2 c. chopped celery 3 tbsp. chopped onion 1/2 tsp. celery salt 1/3 c. cholesterol free mayonnaise 1/3 c. lemon yogurt 1 tbsp. dry white wine 1 tbsp. prepared mustard 7 eggs, separated salt 3/4 c. sugar 3/4 c. coarsely chopped walnuts 1/4 c. fine bread crumbs directions: on special occasions, this cake might be followed by a sweet dessert wine like a tokay aszii. this cake may also be made with hazelnuts simply substitute ground hazelnuts for walnuts. then, it is called magyoro torta in hungary.

inputs: hot pepper, bell pepper, sugar, white cider vinegar, bottle certo, coloring
targets: title: pepper jelly ingredients: 1 c. hot pepper 1 1/3 c. bell pepper 6 1/2 c. sugar 1 1/2 c. white cider vinegar 1 small bottle certo few drops green or red food coloring directions: seed peppers and grind or chop. mix pepper with sugar and vinegar. bring to a boil for 6 minutes, then add certo. prepare jars and lids for jelly. pour into jelly glasses and cap. wear gloves while preparing hot pepper.

inputs: broccoli, swiss cheese, pepper, onions, sour cream
targets: title: swiss vegetable medley ingredients: 16 oz. bag frozen combination broccoli, carrots and cauliflower 1 c. shredded swiss cheese 1/2 tsp. pepper 1 can french fried onions 1/3 c. sour cream directions: combine all ingredients in a two quart casserole dish, except 1/2 cheese and 1/2 onions. bake 30 minutes at 400 . top with remaining cheese and onions bake 5 more minutes.

inputs: coffee, coconut, water, chocolate, brown sugar, whipped cream
targets: title: science chocolate coffee mousse ingredients: 1 teaspoon 1 tablespoon of instant coffee i like nescafe gold blend 1 2 tablespoons coconut or coffee flavoured liqueur water, at room temperature 265 grams dark bittersweet chocolate, or a mixture of milk and dark 4 tablespoons of dark brown sugar, optional optional/to serve whipped cream, ducle de leche directions: dissolve the coffee in 1 2 tablespoons of hot water and then add the liqueur. top up with water at room temperature to make up one cup. place a large mixing bowl on top of another slightly smaller one, filled with ice and cold water the bottom of the large bowl should touch the ice . set aside. put chocolate, liquid coffee coconut mix and sugar in a medium sized pan and melt the chocolate over medium heat, whisking till melted. pour the melted chocolate into the mixing bowl sitting on top of ice and water from step 2 , and start whisking with a wire whisk or an electrical hand held mixer until thick. watch the texture as you whip and make sure not to over whip as it will make the mousse grainy. if the mousse becomes grainy, return it back into the pan, reheat until half of it is melted, pour it back to the mixing bowl and whisk again briefly. divide into four serving cups and serve with some whipped cream and a scoop of dulce de leche. it also makes a great frosting, thick, rich and smooth...if used and allowed to set for a couple of hours.

inputs: leeks, onion, butter, baking potatoes, carrot, chicken stock, salt, cream, milk
targets: title: vichyssoise ingredients: 4 leeks white part only , sliced 1/4 c. onion, chopped 1/4 c. butter 5 baking potatoes 1 carrot, diced 1 qt. chicken stock 1 tsp. salt 3 c. cream 2 c. milk directions: saute leeks and onion in butter until yellow. add potatoes, carrot, chicken stock and salt. bring to a rapid boil cover, reduce heat and simmer until potatoes and carrots are soft. mash and rub through a fine sieve. return to heat and add milk. season to taste and cool. add cream and chill thoroughly. serve with a sprinkling of finely chopped chives.

inputs: yeast, water, flour, extra virgin olive oil, basil, white wine, salt, pepper, water
targets: title: basil and sage bread recipe ingredients: 1 x yeast, dry, envelope 1 c. water, hot 105 115 5 1/2 c. all purpose flour 1/4 c. extra virgin olive oil 4 tsp basil, crumbled dry 1/4 tsp sage, crumbled dry 1/2 c. dry white wine 1 3/4 tsp salt 1/4 tsp pepper, freshly grnd 1/2 c. water, hot 105 115 directions: makes 2 baguettes. sprinkle yeast over 1 c. water in bowl of heavy duty electric mixer stir to dissolve. let stand 5 min. thoroughly fold in 1 1/2 c. flour. sprinkle 1/2 c. flour over dough. cover with towel. let rise in hot draft free area till doubled, about 1 1/2 hrs. heat oil in heavy small skillet over low heat. add in basil and sage and stir till aromatic, about 1 minute. cold. blend 1 c. flour, oil mix, wine, salt and pepper into dough, using dough hook. slowly add in remaining 1/2 c. water. stir in 2 1/2 c. flour 1/2 c. at a time. knead dough in mixer till smooth and resilient, about 10 min, adding more all purpose flour if sticky. grease large bowl. add in dough, turning to coat entire surface. cover bowl. let dough rise in hot draft free area till doubled, about 1 1/4 hrs. grease two baking sheets. punch dough down. divide in half. form each piece into 14 inch long loaf. place on prepared sheets, seam side down. let rise in hot draft free area till almost doubled, about 1 hour. preheat oven to 400 . slash tops of loaves with sharp knife. bake till breads sound hollow when tapped on bottom, about 50 min. cold on wire racks before serving.

inputs: cornstarch, cocoa, sugar, milk, egg yolks, orange, baking chocolate
targets: title: chocolate cr me br l e ingredients: 1/3 cup cornstarch 2 tbsp cocoa powder 3/4 cup sugar 3 1/8 cups milk 3 none large egg yolks 1 none medium orange 1.75 oz 70 dark baking chocolate, broken into pieces directions: combine cornstarch, cocoa and half the sugar in a medium saucepan. stir in enough of the milk to mix to a smooth paste. add egg yolks and whisk to combine. gradually whisk in the remaining milk. using a vegetable peeler, peel thin wide strips of zest from orange avoid white pith. add zest and chocolate to egg mixture. place pan over moderately high heat. cook and stir for 3 5 minutes or until mixture boils and thickens. strain through a sieve into a heatproof bowl. pour chocolate mixture into 6 ramekins or heatproof dishes. cover each ramekin with plastic wrap pressed against the chocolate mixture to prevent skin forming. place ramekins on a baking sheet and chill for 3 hours or until set. preheat the broiler to high. remove plastic wrap, sprinkle surface of each ramekin evenly with remaining sugar. broil for 2 3 minutes or until sugar melts and caramelizes. serve warm.

inputs: red beets, linguine, olive oil, garlic, salt, blue cheese, lemon juice, walnuts
targets: title: beets blues and greens linguine ingredients: 6 medium red beets, with greens 8 ounces linguine 1 t. olive oil, separated in half 2 3 cloves garlic, diced salt and pepper to taste 4 oz. blue cheese 1 t. lemon juice, separated in half optional 1/4 cup toasted chopped walnuts directions: 1. rinse and trim beets, dry with paper towels, and cut into 1/2 cubes. toss in one half of the olive oil, one half of the lemon juice, and salt and pepper until pieces are well coated. spread on a cookie sheet and roast at 450 for 20 minutes or until tender. 2. while beets are roasting, put on the water for the pasta. start the pasta cooking so that it s done when the beets are roasted. have a bowl to toss pasta waiting, with the blue cheese in the bottom. 3. rinse the beet greens, chop the tough stems, and slice the leaves into 2 strips. ten minutes before the beets are roasted, heat the remaining olive oil in a heavy saute pan, add the garlic and beet green stems and saute over medium heat for two minutes. add leaves to saute pan and cook over medium heat until just wilted. leaves should still be bright green. add salt and pepper to taste and remaining lemon juice. to serve layer sauteed greens in the bottom of a pasta serving dish. toss the linguine with the blue cheese until thorougly coated. layer over the greens, then top with the roast beets. top with walnuts if you like. enjoy

inputs: pretzels, butter, unflavored gelatin, liquid margarita, tequila, orange flavored liqueur, condensed milk
targets: title: margarita pie ingredients: 3 cup small pretzels, ground about 1 1/2 cups crumbs 2/3 cup butter or margarine, melted 1 envelope unflavored gelatin 1 cup liquid margarita mix, divided 1/3 cup tequila 5 tbsp orange flavored liqueur 2 can 14 ounces each sweetened condensed milk 2 to 3 drops green food coloring 1 lime slices for garnish directions: for crusts, combine pretzel crumbs and butter in a small bowl. press crumb mixture into bottom and up sides of two 8 inch pie pans. place in refrigerator to chill. in a microwave safe measuring cup, sprinkle unflavored gelatin over 1/4 cup margarita mix. let mixture stand 2 minutes. microwave on high power 100 40 seconds stir thoroughly. allow to stand 2 minutes or until gelatin is completely dissolved. in a large bowl, combine gelatin mixture, remaining 3/4 cup margarita mix, condensed milk, tequila, orange liqueur, and food coloring until well blended and smooth. divide filling equally between crusts chill until firm. garnish with lime slices. cover and refrigerate.

inputs: milk, egg substitute, broccoli, green peppers, cheese, scallions, dill, parmesan cheese
targets: title: broccoli quiche low fat ingredients: 1 c. skim milk 3/4 c. fat free egg substitute 2 c. chopped broccoli 1/2 c. diced green peppers 1/2 c. shredded reduced fat monterey jack cheese 3 scallions 2 tbsp. minced fresh dill 2 tbsp. grated parmesan cheese directions: in a large bowl, mix the milk and eggs. stir in the broccoli, peppers, monterey jack, scallions and dill. coat a 9 inch pie plate with nonstick spray. add the broccoli mixture. sprinkle with parmesan. bake at 375 for 30 minutes or until knife inserted in the center comes out clean and the quiche is lightly puffed and golden on top.

inputs: rice, onion, spring onion, carrots, french bean, eggs, praws, chicken breasts, soya sauce, light soya sauce, ground black pepper, ajinomoto, vegetable oil
targets: title: mixed fried rice ingredients: 250 grams rice non scented boiled 1 tbsp chopped onion 1 cup spring onion 1/4 cup carrots cubed in small pieces 1/4 cup french bean diced 2 eggs 50 grams praws, deveined 1/2 cup chicken breasts, julliene 1 tbsp dark soya sauce 1/2 tbsp light soya sauce 1/2 tbsp ground black pepper 1 tsp ajinomoto 1 tbsp vegetable oil directions: take a wok add a little oil. make the egg scrambled. set it aside. fry the chicken add salt. and set it aside. fry the prawns. till its pink. set it aside. take a wok add the vegetables and fry. take the boiled rice in a wok add 1,2,3 and 4 and stir. until all is mixed well in low flame. serve hot.

inputs: sweet white sorghum flour, white rice, brown rice flour, starch, oats, brown sugar, baking powder, xanthan gum, baking soda, salt, ground cinnamon, ground nutmeg, butter, apple, cinnamon flavored baking chips, low fat buttermilk, applesauce, white rice flour, egg, turbinado sugar
targets: title: cinnamon, apple, and oat scones ingredients: 4.2 ounces sweet white sorghum flour about 1 cup 1.3 ounces white rice flour about 1/4 cup 1.15 ounces brown rice flour about 1/4 cup 1.3 ounces potato starch about 1/4 cup 1 cup certified gluten free quick cooking oats 1/4 cup packed brown sugar 2 teaspoons baking powder 1 teaspoon xanthan gum 1 teaspoon baking soda 1/2 teaspoon salt 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg 5 tablespoons chilled unsalted butter, cut into small pieces 1 cup finely diced peeled granny smith apple 1/4 cup cinnamon flavored baking chips 1/2 cup low fat buttermilk 1/4 cup applesauce white rice flour, for dusting 1 egg white, lightly beaten 2 teaspoons turbinado sugar or granulated sugar directions: preheat oven to 400 . weigh or lightly spoon flours and potato starch into dry measuring cups level with a knife. combine flours, potato starch, oats, and next 7 ingredients through nutmeg in a large bowl, stirring with a whisk cut in butter with a pastry blender or 2 knives until mixture resembles coarse meal. stir in apple and baking chips. add buttermilk and applesauce stir just until moist. turn dough out onto a surface lightly dusted with white rice flour. pat dough into an 8 inch circle cut into 14 wedges. place wedges on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. brush egg white over surface of dough sprinkle with turbinado sugar. bake at 400 for 14 minutes or until golden brown. remove scones from baking sheet to a wire rack. serve warm.

inputs: pineapple, lemon juice, golden rum
targets: title: trader vic s babalu ingredients: 34 ounce pineapple grapefruit juice 12 ounce lemon juice 2 ounces golden rum directions: blend. serve in a 10 ounce glass. garnish with mint and a fruit stick. take a skewer and put your favorite fancy cut fruit on it . serve with malt straw.

inputs: chicken, dressing, onion soup, preserves
targets: title: sweet and sour chicken ingredients: 3 or 4 lb. chicken, cut up 1 bottle russian dressing 1 pkg. lipton onion soup 1 small jar smucker s apricot preserves directions: place chicken in baking dish. mix remaining ingredients and pour over chicken. bake for 1 hour at 350 , basting several times. serve gravy over rice.

inputs: spinach, cottage cheese, salt, parmesan cheese, eggs
targets: title: spinach casserole ingredients: 2 10 oz. pkg. frozen chopped spinach 2 c. cottage cheese 1 tsp. salt 1/2 c. parmesan cheese, grated 3 eggs directions: cook spinach and drain. combine spinach and cottage cheese, salt, parmesan cheese and eggs blend thoroughly. pour into a greased shallow casserole 7 x 11 inch . bake at 350 for 30 to 40 minutes. excellent for a brunch.

inputs: all purpose, baking powder, salt, lard, water
targets: title: home made tortillas ingredients: 4 cups all purpose flour 1 teaspoon baking powder 1/2 teaspoon salt 2 tablespoons lard 1/2 to 3/4 cup lukewarm water directions: combine flour, baking powder, salt in a glass bowl with hand. add lard to dry ingredients, mix with hand. add lukewarm water to form dough into ball. after forming ball, rub dough ball with a little lard. put ball in plastic bag and let rest for about 30 minutes. flour rolling surface and then pinch off balls of dough between index finger and thumb and shape into mushroom like balls. set aside. take each ball and pat each side on flour surface, roll out into flat round tortilla, cook on comal or griddle turning only once. the recipes for this program, which were provided by contributors and guests who may not be professional chefs, have not been tested in the food network s kitchens. therefore, the food network cannot attest to the accuracy of any of the recipes.

inputs: butternut squash, onion, olive oil, white wine, butter, milk, nutmeg powder, fennel seeds, bay leaf, coriander seeds
targets: title: spiced butternut squash soup ingredients: 1 butternut squash 1/2 onion 1/2 japanese leek 1 1/2 tbsp olive oil 50 ml white wine 1/2 tbsp butter 100 ml milk 1 dash nutmeg powder 1 dash fennel seeds 3 leaves bay leaf 1 dash coriander seeds directions: remove the seeds from the butternut squash, cut into easy to handle pieces, and scrape the skin off. cut it into 5 6 cm cubes. slice the onion thinly and the japanese leek into thin round slices. use the same amount of coriander seeds and fennel seeds. heat the olive oil and saute the onion and leek being careful not to burn it. add some salt and once the onions are transparent, add the butter. add the spices and saute until fragrant. scrape the bottom of the pan with a wooden spatula. pour in the white wine and boil off the alcohol. saute until the liquid evaporates. add the butternut squash, pour in water to cover the squash, and drop in the bay leaves. bring it to a boil, remove any scum, cover, and simmer over medium heat. once the butternut squash is tender, turn off the heat and wait until cool. in an electric mixer, blend the ingredients in 2 batches. return it to the pot, add the milk and season it with salt and nutmeg. pour it in a bowl, garnish it with some green, and bon appetit

inputs: brown mustard, apples, brown sugar, cheddar cheese
targets: title: washington state hot dog ingredients: 8 hot dogs, 8 to a pound 1 tablespoon dijon mustard or 1 tablespoon brown mustard 3 granny smith apples or 3 other tart apples, thinly sliced 14 cup brown sugar 12 cup coarsely grated cheddar cheese directions: preheat oven to 350 degrees. place hotdog in a baking dish. spread with mustard. spread apple slices over the hot dogs and sprinkle with brown sugar. bake for about 20 minutes, until the apples are tender. sprinkle grated cheese over the top of dish, replace in oven, and bake until cheese melts, about 5 minutes.

inputs: avocados, shredded lettuce, shrimp, alfalfa sprouts, tomatoes, lemon
targets: title: avocado shrimp boats recipe ingredients: 2 x soft avocados, peeled, halved, seeds removed 2 c. shredded lettuce 2 c. cooked shrimp, shelled and deveined 1 c. alfalfa sprouts 16 x cherry tomatoes halved parsley for garnish 1 x lemon cut into wedges french dressing directions: 1 on 4 salad plates, place avocado halfon bed of shredded lettuce, spoon 1/2 c shrimp into cavity of each. 2 arrange alfalfa sprouts and tomatoes on plate next to avocado. 3 garnish shrimp with parsley and lemon wedges. serve french dressing separtely.

inputs: rosemary, thyme, garlic, butter, mushrooms, carrot, flour, chicken broth, chicken thighs, onions, frozen peas, bread, oil
targets: title: chicken pot pie soup ingredients: 1 12 teaspoons rosemary, leaves crushed 1 12 teaspoons thyme leaves 1 teaspoon garlic powder 4 teaspoons butter, divided 1 8 ounce package mushrooms, sliced 1 cup carrot, sliced 12 cup flour 4 cups reduced sodium chicken broth 1 lb boneless chicken thighs, cut into 1 inch pieces 1 12 cups frozen pearl onions 1 cup frozen peas 8 bread, slices thin 1 teaspoon oil directions: mix rosemary, thyme and garlic powder in small bowl reserve 1/2 t. heat 1 t butter in large saucepan on medium heat. add mushrooms, carrots, and remaining seasoning mixture cook and stir 3 minutes. remove from saucepan set aside. melt remaining 3 t butter in saucepan on medium heat, stirring to release browned bits from bottom of skillet. sprinkle with flour cook and stir 3 4 minutes or until flour is lightly browned. gradually stir in broth until well blended. bring to a boil. reduce heat to low simmer 10 minutes or until slightly thickened, stirring occasionally. add vegetable mixture, chicken, pearl onions and peas simmer 8 minutes or until chicken is cooked through, stirring occasionally. meanwhile, cut bread into rounds with 3 inch cookie cutter. place on baking sheet. brush bread with oil and sprinkle with reserved seasoning mixture. bake in preheated oven 350 degrees f for 10 minutes or until toasted. to serve soup, ladle into soup bowls and top each with 1 crouton bread .

inputs: chicken breasts, mayonnaise, almond, red onions
targets: title: easy chilled chicken salad ingredients: 3 cups chopped cooked chicken breasts 3/4 cup kraft mayo with olive oil reduced fat mayonnaise 1/2 cup coarsely chopped almond, raisin, pistachios, cranberry and dried cherry fruit and nut mix 1/4 cup chopped red onions directions: combine all ingredients. refrigerate 30 min. serve spooned over torn mixed greens, or as a sandwich filling.

inputs: cornmeal, flour, sugar, eggs, buttermilk, corn oil, corn kernels
targets: title: corn cakes ingredients: 1 cup roasted cornmeal fine ground yellow cornmeal 1 cup self rising flour 4 tablespoons sugar 2 eggs 2 cups buttermilk 3 ounces corn oil 2 cups fresh corn kernels directions: place cornmeal, flour, and sugar in a bowl and mix together. in a separate bowl, combine eggs, buttermilk, corn oil, and fresh corn and mix together fold mixtures together. place 4 ounces of pancake mix onto a hot griddle. cook on medium high heat for 4 minutes on each side, until cooked through. this recipe was provided by professional chefs and has been scaled down from a bulk recipe provided by a restaurant. the fn chefs have not tested this recipe, in the proportions indicated, and therefore, we cannot make any representation as to the results.

inputs: flour, salt, pepper, shrimp, eggs, water, s angel
targets: title: coconut shrimp ingredients: 4 1/2 cups flour 1 1/4 tsp. salt 1 1/4 tsp. pepper cleaned shrimp with tails on 21 to 25 ct. 5 each eggs 2/3 cup water 1 qt. baker s angel flake coconut directions: mix flour, salt and pepper in shallow pan. add shrimp toss to coat. beat eggs with water in large bowl with wire whisk until well blended. dip shrimp in egg mixture, then add to coconut in bowl toss to coat. fry in deep fat fryer at 350f for 3 to 4 minutes or until shrimp are golden brown.

inputs: butter, sugar, corn syrup, water, peanuts, chocolate chips, peanuts
targets: title: peanut crunch ingredients: 1 c. butter or oleo 1 1/3 c. sugar 1 tbsp. corn syrup 3 tbsp. water 2 c. finely chopped roasted peanuts 12 oz. bag chocolate chips, melted 1 c. finely chopped roasted peanuts directions: cook butter, sugar, syrup and water in large saucepan on moderate heat until it reaches 300 or to hard crack stage. remove from heat quickly stir in nuts and spread in lightly buttered cookie sheet pan. cool. spread with melted chocolate use 1/2 for each side and sprinkle with crushed nuts 1/2 cup to each side . cool thoroughly until chocolate is firm. remove from pan, turn candy over and spread remaining chocolate and nuts on other side.

inputs: shortening, sugar, eggs, bananas, flour, baking soda, salt, nuts
targets: title: banana nut bread ingredients: 1/2 c. shortening 1 c. sugar 2 eggs 2 bananas 2 c. flour 1 tsp. baking soda 1 tsp. salt 1/4 c. chopped nuts directions: cream shortening until fluffy. gradually beat in sugar. add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each. beat in sifted dry ingredients. stir in crushed bananas and nuts. bake in a greased loaf pan at 350 for 50 to 60 minutes. slice and serve.

inputs: kidney beans, tomatoes, ground beef, salt, sugar, paprika, cayenne, cloves, bay leaf, chili powder
targets: title: al s chili ingredients: 2 15 1/2 oz. cans kidney beans 1 qt. stewed tomatoes 1 lb. ground beef 1/2 to 1 tsp. salt 1 tsp. sugar dash of paprika dash of cayenne 3 whole cloves 1 bay leaf 1 to 3 tsp. chili powder directions: brown the beef drain. mix all ingredients together. simmer for 30 minutes. can also be cooked in a crock pot, low 10 to 12 hours, high 5 to 6 hours.

inputs: ground beef, onion, salt, milk, cornstarch, pineapple tidbits, vinegar, soy sauce, green pepper, cracker crumbs, egg, ginger, shortening, brown sugar
targets: title: sweet and sour meatballs ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. ground beef 1/3 c. minced onion 1 1/2 tsp. salt 1/4 c. milk 2 tbsp. cornstarch 1 13 1/2 oz. can pineapple tidbits, drained reserve syrup 1/3 c. vinegar 1 tbsp. soy sauce or worcestershire sauce 1/3 c. chopped green pepper 2/3 c. cracker crumbs 1 egg 1/4 tsp. ginger 1 tbsp. shortening 1/2 c. brown sugar directions: mix beef, onion, salt, milk, cracker crumbs, egg and ginger together and form into small balls and brown in 1 tablespoon shortening. mix cornstarch, sugar and pineapple juice, vinegar and soy sauce. cook until mixture boils. pour over meatballs add pineapple and green pepper. heat and serve.

inputs: mashed sweet potatoes, sugar, eggs, oil, water, flour, nutmeg, cloves, soda, salt, raisins, nuts
targets: title: sweet potato bread ingredients: 2 c. mashed sweet potatoes 3 c. sugar 4 eggs 1 c. oil 2/3 c. water 3 1/2 c. flour 2 tsp. nutmeg 1/2 tsp. cloves 2 tsp. soda 1 tsp. salt 1 c. raisins optional 1 c. chopped nuts optional directions: boil and whip sweet potatoes ahead or use canned potatoes. cream the sugar, eggs and oil. add water to dry ingredients in separate bowl. gradually add to sugar mixture. blend in sweet potatoes. fold in nuts and raisins. grease and flour 2 9 x 5 inch pans. fill pans 2/3 full. bake at 325 for 1 hour and 15 minutes. makes 2 loaves.

inputs: flounder, onion, salt, potatoes, bacon strips
targets: title: baked flounder with potatoes ingredients: 1 flounder 4 to 5 lb. , cleaned 1 onion salt and pepper 6 potatoes, peeled and sliced 6 bacon strips directions: wash flounder and place in baking pan. slice potatoes and onion and place on top of flounder. salt and pepper to taste. place bacon strips on top of fish and potatoes. cover with foil and bake at 350 approximately 1 1/2 hours or until fish is flaky.

inputs: butter, english cheese spread, mayonnaise, garlic salt, crabmeat, muffins
targets: title: crab canapes ingredients: 1/4 lb. butter or margarine, softened 1 5 1/2 oz. jar old english cheese spread 1 1/2 tsp. mayonnaise 1/2 tsp. garlic salt 1 7 oz. can crabmeat 6 english muffins directions: blend butter, cheese spread, mayonnaise, garlic salt and crabmeat together. open muffins and spread crab mixture on muffin halves. cut each into quarters. place on cookie sheet and place under boiler until cheese bubbles. serve warm. serves 48 pieces.

inputs: bread, flour, genoa salami, mozzarella cheese, olive, olive oil
targets: title: cheat salami cheese bread ingredients: 2 lbs bread, loaf dough either frozen and thawed or refridgerated all purpose flour, for rolling dough 12 lb genoa salami, thinly sliced 12 lb shredded mozzarella cheese 12 cup greek olive, pitted and chopped 14 cup olive oil directions: heat oven to 350 and grease a baking sheet. on floured surface with floured rolling pin roll out 1lb loaf of dough into a 16x8 rectangle. spread 1/2 of salami over rectangle leaving 1/2in border on all sides. spread 1/2 of cheese over and then 1/2 of olives. starting from long side roll up until start to look like a french bread loaf. paint edges of dough with water and press to seal so cheese doesn t ooze out. repeat with remaining dough and ingredients. brush outside both loaves with olive oil, place seam side down on the prepared baking sheet leaving space between loaves for expansion. bake in preheated oven for 30 35 minues or until crusts are lightly golden. let the loaves cool on baking sheet that is on a wire rack for about 10 minutes before slicing.

inputs: lean ground beef, taco seasoning mix, water, jalapeno bean dip, shredded monterey jack cheese, cheddar cheese, green chilies, tomatoes, cheese flavored tortilla chips, guacamole, sour cream
targets: title: super nacho ingredients: 8 oz. lean ground beef 1/2 1 1/8 to 1 1/4 oz. pkg. taco seasoning mix about 2 tbsp. 1/2 c. water 1 10 1/2 oz. can jalapeno bean dip 1/2 c. shredded monterey jack cheese 1/2 c. shredded cheddar cheese 1 tbsp. chopped green chilies 1 c. shredded or chopped lettuce 2 medium tomatoes, chopped coarse 1 8 oz. pkg. cheese flavored tortilla chips 1/2 c. guacamole homemade or purchased 1/2 c. sour cream directions: in a large skillet, cook meat until browned drain. add seasoning mix and water. bring to a boil. reduce heat and simmer 15 to 20 minutes or until meat is cooked and flavors have blended. set aside. spread bean dip to cover bottom of a 12 to 14 inch pizza pan. sprinkle with cheeses. top with the meat mixture, then sprinkle with chilies. broil 5 to 7 minutes or until cheese is bubbly and brown. around edge of pan, arrange a border of lettuce, then tomatoes, then tortilla chips. place mound of guacamole topped with sour cream in center. makes 4 servings.

inputs: graham cracker, light cream cheese, splenda sugar substitute, instant chocolate, milk, topping
targets: title: cream cheese chocolate pudding dessert ingredients: graham cracker 8 ounces light cream cheese 8 ounces cool whip free 1 cup splenda sugar substitute 2 4 ounce boxes instant chocolate pudding mix 3 cups skim milk cool whip, for topping optional directions: lay a single layer of graham crackers in bottom of 13x9 in pan. mix together cream cheese, cool whip, and splenda. spread over top of the graham crackers. lay another layer of graham crackers over the cream cheese layer. using a whisk, mix both boxes of pudding mix with milk for 2 minutes. let sit until it firms up a little about 5 min . spread the pudding over 2nd layer of graham crackers. refrigerate for a couple hours and enjoy use a dollop of cool whip before serving.

inputs: bread, egg, sugar, milk, vanilla, cinnamon, butter
targets: title: french toast ii ingredients: 1 loaf texas toast thick bread, sliced 1 lb. 1 dozen egg 1/2 cup sugar 1 cup milk 1 teaspoon vanilla 2 tablespoons cinnamon, ground more if needed to taste butter or to taste shortening, to grease skillet directions: whisk the eggs till frothy. add remaining ingredients, and mix well. over medium heat, lightly grease skillet with shortening butter will burn very quickly, so exercise caution if using butter . i use a paper towel, so i can use it repeatedly, with every 2 or 3 pans of french toast. dip each slice of bread into the egg mixture, on both sides. do this quickly, so as not to completely soak the bread. cook in skillet over med/med high heat for approx 5 min per side. you may need to flip more than once to get th e desired golden brown color. serve with butter and powdered sugar, or preserves my favorite or syrup.

inputs: vegetable broth, tomatoes, dried lentils, yellow onion, chili powder, ground cumin, garlic, fresh ground black pepper, cayenne pepper
targets: title: vegan lentil taco meat ingredients: 3 cups vegetable broth 14 ounces, fluid canned diced tomatoes with juice 1 1/2 cup dried lentils, any variety i used beluga 1 whole yellow onion, chopped 1 tablespoon chili powder 2 teaspoons ground cumin 1/4 teaspoons garlic powder 1/4 teaspoons fresh ground black pepper 1 dash cayenne pepper directions: place all ingredients into your slow cooker and cook on low for 8 9 hours. serve in a tortilla, on nachos, in a taco salad, etc. nutrition info per 1/2 cup 83 calories, 0 g fat, 7 g protein, 13 g carbohydrates, 3 g fiber

inputs: butter, chicken breasts, coconut milk, curry powder, peanut butter, red bell pepper, peanuts
targets: title: thai chicken curry ingredients: 1 12 tablespoons butter or 1 12 tablespoons peanut oil 4 boneless chicken breasts, cubed 1 15 ounce can coconut milk or 1 15 ounce can light coconut milk 2 teaspoons curry powder 1 teaspoon thai seasoning, mix i use spice islands 2 tablespoons peanut butter 12 red bell pepper, sliced optional 14 cup peanuts, chopped directions: fry chicken breasts in butter or peanut oil. cube if not done already and return to pan to coat. add peppers and cook until tender firm. remove chicken and peppers. in pan, whisk together coconut milk, curry, thai seasoning, and peanut butter. simmer for 3 4 minutes. add chicken and peanuts. simmer for about 5 minutes. serve over rice.

inputs: eggs, salt, cream
targets: title: baked eggs ingredients: eggs salt and pepper cream directions: put the desired number of eggs in a shallow baking dish or pan. salt and pepper to taste. cover with cream. bake at 400 for 8 to 10 minutes. can bake biscuits at the same time.

inputs: flour, white sugar, baking powder, cocoa, salt, buttermilk, butter, eggs, vanilla, white vinegar, red velvet food coloring, cream cheese, butter, sugar, milk, vanilla, toppings, sugar, whipped cream, strawberries
targets: title: red velvet belgium waffles ingredients: waffles 2 cups all purpose flour 3 tablespoons white sugar 4 teaspoons baking powder 1 tablespoon unsweetened cocoa powder 3/4 teaspoon salt 1 3/4 cups buttermilk 1/3 cup melted butter, cooled 2 eggs 2 teaspoons vanilla extract 1/2 teaspoon white vinegar 1 tablespoon red velvet food coloring such as lorann professional kitchen r red velvet bakery emulsion or as desired glaze 6 ounces cream cheese, softened 6 tablespoons butter, softened 2 cups confectioners sugar 1/2 cup whole milk, or more as needed 1 teaspoon vanilla extract toppings 2 tablespoons confectioners sugar, or to taste optional 6 tablespoons whipped cream, or to taste optional 1 cup sliced strawberries, or to taste optional directions: whisk flour, white sugar, baking powder, cocoa powder, and salt together in a bowl. beat buttermilk, melted butter, eggs, 2 teaspoons vanilla extract, and vinegar together in a bowl until smooth. stir red food coloring into buttermilk mixture. mix buttermilk mixture into flour mixture until just combined. preheat a waffle iron according to manufacturer s instructions. beat cream cheese and softened butter together in a bowl using an electric mixer until smooth and fluffy. gradually mix 2 cups confectioners sugar into cream cheese mixture, alternating with milk and 1 teaspoon vanilla extract, until glaze is smooth. spoon 1/4 to 1/2 cup waffle batter into preheated waffle iron. cook according to manufacturer s directions. repeat with remaining batter. lightly dust each waffle with remaining confectioners sugar, drizzle with glaze, and top each with whipped cream and strawberries.

inputs: eggs, sugar, salt, gelatine, water, milk, white syrup, vanilla, milk
targets: title: ice cream ingredients: 6 eggs, well beaten 2 c. sugar dash of salt 2 pkg. gelatine knox 1/2 c. water 2 c. milk 1/2 c. white syrup 1 c. milnot 3 tbsp. vanilla or 2 tbsp. lemon milk to fill container directions: to well beaten eggs, beat in 2 cups sugar and dash of salt. dissolve the gelatine in 1/2 cup water. scald the 2 cups milk. add gelatine. beat into egg mixture along with syrup, milnot and vanilla. put into container and add milk to fill container.

inputs: confectioners sugar, cocoa, salt, milk, vanilla, butter, nuts
targets: title: 2 minute microwave fudge ingredients: 1 box confectioners sugar 1/2 c. cocoa 1/4 tsp. salt 1/4 c. milk 1 tbsp. vanilla 1/2 c. butter or margarine 1 c. chopped nuts directions: in a casserole, stir sugar, cocoa, salt, milk and vanilla. mixture will be stiff. cut butter over top. microwave on high for 2 minutes. stir vigorously until smooth. blend in nuts. pour into waxed paper lined loaf pan. chill one hour. cut into squares.

inputs: brown sugar, grapeseed oil, apple, almond milk, cornstarch, pumpkin, whole wheat flour, flour, flour, baking soda, baking powder, salt, ground cinnamon, ground nutmeg, ground allspice, ground cloves, water
targets: title: vegan pumpkin spice bread ingredients: 23 cup brown sugar 2 tablespoons grapeseed oil 12 medium apple, cooked with skin is fine, cored, or 3/8 c unsweeted applesauce 3 tablespoons almond milk 12 teaspoon cornstarch 1 cup cooked pumpkin drain off excess water 13 cup whole wheat flour 1 13 cups all purpose flour 1 12 tablespoons flour all flour totals 1 3/4 c 1 teaspoon baking soda 12 teaspoon baking powder 12 teaspoon salt 12 teaspoon ground cinnamon 12 teaspoon ground nutmeg if no nutmeg allspice, try cardamom 5spice 14 teaspoon ground allspice 14 teaspoon ground cloves i prefer 2x 3x this amount 3 4 tablespoons water less if homecooked pumpkin is slightly fluid directions: preheat oven to 350 deg f. combine flour, baking soda, and baking powder in a bowl. in a blender or food processor, combine all other ingredients until smooth. add the blended ingredients to the dry ingredients in the bowl. pour into a 9x5x3 loaf pan. i use glass do not grease . bake at 350 deg f for 60 min or untill done. cool for 10 minutes in the plan. then cool completely on wire rack. note if you live in a humid environment, reduce water accordingly, increase cooking time, and adjust baking powder as you are accustomed.

inputs: extra virgin olive oil, onions, red bell pepper, yellow bell pepper, pepper, garlic, serrano pepper, lean ground turkey, chili powder blend, paprika, ground cumin, kosher salt, tomatoes, chickpeas, cilantro
targets: title: chunky turkey and chickpea chili ingredients: 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil 2 medium onions, cut into 1/2 inch dice 1 red bell pepper, cut into 1/2 inch dice 1 yellow bell pepper, cut into 1/2 inch dice 1 poblano pepper, cut into 1/4 inch dice 3 garlic cloves, minced 1 serrano pepper, seeded and minced 1 1/2 pounds lean ground turkey 2 1/2 tablespoons chili powder blend 1 1/2 teaspoons smoked paprika 1 teaspoon ground cumin kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper one 28 ounce can whole peeled tomatoes, with their juices one 15 ounce can chickpeas, drained chopped cilantro, chopped scallion, diced avocado and sour cream, for serving directions: in a large soup pot, heat the olive oil. add the onions, bell peppers and poblano pepper and cook over moderately high heat, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 10 minutes. add the garlic and serrano and cook until softened, about 2 minutes. add the turkey to the pot and cook, breaking up any lumps with a spoon, until the meat is white throughout, about 4 minutes. stir in the chili powder, paprika, cumin, salt and pepper and cook until fragrant, about 2 minutes. add the tomatoes and chickpeas and bring to a simmer, breaking up the tomatoes with the spoon. simmer the chili over moderate heat until thickened, about 20 minutes. remove from the heat and let stand for 5 minutes. season with salt and pepper. ladle the chili into bowls, garnish with the cilantro, scallions, avocado and sour cream and serve.

inputs: black beans, yellow onion, cilantro, cumin, chili powder, salt, oil, sour cream, buttermilk, cilantro, lemon juice
targets: title: spicy black bean cakes with cilantro crema ingredients: 4 cups cooked black beans, drained or 4 cups rinsed and drained canned beans 1 jalapeno, with seeds,finely diced 1 large yellow onion, finely diced 12 bunch cilantro, minced 12 teaspoon cumin 12 teaspoon chili powder salt pepper, to taste oil, for frying 2 cups sour cream 12 cup buttermilk 12 bunch cilantro, minced 1 teaspoon lemon juice directions: place all bean cake ingredients, except oil, in a large mixing bowl and combine, partially mashing black beans hands are best for this . shape mixture into patties about 2 inches in diameter by 1 inch thick an ice cream scoop is and ideal measure for this size patty . fry over medium high heat in a lightly oiled, heavy bottomed pan, about 2 minutes per side, until cooked through. serve immediately with a generous scoop of avocado salsa and a generous drizzle of cilantro crema, if desired. for cilantro crema combine all ingredients until well blended. keep refrigerated until serving. makes 2 1/2 cups. .

inputs: butter, brown sugar, eggs, ground flax, honey, rolled oats, flour, cinnamon, baking soda, raisins, powdered sugar, water
targets: title: cinnamon granola bars ingredients: 1/4 cup butter softened 1 cup brown sugar, light packed 1 each eggs 2 tablespoons ground flax seed or 1 tbs. vegetable oil 2 tablespoons honey 2 cups rolled oats 1 cup flour, unbleached all purpose 1 teaspoon cinnamon 1/2 teaspoon baking soda 1/2 cup raisins, seedless 1 cup powdered sugar 2 tablespoons water directions: preheat oven to 350f 180c spray or grease an 11 x 7 baking dish. in a large bowl with electric mixer, beat butter and brown sugar until creamy, about 2 minutes. add the egg and beat well. stir in flax seed or vegetable oil and honey. in a small bowl, combine the oats, flour, cinnamon and baking soda stir into creamed mixture just until blended. gently stir in raisins. press mixture into prepared dish. bake for 14 to 18 minutes or until set and edges are lightly browned. cool on wire rack. glaze, if desired. cut into bars.

inputs: graham cracker crumbs, butter, condensed milk, coconut, chocolate chips, peanut butter, almonds
targets: title: almond coconut bars ingredients: 1 1/2 cups graham cracker crumbs 1/2 cup butter, melted 1 can 14 ounces sweetened condensed milk 1 package 7 ounces sweetened shredded coconut 2 cups 12 ounces semisweet chocolate chips 1/2 cup peanut butter 24 blanched almonds directions: in a small bowl, combine the graham cracker crumbs and butter. press into an ungreased 13 in. x 9 in. baking pan. combine milk and coconut carefully spread over crust. bake at 350 for 18 20 minutes or until lightly browned. in a microwave, combine the chocolate chips and peanut butter stir until smooth. microwave 30 60 seconds longer or until chips are melted stir until smooth. spread over warm bars. garnish with almonds. refrigerate for 1 hour before cutting.

inputs: soy sauce, rice wine vinegar, garlic, green onion, honey, ginger, chicken breast halves, breadcrumbs, unsalted peanuts, paprika, pepper
targets: title: asian peanut crusted chicken ingredients: 1/4 cup reduced sodium soy sauce 2 tablespoons rice wine vinegar 3 garlic cloves, minced 1 green onion, thinly sliced 1 tablespoon honey 1 teaspoon ginger, minced 4 4 ounce boneless skinless chicken breast halves 1/2 cup panko breadcrumbs japanese 1/4 cup unsalted peanuts, chopped 1/4 teaspoon paprika 1/4 teaspoon pepper directions: in a large resealable plastic bag, combine the first six ingredients add chicken. seal bag and turn to coat refrigerate for up to 4 hours. in another large resealable plastic bag, combine the bread crumbs, peanuts, paprika and pepper. drain and discard marinade. add chicken to crumb mixture, one piece at a time, and shake to coat. place in a 13 in. x 9 in. x 2 in. baking pan coated with cooking spray. bake, uncovered, at 350 for 25 30 minutes or until juices run clear.

inputs: green beans, cream of mushroom soup, salt, onion rings
targets: title: green bean casserole ingredients: 1 15 1/2 oz. green beans 1 can cream of mushroom soup salt and pepper to taste 1 small can onion rings directions: drain beans. mix in soup and season to taste with salt and pepper. place in small casserole. bake at 350 until bubbly. top with onion rings. garnish with a little chopped pimento. makes approximately 4 servings.

inputs: flour, cornstarch, baking powder, salt, xanthan, milk, corn oil
targets: title: gluten free pizza ingredients: 1 cup gluten free flour 1/2 cup cornstarch 1 tsp baking powder 1/4 tsp salt 1 tsp xanthan gum 3/4 cup milk 1/4 cup corn oil directions: preheat the oven to 425 combine dry ingredients stir in milk and oil spread on to baking pan to form a circle 1/4 of an inch thick cook for 14 minutes or until lightly browned around the edge. remove from oven and add toppings sauce, cheese, etc bake 5 to 7 minutes or until cheese is bubbly enjoy

inputs: egg yolk, heavy cream, vanilla, unsalted butter, sugar, salt, flour
targets: title: spritz cookies with variations america s test kitchen ingredients: 1 large egg yolk 1 tablespoon heavy cream 1 teaspoon vanilla extract 16 tablespoons unsalted butter, softened but still cool 2 sticks 2/3 cup sugar about 4 3/4 ounces 1/4 teaspoon salt 2 cups unbleached all purpose flour 10 ounces directions: adjust an oven rack to the middle position heat the oven to 375 f in a small bowl, beat the egg yolk, cream, and vanilla with a fork until combined set aside. in a standing mixer, cream the butter, sugar, and salt at medium high speed until light and fluffy, 3 to 4 minutes. scrape down the bowl with a rubber spatula. with the mixer running at medium speed, add the yolk cream mixture and beat until incorporated, about 30 seconds. scrape down the bowl. with the mixer running at low speed, gradually beat in the flour until combined. scrape down the bowl and give a final stir with the rubber spatula to ensure that no flour pockets remain. if using a cookie press to form the cookies, follow the manufacturer s instructions to fill the press if using a pastry bag see technique below . press or pipe cookies onto ungreased baking sheets, spacing them about 1 1/2 inches apart. bake, one sheet at a time, until the cookies are light golden brown, 10 to 12 minutes, rotating the baking sheet halfway through the baking time. cool the cookies on the baking sheet until just warm, 10 to 15 minutes using a metal spatula, transfer them to a wire rack and cool to room temperature. for lemon spritz cookies follow the recipe for spritz cookies, adding 1 teaspoon lemon juice to the yolk cream mixture in step 1 and adding 1 teaspoon finely grated lemon zest to the butter along with the sugar and salt in step 2. for almond spritz cookies grind 1/2 cup sliced almonds and 2 tablespoons of the flour called for in spritz cookies in a food processor until powdery and evenly fine, about 1 minute combine the almond mixture with the remaining flour. follow the recipe for spritz cookies, substituting 3/4 teaspoon almond extract for the vanilla. technique filling a pastry bag 1 make a c shape with one hand and hold the piping bag. fold the bag over that hand about halfway down, insert the tip, and scrape the dough into the bag. 2 when the bag is about half full, pull up the sides, push down the dough, and twist tightly while again pushing down on the dough to squeeze out any air. 3 grab the bag at the base of the twist. using the other hand as a guide, hold the top at a 90 degree angle about 1/2 inch above the baking sheet and squeeze to form the shape.

inputs: olive oil, skinless, eggplant, onions, carrots, cranberries, apricots, chicken broth, tomato paste, lemon juice, flour, garlic salt, ground cumin, ground ginger, cinnamon, ground black pepper, water, couscous
targets: title: chicken tagine ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive oil 8 skinless, boneless chicken thighs, cut into 1 inch pieces 1 eggplant, cut into 1 inch cubes 2 large onions, thinly sliced 4 large carrots, thinly sliced 1/2 cup dried cranberries 1/2 cup chopped dried apricots 2 cups chicken broth 2 tablespoons tomato paste 2 tablespoons lemon juice 2 tablespoons all purpose flour 2 teaspoons garlic salt 1 1/2 teaspoons ground cumin 1 1/2 teaspoons ground ginger 1 teaspoon cinnamon 3/4 teaspoon ground black pepper 1 cup water 1 cup couscous directions: heat olive oil in a skillet over medium high heat. place the chicken pieces and eggplant in the heated oil stir and cook until the chicken is browned on all sides but not cooked through. remove the skillet from the heat. place the browned chicken and eggplant on the bottom of a slow cooker. layer the onion, carrots, dried cranberries, and apricots over the chicken. whisk together the chicken broth, tomato paste, lemon juice, flour, garlic salt, cumin, ginger, cinnamon, and ground black pepper in a bowl. pour the broth mixture into the slow cooker with the chicken and vegetables. cook on high setting for 5 hours, or on low setting for 8 hours. bring water to boil in a saucepan. stir in couscous, and remove from heat. cover, and let stand about 5 minutes, until liquid has been absorbed. fluff with a fork.

inputs: broccoli floret, cauliflower floret, mushroom, onion, tomatoes, cheddar cheese, ranch dressing, whole wheat pita bread, cheese
targets: title: summer time veggie pita melt ingredients: 1/4 cup broccoli floret 1/4 cup cauliflower floret 1/4 cup mushroom optional 1/4 cup onion, chopped 1 tomatoes, chopped shredded cheddar cheese ranch dressing 1 whole wheat pita bread cheese, optional your favorite directions: cook broccoli and cauliflower till desired tenderness. drain and put into bowl. add mushrooms, if desired. cut and open a pita bread and stuff veggies inside. pour about 2 to 3 tablespoon ranch dressing inside. top with the onion, chopped tomato and the cheddar cheese. close pita secure top with tooth pick. micro wave for about 30 to 40 seconds till. everything is hot and cheese begins to melt.

inputs: butter, ground chuck, macaroni, salt, butter, milk, eggs, parmesan cheese
targets: title: pastitso macaroni meat casserole ingredients: 1 cup butter, melted and separated 1 12 lbs ground chuck 1 12 lbs elbow macaroni salt pepper 1 cup butter, melted 3 cups milk 9 eggs 1 lb parmesan cheese directions: macaroni mixture melt 1/2 cup butter in skillet and add ground chuck. stir until brown, adding salt and pepper to taste. set this mixture aside. boil macaroni until almost done, drain well, and put in large bowl. stir in other 1/2 cup melted butter set aside. grease bottom and sides of pan 11 x 14 x 2 inch . put 1/2 macaroni mixture into pan. then cover macaroni with all of ground chuck mixture and top with remaining macaroni. set aside. crema sauce beat eggs until smooth, then stir in melted butter and milk. slowly mix in parmesan cheese. mix all ingredients well and spread over macaroni mixture, making sure it goes through the mixture. bake 1 hour or until brown. let stand about 15 minutes then cut in squares. secret this may be frozen and warmed again to serve.

inputs: rice, soy sauce, sugar, nori
targets: title: spam musubi ingredients: 1 12 ounce can spam 3 cups uncooked sushi rice, prepared as directed soy sauce sugar seasoning see directions nori directions: seasoning is furikake or li hing mui. i have a stick of umami at home that you grate over food. don t know what s in it. cut spam in 8 10 slices. start frying. mix equal amounts of soy sauce and sugar. pour over spam as it is frying to make extra crispy. fry to desired crispness. use a musubi mold to construct musubi or improvise. on sheet of nori, layer one scoop of rice, sprinkle of seasoning, slice of spam, sprinkle of seasoning, scoop of rice and pack tightly into a nice rectangle the size of the spam. wrap nori around and seal with some rice.

inputs: onions, green peppers, olive oil, butter, tomatoes, thin spaghetti, oil, butter, flour, milk, cream, cheddar cheese, mushroom, black olives
targets: title: spaghetti casserole ingredients: 2 onions, chopped 2 green peppers, chopped 2 tablespoons olive oil 2 tablespoons butter or 2 tablespoons margarine 1 28 ounce canpeeled tomatoes 1 lb thin spaghetti 1 tablespoon oil 3 tablespoons butter 3 tablespoons flour 1 cup milk 1 cup cream 1 cup roughly cut cheddar cheese 12 lb mushroom, sliced 14 cup black olives directions: saute onions and peppers in oil and butter until limp. add tomatoes and simmer 30 minutes. cook spaghetti according to package directions. toss with oil and set aside. preheat oven to 325 degrees. make a cream sauce by melting butter and stirring in flour until smooth and bubbly. gradually stir in milk and cream stirring until thickened. add cheese, stirring until cheese melts. set aside. toss spaghetti, mushrooms, olives and tomato sauce together and place in baking dish. cover with cream sauce and bake 45 minutes.

inputs: brown jasmine rice, cinnamon, salt, ghee, garlic, garam masala, onion
targets: title: aromatic brown jasmine rice ingredients: 2 cups uncooked brown jasmine rice, rinsed and drained 1 cinnamon stick 1/2 tsp. salt, divided 1 tbs. ghee clarified butter or vegetable oil 2 cloves garlic, minced 2 tsp. 1 tsp. garam masala 1 small onion, diced 1 cup 1 cup fresh or frozen green peas directions: combine rice, 3 1/4 cups water, cinnamon stick, and 1/4 tsp. salt in large saucepan. bring to a boil over high heat. reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer gently 35 minutes, or until rice is tender and all liquid is absorbed. heat ghee in large skillet over medium heat until hot. add garlic and garam masala, and heat 15 seconds. add onion and remaining 1/4 tsp. salt. reduce heat to low, and cook 5 minutes, or until onion is translucent, stirring occasionally. add peas, and cook 2 minutes more. remove cinnamon stick from rice. stir rice into onion mixture, and cook 2 to 3 minutes more. transfer to serving dish, and fluff rice with fork.

inputs: lime jello, pineapple, cottage cheese
targets: title: dump salad ingredients: 1 small pkg. lime jello 1 12 oz. container cool whip 1 small can crushed pineapple, drained 1 large container cottage cheese directions: mix all ingredients together until all blended. cover and refrigerate approximately 4 hours. options orange jello and mandarin oranges.

inputs: apples, raisins, sugar, cinnamon, egg, flour, butter, sugar, salt, pecans
targets: title: swedish apple pie ingredients: 4 cups apples, peeled and thinly sliced 14 cup raisins 1 teaspoon sugar 1 teaspoon cinnamon 1 egg, beaten 1 cup flour 34 cup butter, melted 12 cup sugar 1 dash salt 14 cup pecans, chopped directions: preheat oven to 350 degrees . put apples in 9 in pie plate. in small bowl combine raisins, 1 tsp sugar and cinnamon. sprinkle over apples. in medium bowl combine egg, flour, butter, 1/2 cup sugar and salt. spread over apples in pie plate. sprinkle with chopped pecans. bake 40 45 minutes or til apples are tender. serve warm.

inputs: honey, semisweet chocolate, bittersweet chocolate, butter, powdered sugar, dark rum, chocolate sprinkles, coarse
targets: title: valentine s day truffles ingredients: 1/3 cup honey 1/2 cup 4 ounces semisweet chocolate, cut into small pieces 1/2 cup 4 ounces bittersweet chocolate, cut into small pieces 1 stick butter, cut into small pieces 2 cups powdered sugar, sifted 2 tablespoons dark rum 1 cup chocolate sprinkles, for rolling 3/4 teaspoon coarse but somewhat small size sea salt directions: in a small skillet, simmer the honey until it becomes medium brown in color and has a light, caramel scent. remove from heat and keep warm. in a medium bowl, combine the 2 types of chocolate and butter. place the bowl over a pot of simmering water and melt the chocolate, making sure to stir often. once the chocolate has completely melted remove the bowl from the heat and whisk in the caramelized honey, rum and powdered sugar. transfer mixture to a cool bowl and allow it to set a little, about 5 minutes. combine the sprinkles and salt in a bowl. using your hands roll the chocolate mixture into small balls, about 1 inch in diameter. roll them in the chocolate sprinkle/salt mixture until they are generously coated. place on serving tray or store them in an airtight container.

inputs: angel food cake, milk, lemon juice, strawberries
targets: title: heavenly delight ingredients: 10 oz. angel food cake 1 can eagle brand milk 1/4 c. lemon juice 1 large container cool whip 2 1/2 c. sliced strawberries directions: break cake into bite size pieces. mix milk and lemon juice together. mix cool whip with lemon milk mixture. gently fold in strawberries. mix with cake until cake is coated. store in refrigerator 6 hours or overnight.

inputs: butter, flour, sugar, egg, baking powder
targets: title: fruit cobbler ingredients: 6 tbsp. butter 1 cup plain flour 1 cup sugar 1 egg 1 tsp. baking powder 2 cups sweetened fruit any kind you desire directions: grease 2 10 inch pie plates and put sweetened fruit on bottom. cover with the above mixture and bake at 350 for 30 to 40 minutes. use 2 deep dish pie plates. serves 4 to 6.

inputs: head lettuce, green pepper, red onion, frozen petite peas, tomato, apple cider vinegar, water, sugar, cheese, sugar, onion powder, garlic salt, italian seasoning, parmesan cheese, bacon bits
targets: title: seven layer salad ingredients: 1/2 head lettuce, shredded 1 green pepper, chopped, 1 1/2 c. sliced cucumbers or 4 stalks sliced celery 1/2 c. red onion, sliced 2/3 c. frozen petite peas 1 1/2 c. chopped tomato 2 tsp. apple cider vinegar 2 tsp. water 1 tsp. sugar 1 c. nonfat cottage cheese 3 tsp. sugar 1/4 tsp. onion powder 1/4 tsp. garlic salt 1 tsp. italian seasoning 2 tbsp. parmesan cheese 1 tbsp. bacon bits directions: layer vegetables in a large bowl. mix vinegar, water and 1 teaspoon sugar and pour over salad. blend cottage cheese until creamy. add sugar and spices. blend well. spread mixture over salad. sprinkle with cheese and bacon bits.

inputs: pastry, pork sausage, eggs, swiss cheese, cheddar cheese, eggs, light cream, salt, pepper
targets: title: egg sausage quiche ingredients: pastry for one 9 inch pie 8 oz. bulk pork sausage 4 hard cooked eggs, chopped 1 c. 4 oz. shredded natural swiss cheese 1 c. 4 oz. shredded natural cheddar cheese 3 beaten eggs 1 1/4 c. light cream or milk 3/4 tsp. salt 1/8 tsp. pepper directions: line a 9 inch pie plate with pastry flute edges. do not prick. bake in a 350 oven for 7 minutes. in skillet, cook sausage drain well. sprinkle hard cooked eggs in bottom of pie shell. top with sausage and cheese. combine beaten eggs, cream, salt and pepper pour over all. bake in a 350 oven for 30 to 35 minutes, or until set. let stand 10 minutes before serving. makes 6 servings. a 1976 recipe.

inputs: butter, flaked coconut, butterscotch, nuts, vanilla wafers, semi sweet chocolate bits, condensed milk
targets: title: hello dollies or layer bars ingredients: 1/2 to 1 stick butter or margarine 1 3 1/2 oz. can flaked coconut 1 6 oz. pkg. butterscotch pieces can substitute peanut butter and white chocolate for variety 1 c. chopped nuts 1 c. crushed vanilla wafers or graham crackers 1 6 oz. pkg. semi sweet chocolate bits 1 can sweetened condensed milk eagle brand directions: melt butter in 9 x 12 x 2 inch baking pan. sprinkle crumbs over butter sprinkle coconut over crumbs. layer chocolate bits, butterscotch pieces and nuts over crumbs. pour condensed milk over nuts. bake at 325 to 350 for 30 minutes. cut into squares while warm. yield 2 dozen.

inputs: rolls, mustard, pastrami, swiss cheese, egg, poppy seed
targets: title: pastrami braids ingredients: 8 ounces refrigerated crescent dinner rolls 4 teaspoons dijon mustard 4 ounces pastrami, thinly sliced, cut into 1/2 inch strips 1 cup swiss cheese, shredded 1 egg, beaten 1 teaspoon poppy seed directions: heat oven to 375. unroll dough and separate into 4 rectangles. place on ungreased cookie sheet. press into 6x4 inch rectangle, firmly pressing perforations to seal. spread mustard lengthwise down center of each rectangle in 1 1/2 inch strip. top each with pastrami and cheese. on long sides of each rectangle, make 7 cuts at an angle and about 3/4 inch apart almost to edge of filling. for braided appearance, fold strips of dough at an angle halfway across filling with ends of strips slightly overlapping, alternating from side to side. brush tops with egg. sprinkle with poppy seeds. bake 11 16 minutes. immediately remove from cookie sheet. serve warm.

inputs: tomatoes, onion, garlic, carrot, bayleaves, salt, fresh basil, balsamic vinegar, olive oil, sourcream
targets: title: tomato soup from fresh tomatoes ingredients: 1000 grams ripe tomatoes 1 onion 3 cloves of garlic 1 small carrot 2 bayleaves salt, pepper to taste fresh basil 1 dash balsamic vinegar olive oil 1 tablespoon sourcream directions: wash and dry the tomatoes, then chop them roughly. try to squeeze out excess water and seeds. peel onion, garlic and carrot. finely slice onion and garlic cloves and grate the carrot. in a soup pot, heat olive oil, then add onions and lightly fry them until translucent. add grated carrots and garlic, stir fry for about a minute or two, until the carrots tenderize. then, add in chopped tomatoes and a dash of balsamic vinegar, stir well and let it cook down for a few minutes, stirring regularly. add vegetable stock, bayleaves and season to taste with salt pepper. bring to a boil, then lower the heat and cook for about 15 minutes. when the tomatoes are cooked, remove the pot from heat, then remove the bayleaves and blend into a smooth soup with a stick blender. roughly chop basil leaves and add to the soup for taste and garnish, add a teaspoon of sour cream and serve.

inputs: turkey, pimentos, green pepper, onion, condensed cream, turkey broth, salt, pepper, cheddar cheese
targets: title: susan s turketti ingredients: 1 1/4 c. spaghetti, broken into 2 inch pieces 1 1/2 to 2 c. cut up, cooked or canned turkey chicken or cooked veal 1/4 c. diced pimentos 1/4 chopped green pepper 1/2 chopped small onion 1 can condensed cream of mushroom soup undiluted 1/2 c. turkey broth or water 1/2 tsp. salt 1/8 tsp. pepper 1 3/4 c. grated sharp cheddar cheese about 1/2 lb. directions: cook spaghetti as package directs drain. place turkey, pimentos, green pepper and onion in 1 1/2 quart casserole. pour in mushroom soup and turkey broth add salt, pepper, 1 1/4 cups of grated cheese and spaghetti. with two forks, lightly toss until all is well mixed and coated with sauce. sprinkle remaining 1/2 cup grated cheese on top of turkey mixture refrigerate.

inputs: polenta, flour, baking powder, caster sugar, butter, water, strawberries, icing sugar
targets: title: strawberry and yoghurt cake ingredients: 200 g polenta 200 g self rising flour 1 teaspoon baking powder 275 g caster sugar 110 g butter, melted 500 g natural yoghurt 200 ml water, warm 600 g strawberries 14 cup icing sugar directions: preheat oven to 170c. mix dry ingredients and add melted butter, 300g yoghurt and water and beat until smooth. stir through 250g chopped strawberries and pour into 20cm springform prepared cake pan. bake for 2 hours or until springy in the centre. remove from oven and cool 15 mins before removing. when cool top with remaining yoghurt and strawberries. dust with icing sugar.

inputs: condensed milk, frozen limeade, food coloring
targets: title: key lime pie ingredients: 1 can eagle brand sweetened condensed milk 1 small can frozen limeade, thawed 1 8 oz. cool whip food coloring if desired directions: mix condensed milk and limeade, then add cool whip and a couple drops green food coloring. mix well. pour into 2 graham cracker crusts. refrigerate several hours before serving. garnish with lime slices before serving.

inputs: shrimp, chili sauce, worcestershire sauce, fresh horseradish, lemon juice, cream cheese, crackers
targets: title: spicy shrimp dip ingredients: 2 c. cooked chopped shrimp 2 bottles heinz chili sauce 4 tbsp. worcestershire sauce 4 tbsp. fresh horseradish 2 tbsp. lemon juice 8 oz. pkg. cream cheese crackers directions: cook, peel and chop shrimp into small bite size pieces, enough to make 2 cups set aside. mix chili sauce, worcestershire sauce, horseradish found in the dairy products at most grocers and lemon juice. place cream cheese on platter. mix shrimp into sauce and pour over cream cheese. chill. serve with your favorite crackers.

inputs: soy sauce, vegetable oil, lemon juice, onions, sugar, black pepper, fresh spinach, fresh bean sprouts, water chestnuts, fresh mushrooms, bacon, sesame seeds, tomatoes
targets: title: spicy oriental spinach salad ingredients: 14 cup soy sauce 12 cup vegetable oil or 12 cup canola oil 2 tablespoons lemon juice 1 12 tablespoons minced onions 12 teaspoon sugar 12 teaspoon black pepper 1 lb fresh spinach, washed and torn 1 cup fresh bean sprouts or 1 can bean sprouts 1 4 ounce can water chestnuts, drained and rinsed 1 cup fresh mushrooms, cleaned and sliced thin 12 lb bacon, cooked and crumbled 13 cup sesame seeds, lightly toasted tomatoes, cut up optional directions: make the dressing at least a few hours in advance to meld the flavors. combine all the dressing ingredients and mix well. refrigerate. pour boiling water over the bean sprouts let stand a few minutes and drain. mix all the salad ingredients together and chill until serving. just before serving, toss with dressing.

inputs: ground squash, onions, salt, cider vinegar, sugar, nutmeg, mustard, turmeric, cornstarch, celery, black pepper
targets: title: squash relish ingredients: 10 c. ground squash yellow or zucchini may be used 4 medium onions 5 tbsp. salt 2 1/4 c. cider vinegar 4 to 5 c. sugar 1 tbsp. nutmeg 1 tbsp. dry mustard 1 tbsp. mustard seed 1 tbsp. turmeric 1 tbsp. cornstarch 2 tbsp. celery seed 1/2 tbsp. black pepper directions: let first 3 ingredients set overnight in refrigerator. rinse well using colander. add remaining ingredients. grind 2 bell peppers. bring quickly to a boil and simmer 30 minutes. place in sterilized, hot pint jars and seal. makes 7 pints. this relish is great with meats and veggies.

inputs: boiling water, salt, corn meal, butter, eggs, milk, baking powder
targets: title: spoon bread ingredients: 2 c. boiling water 1 tsp. salt 3/4 c. corn meal 3 tbsp. butter 2 eggs, separated 2/3 c. evaporated milk 1 tsp. baking powder directions: add corn meal to boiling salted water. wait until thick and add butter. beat egg yolks. add to milk, then stir into corn meal. fold in stiffly beaten egg whites and baking powder. bake in buttered dish at 375 for 40 minutes.

inputs: flour, salt, baking soda, baking powder, butter, white sugar, light brown sugar, eggs, bananas, vanilla, nuts, cinnamon sugar
targets: title: insane banana nut bread ingredients: 2 cups flour 1 teaspoon salt 2 teaspoons baking soda 1 teaspoon baking powder 1 cup butter or 1 cup margarine 1 cup white sugar 1 cup light brown sugar 4 eggs 2 cups ripe bananas, mashed 1 teaspoon vanilla 1 cup nuts, chopped cinnamon sugar mixture optional directions: sift the flour, salt, baking soda, and baking powder into a large bowl. in a separate bowl, cream the butter, white sugar, and brown sugar. add eggs, one at a time, mixing after each addition. mix in mashed bananas and vanilla. mix dry ingredients into wet ingredients in 3 batches. stir just until blended. stir in nuts. pour into two greased and floured 9 x 5 inch loaf pans. top with cinnamon sugar mixture optional . bake at 350 degrees fahrenheit for 55 to 60 minutes or until knife inserted into the middle comes out clean. cool loaves in pans on wire rack for 5 to 10 minutes. turn out onto a cooling rack cool completely. wrap in aluminum foil when cool. refrigerate the loaves for 2 hours or more before serving.

inputs: unflavored gelatin, pickled beet liquid, salt, onion, pickled beets, celery
targets: title: zippy beet salad ingredients: 1 envelope unflavored gelatin 2/3 c. pickled beet liquid 1/2 tsp. salt 1/4 tsp. grated onion 1 c. chopped pickled beets 1 c. finely chopped celery directions: soften gelatin in 1/2 cup cold water in saucepan. heat, stirring over low heat until gelatin dissolves. add enough water to beet juice to make 1 1/2 cups liquid. add salt and onion chill until partially set. stir in beets and celery put in mold and serve on lettuce leaf.

inputs: extra virgin olive oil, lemon juice, shallots, garlic, capers, flat leaf parsley, anchovy, freshly ground black pepper, fresh basil
