targets: title: tapenade ingredients: 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice 1 tablespoon shallots minced 1 tablespoon minced garlic 1 tablespoon capers drained 1 tablespoon fresh flat leaf parsley chopped 4 anchovy fillets 1/8 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper 1 tablespoon fresh basil chopped directions: combine all the ingredients except the basil in the bowl of a food processor. puree and then transfer to a bowl. fold in the basil and set aside until needed, up to two hours, or refrigerate for up to three days in an airtight container.

inputs: milk, butter, sugar, marshmallows, nuts, semi sweet chocolate chips, vanilla
targets: title: 5 minute carnation fudge ingredients: 2/3 c. undiluted evaporated milk 1 tbsp. butter 1 2/3 c. sugar 2 c. miniature marshmallows 1/2 c. chopped nuts 1 1/2 c. semi sweet chocolate chips 1 tsp. vanilla directions: combine and boil for 5 minutes the evaporated milk, butter and sugar. remove from heat and add the marshmallows, nuts, chips and vanilla. stir until marshmallows and chips are melted. pour into 8 or 9 inch buttered, square pan. when cooled, cut into squares and serve.

inputs: olive oil, fresh ripe peaches, lime, mixed salad greens, red onion, sugar snap peas, mint, feta cheese, fresh ground black pepper
targets: title: peaches and mint feta cheese salad ingredients: 1 teaspoon olive oil 4 fresh ripe peaches, stoned and cut into wedges lime, juice and zest of 200 g mixed salad greens 1 small red onion, halved and thinly sliced 150 g sugar snap peas, halved lengthways 2 tablespoons chopped of fresh mint 200 g feta cheese, roughly crumbled fresh ground black pepper directions: brush a ridged griddle pan, with half of the oil and heat until slightly smoking. toss the peaches in the lime juice, place flesh side down onto the griddle and cook for 2 3 minutes until charred. in a large bowl toss together any remaining oil and lime juice, and the lime zest, salad leaves, onion, sugar snap peas and mint. divide between 4 bowls or serving plates. scatter over the peaches and the feta cheese. season with a good scattering of freshly ground black pepper and serve warm.

inputs: flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, salt, walnuts, egg, egg yolk, sour cream, unsalted butter, milk, vanilla, sugar, walnuts, ground cinnamon
targets: title: prune sour cream muffins ingredients: 2 cups all purpose flour 1 1/4 cups sugar 2 teaspoons baking powder 1 teaspoon baking soda 3/4 teaspoon salt 1 cup prune, pitted and chopped 1/2 cup walnuts, chopped 1 large egg 1 large egg yolk 1 cup sour cream 6 tablespoons unsalted butter, melted 2 tablespoons milk 1 teaspoon vanilla extract 2 tablespoons sugar 2 tablespoons walnuts, finely chopped 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon directions: preheat oven to 400 f. generously butter 12 muffin cups or line with paper cups. sift flour, sugar,baking powder, soda and salt into a large bowl. add prunes and 1/2 cup walnuts stir to combine. whisk egg and yolk together in a medium bowl. add sour cream, butter, milk and vanilla, stirring until smooth. make a well in center of flour mixture. add egg mixture and stir until just combined. divide batter among prepared cups. combine the 2 tablespoons sugar, 2 tablespoons walnuts and cinnamon together. sprinkle each muffin with tipping. bake until tester inserted into centers comes out clean, about 25 minutes.

inputs: lime, boiling water, cheese, pineapple, whipped whipping cream, maraschino cherries
targets: title: lime jello salad ingredients: 1 small pkg. lime jell o 1 c. boiling water 1 c. small curd cottage cheese 1 9 oz. crushed and drained pineapple 1 c. whipped whipping cream 1/2 pt. whip cream maraschino cherries, sliced in half directions: combine jell o and boiling water. let cool 15 minutes at least. add cottage cheese. fold in crushed and drained pineapple and whipped cream. add sliced maraschino cherries on top.

inputs: tomatoes, garlic, peppers, cumin powder, cilantro, white onion, lime, salt
targets: title: restaurant style salsa ingredients: 1 28 ounce can diced tomatoes 4 unpeeled garlic cloves 2 jalapeno peppers 1 teaspoon cumin powder 1/2 bunch cilantro 1/2 white onion 1 lime, juice of 2 teaspoons salt directions: pan roast with, no oil, the unpeeled garlic cloves and jalapeno peppers on medium high until skins are darkened on all sides. about 5 minutes for the jalapenos and 8 10 minutes for the garlic. peel garlic and add to food processor with jalapeno and onion. process until ingredients are finely minced. de seeding the jalapenos or only using one will result in a medium heat salsa . add all remaining ingredients tomatoes, cumin, cilantro, lime juice, and salt and process until smooth. cool for one hour in refrigerator prior to serving.

inputs: cake mix, water, vegetable oil, egg, white frosting, chocolate chips
targets: title: dreamy cream filled cupcakes ingredients: 1 18 ounce boxbetty crocker devil s food cake mix water vegetable oil, as called for on cake mix box egg, as called for on cake mix box 1 18 ounce containerbetty crocker whipped fluffy white frosting 12 cup miniature semisweet chocolate chips directions: heat oven to 350 325 for dark or nonstick pan . make and bake cake mix as directed on box for 24 cupcakes, using water,oil and eggs. cool 10 min remove from pan to cooling rack.cool completely,about 30 minute. spoon 1 container of frosting into corner of a resealable heavy duty food storage plastic bag.cut about 1/4 off corner of bag.gently push cut corner of bag into center of cupcake. squeeze about 2tsp. of frosting into center of each cupcake for filling, being careful not to split cupcake. frost tops of cupcakes with remaining 1/2 container of frosting. sprinkle chocolate chips on top of each cupcake.

inputs: brown sugar, sugar, tapioca flour, vanilla, non dairy milk, matcha powder, sunflower, flour, whole wheat flour, salt, baking soda, pistachios
targets: title: pistachio matcha cookies ingredients: 1/2 cup brown sugar 1/4 cup raw sugar 2 tablespoons tapioca flour 1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract 1/4 cup non dairy milk, cashew or almond 1 tablespoon matcha powder 2/3 cup sunflower or coconut oil 3/4 cup 1 tbs unbleached all purpose flour 3/4 cup 1 tbs whole wheat flour 1/2 teaspoon sea salt 1/2 teaspoon baking soda 1/2 cup pistachios, raw and shelled directions: preheat oven to 375 . in a small sauce pan, warm 1/4 cup non dairy milk for 2 3 minutes. you don t need to bring the milk to boil, but make sure that it is warm to touch. pour into small bowl and use match whisk to dissolve 1 tsp matcha powder. set aside. in a medium bowl, combine flour, sea salt, and baking soda. set aside. in a large bowl, combine sugar, oil, vanilla, tapioca flour, and matcha milk. whisk for 3 5 minutes until the mixture looks like smooth caramel. slowly add the dry ingredients to your wet ingredients followed by pistachios. cook for 8 minutes on the middle rack snack away.

inputs: chicken, swiss cheese, chicken soup, milk, directions
targets: title: chicken and cheese casserole ingredients: 1 lb. skinless chicken breast sliced swiss cheese 1 can creamed chicken soup 1/2 soup with milk 1 box stuffing mixed made according to box directions directions: heat oven 350. in glass 9x13 inch baking dish place chicken pieces. place single layer cheese on top of chicken. mix soup and milk and pour over cheese layer. cover with stuffing mixture and foil. bake 350 for 1 hour. do not peek.

inputs: pork, brown sugar, dry mustard, catsup, bacon
targets: title: nita s baked beans ingredients: 2 cans no. 10 pork and beans 3 c. brown sugar 6 tsp. dry mustard 6 c. catsup 1 lb. bacon or chopped ham directions: mix all ingredients except bacon or ham. bake, covered, 20 minutes at 350 . remove. top with bacon or ham. return, uncovered, until bacon or ham is brown. serves 50.

inputs: proofed active starter, butter, honey, water, grain cereal, bread flour, eggs, salt
targets: title: honey oat sourdough ingredients: 2 cups proofed active starter 1/2 cup melted butter 1/2 cup honey or 1/2 cup corn syrup 1/2 cup water 1 cup of 5 grain cereal, coarsely milled can use quick oats 4 5 cups bread flour or more as needed 2 eggs 1 pinch salt directions: melt butter mix in a small bowl with water and honey make sure temperature is less than 120 . add proofed starter and mix in stand mixer, add oats and 3 cups of flour and whirl with the dough hook until combined. add wet ingredients and mix on speed 2 until combined. add eggs. mix until combined, continue to mix on speed 2. add additional flour, 1/2 cup at a time until dough clings to hook and cleans the sides of the bowl. knead for 7 more minutes. transfer dough to oiled bowl and turn to coat. let rise until at least doubled in size. punch down. divide into 2 loaves. let rise again until risen higher than tops of pans. bake at 350 until crust sounds hollow when tapped.

inputs: red bell peppers, sweet onions, boneless beef, worcestershire sauce, italian seasoning, olive oil, parsley, garlic, salt, ground black pepper, lemon juice
targets: title: beef kabobs with red bell pepper and sweet onion ingredients: 2 red bell peppers, cut into 1 inch pieces 2 pieces sweet onions, cut into 12 wedges 1 lb boneless beef top sirloin steak, cut into cubes 1 inch thick 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce 2 teaspoons italian seasoning 3 tablespoons olive oil 1 teaspoon chopped fresh parsley or 1 teaspoon dried parsley 2 garlic cloves, crushed 1/2 teaspoon msg optional 1 pinch salt 1/2 teaspoon ground black pepper optional 1 teaspoon lemon juice directions: put in a large bowl the beef and red bell pepper. rub into beef and red bell pepper the ff italian seasonning, worcestershire sauce,olive oil,ground black pepper and monosodium glutamate optional . set aside for about 5 minutes. place sweet onions in a plate and put a lit bit of olive oil,italian seasoning and a pinch of salt. meanwhile,prepare and mix together olive oil,chopped parsley,garlic crushed,lemon juice to be use later while grilling the kabobs. alternately,thread pieces of beef,red bell pepper,and sweet onions on each of four 12 inch skewers or bamboo skewers. put aluminum foil on grid and place the kabobs,grill 8 to 10 mins over medium coals turning occasionally. brush olive oil mixture on each side while grilling. serve with hot plain white cooked rice or mashed potato.

inputs: lean pork cutlets, sweet potatoes, apple sauce, apple pie spice, brown sugar twin
targets: title: baked pork with sweet potatoes and applesauce diabetic ingredients: 4 lean pork cutlets 3 c. raw sweet potatoes cut 1/4 inch thick 2 c. unsweetened apple sauce 1/2 tsp. apple pie spice 1/4 c. brown sugar twin directions: spray 8 x8 inch baking dish. spray skillet with butter flavored spray and brown cutlets. place chops in baking dish. arrange sweet potatoes over chops. combine applesauce, pie spice and brown sugar. pour over sweet potatoes. cover and bake 50 to 60 minutes until sweet potatoes are tender. uncover and bake 10 to 15 minutes more. bake at 350 degrees.

inputs: extra virgin olive oil, mint, kosher salt, garlic, ground black pepper, ground cumin, sugar, paprika, oregano, habanero chile, chicken
targets: title: peruvian roast chicken with garlic and lime ingredients: 3tablespoons extra virgin olive oil 1/4cup lightly packed fresh mint leaves 2tablespoons kosher salt 6 medium garlic cloves, peeled and roughly chopped 1tablespoon ground black pepper 1tablespoon ground cumin 1tablespoon sugar 2teaspoons smoked paprika 2teaspoons dried oregano 2teaspoons finely grated zest and 1/4 cup juice from 2 limes 1teaspoon minced habanero chile see note 1 3 1/2 to 4 pound whole chicken directions: 1. process all ingredients except chicken in blender until smooth paste forms, 10 to 20 seconds. using fingers or handle of wooden spoon, carefully loosen skin over thighs and breast and remove any excess fat. rub half of paste beneath skin of chicken. spread entire exterior surface of chicken with remaining paste. tuck wingtips underneath chicken. place chicken in gallon size zipper lock bag and refrigerate at least 6 hours and up to 24 hours. 2. adjust oven rack to lowest position and heat oven to 325 degrees. place vertical roaster on rimmed baking sheet. slide chicken onto vertical roaster so chicken stands upright and breast is perpendicular to bottom of pan. roast until skin just begins to turn golden and instant read thermometer inserted into thickest part of breast registers 140 degrees, 45 to 55 minutes. carefully remove chicken and pan from oven and increase oven temperature to 500 degrees. 3. when oven is heated to 500 degrees, place 1 cup water in bottom of pan and return pan to oven. roast until entire skin is browned and crisp and instant read thermometer registers 160 degrees inserted in thickest part of breast and 175 degrees in thickest part of thigh, about 20 minutes replenish water as necessary to keep pan from smoking , rotating bird 180 degrees halfway through cooking. 4. carefully remove chicken from oven and let rest, still on vertical roaster, 20 minutes. using kitchen towel, carefully lift chicken off vertical roaster and onto platter or cutting board. carve chicken and serve, passing spicy mayonnaise separately.

inputs: chicken breasts, cracker crumbs, parmesan cheese, butter, cream of chicken soup, water, mushroom soup, sour cream
targets: title: baked chicken breasts ingredients: 4 to 6 chicken breasts skinless 1 c. ritz cracker crumbs 1/2 c. parmesan cheese 1 stick butter 1 c. cream of chicken soup 1/2 c. water 1 4 oz. can mushroom soup 8 oz. sour cream directions: roll chicken pieces into the first 2 ingredients. place in melted butter dish. pour the remaining ingredients over. bake 1 hour at 350 .

inputs: thighs, catsup, brown sugar, worcestershire sauce, orange juice, mustard, onion, garlic salt
targets: title: chicken delight ingredients: 4 legs and 4 thighs 3/4 c. catsup 1/3 c. brown sugar, packed 3 tbsp. worcestershire sauce 2 tbsp. orange juice 1 tbsp. prepared mustard 1 onion, chopped fine 1/2 tsp. garlic salt directions: combine all ingredients. heat to boiling point. place chicken pieces in baking dish and pour sauce over chicken. cover with foil. bake 1 hour at 350 , turning chicken once. there will be sauce to eat with rice.

inputs: butter, sugar, flour, salt, pecans, dish pie shell, buttermilk, eggs
targets: title: buttermilk pie ingredients: 1/2 c. butter 1 stick , softened 1 1/2 c. sugar 3 tbsp. flour all purpose 1/4 tsp. salt 1 c. crushed pecans or walnuts 1 unbaked deep dish pie shell 1 c. buttermilk 4 eggs directions: cream all ingredients except eggs and pecans. once creamed, beat eggs into mixture, one at a time. when batter is smooth, pour into pie shell. sprinkle pecans or walnuts on top. bake for 1 1/2 hours or until firm at 300 . do not overcook. enjoy

inputs: butter, brown sugar, eggs, vanilla, old fashioned oats, flour, nonfat dry milk powder, salt, baking powder, ground cinnamon, apple pie filling
targets: title: apple oat breakfast treats ingredients: 3/4 cup butter, softened 3/4 cup packed brown sugar 2 eggs 1 teaspoon vanilla extract 2 1/2 cups old fashioned oats 3/4 cup all purpose flour 1/2 cup nonfat dry milk powder 1 teaspoon salt 1/2 teaspoon baking powder 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon 1 to 1 1/4 cups apple pie filling directions: in a bowl, cream butter and brown sugar. add the eggs and vanilla. combine dry ingredients add to the creamed mixture and mix well. drop by 1/4 cupfuls 6 in. apart onto ungreased . flatten into 3 in. circles. make a slight indentation in the center of each top with a rounded tablespoonful of pie filling. bake at 350 for 16 20 minutes or until edges are lightly browned. cool for 5 minutes remove to wire racks to cool completely.

inputs: pastry, egg yolk, unsalted butter, mushrooms, salt, stalks, white wine, orange juice, raspberry, unsalted butter, meat
targets: title: puff pastry with asparagus and mushrooms ingredients: 1/2 pound homemade puff pastry, or 1 defrosted frozen puff pastry sheet see note 1 egg yolk 2 tablespoons unsalted butter 3/4 pound medium mushrooms preferably cremini sliced 1/8 inch thick salt and freshly ground black pepper, to taste 16 to 24 asparagus stalks, trimmed and peeled into 6 inch spears 1/2 cup dry white wine 1/2 cup fresh orange juice 1 tablespoon raspberry or other fruit flavored vinegar 12 tablespoons 1 1/2 sticks unsalted butter, chilled and cut into bits 1 tablespoon meat or chicken demi glace optional directions: preheat the oven to 375f. line a 12 x 18 inch baking sheet with parchment paper and sprinkle with water. on a lightly floured surface, roll out the pastry into a 14 x 5 inch rectangle 1/8 inch thick. cut the pastry into 4 rectangles. place them on the prepared sheet about 1 1/2 inches apart to allow for expansion during baking. cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 20 minutes, or until chilled. beat the egg yolk with 2 tablespoons cold water. brush the tops of the chilled pastry lightly with the egg wash. bake for 20 minutes, or until puffed and golden. meanwhile, in a large skillet, melt the butter over medium heat. add the mushrooms and season with salt and pepper. cook, stirring from time to time, just until the mushrooms give off their liquid, about 5 minutes. pour off the cooking liquid into a saucepan. keep the mushrooms warm. cook the liquid over low heat until reduced to about 1 tablespoon. set aside. in a medium saucepan of lightly salted simmering water, poach the asparagus for 5 to 7 minutes, or until crisp tender. drain and keep warm. prepare the sauce place the wine, orange juice, and vinegar in a small nonreactive heavy saucepan over medium heat and slowly bring to a simmer. continue to simmer until the mixture is syrupy and reduced to about 2 tablespoons. remove the pan from the heat and whisk in about 2 tablespoons of the butter pieces. return to low heat, and whisking constantly, add the remaining butter piece by piece. whisk in the reduced mushroom liquid and optional demi glace. set aside on the warm side of the stove. using a serrated knife, carefully slice each pastry in half lengthwise. place each bottom slice on an individual warm plate. divide the mushrooms over each, then add the asparagus spears. coat the asparagus with the sauce. place the top pastry over the asparagus and serve immediately.

inputs: campbell s tomato soup, cheese, corn tortilla chips
targets: title: poor man s tomato soup ingredients: 1 10 1/2 ounce can campbell s tomato soup mexican style cheese shredded corn tortilla chips directions: prepare soup as directed. pour over desired amount of cheese and chips. enjoy

inputs: flour, soda, salt, sugar, eggs, pineapple, vanilla
targets: title: do nothing cake ingredients: 2 c. plain flour 1 tsp. soda 1/2 tsp. salt 2 c. sugar 2 eggs 1 large can crushed pineapple 1 tsp. vanilla directions: mix together all ingredients. pour into 9 x 15 inch buttered pan. cook at 350 for 25 minutes.

inputs: cream cheese, parmesan cheese, egg, salt, phyllo dough, unsalted butter, pesto
targets: title: cheese straws in pesto ingredients: 1 8 ounce package cream cheese, softened 1/4 cup grated parmesan cheese 1 large egg, lightly beaten salt 1 16 ounce package frozen phyllo dough about 40 sheets , thawed 1 stick unsalted butter, melted store bought pesto, for dipping directions: preheat the oven to 375 degrees. combine the cream cheese, parmesan, egg and 1/4 teaspoon salt in a small bowl mix well. spoon into a resealable bag snip off the corner to make a 1/4 inch diameter opening. unfold the stack of phyllo sheets on a clean surface. working quickly to keep the dough from drying out, brush the top sheet all over with melted butter, then pipe the cheese filling along the long edge of the dough to within 1/2 inch of the ends. fold the ends over the filling, then roll up the dough to make a straw. place on a baking sheet repeat with the remaining phyllo sheets and cheese mixture. bake until golden, 10 to 12 minutes. serve the cheese straws with pesto. photograph by mark peterson

inputs: butter, clove garlic, stalk celery, chicken, ground almonds, ground mace, heavy cream, salt, almonds
targets: title: cream of almond soup ingredients: 2 tablespoons butter 1 clove garlic, peeled and crushed 1 large stalk celery, thinly sliced 3 cups chicken or vegetable broth 2/3 cup ground almonds 1/8 teaspoon ground mace 1 cup heavy cream salt to taste 2 tablespoons toasted slivered almonds directions: melt butter in a saucepan over medium heat. add garlic and celery cook and stir until softened, 4 to 5 minutes. pour in chicken broth, increase heat to medium high, and bring to a simmer. stir in almond butter until dissolved and season with mace. reduce heat to medium low, cover, and simmer until the celery is tender, 30 to 40 minutes. once the celery is tender, turn off heat, and allow the soup to stand covered for 1 hour. carefully puree the warm soup until smooth using a blender or immersion blender pour through a sieve into a clean saucepan. stir in cream and place over medium low heat. heat until hot, being careful not to bring to a boil or else the cream will curdle. season with salt to taste serve garnished with toasted slivered almonds.

inputs: sweet milk, sugar, cake, flour, salt, soda, baking powder
targets: title: rolls ingredients: 1 qt. sweet milk 1 c. creamy crustene shortening 1 c. sugar 1 cake fleischmann s yeast flour 1 tbsp. salt 1 tbsp. soda 1 tbsp. baking powder directions: cook milk, shortening and sugar until boiling, then set aside. when lukewarm, dissolve yeast in it and sift enough flour in to make it the consistency of cake batter. let stand in warm place for 2 hours, then sift salt, soda and baking powder. work in enough flour to make stiff dough, then roll out and cut as many rolls as you wish. set in a warm place and let rise for 2 hours before baking. put the rest of dough in the icebox. will keep a week or more.

inputs: chuck roast, catsup, catsup bottle full, brown sugar, vinegar, lemon, salt, pepper, chili powder, worcestershire sauce, dry mustard, onion, celery
targets: title: beef barbecue ingredients: 3 1/2 to 4 lb. chuck roast 1 small bottle catsup 1 catsup bottle full of water 1/4 c. brown sugar 1/4 c. vinegar juice of 1 lemon 1 1/2 tsp. salt 1/2 tsp. pepper 2 tsp. chili powder 1/4 c. worcestershire sauce 1 tsp. dry mustard 3/4 c. onion, chopped 3/4 c. celery, chopped directions: place chuck roast in roasting pan. combine remaining ingredients and pour over roast cover pan. bake in 325 oven about 3 hours or until fork tender.

inputs: ground beef, stalks celery, onion, clove garlic, salt, tomatoes, bulgur, water, raisins, sunflower seeds, cheddar cheese
targets: title: bulgur natural casserole ingredients: 1 lb. ground beef 2 stalks celery, chopped 1 c. 1 medium onion, chopped 1 clove garlic, minced salt and pepper 1 16 oz. can tomatoes 1 c. bulgur 1 c. water 1/2 c. raisins 1/3 c. sunflower seeds cheddar cheese directions: stir all ingredients together, except cheese. pour into casserole. bake, covered. the last 5 minutes, add triangles of cheddar cheese. bake, uncovered, until cheese is melted in 375 oven for 35 minutes.

inputs: chili sauce, white wine, olive oil, garlic, basil, salt, pepper, chicken
targets: title: chili sauce chicken ingredients: 1 bottle 12 ounces chili sauce 1/3 cup white wine or chicken broth 1/4 cup olive oil 10 to 12 garlic cloves, minced 4 1/2 teaspoons dried basil 1/2 teaspoon salt 1/8 teaspoon pepper 8 bone in chicken thighs about 3 pounds directions: in a large bowl, whisk the first seven ingredients until blended. pour 1 1/2 cups marinade into a large resealable plastic bag. add chicken seal bag and turn to coat. refrigerate 8 hours or overnight. cover and refrigerate remaining marinade. drain chicken, discarding marinade in bag. place chicken on a greased grill rack, skin side down. grill, covered, over medium heat or broil 4 in. from heat 15 minutes. turn grill 10 15 minutes longer or until a thermometer reads 170 175 , basting occasionally with reserved marinade. freeze chicken with 1 1/2 cups marinade in a resealable plastic freezer bag. freeze reserved marinade in a freezer container. to use, thaw chicken with marinade and the reserved marinade in refrigerator overnight. drain chicken, discarding marinade in bag. grill as directed, basting with reserved marinade.

inputs: eggs, sugar, milk, flour, corn, butter
targets: title: corn puddin ingredients: 3 eggs 1/2 c. sugar 1 1/2 c. milk 2 tbsp. flour 2 cans creamed corn 2 tbsp. butter directions: beat the first 4 ingredients until well blended. melt butter in casserole dish. add corn to first mixture, then pour into dish. bake at 350 for 1 hour.

inputs: flour, salt, cream of tartar, oil, water, food coloring
targets: title: play dough ingredients: 1 c. flour 1/2 c. salt 2 tsp. cream of tartar 2 tsp. oil 1 c. water food coloring for desired color directions: an emergency substitute for sour cream combine 6 ounces cottage cheese and 1 teaspoon lemon juice. put in blender until smooth.

inputs: stalk, coriander seeds, ginger, garlic, shallot, fresh jalape o chiles, asian sesame oil, kosher salt, white pepper, vegetable oil, sirloin tip, wooden skewers
targets: title: sirloin kebabs with southeast asian style spice paste ingredients: 1 large fresh lemongrass stalk, tough outer leaves discarded 1 tablespoon coriander seeds 2 tablespoons minced peeled ginger 2 tablespoons minced garlic 1 large shallot, minced 2 fresh jalapeno chiles, minced 3 tablespoons , including seeds 2 tablespoons asian sesame oil 2 teaspoons kosher salt 2 teaspoons white pepper 3 tablespoons vegetable oil 1 1/2 pounds sirloin tip, trimmed and cut into 1 inch chunks an electric coffee/spice grinder or a mortar and pestle 8 12 inch wooden skewers, soaked in warm water 30 minutes directions: mince enough lemongrass from lower 4 inches of stalk to measure 2 tablespoons. coarsely grind coriander seeds in grinder or with mortar and pestle, then stir together with lemongrass and remaining ingredients except sirloin in a bowl. prepare grill for direct heat cooking with medium hot charcoal. toss sirloin with 1/3 cup spice paste in a large bowl and thread chunks 1/4 inch apart onto skewers. oil grill rack, then grill kebabs, turning occasionally and moving around if flare ups occur, 5 to 6 minutes for medium rare.

inputs: cream cheese, pesto sauce, pistachio, fresh basil sprigs
targets: title: pistachio pesto cheese ingredients: 1 8 oz. pkg. cream cheese 1/2 c. prepared pesto sauce 1/2 c. chopped pistachio, divided fresh basil sprigs directions: in small bowl with electric mixer at medium speed, beat cream cheese with pesto sauce and 1/4 cup pistachio. spoon into serving dish. sprinkle with remaining 1/4 cup pistachios and garnish with basil leaves.

inputs: white cake, fresh strawberries, cream, chocolate bar, strawberries, sparkling wine, sugar
targets: title: sparkling strawberry shortcake ingredients: 1 betty crocker white cake mix 1 lb. fresh strawberries 1/4 c. cream 1 2 oz. chocolate bar 1 8 oz. cool whip 6 whole strawberries 1 bottle sparkling wine 1 c. sugar directions: prepare cake mix according to instructions on box substituting 1 1/3 cups sparkling wine for water. bake in a 13 x 9 x 2 inch pan. after the cake is cooled, flip onto serving tray and place in refrigerator for 2 hours.

inputs: veal snitzels, flour plain, eggs, breadcrumbs, olive oil, butter, parmesan cheese, olive oil, onions, garlic, tomato paste, tomatoes, white wine, chicken stock, sugar caster, basil
targets: title: veal parmigiana ingredients: 4 veal snitzels 1 cup flour plain 2 eggs 1 cup breadcrumbs 1 cup olive oil 30 grams butter 250 grams cheese grated 60 grams parmesan cheese 1 tablespoon olive oil 1 onions medium 2 teaspoons garlic crushed 1 tablespoon tomato paste 450 grams whole peeled tomatoes 1 cup white wine 1 cup chicken stock 1 teaspoon sugar caster 1 tablespoon basil chopped directions: pound veal steaks thin, coat lightly in flour, dip in egg and press into breadcrumbs to coat evenly. refrigerate while preparing sauce. sauce in a pan, saute the diced onion and garlic in olive oil until tender . add the white wine, stock, sugar, tomatoes and tomato paste. stir in the seasoning and simmer gently for 1/2 hour or until sauce is thick. heat oil and butter in a pan and gently cook the crumbed steaks on each side until golden, about 3 minutes each side. remove from pan and place in an ovenproof dish. top with grated cheese, tomato sauce and sprinkle evenly with grated parmesan. bake in a moderate oven, uncovered, for 15 minutes or until cheese is golden brown.

inputs: olive oil, fresh fennel, carrots, onions, garlic, red pepper, sweet paprika, paprika, red lentils, water, salt, spaghettini
targets: title: spaghettini with spicy lentil sauce ingredients: 2 tablespoons olive oil 1 cup chopped fresh fennel 1/2 pound carrots, scraped and chopped fine 23 pound onions, chopped fine 2 large cloves garlic, chopped fine 1/4 pound chunk prosciutto, diced 1/4 to 1/2 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes 1 teaspoon hungarian sweet paprika 1/4 teaspoon hungarian hot paprika 1 heaping cup red lentils 5 cups water 1 teaspoon salt optional 1 pound spaghettini directions: heat oil in nonstick skillet and saute fennel, carrots, onions, garlic, prosciutto and red pepper flakes until vegetables are soft, 10 to 15 minutes. add paprikas and saute for another 2 minutes to coat vegetables. add lentils and 5 cups of water bring to boil, lower heat and simmer until lentils are soft but not mushy, 10 to 12 minutes. season with salt if desired. meanwhile, bring water to boil for pasta in covered pot. cook pasta and drain. stir into lentil sauce and toss. serve immediately or sauce will thicken too much.

inputs: vodka, lemon lime beverage, orange slice
targets: title: orange cream ingredients: 1 12 ounces smirnoff orange vodka 1 splash carbonated lemon lime beverage 1 orange slice directions: add smirnoff orange flavored vodka, and lemon lime soda. stir well. garnish with orange slice.

inputs: flour, salt, baking soda, sugar, eggs, buttermilk, oil
targets: title: aunt tammy s buttermilk pancakes ingredients: 2 c. flour 1 tsp. salt 2 tsp. baking soda 4 tbsp. sugar 2 eggs 2 c. buttermilk 3 tbsp. oil directions: sift dry ingredients together. beat eggs until lemon colored. add buttermilk and oil. fold dry ingredients into wet mixture.

inputs: lean ground beef, garlic, pasta sauce, salt, parmesan cheese, philadelphia cream cheese, milk, italian seasoning, eggs, italian, parsley, noodles
targets: title: creamy lasagna roll ups ingredients: 1 lb. lean ground beef safeway 1 lb for 5.99 thru 02/09 4 cloves garlic, minced 1 jar 24 oz. classico family favorites traditional pasta sauce 1 can 14.5 oz. no salt added diced tomatoes, drained 1/2 cup kraft grated parmesan cheese, divided 1 tub 8 oz. philadelphia cream cheese spread 2 tbsp. milk 1/2 tsp. italian seasoning 2 eggs, beaten 1 pkg. 8 oz. kraft shredded italian five cheese with a touch of philadelphia 2 tbsp. chopped fresh parsley 12 cooked lasagna noodles directions: heat oven to 350 degrees f. brown meat with garlic in large skillet drain. stir in pasta sauce, tomatoes and 1/4 cup parmesan. remove from heat. mix cream cheese spread, milk and italian seasoning in medium bowl until blended. add eggs, shredded cheese and parsley mix well. spread half the meat sauce onto bottom of 13x9 inch baking dish sprayed with cooking spray. spread each noodle with 3 tbsp. cream cheese mixture roll up. place, seam sides down, over sauce in dish. top with remaining meat sauce and parmesan cover. bake 45 to 50 min. or until heated through.

inputs: chicken, salt, coca cola, ketchup
targets: title: barbecue chicken ingredients: 1 chicken, cut up salt and pepper 1 c. coca cola 1 c. ketchup directions: preheat oven to 350 . wash chicken salt and pepper to taste. place chicken pieces in baking dish. mix ketchup and coca cola together. pour over chicken. bake about 1 hour, until chicken is tender and sauce has thickened, turning chicken a couple of times.

inputs: egg yolks, egg whites, salt, sugar, ground pecans
targets: title: kayla s southern pecan mist cake ingredients: 12 egg yolks 12 egg whites 1/2 teaspoon salt 3 1/8 cups sifted confectioners sugar 3 cups ground pecans directions: preheat oven to 350 degrees f 175 degrees c . line the bottom of a 10 inch tube pan with parchment paper do not grease the paper . separate eggs while cold, but let them come to room temperature before making the cake. in a large mixing bowl, beat egg yolks until very thick and lemon colored. in another bowl, beat egg whites and salt until foamy. gradually add sifted powdered sugar to egg whites and continue to beat until stiff, but not dry. fold 1/3 of the whites into the yolks, then fold in the remaining whites. gently fold ground pecans into egg mixture. pour batter into pan. bake at 350 degrees f 175 degrees c for 50 minutes or until a cake tester comes out clean and the top of the cake is light brown. remove from oven and invert pan to cool. cool cake completely before removing from pan.

inputs: orange, fresh cranberries, apple, sugar, brown sugar, apple juice, , water, fresh ginger, cinnamon, salt, , ground allspice
targets: title: cranberry compote ingredients: 1 whole large orange, zested then sectioned and diced 1 package 12 oz. size fresh cranberries, rinsed and picked over 1 whole large granny smith apple 1 whole large pear i used bosc 1 cup white granulated sugar 2 tablespoons brown sugar 1/2 cups apple juice or apple cider 1/4 cups orange juice 1 1/4 cup water 1 teaspoon grated fresh ginger 2 whole cinnamon sticks 1/2 teaspoons salt 1/4 teaspoons ground nutmeg 1/8 teaspoons ground allspice directions: for the orange after removing the zest from the orange, remove the remaining pith from the orange, cut out each section, then dice the sections. combine all ingredients in a medium sauce pot. cook over medium heat, stirring as needed, until cranberries have burst and mixture has reduced and thickened. it may be necessary to lower heat as the compote starts to thicken so that it will not burn. may be served warm or at room temperature. note may be made a few days ahead. store covered in the refrigerator.

inputs: cream style cottage cheese, water, egg, butter, bread flour, sugar, dill seeds, onion flakes, salt, pepper, yeast, butter, kosher salt
targets: title: bread machine dilly onion bread ingredients: 1 cup cream style cottage cheese 1/4 cup water 1 egg slightly beaten 2 tablespoons butter cut up 3 cups bread flour 2 teaspoons sugar 3 teaspoons dill seeds 1 tablespoon dried onion flakes 3/4 teaspoon salt 1/8 teaspoon pepper 1 1/2 teaspoons dry yeast butter 1/4 teaspoon kosher salt directions: select dough cycle. add ingredients to machine according to manufacturer s directions. when dough cyle is done, remove dough, knead 3 4 times on lightly floured board. in a greased or oiled 2 quart dish add dough, turn to cover in oil. allow to rise under a warm dish towel and or in microwave oven till double. bake at 350 degrees for about 30 40 minutes or till nicely browned. remove from oven, rub with butter and sprinkle with freshly ground kosher salt or pre ground kosher salt. serve warm with dark lager beer,wine or orange juice as desired.

inputs: olive oil, garlic, bread, salt, flour, pinches, parsley
targets: title: white fish fillets in parsley sauce ingredients: 4 tablespoons olive oil 8 cloves garlic, coarsely chopped 1 slice stale whole wheat bread 4 pieces thick white fish fillets, fresh or frozen 2 pinches salt and pepper 4 tablespoons corn flour 2 cups, 1 tablespoon, 2 teaspoons, 7 18 pinches fish or vegetable stock 1 bunch parsley, small directions: 1. heat the olive oil at medium heat in a large skillet. saute chopped garlic until golden, but be very careful not to burn it. remove it from the pan using a slotted spoon and set aside. 2. toast a slice of stale bread on both sides in the same oil. remove it from the pan, cut into smaller chunks and set aside. 3. season fish fillets with salt and pepper, dredge them through flour. fry briefly on both sides in the same pan. remove from the pan and keep warm. 4. pour 3/4 of the fish stock into the pan and boil until the liquid reduces to 1/3. 5. meanwhile, place the garlic, chunks of toasted bread and coarsely chopped parsley into the food processor. gradually add the remaining fish stock as you blend the mixture until you get a thick sauce. 6. add this mixture to the reduced stock in the pan. mix well and cook for 3 4 minutes. 7. put the fish fillets back into the pan and cover it with parsley sauce. simmer until the fish is cooked but still firm and the sauce becomes slightly thicker. if necessary, add a little water or stock to the sauce. adjust seasoning to taste. serve with basmati rice or steamed small new potatoes.

inputs: cream cheese, flour tortillas, cheese, ham
targets: title: cheese tortilla roll ups ingredients: 1/4 c. soft cream cheese with chives and onion 4 6 to 8 inch flour tortillas 8 kraft american singles pasteurized cheese 8 slices smoked cooked ham directions: spread cream cheese over tortillas. top with 2 slices of cheese and 2 ham slices. roll up tightly. wrap each roll securely in plastic wrap. refrigerate. cut each roll into 6 pieces secure ends with toothpick. serve with salsa or picante sauce.

inputs: butter, yellow onion, all purpose, heavy cream, salt, pepper, furmano s petite, corn, chicken, worcestershire sauce, fresh cilantro
targets: title: salsa style green chile chicken bisque ingredients: 4 tablespoons butter 1 yellow onion, finely chopped 4 tablespoons all purpose flour 2 cups heavy cream 1 teaspoon salt 1/2 teaspoon pepper 1 28 ounce can furmano s petite diced tomatoes with green chilies 1 8 ounce can creamed corn 1 cup cooked chicken, diced 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce 2 tablespoons fresh cilantro, chopped, for garnish directions: in a large saucepan over medium heat, melt butter. saute onion for 4 minutes. add flour, stirring constantly for 2 minutes. add cream, salt, pepper, toamtoes, corn, chicken and worcestershire sauce. reduce heat to medium low and simmer for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. serve warm with cilantro sprinkled on top.

inputs: cornmeal, all purpose, baking powder, salt, buttermilk, eggs, vegetable oil, cheddar cheese, cream style corn, onion, bacon, pimento
targets: title: cowboy cornbread ingredients: 1 1/2 c. cornmeal 1/2 c. all purpose flour 1 tsp. baking powder 1/2 tsp. salt 1 c. buttermilk 2 eggs, beaten 1/4 c. vegetable oil 2 c. grated cheddar cheese 1 c. cream style corn 1 small onion, grated 12 to 14 slices bacon, cooked and crumbled 2 tbsp. chopped pimento directions: combine cornmeal, flour, baking powder and salt. mix well. add buttermilk, eggs and vegetable oil. stir well. stir in cheese, corn, onion, bacon and pimento. pour into greased 9 inch square pan or 8 inch black iron skillet. bake at 350 for 40 to 45 minutes or until lightly browned. makes 8 or 9 servings.

inputs: frozen strawberries, fresh blueberries, cream cheese, sugar, milk, eggs, vanilla, ground cinnamon, butter, bread
targets: title: patriotic french toast ingredients: 1 10 ounce package frozen strawberries, thawed 1 cup fresh blueberries 1 8 ounce package cream cheese, softened 2 cups confectioners sugar 2 cups milk 2 eggs, beaten 1 teaspoon vanilla extract 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon 2 tablespoons butter 8 thick slices bread directions: preheat an oven to 250 degrees f 120 degrees c . combine the thawed strawberries with their juice and the blueberries in a bowl set aside. beat together the softened cream cheese and confectioner s sugar until smooth set aside. whisk the milk, eggs, vanilla, and cinnamon in a shallow bowl. melt butter over medium heat in a large skillet or griddle. dip bread into egg mixture, coating thoroughly. cook until well browned on both sides, about 5 minutes. place cooked slices on baking sheet and place in oven to keep warm until ready to serve. spread the cream cheese mixture over each slice of french toast, then top with 2 tablespoons of the fruit. serve immediately.

inputs: beets, salt, flour, milk
targets: title: creamed beets ingredients: 2 pints canned beets, sliced or diced in water 1/2 tsp. salt 2 tbsp. all purpose flour 1 c. milk directions: bring beets, water and salt to boiling. mix flour and milk. pour in beets. let simmer.

inputs: pork, shoyu, salt, white sugar, ginger, vegetable oil, rice rolls, bean sprouts, celery, string beans, green onions, shoyu, ginger, salt, white sugar, monosodium glutamate, ground black pepper, sesame seeds
targets: title: simple chow fun ingredients: pork 3/4 pound pork, thinly sliced 1 tablespoon shoyu soy sauce 1 teaspoon salt 1/2 teaspoon white sugar 1 slice ginger, crushed chow fun 1 tablespoon vegetable oil 2 rice rolls look fun , sliced into 1/4 inch strips 10 ounces bean sprouts 1 cup sliced celery 1 cup finely sliced string beans 1 cup green onions cut into 1 inch pieces 2 tablespoons shoyu soy sauce 1 slice ginger, crushed 1 teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon white sugar 1/4 teaspoon monosodium glutamate such as aji no moto r optional 1 pinch ground black pepper 2 tablespoons toasted sesame seeds directions: combine pork, 1 tablespoon shoyu, 1 teaspoon salt, 1/2 teaspoon sugar, and 1 slice crushed ginger in a bowl. let marinate for 15 minutes. heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. add pork with marinade cook and stir until pork is browned, about 5 minutes. stir rice roll strips into the skillet cook until edges start to brown, 3 to 5 minutes. stir bean sprouts, celery, string beans, green onions, 2 tablespoons shoyu, 1 slice crushed ginger, 1 teaspoon salt, 1 teaspoon sugar, 1/4 teaspoon monosodium glutamate, and pepper into the skillet. cook and stir until string beans are tender, about 10 minutes. garnish with sesame seeds.

inputs: chicken breasts, frozen broccoli, cream of mushroom soup, mayonnaise, cooking sherry, romano cheese
targets: title: chicken and broccoli ingredients: 4 chicken breasts fresh or frozen broccoli, chopped 1 can cream of mushroom soup 1 c. mayonnaise 1/2 c. cooking sherry 2/3 c. grated parmesan or romano cheese directions: steam breasts do not overcook . let cool. cut chicken in bite sized pieces. cook broccoli until barely tender.

inputs: unsalted butter, flour, grated monterey, fresh breadcrumbs, milk, romano cheese
targets: title: cheese straws ingredients: 1/2 cup unsalted butter, softened 1 1/2 cups all purpose flour 2 cups grated monterey jack cheese 1 to 1 1/2 cups fresh breadcrumbs 1/2 cup whole or nonfat milk about 1/2 cup grated romano cheese directions: cream butter and flour until smooth. add cheese and breadcrumbs. blend in milk to form a smooth dough, adding more crumbs if the dough is too wet. lay a large piece of plastic wrap on counter, and set dough on it. cover with another piece of plastic. roll dough out until it is about 18x8 inches. chill till firm, about 1 hour. preheat oven to 400f. spray a baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray. use a sharp knife to cut dough into strips 4x1/4 inch thick. arrange dough strips on baking sheet, and sprinkle with romano cheese. bake until brown, for 20 to 25 minutes. remove from oven, and store or serve.

inputs: pork ribs, marinade, stalks lemongrass, sugar, canola oil, shallots, bird chiles, fish sauce, honey hoisin sauce, canola oil, shallots, garlic, fresh ginger, chile, ketchup, hoisin sauce, honey, rice vinegar, soy sauce, espresso, golden brown sugar, cilantro stems, sesame seeds
targets: title: pork ribs with honey hoisin sauce ingredients: 2 racks of baby back pork ribs marinade 4 stalks lemongrass 1/2 cup sugar 1/4 cup canola oil 4 shallots, peeled 2 thai bird chiles, stemmed, halved seeded 1/2 cup fish sauce honey hoisin sauce 1 tablespoon canola oil 2 tablespoons shallots, minced 2 garlic cloves, minced 1 teaspoon minced peeled fresh ginger 1 small thai chile, stemmed, minced 1 cup ketchup 3 tablespoons hoisin sauce 3 tablespoons honey 3 tablespoons unseasoned rice vinegar 3 tablespoons light soy sauce 1 1/2 tablespoons brewed espresso 1 1/2 tablespoons golden brown sugar 3 large fresh cilantro stems sesame seeds garnish optional directions: for the marinade trim bottom 1/2 inch from lemongrass stalks and discard. starting from bottom, thinly slice remaining lemongrass until rings are no longer tinged with pink discard remainder of each stalk. place lemongrass in small processor and mince finely. add sugar, oil, shallots, and chiles process until finely minced. add fish sauce until blended. cover and chill at least 2 hours better overnight in a zip bag. for the sauce heat oil in heavy medium saucepan over medium heat. add shallots, garlic, ginger and chile. saute until soft about 3 minutes. mix ketchup and all remaining ingredients. bring mixture to boil reduce heat to low. simmer 20 minutes. transfer sauce to blender and puree until smooth. to prepare the ribs preheat oven to 375 f. place ribs bone side down, atop rack on rimmed baking sheet. roast for 1 hour. brush ribs generously on both sides with some honey hoisin sauce. roast 15 minutes. brush ribs again with honey hoisin sauce. roast another 15 minutes. cut ribs up and brush the ribs with the remainder of the honey hoisin sauce. add toasted sesame seeds over ribs, optional.

inputs: curd creamed cottage cheese, parmesan cheese, ground beef, mozzarella cheese, oregano, basil, tomato paste, milk, eggs, bisquick baking mix, salt, pepper, parsley
targets: title: impossible lasagne pie ingredients: 1/2 c. small curd creamed cottage cheese 1/4 c. parmesan cheese 1 lb. ground beef, cooked and drained 2 c. mozzarella cheese 1 tsp. dried oregano 1/2 tsp. dried basil 1 6 oz. can tomato paste 1 c. milk 2 eggs 2/3 c. bisquick baking mix 1 tsp. salt 1/4 tsp. pepper snapped fresh parsley directions: grease pie plate, 10 x 1 1/2 inch or square baking dish, 8 x 8 x 2 inch. layer cottage cheese and parmesan cheese in plate. mix cooked beef, 1 cup of the mozzarella cheese, the oregano, basil and tomato paste. spoon evenly over top. beat milk, eggs, baking mix, salt and pepper 15 seconds in blender on high. pour into plate. bake 30 to 35 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean. sprinkle with remaining cheese. return to oven 1 to 2 minutes or until cheese is melted. cool 5 minutes. sprinkle with parsley. makes 6 to 8 servings.

inputs: anisette sponges, rum, water, vanilla pudding, heavy cream
targets: title: anisette sponges cake ingredients: 2 pkg. anisette sponges by stella d oro not toast 1/4 c. rum 1/4 c. water 2 pkg. vanilla pudding not instant 1 pt. heavy cream, whipped directions: mix together rum and water. layer one package of sponges in a 10 inch spring form pan. pour half the water and rum mixture over sponges. cook pudding according to directions. while hot, pour half over sponges.

inputs: light brown sugar, cream of tarter, salt, milk, butter, pecans
targets: title: caramel pecan candy ingredients: 1 package light brown sugar 1/4 tsp. cream of tarter 1/8 tsp. salt 1 cup milk 2 tbsp. butter 2 cups pecans directions: mix first four ingredients and cook until medium to hard boiled stage when dropped in cool water. remove from heat and add butter and then pecans. beat and drop on cookie sheet until it hardens.

inputs: eggs, milk, white bread, sharp cheese, sausage, dried mustard
targets: title: breakfast casserole ingredients: 8 to 10 eggs, slightly beaten 1 c. milk 6 slices white bread, cubed 1 c. sharp cheese, grated 1 lb. sausage, browned, drained and crumbled 1 tsp. dried mustard directions: mix together all ingredients and put in a 9 x 12 inch casserole. refrigerate for 12 hours. this is a must. bake at 350 for 30 minutes.

inputs: onion, new potato, carrot, beef brisket, kosher salt, black pepper, tomato paste, black coffee, worcestershire sauce, brown sugar, flat leaf parsley
targets: title: coffee braised brisket with potatoes and carrots ingredients: 1 medium onion, peeled and quartered, stem end left in tact 1 lb new potato about 12 1 lb medium carrot, cut into 2 1/2 inch lengths 2 1/2 lbs beef brisket, trimmed 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt 1/4 teaspoon black pepper 1 6 ounce can tomato paste 1 cup brewed black coffee 1/4 cup worcestershire sauce 1/4 cup packed light brown sugar 2 tablespoons chopped fresh flat leaf parsley optional directions: in the bottom of a 5 6 quart slow cooker, combine the onion, potatoes and carrots. season the beef with salt and pepper both sides and place on top of vegetables. in a bowl, whisk together the tomato paste, coffee, worcestershire sauce, and brown sugar pour over the beef and vegetables. cover and cook on low until the beef and vegetables are tender, about 7 8 hours. slice the beef across the grain and serve with the vegetables and sauce, sprinkled with the parsley. serve with bread if desired.

inputs: vanilla pudding, cheese, low fat ricotta cheese, cold skim milk
targets: title: cheesecake pudding ingredients: 1 1 ounce package cook n serve sugar free vanilla pudding mix 1/2 cup nonfat cottage cheese 1/2 cup low fat ricotta cheese 3/4 cup cold skim milk directions: combine sugar free vanilla pudding mix, cottage cheese, ricotta cheese, and milk in a medium pot. mix well with a wire whisk . boil on medium heat, stirring constantly, until concoction is boiling steadily. pour immediately into four custard dishes. serve hot or cold. optional if serving hot, mix in raisins and top with cinnamon, brown sugar, honey and/or maple syrup. i like mine less sweet, so i usually just add raisins . for a more cheesecake effect, mix with equal parts of cool whip free and chill before serving. garnish with a graham cracker and raspberries or other cheesecake topping.

inputs: carrots, garlic, rotini pasta
targets: title: creamy pasta veggies ingredients: 1 pkg. 16 oz. frozen mixed vegetables carrots, corn, green beans, peas 1 tub 10 oz. philadelphia savory garlic cooking creme 2 cups cooked tri colored rotini pasta directions: cook vegetables and cooking creme in large skillet on medium heat 6 to 8 min. or until vegetables are heated through and sauce is bubbly, stirring frequently. stir in pasta cook 2 min. or until heated through.

inputs: rice a roni, green, green onions, green olives, artichokes, mayonnaise, curry
targets: title: rice salad ingredients: 1 pkg. rice a roni 1/2 green or red pepper, chopped 4 green onions, chopped 1/2 c. stuffed green olives 2 jars marinated artichokes, chopped and drained save marinade 1/2 c. mayonnaise curry to taste directions: cook rice a roni according to package but no butter . add pepper, onions, olives and artichokes. add mayonnaise to marinade. add curry to taste. toss all together. chill overnight. great salad for potluck or buffets.

inputs: ground chicken, onion, barbecue sauce, onions, cheddar cheese, mayonnaise, red cabbage
targets: title: bbq chicken bake with crunchy onions ingredients: 3 lb. ground chicken 1 onion, chopped 1 bottle 18 oz. bull s eye original barbecue sauce 1 container 6 oz. french fried onions 1 pkg. 8 oz. kraft shredded sharp cheddar cheese 2 tbsp. kraft real mayo mayonnaise 1 tbsp. kraft sun dried tomato vinaigrette dressing 4 cups finely shredded red cabbage directions: heat oven to 350 degrees f. cook chicken with onions in large skillet on medium heat 5 min. or until chicken is done and onions are tender drain. stir in barbecue sauce. spoon into 13x9 inch baking dish sprayed with cooking spray. top with onions and cheese cover. bake 30 min. or until mixture is heated through and cheese is melted, uncovering for the last 10 min. meanwhile, whisk mayo and dressing until blended. add to cabbage in large bowl mix lightly. top casserole with cabbage mixture before serving.

inputs: light italian dressing, lime juice, maple syrup, fresh ginger, soy sauce, fresh lime zest, salmon
targets: title: ginger lime salmon ingredients: 23 cup light italian dressing 13 cup fresh lime juice 14 cup maple syrup 14 cup fresh ginger, grated 2 tablespoons soy sauce 1 tablespoon fresh lime zest 2 12 lbs salmon steaks 4 or 2 12 lbs tuna steaks, 1 inch thick 4 directions: in a large ziptop bag, combine salad dressing, lime juice, maple syrup, ginger, soy sauce and lime zest. add salmon. carefully squeeze out the excess air and seal the bag. put the bag in a large baking dish to catch any leaks and marinate in the refrigerator, turning occasionaly for up to 30 minutes. remove tuna. discard the marinade. grill or broil the salmon until it flakes, about 10 minutes.

inputs: chicken breasts, buttermilk, eggs, flour, salt, peanut oil, cayenne pepper
targets: title: cayenne chicken breasts ingredients: 4 lb. chicken breasts 1 c. buttermilk 2 eggs flour salt peanut oil cayenne pepper directions: beat eggs add buttermilk and mix well. sprinkle red pepper and salt on chicken breasts to taste. dip in eggs and buttermilk, then flour. fry in peanut oil until tender.

inputs: pineapple tidbits, milk, sour cream, cake
targets: title: pineapple angel food trifle ingredients: 1 16 oz. can pineapple tidbits undrained reserve juice 2 3.4 oz. pkg. vanilla instant pudding 3 c. milk 1 8 oz. carton sour cream 1 10 inch angel food cake, cut into 1 inch cubes 1 8 oz. carton cool whip directions: drain pineapple tidbits, reserving 1 cup juice set aside. combine instant pudding mix, 1/2 cup reserved pineapple juice and milk in a large bowl beat at low speed with an electric mixer for 1 minute or until thickened. fold in sour cream and pineapple tidbits. place 1/3 of cake crumbs in bottom of a 16 cup glass bowl drizzle with 2 to 3 tablespoons remaining reserved pineapple juice. spoon 1/3 of pudding mixture over cake. repeat procedure twice, ending with pudding mixture. cover and chill at least 3 hours.

inputs: flour, sugar, butter, egg, almond paste, nectarines, strawberries, strawberry jam
targets: title: strawberry nectarine almond tart ingredients: 1 1/3 cups all purpose flour 6 tablespoons sugar 1/2 cup 1/4 lb. plus 1 tablespoon butter or margarine 1 large egg, separated 1/2 cup packed almond paste, broken into chunks 2 1/4 cups sliced firm ripe nectarines 1/4 in. thick 3/4 lb. 1 1/2 cups sliced strawberries 1/4 in. thick 1/3 cup strawberry jam directions: in a food processor or bowl, combine flour and 1/4 cup sugar. add 1/2 cup butter, cut into chunks. whirl or rub in with your fingers until fine crumbs form. add egg yolk whirl or mix with a fork until dough holds together. firmly pat into a ball. press dough evenly over bottom and up sides of a 10 to 11 inch tart pan with removable rim. bake in a 300 regular or convection oven until golden, 25 to 30 minutes. meanwhile, in food processor no need to wash or a bowl with a mixer on medium high speed, whirl or beat remaining 2 tablespoons sugar, 1 tablespoon butter, egg white, and almond paste until smooth. gently spread over bottom of tart crust. return to oven and bake until crust is deep golden brown and almond paste mixture feels dry to touch, about 15 minutes. let cool on a rack. arrange nectarines on almond filling in concentric circles around outside of tart, strawberries in the middle. heat jam in a microwave safe bowl in a microwave oven on full power 100 until melted, about 1 minute, stirring after 30 seconds. brush evenly over fruit. chill until jam is set, about 1 hour, or chill airtight up to 6 hours. remove pan rim and cut tart into wedges.

inputs: olive oil, onions, chili powder, leaf oregano, brown rice, water, cider vinegar, sweet green peppers, black beans
targets: title: spanish rice and beans ingredients: 1 1/2 tsp. olive oil 3/4 lb. onions, chopped 2 tsp. chili powder 1 tsp. leaf oregano 1 c. fast cooking brown rice 3/4 c. water 2 tbsp. cider vinegar 1 lb. sweet green peppers, coarsely chopped 1 15 oz. can black beans, rinsed and drained directions: heat oil in saucepan over medium heat. add onion cook, covered, 6 minutes or until softened, stirring occasionally. stir in chili powder and oregano cook 1 minute. stir in rice, water, vinegar and salt. bring to a simmer. scatter peppers on top. cook, covered, 10 minutes. stir in beans. makes 4 servings at 69 cents each.

inputs: white tuna, cream of asparagus soup, milk, crackers, eggs
targets: title: tuna puffs ingredients: 1 7 oz. can white tuna 1 can cream of asparagus soup 1 soup can milk 16 square soda crackers 4 eggs, well beaten directions: flake tuna and crumble crackers in plastic bag or between two sheets of waxed papers. mix soup and milk together. fold in tuna and crackers. then fold in well beaten eggs. bake in square 8 x 8 x 2 inch greased pan at 350 for one hour. test with knife. if it comes out clean, it is done

inputs: elbow macaroni, butter, onion, flour, milk, salt, ground mustard, black pepper, cheddar cheese, american cheese
targets: title: mac is back macaroni and cheese ingredients: 2 cups elbow macaroni, uncooked 2 tablespoons butter or 2 tablespoons margarine 14 cup finely chopped onion optional 2 tablespoons flour 2 cups milk 34 teaspoon salt 12 teaspoon dry ground mustard 14 teaspoon black pepper 2 cups shredded sharp cheddar cheese 8 ounces sliced american cheese, broken into 2 quot pieces directions: heat oven to 350 . in medium saucepan over medium heat, melt butter, add onion. cook 2 minutes. add flour, cook stirring constantly for one minute. stir in milk and seasonings, cook stirring frequently until mixture boils and thickens. stir cheeses into sauce. cook elbows according to package directions, drain. in a 2 quart baking dish, stir together pasta and cheese sauce. bake 30 minutes or until hot and bubbly.

inputs: frozen broccoli, cream of chicken soup, rice, onion, butter
targets: title: broccoli casserole microwave ingredients: 1 pkg. frozen broccoli 1 can cream of chicken soup 1 8 oz. jar cheez whiz 1 c. minute rice uncooked 1 small onion 3/4 stick melted butter directions: mix all ingredients together. cover cook on high for 10 minutes. stir. cook, uncovered, for 2 minutes on high.

inputs: ground turkey, tomatoes, thin sargento, garlic, onion, black pepper, salt, salt, red, worcestershire sauce
targets: title: baked turkey n onion burger ingredients: 1 lb ground turkey 8 leaf lettuce 8 tomatoes 4 slice ultra thin sargento cheddar cheese 1/2 tsp garlic powder 1/2 tsp onion powder 1/2 tsp black pepper 1/2 tsp seasonal salt 1 add salt if you would like 1/2 cup diced red or white onion 4 tbsp worcestershire sauce directions: preheat oven to 350f in a medium bowl combine ground turkey , onion, worcestershire sauce and seasonings and mix together. divide mixture into 4 balls or 6 if you want smaller patties and flatten. place patties on a baking sheet or pan and place in the oven and cook for about 20min on each plate place 2pieces of lettuce and 2 tomato slices. remove patties from oven and place on top of lettuce and tomato and top with cheese add condiments and enjoy

inputs: white bread, process cheese, broccoli, fully cooked ham, eggs, milk, onion, salt, dry mustard, shredded cheese
targets: title: company strata ingredients: 12 slices white bread 12 oz. sharp process cheese, sliced 10 oz. pkg. frozen chopped broccoli 2 c. diced fully cooked ham 6 eggs, slightly beaten 3 1/2 c. milk 2 tbsp. instant minced onion 1/2 tsp. salt 1/4 tsp. dry mustard 8 oz. shredded cheese directions: from 12 slices white bread, cut 12 doughnuts and holes. you will have nicer edges if you freeze the bread before cutting. fit the scraps of bread top crusts removed in bottom of 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking dish. layer cheese slices, broccoli that has been cooked and drained, and ham over bread. arrange doughnuts and holes on top. combine eggs, milk, onion, salt and dry mustard pour over bread. cover refrigerate 6 hours or overnight. bake, uncovered, at 325 for 55 minutes. for a pretty finish, sprinkle with shredded cheese last 5 minutes of baking.

inputs: walnuts, butter, butter, brown sugar, ground cinnamon, buttermilk
targets: title: caramel nut bread ring ingredients: 3/4 cup chopped walnuts, divided 2 tablespoons butter, melted 1/2 cup butter 1 cup firmly packed brown sugar 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon 2 12 oz. cans refrigerated layered buttermilk biscuits directions: preheat oven to 350 . bake walnuts in a single layer in a shallow pan 6 to 8 minutes or until toasted and fragrant. pour 2 tbsp. melted butter into a lightly greased 10 inch 14 cup tube pan. sprinkle 2 tbsp. walnuts over butter in pan. melt 1/2 cup butter in a medium saucepan over medium heat. add brown sugar, and cook 2 minutes or until sugar is melted and begins to bubble. stir in cinnamon and remaining walnuts. cut each biscuit into fourths using kitchen shears or a knife. place 40 biscuit quarters on top of walnuts and butter in pan. top with half of brown sugar mixture. add remaining 40 biscuit quarters, and top with remaining brown sugar mixture. bake at 350 for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown. invert onto a serving plate, and serve immediately. note for testing purposes only, we used pillsbury golden layers buttermilk biscuits.

inputs: cream cheese, carrots, onion, grated bell pepper, pineapple, salt
targets: title: vegetable ball ingredients: 2 pkg. cream cheese, softened 8 oz. pkg. 1/2 c. grated carrots, well drained 2 tbsp. grated onion 1/2 c. grated bell pepper, well drained 1 can crushed pineapple large , well drained 1 tsp. seasoned salt directions: after i let pineapple drain well in a colander, i take it in my hands and squeeze it to get all the juice out that i can. mix all ingredients well make into a ball. roll in chopped pecans or chopped fresh parsley. store in refrigerator until ready to serve. allow to soften for about 15 minutes before serving. very good with wheat thins or other snack crackers.

inputs: cucumbers, salt, sugar, mixed pickling, vinegar
targets: title: ice pickles ingredients: 4 qt. cucumbers 1/3 c. salt 5 c. sugar 1/4 c. mixed pickling spices tied in cloth 3 c. vinegar directions: soak cucumbers and salt in ice water for 3 hours. drain well. bring sugar, pickling spices and vinegar to a boil. add cucumbers to vinegar mixture and bring to a boil. place in jars and seal.

inputs: arepa flour, kosher salt, vegetable oil, pork, lime wedges
targets: title: arepas ingredients: 2 cups arepa flour precooked cornmeal 2 teaspoons kosher salt 2 tablespoons vegetable oil desired fillings such as shredded cooked chicken or pork, stewed black beans with cheese and lime, corn salad with onion and fresh herbs for serving lime wedges for serving directions: combine arepa flour and salt in a medium bowl. make a well in the center and add 2 1/2 cups warm water. using a wooden spoon, gradually incorporate dry ingredients, stirring until no dry lumps remain. let rest 5 minutes to hydrate. knead dough a few times in bowl, then divide into 8 pieces. roll each piece on work surface into a ball, then gently flatten to about 1/2 thick. heat 1 tablespoons oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. add 4 arepas, cover, and cook until golden brown, 6 8 minutes. uncover, flip, and cook keep uncovered until other side is golden brown, 6 8 minutes. transfer arepas to a wire rack. repeat with remaining 1 tablespoons oil and dough. split arepas and stuff with desired fillings serve with lime wedges for squeezing over.

inputs: vinaigrette, balsamic vinegar, honey, poupon, ground black pepper, olive oil, salad, salad greens, cranberries, feta cheese, walnuts
targets: title: cranberry and feta salad with dijon vinaigrette ingredients: dijon vinaigrette 3/4 cup balsamic vinegar 6 tbsp. honey 2 tbsp. grey poupon classic dijon mustard 1 1/2 tsp. ground black pepper 1 1/2 cups olive oil cranberry and feta salad 2 1/2 gal. torn mixed salad greens 1 1/2 qt. dried cranberries 1 1/2 qt. crumbled feta cheese 3 cups coarsely chopped walnuts, toasted directions: dijon vinaigrette beat vinegar, honey, mustard and pepper with whisk until blended. gradually add oil, beating well after each addition. refrigerate until ready to use. salad combine ingredients. refrigerate until ready to use. for each serving toss 2 cups salad with 1 1/2 tbsp. dijon vinaigrette.

inputs: peanut oil, cauliflower florets, broccoli florets, carrot, celery, green onions, red pepper, green pepper, chicken bouillon cubes, boiling water, garlic, onion powder, pepper, cornstarch, water
targets: title: lightly glazed stir fried vegetables ingredients: 2 tablespoons peanut oil 2 cups cauliflower florets 2 cups broccoli florets 1 cup carrot, sliced diagonally 1 cup celery, sliced diagonally 3 green onions, sliced 1 red pepper small 1 green pepper, thinly sliced small 2 chicken bouillon cubes, low sodium is best 1 cup boiling water 2 teaspoons garlic powder or 1 clove minced 1 teaspoon onion powder 14 teaspoon pepper 1 tablespoon cornstarch 2 tablespoons water directions: heat wok or large skillet until very hot. add oil and continue to heat. add cauliflower, broccoli, carrot, celery and stir fry 2 3 minutes. add green onion, red and green pepper and stir fry 2 minutes. dissolve chicken bouillon granules in boiling water and stir in seasonings. add broth to wok, cover and steam about 2 minutes or until vegetables are crisp tender. combine the water and cornstarch and slowly add to vegetables stirring gently to coat well. heat through until thickened and serve immediately.

inputs: raspberry gelatin, boiling water, cranberry sauce, pineapple, orange juice, lemon juice, walnuts, lettuce leaves, mayonnaise
targets: title: cranberry pineapple salad ingredients: 1 6 oz. pkg. raspberry gelatin 1 3/4 c. boiling water 1 16 oz. can jelled cranberry sauce 1 8 oz. can crushed pineapple undrained 3/4 c. orange juice 1 tbsp. lemon juice 1/2 c. chopped walnuts lettuce leaves mayonnaise or salad dressing directions: in a bowl, dissolve gelatin in boiling water. break up and stir in cranberry sauce. add pineapple, orange juice and lemon juice. chill until partially set. stir in nuts. pour into an 11 x 7 x 2 inch dish. chill until firm. cut into squares. serve on lettuce leaf and top with a dollop of mayo. yield 12 servings.

inputs: sugar, margarine, eggs, mashed ripe bananas, milk, vanilla, flour, nuts, baking soda, salt
targets: title: banana bread ingredients: 3/4 c. sugar 1/2 c. margarine or butter, softened 2 eggs 1 c. 2 medium mashed ripe bananas 1/3 c. milk 1 tsp. vanilla 2 c. all purpose flour 1/2 c. chopped nuts if desired 1 tsp. baking soda 1/2 tsp. salt directions: heat oven to 350 . grease bottom only of 9 x 5 inch or 8 x 4 inch loaf pan. in a large bowl beat sugar and margarine until light and fluffy. beat in eggs and blend in bananas, milk and vanilla. lightly spoon flour into measuring cup level off. in a small bowl, combine flour, nuts, soda and salt mix well. add to banana mixture stir just until dry ingredients are moistened. pour into greased pan. bake at 350 for 50 to 60 minutes or until done. remove. cool on wire rack. wrap tightly and store in refrigerator.

inputs: egg, sugar, butter, vanilla, milk, flour, baking powder, salt
targets: title: easy tea doughnuts ingredients: 1 egg 1/3 c. sugar 1 tbsp. melted butter or margarine 1 tsp. vanilla 1/2 c. milk 1 1/3 c. sifted all purpose flour 2 1/2 tsp. baking powder 1/4 tsp. salt directions: beat egg. add sugar, melted butter, vanilla and milk. beat 1 minute. sift flour, baking powder and salt add to egg mixture. beat until well blended. drop by small teaspoonfuls into preheated shortening. fry until golden brown, turning to brown evenly. drain. roll in confectioners sugar.

inputs: sour cream, onion, vegetable soup, water chestnuts, mayonnaise, frozen spinach
targets: title: vegetable dip ingredients: 16 oz. sour cream 1 chopped onion 1 pkg. knorr vegetable soup mix 1 can water chestnuts, chopped 1 1/2 c. mayonnaise 1 10 oz. box frozen spinach, thawed and drained directions: mix together sour cream, mayonnaise, chopped chestnuts, onion and soup mix. drain spinach and squeeze dry add spinach to mix. scoop out long loaf of french bread. fill center with dip.

inputs: peaches, almond extract, sugar, flour
targets: title: peach cobbler ingredients: 29 oz. sliced peaches canned 1 tsp. almond extract 1 1/2 c. sugar 13 tbsp. flour directions: mix flour and sugar. gradually stir in juice from peaches. add peaches and almond extract. pour into 9 x 12 inch cake pan onto raw pie crust and bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes.

inputs: shrimp, italian dressing, lime juice, red pepper, onion, celery, cilantro, baby spinach
targets: title: grilled shrimp salad ingredients: 1 12 lbs shrimp 20 24 count 12 cup zesty italian dressing 12 cup lime juice or 12 cup lemon juice 1 red pepper, seeded, chopped 1 medium onion, finely chopped 1 celery, chopped 1 tablespoon cilantro, chopped 6 cups baby spinach leaves directions: pour dressing and lime juice over shrimp over shrimp in large non metal bowl toss to coat, add all remaining ingredients except lettuce mix lightly cover. refrigerate 1 hour to marinate. drain, reserving marinade. place spinach leaves on serving plate top with shrimp mixture. drizzle with reserved marinade.

inputs: onion, chardonnay wine, butter, flour, fish stock, mushroom, green pepper, garlic, butter, cayenne pepper
targets: title: landry s pontchartrain sauce ingredients: 1 small onion, peeled and chopped fine 1 cup chardonnay wine 1 tablespoon butter no substitutions 1 tablespoon flour 1 cup fish stock or 1 cup chicken stock 1/4 cup mushroom, chopped fine 1 small green pepper, seeded and chopped fine 2 garlic cloves, minced 1/2 cup butter, chopped into 1 tablespoon pieces no substitutions cayenne pepper or tarragon directions: cook the chardonnay and the onion together over a low fire until the wine is reduced and the onion is very soft and transparent. melt 1 tablespoon of butter in another heavy saucepan over medium heat. add the flour and whisk until blended. add the stock a little at a time, whisking constantly until blended and thickened. add the mushrooms, green pepper and garlic. cover and simmer down until the vegetables are soft. remove from heat and add 1/2 cup of butter pieces until melted. add to the chardonnay which should now be reduced to a glaze mixture. blend well over very low heat. season to taste with salt may not be needed , black pepper, cayenne, and tarragon.

inputs: chicken, water, carrots, celery, green onion, frozen peas, chicken, salt, pepper, flour, baking powder, chives, milk, salt, oil
targets: title: dees chicken and dumplings ingredients: 1 4 lb chicken 8 cups water 2 chopped carrots 2 stalks chopped celery 1 chopped green onion 1 cup frozen peas 1 chicken bouillon cube 1 teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon pepper 2 cups flour 3 teaspoons baking powder 1 tablespoon chives optional or 1 tablespoon parsley optional 34 cup milk 12 teaspoon salt 3 tablespoons oil directions: boil chicken with water covering chicken in soup pot with tight lid. add carrots and celery and bullion cook until chicken is falling off bone, about 2 hours take chicken out and debone. chop chicken in bite size pieces. add back to soup pot with onion, peas, salt and pepper. add 2 more cups water. bring back to boiling. in another bowl, mix flour, baking powder, milk, salt and oil and drop by teaspoon in boiling chicken stock. you can add 1 tablespoon parsley or finely chopped chives if you want. cover pot with lid and cook about 20 minutes on a low simmer so it doesn t burn. don t lift lid in the 20 minutes that dumplings are cooking cause the steam cooks the dumplings.

inputs: semi sweet chocolate chips, condensed milk, vanilla, nuts
targets: title: decadent chocolate truffles ingredients: 3 cup 18 ounces semi sweet chocolate chips 1 14 ounce can sweetened condensed milk 1 tbsp vanilla extract i use extra 1 coatings finely chopped toasted nuts, flaked coconut, chocolate sprinkles, colored sprinkles, unsweetened cocoa powder, sifted powdered sugar, tiny candies, colored sugars, and/or frosting directions: in a large saucepan, melt chips with condensed milk. remove from heat. stir in vanilla. pour into medium sized bowl. cover and chill 2 to 3 hours or until firm. shape into 1 inch balls roll in desired coating and/or decorate with frosting and candies. store tightly covered in refrigerator.

inputs: plain yogurt, sour cream, cucumber, cucumber juice, garlic, extra virgin olive oil, salt
targets: title: pure tzatziki sauce of the gods ingredients: 1 cup plain yogurt 1/3 cup sour cream 1/3 cup cucumber 1 tablespoon cucumber juice 1 garlic clove minced 1 teaspoon extra virgin olive oil 1/8 teaspoon salt directions: first, we will make the yogurt cream. put a coffee filter in a strainer. put the strainer into a bowl to catch the liquids that run off from the yogurt. next, put the one cup of plain yogurt into the coffee filter. cover and place in the refrigerator overnight. this will drain off liquids from the yogurt and make it thicker with a consistency like sour cream. you can let it drain up to 24 hours if you wish, but overnight will be okay. the next day, peel a cucumber i use a potato peeler . slice the cucumber in half lengthwise. take a spoon and scrape out the seedy portion in the middle. shred the cucumber on a cheese shredder or using the shredding attachment in your food processor. take 1/3 cup of shredded cucumber and squeeze out the juice into a separate bowl. remove the thickened yogurt from the coffee filter and place in a mixing bowl. add the sour cream, minced garlic, olive oil, salt, shredded cucumber and cucumber juice. mix well then cover and refrigerate if not using immediately.

inputs: flour, sugar, soda, eggs, walnuts, pineapple
targets: title: pineapple nut cake ingredients: 2 c. flour 2 c. sugar 2 tsp. soda 2 beaten eggs 1/2 c. chopped walnuts 18 to 20 oz. can crushed pineapple directions: mix all ingredients together with a spoon. put in ungreased baking dish or pan 9 x 13 inch and bake about 45 minutes to 1 hour at 350 . it can be iced with any kind of frosting. sprinkle top with nuts, if desired.

inputs: shrimp, mayonnaise, onion, worcestershire sauce, lemon, margarine, tabasco sauce, red pepper
targets: title: shrimp salad ingredients: 3 5 oz. cans shrimp 1 c. mayonnaise 1 medium onion, chopped 1/2 tsp. worcestershire sauce juice of 1 lemon 1/2 c. margarine, melted 1/2 tsp. tabasco sauce dash of red pepper directions: drain shrimp and flake add margarine, onion and lemon juice mix. add additional ingredients. press into decorative mold or other container. refrigerate for 24 hours before serving. serve with crackers or bread.

inputs: fresh strawberries, sugar, boiling water
targets: title: strawberry pie ingredients: 2 cups fresh strawberries, sliced 3 ounces sugar free strawberry gelatin 14 cup boiling water directions: spray 9 inch pie plate with pam. place strawberries around pie plate. add boiling water to jello and stir to dissolve. pour jello over strawberries. top with fat free cool whip if desired. refrigerate till set and enjoy.

inputs: cream of chicken, water, rice, chicken breasts, salt
targets: title: chicke n rice ingredients: 2 c. cream of chicken 2 c. water 1 c. rice, uncooked 6 uncooked chicken breasts salt and pepper to taste directions: boil chicken until tender, then remove skin and set aside. then mix soup, water, rice, salt and pepper to taste. spread rice mixture in bottom of a 9 x 13 x 2 inch dish. lay chicken breasts on top of mixture. cover tightly with lid or foil. bake 2 hours at 350 .

inputs: fresh cranberries, oranges, pecans, orange jello, raspberry jello, sugar
targets: title: cranberry jello salad 1 ingredients: 1 lb. fresh cranberries 2 oranges 1 cup pecans, chopped 1 3 oz. package orange jello 1 3 oz. package raspberry jello 1 1/4 cup sugar directions: in blender, grind cranberries and peeled oranges. pour sugar over them and let sit. make jello as per instructions on box you could use 1/4 1/2 cup less water . combine jello and fruit mixture. grease mold or bowl or glass pan with salad oil or mayonnaise and then pour mixture in. chill until it is set.

inputs: butter, brown sugar, flour, milk, egg, vanilla, dates, brown sugar, unsalted butter, boiling water
targets: title: easy sticky toffee dessert ingredients: butter, for baking dish plus 1/4 cup, melted scant 1/3 cup dark brown sugar, packed 1 cup plus 2 tablespoons self rising flour 1/2 cup whole milk 1 egg 1 teaspoon vanilla extract 3/4 cup plus 2 tablespoons chopped, rolled dates 3/4 cup dark brown sugar, packed approximately 2 tablespoons unsalted butter in little blobs 2 1/4 cups boiling water directions: preheat the oven to 375 degrees f and butter a 1 1/2 quart capacity baking dish. combine the sugar with the flour in a large bowl. pour the milk into a measuring cup, beat in the egg, vanilla and melted butter and then pour this mixture over the sugar and flour, stirring with a wooden spoon to combine. fold in the dates then scrape into the prepared baking dish. don t worry if it doesn t look very full it will by the time it cooks. sprinkle the sugar over the cake mixture and dot with butter. pour over the boiling water yes really and transfer to the oven. set the time for 45 minutes, though you might find the dessert needs 5 or 10 minutes more. the top of the dessert should be springy and spongy when it s cooked underneath, the butter, dark brown sugar and boiling water will have turned into a rich, sticky sauce. serve with vanilla ice cream, creme fraiche or heavy or light cream, as you wish.

inputs: red, baking powder, baking soda, xanthan gum, salt, ground cinnamon, coconut oil, nectar, rice milk, vanilla, bananas
targets: title: banana bread/banana chocolate chip bread ingredients: 2 cups bobs red mill gluten free all purpose baking flour 2 teaspoons baking powder 2 teaspoons baking soda 1 teaspoon xanthan gum 1 teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon 1/2 cup coconut oil, plus more for the pan 2/3 cup agave nectar 2/3 cup rice milk 1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract 1 1/2 cups mashed bananas directions: preheat the oven to 325f. lightly grease a 7 x 4 x 3 inch loaf pan with oil. in a medium bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, baking soda, xanthan gum, salt, and cinnamon. add 1/2 cup oil and the agave nectar, rice milk, and vanilla to the dry ingredients. stir until the batter is smooth. using a plastic spatula, gently fold in the bananas until they are evenly distributed throughout the batter. fill the prepared pan halfway with batter. see batter spectacular on page 63 for ideas for using leftover batter. bake the banana bread on the center rack for 35 minutes, rotating the pan 180 degrees after 20 minutes. the finished loaf will bounce back slightly when pressed, and a toothpick inserted in the center will come out clean. let the banana bread stand in the pan for 20 minutes. gently run a knife around the edge of the cake, cover the top of the pan with a cutting board, and invert the loaf onto the board. carefully lift the pan away and re invert the bread onto another cutting board. either cut and serve warm, or wait until completely cool before storing. cover the uncut banana bread with plastic wrap and store at room temperature for up to 3 days.

inputs: orzo, cooking spray, mushrooms, zucchini, butter, oregano, salt, freshly ground black pepper
