targets: title: mushroom and zucchini orzo ingredients: 1 cup uncooked orzo rice shaped pasta cooking spray 1 cup sliced mushrooms 1 cup diced zucchini 1 tablespoon butter 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano 1/4 teaspoon salt 1/4 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper directions: cook orzo according to package directions, omitting salt and fat. drain and keep warm. while orzo cooks, heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. coat pan with cooking spray. add mushrooms and zucchini saute 6 minutes or until tender and browned. combine orzo, mushroom mixture, and remaining ingredients in a large bowl, tossing gently.

inputs: rice, cabbage, salt, pepper, onion, mushrooms, oil, dill
targets: title: stuffed cabbage ingredients: 2 c. cooked rice 1 head cabbage about 3 lb. 2 1/2 tsp. salt 1/4 tsp. pepper 1 large onion, diced 1 c. sliced fresh mushrooms 3 tbsp. oil 2 tbsp. chopped dill directions: brown onions until light brown. add mushrooms, salt, pepper and dill, then combine with rice. steam cabbage and remove thickened part. place ball of rice mixture into the cabbage leaf, then roll as for a bundle, push ends in. put in a baking dish, cover with tomatoes 1 can and a little catsup. add 1 cup water. bake for an hour at 350 . this is a traditional christmas eve dish in many homes.

inputs: pepper, pepper, olive oil, sweet onion, sugar, cilantro, lime juice, salt
targets: title: roasted tomatillo salsa ingredients: 6 medium tomatillos with top core removed and cut in half 1 poblano pepper, cut in half with seeds and ribs removed 2 jalapeno pepper, cut in half with seeds and ribs removed olive oil 1 medium sweet onion, cut in half and sliced 1 tablespoon sugar cilantro leaves, chopped 4 tablespoons lime juice sea salt to taste directions: place tomatillos and peppers on baking sheet, cut side down. brush with olive oil. place under the broiler until vegetables begin to blister and char about 5 7 minutes . remove from heat. while tomatillos and peppers are cooking, saute onions in a bit of olive oil until translucent. take off the heat and sprinkle on sugar to caramelize. place tomatillos including juice they have released in cooking , peppers, onions, cilantro, lime juice and sea salt in a food processor and pulse on high until vegetables are pureed and combined. cool and place in jars to store in the refrigerator for up to 2 weeks. serve with mexican food, meets, tortilla chips

inputs: sausage, hickory flavored barbecue sauce, honey, brown sugar
targets: title: barbecued sausage pieces crock pot ingredients: 1 lb smoked sausage 1 cup hickory flavored barbecue sauce 1/4 cup honey 2 tablespoons brown sugar directions: cur sausage in 1/2 inch pieces. brown in skillet. place in slow cooker. combine remaining ingredients. pour over sausage. cover. cook on low 2 hours.

inputs: new, bacon, salt, pepper, olive oil, fresh cranberries, orange, rosemary, orange marmalade
targets: title: bacon wrapped pork loin with a cranberry orange glaze ingredients: 3 pounds new york top loin pork roast 7 slices bacon salt pepper 1 tablespoon olive oil 1 1/2 cups fresh cranberries 2 orange 1 sprig rosemary chopped 1/3 cup orange marmalade directions: preheat oven to 350 degrees and heat a nonstick skillet on the stove over medium high heat. liberally sprinkle the pork loin with salt, pepper and oil. on the stove, sear the pork over medium heat until its light brown on all sides, 1 to 2 minutes per side. remove the pork from the heat. wrap the pork loin with bacon and place it in the oven. meanwhile, cook your cranberry glaze place cranberries, orange juice and zest, rosemary and orange marmalade in a saucepan. cook the sauce over medium heat for 10 minutes and set aside. after 20 minutes of cooking time, brush about 1/2 the glaze over the pork. cook for an additional 15 minutes for a total cooking time of 35 40 minutes 20 minutes per pound , or until the internal temperature of the pork reaches between 145 to 160 degrees f., using a digital meat thermometer. remove the pork from the oven and let it rest for three minutes. brush the rest of the glaze on the pork.

inputs: butter, sugar, water, white karo, pecans
targets: title: christmas toffee ingredients: 1 lb butter 2 cups sugar 4 tablespoons water 2 tablespoons white karo 1 12 cups chopped pecans 10 ounces hershey bars directions: to make this recipe you must use two things, a wooden spoon, and a candy thermometer. do not stir with anything else. grease a jelly roll pan cookie sheet with sides . put butter in 4 quart saucepan. melt over low heat. set off fire. stir in sugar. place back on fire. low heat. bring to a bubbly boil. add water and karo syrup. insert candy thermometer. cook until temperature reads 290 degrees. set off the fire, remove thermometer and add nuts. pour into greased pan. let cool completely, so that toffee is cold to the touch. melt one chocolate bar in microwave. pour the chocolate over the toffee spreading to cover the entire top of it. let cool completely. if need be, refrigerate if in warm or humid climate. when completely cold, remove toffee from pan and coat the other side with the other melted chocolate bar. let cool completely again. break cooled toffee into pieces. store in parchment paper layers in plastic container with tight fitting lid.

inputs: yeast, water, salt, oleo, molasses, brown sugar, rye flour, white flour
targets: title: swedish rye bread ingredients: 2 pkg. yeast 2 c. warm water 1 tbsp. salt 1/2 c. oleo 1/2 c. molasses 1/3 c. brown sugar 2 1/2 c. rye flour 3 1/2 to 4 c. white flour directions: dissolve yeast in warm water with oleo. add salt, brown sugar and molasses. add rye flour and white flour and knead. bake at 375 until golden brown. makes 2 loaves.

inputs: mushrooms, butter, garlic, parsley, white pepper, salt, shallot, crostini
targets: title: mushroom crostini ingredients: 1 lb. mushrooms, thinly sliced 2 tbsp. butter 2 cloves garlic, minced 1/2 cup parsley, chopped white pepper salt 1 shallot, chopped crostini directions: melt butter in pan. cook mushrooms in butter until all liquid has evaporated. season with salt and pepper. stir in shallots and garlic and cook 1 minute. stir in parsley and spoon over crostini.

inputs: bacon, flour, water, vinegar, sugar, egg
targets: title: hot lettuce ingredients: 6 slices bacon 2 tbsp. flour 2 c. water 3 tbsp. vinegar 3 tbsp. sugar 1 egg directions: fry bacon and drain. mix flour with water, then add vinegar and sugar for a sweet and sour taste. add egg, then add to the fried bacon. cook and stir over medium heat until it bubbles. pour over cut up lettuce slice a hard boiled egg over top.

inputs: sweet paprika, paprika, hot paprika, garlic, skinless, salt, canola oil, wide strips lemon zest, shallots, butter, almonds
targets: title: monkfish almondine ingredients: 1 teaspoon sweet paprika 1/2 teaspoon smoked paprika 1/4 teaspoon hot paprika or ground chipotle pepper 1/2 teaspoon garlic powder four 6 ounce skinless, boneless monkfish fillets or catfish or burbot fine sea salt and freshly ground black pepper canola oil, for frying 4 wide strips lemon zest 2 medium shallots, quartered 4 to 5 tablespoons salted butter 1/3 cup sliced almonds directions: combine the sweet paprika, smoked paprika and hot paprika, and the garlic powder in a small bowl. sprinkle the fish with salt and pepper, and then sprinkle evenly, but sparingly, with the paprika mixture, and rub it in. heat a large, heavy skillet over medium high heat, and add enough oil to coat the bottom of the skillet. when the skillet is hot, add the fish and sear on one side until dark, 3 to 4 minutes. add the lemon zest and shallots to the skillet. flip the fish add the butter and almonds and cook, basting the fish using a large spoon, until the almonds brown and the fish tests tender in the center when poked with a fork or toothpick, 2 to 3 minutes. pick out the lemon zest and discard. transfer the fish, along with the shallots, almonds and some of the butter, to plates and serve right away.

inputs: phyllo, gelatin, milk cold, milk, cocoa, instant coffee, ricotta cheese, sugar, vanilla, cinnamon ground, salt
targets: title: mocha dream pie ingredients: 8 each phyllo filo pastry sheets 12x17 1 package gelatin, unflavored unflavored 1/2 cup milk cold 1/2 cup milk heated to boiling 2 tablespoons cocoa powder unsweetened 2 teaspoons instant coffee 15 ounces ricotta cheese 1/2 cup sugar 1 teaspoon vanilla extract 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon ground 1/4 teaspoon salt directions: preheat oven 350f 180c . spray 9 in pie plate with non stick cooking spray place on baking sheet. place 4 phyllo strudel sheets across pie plate, extending sheets over sides press gently into plate. place remaining 4 sheets in opposite direction across pie plate, extending sheets over sides, to form cross press gently into pie plate. with scissors, cut edge 1 inch beyond rim of plate pierce crust with fork. squeeze phyllo strudel trimmings into small bundles place on baking sheet. spray crust and bundles with cooking spray. bake 15 minutes or until golden brown cool on wire rack. in blender, sprinkle unflavored gelatin over cold milk let stand 2 minutes. add hot milk, cocoa and instant coffee and process at low speed until completely dissolved, about 2 minutes. add remaining ingredients and process at high speed until thoroughly blended, scraping sides once, about 2 minutes. pour into prepared crust chill until firm, at least 2 hours. garnish with phyllo bundles.

inputs: vanilla wafers, pecans, cherries, pineapple, white raisins, eggs, white sugar, carnation, salt
targets: title: vanilla wafer fruitcake ingredients: 13 oz. bag vanilla wafers, crushed 2 c. pecans, chopped 1/2 lb. cherries candied 1/2 lb. pineapple candied 5 oz. white raisins 2 eggs 1/2 c. white sugar 1 small can carnation 1/4 tsp. salt directions: place crushed vanilla wafers in large bowl. add chopped cherries, pineapple, pecans and raisins. mix well using hands. beat eggs, sugar, milk and salt together. pour over fruit. mix well with hands. place in greased tube pan and press down with hand. wet hand before pressing, it will not stick to cake. bake 1 hour at 325 . cool 15 minutes before removing.

inputs: brown sugar, powdered sugar, vanilla, sour cream, bar snickers, apple
targets: title: candy bar apple dip ingredients: 3/4 cup packed brown sugar 1/2 cup powdered sugar 1 teaspoon vanilla 1 8 ounce container light sour cream 1 2 2/3 ounce bar snickers candy bars, chopped sliced apple directions: in a medium bowl, mix brown sugar, powdered sugar, vanilla and sour cream with an electric mixer at medium speed until blended. stir in chopped snickerstm bar. cover and chill at least 1 hour before serving as a dip with apple slices.

inputs: sauce, sauce, ketchup, mayonnaise, sugar, granules, ground sesame seeds
targets: title: easy homemade tonkatsu sauce ingredients: 5 tbsp japanese worcestershire style sauce 5 tbsp okonomiyaki sauce 1 tsp ketchup 2 tsp mayonnaise 1/2 tsp sugar 1/2 tsp dashi stock granules 2 to 3 tablespoons ground sesame seeds directions: combine all the ingredients except for the sesame seeds and mix well. microwave for 30 seconds. add the ground sesame seeds. mix together and it s done

inputs: garlic, salt, anchovies, lemon juice, egg, olive oil, romaine lettuce, garlic, parmesan cheese
targets: title: diane s caesar salad ingredients: 2 garlic cloves, crushed 1/2 tsp. salt and pepper 6 oil packed anchovies, rinsed and chopped optional 1 tbsp. lemon juice 1 egg raw or coddled 1 minute or use second nature egg substitute 1/3 c. olive oil 1 head romaine lettuce 1 c. garlic and onion croutons parmesan cheese directions: in large bowl, mix garlic, salt, pepper, anchovies, lemon juice and egg. add olive oil and mix to combine. add lettuce and toss. add parmesan cheese and croutons and toss again. serves 4.

inputs: sausages, corn tortillas, vegetable oil, tooth picks
targets: title: mexican hotdogs ingredients: 1 packages large hotdogs or smoked sausages 12 1 dozen corn tortillas 4 cup vegetable oil 1 dozen tooth picks directions: heat tortillas in microwave for 30 seconds to make them more flexible 6 at a time heat oil over medium heat don t make the oil too hot or the dog will be cold even though the outside is crispy roll each hot dog in a tortilla putting a tooth pick through each one to hold it. put each hot dog into the oil seem down by pusshing most of the tooth pick through holding it by the pick and sliding it the last bit into the oil cook making 1/4 turns until each side is crispy cooking at medium heat will heat the dogs with out the burning the tortilla.

inputs: paprika, oregano, salt, black pepper, ground cumin, garlic, catfish fillets, light butter, lemon slices
targets: title: blackened catfish fillets ingredients: 1 tablespoon paprika 1 1/2 teaspoons dried oregano 1/2 teaspoon salt 1/2 teaspoon black pepper 1/4 teaspoon ground cumin 1/8 teaspoon garlic powder 4 6 ounce catfish fillets 1 tablespoon light butter lemon slices optional directions: combine first 6 ingredients in a small bowl, and stir well. rinse fillets, and pat dry with paper towels to remove excess moisture. sprinkle paprika mixture evenly on both sides of fillets gently rub in seasonings. place a 12 inch cast iron skillet over high heat until hot. add 1 1/2 teaspoons butter, and tilt pan to coat bottom. add 2 fillets, and cook 2 minutes. reduce heat to medium turn and cook 4 minutes or until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork. repeat procedure with remaining butter and fillets. serve with lemon slices, if desired. serve immediately. carbo rating 1

inputs: apple, pear, sugar, vanilla bean, lingonberries, cream
targets: title: titta bere ingredients: 1 apple 1 pear 2 tablespoons sugar 1 vanilla bean, chopped 12 16 ounces lingonberries 1 pint whipped cream directions: about 1 week before serving, cook the apple and pear peeled and chopped with the sugar to mush. add the chopped vanilla bean and jar of lingonberries. cook for a short time cool and store in refrigerator for a week stir once in a while . when ready to serve, beat one pint of whipped cream add lingonberry mixture to it and serve in sherbet glasses.

inputs: peanut butter, nutella chocolate hazelnut spread, minni, banana, flour tortillas, butter
targets: title: gooey desert quesadialla ingredients: 1 peanut butter 1 nutella chocolate hazelnut spread 1 minni marshmellows 1 banana 2 flour tortillas 1 tbsp butter directions: spread one side of a tortilla with peanut butter, and the other one with nuitlla. heat pan at medium high heat. add butter. wait until bubbling. place one side of tortilla in pan, top with banana and marshmellows. place other tortilla on top. cook for 3 minutes or until browned. flip cook for 3 minutes on other side or until brown. transfer to plate and cut with pizza cutter.

inputs: greek yogurt, brown sugar, honey, eggs, vanilla, bananas, ground oats, baking soda, baking powder, salt, ground cinnamon, peanut butter
targets: title: peanut butter swirl banana bread ingredients: 1/2 cup plain greek yogurt 1/4 cup brown sugar 1/4 cup honey 2 eggs or 3 egg whites 1 teaspoon vanilla extract 2 mashed bananas large 2 cups ground oats just put them in the blender or food processor 1 teaspoon baking soda 1 teaspoon baking powder 1 teaspoon sea salt 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon 1/4 cup creamy peanut butter directions: preheat oven to 350 f. in a large bowl, mix the yogurt, brown sugar, honey, eggs, vanilla, and mashed bananas. in a separate bowl, combine oat flour, baking soda, baking powder, sea salt, and cinnamon. add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and gently fold together until everything is moistened and mixed don t over mix pour the batter into a lightly greased 9 x 5 inch loaf pan. gently spoon peanut butter on the banana bread and then use a knife to swirl the peanut butter through the bread. bake the bread for 40 45 minutes until it is cooked through and starts to turn golden . allow the bread to cool for about 5 minutes...turn in out onto a cooking rack and allow to cool at least 10 minutes before cutting. makes 1 loaf.

inputs: all purpose, whole wheat flour, bran, baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon, honey, egg, peach yogurt, vegetable oil, peaches
targets: title: honey peach bran muffins ingredients: 1/2 cup all purpose flour 3/4 cup whole wheat flour 1/4 cup wheat bran 1 teaspoon baking powder 1 teaspoon baking soda 1 teaspoon cinnamon 1/4 cup honey 1 egg white, lightly beaten 1 cup peach yogurt 1/4 cup vegetable oil 1/2 cup drained chopped canned peaches directions: preheat oven to 350 degrees f. combine flours, bran, baking powder, baking soda, and cinnamon. separately, combine honey, egg white, yogurt, and oil stir well. pour liquid into dry ingredients stir until just moistened. add peaches. pour into greased muffin tins. bake at 350 degrees f for 18 20 minutes or until lightly browned.

inputs: all purpose, , butter, powdered sugar, vanilla, almond extract
targets: title: best ever butter cookies ingredients: 2 cups all purpose flour 1/4 teaspoons salt 1 cup unsalted butter 1/2 cups powdered sugar 1 teaspoon vanilla 1 teaspoon almond extract directions: in a small bowl whisk the flour with the salt. set aside. in the bowl of your electric mixer or with a hand mixer , cream the butter until smooth about 1 minute . add the powdered sugar and beat until smooth about 2 minutes . beat in the vanilla and almond extract. gently stir the flour mixture into the creamed mixture, just until incorporated. note this is super important when i took my expert cookie class in nyc last february at the institute of culinary education, chef jeff taught us that the more you mix in the dry ingredients the worse your cookie will be... because the gluten releases and makes the cookie lose its tenderness . flatten the dough into a disk shape, wrap in plastic wrap, and chill the dough for at least an hour. preheat oven to 350 degrees f 177 degrees c with the rack in the middle of the oven. line baking sheets with parchment paper. on a lightly floured surface roll out the dough to 1/4 inch .5 cm thick. i used my dough bands to achieve a perfectly even thickness. cut into rounds or whatever shapes you wish using a lightly floured cookie cutter. place the cookies on the prepared baking sheet and place in the refrigerator for about 15 minutes. this will firm up the dough so the cookies will maintain their shape when baked. bake for 8 10 minutes, or until cookies are lightly brown. cool on rack. flood with royal icing watered down to a consistency that will flow. or you can use whatever icing/frosting recipe is your favorite. shortbread will keep in an airtight container for about a week or frozen for several months. makes about 20 shortbread cookies or if you are a super freak like me you can quadruple this recipe and make 80

inputs: lemon, extra virgin olive oil, lemon juice, parmesan, pepper, salt, gem lettuces, parmesan
targets: title: little gem lettuces with preserved lemon dressing ingredients: 1 large preserved meyer lemon or 1 small preserved regular lemon 1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil 1 tablespoon meyer lemon juice or 2 tsp. regular lemon juice 2 tablespoons freshly grated parmesan 1/4 teaspoon pepper fine sea salt 1 pound little gem lettuces about 4 heads, separated into leaves 1/4 cup shaved parmesan directions: scrape out and discard flesh of preserved lemon. rinse peel and put in a blender or food processor. add olive oil, lemon juice, parmesan, pepper, and a pinch of salt to taste. blend until emulsified. dip a leaf into dressing to taste add more salt or lemon juice if you like. put lettuces in a large bowl or on a platter and drizzle with dressing. toss gently to coat. add about 1/4 cup shaved parmesan and toss gently once more.

inputs: shrimp boil, salt, water, kielbasa polish sausage, corn, shrimp
targets: title: frogmore stew ingredients: 3 tbsp. shrimp boil old bay seasoning 3 tbsp. salt 1 1/2 gal. water 2 lb. kielbasa polish sausage, cut into 2 inch pieces 12 ears fresh or frozen corn 3 to 4 inch pieces 4 lb. shrimp in shell directions: in large stockpot, add seasonings to water. bring to a boil. add sausage and boil, uncovered, 5 minutes. add corn count 5 minutes. add shrimp count 3 minutes. don t wait for liquid to return to a boil before timing corn and shrimp. drain immediately and serve. serve with cocktail sauce, sweet and sour mustard or hot mustard. serves 8.

inputs: cream chicken, soy sauce, green beans, french fried onions, pepper
targets: title: green bean casserole ingredients: 1 can cream chicken or mushroom soup 1 tsp. soy sauce 2 10 oz. cans green beans, cooked and drained 1 3 1/2 oz. can french fried onions dash pepper directions: heat oven to 350 . use deep 1 1/2 quart casserole. mix soup and soy sauce until smooth. add green beans, 1/2 of onions, and pepper. mix well. bake 20 minutes. sprinkle remaining onions over beans and bake 5 minutes longer or until onions are crisp.

inputs: milk, eggs, flour, salt, butter, brown sugar, cream cheese, sour cream, vanilla, thin apple, walnuts
targets: title: apples n cream pancake ingredients: 1/2 c. milk 2 eggs 1/2 c. flour 1/4 tsp. salt 1 tbsp. butter 1/4 c. packed brown sugar 1 3 oz. pkg. cream cheese, softened 1/2 c. sour cream 1/2 tsp. vanilla 1 1/2 c. thin apple slices 1/4 c. chopped walnuts directions: combine milk, eggs, flour and salt beat until smooth. heat heavy ovenproof 9 inch skillet in 450 oven until very hot. add butter to coat skillet pour in batter immediately. bake on lowest oven rack at 450 for 10 minutes. reduce oven temperature to 350 . continue baking 10 minutes or until golden brown. combine cream cheese and sugar, mixing until well blended. add sour cream and vanilla mix well. fill pancake with 3/4 cup cream cheese mixture cover with apples. top with remaining cream cheese mixture. sprinkle with walnuts. cut into wedges. serve immediately. makes 6 to 8 servings.

inputs: fresh spinach, sour cream, onion, bread crumbs, cheese, pepper
targets: title: summer squash delight ingredients: 2 medium size yellow squash 2 c. fresh spinach 1/2 c. sour cream 1/4 c. chopped onion bread crumbs thin shredded cheese pepper for flavor directions: cut squash lengthwise and boil for 5 minutes. scoop out seeds. bring 2 cups of spinach to a boil, drain when completed. combine together spinach, chopped onion and sour cream. place spinach inside each piece of squash. sprinkle on bread crumbs, lightly. finally top with shredded cheese. bake at 325 for 30 minutes.

inputs: minute rice, onion soup mix, soup, water, soup, chicken
targets: title: roasted chicken n rice casserole ingredients: 1 cup minute rice 1/2 package onion soup mix 1 x soup, cream of chicken can 1 1/2 x water can 1 x soup, cream of mushroom canned 1 cup chicken, whole directions: mix all ingredients except chicken in a 9 x 13 inch baking pan. add cut up chicken parts, skin side up. bake covered 2 hours at 350f 180c or 3 hours at 300 degrees.

inputs: red lentil, vegetable stock, onion, white potato, paprika, salt, pepper
targets: title: turkish red lentil soup ingredients: 1 cup red lentil, washed and cleaned 4 cups vegetable stock 1/4 cup mild onion, finely chopped 1/2 cup white potato, peeled and diced 1 teaspoon paprika 1 teaspoon salt to taste pepper to taste directions: place the red lentils in a colandar and rinse. sift through to remove and debris or damaged beans. place the washed and cleaned lentils into a medium pot with the stock, potatoes, onions and paprika. bring the pot to a boil and reduce to a simmer. loosely place a lid on the pot leaving slightly ajar as to allow some evaporation. cook for 40 40 minutes until the lentils are tender. add salt and pepper to taste. place all but 1 cup of the soup into a blender or food processor and blend briefly. return blended soup to the pot with the reserved cup of soup. heat through. serve.

inputs: pork loin roast, clove garlic, ancho chilies, commercial chili powder, ground cayenne, oregano, thyme, ground cumin, garlic, ground coriander, celery salt, bacon, garlic, red bell pepper, green bell pepper, pepper, ancho chili, italian plum tomatoes, onion, red wine, veal, pudding
targets: title: roast loin of pork with southwestern sauce ingredients: 1 3 pound pork loin roast, boned and tied 1 large clove garlic, peeled and halved 2 ancho chilies see note 6 tablespoons commercial chili powder 1 tablespoon ground cayenne 1 tablespoon good quality oregano, crumbled 1 tablespoon dried thyme, crumbled 1 tablespoon ground cumin 1 tablespoon garlic powder 1 tablespoon ground coriander 1 tablespoon celery salt 4 strips bacon 1/2 teaspoon minced garlic 1 medium red bell pepper, seeded, veined and finely diced 1 medium green bell pepper, seeded and finely diced 1 poblano pepper, seeded and finely diced 1 ancho chili, finely diced 3 ripe italian plum tomatoes, diced 1 small onion, peeled and finely diced 1/2 cup dry red wine 3 cups good veal or pork stock corn pudding see recipe directions: preheat the oven to 475 degrees. rub the pork all over with the cut clove of garlic. discard the garlic. set the meat on a rack in a roasting pan. remove the stems from two anchos and place the chilies in a blender jar. chop and grind them to a fairly fine powder. transfer this to a small mixing bowl. stir in the chili powder, cayenne, oregano, thyme, cumin, garlic powder, coriander and celery salt. stir until completely mixed. remove a half cup of the mixture and set aside for sauce. rub the remainder all over the roast to coat completely. set the roast in the oven and cook for 30 minutes. transfer the meat from the oven onto a wire rack to cool for 30 minutes. it will still be raw in the center, but the cooking will be finished later this cooling period will guarantee even cooking and very tender meat. reduce the oven temperature to 375 degrees. while the roast is cooking, start the sauce. cook the bacon in a large skillet over low heat to render the fat. remove the bacon from the pan and reserve. drain off all but about two tablespoons of the fat. add the minced garlic and saute for one minute. add the red and green peppers, poblano, ancho, tomatoes and onion. sprinkle the reserved spice mixture over the vegetables and cook over medium heat, stirring frequently, until they are soft, about 15 minutes. pour the red wine over the vegetables and cook until the mixture is reduced to just a glaze. pour in the veal stock and continue cooking over medium heat until the liquid is reduced by about half, about 15 minutes. crumble the reserved bacon into the sauce. keep it warm while finishing the roast. return the pork roast to the oven at 375 degrees. cook 20 to 25 minutes, until a meat thermometer inserted in the center reads 137 degrees. remove from the oven and transfer to a rack. let cool slightly before slicing into medallions. serve the roast on a pool of the vegetable sauce, with corn pudding on the side.

inputs: sugar, salt, eggs, lemon, flour, baking powder, pecans, cranberry sauce
targets: title: cranberry coffee bars ingredients: 1 c. sugar a little salt 2 eggs juice of 1/2 lemon 1 1/2 c. flour 1 1/2 tsp. baking powder 1 c. chopped pecans 1/2 large can jellied cranberry sauce directions: beat together the first 4 ingredients, then add flour, baking powder and beat until smooth. fold in nuts and add cranberry sauce. spread in a 9 x 12 inch pan. bake 25 to 30 minutes at 350 . while warm, frost with lemon butter frosting. confectioners sugar, warm milk, butter and lemon juice. cut in small squares.

inputs: unsalted butter, brown sugar, all purpose, cinnamon, kosher salt, flour, baking powder, cinnamon, kosher salt, unsalted butter, sugar, eggs, milk, pear preserves, confectioners sugar
targets: title: crumb cake with pear preserves ingredients: 4 tablespoons unsalted butter, diced, plus more for greasing 1/2 cup packed light brown sugar 1/2 cup all purpose flour 1 teaspoon cinnamon 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt 2 cups all purpose flour 2 teaspoons baking powder 1 teaspoon cinnamon 3/4 teaspoon kosher salt 1 stick unsalted butter, softened 1 cup granulated sugar 3 large eggs 3/4 cup whole milk 1/2 cup pear preserves 4 ounces confectioners sugar, for dusting directions: make the streusel preheat the oven to 350 and butter a 9 inch square metal baking pan. in a medium bowl, mix the brown sugar with the flour, cinnamon and salt. add the 4 tablespoons of diced butter and, using your fingers, pinch it into the dry ingredients until evenly moistened, then press the mixture into clumps. refrigerate the streusel until chilled, about 15 minutes. meanwhile, make the cake in a medium bowl, whisk the flour with the baking powder, cinnamon and salt. in a large bowl, using an electric mixer, beat the butter with the granulated sugar at medium speed until fluffy, 2 minutes. beat in the eggs 1 at a time. scrape down the side of the bowl, then beat in the dry ingredients and milk in 3 alternating batches, starting and ending with the dry ingredients, until just incorporated. meanwhile, make the cake scrape the batter into the prepared pan, spreading it in an even layer. dollop the pear preserves evenly in the batter and sprinkle the streusel evenly on top. bake for about 50 minutes, until a toothpick inserted in the center of the cake comes out clean. some of the streusel will sink into the cake. transfer the pan to a rack and let the cake cool completely, about 1 hour. dust with confectioners sugar, cut into squares and serve.

inputs: milk, powdered milk, honey, plain yogurt
targets: title: diy fresh yogurt ingredients: 1 quart 2 low fat milk 1/2 cup powdered milk 1 2 tablespoon honey 1/2 cup plain yogurt, room temperature directions: pour the milk into a small saucepan and whisk in the powdered milk and honey. place over medium heat and bring to 120 degrees f on an instant read thermometer. once the milk has reached has reached the target temperature, pour it into a cylindrical plastic container, reserving 1/2 cup. whisk the reserved milk into the yogurt and add it back to the milk mixture. place the container into a narrow wine bucket lined with a heating pad. set the heating pad to medium. let the mixture ferment for 3 to 12 hours, making sure the temperature stays as close to 115 degrees f as possible. after the fermentation is complete, refrigerate overnight.

inputs: olive oil, zucchini, crookneck squash, red pepper, crust, garlic, mozzarella cheese, drained oil, parmesan cheese
targets: title: superfast vegetarian pizza ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive oil 1 medium zucchini, diced 1 medium size yellow crookneck squash, diced 1/2 tablespoon dried crushed red pepper 1 16 ounce baked cheese pizza crust such as boboli 1 14 ounce jar mushroom pizza sauce 3 large garlic cloves, minced 1 cup packed shredded mozzarella cheese about 4 ounces 1/2 cup drained oil packed sun dried tomatoes, thinly sliced 1/3 cup grated parmesan cheese directions: preheat oven to 450f. heat oil in heavy medium skillet over medium heat. add zucchini, yellow squash and crushed red pepper saute until vegetables are almost tender, about 5 minutes. place pizza crust on baking sheet. spread mushroom sauce over. sprinkle with garlic, then mozzarella. top with squash mixture and tomatoes. sprinkle with parmesan cheese. bake pizza until cheese melts and crust is crisp, about 13 minutes. cut into pieces.

inputs: cream cheese, vanilla, equal sugar, graham cracker crust, fresh strawberries, gelatin, cold water, cornstarch
targets: title: strawberry cream pie ingredients: 1 8 ounce package fat free cream cheese 1 teaspoon vanilla 2 packages equal sugar substitute 1 graham cracker crust fresh strawberries 1 package wild strawberry sugar free gelatin 1 cup cold water 2 teaspoons cornstarch directions: beat cream cheese, vanilla and sweetener till fluffy and smooth. spread this in the pie crust. bring the water and cornstarch to boil till thick about 1 minute . add the gelatin and stir till dissolved. let it cool a few minutes while you slice a layer of strawberries over the cream cheese mixture, pour the gelatin mixture over the berries and then garnish with more strawberries. let cool in fridge and serve with whipped cream. this is a recipe that the dieters as well as non dieters in our house really enjoyed

inputs: chili pods, hot oil, cream of chicken soup, corn tortillas, chicken breasts, garlic, cheddar cheese, onions
targets: title: green chili enchiladas ingredients: 8 chili pods or 2 cans diced green chili 2 tbsp. hot oil 2 cans cream of chicken soup corn tortillas 4 small chicken breasts 1/4 tsp. minced garlic cheddar cheese, shredded 1/4 c. chopped onions directions: roast chili pods in hot oil. peel chili under cold running water. remove seeds. place in blender with enough water to cover chili pods. chop. boil chicken breasts, set aside. put chili in saucepan, add cream of chicken soup and 1 can of water. bring to a boil. add garlic, onions and diced chicken. simmer for 5 minutes. layer corn tortillas, sauce and cheese. bake at 350 for 20 to 25 minutes. serves 4.

inputs: premade, cream cheese, brown sugar, peanut butter, vanilla, green apples, caramel ice cream topping, pecans
targets: title: caramel apple pizza ingredients: 18 ounces premade refrigerated sugar cookie dough 1 8 ounce package cream cheese, room temp 1/2 cup packed brown sugar 1/4 cup creamy peanut butter 1 teaspoon vanilla 2 green apples 1/4 cup caramel ice cream topping 1/2 cup chopped pecans directions: preheat oven to 350 f roll out dough into a large cookie should be about 3/4 thick on a cookie sheet. bake appx. 17 minutes or until light brown. remove from oven cool 10 minutes. combine cream cheese, brown sugar, peanut butter and vanilla with a speed mixer until well blended. spread mixture evenly over cookie. peel and slice your apples. cut apple slices into bite sized chunks and arrange evenly over pizza. microwave caramel topping appx. 45 seconds or until warm drizzle evenly over apples. chop pecans sprinkle over apples. serve this pizza by cutting it into wedges.

inputs: pork loin roast, sauerkraut, apples, onions, brown sugar
targets: title: pork roast with apples, beer, and sauerkraut ingredients: 1 3 pound pork loin roast 1 20 ounce can sauerkraut, drained 2 large apples, cored and quartered 2 large onions, quartered 1/3 cup brown sugar 1 12 fluid ounce can or bottle beer, or as needed directions: preheat oven to 250 degrees f 120 degrees c . place pork roast into a large baking dish and scatter sauerkraut around the roast. arrange apple and onion quarters around the roast. sprinkle sauerkraut, apples, and onions with brown sugar. pour beer over roast and sauerkraut mixture. cover dish with aluminum foil and seal foil to the edges of the dish. bake in the preheated oven until roast is tender and pan juices are reduced, 3 to 4 hours. if roast, vegetables, and apples seem dry, pour in 1 more can beer. to serve, gently toss sauerkraut with apple and onion quarters and serve with the roast.

inputs: mayonnaise, yellow mustard, ketchup, worcestershire sauce, lemon juice, garlic, cayenne pepper, cilantro, sage, black pepper, pork chops
targets: title: condiment chops ingredients: 3 tablespoons mayonnaise 1/4 cup prepared yellow mustard 1/3 cup ketchup 1/4 cup worcestershire sauce 2 teaspoons lemon juice 1 tablespoon garlic powder 1 tablespoon cayenne pepper 1 pinch dried cilantro 1 pinch dried sage black pepper to taste 6 pork chops directions: preheat oven to 350 degrees f 175 degrees c . whisk the mayonnaise, mustard, ketchup, worcestershire sauce, lemon juice, garlic powder, cayenne, cilantro, sage, and black pepper together in a large bowl. dip the pork chops into the sauce to coat thickly. place chops in a 9x13 inch baking dish. bake chops in the preheated oven until the juices run clear, about 50 minutes. place a large skillet over medium high heat. pan fry the baked chops in the hot skillet, basting chops with sauce from the baking dish. cook until glazed, about 3 minutes per side.

inputs: hot dog buns, swiss cheese, turkey breast, buttermilk, shredded lettuce, tomato
targets: title: tasty toasted turkey sub ingredients: 2 98 fat free hot dog buns 2 kraft slim cut swiss cheese slices 12 slices oscar mayer deli fresh mesquite smoked turkey breast 1 tbsp. kraft buttermilk ranch dressing 1/2 cup shredded lettuce 1 tomato, cut into 4 slices, then cut in half directions: heat broiler. open buns place, cut sides up, on foil covered baking sheet. top with cheese, turkey and dressing. broil, 6 inches from heat, 3 to 4 min. or until cheese is melted and sandwiches are heated through. top with tomatoes and lettuce fold in half.

inputs: butter, white onion, celery stalks, flour, chicken broth, cheddar cheese, pimientos, freshly ground black pepper, salt
targets: title: pimiento cheese soup ingredients: 4 tablespoons 1/2 stick unsalted butter 1 small white onion, finely chopped 3 celery stalks, leaves and all, finely chopped 2/3 cup unbleached all purpose flour 5 cups chicken broth 1 1/2 pounds extra sharp cheddar cheese, grated 5 cups 1 quart half and half 2 4 ounce jars diced pimientos, rinsed and drained 1 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper salt directions: in a large soup pot set over medium low heat, cook the butter, onion, and celery for 6 minutes or until the onion turns translucent. add the flour and stir until completely blended. slowly add the broth, whisking until any lumps disappear. turn the heat to low, then bit by bit stir in the cheese and half and half until the mixture is smooth. add the pimientos and pepper, then season with salt. cook, stirring often, for 10 minutes.

inputs: cream of celery, sour cream, milk, tuna, noodles, buttered bread crumbs, salt
targets: title: tuna chicken turkey casserole ingredients: 1 can cream of celery or mushroom soup 1/2 c. sour cream 1/2 to 3/4 c. milk 1 c. tuna, chicken or turkey 2 c. cooked wide noodles 2 tbsp. buttered bread crumbs salt and pepper to taste directions: mix all ingredients. top with buttered crumbs. bake at 350 for 30 minutes.

inputs: semisweet ground chocolate, chocolate stout, suggestion
targets: title: chocolate velvet ingredients: semisweet ground chocolate optional 2 ounces chocolate stout, preferably a robust one recommended young s 2 ounces prosecco serving suggestion chilled champagne flute directions: if desired, rim the glass with chocolate pour some ground chocolate onto a small plate. roll the outer rim edge of the champagne flute in the chocolate. pour the stout into the glass, taking care to make as little foam as possible. the best way to do this tilt the glass and pour the beer slowly down the inside of the glass. slowly pour prosecco down over the back of a spoon and into the glass, layering the two alcohols for a dramatic cocktail. drink. from food network kitchen this recipe has been updated and may differ from what was originally published or broadcasted.

inputs: dish pie shell, eggs, parmesan cheese, swiss cheese, gruyere cheese, salt, vegetables
targets: title: authentic french quiche ingredients: 1 deep dish pie shell either pre made or frozen 4 eggs 1/2 pint half and half parmesan cheese to taste 1 cup swiss cheese shredded 1/2 cup gruyere cheese shredded or crumbled salt and pepper 1/3 1/3 cup any already cooked meat or 1/3 cup vegetables directions: pre bake pie shell 425 for ten minutes with parmesan covering bottom. this prevents soggy crust. just sprinkle parmesan to cover bottom before pre baking. saute leftovers for a minute or two to warm. mix cheeses to slightly soften in pan with leftovers. if using no leftovers just put cheese in pre baked pie shell. mix eggs, half and half and spices to taste. pour egg mixture into pie shell containing leftovers or just cheese. bake 425 for 25 mins until toothpick inserted comes out clean.

inputs: ground beef, onions, carrots, tomato sauce, garlic, spaghetti, romanoff cheese, oregano
targets: title: spaghetti for 100 ingredients: 20 to 25 lb. ground beef 3 c. chopped onions 8 carrots, grated 5 gal. tomato sauce 1 1/2 c. minced garlic 10 lb. spaghetti 2 c. romanoff cheese, grated spices oregano, parsley flakes, italian seasoning, sweet basil, bay leaf, salt, pepper and romanoff cheese season to taste directions: cook meat until beginning to turn color. add onion and continue to cook until just done and light brown. drain off fat. put in large container or divide into 2 pots. add the rest of the ingredients, except the spaghetti. simmer about 2 hours, stirring occasionally to prevent sticking. serve over cooked spaghetti.

inputs: flour, sugar, salt, baking soda, cocoa, vanilla, oil, zucchini
targets: title: zucchini brownies ingredients: 2 cups flour 1 1/2 cups sugar 1 teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon baking soda 1/2 cup cocoa 2 tablespoons vanilla 1/2 cup oil 2 cups peeled and grated zucchini directions: combine the flour, sugar, salt, baking soda, and cocoa in a bowl. add the vanilla, oil, and zucchini and mix well. bake in an ungreased 9 x 13 inches pan at 350 degrees fahrenheit for 30 minutes. note you can substitute the sugar for splenda or add a 1/2 cup of chopped nuts if you wish.

inputs: mayonnaise, flour, eggs, milk, crab meat, swiss cheese, green onion, pie shell
targets: title: crab pie ingredients: 1/2 c. mayonnaise 2 tbsp. flour 2 eggs, beaten 1/2 c. milk 7 1/2 oz. can crab meat, drained 1 8 oz. pkg. swiss cheese, diced 1/3 c. green onion pie shell directions: mix first 4 ingredients until blended. stir in crab meat, cheese and onion. pour into pie shell. bake at 350 for 40 to 45 minutes.

inputs: vanilla, vanilla frosting, oil, water, eggs, chocolate chips, sprinkles, maraschino cherries
targets: title: ice cream sundae cupcakes ingredients: 1 box miss jones baking co. organic vanilla cake mix 1 jar miss jones baking co. organic vanilla frosting 1/3 cup oil 2/3 cup water 3 eggs 1/4 cup chocolate chips sprinkles maraschino cherries directions: preheat oven to 350 f. prepare and bake cupcakes according to package directions, filling each ice cream cone approximately halfway full with batter. set each ice cream cone in a mini or normal cupcake pan to stabilize while baking. let cool completely. top cupcakes with vanilla frosting using a pastry bag fitted with a star tip. top with sprinkles. melt chocolate chips and place in a pastry bag or ziploc bag with the end corner trimmed off. pipe onto frosting and let cool slightly before topping with a cherry. bon appetit

inputs: unsalted butter, sugar, eggs, vanilla, dutch, flour, baking soda, salt, white sanding sugar
targets: title: top secret chocolate cookies ingredients: 1 1/4 cups unsalted butter, at room temperature 2 cups sugar 2 large eggs 1 tablespoon vanilla extract 3/4 cup dutch processed cocoa powder 2 cups all purpose flour 1 teaspoon baking soda 1/2 teaspoon salt white sanding sugar, for garnish directions: in a large bowl, add the butter and sugar and cream together with a hand mixer. add the eggs and vanilla extract to the creamed mixture and mix until combined. in a medium bowl, mix the cocoa powder, flour, baking soda, and salt. slowly add the dry ingredients and continue mixing until incorporated. roll the dough into 2 logs that are about 2 inches high and 1 foot long. wrap them in waxed paper and place in a refrigerator for 2 hours. preheat oven to 350 degrees. once thoroughly chilled, slice the cookies into 1/2 inch thick rounds and cover with sanding sugar. place on a parchment paper lined cookie sheet and bake for 10 minutes. remove to a wire rack to cool.

inputs: strawberry yogurt, milk, peach, banana, maple syurp
targets: title: peach banana smoothie ingredients: 3 tablespoons strawberry yogurt 1/4 cup milk 1 peach 1 ripe banana 2 tablespoons maple syurp directions: cut fruit into large pieces. put everything into blender. blend until desired smoothness.

inputs: potato, carrot, frozen broccoli, bell pepper, onion, cream of asparagus soup, shredded cheese, crescent roll
targets: title: veggie cheddar braid ingredients: 1 cup potato 1 cup carrot 1 cup frozen broccoli 1/2 cup bell pepper 1/2 cup onion 1 can cream of asparagus soup 1 cup shredded cheese 2 cans crescent roll dough directions: preheat oven to 375 1. chop all veggies 2. steam potatos and carrots until almost soft. 3. mix all ingredients together in a bowl except the crescent roll dough. 4. roll out the dough in a pan, pressing the seams together. place the mixture down the center of the dough. 5. every 2 inches down the sides of the dough cut a small line. 6. braid together the dough on top of the mixture. cook 25 minutes

inputs: eggs, sugar, honey, vanilla, walnuts, shell
targets: title: rene s honey walnut pie ingredients: 3 eggs 1 cup sugar 1 cup honey 1 teaspoon vanilla 2 cups english walnuts 1 unbaked pie shell directions: mix together the 5 ingredients for the filling. place in the unbaked pie shell. cook 55 minutes at 350f.

inputs: fresh mushrooms, cream cheese, bacon, green onions
targets: title: stuffed mushrooms ingredients: 1 lb. fresh mushrooms 1 8 oz. pkg. cream cheese 1/2 lb. bacon, fried crisp and crumbled 2 green onions, chopped fine directions: wash and stem mushrooms. add onions and bacon to softened cream cheese. mix well. fill mushroom caps with cheese mixture. place on cookie sheet. bake at 350 for 15 minutes. can be browned under boiler, if you wish.

inputs: lasagna noodles, lean ground beef, green pepper, onions, sugar, garlic salt, oregano, pepper, cottage cheese, parmesan cheese, egg, parsley flakes, pepper, mozzarella cheese
targets: title: darcy s lasagna ingredients: 10 12 lasagna noodles, cooked, fresh or oven ready 1 lb lean ground beef 640 ml tomato sauce 14 cup green pepper, chopped fine 2 tablespoons onions, chopped fine 1 teaspoon sugar 1 teaspoon garlic salt 12 teaspoon oregano pepper, to taste 2 cups cottage cheese 12 cup parmesan cheese, grated 1 egg 1 tablespoon parsley flakes pepper, to taste 2 cups mozzarella cheese, grated directions: brown ground beef, then add green pepper, onion, sugar, garlic salt, oregano and pepper. simmer uncovered for 20 minutes. in a bowl combine cottage and parmesan cheeses, egg, parsley and pepper, and mix well. to assemble your lasagna . 1. layer of noodles. 2. half of meat sauce. 3. cheese mixture. 4. layer of noodles. 5. remaining meat sauce. 6. mozzarella cheese. bake uncovered at 350 f for 45 55 minutes or until golden brown. let sit for 10 minutes before cutting. serve with mom s garlic bread and mom s caesar salad for an incredible dinner.

inputs: linguine, olive oil, eggplants, garlic powder, oregano, salt, pepper, tomatoes, fresh parsley
targets: title: linguine with eggplant ingredients: 1 lb linguine 2/3 cup olive oil, divided 2 small eggplants, cut into 1/2 inch chunks 3/4 teaspoon garlic powder 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano 3/4 teaspoon salt 1/2 teaspoon pepper 4 plum tomatoes, chopped 2 tablespoons fresh parsley, chopped directions: in a large pot, cook linguine according to package directions and drain. put linguine in a large bowl and toss with 2 tablespoons olive oil set aside. in the same pot, heat the remaining olive oil over medium high heat. saute the eggplant for 10 to 12 minutes, until lightly browned. add garlic powder, oregano, salt, and pepper. saute for about 5 more minutes. add tomatoes, parsley, and linguine and toss gently until heated through. serve immediately.

inputs: shrimp, oil, garlic, red chilies, onion, red bell pepper, holibasil, oyster sauce, sugar, fish sauce
targets: title: kra pow khung ingredients: 20 peeled large shrimp 1 tbsp of oil 1 tbsp of chopped garlic 1 tbsp of chopped red chilies 1 half slices of onion 1 red bell pepper slices 1 full hand of holibasil 2 tbsp of oyster sauce 1 tsp of sugar 1 tsp of fish sauce directions: in the heating pan add oil and garlic fry till golden brown add shrimp fry till cooked. add onion and red bell pepper then basil fry till soft then add chilies. add oyster sauce, sugar and fish sauce stirring till every ingredients gets mixed served on rice.

inputs: extra virgin olive oil, garlic, white wine, tomatoes, tomatoes, anchovy paste, baking soda, parsley flakes, basil, oregano, italian seasoning, rosemary, sherry
targets: title: marinara sauce recipe ingredients: 2 tbsp. extra virgin olive oil 4 cloves garlic, squeezed through press 1/2 c. dry white wine 2 lg. cans progresso crushed tomatoes 2 lg. cans progresso peeled tomatoes, minced 2 teaspoon anchovy paste 1/2 teaspoon baking soda 2 tbsp. parsley flakes 2 tbsp. basil 1 teaspoon oregano dash italian seasoning dash grnd rosemary 1/2 c. dry sherry directions: saute/fry garlic in extra virgin olive oil and white wine don t burn add in anchovy paste and continue to saute/fry about 4 min. add in crushed tomatoes heat. salt and pepper to taste. add in minced, peeled tomatoes heat. salt pepper to taste. when mix begins to boil, sprinkle baking soda and stir till foaming stops. add in parsley, basil, oregano, italian seasoning and rosemary simmer 10 min. salt and pepper to taste again, if needed. add in sherry cover and simmer 30 min. serve over pasta with grated parmesan and/or possibly romano cheese. may be stored in refrigerator several days or possibly frzn in serving portions for later. a real time saver.

inputs: mustard, garlic, sugar, salt, ground black pepper, worcestershire sauce, lemon juice, red wine vinegar, extra virgin olive oil, eggs, chicken breasts, head romaine lettuce, cherry tomatoes, avocados, bacon, blue cheese, chives
targets: title: classic cobb salad ingredients: 1 teaspoon dijon mustard 1 medium garlic clove, minced 14 teaspoon sugar 12 teaspoon salt 18 teaspoon ground black pepper 1 teaspoon worcestershire sauce 2 teaspoons lemon juice 2 tablespoons red wine vinegar 12 cup extra virgin olive oil 3 large eggs 3 chicken breasts, boneles, skinless about 6 oz each 1 large head romaine lettuce, washed, dried and torn into bite sized pieces about 8 cups 1 bunch watercress, washed, dried and stemmed about 4 cups 1 pint cherry tomatoes preferably grape tomatoes 2 medium avocados, pitted and cut into 1/2 inch cubes 8 slices bacon, cut crosswise into 1/4 inches pieces fried in medium skillet over medium heat until crisp, about 7 m 2 ounces blue cheese, crumbled about 1/2 cup 2 ounces fresh minced chives directions: whisk all vinaigrette ingredients in medium bowl until well combined alternatively, shake vigorously in tight lidded jar set side. dressing may be refrigerated in airtight container for 1 day bring to room temperature and shake well before using. for the eggs . place eggs in medium saucepan cove with 1 inch water, and bring to boil over high heat. remove pan from heat, cover, and let stand 10 minutes. meanwhile, fill medium bowl with 1 to 2 quarts ice water. transfer cooked eggs to ice water with slotted spoon let stand 5 minutes, then peel, cut into 1/2 inch cubes, and set aside. for the chicken . meanwhile, season chicken with salt and pepper. adjust oven rack to 6 inches from broiler pan top with vegetable cooking spray place chicken breasts on top and broil chicken until lightly browned, 4 8 minutes. using tongs, flip chicken over and continue to broil until thickest part is no longer pink when cut into and registers 160f on instant read thermometer. 5 8 minutes. when cool enough to handle, cut chicken into cubes and set aside. to finish the salad . toss romaine and watercress with 5 tablespoons vinaigrette in large bowl until coated arrange on very large flat serving platter. place chicken in now empty bowl, add 1/4 cup vinaigrette and toss to coat arrange in row along one edge of greens. place tomatoes in now empty bowl, add 1 tablespoons vinaigrette and toss gently to combine arrange on apposite edge of greens. arrange reserved eggs and avocados in separate rows near center of greens, and drizzle with remaining vinaigrette. sprinkle bacon, cheese, and chives evenly over salad and serve immediately.

inputs: green pods pepper, red pods pepper, onions, salt, sugar, vinegar
targets: title: pepper relish ingredients: 12 green pods pepper 12 red pods pepper 12 onions 3 tbsp. salt 2 c. sugar 2 c. vinegar directions: chop pepper and onions. pour boiling water over pepper and onions let stand 5 minutes. drain off water. add salt, sugar and vinegar cook for 5 minutes. pack in can and seal.

inputs: aubergine, salt, extra virgin olive oil, onion, green pepper, nuts, basil, eggs, matzoh cracker, salt, pepper, margarine
targets: title: aubergine and green pepper kugel recipe ingredients: 1 x aubergine,large 1/2 tsp salt 3 tbsp. extra virgin olive oil 1 x onion,minced 1 x green pepper,sweet,minced 2 tbsp. pine nuts 2 tbsp. basil,fresh,minced 2 x large eggs,slightly beaten 1 x matzoh cracker,crumbled 1/2 tsp salt 1/2 tsp pepper 1 tbsp. margarine directions: 1. peel aubergine dice into 2 cubes. simmer with salt in water to cover in medium size saucepan 20 min to tender. drain. mash in large bowl. 2. meanwhile, heat oil in medium size skillet over medium heat. add in onion, pepper and pine nuts cook till tender, about 8 min. add in to aubergine in bowl. stir in basil, large eggs, matzoh, salt and pepper. scrape into greased small casserole. dot with margarine. 3. bake in preheated moderate 350 f oven for 35 min to heat through.

inputs: spinach, cream cheese, butter, salt, parmesan cheese
targets: title: spinach dip casserole ingredients: 2 10 oz. pkgs. frozen chopped spinach 2 8 oz. pkgs. cream cheese, softened 1/4 lb. butter, softened 1/2 tsp. salt 1 1/2 c. parmesan cheese directions: preheat oven to 350 degrees. cook spinach until just done. drain well. mix spinach with cream cheese, butter and salt. put in casserole dish and cover with parmesan cheese. bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes or until cheese melts. serve with tortilla chips.

inputs: boiling water, gelatin, apple juice, red
targets: title: apple orchard dessert ingredients: 1 1/2 cups boiling water 1 pkg. 8 serving size jell o lemon flavor sugar free gelatin 2 cups cold apple juice 1 small red and green apple, diced directions: stir boiling water into gelatin in large bowl at least 2 minutes until completely dissolved. stir in cold juice. refrigerate about 1 1/2 hours or until thickened spoon drawn through leaves definite impression . stir in apples. pour into 2 quart serving bowl. refrigerate 4 hours or until firm. store leftover dessert in refrigerator.

inputs: shortbread cookies, butter, shortbread cookies, cream, pecans
targets: title: frozen yogurt cookie pie ingredients: 24 bite sized shortbread cookies, crushed 1 c. 2 tbsp. butter or margarine, melted 18 bite sized pecan shortbread cookies 1/2 gal. frozen peach yogurt or ice cream, softened 2 tbsp. chopped pecans or cookie crumbs directions: in small bowl, combine crushed cookies and butter. mix well. press in bottom only of 9 inch pie plate. stand 18 whole cookies up around edges, pressing slightly into crust mixture. freeze 20 minutes until cold. carefully spread softened ice cream over crust. sprinkle with pecans. cover freeze at least 2 hours or overnight. makes 6 to 8 servings.

inputs: hot sausage, biscuit mix, water, grated cheese, worcestershire sauce, tabasco sauce
targets: title: sausage balls ingredients: 1 lb. hot sausage 3 c. biscuit mix few drops water 1 lb. sharp grated cheese 2 tbsp. worcestershire sauce tabasco sauce directions: allow sausage to soften to room temperature. add biscuit mix, worcestershire sauce, cheese and enough water to mix. shape into small balls and bake 10 minutes at 350 .

inputs: eggnoodles, cream of mushroom soup, peas, tuna
targets: title: flora s super fast tuna pot ingredients: 1 bag of eggnoodles 2 can of cream of mushroom soup see note 2 can of peas 2 large cans of tuna directions: ok so we all have those dishes that we reserve for hard times or just for a time saver. this is something i prepare when funds are low or just a fast fix after church. basically this is just my rendition of a tuna helper. boil your egg noodles in a pot of salted, boiling water. when your noodles are tender, drain them. drain the water off of your tuna and your peas. and them and the soup into the pot of noodles. stir to incorporate. cook over a low heat until the whole mixture is warm. now its ready. this meal will serve 4 easily and only costs around 10 bucks to prepare. note cream of pea and cream of celery soups also work in this.

inputs: chicken, beef, pork, corn, tomatoes, soy sauce, worcestershire sauce, black pepper, potatoes
targets: title: debra s camp stew ingredients: 10 oz. 1 can bbq chicken 10 oz. 1 can bbq beef 10 oz. 1 can bbq pork 14 oz. 1 can corn, cream style 28 oz. 1 can tomatoes, crushed 1/4 c. soy sauce 2 tbsp. worcestershire sauce black pepper to taste 4 medium potatoes, cooked and sliced directions: in a crock pot, mix together chicken, beef, pork, corn and tomatoes. add soy sauce, worcestershire sauce and black pepper. mix well. add potatoes, mixing well. simmer 2 hours.

inputs: white flour, flour, salt, honey, baking powder, shortening, water
targets: title: communion bread ingredients: 1 1/2 c. white flour 1/2 c. wheat flour 1 tsp. salt 1 1/2 tsp. honey 3/4 tsp. baking powder 2 tbsp. shortening 1/2 c. water directions: mix all ingredients together. makes 4 circles, 3/8 inch thick. bake at 350 for 10 minutes.

inputs: chocolate almond bark, honey, marshmallows
targets: title: chocolate peanut marshmallow candy ingredients: 1 pkg. chocolate almond bark plymouth pantry tastes the best 1 can planters honey roasted peanuts 1 bag miniature marshmallows directions: melt almond bark in the microwave or in a large saucepan. add enough peanuts and marshmallows to take up liquid. stir until well coated. pour out on cookie sheet that has been lined with wax paper. place in freezer until set, about 10 minutes. break or cut into bite size pieces. this is very fast and easy. with adult supervision, children can make this.

inputs: potatoes, eggs, onion, green onions, stalks celery, miracle, mayonnaise, sour cream, salt, paprika, parsley
targets: title: mom s potato salad ingredients: 6 boiled potatoes, cut in chunks 4 hard boiled eggs, chopped 12 1 onion, chopped 6 green onions, sliced thin 3 stalks celery, chopped 13 cup miracle whip 13 cup mayonnaise 13 cup sour cream salt and pepper paprika optional parsley optional directions: toss together. chill. eat

inputs: cabbage, celery, green pepper, cucumber, onion, salt, pepper, mayo, light cream, almonds
targets: title: almond coleslaw ingredients: 2 1/4 c. shredded cabbage 1/2 c. chopped celery 1/4 c. diced green pepper 1/4 c. diced cucumber 3 tbsp. minced onion 1/4 tsp. salt dash of pepper 1/2 c. mayo 2 or 3 tbsp. light cream 1/2 c. toasted slivered almonds directions: combine all ingredients, except mayo, cream and almonds. chill. just before serving, blend mayo and cream. toss dressing and almonds with salad.

inputs: whole kernel corn, margarine, bell pepper, onion, tomato, crawfish tails, red
targets: title: crawfish corn maquchoux ingredients: 4 12 oz. cans whole kernel corn, drained or 12 ears fresh corn cut off the cob 1 stick margarine 1 bell pepper, diced 1 onion, chopped 1 fresh tomato, diced 1/2 lb. crawfish tails red or black pepper to taste directions: in a large saucepan, melt margarine and add all ingredients except crawfish. cook until corn is tender. add crawfish and cook about 10 minutes longer.

inputs: sausage, vegetable oil, chicken thighs, garlic, stalks celery, green peppers, onions, long grain white rice, paprika, oregano, thyme, salt, chicken broth, tomatoes, water, hot pepper
targets: title: jambalaya ingredients: 8 ounces hot smoked sausage, sliced 3 teaspoons vegetable oil 2 lbs boneless skinless chicken thighs 6 cloves garlic, crushed 3 stalks celery, sliced 2 medium green peppers, chopped 3 medium onions, chopped 3 cups long grain white rice 1 teaspoon paprika 34 teaspoon dried oregano 12 teaspoon dried thyme 1 teaspoon salt 1 14 ounce can chicken broth 1 14 ounce can diced tomatoes 1 cup water 12 teaspoon hot pepper sauce directions: preheat oven to 425f. in skillet cook sausageover medium high heat until browned. place in bowl when done. add 2 tsp oil to skillet add chicken and cook until done. place in bowl with sausage. add remaining tsp oil to skillet reduce heat to medium. cook garlic, celery, peppers, and onions in covered skillet until tender. add salt, thyme,paprika, oregano, and rice cook one minute while stirring. place chicken and sausage with juices to rice mixture in skillet. add water, broth, tomatoes with juice, hot pepper sauce and heat to boiling over high heat. place in baking dish, and bake uncovered 15 minutes. stir mixture and cover, bake an additional 10 minutes, or until rice is tender. allow to cool, prep and place in freezer. to serve allow to thaw completely, bake covered loosely at 350 f for 1 hour. remove cover and bake 20 30 minutes or until heated through.

inputs: green beans, milk, cream of mushroom soup, black pepper, onions
targets: title: green bean casserole ingredients: 2 1 lb. cans cut green beans, drained 3/4 c. milk 1 10 3/4 oz. can cream of mushroom soup black pepper to taste 1 2.8 oz. can french fried onions directions: combine all ingredients, except 1/2 can of onions. pour into a 1 1/2 quart casserole dish. bake, uncovered, at 350 for 30 minutes. top with remaining onions and bake 5 minutes longer.

inputs: chicken strips, all purpose, parsley, basil, extra virgin olive oil, garlic, vegetable soup, mushrooms, green onion, tomatoes, zucchini
targets: title: skillet chicken primavera recipe ingredients: 1 1/2 c. raw chicken strips 1/3 c. all purpose flour 1 tbsp. minced parsley 1 teaspoon crushed basil 2 tbsp. extra virgin olive oil 1 clove chopped garlic 1 can 19 ounce. vegetable soup 1/2 c. sliced mushrooms 1/2 c. diagonally sliced green onion 3/4 c. halved cherry tomatoes 1/2 c. sliced zucchini directions: in small bowl toss chicken in flour, parsley, and minced basil till well coated. in a large skillet, heat extra virgin olive oil and garlic add in chicken and cook till lightly browned and no longer pink. pour in soup, mushrooms, green onions, tomatoes, and zucchini. stir over medium heat till heated through. makes 4 servings.

inputs: margarine, vinegar, sugar, mustard, catsup, onion
targets: title: barbecue chicken ingredients: 3/4 stick margarine 3/4 c. vinegar 1 tsp. sugar 1 tsp. mustard 1/2 c. catsup 1 small onion, chopped texas pete directions: simmer all ingredients for 5 minutes. place chicken in large casserole dish. pour sauce over chicken. cover. bake at 350 until tender. remove cover, heat oven to 425 and brown.

inputs: eggs, sugar, salt, all purpose, milk, margarine, vanilla extract
targets: title: pear clafoutis ingredients: 4 large eggs 1/2 c. sugar pinch of salt 1/3 c. all purpose flour 1 c. milk 1/2 stick margarine, melted 1 tsp. vanilla extract 1 tsp. grated lemon peel 3 large pears, peeled, cored and sliced directions: preheat oven to 325 . generously butter a 9 inch deep dish glass pie plate. beat eggs, 1/2 cup sugar and salt in medium bowl to blend whisk in flour. add milk, margarine, vanilla and lemon peel and whisk until smooth. arrange pears in bottom of the pie plate. pour custard over pears. bake until clafoutis is set in center and golden on top, about 55 minutes. yield 6 servings.

inputs: corn , peanuts, brown sugar, white karo, oleo, soda, vanilla
targets: title: cracker jacks ingredients: 24 c. popcorn approximately 2 c. unpopped corn 1 can roasted peanuts 2 c. brown sugar 1/2 c. white karo 2 sticks oleo 1/2 tsp. soda 1 tsp. vanilla directions: in saucepan, mix sugar, karo and oleo. bring to a boil and boil for 5 minutes. add peanuts to mixture and coat well. add soda and vanilla.

inputs: oreo cookies, butter, philadelphia cream cheese, sugar, vanilla, s, eggs
targets: title: easy oreo cheesecake ingredients: 36 oreo cookies, divided 1/4 cup butter, melted 4 pkg. 8 oz. each philadelphia cream cheese, softened 1 cup sugar 1 tsp. vanilla 1 cup breakstone s or knudsen sour cream 4 eggs directions: heat oven to 325f. place 28 cookies in resealable plastic bag. flatten bag to remove excess air, then seal bag. finely crush cookies by rolling a rolling pin across the bag. place crumbs in bowl. add butter mix well. press onto bottom of 9 inch springform pan. beat cream cheese, sugar and vanilla in large bowl with mixer until blended. add sour cream mix well. add eggs, 1 at a time, beating after each just until blended. chop or crush remaining cookies. gently stir 1 1/2 cups of the chopped cookies into batter. pour over crust sprinkle with remaining chopped cookies. bake 1 hour 10 min. or until center is almost set. run knife around rim of pan to loosen cake cool before removing rim. refrigerate 4 hours.

inputs: cheddar cheese, sausage, bisquick
targets: title: sausage and cheese balls ingredients: 1 pkg. cheddar cheese, grated 1 lb. raw sausage 3 c. bisquick directions: mix cheese and raw sausage add bisquick gradually. mix thoroughly with hands. roll into small balls and bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 350 for 20 minutes.

inputs: pie shell, chocolate pudding, brown sugar, unsweetened chocolate, milk, eggs, butter, peanuts
targets: title: chocolate peanut pie ingredients: 1 baked 8 inch pie shell 1 4 oz. pkg. chocolate pudding and pie filling mix 2 tbsp. brown sugar, firmly packed 1/2 sq. unsweetened chocolate 2 c. milk 2 eggs, separated 2 tbsp. butter or margarine 1/3 c. chopped salted peanuts directions: combine pudding mix, brown sugar, chocolate and 1/4 cup milk in saucepan. add egg yolks and blend well. add remaining 1 3/4 cups milk. cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until mix comes to a boil. remove from heat and stir in butter. cool at least 5 minutes, stirring 2 or 3 times.

inputs: frozen meatballs, cranberry sauce, barbecue sauce, honey, chili powder
targets: title: berry good cocktail meatballs ingredients: 2 lbs frozen meatballs 1 16 ounce can cranberry sauce, jellied 1 20 28 ounce bottle barbecue sauce 2 tablespoons honey 1 teaspoon chili powder optional directions: combine cranberry sauce, bbq sauce and honey in a crock pot. mix well. add meatballs. cover and cook on low till heated through. if using your own meatball recipe, shape and cook before adding to sauce.

inputs: pasta, flour, flour, water, extra virgin olive oil, eggs, sauce, bacon, onions, extra virgin olive oil, garlic, water, tomatoes, red pepper, salt, remaining ingredients, water, salt, cooking spray, mozzarella cheese, ricotta cheese, cheese
targets: title: semolina lasagna with spicy amatriciana ingredients: pasta 1 cup all purpose flour 1 cup semolina flour 1/3 cup water 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil 2 large eggs sauce 2 slices bacon, chopped into small pieces 4 cups of thinly sliced onions 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil 4 fresh garlic cloves, finely minced 1/2 cup water 1 28 ounce can diced tomatoes, undrained 1 teaspoon crushed red pepper flakes salt pepper to season remaining ingredients 6 quarts water 1 tablespoon salt cooking spray 1 cup mozzarella cheese, chopped into cubes 1 8 ounce container part skim ricotta cheese 1/2 cup grated parmigiano reggiano cheese directions: to prepare the pasta, pour flours in a food processor and spin for 30 seconds. add 1/3 cup of water, 2 tbs oil, and eggs in a bowl, stirring well with a whisk. with processor running, slowly pour mixture into the food chute, processing just until dough forms a ball. turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface, knead lightly 5 times. shape dough into a disk. dust lightly with flour, wrap in plastic wrap, and let stand for 30 minutes. divide dough into 6 equal portions. working with one portion at a time, roll dough into a 20x4 inch rectangle. repeat with remaining dough to form 6 sheets. to prepare sauce, cook bacon in a large nonstick skillet until crisp. add onion, 1 tbs oil, and garlic to pan saute 5 minutes or until browned. add 1/2 cup water and tomatoes, bring to a boil. stir in crushed red pepper, salt, pepper. reduce heat and simmer for about 20 minutes, or until mixture is thickened. bring 6 quarts water and 1 tbs salt to a boil. slowly lower 1 pasta sheet into boiling water cook 1.5 minutes. carefully remove pasta with a slotted spoon and place in a pan with a damp towel. repeat process with all six pasta sheets. preheat oven to 350 f. place 1 pasta sheet on each of 6 individual baking dishes lightly coated with cooking spray. layer each of the three cheeses and sauce while folding the piece of pasta back forth. bake at 350 f for about 10 minutes or until cheese is melted. notes i also added some extra parmesan cheese on the top near the end, turned the oven up to a broil to crisp up the cheesy top quickly. this works well as a make ahead or freezer meal. the smoky flavor of the bacon in the sauce makes the dish.

inputs: chicken breasts, potatoes, carrots, fresh green beans, onion, parsley flakes, salt, sherry
targets: title: chicken dinner in the pot ingredients: 2 chicken breasts, split and skinned 4 medium size potatoes 2 large carrots 1/2 lb. fresh green beans or 1 10 oz. pkg. frozen 1 large onion 1 tbsp. dried parsley flakes salt and pepper 1/2 c. dry sherry directions: preheat oven to 300 . place chicken breasts in a large, heavy ovenware pot. an enamel coated cast iron pot is best. peel potatoes, slice 1/2 inch thick and place on top of chicken.

inputs: canola oil, whole wheat flour, flour, salt, water, water, tomatoes, feta cheese, eggs, pesto sauce, mozzarella cheese, basil, onion powder, garlic, salt
targets: title: tomato pesto quiche ingredients: 1/3 cup canola oil or 1/3 cup grapeseed oil 3/4 cup whole wheat flour 3/4 cup flour 3/8 teaspoon salt 1/8 cup ice water 2 3 tablespoons ice water 1 1/2 lbs firm tomatoes, thinly sliced 4 ounces feta cheese, crumbled 3 large eggs 1 tablespoon pesto sauce 1/2 cup shredded mozzarella cheese 1/4 cup chopped basil or 1/4 cup parsley 1 teaspoon onion powder 1 teaspoon garlic powder salt freshly ground black pepper directions: preheat oven to 425 f. chill oil in freezer for 10 minutes or until very cold. in a large mixing bowl, combine the flours and salt. whisk together until well combined. set aside. remove the oil from the freezer and drizzle into the flour mixture. using a fork or dough blender, incorporate until crumbly. sprinkle in the ice water, tossing the dough with a fork until it is just moist enough to hold together without appearing crumbly. knead briefly with your hands until dough is smooth and then shape into a round. roll the dough to a thickness of 1/8 1/4 in and approximately 3 inches larger than that of the pie pan. place in the pie pan and then work it around until it evenly covers the whole pan. layer half the tomato slices in the pie crust and sprinkle with half the feta cheese. whisk together eggs and pesto until well mixed, and stir in mozzarella, basil/parsley, onion powder, garlic powder, salt and pepper. pour half of the mixture over first tomato layer. add a second layer of tomato slices and top with the rest of the egg mixture. sprinkle the remaining feta cheese on top. bake for 20 25 minutes, or until egg mixture firms and feta browns.

inputs: cream cheese, pineapple, green pepper, salt, pecans, onions
targets: title: pineapple cheese ball ingredients: 2 8 oz. pkg. cream cheese 1 small can pineapple, drained and mashed 1/4 c. green pepper, chopped 3/4 tsp. lawry s seasoning salt 1 c. chopped pecans 2 tbsp. chopped onions directions: soften cream cheese to room temperature. add all other ingredients. shape into ball. roll in nuts and chill.

inputs: flour, sugar, baking powder, salt, eggs, milk, margarine, nutmeg, vanilla, blueberries
targets: title: blueberry muffins ingredients: 2 c. all purpose flour 2/3 c. sugar 1 tbsp. baking powder 1/4 tsp. salt 2 eggs 1 c. milk 1/3 c. margarine, melted 1/4 tsp. nutmeg 1 tsp. vanilla 2 c. blueberries if frozen, rinse and pat dry before using directions: combine flour, sugar, baking powder and salt. in another bowl, beat eggs blend in milk, margarine, nutmeg and vanilla. pour into dry ingredients and mix just until moistened. fold in blueberries. fill greased or paper lined muffin pans 2/3 full. bake at 375 for 20 to 25 minutes. optional brush top with melted margarine and sprinkle with sugar. makes 12 large muffins or 18 medium.

inputs: sour cream, bacon, cheddar cheese, cream cheese, green onion
targets: title: cheesy bacon dip ingredients: 1 16 ounce container sour cream 5 pieces bacon, crisply cooked and crumbled 2 cups shredded sharp cheddar cheese 1 8 ounce package cream cheese, softened 1 cup chopped green onion chives directions: heat oven to 400 f. combine all ingredients in a bowl and mix well. place in a 1 quart baking dish. cover and bake 25 minutes.

inputs: potatoes, cheddar cheese, cream of chicken soup, miracle, onion, pepper, margarine
targets: title: quick potatoes au gratin ingredients: 1 pkg. 16 oz. frozen southern style hash brown potatoes 1 c. 8 oz. kraft natural shredded sharp cheddar cheese 1 can 10 3/4 oz. cream of chicken soup 1 c. miracle whip salad dressing 1/2 c. chopped onion 1/8 tsp. pepper 2 c. crushed post toasties cornflakes 2 tbsp. margarine, melted directions: heat oven to 350 . mix potatoes, cheese, soup, salad dressing, onion and pepper. spoon into 12 x 8 inch baking dish. sprinkle with combined crushed cornflakes and margarine. bake 45 to 55 minutes or until thoroughly heated. makes 6 servings. preparation time 10 minutes.

inputs: shortening, brown sugar, sugar, eggs, oats, vanilla, flour, soda, salt, nuts
targets: title: oatmeal cookies ingredients: 1 c. shortening 1 c. brown sugar 1 c. sugar 2 eggs 3 c. quick oats 1 tsp. vanilla 1 1/2 c. flour 1 tsp. soda 1/2 tsp. salt 1/2 c. chopped nuts directions: cream shortening and sugar add eggs and vanilla and blend. sift dry ingredients together. add to creamed mixture. shape into a roll wrap in wax paper and chill for several hours. cut into slices. place on ungreased cookie sheet. bake 10 minutes at 350 .

inputs: ground beef, tomato soup, liquid, onion, cheddar cheese, egg noodles
targets: title: hamburger casserole ingredients: 1 1/2 lb. ground beef 1 can tomato soup 1 small can english peas and liquid 1 medium onion 1 pkg. grated cheddar cheese 1 5 oz. pkg. egg noodles directions: brown ground beef and onion. add the soup, peas and cooked noodles. place in a baking dish and top with grated cheese. bake long enough for cheese to melt.

inputs: oleo, graham cracker crumbs, butterscotch chips, chocolate chips, angel, condensed milk, pecans
targets: title: six layer cookies ingredients: 1 stick oleo, melted 1 c. graham cracker crumbs 1 6 oz. pkg. butterscotch chips 1 6 oz. pkg. chocolate chips 1 can angel flake coconut 1 can sweetened condensed milk 1 c. chopped pecans directions: add each in order in layers. bake at 350 for 25 to 30 minutes. cut into squares while still warm. remove from pan when cool.

inputs: flour, butter, sugar, nuts, eggs, cranberries
targets: title: cranberry squares ingredients: 1 1/2 c. flour 1 c. melted butter or oleo 1 1/2 c. sugar 1 c. chopped nuts 2 eggs, well beaten 2 c. cranberries, cut in half directions: mix all ingredients well. add cranberries. bake at 325 for 40 to 45 minutes after bring poured into a greased and floured 13 x 9 inch pan. cool and cut into squares.

inputs: bread, milk, eggs, sugar, salt, cinnamon, apples
targets: title: apple bread pudding ingredients: 1 1/2 bread, cubed 3 c. milk 3 eggs, beaten 1/2 c. sugar 1/4 tsp. salt 1 tsp. cinnamon 1 1/2 c. sliced apples directions: in buttered 1 quart baking dish, soak bread in milk. combine eggs, sugar, salt and cinnamon. stir into bread mixture. place apple slices over top. bake at 350 for 40 minutes or until almost set in center.

inputs: beaver, barbecue sauce, salt, pepper
targets: title: barbecued beaver ingredients: 1 medium beaver 1 bottle barbecue sauce salt pepper directions: place beaver in a medium baking dish. cover beaver with barbecue sauce. add salt and pepper and bake for 2 hours at 350 .

inputs: oreo cookies, butter, cream cheese, powdered sugar
targets: title: dirt pudding ingredients: 1 1/4 lb. oreo cookies stick butter 2 small boxes french vanilla pudding 8 oz. cream cheese 1 c. powdered sugar large cool whip directions: crush oreos, mix with melted butter. put layer in 9 x 13 inch glass pan. mix instant pudding with 3 cups cold milk set aside. mix cream cheese and powdered sugar. add cool whip and pudding. layer oreos, then pudding mix in pan.

inputs: gruyere, sage, pastry, egg
targets: title: prosciutto and gruyere pinwheels ingredients: 3/4 cup finely grated gruyere about 3 ounces 4 teaspoons chopped fresh sage leaves 1 sheet puff pastry, thawed from one 17 1/4 ounce package frozen puff pastry 1 large egg, beaten lightly 2 ounces thinly sliced prosciutto directions: combine gruyere and sage in bowl. on lightly floured surface, unfold pastry with short side facing you, and cut in half crosswise. arrange half of sheet with long side facing you, and brush just the edge of far side with the egg. arrange half of prosciutto evenly on top of pastry, avoiding egg washed edge, and top with half of gruyere mixture. starting with near side, roll jelly roll fashion into a log and wrap in wax paper. repeat procedure with remaining ingredients. chill, seam side down, until firm, at least three hours, or up to three days you can even freeze for several weeks . preheat oven to 400 degrees and lightly grease 2 baking sheets. cut logs crosswise into 1/2 inch thick pinwheels and arrange, cut side down, 1 inch apart on sheets. bake until golden, about 15 minutes. transfer to rack and cool just slightly best served while still warm.

inputs: olive oil, honey, white wine vinegar, rosemary, garlic, salt, freshly ground pepper
targets: title: sweet potato salad ingredients: 4 1/2 cups peeled, cubed sweet potato 2 tbsp. olive oil, divided 1/4 cup honey 3 tbsp. white wine vinegar 2 tbsp. chopped fresh rosemary 2 garlic cloves, minced 1/2 tsp. salt 1/2 tsp. freshly ground pepper directions: line a 15 x 10 inch jellyroll pan with aluminum foil. coat foil with vegetable cooking spray. toss together sweet potato and 1 tablespoon oil in a pan. bake at 450 degrees for 35 minutes or until tender. whisk together remaining 1 tablespoon oil, honey, and next 5 ingredients in large bowl. add sweet potato toss well. cool. yield 6 servings.

inputs: turkey cutlets, liquid butter, onion, wine vinegar, chili sauce, tomato sauce, chili powder, worcestershire sauce, sugar, thyme, tomatoes, beef broth, red wine
targets: title: barbecued turkey cutlets ingredients: 2 lb. turkey cutlets skinless 1 tsp. liquid butter buds 1 c. chopped onion 1/2 c. wine vinegar 1/4 c. chili sauce 1/4 c. tomato sauce 2 tsp. chili powder 2 tsp. worcestershire sauce 2 tsp. sugar 1/4 tsp. thyme 1 c. stewed tomatoes 1/2 c. beef broth 1/2 c. red wine directions: cut turkey cutlets into 2 inch cubes. brown in a nonstick skillet sprayed with nonfat cooking spray. remove turkey and place in a large casserole dish. heat liquid butter buds in skillet, adding onion and cook for 3 minutes. add all other ingredients, bring to a boil and pour over turkey chunks. cover and bake in a 300 oven for 40 to 50 minutes or until turkey falls apart in shreds when probed with a fork. serve over steamed rice or as sandwiches on toasted buns. serves 8.

inputs: tortilla, tomato paste, grated cheese, oregano, clove garlic, favourite pizza topping
targets: title: lazy pizza ingredients: 1 tortilla 1/4 cup tomato paste 1/2 cup grated cheese 1 tsp oregano 1 clove garlic 1 favourite pizza topping directions: preheat oven to 180c mix tomato paste, garlic, oregano or any other herbs or spices i add chili powder and fresh ground pepper and spread on tortilla sprinkle with grated cheese and add any kind of topping bake for 5 minutes and voila
