inputs: olive oil, onion, sugar, salt, frozen southern, breadstick, cooking spray, milk, egg whites, eggs, feta cheese
targets: title: spinach, caramelized onion, and feta quiche ingredients: 2 teaspoons olive oil 3 cups chopped onion 1 teaspoon sugar 1/2 teaspoon salt 2 cups frozen southern style hash brown potatoes, thawed 1 11 ounce can refrigerated soft breadstick dough cooking spray 1 10 ounce package frozen chopped spinach, thawed, drained, and squeezed dry 1 cup fat free milk 3 large egg whites 2 large eggs 1 1/4 cups 5 ounces crumbled feta cheese directions: preheat oven to 350 . heat olive oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. add onion, sugar, and salt cook for 30 minutes or until golden brown, stirring occasionally. stir in potatoes, and cook for 5 minutes or until lightly browned. remove from heat. unroll dough, separating into strips. working on a flat surface, coil one strip of dough around itself in a spiral pattern. add second strip of dough to the end of the first strip, pinching ends together to seal continue coiling the dough. repeat procedure with the remaining dough strips. cover and let dough rest for 10 minutes. roll dough into a 12 inch circle, and fit into a 10 inch deep dish pie plate coated with cooking spray. spread potato mixture in bottom of prepared crust, and top with spinach. combine milk, egg whites, eggs, and cheese pour the milk mixture over the spinach. bake at 350 for 1 hour or until set, shielding crust with foil after 50 minutes. let stand 10 minutes before serving.

inputs: garlic, scallions, green, wine vinegar, sweet chili sauce, kiwi fruits
targets: title: kiwi relish ingredients: 2 garlic cloves 2 scallions 1 teaspoon green peppercorns in brine, crushed 2 tablespoons wine vinegar 1 tablespoon thai sweet chili sauce 2 4 tablespoons cilantro leaves, chopped 4 kiwi fruits, halved and peeled directions: peel the garlic and put it in the food processor with the roughly chopped scallions and the drained green peppercorns. process till finely chopped. add the vinegar and sweet chili sauce and pulse to combine, then add the cilantro leaves and kiwi fruit pulse until the kiwifruit and cilantro are fairly finely and evenly chopped . leave to stand for an hour or so for best flavour, but serve sooner if needed.

inputs: chicken breasts, cream of chicken soup, cream of celery soup, milk, chicken broth, margarine, pack herb stuffing
targets: title: chicken casserole ingredients: 4 large chicken breasts 1 can cream of chicken soup 1 can cream of celery soup 1 c. whole milk 1 c. chicken broth 1 stick margarine 1 small pack herb stuffing directions: cook chicken. remove from the bone. cool. cut into pieces put into greased casserole dish. save 1 cup of chicken broth. combine milk with 2 cans of soup pour over chicken. mix chicken broth with melted margarine. mix herb stuffing lightly with chicken broth and margarine and pour over soup. cook at 350 for 30 to 40 minutes.

inputs: eggplants, meat, clove garlic, ginger, doubanjiang, water, chicken soup stock granules, oyster sauce, sugar, soy sauce, katakuriko, water
targets: title: mapo eggplant that kids love ingredients: 5 medium sized eggplants 200 grams minced meat 1 clove garlic 1 small piece ginger 1 tsp doubanjiang 300 ml water 1 tsp chicken soup stock granules 1 tbsp oyster sauce 1 tbsp sugar 3 tbsp soy sauce 1 tbsp katakuriko 2 tbsp water directions: cut the eggplants into easy to cook pieces about 6 8 pieces lengthwise . mince the garlic and ginger. combine the ingredients. heat some oil in a wok, add the garlic and ginger and cook on low heat until fragrant. once the aroma develops increase to high heat and add the minced meat and doubanjiang. cook while mixing. after the minced meat has cooked, if there isn t enough oil left over, add some before you add the eggplants. cook until they re wilted. once the eggplants are wilted, add the ingredients and bring to a boil. then add the water dissolved katakuriko to give it thickness and it s done. you can add sesame oil at the end for a final aroma flavoring .

inputs: pork tenderloin, onion, pepper, salt bacon, butter, paxo, cooking kitchen twine, sausage, water
targets: title: easy stuffed pork tenderloin ingredients: 2 pork tenderloin 1 onion, chopped 1/2 cup chopped red and yellow pepper 1 lb low salt bacon 1 tablespoon butter or 1 tablespoon margarine 1 8 ounce box paxo seasoned stuffing mix cooking kitchen twine 1 sausage 1 cup water directions: rinse both tenderloins and with a very sharp knife remove most of the membrane from the outside. hold the tenderloin on end and slice down the middle but not all the way through. fold open the loins and cover with sheet of waxed paper. pound them a little thinner with a meat mallet or roll out with rolling pin. set loins aside. in frying pan melt butter or margarine over medium heat. add cut up sausage hot or mild and saute for about 5 minutes. add onions and peppers and saute for another 5 minutes. add contents of paxo box to pan with 1 cup of boiling water and combine. it will get sticky that s what we want. remove from heat. on a large cutting board or clean counter lay out 18 inch lengths of cooking twine vertically about 2 inches apart for the length of the tenderloin. place one tenderloin on the cooking twine. place stuffing mixture on tenderloin in mound along the middle of loin not flat. place second loin on top of stuffing and tie the strings starting in the middle. fold the edges of the top loin inside the edge of the bottom loin before binding with twine. lay enough bacon strips vertically on the counter or cutting board for the length of the loin. place stuffed loin on top of bacon and fold bacon over top securing with tooth picks. place loin on rack in backing pan with 1/2 cup water on bottom. cover with aluminum foil and bake for 1 1/4 hours at 350 degrees. remove pan from oven and remove foil. place pan back in oven under broiler and watch until bacon gets a little more crispy. for main course serve with mashed tatoes, turkey gravy and veges. enjoy

inputs: no yolks, all purpose, salt, ground black pepper, boneless beef sirloin, vegetable oil, tomatoes, beef broth, carrots, leeks, fresh rosemary, paprika, sour cream, fresh chives
targets: title: no yolks beef goulash ingredients: 12 ounces no yolks r kluski noodles 1/2 cup all purpose flour 1 teaspoon salt 1/4 teaspoon ground black pepper 2 pounds boneless beef sirloin, cut into 1 inch cubes 3 tablespoons vegetable oil, divided 1 15 ounce can diced tomatoes, undrained 1 14.5 ounce can beef broth 3 cups carrots, cut into 1/4 inch diagonal slices 2 medium leeks or onions, cut in half lengthwise and sliced 2 teaspoons chopped fresh rosemary 2 teaspoons paprika 1 cup dairy sour cream chopped fresh chives or green onion tops directions: stir together flour, salt and pepper coat meat with mixture. in 5 quart saucepan over medium high heat, heat 1 1/2 tablespoons oil add one half meat. cook until browned, about 5 minutes, stirring occasionally remove meat. heat remaining oil add beef and cook until browned. return all beef and any remaining flour mixture to saucepan. stir in tomatoes with juice, broth, carrots, leeks, rosemary and paprika heat to boiling. reduce heat and cover. simmer 45 minutes or until meat is tender. meanwhile, cook noodles according to package directions drain. spoon goulash over noodles spoon sour cream on top. sprinkle with chives.

inputs: tomatoes, tomato puree, tomato paste, sugar, onion, clove garlic, parsley, garlic, onion, basil, italian seasoning, black pepper, salt, olive oil
targets: title: homemade spaghetti sauce ingredients: 2 can crushed tomatoes 2 can tomato puree 1 can tomato paste 1/2 cup sugar 1 large onion diced 5 clove garlic minced 3 tbsp dried parsley 1/2 tsp garlic powder 1/2 tsp onion powder 1/2 tsp dried basil 1/2 tsp italian seasoning 1/2 tsp black pepper 1 salt to taste 3 tbsp olive oil directions: in a large heated pot with olive oil cooked diced onions till half done. add minced garlic, cook until browned. add tomato paste and mix well. add tomato puree and crushed tomatoes and mix well. add garlic powder, onion powder, parsley, basil, italian seasoning, black pepper, and sugar. mix well. cook at least 4 hours on very low heat. u may then freeze it for later use. it keeps it flavor.

inputs: tamarind, cold water, fresh ginger, garlic, sugar, chili garlic sauce, fish sauce, soy sauce, cornstarch
targets: title: tamarind dipping sauce ingredients: 5 ounces tamarind pulp 2 cups plus 2 tablespoons cold water 1 piece 1 inch fresh ginger, peeled and grated 3 cloves garlic, minced 3 tablespoons sugar, or more to taste 1 tablespoon chili garlic sauce sambal oelek 2 teaspoons thai fish sauce nam pla 1 teaspoon good quality soy sauce, such as kikkoman 2 tablespoons cornstarch directions: 1. combine the tamarind and 2 cups of the water in a small saucepan and bring to a boil over high heat. remove the pan from the heat and let stand until the tamarind has softened, about 15 minutes. help it along by breaking up the pulp with a spoon. 2. strain the tamarind through a sieve, pressing on the pulp to extract as much water as possible. discard the pump and seeds and return the water to the pan. add the ginger, garlic, 3 tablespoons sugar, the chili garlic sauce, fish sauce, and soy sauce and bring to a boil over high heat. reduce the heat and simmer for 5 minutes, stirring frequently. 3. whisk the cornstarch with the remaining 2 tablespoons water. when smooth, whisk the mixture into the tamarind sauce, continuing to whisk until the sauce thickens, about 1 minute. remove the pan from the heat and let cool. before serving, taste and adjust the seasoning, adding more sugar if necessary to balance the tartness of the tamarind. store tamarind sauce in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to a week.

inputs: flour, , sugar, baking powder, cinnamon, egg, oil, milk, vanilla
targets: title: cinnamon banana pancakes ingredients: 1 cup flour 1/4 teaspoons salt 1 tablespoon sugar 2 teaspoons baking powder 1 teaspoon cinnamon 1 whole egg 2 tablespoons oil 1 cup milk 1 teaspoon vanilla directions: first take your banana and mash it up. just take a fork and mush her right up in one bowl, combine the flour, salt, sugar, baking powder and cinnamon. stir with a fork to combine. in another bowl, add the egg, mashed banana, oil, milk, and vanilla. stir to combine. combine the two bowls and stir to combine. start putting batter on the griddle. once it starts bubbling, it s ready to flip. once both sides are cooked, serve with syrup and sliced banana. yum

inputs: beef, onion soup, salt
targets: title: easy oven roast beef ingredients: 1 beef roast any kind or type 1 envelope lipton onion soup mix salt and pepper to taste directions: use a roasting pan or dutch oven. line with aluminum foil. put roast in pan. mix salt, pepper and onion soup mix and spread on top of roast. pour water over roast slowly so as not to wash off the seasoning. cover with foil. bake in moderate oven 325 for 1 to 2 hours. save gravy to serve over rice.

inputs: pork tenderloin, butter, sherry, sugar, salt, pepper, onion, orange juice
targets: title: pork tenderloins ingredients: 2 lb. pork tenderloin 2 tbsp. butter or margarine 1/3 c. sherry 2 tbsp. sugar 2 tsp. salt dash of pepper 1/2 c. onion 2/3 c. orange juice directions: brown meat on all sides in the butter or margarine remove meat. in same skillet, cook onion until tender. add orange peel and juice, sherry, sugar, salt, pepper and bay leaf. return meat, cover and simmer 1 hour or until tender, turning occasionally. remove meat to hot platter slice.

inputs: golden cake mix, orange juice, miracle, eggs, poppy seed, icing sugar
targets: title: fluffy orange cake ingredients: 1 pkg. 2 layer size golden cake mix 1 cup orange juice 3/4 cup miracle whip original spread 3 eggs 1/4 cup poppy seed 2 tbsp. icing sugar directions: heat oven to 350f. beat all ingredients except icing sugar in large bowl with mixer until blended. pour into greased and floured 10 inch tube pan or 12 cup fluted tube pan. bake 35 to 40 min. or until toothpick inserted near centre comes out clean. cool cake in pan 10 min. loosen cake from sides of pan with knife. gently remove cake from pan cool completely. sprinkle with icing sugar just before serving.

inputs: ground beef, sauce, noodles, mozzarella cheese
targets: title: lasagne ingredients: 2 lb. ground beef 1 large can hunt s spaghetti sauce lasagne noodles 1 lb. shredded mozzarella cheese directions: sauce brown ground beef and drain. add spaghetti sauce and simmer for 15 minutes. cook lasagne noodles until done. drain.

inputs: white bread, onions, celery, salt, eggs, cold broth
targets: title: mary kocman s dressing ingredients: 10 slices white bread onions celery salt and pepper 2 eggs, beaten cold broth directions: toast bread. after bread cools, soak in cold water and squeeze and pull apart into small pieces. add sauteed onions, celery, salt and pepper. add eggs and cold broth. bake 1/2 hour at 300 .

inputs: pastry, butter, hazelnuts, filling, custard powder, caster sugar, milk, vanilla essence, philadelphia cream cheese, topping, lime strands
targets: title: mango and filo custard pies ingredients: 6 sheets filo pastry 60g butter, melted 1/3 cup finely chopped hazelnuts filling 1/4 cup custard powder 1/2 cup caster sugar 1 1/4 cups milk 2 teaspoons vanilla essence 250g block philadelphia cream cheese, softened topping 2 mangos, sliced lime strands, for serving safeway 3 ct for 1.00 thru 02/09 directions: grease 12 x 1/2 cup 125ml capacity muffin pans. brush sheets of filo with butter, layer into 2 bundles of 3 sheets, sprinkling between each layer with hazelnuts. cut each bundle into 6 squares and push into a prepared pan. bake at 200c for 6 8 minutes or until pastry is golden and crisp. allow to cool and remove from pan. combine custard powder, sugar, milk and vanilla and whisk over medium heat until custard boils and thickens. custard will be quite thick . cover and cool. beat the cold custard until smooth. gradually add philly and beat until smooth and spoon into pastry cases. top custard pies with mango slices, garnish with rind and serve.

inputs: bread, cucumbers, tomatoes, onions, olive oil, lemon juice, clove garlic, purslane
targets: title: peasant salad fattouche ingredients: 1/2 lb. flat bread arab bread , toasted and broken into small pieces 2 1/2 lb. chopped cucumbers or heart of lettuce, cut into small pieces 2 lb. tomatoes, cut into small pieces 10 oz. onions, finely chopped 6 oz. olive oil 8 oz. lemon juice 1 clove garlic, mashed with salt 1 bunch purslane bagle directions: toast and break bread into small pieces. chop all the vegetables add them to the bread and mix well. add mashed garlic, lemon juice and oil toss well. serve on platter. garnish with pomegranate seeds and a little chopped onion and tomatoes.

inputs: persimmon pulp, baking soda, sugar, salad oil, egg, nuts, flour, cinnamon, cloves, nutmeg, salt, raisins
targets: title: persimmon squares ingredients: 2 c. persimmon pulp 1 tsp. baking soda 1 c. sugar 1/2 c. salad oil 1 egg 1 c. chopped nuts 2 c. flour 1 tsp. cinnamon 1/2 tsp. cloves 1/2 tsp. nutmeg 1/2 tsp. salt 1 c. raisins directions: sprinkle soda over persimmon pulp. mix with rest of ingredients. bake in jelly roll pan 30 minutes at 350 . frost with light frost or glaze.

inputs: corn, cold unsalted butter, vegetable oil, cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking soda, salt, well shaken buttermilk, eggs, bacon fat, honey
targets: title: rutherford grill cornbread ingredients: 2 ears corn 1/4 cup cold unsalted butter, cut into pieces 1/4 cup vegetable oil 1 1/2 jalapeons fine dice with some seeds 1 1/4 cups cornmeal preferably stone ground not coarse 1/4 cup all purpose flour 1 tablespoon sugar 1 teaspoon baking soda 1/2 teaspoon salt 1 1/2 cups well shaken buttermilk 2 large eggs 1 teaspoon bacon fat 2 tablespoons honey directions: put oven rack in middle position and preheat oven to 450 f, add butter, lard and oil to skillet andneat inovenuntil melted. about 5 minutes, then carefully pour into a medium bowl. heat grill to medium high. lightly brush corn with oil and grill turning every 3 minutes until charred and golden brown. cut kernels off of cobs. set aside. put oven in middle position and reheat to 450. add butter, lard and oil to skillet and heat in oven until melted, about 5 minutes, then carefully pour into a medium bowl. wisk together cornmeal, flour, sugar jalapenos, baking soda, and salt in a large bowl. whisk buttermilk and eggs into melted butter, then stir into cornmeal mixture until just combined. pour into hot skillet and bake until a wooden picik or skewer inserted in center comes out clean, 15 to 20 minutes. cool in skillet on a rack 5 minutes.

inputs: turkey sausage, canola oil, shallots, garlic, flageolets, water, thyme, celery seeds, freshly ground black pepper, chicken broth, thyme
targets: title: tiny french beans with smoked sausage ingredients: 1 pound smoked turkey sausage, cut into 1 1/2 inch pieces 1 tablespoon canola oil 1/3 cup minced shallots 3 garlic cloves, minced 2 cups dried flageolets or other dried white beans, about 1 pound 2 cups water 1/4 cup minced fresh or 1 tablespoon dried thyme 1 teaspoon celery seeds 1/4 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper 1 14 1/2 ounce can fat free, lower sodium chicken broth thyme sprigs optional directions: heat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat. add sausage saute 5 minutes or until browned. remove from pan, and place in an electric slow cooker. heat the oil in pan over medium heat. add shallots and garlic cook 1 minute, stirring constantly. sort and wash beans. add beans, shallot mixture, water, and the remaining ingredients to slow cooker. cover and cook on high 8 hours or until beans are tender. this recipe has been retested for , 2012 if you use another type of dried beans other than the flageolets, your cooking time will probably be closer to 6 hours instead of 8 hours. myrecipes is working with , the partnership for a healthier america, and usda s myplate to give anyone looking for healthier options access to a trove of recipes that will help them create healthy, tasty plates. for more information about creating a healthy plate, visit .

inputs: lasagna noodles, ground beef, onion, tomatoes, tomato paste, chili powder, oregano, pepper, garlic salt, sugar, paprika, cottage cheese, mozzarella cheese, velveeta cheese, parmesan cheese
targets: title: lasagna ingredients: 8 oz. pkg. lasagna noodles 1 lb. ground beef 1/2 c. chopped onion 16 oz. can tomatoes 6 oz. can tomato paste 2 tsp. chili powder 2 tsp. oregano leaves 1/4 tsp. pepper 2 tsp. garlic salt 2 tsp. sugar 1 tsp. paprika 12 oz. carton cottage cheese 12 oz. mozzarella cheese 1/2 lb. velveeta cheese 1/2 c. parmesan cheese directions: cook and drain lasagna noodles. brown meat drain. add onion, tomatoes, tomato paste, cottage cheese and seasonings. cover and simmer for 30 minutes. in 9 x 13 inch pan, layer half of noodles, meat sauce, mozzarella cheese, velveeta cheese and parmesan cheese. repeat layers. save enough sauce to put on top. bake at 350 for 30 minutes. let stand for 10 minutes before serving. slice the velveeta cheese in thin slices.

inputs: syrup, cookie, ginger liqueur, caramel vodka, apple cider, lemon juice
targets: title: spiced caramel apple martini ingredients: agave syrup gingersnap cookie finely crumbled 2 ounces ginger liqueur domaine de canton ask for 1 ounce caramel vodka van gogh dutch ask for 2 12 ounces apple cider 1 dash lemon juice directions: rim martini glass with agave syrup and crumbled gingersnap cookies and set aside. add liquid ingredients to a cocktail shaker with ice and shake well. strain into martini glass.

inputs: butter, white sugar, weight, chocolate chips, salt, coating chocolate
targets: title: chocolate pretzel bark ingredients: 1 cup butter 3/4 cups white sugar 10 ounces, weight thin pretzel sticks 2 cups semi sweet chocolate chips 1 pinch sea salt 1/2 cups white candy coating chocolate directions: heat oven to 350 f. heat butter and sugar in a saucepan until boiling. cook on medium for 2 3 minutes until sugar is dissolved. remove from heat. set aside. line an 11x14 inch pan with parchment paper. line up pretzels in a single layer across the bottom of the pan as best as you can. pour sugar butter mixture over the pretzels and pop into the oven for 8 minutes. pull the pan out of the oven and sprinkle with the chocolate chips. return to oven for 3 minutes. pull the pan out and spread the chocolate all around. sprinkle with sea salt to taste. this depends on the saltiness of your pretzels as well. be careful. melt white chocolate in the microwave on 50 power until smooth. drizzle over the pretzel bark. allow all of this to cool. you want the chocolate completely solid again. i put mine in the refrigerator for 30 minutes. as if this wasnt enough fun all ready now you get to break it apart and share with your friends. they will call you blessed. store in airtight container.

inputs: cucumbers, onion, salt, sugar, vinegar
targets: title: frozen pickles ingredients: 2 qt. cucumbers, sliced thin 1 large onion, sliced thin 2 tbsp. salt 1 1/2 c. sugar 1/2 c. vinegar directions: place in a large bowl. cover cucumbers and onions with cold water and add 2 tablespoons salt. let stand for 2 hours. drain for 15 minutes. dissolve the sugar and vinegar. pour over cucumbers. let stand for 15 minutes. put in freezer bags and freeze. to use, simply thaw in refrigerator.

inputs: tomato paste, grapeseed oil, spring onions, clove garlic, ginger, serrano chile, tomatoes, coconut, tomato paste, salt, curry sauce, grapeseed oil, red onion, coconut milk, serrano chile, coriander, lime, soy sauce, lime, salt, jasmine rice
targets: title: tomato eggplant curry with chile lime ingredients: tomato paste 500g small long asian eggplants, sliced into 1 1/2 cm a little more than 1/2 inch rounds 1 tablespoon grapeseed oil 4 spring onions scallions 1 clove garlic 2 tablespoons finely grated ginger 1 serrano chile 5 small tomatoes, peeled and finely chopped see note 2 tablespoons coconut or dark palm sugar 2 tablespoons tomato paste 1/2 teaspoon fine sea salt curry sauce 2 tablespoons grapeseed oil 1 medium red onion, finely sliced 1 400 milliliter can coconut milk 1 serrano chile, thinly sliced 1/2 cup roughly chopped coriander cilantro 4 kaffir lime leaves, stem removed, finely shredded 1 tablespoon gluten free soy sauce juice and finely grated zest of 1 lime sea salt and freshly ground black pepper steamed jasmine rice and fresh herbs, to serve directions: first up lay the eggplant slices out onto a tray in a single layer. sprinkle with a little salt and set aside for 30 minutes. rinse off salt and pat eggplant slices dry with a clean tea towel or paper towel. to make the tomato paste, heat oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat. add spring onion, garlic, ginger, and chile, and cook, stirring often, for 3 to 4 minutes or until tender. add chopped tomatoes, sugar, tomato paste, and salt, and continue to cook for a further 6 to 8 minutes or until the tomatoes are pulpy. remove from the heat and puree with a stick blender to a fine paste. wash out the saucepan quickly and return to the heat over medium. add the oil for the curry sauce. when hot add the eggplant aubergine slices and red onion and cook, stirring often for 8 to 10 minutes or until the eggplant is starting to soften. add the coconut milk, prepared tomato paste, sliced chile, chopped coriander cilantro , kaffir lime leaves, soy sauce, and lime zest and juice. reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 15 to 20 minutes or until the eggplant is meltingly tender. add a touch of water at any stage if the sauce is thickening up too much. taste and adjust seasoning, adding more salt/pepper, chile, lime juice, or sugar if needed to get the right balance of flavors. serve hot over jasmine rice, scattered with coriander leaves, thai basil, sliced chile, and a wedge of lime to squeeze. note to skin tomatoes remove the hard core at one end and make a cross slit with a sharp knife on the other round end. submerge into boiling water for 30 to 45 seconds, remove, and run under cold water. the skins should now slip off easily.

inputs: buttermilk, lemon juice, olive oil, shallots, dill, parsley, salt, freshly ground black pepper, baby spinach, hearts of palm, oranges, pine nuts
targets: title: spinach and mandarin orange salad with buttermilk herb dressing ingredients: 1/2 cup buttermilk 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice 1 tablespoon olive oil 1 tablespoon minced shallots 1 tablespoon minced fresh dill 1 tablespoon minced fresh parsley 1/2 teaspoon salt 1/4 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper 1 pound fresh baby spinach, rinsed well, dried and stems removed 1 14 1/2 ounce can hearts of palm, cut crosswise into 1/2 inch rings 2 mandarin oranges, peeled and segmented 1/3 cup pine nuts, lightly toasted directions: in a bowl whisk together the buttermilk, lemon juice and oil. add the shallots, dill, parsley, salt, and pepper, and mix well. in a large salad bowl, combine the baby spinach and hearts of palm. toss with the dressing to taste, and divide the greens among 6 salad plates. decoratively arrange the orange segments on each salad, and top with the toasted pine nuts. drizzle additional dressing, if desired. serve.

inputs: extra virgin olive oil, vinegar, mustard, shallot, fresh herbs, kosher salt, black pepper
targets: title: simple vinaigrette ingredients: 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil 3 tablespoons vinegar such as red wine, white wine, sherry or balsamic, plus more if needed 1 teaspoon dijon mustard 2 teaspoons shallot chopped, optional 1/2 teaspoon fresh herbs such as basil, oregano, thyme or chives chopped, optional kosher salt black pepper freshly ground directions: combine oil, vinegar, mustard and shallot and/or herb if desired in the blender jar. secure lid and turn dial to speed 1. slowly increase speed to medium speed 5 or 6 . blend until emulsified, about 30 seconds. adjust flavor with splash more vinegar if needed. season to taste with salt and pepper. use immediately, or transfer to airtight container and store at room temperature for up to 2 days. tip this version comes together in moments and can be personalized with the type of vinegar you choose and if you opt to add the shallot and/or fresh herb.

inputs: water, milk, brown sugar, salt, yeast, vegetable oil, whole wheat flour, arthur unbleached
targets: title: wheat bread recipe ingredients: 2 c. warm water 1/2 c. dry lowfat milk opt. 1/2 c. brown sugar, honey or possibly molasses 1 tbsp. salt 1 tbsp. or possibly packet active dry yeast 1/4 c. vegetable oil or possibly butter 3 c. king arthur stone grnd whole wheat flour 3 4 c. king arthur unbleached white flour directions: to 2 c. warm water, add in and let dissolve in 3 successive stages, 1 tbsp. sweetener, the yeast and salt. when all 3 are dissolved, add in rest of sweetener, the shortening and 3 c. whole wheat flour. mix thoroughly and let it sit for at least 2 hrs. all day if convenient. this sponge will bubble. add in white flour. 3 1/2 c. if honey or possibly molasses is used. knead till spongy. cut dough in half and form into loaves. place in greased bread pans. let rise till double. place in cool oven. bake at 350 degrees for 35 to 40 min.

inputs: shortening, sugar, eggs, flour, cream of tartar, soda, salt
targets: title: snicle doodles ingredients: 1 c. shortening part butter 1 1/2 c. sugar 2 eggs 2/3 c. flour 1 tsp. cream of tartar 1 tsp. soda 1/4 tsp. salt directions: mix thoroughly shortening, sugar and eggs. sift together and stir in flour, cream of tartar, soda and salt. roll into balls the size of small walnuts. then roll balls in mixture of 2 tablespoons sugar and 2 tablespoons cinnamon. place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet. bake until light brown but still soft. temperature 400 , bake 8 to 10 minutes. yields 5 dozen 2 inch cookies.

inputs: salad, cranberries, hazelnuts, apple, sweet red pepper, pomegranate seeds, romaine lettuce, red leaf, vinegarette, pomegranate juice, raspberry vinegar, shallot, olive oil, salt
targets: title: brigid s pomegranate salad with pomegranate raspberry vinegarette ingredients: salad 1/4 cup dried cranberries 1/2 cup hazelnuts, toasted and chopped 4 oz oregon blue cheese crumbles 1 granny smith apple, diced medium slices are fine too 1 small sweet red pepper, diced fine optional 1/2 1 cup fresh pomegranate seeds 1/2 head romaine lettuce 1/2 head red leaf lettuce vinegarette 1/4 cup pomegranate juice 1/4 cup raspberry vinegar 1 small shallot, peeled 1 1/2 cups olive oil salt and pepper to taste directions: vinegarette place shallot, vinegar and pomegranate juice into a blender or food processor. puree with two or three short bursts until the shallot is well chopped. while running, slowly drizzle in oil until emulsified. add salt and pepper as desired. salad cut each of the half heads of lettuce in half again keeping the two halves connected at the core. cut the lettuce with 3/4 cuts. rinse with cold water, drain and dry. in a large bowl, mix lettuce with apples, peppers, dried cranberries, and desired amount of dressing. toss thoroughly. take a larger serving platter, place salad on platter, sprinkle the top with the nuts, blue cheese, and desired amount of pomegranate seeds.

inputs: chicken, chicken rice, onion soup mix, mushrooms, mushroom soup, boiling water
targets: title: chicken rice a roni ingredients: 1 cut up chicken, raw 1 box chicken rice a roni 1/2 pkg. onion soup mix 1 can mushrooms 1 can mushroom soup 1 1/2 c. boiling water directions: brown rice a roni and seasoning in 2 tablespoons oil. add mushrooms, mushroom soup and boiling water. place chicken in oiled 9 x 13 inch pan. pour rice a roni mixture over the chicken. sprinkle onion soup on top. seal well with foil and bake for 1 1/2 hours at 350 . do not add salt.

inputs: cheddar cheese, cream cheese, margarine, milk, steak sauce, pecans
targets: title: cheese balls ingredients: 1 8 oz. kraft longhorn mild cheddar cheese 2 8 oz. cream cheese 1/2 c. margarine 2 tbsp. milk 2 tsp. steak sauce 1 2 c. pecans, finely chopped directions: beat all ingredients except pecans until fluffy. chill and shape. roll in pecans.

inputs: whole wheat flour, all purpose, oats, baking powder, baking soda, salt, cinnamon, unsweetened applesauce, low fat buttermilk, brown sugar, canola oil, egg, dried cherries
targets: title: oatmeal cherry applesauce muffins ingredients: 3/4 cup whole wheat flour 1/2 cup all purpose flour 1 1/4 cups oats 1 teaspoon baking powder 1/2 teaspoon baking soda 1/4 teaspoon salt 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon 1 cup unsweetened applesauce 1/2 cup low fat buttermilk 1/2 cup firmly packed brown sugar 2 tablespoons canola oil 1 large egg, slighlty beaten 3/4 cup dried cherries or 3/4 cup cranberries directions: preheat oven to 375 degrees. line a 12 cup and a 6 cup muffin pan with paper cases or non stick spray. in a large bowl combine flour, oats, baking powder, baking soda, salt and cinnamon. in a medium bowl combine applesauce, buttermilk, sugar, oil and egg. make a well in dry ingredients and add applesauce mixture. stir until just moist. fold in cherries or cranberries. fill muffin cups 2/3 full.

inputs: flour, sugar, margarine, milk, eggs, vanilla
targets: title: cake and chocolate sauce ingredients: 2 1/2 c. self rising flour 1 1/2 c. sugar 1/2 c. margarine 1 c. milk 3 eggs, beaten 1 tbsp. vanilla directions: mix together cake ingredients. mix well. bake at 350 in a 9 x 13 inch pan for 30 minutes.

inputs: macaroni, butter, salt, pepper, flour, milk, white wine, velveeta cheese, cheddar vermont, breadcrumbs
targets: title: vermont mac and cheese ingredients: 16 ounces elbow macaroni cooked 1 cup butter 1 teaspoon salt 1/2 teaspoon pepper 1/2 cup flour 3 1/4 cups milk 1/4 cup white wine 1/2 pound velveeta cheese cut into cubes 1/2 pound cheddar vermont, cut into cubes panko breadcrumbs directions: preheat oven to 350 degrees. in a pan, melt the butter along with the salt, pepper and flour and stir until smooth. remove from heat add milk and wine, then return to heat and bring to a boil. boil 1 minute while whisking. remove from the heat and add both cheeses, and stir until melted. pour over elbows, mix well, and pour into very lightly greased baking dish. sprinkle with panko and bake at 350 degrees for 30 40 minutes.

inputs: pork, potatoes, soy sauce, sake, olive oil
targets: title: kimchi pork rolls ingredients: 8 slice thinly sliced pork 1 small potatoes 30 grams kimchi 2 tbsp soy sauce 1 tbsp sake 1 olive oil directions: cut the potato into 8 sticks. boil until slightly under cooked. spread out the pork slices and top the whole slice with a thin layer of kimchi. then place one potato stick from step 1 on top, and wrap into a roll. if you have time, leave it for 1 hour to rest you can skip this step . heat the olive oil in a frying pan and evenly fry all sides of the rolls. steam the rolls with the lid on, over low heat. finish by adding the mixed soy sauce and sake, to make it teriyaki style. transfer to a serving dish and garnish with kimchi if you like.

inputs: butter, sugar, eggs, all purpose, baking soda, salt, lemon rind, vanilla, peach yogurt, powdered sugar
targets: title: yogurt pound cake ingredients: 1 c. butter or margarine, softened 1 1/2 c. sugar 3 eggs 2 1/4 c. all purpose flour 1/2 tsp. baking soda 1/2 tsp. salt 1 tsp. grated lemon rind 1 tsp. vanilla 1 8 oz. carton peach yogurt powdered sugar optional directions: preheat oven to 350 . cream the butter. gradually add sugar, beating until mixture is light and fluffy. add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition. combine flour, soda and salt. add to creamed mixture, mixing well. stir lemon rind, vanilla and yogurt into batter. pour batter into a greased and floured 10 inch bundt pan. i just spray with pam, no flour. bake at 350 for 1 hour or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean. cool in pan 15 minutes remove from pan and cool completely on a rack. sprinkle cake with powdered sugar, if desired. yields one 10 inch cake.

inputs: oatmeal, coconut, nuts, germ, brown sugar, margarine, honey
targets: title: crunchy granola ingredients: 5 c. dry oatmeal 2/3 c. coconut 2 c. chopped nuts 3 c. wheat germ optional 2/3 c. brown sugar 2 c. margarine 4 c. honey or molasses directions: in one bowl combine oats, coconut, nuts and wheat germ. in another bowl combine brown sugar, margarine and honey. mix the two together. press firmly into well greased 9 x 13 inch cake pan. bake at 325 for 25 minutes. get out of pan immediately and spread out on a piece of waxed paper. cool.

inputs: lamb roast, salt, honey, herbes, red wine, garlic, extra virgin olive oil, eggplants, chicken stock
targets: title: honey glazed lamb with herbes de provence ingredients: one 3 1/2 pound trimmed boneless leg of lamb roast with at least 1/8 inch layer of fat on one side, butterflied salt and freshly ground black pepper 1/4 cup plus 1 tablespoon mild honey, such as clover 3 tablespoons herbes de provence 1/2 cup plus 1 tablespoon dry red wine 2 heads of garlic, separated into unpeeled cloves extra virgin olive oil 4 asian eggplants about 12 ounces each , sliced crosswise 1 inch thick 1/2 cup chicken stock directions: preheat the oven to 400. spread the lamb out on a work surface, fat side down. season with salt and pepper and rub 2 tablespoons of the honey on the lean side of the lamb. sprinkle with 1 tablespoon of the herbes de provence. loosely roll the lamb into a neat oval shape and stitch together by crisscrossing short skewers at the bottom of the roast. transfer the lamb to a shallow roasting pan, fat side up, and season with salt and pepper. rub the remaining 3 tablespoons of honey all over the roast and sprinkle with the remaining 2 tablespoons of herbes de provence. add 1/2 cup of the red wine and 1/2 cup of water to the roasting pan. roast the lamb in the upper third of the oven for about 1 hour and 15 minutes, rotating the pan halfway through, until an instant read thermometer inserted into the thickest part of the meat registers 145 for medium meat. meanwhile, put the garlic cloves on a sheet of heavy duty foil and drizzle lightly with olive oil. wrap the garlic in the foil. spread the eggplant slices on a large rimmed baking sheet and brush both sides generously with olive oil. roast the eggplant and the garlic in the lower third of the oven for 45 to 50 minutes, until the eggplant is very tender and browned on the bottom and the garlic is very soft. using a thin spatula, loosen the eggplant from the pan, then cover with foil and keep warm. peel the garlic cloves. transfer the lamb to a carving board and let rest for 10 minutes. remove the skewers. add the stock and the peeled garlic cloves to the pan juices. set the pan over moderately high heat just until the juices are bubbling scrape up the browned bits from the bottom of the pan. strain the juices through a coarse sieve set over a small saucepan press to push the garlic through. skim off the fat. season the sauce with salt and pepper and stir in the remaining 1 tablespoon of red wine. slice the lamb 1/3 inch thick and serve with the roasted garlic sauce and eggplant.

inputs: turkey, seasoning salt, leftover prepared stuffing, green onions, original bisquick, milk, eggs, turkey gravy
targets: title: impossibly easy turkey and stuffing pie ingredients: 2 cups cut up cooked turkey or 2 cups chicken 1/2 teaspoon seasoning salt 1 cup leftover prepared stuffing 4 medium green onions, thinly sliced 1/4 cup 1/2 cup cooked green peas 1/2 cup original bisquick baking mix 1 cup milk 2 eggs turkey gravy, heated, if desired directions: preheat oven to 400 degrees f. spray a 9 inch pie plate with cooking spray. spread turkey in pie plate sprinkle with seasoned salt. separate stuffing into small pieces arrange on turkey. top with onions and peas. stir bisquick mix, milk and eggs in medium bowl with wire whisk or fork until blended. carefully pour into pie plate. bake 30 35 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean. let stand 5 minutes before serving. serve with gravy,, if desired.

inputs: sausage, water, red pepper, sage, cornmeal
targets: title: easy scrapple ingredients: 1 lb sausage 2 cups water 1 tablespoon red pepper flakes 1 teaspoon rubbed sage 1 cup cornmeal directions: pour 2 cups of water in a sauce pan and bring to a boil. cut sausage into pieces and add to boiling water mixing throughly a potato masher works well . once sausage is done take pan off heat and add red pepper flakes and sage. add cornmeal and mix throughly and pour into loaf pan. refrigerate until completely cooled. slice and fry in frying pan with cooking spray.

inputs: cranberries, oranges, pineapple, sugar, pecans, cinnamon
targets: title: steve s cranberry relish ingredients: 1 lb cranberries 2 navel oranges, peeled and seeded including the peel 1 6 ounce can crushed pineapple 1 1/2 cups sugar 1/2 cup pecans, chopped 1 dash cinnamon, and or 1 dash clove directions: chop the berries and the oranges fairly fine. toss everything together. add up to 1 1/2 cups of sugar to taste.

inputs: rump roast, beef broth, garlic salt, oregano, paprika, bay leaves, pepper
targets: title: italian beef ingredients: 4 lb. rump roast 3 c. beef broth i make broth with bouillon cubes 2 tsp. garlic salt 2 tbsp. oregano 1 tbsp. paprika 4 bay leaves pepper directions: bake roast at 325 , about 1 1/2 hours, uncovered, until medium well done. cool. slice very thin. in large pan simmer remaining ingredients. add beef slices and simmer 1 hour or until done. serve on hard rolls. spoon juice over meat on rolls.

inputs: cream cheese, velveeta cheese, pecans, paprika
targets: title: hot cheese rolls ingredients: 2 small pkg. cream cheese 1 lb. velveeta cheese 1 c. chopped pecans tabasco to taste paprika directions: mix cheeses and pecans in mixing bowl with hands until thoroughly blended. add tabasco sauce and mix well. divide in half. roll in hands to form long roll. place on wax paper which is covered with paprika. roll cheese until covered. wrap in same paper and refrigerate.

inputs: hot cocoa, rumple minze, godiva original chocolate
targets: title: godiva peppermint patty ingredients: 1/2 cup hot cocoa 1 ounce rumple minze pepper mint liqueur 1 ounce godiva original chocolate liqueur directions: pour hot chocolate into a brandy snifter. add rumple minze and godiva liqueurs. stir. top with whipped cream.

inputs: butter, brown sugar, egg, baking soda, chocolate chips
targets: title: p nut butter truffle cookies ingredients: 1 c. p nut butter 1 c. brown sugar 1 egg 1 tsp. baking soda 3/4 c. chocolate chips directions: mix peanut butter, brown sugar and egg. add chocolate chips and mix well. drop by tablespoons on baking sheet and bake 9 to 10 minutes at 350 . cool baking sheet on wire rack for 5 minutes and then remove cookies.

inputs: graham cracker crumbs, walnuts, margarine, sugar, cream cheese, eggs, pumpkin, sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg, ginger, salt, cloves
targets: title: pumpkin cheesecake ingredients: 1 1/2 c. graham cracker crumbs 1/2 c. english walnuts 1/3 c. margarine 1/4 c. sugar 4 8 oz. cream cheese 6 eggs 1 15 oz. can pumpkin 1 3/4 c. sugar 1/2 tsp. cinnamon 1/2 tsp. nutmeg 1/2 tsp. ginger 1/8 tsp. salt 1/2 tsp. cloves directions: blend together pour into crust. bake 1 hour and 30 minutes until golden brown. turn off oven, crack oven door and let stand 60 minutes. remove from oven and cool completely. chill. delicious

inputs: apples, flour, margarine, brown sugar, oats
targets: title: apple crisp ingredients: 3 large apples, sliced 1/2 c. flour 1/2 c. margarine, melted 3/4 c. brown sugar 3/4 c. oats, uncooked directions: place sliced apples into baking dish. mix butter, flour, brown sugar and oats. heat and pour on top of apples. bake at 350 for 30 minutes. serve warm, good with vanilla ice cream.

inputs: salmon, teriyaki apple, apple cider, apples, teriyaki sauce, wasabi mashed potatoes, potatoes, milk, wasabi powder, butter, salt, snow peas, tsuyu no
targets: title: apple teriyaki salmon and wasabi mashed potatoes ingredients: 4 salmon fillets, 7 oz each teriyaki apple reduction 1/2 cup apple cider 2 fuji apples, peeled and thinly sliced 1/2 cup teriyaki sauce wasabi mashed potatoes 2 lbs russet potatoes, peeledd, cut into 2 in pieces 3/4 cup whole milk 1 tbsp wasabi powder 1/4 cup butter salt/pepper to taste snow peas 1 cup snow peas 1/2 cup tsuyu no moto asian markets directions: place apple cider and apples in saute pan. bring to boil and reduce heat to simmer. reduce by 3/4, stirring occasionally. add teriyaki to apple reduction. stir well. meanwhile, mashed potatoes place potatoes in large pot of cold, salted water. boil til tender 20 mins . drain, return to pot and mash. combine milk and wasabi powder in small bowl. stir to dissolve powder. add milk mixture and butter to potatoes. beat until fluffy and smooth. season potatoes to taste with salt/pepper. while making potatoes, lightly steam snow peas and season with tsuyu no moto keep warm . to grill salmon preheat grill to medium high, oil grates well, and when hot, place salmon fillets on grill. grill for 3 4 mins and turn, grill another side 3 4 mins and remove from grill.

inputs: ground beef, vegetable oil, salt, condensed french onion soup, chili powder, ground cumin, ground black pepper, tomato paste, tomato sauce, kidney beans, unsweetened cocoa, cola flavored carbonated beverage
targets: title: chili iv ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds ground beef 1 tablespoon vegetable oil 1/2 teaspoon salt 1 10.5 ounce can condensed french onion soup 1 tablespoon chili powder 2 teaspoons ground cumin 1/2 teaspoon ground black pepper 1 6 ounce can tomato paste 1 8 ounce can tomato sauce 2 15 ounce cans kidney beans 2 teaspoons unsweetened cocoa 1 cup cola flavored carbonated beverage directions: in a deep skillet or large saucepan, cook beef with oil and salt over medium heat until brown. meanwhile, puree french onion soup in a blender until smooth. drain meat. stir pureed soup into meat, reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes. stir in chili powder, cumin, pepper, tomato paste, tomato sauce, and beans until well combined. stir in cocoa and cola. heat through and serve.

inputs: oil, red wine vinegar, sugar, catsup
targets: title: salad dressing ingredients: 1 c. oil 1/2 c. red wine vinegar 1/2 c. sugar 1/3 c. catsup directions: combine and shake well. refrigerate 1 hour. great on spinach salad.

inputs: green peppers, butter, olive oil, onions, celery, tomatoes, tomato sauce, garlic, dried leaf oregano, dried leaf basil, salt, ground black pepper, egg, worchestershire sauce, lean ground beef, rice, cheddar cheese
targets: title: stuffed peppers with ground beef and rice ingredients: 6 green peppers 1 tablespoon butter 1 tablespoon olive oil 1/2 cup onions chopped 1/2 cup celery chopped 1 can diced tomatoes 14 oz 1 can tomato sauce 8 oz 1 clove garlic crushed 1 teaspoon dried leaf oregano 1/2 teaspoon dried leaf basil 2 teaspoons salt, divided 1 teaspoon ground black pepper 1 egg lightly beaten 1 teaspoon worchestershire sauce 1 1/2 pounds lean ground beef 1 1/2 cups cooked long grain rice 1/2 cup shreeded mild cheddar cheese optional directions: cut tops off peppers, remove seeds and membraines. chopp dible part of tops and set aside. rinse peppers under cold water. place peppers in large pot, cover with salted water. bring to a boil reduce heat, cover and simmer for 5 minutes. drain peppers and set aside. heat olive oil and butter in a large skillet over medium heat until hot. saute chopped greeen pepper from tops , chopped onion, and chopped celery for about 5 minutes, or until vegetables are tender. add to,matoes, tomato sauce, crushed garlic, oregano, basil, 1 teaspoon salt, and 1/4 teaspoon pepper. simmer for about 10 minuteds. in a large mixing bowl, combine egg with remaining 1 teaspoon pepper, and worchestershire sauce. gently stir to blend add ground beef, cooked rice, and 1 cup of the tomato mixture. mix well. stuff peppers with meat mixture and place in a 3 quart bakng dish. pour remaining tomato mixture over the stuffed peppers. bake at 350 degrees for 55 to 65 minutes. if desired, top stuffed peppers with a little shredded cheddar cheese just before peppers are done. bake until cheese is melted.

inputs: eggs, butter, scallion including green, celery, flour, stock, milk, heavy cream, lump crabmeat, sherry, salt, fresh ground black pepper, paprika, thin slices
targets: title: she crab soup ingredients: 2 hard cooked eggs, optional 3 tablespoons butter 1 scallion including green top, minced 1 rib celery, minced 2 tablespoons flour 2 cups fish stock, or bottled clam juice 2 cups milk 2 cups heavy cream 1 1/2 pounds lump crabmeat, picked free of shell 1/4 cup dry sherry 1 1/2 teaspoons salt 1/4 teaspoon fresh ground black pepper 1/2 teaspoon paprika 6 thin slices lemon directions: if using the eggs, separate the yolks from the whites and save the whites for another use. press the yolks through a sieve and reserve. in a large pot, melt the butter over moderately low heat. add the scallion and celery and cook, stirring occasionally, until the vegetables are soft, about 4 minutes. add the flour and cook, stirring, for 2 minutes. stir in the stock, milk and cream. bring to a simmer, stirring. add the sieved egg yolks, if using, the crabmeat, sherry, salt and pepper and bring almost to a simmer. ladle into bowls and top each serving with a pinch of paprika and a lemon slice.

inputs: cornbread mix, onion, green pepper, tomatoes, bacon, velveeta cheese, salad dressing, mustard, salt
targets: title: cornbread salad ingredients: 2 pkg. jiffy cornbread mix, cooked, cooled and crumbled 1 1/2 c. chopped onion 1 medium green pepper, chopped 3 medium firm tomatoes 8 to 10 slices bacon, cooked, drained and crumbled 1 1/2 c. cubed light velveeta cheese 1 1/2 c. salad dressing or mayo 2 tbsp. mustard salt and pepper to taste directions: mix well and let set overnight. will make 2 quarts and 1 pint. you can cut this in half.

inputs: dish pie crust, cream cheese, eggs, white sugar, lemon juice, white sugar, cornstarch, water, lemon juice, strawberry flavored, fresh strawberries
targets: title: fresh strawberry cheesecake pie ingredients: 1 9 inch unbaked deep dish pie crust 1 8 ounce package cream cheese, softened 2 eggs 1/2 cup white sugar 2 tablespoons lemon juice 1/2 cup white sugar 2 tablespoons cornstarch 3/4 cup water 1 tablespoon lemon juice 2 tablespoons strawberry flavored jell o r mix 1 quart fresh strawberries, hulled and sliced directions: preheat oven to 400 degrees f 200 degrees c . bake pie crust until lightly browned, about 10 minutes. remove crust from oven and turn oven temperature down to 350 degrees f 175 degrees c . beat cream cheese, eggs, 1/2 cup sugar, and 2 tablespoons lemon juice in a bowl until smoothly combined. pour filling into crust. bake until filling is set, about 30 minutes. remove from oven and let cool completely. whisk together 1/2 cup sugar, cornstarch, water, 1 tablespoon lemon juice, and strawberry gelatin in a saucepan until smooth place over medium heat and bring to a simmer. cook, stirring constantly, until the gelatin has dissolved and the glaze has thickened, 5 to 10 minutes. remove from heat and allow to cool slightly. arrange the sliced strawberries atop the cheese filling. pour warm glaze over sliced strawberries. chill thoroughly in refrigerator before serving.

inputs: potatoes, celery stems, carrots, onion, ham, cheddar cheese soup
targets: title: ham and cheese soup ingredients: 8 medium potatoes 4 celery stems 4 c. carrots 1 medium onion 2 c. ham 2 cans cheddar cheese soup directions: dice potatoes, celery, carrots and onion. cook until tender, but firm. add diced ham and cheese soup. heat thoroughly.

inputs: flour, baking powder, salt, shortening, sugar, eggs, milk, vanilla, brown sugar, flour, cinnamon, butter, nuts
targets: title: streusel cake ingredients: 3 cups sifted flour 3 teaspoons baking powder 1 teaspoon salt 1 cup shortening 1 cup sugar 2 eggs 1 cup milk 1 teaspoon vanilla 12 cup firmly packed brown sugar 2 tablespoons flour 2 teaspoons cinnamon 2 tablespoons melted butter or 2 tablespoons margarine 12 cup chopped nuts directions: mix and sift flour, baking powder and salt. cream shortening and sugar until light and fluffy add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition. combine milk and vanilla and add alternately with dry ingredients to creamed mixture, beginning and ending with dry ingredients. spread half the batter in well greased ablong baking pan, 9x13x2 inches sprinkle half the streusel mixture on top then add remaining batter top with remaining streusel mixture. bake at 350 degrees about one hour or until cake tests done cut into squares to serve. streusel mixture blend brown sugar, flour, cinnamon, melted butter or margarine and chopped nuts until mixture is crumbly.

inputs: water, brown rice, weight broccoli, garlic, carrots, sprouts, chicken, soy sauce, fish sauce, salt, vegetable oil
targets: title: fried brown rice with chicken, broccoli, carrot bean sprouts ingredients: 4 cups water 2 cups short grained brown rice 9 ounces, weight broccoli 3 cloves garlic, minced 1 whole carrots, diced 8 ounces, weight bean sprouts 1 pound boneless skinless chicken breast 3 tablespoons soy sauce 2 tablespoons fish sauce salt to taste vegetable oil, as needed directions: 1. if you have left over rice in the refrigerator, use this. day old rice is better than fresh rice for fried rice. otherwise, cook some fresh rice. wash rice and make sure to drain all of the water from the rice. in a medium sized pot, add the listed amount of water. once water starts to boil, add rice. place lid on the pot and turn flame to low. simmer cook rice for 45 minutes. after 45 minutes, turn off the flame and let the rice sit for 10 minutes. 2. slice off stem from broccoli and slice broccoli into smaller bite sized pieces. leave sliced and diced vegetables to the side. 3. cube chicken breast into about 1/2 inch pieces. 4. in a large frying pan over medium to high heat, add a drizzle of vegetable oil. add chicken and some salt to flavor chicken. cook chicken so chicken turns golden brown on all sides. once chicken is cooked, transfer it to a bowl. 5. in the same frying pan, add a little more vegetable oil. add garlic and broccoli first. saute for 2 3 minutes, so broccoli starts to get soft but you want broccoli to still retain crunchiness . 6. after broccoli gets a little soft, add carrots and saute for another 1 2 minutes so carrot gets soft. 7. finally add bean sprouts. add 1 tablespoon of soy sauce and 1 tablespoon of fish sauce and saute for 1 2 minutes, so the soy sauce and fish sauce cover all of the vegetables. 8. add chicken and cooked brown rice and stir to combine. then add the remaining 2 tablespoons of soy sauce and 1 tablespoon of fish sauce and saute until all of the flavors come together. serves 4 6.

inputs: red wine, shallots, garlic, carrots, bay leaf, thyme, parsley, peppercorns, honey, mushrooms, butter, eggs, croutons, flour, parsley
targets: title: eggs poached in red wine sauce les oeufs poches au vin rouge ingredients: 3 cups dry red wine 1/2 cup shallots, peeled and thinly sliced 4 large cloves garlic, peeled and crushed 1/4 cup carrots, scraped and cut into very small cubes 1 bay leaf 2 sprigs fresh thyme 4 sprigs fresh parsley 6 peppercorns 1 teaspoon honey 8 fresh mushrooms, about 1/2 pound 5 tablespoons butter 8 eggs at room temperature 8 croutons see recipe 2 tablespoons flour 3 tablespoons finely chopped parsley directions: put the wine in a wide saucepan and add the shallots, garlic, carrots, bay leaf, thyme and parsley sprigs, peppercorns and honey. cut off the stems of the mushrooms and add them. set the caps aside. bring to the simmer and cook 15 minutes. strain the mixture and discard the solids. return the wine liquid to the saucepan. heat one tablespoon of the butter in a skillet large enough to hold the mushroom caps in one layer when they are added. add the mushrooms cap side down. cook two to three minutes on one side or until golden brown. turn and continue cooking two to three minutes. remove from the heat. break each egg into a small bowl. it is best to poach only four eggs at a time. bring the wine liquid to the simmer and carefully slide the eggs, one at a time, into the liquid. let simmer until the whites are firm and the yolks remain runny, about two to three minutes. carefully scoop out each egg, using a slotted spoon, and drain on absorbent paper towels. repeat with the remaining eggs and drain. arrange the croutons on a serving platter or arrange two croutons on each of four serving dishes. top each crouton with a poached egg. meanwhile, knead the remaining four tablespoons of butter with the flour. skim off and discard any egg remnants floating on the surface of the wine liquid. bring the liquid to the simmer and gradually add the butter flour mixture. stir until the sauce is thickened. pour the sauce over the eggs on croutons and garnish with the mushrooms on the side. sprinkle each egg with chopped parsley and serve.

inputs: pork loin, kosher salt, brown sugar, freshly cracked black pepper, cayenne pepper, olive oil, butter, garlic, pepper, salt, apples, maple syrup, ground cinnamon, ground allspice, mutha sauce, water, scallion
targets: title: apple maple roasted pork loin ingredients: 1 pork loin with the rib bones attached 3 1/2 to 4 pounds 1 tablespoon kosher salt 1 tablespoon brown sugar 1 tablespoon freshly cracked black pepper pinch of cayenne pepper 3 tablespoons olive oil 1/4 cup butter 1 tablespoon minced garlic 1 jalapeno pepper, seeded and minced pinch each of kosher salt and black pepper 1 pound mcintosh apples, peeled, cored, and diced 3/4 cup pure maple syrup 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon 1/8 teaspoon ground allspice 3/4 cup mutha sauce page 165 1/4 cup water 3 tablespoons sliced scallion directions: preheat the oven to 500. get the butcher to cut the chine bone from the roast for easy carving later. mix up all the ingredients for the rub, and massage it all over the roast. place the roast, rib side down, in a roasting pan and pop it in the oven. cook for 30 to 40 minutes to caramelize the outside, then lower the heat to 350 and continue roasting slowly for another 25 to 30 minutes, til the internal temperature registers 150 see cookin perfect pork, page 95 . throw together the sauce while the pork is roasting. melt the butter in a saucepan. toss in the garlic and jalapenos with a pinch of salt and pepper, cooking til soft. dump in the apples and give them a stir. cook til soft but not mushy, 8 to 10 minutes. add the maple syrup, cinnamon, allspice, mutha sauce, and water, and simmer gently for 15 minutes. keep warm. take the roast out of the oven and let it rest for 15 minutes. slice the meat between the ribs into chops. pour any meat juices that ooze out while carving into the sauce and stir it up a bit. ladle some sauce onto each chop and sprinkle with scallions. serve em up and pass the remaining sauce at the table.

inputs: flour, active dry yeast, milk, sugar, butter, salt, eggs
targets: title: egg bread ingredients: 6 3/4 to 7 1/4 c. flour 2 pkg. active dry yeast 2 c. milk 1/4 c. sugar 1/4 c. butter or margarine 2 tsp. salt 3 eggs directions: heat oven to 375 . in a large mixer bowl, combine 3 cups of the flour and the yeast. in a saucepan, heat milk, sugar, butter and salt just until warm 115 to 120 and butter is almost melted stir constantly. add to flour mixture. add eggs. beat at low speed of electric mixer 1/2 minute, scraping bowl. beat 3 minutes at high speed. stir in as much remaining flour as you can mix in with a spoon.

inputs: new potatoes, vegetable oil, shallot, curry powder, kosher salt, yogurt
targets: title: crispy curried new potatoes recipe ingredients: 1 1/2 pounds new potatoes, all about the same size 1/3 cup vegetable oil 1 medium shallot, thinly sliced 1 teaspoon curry powder 1/2 teaspoon kosher salt, plus more as needed plain yogurt, for serving directions: place the potatoes in a large saucepan and cover them with water by 1 inch. season generously with salt, cover with a tightfitting lid, and bring to a boil over high heat. remove the lid and cook the potatoes until a sharp knife easily pierces them and they easily fall off the knife, about 10 to 15 minutes. using a slotted spoon, transfer the potatoes to a baking sheet. use the bottom of a measuring cup to smash each potato until it bursts and is flattened to about 1/2 inch thick set the potatoes aside. heat the oil in a large frying pan over medium high heat until shimmering. meanwhile, line a small plate with paper towels and set it aside. add the shallots to the pan and fry, stirring often, until browned, about 3 to 5 minutes be careful not to burn the shallots, as some pieces may brown faster than others . remove with the slotted spoon to the prepared plate, season with salt, and set aside. add the curry powder to the pan and stir until fragrant, about 20 seconds. using your hands, carefully add the smashed potatoes to the pan. use a metal spatula to flatten them into an even layer. season with the measured salt and cook undisturbed until browned and crusty on the bottom, about 6 to 8 minutes. flip, press into an even layer, and cook undisturbed until browned on the other side, about 4 minutes more. sprinkle the fried shallots over the potatoes and toss to combine. taste and season with additional salt as needed. serve immediately, passing the yogurt on the side.

inputs: cabbage, figs stewed, carrots, onions, parsley sprigs, celery seeds, pineapple, mayonnaise, sugar, salt, black pepper, dry mustard, vinegar, heavy whipping cream whipped
targets: title: san joaquin glamour salad ingredients: 1 medium cabbage 12 each figs stewed, dried, drained 2 each carrots 2 tablespoons onions grated 2 each parsley sprigs 1 teaspoon celery seeds 1 can pineapple, canned, crushed including syrup 3 tablespoons mayonnaise 2 tablespoons sugar 1 teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon black pepper freshly ground 1/2 teaspoon dry mustard 3 tablespoons vinegar 1/2 cup heavy whipping cream whipped directions: wash the cabbage, remove blemished leaves. cut stem at bottom to make even base. cut out center of cabbage. scoop out all possible cabbage, but retain a good shell that will not leak. remove stems from figs. then put scooped out cabbage, figs, carrots, onion, and parsley through food grinder, using the coarse blade. add all the remaining ingredients except the cream. stir together lightly. whip the cream and fold into the salad. spoon into cabbage shell, heaping high. garnish with more stewed figs and small lettuce leaves. adjust seasoning to your own taste if you wish.

inputs: whole wheat flour, baking soda, brown sugar, cinnamon, ground cloves, salt, raisins, egg, buttermilk, oil
targets: title: basic whole wheat muffins ingredients: 2 cups whole wheat flour 1 teaspoon baking soda 1/4 cup brown sugar or 1/4 cup honey 1 teaspoon cinnamon optional 1/8 teaspoon ground cloves optional 1/2 teaspoon salt 1/2 cup raisins 1 egg, beaten 1 cup buttermilk or 1 cup yogurt 3 tablespoons oil or 3 tablespoons melted butter directions: mix all dry ingredients thoroughly, including raisins. make a well in the center of dry ingredients and add egg, milk and oil. mix only until dry ingredients are moist. fill greased muffin pans half full. bake at 375f for 15 minutes.

inputs: bread, beans, green chilies, ground round, yellow onion, bell pepper, cheddar cheese, cheese, combination
targets: title: mexican deep dish pizza ingredients: 1 loaf frozen bread dough, thawed 1 can 1 lb. refried beans 1 can 4 oz. chopped green chilies, drained 1 lb. ground round, cooked, drained and finely crumbled 1 cup yellow onion, chopped 1 bell pepper, cut in strips 1 1/2 cup sharp cheddar cheese jalapeno jack cheese combination, shredded directions: allow bread to rise according to package directions. heat oven to 400f. brush olive oil lightly on bottom and sides of a rectangular baking dish. punch down dough and pat into prepared pan. spread refried beans evenly over dough surface. layer remaining ingredients over beans. can be prepared up to 8 hours in advance up to this point, cover and chill. add 15 minutes to baking time. bake 20 to 25 minutes or until edges are golden brown. serve immediately.

inputs: quinoa, curly kale, red, lebanese cucumber, fennel bulb, lemon, extra virgin olive oil, yeast, salt
targets: title: kale and quinoa salad ingredients: 1 cup quinoa 1 bunch curly kale 1/2 red capsicum 1 small lebanese cucumber 1 small fennel bulb 1 lemon, juiced 6 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil 1 teaspoon nutritional yeast optional salt amp pepper 1/4 cup slivered almonds, toasted directions: rinse and rub the quinoa grains with your fingers under running water. drain and place in a medium saucepan. add 1 plus 3/4 cup water and bring to the boil. one boiling add 1/2 tsp salt, reduce heat to a gentle simmer and cover the pot. cook for about 15 minutes or until all liquid is absorbed and you can see the tiny spirals curling around the seed. remove from the heat, and place a clean dishcloth over the pot and pop the lid back in place. rest for 10 minutes before turning out into a deep serving bowl. wash the kale and trim off the stems, tear into bite size pieces and set aside. remove the capsicum seeds and membranes and slice into thin strips, cut in half if they are too long. slice the cucumbers in quarters length ways and cut out seeds and membranes. slice these on an angle into thin strips too. trim the fennel and slice at an angle into equivalent strips. squeeze the juice from the lemon and place in a glass jar with a lid. add the extra virgin olive oil, nutritional yeast, and some salt and pepper. shake for a uniform consistency, taste, you re looking for a slight tang. adjust accordingly. add the vegetables to the cooled quinoa and add 4 tbsp of the vinaigrette, mix thoroughly before topping with the toasted almonds. serve with the remaining dressing on the side.

inputs: green onions, green bell pepper, red bell pepper, celery, feta cheese, black olives, tomatoes, chicken, dressing, salt, olive oil, red wine vinegar, lemon juice, garlic, onion powder, mustard, sugar, oregano, basil, salt, black pepper, parmesan cheese
targets: title: creamy greek style pasta salad ingredients: 500 g uncooked medium pasta shells or use small cheese tortellini pasta 6 8 green onions, chopped 1 small green bell pepper, seeded and finely chopped 1 small red bell pepper, seeded and finely chopped 1 stalk celery, finely diced optional 1 12 cups crumbled feta cheese 34 cup sliced black olives 2 large plum tomatoes, coarsley chopped or use halved cherry tomatoes 3 cups cooked chicken, diced or use cooked turkey 12 34 cup prepared ranch dressing or to taste salt and black pepper 12 cup olive oil can use half each vegetable oil and olive oil 3 tablespoons red wine vinegar 1 tablespoon lemon juice 1 teaspoon garlic powder 1 teaspoon onion powder 2 teaspoons dijon mustard 2 3 teaspoons sugar 3 teaspoons dried oregano you can add in more at the end of making the salad 3 teaspoons dried basil 1 2 teaspoon seasoning salt black pepper to taste 14 cup grated parmesan cheese directions: for the dressing in a bowl whisk together all ingredients until well blended adjusting amount to taste, then refrigerate until ready to use the dressing may be made up to a day in advance . boil the pasta shells in boiling water until al dente drain and rinse under cold water place into a large bowl. add in onions, bell peppers, celery if using feta cheese, olives, tomatoes and cooked chicken toss with a wooden spoon to combine. add in the prepared dressing toss well to combine. add in ranch dressing start with 1/2 cup and add in more to taste . add in more oregano if desired and season with salt and lots freshly ground black pepper. cover and chill for 5 hours or more before serving.

inputs: potato, zucchini, onion, eggplant, tomatoes, mozzarella cheese, parmesan cheese, dried basil, salt, pepper, water
targets: title: potato eggplant aubergine casserole ingredients: 1 lb medium potato, thinly sliced 1 medium zucchini, thinly sliced 1/2 lb medium onion, thinly sliced 1 small eggplant, peeled and sliced 1 lb medium tomatoes, sliced 1 1/2 cups shredded part skim mozzarella cheese 1/4 cup grated parmesan cheese 1/2 teaspoon dried basil 1/2 teaspoon salt 1/4 teaspoon pepper 1/4 cup water directions: coat a 3 quart baking dish with nonstick cooking spray. layer half of the ingredients in the baking dish. repeat layers. pour water over the top of the layers and cover. bake 60 75 minutes until tender at 375 f. uncover and bake an additional 5 minutes until lightly browned .

inputs: cashews, garlic, nutritional yeast, water, extra virgin olive oil, paprika, chipotle powder, salt, cumin
targets: title: spicy vegan cheese sauce ingredients: 1 cup raw cashews soaked for at least 3 hours, or raw sunflower seeds, also soaked 1 garlic clove 1/2 cup nutritional yeast 1/3 cup water 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil 1/2 teaspoon paprika 1/4 teaspoon dried chipotle powder 1/2 teaspoon sea salt more to taste 1 teaspoon cumin more to taste directions: place all ingredients into a high powered blender. blend till smooth and creamy. adjust seasoning to taste and add more water for preferred consistency.

inputs: raisins, dates, raisins, currants, pineapple, cherries, walnuts, white sugar, boiling water, shortening, flour, baking soda, cinnamon, ground cloves, salt, eggs
targets: title: holiday fruit cake ingredients: 2 1/2 c. small raisins 2 1/2 c. pitted dates, cut up 2 c. large muscat raisins 2 c. currants 2 small jars candied pineapple 2 small jars candied cherries 2 c. walnuts or pecans 3 c. white sugar 3 c. boiling water 8 tbsp. shortening 4 c. plain flour 2 tsp. baking soda 3 tsp. cinnamon 2 tsp. ground cloves 2 tsp. salt 2 eggs directions: put raisins, dates, fruits, sugar, water and shortening in a large pot bring to a boil, then simmer for 20 minutes. cool. sift flour once before measuring. combine flour, soda, cinnamon, cloves and salt and sift together. stir into cool mixture, adding eggs and nuts last. pour into very well greased and floured pan. bake 1 1/2 hours at 325 .

inputs: butter, head cabbage, lemon juice, caraway seed, salt
targets: title: butter crisp cabbage ingredients: 3 to 4 tbsp. butter/margarine 1 large head cabbage 2 tbsp. lemon juice 1/2 tsp. caraway seed salt and pepper to taste directions: shred cabbage. melt butter in a large heavy skillet. add cabbage. cover and cook, stirring until tender. add lemon juice, caraway seed, salt and pepper. serves 6.

inputs: shortening, flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt, eggs, sugar, bananas, nuts
targets: title: banana nut bread ingredients: 12 cup shortening 2 cups all purpose flour 12 teaspoon baking powder 12 teaspoon baking soda 1 pinch salt 2 eggs 1 cup sugar 3 bananas very ripe 12 cup nuts optional directions: peel and mash ripe bananas in a bowl. add eggs and sugar to bananas. sift together all dry ingredients. mix together with banana mixture. pour into greased loaf pan that has been sprayed well with pam. bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour.

inputs: salad, trout, fresh fennel, shallot, apple , fresh black pepper, dressing, heavy cream, horseradish, olive oil, vinegar, fresh dill, cayenne pepper
targets: title: smoked trout salad with apples, fennel and creamy horseradish dressing ingredients: for the salad 1 whole smoked trout 1/2 head frisee 1/2 bunch watercress 1/2 bulb fresh fennel 1 shallot 1 apple peeled, cored and julienned 1/4 cup fresh dill chopped 1 dash fresh black pepper for the dressing 1/2 cup heavy cream 1/4 cup prepared horseradish 2 tablespoons olive oil 1 tablespoon cider vinegar 2 teaspoons fresh dill 1 pinch cayenne pepper directions: in a large salad bowl, break the smoked trout into small pieces, discarding any bones. tear the frisee and watercress into small pieces and add that the bowl. shave the fennel and shallots into fine slices and add them to the bowl. add the apple, fresh dill and several grinds of black pepper. prepare the dressing by combining all of the dressing ingredients into a jar. cover and shake vigorously. pour the dressing over the salad and toss to distribute.

inputs: shrimp, lean bacon, bass fillets, butter, lemon, dill, salt, mushrooms, dill
targets: title: shrimp and bass spear it ingredients: 12 large shrimp 4 slices lean bacon 2 lb. bass fillets, cut in 1 inch strips 1/2 c. butter 1 stick juice of 1/2 lemon 1 tbsp. minced fresh dill salt and freshly ground pepper 6 large mushrooms, halved dill sprigs garnish directions: shell and devein shrimp. leave tails on. roll fish strips. cut bacon slices in half and wrap half strip around each fillet strip roll. melt butter and add lemon juice and minced dill. season to taste with salt and pepper. on each of four 12 to 16 inch skewers, spear first shrimp, next mushroom half, then wrapped fish. repeat, ending with shrimp.

inputs: ham, chicken cutlets, butter, flour, cream, white wine, button mushrooms, salt
targets: title: saltimboca ingredients: 1/2 lb. cooked ham 8 chicken cutlets 8 tbsp. butter 4 tbsp. flour 2 c. medium cream 1/2 c. white wine 2 small cans button mushrooms, drained salt and pepper directions: sprinkle salt and pepper on chicken breasts. saute in 4 tablespoons butter. cook for 15 minutes. remove from skillet and place in greased casserole. melt remaining 4 tablespoons butter in same skillet blend in flour and slowly stir in wine and cream. cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until smooth and thickened. add diced ham and mushrooms over chicken. pour sauce over and bake, covered, at 350 for 30 minutes or until bubbly. serve with rice.

inputs: white raisins, oats, pineapple, flour, salt, soda, cloves, cinnamon, shortening, egg, vanilla, nuts
targets: title: sugarless drop cookies ingredients: 1/2 c. white raisins 1 3/4 c. quick oats 8 1/2 oz. can dietetic crushed pineapple 1 1/2 c. flour 1 tsp. salt 1/2 tsp. soda 1/2 tsp. cloves 1 tsp. cinnamon 1 scant c. shortening 1 beaten egg 2 tbsp. artificial sweetener 1 tsp. vanilla 1 c. chopped nuts directions: soften white raisins in hot water and drain. spread oats on cookie sheet and brown 5 to 8 minutes in oven at 375 . drain can of dietetic crushed pineapple. sift together flour, salt, soda, cloves and cinnamon. blend shortening with flour mixture . add beaten egg, sweetener and vanilla. add pineapple, raisins, chopped nuts and oat mixture. drop by spoonfuls on ungreased cookie sheet and bake 10 to 15 minutes at 375 .

inputs: margarine, sugar, eggs, sour cream, flour, baking powder, baking soda, vanilla extract, nuts
targets: title: florence s pound cake ingredients: 1/2 lb. margarine 2 c. sugar 4 eggs one at a time 1 pt. sour cream 3 c. flour 2 tsp. baking powder 1 tsp. baking soda 1 tsp. vanilla extract chopped nuts or chocolate chips chopped in food processor directions: cream margarine and sugar in mixer. add eggs unbeaten , sour cream, flour, baking powder and baking soda. mix well. add vanilla and nuts. grease and flour large tube pan. bake at 350 for 45 to 60 minutes or until toothpick inserted comes out clean.

inputs: fresh spinach, oil, vinegar, sugar, onion, catsup, salt, worcestershire sauce, eggs, tomato, bacon
targets: title: spinach and tomato salad ingredients: 1 lb. fresh spinach 1 c. oil 1/4 c. vinegar 1/2 c. sugar 1 small onion, finely chopped 1/3 c. catsup 1 tsp. salt 1 tbsp. worcestershire sauce 2 hard boiled eggs, sliced 1 tomato, chopped 4 slices crisp fried bacon, crumbled directions: wash spinach drain. combine oil and vinegar in mixer bowl beat for 3 to 5 minutes or until well blended. add sugar, onion, catsup, salt and worcestershire sauce. beat well. combine spinach, eggs, tomato and bacon in large bowl. add desired amount of dressing toss to mix. dressing will keep well in refrigerator. yield 6 servings.

inputs: chocolate, water, sugar, margarine, vanilla
targets: title: chocolate sauce ingredients: 1 sq. unsweetened baking chocolate 1/2 c. water 2/3 c. sugar 1/4 c. margarine or butter 1 tsp. vanilla directions: place chocolate in saucepan with the water over low heat. cook and stir until chocolate is melted. add the sugar, stirring until sugar is dissolved. bring to a boil and remove from heat. add margarine and vanilla and stir until blended.

inputs: lemon jello, lime jello, boiling water, frozen lemonade, frozen limeade, pineapple
targets: title: daiquiri jello mold ingredients: 1 3 oz. pkg. lemon jello 1 3 oz. pkg. lime jello 2 scant c. boiling water 1 small can frozen lemonade 1 small can frozen limeade 1 9 oz. container cool whip 1 14 oz. can crushed pineapple, well drained directions: dissolve jellos in boiling water and add thawed lemonade and limeade. chill until partially set. whip until foamy. add cool whip and mix well. stir in pineapple and pour into an 8 cup mold. refrigerate.

inputs: unsweetened chocolate, shortening, sugar, eggs, flour, baking powder, salt, nuts, vanilla
targets: title: brownies ingredients: 2 sq. unsweetened chocolate 1/3 c. shortening 1 c. sugar 2 eggs 3/4 c. flour 1/2 tsp. baking powder 1/2 tsp. salt 1/2 c. chopped nuts 1 tsp. vanilla directions: in saucepan, melt unsweetened chocolate with shortening. pour chocolate into mixing bowl. beat in sugar, eggs and vanilla. stir in flour, baking powder, salt and nuts. spread in greased 8 inch square pan. bake at 350 for 30 to 35 minutes. cool slightly. cut into squares.

inputs: milk, corn syrup, butter, sugar, flour, vanilla, pecans, chocolate almond bark
targets: title: no fail turtles ingredients: 1 c. eagle brand milk 1 c. corn syrup 1/4 lb. butter 1 c. sugar 1/4 c. flour 1 tsp. vanilla pecans chocolate almond bark directions: melt butter in heavy saucepan. add sugar and syrup. boil for 5 minutes, stirring constantly. add milk save 1/2 can of milk. mix with flour and then add to the mixture. stir constantly this will burn very easy. boil to 240 on medium heat. pour over pecans. this will fill a cookie sheet. you may break and eat or top with melted chocolate flavor almond bark for a traditional turtle candy.

inputs: lemon, boiling water, sugar, pineapple, dream whip, pecans, cheddar cheese
targets: title: orange jello salad ingredients: 1 pkg. lemon or orange jello 1 1/4 c. boiling water 1/4 c. sugar 1 small can crushed pineapple 1 pkg. dream whip, mixed according to pkg. directions 1/2 c. chopped pecans 1 c. grated cheddar cheese directions: mix and chill until partially congealed the jello, boiling water, sugar and pineapple fold in dream whip, chopped pecans and cheddar cheese. chill until firm.

inputs: baking potatoes, onions, garlic, butter, salt, heavy aluminum, sour cream, bacon bits
targets: title: bbq potato with onion garlic ingredients: 4 baking potatoes, scrubbed 3 medium onions, peeled,sliced fairly thin,you need 24 slices 2 teaspoons garlic powder 3 tablespoons butter salt and pepper 4 pieces heavy aluminum foil or double foil 4 ounces sour cream optional 4 tablespoons bacon bits optional directions: make 6 cuts across the potato but do not cut through. place a slice of onion in each slit. dot with butter. sprinkle on the garlic, salt pepper. wrap tightly in the foil, seal all the joins. bbq over medium heat for apprx 1 hour, turning occasionally, the time depends on the size of the potato. if you choose top with the sour cream and bacon bits.

inputs: chocolate cake, pecans, coconut, margarine, cream cheese, confectioners sugar
targets: title: hawaiian cake ingredients: 1 german chocolate cake mix 1 c. chopped pecans 1 pkg. frozen shredded coconut, thawed 1 stick margarine, melted 1 8 oz. pkg. cream cheese, softened 1 box confectioners sugar directions: spray sheet cake pan with pam. place pecans and coconut in pan. mix cake as directed on box. pour over nuts and coconut. mix margarine, cream cheese and confectioners sugar. spoon over batter and cut, swirl into spread. bake at 350 for 45 to 60 minutes.

inputs: collard greens, cured smoked neckbone, water, salt
targets: title: southern style collards ingredients: 1 bunch collard greens about 3 lb. 1 lb. cured smoked neckbone or ham hock 1 1/2 qt. water 1/4 tsp. seasoned salt directions: check leaves of collards carefully. remove pulpy stems and discolored spots on leaves. wash leaves thoroughly. drain and chop. put greens in pot. boil until water turns dark green. then pour off and put clean water. then combine with smoked neckbone or ham hock. bring to boil. reduce heat and simmer, partially covered, 45 minutes or until meat is tender.

inputs: butter, sugar, eggs, flour, salt, baking powder, fresh blueberries
targets: title: blueberry pound cake ingredients: 1 c. butter 2 c. sugar 4 eggs 1 tsp. 2 c. flour 1/2 tsp. salt 1 tsp. baking powder 1 pt. fresh blueberries, rinsed and drained directions: cream the butter and sugar. add the eggs, one at a time. add the . dredge the blueberries 1 cup of the flour. sift 1 cup flour, salt and baking powder. add to the creamed mixture. gently fold the dredged blueberries in the batter. grease and flour a 10 inch bundt pan. bake approximately 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350 . cool in pan about 10 minutes, then remove.

inputs: celery, macaroni, green onion, eggs, frzn peas, parsley, mayonnaise, vinegar, celery, salt, pepper, mustard
