targets: title: salsa de pinon pine nut sauce ingredients: 3/4 cup pine nuts, toasted and cooled 3 hardcooked egg yolks 2 tablespoons caper juice 2 tablespoons capers 1 cup half and half sea salt, to taste freshly ground black pepper, to taste directions: in a blender, combine the pine nuts, egg yolks, caper juice, capers, and half and half. blend until smooth. season with salt and pepper.

inputs: chicken breasts, olive oil, basil, garlic, tomatoes, onion, basil, garlic, salt, ground black pepper, olive oil, parmesan cheese
targets: title: bruschetta chicken ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts 2 tablespoons olive oil 1 tablespoon dried basil 1 2 tablespoon fresh minced garlic 2 cups chopped ripe tomatoes, any variety 1/4 cup finely chopped mild onion 5 8 basil leaves, chopped 1 tablespoon minced garlic 1/4 teaspoon salt 1/4 teaspoon ground black pepper 2 3 tablespoons olive oil 4 tablespoons grated parmesan cheese directions: bruschetta. stir together chopped tomatoes, onion, basil, chopped garlic, salt pepper, and 2 3 tablespoons of extra virgion olive oil. set aside until chicken is done. chicken. add olive oil to pan and preheat until oil is shimmering. add chicken to pan, sprinkle with salt pepper and dried basil. cook until browned. about 6 minute shorter if yousing thin sliced breast. turn chicken over to brown other side. cook 2 3 minute add garlic to pan and cook over medium heat for several min more until chicken is cooked through. place chicken on serving platter and top with bruschetta mixture. add a sprinkle of freshly grated paremesan.

inputs: pineapple, flour, sugar, cheddar cheese, butter, buttery flavored crackers
targets: title: hot pineapple casserole ingredients: 1 15 1/2 oz. can pineapple chunks 3 tbsp. flour 1/2 c. sugar 1 c. shredded cheddar cheese 1/4 c. melted butter or margarine 1 c. crushed buttery flavored crackers ritz or other brand directions: preheat oven to 350 . drain the pineapple, saving 3 tablespoons of the juice. combine flour, sugar and juice. add the cheese and pineapple stir well. pour into a 1 quart casserole dish. combine the butter and crushed crackers and spread on top of the pineapple mixture. bake at 350 for 20 to 30 minutes. serves 6 to 8.

inputs: water, sugar, vanilla, liquor
targets: title: pastry chefs simple syrup ingredients: 2 lbs water 2 lbs sugar 1 teaspoon vanilla 3 tablespoons liquor directions: boil water and sugar 1 minute. cool. add vanilla and liquer. apply with pastry brush laying on not brushing.

inputs: sweet potatoes, olive oil, fresh rosemary, paprika, shrimp, salt, pepper, lemon juice, couscous
targets: title: shrimp sweet potato skewers ingredients: 3/4 pound sweet potatoes about 2 small , cut into 1 inch pieces 3 tablespoons olive oil, divided 1 teaspoon minced fresh rosemary 3/4 teaspoon paprika, divided 12 uncooked shrimp 26 30 per pound , peeled and deveined 1/4 teaspoon salt 1/8 teaspoon pepper 4 1/2 teaspoons lemon juice hot cooked couscous directions: preheat oven to 450 . place sweet potatoes in a greased 15x10x1 in. baking pan. mix 1 tablespoons oil, rosemary and 1/2 teaspoon paprika drizzle over potatoes. toss to coat. roast 25 35 minutes or just until just tender, stirring occasionally. on six metal or soaked wooden skewers, alternately thread shrimp and sweet potatoes sprinkle with salt and pepper. grill, covered, over medium heat 5 7 minutes or until shrimp turn pink, turning once. meanwhile, in a small bowl, whisk lemon juice and the remaining oil and paprika until blended. serve skewers with couscous and drizzle with lemon mixture.

inputs: margarine, clove garlic, soy sauce, worcestershire sauce, chicken breast
targets: title: dad s chicken n rice ingredients: 1 stick margarine 1 clove garlic 5 tbsp. soy sauce 6 to 8 oz. worcestershire sauce 1 lb. chicken breast, diced directions: in frying pan, melt margarine. add garlic and diced chicken. cook chicken until it turns white. add soy sauce and worcestershire sauce. simmer 20 minutes. serve over cooked rice. chinese noodles are great on top. serves 6.

inputs: ground beef, tomato sauce, tomato paste, red beans, chilli powder, ground cumin, cheddar cheese, beef, hot dog buns
targets: title: home made red bean chilli cheese hot dogs ingredients: 1 lb ground beef 1 can tomato sauce 15 oz 2 tbsp tomato paste 1 can small red beans 15.5 oz 1 tbsp goya adobo seasoning 1 tbsp chilli powder 1 tsp ground cumin 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese 1 packages beef hot dogs 1 packages hot dog buns directions: season ground beef with adobo seasoning then cook til brown. then drain. add chilli powder and cumin and let cook for an additional 2 minutes. add drained beans, tomato sauce, tomato paste. bring to a boil and then let simmer for 30 minutes on low heat, stirring occasionally. cook your hot dogs however you like either before chilli is done or after, your choice. i do it on the grill add the finished hot dog to the bun and top with some chilli and melted cheddar cheese.

inputs: cheddar cheese, meal, cream cheese
targets: title: cheese roll ingredients: 1 lb. cheddar cheese, grated 1 c. pecan meal 1 8 oz. pkg. cream cheese directions: mix ingredients well. flavor with either garlic, onion or wine. shape into roll roll in red pepper, paprika or ground pecans.

inputs: egg, vegetable oil, milk, bread flour, salt, baking powder, yellow onions, onions, oil, white rice, tapioca starch, xanthan gum, gelatin unflavoured, egg replacer, sugar
targets: title: gluten free onion rings ingredients: 1 egg 1/4 cup vegetable oil 1 cup milk 1 cup bread flour mix bette hagman s pizza/french, see note i m sure any other gluten free all purpose blend would work 1/2 teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon baking powder 2 yellow onions large, sliced separated into rings 1/2 cup gluten free all purpose flour for coating onions oil for frying, we use canola 3 1/2 cups white rice flour 2 1/2 cups tapioca starch 2 tablespoons xanthan gum 14 grams gelatin unflavoured 2 tablespoons egg replacer 1/4 cup sugar directions: mix egg, oil, and milk on low speed of mixer for 1 minute. add bette s mix or equivalent dry ingredients and mix until smooth. put 1/2 cup all purpose gf flour in a shallow dish. coat onion rings in flour. dip floured onions in prepared batter. fry in hot oil 375 degrees, at least 1 inch deep until desired shade of brown.

inputs: kamaboko, cucumber, salt, mayonnaise, honey
targets: title: kamaboko and cucumber tossed in umeboshi mayonnaise sauce ingredients: 1/2 block kamaboko 1 cucumber 1 to 2 leaves green shiso leaves 2 umeboshi salt cured plums , plump, low salt 1 tbsp mayonnaise 1 tsp honey directions: to make the dressing, combine umeboshi, mayonnaise, and honey, mashing the umeboshi as you mix. thinly slice the green shiso leaves, cut the kamaboko in half lengthwise, then into thin strips. diagonally chop the cucumber into 7 to 8 mm slices. toss the kamaboko and cucumbers in the sauce from step 1, transfer to a serving dish, garnish with shiso leaves, then serve.

inputs: eggplants, peas, oil, garlic, onions, tomatoes, green chilies, kosher salt, cilantro
targets: title: eggplant bharca ingredients: 2 medium eggplants 12 cup peas frozen is fine 14 cup oil 1 teaspoon garlic 1 14 cups onions finely chopped 1 12 cups chopped tomatoes fresh or drained canned 2 green chilies 2 teaspoons kosher salt 3 tablespoons cilantro directions: roast the whole eggplants until completely soft on a wood or charcoal fire. the skin will be charred black. that s ok. let them cool then slice them in half and scrape out the eggplant into a bowl. saute the onions until soft. add in garlic and chilies then in a minute or 2 add the eggplant. add the salt, tomatoes, and peas. cook until peas are tender. add cilantro and serve hot over rice.

inputs: potatoes, butternut squash, yellow onion, whole cloves, milk, heavy cream, butter, flour, ground nutmeg, parmesan, cayenne pepper, sage
targets: title: butternut squash and sage gratin ingredients: 4 none potatoes, peeled, cut into 1/4 inch slices 1 1/3 lbs butternut squash, peeled, cut into 1/4 inch slices 1 none small yellow onion, peeled 8 none whole cloves 2/3 cup milk 1 1/4 cups heavy cream 1/4 cup butter, chopped, plus 2 tbsp 1/4 cup plain flour 1/2 tsp ground nutmeg 3 oz parmesan, grated none none cayenne pepper, to taste 8 10 none sage leaves directions: preheat oven to 400 f. grease a shallow 2 quart baking dish and place on a baking sheet. put potato in large microwave safe dish, cover and microwave on high for 5 mins or until tender. let stand for 2 mins. drain. repeat with butternut squash, microwaving for 3 4 mins. let stand for 2 mins. drain. meanwhile, stud onion with cloves and place milk, cream and onion in medium heavy based saucepan over moderate heat. bring to a simmer. remove from heat. let stand for 5 mins for flavors to infuse. using tongs, remove and discard onion. pour milk into a clean bowl and wipe pan clean. melt 1/4 cup chopped butter in same pan over moderate heat. add flour and cook, stirring, for 1 2 mins or until bubbling. add nutmeg and cook, stirring, for 30 seconds. gradually whisk in warm cream mixture until smooth. cook, whisking constantly, for 4 mins or until sauce boils and thickens. remove from heat stir in half the parmesan until melted and smooth. season to taste. arrange half the potato in the prepared baking dish. top with half the squash and pour over half the cream mixture. repeat layers. sprinkle with remaining parmesan and cayenne pepper to taste. bake for 30 35 mins or until bubbling and golden. leave gratin to stand for 5 mins. melt 2 tbsp butter in small frying pan over moderate heat. add sage cook, turning, for 1 2 mins or until crisp. drain on paper towels. serve gratin topped with sage.

inputs: mussels, egg, flour, onion, red chili s, basil, garlic, pepper, olive oil
targets: title: fusion pasta with nz green lipped mussels and thai spices ingredients: 8 10 green lipped mussels 1 egg 100g of flour 1 diced onion 4 red chili s optional amount 4 thai basil leave stems 4 cloves of garlic a pinch of pepper and salt 3 tablespoons of olive oil directions: firstly, make fresh pasta from scratch 1. add 100 grams of flour into a bowl 2. crack an egg and mix well with a fork until there is no liquid left unmixed 3. take the dough and lay it on the table with a sprinkle of flour 4. knead it for 5 10 minutes until fully softened and don t forget to keep on adding pinches of flour so that it doesn t become too sticky 5. in a shape of a ball, wrap it up in a saran wrap for 20 30 minutes 6. while that is taking place, dice an onion and add it into a plate 7. half 4 red chili s to give a spicy flavor and add it to another side of the plate 8. mince 3 4 cloves of garlic in small pieces and add it to the plate 9. tear/chop 4 thai basil leave stems and add it to the plate so that everything there will be with you when you start cooking 10. make sure you have 8 10 nz green lipped mussels all boiled up and ready to go, about 2 minutes hint when you see that the mussels have risen and that the shells are slowly opening 11. 20 minutes should have passed by now, open the saran wrap, and to make sure it is ready, feel and see if it has softened 12. flatten the pasta into a rectangle shape and put it into the pasta rolling machine 13. keep the flour next to you in case dough become sticky 14. set the roller control to 2, 3,4,5 and then 6 to make sure it is long and is thin 15. cut the pasta sheet in half and then do the whole process again 16. use the fettuccine cutter 17. make sure the plate it is going to has flour so that it doesn t stick together 18. take the pasta and boil it until risen and cooked which will take about 5 minutes 19. drain the pasta in cold water for a minute or so 20. add the pasta in a pan and slowly add the diced onions, chili, garlic and thai basil leaves for about 5 10 minutes 21. after adding the mussels stir for 5 minutes 22. enjoy your dish

inputs: onion, chicken, cream of chicken soup, pet milk, green chilies, cheddar cheese, corn chips, oleo
targets: title: mexican chicken casserole ingredients: 1 large onion 3 lb. cooked chicken 2 cans cream of chicken soup 1 large can pet milk 2 4 oz. cans chopped green chilies 1 lb. grated cheddar cheese 1 pkg. corn chips 1 stick oleo or butter directions: cook, bone and cut chicken into small pieces. chop onion and cook with green chilies in 1/2 stick oleo until onion is clear. add soup and milk and cook until bubbly. butter all sides of a 9 x 13 inch pan and layer the bottom with corn chips. add the chicken pieces. layer with half of grated cheese and pour soup mixture over all. spread another layer of corn chips and remainder of grated cheese. bake at 350 for 1 hour. serves better if allowed to set 15 minutes before serving. can be prepared ahead and frozen.

inputs: coating, walnuts, strawberries, marshmallows, pretzels
targets: title: strawberry parfait holiday bark ingredients: 10 ounces white candy coating 2/3 cup chopped walnuts, toasted 2/3 cup freeze dried strawberries, chopped 1/2 cup miniature marshmallows 1/2 cup coarsely chopped pretzels directions: line a 15x10x1 in. pan with parchment paper. in a microwave, melt candy coating stir until smooth. stir in walnuts, strawberries, marshmallows and pretzels spread into prepared pan. cool. refrigerate 1 hour or until set. break into pieces. store in an airtight container.

inputs: butter, unsweetened chocolate, unsweetened cocoa, sugar, heavy cream
targets: title: fudge sauce supreme ingredients: 3 tbsp. butter 1 oz. unsweetened chocolate 1/4 c. unsweetened cocoa 3/4 c. sugar 1/2 c. heavy cream directions: melt butter and chocolate blend in cocoa and sugar. stir in cream. bring to a rolling boil for 10 seconds. makes 12 ounces.

inputs: egg, milk, shortening, flour, salt, baking powder, sugar
targets: title: fluffy hot cakes ingredients: 1 egg 3/4 c. and 2 tbsp. milk 2 tbsp. melted shortening 1 c. flour, sifted 1/2 tsp. salt 2 tbsp. baking powder 2 tbsp. sugar directions: beat all ingredients until smooth. bake on griddle until fluffy and brown. turn only once.

inputs: flour, shortening, buttermilk
targets: title: mama lassie s butter rolls ingredients: 3 c flour 1 tbsp shortening 1/2 c buttermilk directions: put flour in a large mixing bowl. make a hole in the middle of flour. add shortening and buttermilk. gradually mix with flour until dough is stiff. roll out thin. cut circles out of dough with a small saucer. cut up 1/2 stick butter or margarine and put on each circle. roll each circle up and place in an iron skillet. bake at 350 until golden brown.

inputs: flour, sugar, baking soda, cinnamon, cloves, nutmeg, cocoa, cornstarch, raisins, oil, applesauce, walnuts
targets: title: applesauce cake ingredients: 2 c. presifted flour 1 c. sugar 2 tsp. baking soda 1 tsp. cinnamon 1/2 tsp. cloves 1/2 tsp. nutmeg 3 tsp. hershey s cocoa 1 tsp. cornstarch 1 c. raisins 1/2 c. oil 2 c. applesauce 1/2 c. walnuts directions: mix thoroughly. add 1/2 cup chopped walnuts if desired . bake at 350 for 40 minutes or until done. cool and frost with chocolate frosting.

inputs: stalks broccoli, red onion, bacon, sunflower seeds, golden raisin, mayonnaise, sugar, vinegar
targets: title: broccoli bacon salad ingredients: 3 stalks broccoli, cut into bite size florets 1 small red onion, cut into thin ringlets about a 1/2 cup or so 12 slices crispy bacon, crumbled 1 cup sunflower seeds, toasted 12 cup golden raisin 1 cup mayonnaise 12 cup sugar 2 tablespoons vinegar directions: chop broccoli into small bite size pieces i use all but large end stems of broccoli heads . place into a large bowl with red onion, crispy crumbled bacon, sunflower seeds and golden raisins. in a medium sized tupperware add the mayonnaise, sugar and vinegar. cover tupperware tight with lid and shake well 1 2 minutes till well combined and sugar has dissolved. when ready to serve add dressing and toss till combined. i like to add dressing an hour or so before serving to let marinate, toss again right before serving .

inputs: olive oil, weight butter, onion, celery, potato, continental parsley, bread, weight, cream, salt
targets: title: delicious pea soup ingredients: 1 dash extra virgin olive oil 1 7/8 ounces, weight butter 1 whole onion, finely chopped 1 stick celery finely chopped 1 whole potato 1/2 cups chopped continental parsley 1 loaf baguette french bread 1 ounces, weight goats feta cheese 1/2 pounds, 2 5/8 ounces, weight frozen peas 6 tablespoons, 2 teaspoons, 4 5/8 pinches thickened cream or low fat yoghurt 1 pinch salt and pepper, to taste directions: preheat oven to the lowest setting and place your soup bowls in the oven. on 1st burner place medium saucepan on medium heat and bring stock to a gentle simmer. on 2nd burner place a large saucepan on low heat, add a splash of extra virgin olive oil and butter. whilst the butter is melting, chop the onion and the celery stick. add the chopped onion and celery to pan and add a splash of water. cover with lid and cook for 5 7 minutes or until vegetables start to soften. on 3rd burner heat a griddle pan on medium heat. peel and grate the potato and add to the vegetable stock, add half the chopped continental parsley to stock. cut the two ends of the baguette off and tear the bread from the inside of these crusts into small crouton sized chunks. in a small bowl add the bread chunks and splash some extra virgin olive oil and toss lightly. add the bread chunks to the griddle pan and toast and toss until the crispy and golden, then add the crisp croutons back to your mixing bowl crumble in the goat feta and drizzle with extra virgin olive oil and chopped parsley. add the peas to the pan of vegetables, cook for 1 2 minutes and then add stock and bring everything to a boil. stir in thickened cream or yoghurt and cook for 3 5 minutes. once the soup is a nice soft consistency, blend the soup using a hand held blender directly in the large saucepan or pour into a mixer and blend until smooth. season to taste and cover pan to keep warm. serve in warm bowls and sprinkle a handful of toasted crouton mix over your soup.

inputs: cottage cheese, sugar, cinnamon, pecans
targets: title: easy pudding south beach phase i /weight watchers ingredients: 34 cup cottage cheese 1 tablespoon fat free sugar free instant vanilla pudding mix 12 teaspoon cinnamon 2 tablespoons toasted chopped pecans directions: mix cottage cheese and pudding mix together. sprinkle with cinnamon and tasted almonds. if you want to get fancy, add a squirt of fat free, sugar free whipped cream to the top, and sprinkle the nuts and cinnamon over that.

inputs: green cabbage, red onion, cucumber, celery, sugar, rice vinegar, salt
targets: title: refrigerator pickled slaw ingredients: 1 head green cabbage or a mix of the two or 1 head red cabbage, very thinly sliced or a mix of the two 1/2 red onion, very finely sliced 1/2 english cucumber, halved lengthwise and thinly sliced crosswise 1 tablespoon celery seed 2 tablespoons sugar 1/2 cup rice vinegar salt and pepper directions: mix all ingredients very well. cover and refrigerate for at least 3 hours, stirring occasionally. best if allowed to marinate overnight before serving.

inputs: cream cheese, pack, hormel ham, pecans
targets: title: cheese ball ingredients: 8 oz. cream cheese, softened 1 pack ranch dressing dry 2 medium cans hormel ham pecans, chopped directions: mix softened cream cheese, ranch dressing and 2 cans ham together in bowl. form ball. place chopped pecans on wax paper. roll cream cheese mixture back and forth in pecans until ball is completely covered with pecans. chill and serve with your choice of crackers.

inputs: flour, sugar, butter, egg yolks, milk, eggs, egg yolks, sugar, milk, cream
targets: title: apricot custard tart recipe ingredients: 250 gm organic flour, 8oz 150 gm organic sugar, 5z 125 gm organic butter, cool, diced 4oz 3 med size organic egg yolks 2 tbsp. organic lowfat milk 2 med size organic large eggs 3 med size organic egg yolks 50 gm organic sugar, 2oz 300 ml organic lowfat milk, 1/2 pint 300 ml organic double cream, 1/2 pint 100 gm organic dry apricots, roughly minced 3 1/2oz directions: preheat the oven to 200 c, 400 f, gas mark 6. place the flour, sugar and butter into a mixing bowl and mix till the ingredients resemble breadcrumbs then add in the egg yolks and lowfat milk and mix to a soft paste. roll out the pastry to line a 23cm 9inch loose based flan ring. refrigeratethe pastry case till hard 10 min in the freezer or possibly 1 hour in the refrigerator, whilst making the filling. place the large eggs into a mixng bowl with the sugar and mix well, add in the lowfat milk and cream. pass the mix through a sieve and then add in the apricots. bake the pastry case blind place a disc of greaseproof paper into the base of the case and fill with baking beans. bake the case for 8 10 min, remove the beans and bake for a further 2 min, till the pastry is golden brown. pour the custard mix into the flan case, reduce the oven temperature to 180 c, 350 f, gas mark 4 and bake till the custard is set, this will take approximately 25 min. remove the tart from the oven and stand for 30 min before serving. notes a luscious custard tart made from organic ingredients.

inputs: pork chops, peppers, mozzarella cheese, oil, salt, black pepper, garlic
targets: title: boneless pork chops ingredients: boneless pork chops sliced hot cherry peppers mozzarella cheese, shredded 1 tbsp. oil salt black pepper garlic powder directions: drizzle oil on baking sheet. place boneless pork chops on sheet and season with salt, pepper and garlic powder. add sliced hot peppers and some hot pepper juice the hotter you like it the more peppers you use on top of the pork chops. bake at 350 for approximately 30 minutes until pork is white inside . just before you take it out of the oven, cover each piece with shredded cheese. remove from the oven when cheese has melted.

inputs: semi sweet chocolate chips, shortening, marshmallows, pecan halves
targets: title: chocolate marshmallow treats recipe ingredients: 2 c. 12 ounce. pkg. semi sweet chocolate chips 2 tbsp. shortening 12 lg. marshmallows 1 1/2 c. pecan halves directions: heat chocolate and shortening in top of double boiler over warm not boiling water, stirring till smooth. remove from heat. set aside. cold mix to 85 degrees. cut marshmallows in half horizontally. place on wax paper. set aside. to make base for treats make 24 clusters by arranging pecans on wax paper covered tray in groups of 5, placing flat side of pecan halves down and ends touching in center. into center of each cluster of pecans spoon 1/2 tsp. melted chocolate mix. use fork to dip marshmallow halves in melted mix place 1/2 over each set of clusters, pressing down slightly. top with pecan half. cold. store covered in refrigerator. 2 dozen snacks.

inputs: cauliflower, milk, flour, butter, salt, garlic, cheddar cheese
targets: title: cauliflower n cheese ingredients: 1 head cauliflower, trimmed 4 cups milk 2 tablespoons all purpose flour 1 tablespoon butter, or to taste salt and ground black pepper to taste 1 pinch garlic powder, or to taste optional 2 cups shredded cheddar cheese, divided directions: bring a pot of water to a boil cook cauliflower until slightly tender, 10 to 15 minutes. remove cauliflower from water and place in a colander to drain for 1 hour. preheat oven to 350 degrees f 175 degrees c . place cauliflower in a baking dish. mix milk, flour, butter, salt, pepper, and garlic powder together in a saucepan bring to a boil. gradually sprinkle 1 1/2 cups cheddar cheese into milk mixture, stirring constantly, until mixture turns into a thick sauce, about 5 minutes. pour sauce over cauliflower and top with remaining cheddar cheese. bake in the preheated oven until cauliflower is tender, about 1 hour. let stand for 10 minutes.

inputs: walnut halves, chocolate, sugar, boiling water, eggs, butter, coffee powder, vanilla, flour, whipping cream, powdered sugar, vanilla
targets: title: frozen chocolate fudge pie ingredients: 1 cup walnut halves, toasted 8 ounces chocolate, broken into pieces 34 cup sugar 14 cup boiling water 4 eggs 34 cup butter, room temperature 1 tablespoon instant coffee powder 1 tablespoon vanilla 14 cup flour 1 cup whipping cream, well chilled 14 cup powdered sugar 1 teaspoon vanilla directions: preheat oven to 350. lightly oil 5 cup glass pie plate. in a food processor, coarsely chop walnuts. coarsely chop 3 oz chocolate. add to walnuts. chop remaining chocolate with sugar then mix until cocolate is as fine as sugar. with machine running, pour 1/4 cup boiling water and blend until chocolate is melted. add eggs and blend 30 45 seconds, stopping once to scrape down sides. add butter, coffee and vanilla and mix for 1 minute. add flour to the chopped walnut chocolate mixture and blend until just combined, about 5 seconds. spoon mixture into prepared pan. bake until edges are set and centre is slightly soft, about 30 35 minutes. cool completely. freeze pie at least 4 hours. remove from freezer 15 minutes before serving. cut into wedges and garnish each serving with the whipped cream topping.

inputs: hash brown potatoes, salt, pepper, sour cream, cheddar cheese, cream of chicken soup, cream of potato soup, onion, parmesan cheese
targets: title: sunday potatoes ingredients: 2 lb. hash brown potatoes, thawed 1 tsp. salt dash of pepper 8 oz. sour cream 4 oz. shredded cheddar cheese 1 can cream of chicken soup 1 can cream of potato soup 1 medium onion, diced 1 c. parmesan cheese sprinkle on top directions: bake at 350 for approximately 50 minutes. i haven t found anyone who didn t love this dish. freezes well also.

inputs: bacon, zucchini, olive oil, salt, pepper, garlic
targets: title: pasta salad a la cochon ingredients: 2 cups cooked pasta i used bowtie because it s pretty 4 strips thick cut bacon 1 cup zucchini from your neighbors garden 1 tablespoon extra virgin olive oil 1 teaspoon salt 1/2 teaspoons pepper 1 teaspoon garlic directions: cook the pasta, set it aside in a bowl...just waiting for the good stuff. cut the bacon into chunks and fry em up good. chop the zucchini and saute it in gasp dare i say it the bacon grease. throw this all in the bowl with the pasta, add the oil, salt, pepper and garlic and mix it up i couldn t wait....i ate it warm. i m sure it would taste just as loverly cold, but hoo wee it was fabulous when it was warm you might need to add a little more oil, it depends on how much of the bacon grease you drained. i m just guessing at the amount. as i said, i made it up and i don t measure when i do that. should i who knows.

inputs: margarine, sugar, eggs, flour, lemon juice, vanilla, pecans, shell
targets: title: buttermilk pie ingredients: 1/2 c. margarine 2 c. sugar 5 eggs 2 tbsp. flour 2 tbsp. lemon juice 1 tsp. vanilla 1 c. chopped pecans 1 unbaked pie shell directions: cream margarine and sugar. add eggs, one at a time, beating well. blend in flour, lemon juice and vanilla. stir in buttermilk and pecans. bake at 325 for 55 minutes or until set.

inputs: pork spareribs, garlic, shallot, light brown sugar, black pepper, caramel sauce, light, fish sauce, other neutral oil, stalk lemongrass, cucumber, serrano chiles, soy sauce
targets: title: grilled lemongrass pork riblets ingredients: 3 1/2 to 4 pounds meaty pork spareribs, cut crosswise through the bone into long strips about 2 inches wide 3 cloves garlic, chopped 1 large shallot, chopped about 1/3 cup 1 tablespoon light brown sugar 1/2 teaspoon black pepper 2 tablespoons caramel sauce page 316 or honey 2 tablespoons light regular soy sauce 1 tablespoon fish sauce 2 tablespoons canola or other neutral oil 2 medium or 1 hefty stalk lemongrass, trimmed and minced about 6 tablespoons 1 small english cucumber or 2 pickling kirby cucumbers, halved lengthwise and sliced on the diagonal 1 or 2 thai or serrano chiles, thinly sliced light regular soy sauce for serving directions: starting from one end, remove the tough white membrane from the underside of each rib strip slide the tip of a knife underneath the membrane that lies between 2 rib bones, lift it up and cut it. then, use a pair of pliers or a dish towel to grab the membrane and pull it away from the ribs. several pulls may be required to remove it all. trim any small membrane patches that remain with a knife. when done, remove as much fat from the rib strips as you like. cut each strip between the bones or cartilage into individual riblets. to make the marinade, combine the garlic, shallot, brown sugar, and pepper in a mortar and pound to a rough paste. or, use an electric mini chopper. transfer to a large bowl and add the caramel sauce, soy sauce, fish sauce, oil, and lemongrass, mixing well. add the riblets to the marinade and mix well to coat all surfaces. your hand is the best tool for this. cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 24 hours. thirty minutes before cooking, remove the bowl from the refrigerator. for the best flavor, grill the riblets. prepare a medium charcoal fire you can hold your hand over the rack for only 4 to 5 seconds or preheat a gas grill to medium. alternatively, position a rack in the upper third of the oven and preheat to 475f. arrange the riblets on an aluminum foillined baking sheet for roasting. the riblets taste nearly as good oven roasted as they do grilled. arrange the riblets on the grill rack, or slip the baking sheet into the oven. cook for 12 to 15 minutes, or until browned and a little charred on the edges. extra thick pieces will require a little more time. monitor the ribs closely as they cook, turning them over or moving them around if you are grilling to ensure even cooking and prevent burning. transfer the riblets to a serving platter. garnish with the cucumber or serve it alongside. at the table, let diners craft their own dipping sauce by muddling some chiles in a little soy sauce. feel free to use fingers for eating.

inputs: fresh mushrooms, canola oil, pastry, mozzarella cheese, sweet onion, tomatoes, parmesan cheese, eggs, cream, ground mustard, basil, oregano, thyme
targets: title: italian tomato onion quiche ingredients: 6 medium fresh mushrooms, thinly sliced 2 teaspoons canola oil 1 sheet refrigerated pie pastry 2 cups shredded part skim mozzarella cheese 1 cup sliced sweet onion 3 medium plum tomatoes, seeded and thinly sliced 1/2 cup shredded parmesan cheese 6 large eggs 1 cup half and half cream 1 teaspoon ground mustard 1 teaspoon dried basil 1 teaspoon dried oregano 1 teaspoon dried thyme directions: in a large skillet, saute mushrooms in oil until tender set aside. roll out pastry to fit a 9 in. deep dish pie plate. transfer pastry to pie plate. trim pastry to 1/2 in. beyond edge of plate flute edges. layer half of the mozzarella cheese, onion and tomato in pastry. top with mushrooms. layer with remaining mozzarella cheese, onion and tomato. sprinkle with half of the parmesan cheese. in a small bowl, combine the eggs, cream, mustard and herbs pour over top. top with remaining parmesan cheese. bake at 350 for 50 60 minutes or until a knife inserted in the center comes out clean. cover edges with foil during the last 20 minutes to prevent overbrowning if necessary. let stand for 10 minutes before cutting.

inputs: cabbage, light mayonnaise, cider vinegar, sugar, wraps, flour, paprika, thyme, oregano, garlic, black pepper, salt, ground red pepper, butter, flour tortillas
targets: title: cajun catfish wraps with slaw ingredients: slaw 3 1/2 cups thinly sliced red or green cabbage 1/4 cup light mayonnaise 1 1/2 tablespoons cider vinegar 1/2 teaspoon sugar wraps 1 tablespoon all purpose flour 1 tablespoon paprika 1 1/2 teaspoons dried thyme 1 1/2 teaspoons dried oregano 1 teaspoon garlic powder 1 teaspoon black pepper 1/2 teaspoon salt 1/4 teaspoon ground red pepper 4 6 ounce farm raised catfish fillets 1 tablespoon butter or stick margarine 4 8 inch fat free flour tortillas directions: to prepare the slaw, combine the first 4 ingredients in a bowl cover and chill. to prepare the wraps, combine flour and next 7 ingredients flour through red pepper in a shallow dish. dredge fillets in flour mixture. melt the butter in a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat. add fillets saute 5 minutes. turn fillets over cook 4 minutes or until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork. heat the tortillas according to package directions. cut each catfish fillet lengthwise into 4 pieces. arrange 4 fillet pieces on each tortilla top each serving with about 3/4 cup slaw, and roll up.

inputs: bread, mustard, ham, mozzarella cheese, cheddar cheese, olives
targets: title: easter fun ham cheese sandwich ingredients: 8 slices bread 4 8 teaspoons prepared mustard 8 slices cooked ham 8 slices mozzarella cheese 12 cup finely shredded cheddar cheese 4 pitted ripe olives directions: place bread on an ungreased baking sheet. spread each slice with mustard top with ham. cut mozzarella cheese into egg shapes. using a sharp knife, cut zigzags in the middle of each egg shape. place the eggs on the ham leaving about 1 inch of space between the two pieces. in between the egg sprinkle cheddar cheese to make the chick . broil 4 inches from the heat for 2 3 minutes or until cheese is melted. cut the olives so you have eight small pieces for beaks, and 16 small pieces for eyes place them on the chicks. serve.

inputs: vegetable oil, chicken, hot chili powder, ginger garlic, flour, red onion, peppers, soy sauce, chili sauce, salt, cilantro
targets: title: indian chili chicken ingredients: vegetable oil 1 3/4 lbs chicken breast fillets 2 1/2 tablespoons hot chili powder laxmi extra hot 7 tablespoons ginger garlic paste 1/2 cup flour 1 red onion, sliced 6 jalapeno peppers, sliced or 10 serrano peppers 3 teaspoons soy sauce 0.5 5 1/2 ounce bottle sweet asian chicken chili sauce 2 pinches salt 1 bunch cilantro directions: add vegetable oil to a depth of 1 2 inches in a pot heat on medium high heat. cut chicken breast fillets into bite sized pieces. combine chicken, chili powder, and five tbsp of ginger garlic paste in a bowl. mix well while lightly covering mixture with the 1/2 cup of flour chicken pieces should be fully covered with flour. set aside. add about 1/4 cup of vegetable oil to the wok and heat on medium high. add sliced onion, sliced peppers, and two tbsp of ginger garlic paste to wok stir occasionally ensuring the vegetables are coated in oil. by now the oil in the pot should be heated carefully test with a single drop of water . gently submerge the chicken pieces, covering the bottom of the pot. once bubbling settles down remove the pieces onto a plate with paper towels. repeat until all the chicken is cooked. be sure not to overcook the the chicken. pat the remaining oil from the chicken with a paper towel. the vegetables in the wok should be softened. add the chicken, a few shots of soy sauce, sweet chili sauce, and salt. mix well for a minute or two. serve with rice and naan and top with cilantro. yumm

inputs: potatoes, cheddar cheese, bacon, green onion, eggs, milk, salt
targets: title: core weight watchers farmers breakfast casserole ingredients: 3 cups potatoes, shredded 3/4 cup shredded low fat cheddar cheese 3 ounces canadian bacon, chopped 1/2 cup green onion, sliced 4 whole eggs, beaten 12 ounces evaporated nonfat milk salt pepper directions: preheat oven to 350 f. spray a 8x8 inch pan with nonstick cooking spray. arrange potatoes at the bottom of the dish. sprinkle with cheese, canadian bacon and green onions. in large mixing bowl, combine eggs, milk, salt pepper pour over potato mixture in dish. bake uncovered in a 350 f oven for 40 minutes or until center appears set. let stand 5 minutes before cutting.

inputs: olive oil, pork tenderloin, salt, pomegranate juice, unsulfured molasses, currants
targets: title: seared pork tenderloin with pomegranate glaze ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive oil 1 pork tenderloin about 1 pound coarse salt and ground pepper 1 cup unsweetened pomegranate juice 1 tablespoon unsulfured molasses 1/4 cup dried currants directions: preheat oven to 350f. in a large ovenproof skillet, heat oil over medium high. pat dry pork and generously season with salt and pepper cook until browned on all sides, 6 to 8 minutes. transfer skillet to oven, and roast until an instant read thermometer inserted in thickest part of tenderloin registers 140f, 10 to 15 minutes. remove pork from oven, place it on a plate, and tent with foil. add pomegranate juice, molasses, and currants to skillet and bring to a boil over medium high heat. cook until sauce is thickened to a glaze it should coat the back of a spoon and hold a line drawn through it with your finger , 5 to 6 minutes. to serve, slice pork against the grain, and drizzle with glaze. youll find bottled pomegranate juice in most supermarkets and health food stores. check the ingredients list, and select one without added sugar, other juices, or preservatives. per serving calories 241 fat 7.3g 1.8g saturated fat protein 24.4g carbohydrates 19.3g fiber 0.6g

inputs: mushrooms, white wine, chicken stock, onion, thyme, butter, flour, butter, olive oil, salt, pepper, cream, cream cheese
targets: title: creamy multiple mushroom soup ingredients: 7 cups fresh mushrooms your choice of variety 1/2 cup dried mushrooms your choice of variety 1 cup white wine 4 cups chicken stock 1 chopped onion 3/4 teaspoon dried thyme 1/4 cup butter 1/4 cup flour 3 tablespoons butter to saute 1 tablespoon olive oil to saute 1/4 teaspoon salt 1/4 teaspoon pepper 1 1/2 cups cream 1/2 block cream cheese room temperature directions: soak the dried mushroom in the white wine for approximately 1/2 hour. reserve wine. chop fresh and dried mushrooms. to the stock pot add butter and olive oil saute onions with thyme until soft. add mushrooms and cook for about 10 minutes. add wine, salt and pepper and cook 5 minutes. add broth and cook for 20 minutes. reserve a bit of stock in a bowl, then puree the soup with an immersion blender. melt butter in a small pot. add flour and blend till smooth. add cream and bring to a boil. add mixture to pureed soup and cook for 10 minutes until thickened. to the reserved stock add the room temperature cream cheese to melt. whisk the cream cheese into the soup. cook additional 5 minutes.

inputs: broccoli, cooking spray, onion, white wine, worcestershire sauce, sage, salt, ground nutmeg, pepper, hot sauce, low salt, flour, milk, cheddar cheese, lump crabmeat, lemon juice, sherry
targets: title: crab and broccoli chowder ingredients: 1 1/2 cups small broccoli florets about 1 small head cooking spray 1 cup chopped onion 2 cups cubed peeled red potato about 3/4 pound 1/2 cup dry white wine 1 tablespoon worcestershire sauce 1/2 teaspoon dried rubbed sage 1/4 teaspoon salt 1/4 teaspoon ground nutmeg 1/4 teaspoon pepper dash of hot sauce 3 10 1/2 ounce cans low salt chicken broth 5 tablespoons all purpose flour 2 1/2 cups 2 reduced fat milk 1/2 cup 2 ounces shredded extra sharp cheddar cheese 3/4 pound lump crabmeat, drained and shell pieces removed 2 tablespoons lemon juice 1 tablespoon sherry directions: steam broccoli, covered, 2 minutes or until tender. place a dutch oven coated with cooking spray over medium heat until hot. add onion saute 4 minutes. add potato and next 8 ingredients potato through broth bring to a boil. reduce heat simmer, uncovered, 30 minutes or until tender. place 3 cups potato mixture in a blender process until smooth. add puree back to potato mixture in pan stir well. place flour in a bowl. gradually add milk stir with a whisk until blended. add to potato mixture. cook over medium heat until thick about 10 minutes , stirring constantly. stir in cheese. add broccoli, crabmeat, lemon juice, and sherry cook until thoroughly heated.

inputs: ready, butter, brown sugar, bourbon, milk, s, bananas
targets: title: bourbon caramel banana cream pie ingredients: 1 ready to use refrigerated pie crust 1/2 of 14.1 oz. pkg. 1/4 cup butter 3/4 cup packed brown sugar 3 tbsp. bourbon 1 pkg. 3.4 oz. jell o vanilla flavor instant pudding 1 cup milk 3/4 cup breakstone s or knudsen sour cream 2 bananas 1 cup thawed cool whip whipped topping directions: prepare and bake pie crust in 9 inch pie plate as directed on package for one crust baked shell. cool. meanwhile, melt butter in saucepan on medium heat. add sugar cook and stir 3 min. or until sugar is melted. remove from heat stir in bourbon. cool. beat pudding mix and milk in medium bowl with whisk 2 min. stir in sour cream. let stand 5 min. slice bananas place in crust. top with caramel sauce, pudding mixture and cool whip. refrigerate 1 hour.

inputs: raspberry gelatin, boiling water, cranberry sauce, wine, pecans, sour cream, cream cheese, pineapple
targets: title: pineapple cranberry salad ingredients: 2 3 oz. pkg. raspberry gelatin 1 1/4 c. boiling water 1 1 lb. 4 oz. can whole cranberry sauce 3/4 c. port wine 1 c. chopped pecans 1 c. dairy sour cream 1 8 oz. cream cheese 1 20 oz. can crushed pineapple in juice directions: dissolve gelatin in boiling water. stir in undrained pineapple, cranberry sauce and wine. chill until mixture thickens slightly. fold in pecans and turn into a 9 x 9 x 2 inch square pan. chill until firm. when gelatin is set, soften cheese and gradually beat in sour cream until mixture is smooth and creamy. spread over gelatin. chill. makes about 9 servings.

inputs: beef rump steak, fish sauce, lime juice, cucumbers, chilies, spring onions, cherry tomatoes, fresh vietnamese mint, fresh cilantro, palm sugar, soy sauce, clove garlic
targets: title: char grilled beef salad ingredients: 1 lb beef rump steak 1/4 cup fish sauce 1/4 cup lime juice 3 none persian cucumbers, seeded, thinly sliced 4 none fresh small red thai chilies, thinly sliced 8 none spring onions, thinly sliced 9 oz cherry tomatoes, quartered 1/3 cup fresh vietnamese mint leaves 1/2 cup fresh cilantro leaves 1 tbsp grated palm sugar 1 tbsp soy sauce 1 clove garlic, minced directions: combine beef with 2 tbsp fish sauce and 1 tbsp lime juice. cover and chill for 3 hours, or overnight. drain beef. cook on a heated, oiled grill plate or grill until browned and cooked to your liking. cover beef and let rest for 5 mins. slice thinly. meanwhile, combine cucumber, chilies, onions, tomatoes and herbs in a large bowl. combine remaining fish sauce and lime juice with sugar, soy sauce and garlic and whisk to combine. pour over salad. add beef and toss to combine.

inputs: butter, sugar, brown sugar, eggs, egg yolk, vanilla, orange extract, malibu rum, sour cream, all purpose, baking powder, baking soda, salt, heavy whipping cream, coconut, butter, milk, powdered sugar, malibu rum, flaked coconut
targets: title: malibu rum coconut cake ingredients: 1 1/2 cups butter, softened 1 cup granulated sugar 1/2 cup brown sugar 3 large eggs 1 egg yolk 2 teaspoons vanilla extract 1 teaspoon orange extract 1/2 cup malibu rum 1/4 cup sour cream 3 cups all purpose flour 2 teaspoons baking powder 1/2 teaspoon baking soda 1/8 teaspoon salt 1 cup heavy whipping cream coconut rum icing 1/3 cup butter 1/4 cup milk 4 cups powdered sugar sifted 1 teaspoon malibu rum 1/4 cup flaked coconut directions: cream butter and sugars until light and fluffy. add eggs, egg yolk, and vanilla, beating until blended. add orange extract, beating until blended. gradually add rum and sour cream, beating until blended. sift together flour, baking soda, baking powder, and salt. add alternately with whipping cream, beginning and ending with flour mixture. beat batter until blended after each addition. pour batter into a greased and floured 10 inch bundt pan. bake at 350 for 55 to 60 minutes or until a long wooden pick inserted in center of cake comes out clean. cool in pan on a wire rack 15 minutes. remove from pan and allow to cool completely on wire rack. ice with coconut rum icing. coconut rum icing directions . melt together butter and milk over low heat in small sauce pan. when melted stir in rum and sugar. whip with wire whisk until thick enough to pour over cake. if necessary add more sugar or hot water to adjust thickness of icing. stir in flaked coconut. place cake on wire rack over cookie sheet line with foil or wax paper to speed cleanup and pour icing over cake. use an offset spatula to smooth icing if necessary to cover cake. sprinkle with a little flaked coconut for garnish.

inputs: frozen spinach souffle, bread crumbs, onion, lemon juice, mushrooms, parmesan cheese
targets: title: spinach stuffed mushrooms ingredients: 1 12 oz. pkg. frozen spinach souffle 1 c. soft bread crumbs, lightly toasted 1 tsp. dried minced onion 2 tsp. lemon juice 24 large fresh mushrooms 1 tbsp. parmesan cheese directions: preheat oven to 350 . bake souffle, uncovered, for 15 to 18 minutes, or until slightly warmed. combine souffle, bread crumbs, onion and lemon juice in bowl mix well. remove and discard mushroom stems. place mushroom caps in shallow baking pan. brush with butter sprinkle with cheese. bake for 15 minutes.

inputs: garlic, great northern, lemon juice, tahini, salt, cumin, olive oil
targets: title: happy hummus ingredients: 2 cloves garlic 19 ounces, weight can great northern or garbanzo beans, half the liquid reserved 4 tablespoons lemon juice 3 tablespoons tahini 1/2 teaspoons salt 1/2 teaspoons cumin 2 tablespoons olive oil directions: add garlic, beans, lemon juice, tahini, reserved bean juice, salt, and cumin in blender. process until creamy and well mixed. place in a serving bowl and drizzle with olive oil. serve with warm pita, chopped up veggies, or use as a spread on your favorite sandwich. garbanzo beans are the traditional bean of choice for hummus but we really like great northern beans in ours. use whatever you like best.

inputs: flour, powdered sugar, butter, eggs , light corn syrup, condensed milk, cream, peanuts, whipped cream
targets: title: caramel peanut tart ingredients: 3/4 cup flour 2 tbsp powdered sugar 11 tbsp butter, 9 tbsp chopped, 2 tbsp, melted 2 none eggs 1 large egg yolk 1/2 cup light corn syrup 1/2 cup sweetened condensed milk 2 tbsp cream 1 oz unsalted roasted peanuts, coarsely chopped none none whipped cream, to serve directions: for the pastry, process flour and powdered sugar in a food processor to combine. add chopped butter and process until mixture resembles crumbs. add egg yolk and 2 tsp ice water and process until just combined. knead briefly, then shape into a disc. cover with plastic wrap and chill for 30 mins. preheat oven to 375 f. grease a 12 x 4 inch loose bottomed tart pan. roll pastry between 2 sheets of parchment paper until large enough to line prepared pan. transfer to pan and trim excess. place pan on a baking sheet and chill for 20 mins. line pastry with parchment paper, fill with dry beans and bake for 10 mins. remove beans and paper and bake for 5 more mins, or until just colored. cool. for the filling, whisk eggs, melted butter, glucose, condensed milk and cream in a large bowl. stir in peanuts. spoon filling into pastry case and bake 30 mins, or until filling is golden and just set. cool in pan, slice and serve with whipped cream.

inputs: vegetable oil, white onion, cloves garlic, green mole paste, salsa verde, white hominy, chicken broth, turkey, radishes, avocado, cilantro, wedges, tortilla strips
targets: title: turkey posole a la guerita recipe ingredients: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil 1 medium white onion, peeled and medium dice 3 medium cloves garlic, coarsely chopped 3 tablespoons green mole paste, such as dona maria 1/2 cup salsa verde 1 28 ounce can white hominy, drained 4 cups 1 quart low sodium chicken broth 8 ounces shredded cooked turkey about 1 1/2 cups thinly sliced green cabbage thinly sliced radishes thinly sliced avocado cilantro leaves lime wedges fried tortilla strips directions: heat oil in a large saucepan over medium high heat until shimmering. add onion and garlic, and season with salt and freshly ground black pepper. cook until tender but not browned, about 6 minutes. stir in mole paste and cook until it melts in with the vegetables, about 1 minute. add remaining ingredients, reduce heat to medium, and bring to a simmer. cook until flavors are melded, about 20 minutes. season with salt, and adjust flavor as needed. serve soup with garnishes passed on the side.

inputs: stew meat, onion, baby carrots, potatoes, stalks celery, mushrooms, frozen peas, frozen corn, frozen green beans, beef broth, bloody mary, white wine, worcestershire sauce, original sauce, butter, olive oil, parsley flakes, salt, pepper, cornstarch, water
targets: title: toms tangy beef stew with mushrooms ingredients: 1 lb stew meat, cut into 1 inch chunks venison or beef 1 small onion, chopped 1 cup baby carrots, chopped into 3rds 2 potatoes, peeled chopped and cubed 3 stalks celery, chopped 2 cups mushrooms, chopped 1 cup frozen peas 1 cup frozen corn 1 cup frozen green beans 2 14 ounce cans beef broth 1 1/2 cups bloody mary mix 1/2 cup white wine 3 tablespoons worcestershire sauce 3 tablespoons a.1. original sauce 1 tablespoon smart balance butter spread or 1 tablespoon regular butter 1 tablespoon olive oil 1 tablespoon dried parsley flakes 1/2 teaspoon salt 1/2 teaspoon pepper cornstarch water directions: cut up all the vegetables and mushrooms ahead of time and soak and store potato s in very cold water until ready to use. in large pot over medium heat add oil and butter spread,then add onions and mushroom and cook until soft about 5 minutes then add meat and cook another 5 minutes. add wine, beef broth, a 1 sauce, worcestershire sauce, salt and pepper cook for 10 minutes. add bloody mary mix, potatoes, carrots, and celery cook another 10 minutes. add peas,corn,green beans and parsley and bring heat up to high and bring to a boil, about 5 minutes . once it starts to boil, reduce heat to simmer and simmer for about 25 minutes or until all the vegetables are soft. add cornstarch and water to thicken and serve.enjoy

inputs: hair spaghetti, hamburg, cottage cheese, pepperoni, mozzarella cheese, salt, spaghetti sauce, garlic salt
targets: title: spaghetti pie ingredients: 1 lb. box angel hair spaghetti 1 lb. hamburg 1 container cottage cheese 1 pkg. pepperoni 1 pkg. mozzarella cheese salt, pepper and onion salt optional 1 jar spaghetti sauce garlic salt optional directions: cook angel hair. brown hamburg and pepperoni. add seasonings, if desired. in baking dish, put in angel hair. add spaghetti sauce, cottage cheese, hamburg and pepperoni. top with mozzarella cheese. bake at 350 until heated through.

inputs: bananas, flour, sugar, egg, shortening, baking soda, vanilla, salt
targets: title: gramma s banana bread ingredients: 3 medium bananas 1 1/2 cups flour sifted 1 cup sugar 1 egg 1/3 cup melted shortening 1 tsp. baking soda 1 tsp. vanilla salt directions: preheat oven to 350 degrees. mash bananas and add wet ingredients. mix dry ingredients in a seperate bowl. coming dry and wet ingredients. grease loaf pan with crisco and add ingredients. cook for 45min, or until done.

inputs: water, rice, sugar, eggs, milk, cinnamon, nutmeg
targets: title: rice pudding ingredients: 3 qt. water 2 c. rice 1 c. sugar 4 eggs, separated 1 can evaporated milk 1 tsp. cinnamon 1 tsp. nutmeg directions: bring rice and sugar to boil cook until tender. take egg yolks and beat until smooth. add milk to eggs. take 1 cup of rice and add to egg yolks, stirring constantly. add mixture to rest of rice. add cinnamon and nutmeg. serve.

inputs: chicken breasts, mayonnaise, pepper, salt, apple cider vinegar, honey, milk, parsley
targets: title: white chicken ingredients: 1 12 lbs boneless chicken breasts 1 cup mayonnaise 12 teaspoon pepper 34 teaspoon salt 3 tablespoons apple cider vinegar 2 teaspoons honey 2 tablespoons milk i use soymilk chopped parsley optional directions: place chicken breasts in 8x8 dish. half and pound them if they are large. in blender, mix mayo, salt, pepper, vinegar, honey, and milk. pour sauce over chicken. cover and bake 350 for 35 40 minutes or until chicken reaches 160. garnish with parsley, if desired.

inputs: peaches, white sugar, brown sugar, ground cinnamon, ground nutmeg, lemon juice, cornstarch, topping, flour, white sugar, brown sugar, baking powder, salt, unsalted butter, boiling water, mix together, white sugar, ground cinnamon
targets: title: peach cobbler with sugar cookie crust ingredients: 8 fresh peaches, peeled, pitted and sliced into thin wedges i have only used fresh 1/4 cup white sugar 1/4 cup brown sugar 1/4 teaspoon ground cinnamon 1/8 teaspoon ground nutmeg 1 teaspoon fresh lemon juice 2 teaspoons cornstarch i used flour topping 1 cup all purpose flour i used self rising and omitted the baking powder 1/4 cup white sugar 1/4 cup brown sugar 1 teaspoon baking powder 1/2 teaspoon salt 6 tablespoons unsalted butter, chilled and cut into small pieces 1/4 cup boiling water mix together 3 tablespoons white sugar 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon directions: preheat oven to 425 degrees f 220 degrees c . in a large bowl, combine peaches, 1/4 cup white sugar, 1/4 cup brown sugar, 1/4 teaspoon cinnamon, nutmeg, lemon juice, and cornstarch. toss to coat evenly, and pour into a 2 quart baking dish. bake in preheated oven for 10 minutes i cooked filling on top of stove until thickened . meanwhile, in a large bowl, combine flour, 1/4 cup white sugar, 1/4 cup brown sugar, baking powder, and salt. blend in butter with your fingertips, or a pastry blender, until mixture resembles coarse meal. stir in water until just combined. remove peaches from oven, and drop spoonfuls of topping over them. sprinkle entire cobbler with the sugar and cinnamon mixture. i sprinkled only a little bit, since it was turning the top too brown for my taste. bake until topping is golden, about 30 minutes.

inputs: plantains, garlic, red onion, long red chilli, green pepper, red pepper, tomatoes, sweet paprika, coconut milk, vegetable stock, cilantro, spoonful of cooked rice
targets: title: brazilian summer plantain stew moqueca ingredients: 4 large plantains, peeled and cut into thick slices on the diagonal 2 limes, juice 3 garlic cloves, finely chopped 1 red onion, sliced 1 long red chilli, finely chopped, seeds removed 1 green pepper, sliced 1 red pepper, sliced 6 tomatoes, diced 1.5 teaspoons sweet paprika 150 milliliters coconut milk 250 milliliters vegetable stock 1 cup cilantro, roughly chopped reserve a little for garnish large spoonful of cooked rice, for serving optional directions: put sliced plantains in a bowl, and marinate with the lime juice and 1 teaspoon of garlic for at least 30 minutes. in a large wide saucepan, saute the remaining garlic, chilli and sweet paprika in 2 tablespoons olive oil for a few minutes. don t let the garlic brown or burn. add the onions, chopped tomatoes, peppers and cilantro. cook for about 5 8 minutes, or until the tomato breaks down to form a sauce. add the vegetable stock and coconut milk, bring the mixture to a simmer. taste and add salt to your liking. add the sliced plantains, mix well, then reduce heat, cover pan, and let cook for another 10 minutes or until the plantain slices are tender. place in small serving dishes optional to add a large spoonful of cooked rice in the bottom of each dish , squeeze over some extra lime juice and top with extra cilantro, then devour

inputs: boxes jello gelatin, cream cheese, pineapple
targets: title: pineapple cream cheese jello mold ingredients: 2 3 ounce boxes jello gelatin, lime or lemon or equivalent even sugar free 8 ounces cream cheese 20 ounces crushed pineapple, drain liquid and set aside directions: start jello according to the box. reduce the 2nd half of the water by the amount of pineapple juice was in the can. blend all in the food processor. set in mold. unmold and plate before serving. be ready for there to be settling of the ingredients, that s part of the fun.

inputs: cabbage, pineapple, mayonnaise
targets: title: cole slaw ingredients: 1 small cabbage 1 8 oz. can crushed pineapple mayonnaise directions: shred cabbage to desired consistency. add drained pineapple save juice. mix juice with 1 cup mayonnaise and mix with cabbage. even the kids love it.

inputs: beans, peas, sour cream, onion, green pepper, pimento, margarine, whole kernel corn, cream of celery soup, grated cheese, cheese crackers
targets: title: vegetable casserole ingredients: 1 large can french green beans 1 small can english peas 1/2 c. sour cream 1/2 c. chopped onion 1/2 c. green pepper 1/4 c. chopped pimento 1/2 stick margarine 1 large can whole kernel corn 1 can cream of celery soup 1/2 c. grated cheese 1 c. cheese crackers cheez its , crumbled directions: drain all vegetables. mix together soup, sour cream, onion, pepper, cheese and pimento. crumble crackers and mix with melted margarine. sprinkle on top. bake at 350 for 1 hour.

inputs: ground chuck, onion, spaghetti sauce, salt, cottage cheese, mozzarella cheese, lasagna noodles
targets: title: lasagna ingredients: 1 lb. ground chuck 1 onion 1 large jar spaghetti sauce salt and pepper to taste 1 lb. dry cottage cheese 1 lb. shredded mozzarella cheese 1 lb. lasagna noodles directions: brown beef and onion. add sauce and simmer for a few minutes. add cottage cheese and set aside. boil the noodles for a few minutes. drain. layer in a 13 x 9 inch dish as follows sauce, noodles and cheese until all gone. bake at 375 for 25 minutes.

inputs: mashed cooked sweet potatoes, mashed banana, milk, brown sugar, egg yolks, salt, raisins, sugar, ground cinnamon, spray
targets: title: sweet potato custard ingredients: 1 c. mashed cooked sweet potatoes 1/2 c. mashed banana 1 c. evaporated skim milk 2 tbsp. packed brown sugar 2 beaten egg yolks 1/2 tsp. salt 1/4 c. raisins 1 tbsp. sugar 1 tsp. ground cinnamon pam cooking spray directions: in a medium bowl, stir together sweet potato and banana. add milk and blend well. add brown sugar, egg yolks and salt. mix. spray 1 quart casserole with pam. put sweet potato mixture in casserole.

inputs: pork, lemon, onion, sugar, bbq sauce
targets: title: bbq recipe ingredients: 1 pork roast or possibly beef roast juice of 1 lemon 1 sm. onion, cut up 1 teaspoon sugar 1 bottle bbq sauce directions: cook roast covered in water in crock pot overnight on low 8 10 hrs. pour off water and pull meat into shredded pcs. saute/fry onion in a little butter. combine bbq sauce, onions, sugar and juice of lemon with meat in crock pot and cook on high for 1 1/2 hrs.

inputs: flour, salt, paprika, ground black pepper, chicken breasts, olive oil, chicken broth, white wine, parmesan cheese
targets: title: chicken in white wine sauce ingredients: 2 tablespoons flour 1/4 teaspoon salt 1/4 teaspoon paprika 1/4 teaspoon ground black pepper 4 4 ounce boneless skinless chicken breasts 1 tablespoon olive oil 1/2 cup chicken broth 1/2 cup dry white wine 4 teaspoons grated parmesan cheese directions: preheat oven to 350. combine first 4 ingredients in a shallow dish. dredge chicken in flour mixture. heat oil in an ovenproof skillet over medium heat. add chicken cook 2 minutes on each side or until browned. add broth and wine. bring to a boil remove from heat. cover and bake at 350 for 30 minutes or until chicken is done. sprinkle with cheese.

inputs: hamburger, cream of chicken soup, cream of celery soup, milk, bread, salt
targets: title: mock turkey ingredients: 2 lb. hamburger, browned in butter 2 cans cream of chicken soup 1 can cream of celery soup 4 c. milk 1 loaf bread, broken salt and pepper to taste directions: mix together and bake at 350 for 45 minutes. very good with cheese melted on top last 10 minutes of baking time. a delicious, simple hamburger dish.

inputs: noodles, supreme garlic, water, peanut butter, brown sugar, sriracha sauce, olive oil, boneless skinless chicken breasts, red pepper, pods, baby corn
targets: title: thai chicken stir fry ingredients: 3.2 oz. 1/4 of 12.8 oz. pkg. soba noodles, uncooked 1/3 cup a.1. supreme garlic steak sauce 1/4 cup water 3 tbsp. creamy peanut butter 2 tsp. brown sugar 1/2 tsp. sriracha sauce hot chili sauce 2 tbsp. olive oil 1 lb. boneless skinless chicken breasts, cut into bite size pieces 1 red pepper, cut into thin strips 1 cup halved pea pods 1 jar 7 oz. baby corn, drained directions: cook noodles as directed on package. meanwhile, mix next 5 ingredients until well blended. drain noodles. heat oil in large skillet on medium high heat. add chicken cook 4 min., stirring frequently. stir in peppers cook and stir 2 min. add pea pods and corn cook 2 min. or until pea pods are crisp tender, stirring frequently. stir in sauce cook and stir 2 to 3 min. or until chicken is done and mixture is heated through. drain noodles. add to ingredients in skillet toss to coat.

inputs: salad oil, sugar, eggs, flour, salt, soda, cinnamon, sour cooking apples, pecans, butterscotch chips
targets: title: fresh apple cake ingredients: 1 c. salad oil 2 c. sugar 2 eggs 2 1/2 c. plain flour 1 tsp. salt 1 tsp. soda 1 tsp. cinnamon 3 c. diced sour cooking apples 1 c. chopped pecans 1 6 oz. pkg. butterscotch chips directions: in large mixing bowl, mix oil, sugar and eggs. sift flour, salt, soda and cinnamon into mixture mix well. add apples and nuts. spread in 9 x 13 inch pan and sprinkle with butterscotch morsels. bake at 350 for 45 to 55 minutes. do not use mixer. batter is cookie dough consistency.

inputs: rigatoni pasta, olive oil, chicken breasts, button mushrooms, heavy cream, grain mustard, fresh parsley
targets: title: creamy chicken and mushroom rigatoni ingredients: 14 oz rigatoni pasta 1 tbsp olive oil 2 none boneless skinless chicken breasts, chopped 7 oz button mushrooms, thinly sliced 1 1/4 cups heavy cream 2 tbsp coarse grain mustard none none chopped fresh parsley, to garnish directions: cook the rigatoni in a large saucepan of boiling salted water according to package directions. drain well and return to pan. meanwhile, heat the oil in a large skillet on high heat. add the chicken and saute for 3 4 mins or until browned. remove chicken from pan. add the mushrooms and saute for 3 4 mins or until tender. stir in the cream and mustard. return the chicken to pan. bring to a boil. reduce heat to low and simmer for 4 5 mins until sauce thickens slightly and the chicken is cooked through. season to taste. add to the pasta and toss to coat well. sprinkle with parsley, if desired.

inputs: flour, sugar, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, salt, lemon yogurt, margarine, egg, lemon rind, vanilla, blueberries
targets: title: lemon blueberry muffins ingredients: 2 cups all purpose flour 2/3 cup sugar 1 tablespoon sugar 1 teaspoon baking powder 1 teaspoon baking soda 1/2 teaspoon salt 1 8 ounce container lemon yogurt 1/4 cup margarine, melted and cooled 1 egg, lightly beaten 2 teaspoons lemon rind, grated 1 teaspoon vanilla 2 cups blueberries directions: preheat oven to 400 degrees. grease 12 3 x 1 1/4 inch muffin cups. in a large bowl, stir together flour, the 2/3 cup sugar, baking powder, baking soda and salt. in another bowl, stir together yogurt, butter, eggs, lemon peel and vanilla until blended. make a well in center of dry ingredients add the yogurt mixture and stir just to combine. stir in the blueberries. spoon batter into the muffin tins and sprinkle with the remaining 1 tablespoon of sugar. bake 20 to 25 minutes.

inputs: bananas, chocolate hazelnut spread, marshmallows, hazelnuts
targets: title: roasted banana boats ingredients: 6 bananas, unpeeled 3/4 cup chocolate hazelnut spread 1 1/2 cups small marshmallows 6 tablespoons toasted hazelnuts, chopped directions: using a small paring knife carefully slice the banana peel from top to bottom. open up the peel like a pocket. spread the banana with the chocolate hazelnut spread, equally divided between the 6 bananas, top each with the marshmallows and sprinkle with chopped nuts. gently fold the banana peel back in place, wrap the bananas in aluminum foil and cook over the coals for about 10 minutes.

inputs: lobster, lemon juice, unsalted butter, garlic, breadcrumbs, salt, pepper, thyme, marjoram, oregano, basil, rosemary, sage, garlic, cayenne, parmesan cheese
targets: title: grilled lobster tails ingredients: 2 lobster tails, thawed if frozen 6 8 oz. each 2 teaspoons fresh lemon juice 3 tablespoons unsalted butter 2 cloves garlic, minced 1/2 cup dry breadcrumbs 1 teaspoon salt 1/2 teaspoon pepper 1/4 teaspoon thyme 1/4 teaspoon marjoram 1/4 teaspoon oregano 1/4 teaspoon basil 1/4 teaspoon rosemary 1/4 teaspoon sage 1/4 teaspoon garlic powder 1/8 teaspoon cayenne, to taste 1 tablespoon freshly grated parmesan cheese directions: holding each lobster tail shell side down, cut away the ribbed membrane as close to the shell as possible with kitchen shears. remove lobster meat in one piece from each shell, rinse and pat dry. sprinkle each with lemon juice and set aside. in a small saucepan, melt butter with the minced garlic over low heat. remove from heat. in a plastic ziplock bag, combine bread crumbs, herbs, garlic powder, cayenne and parmesan cheese. roll the lobster meat in the garlic butter and shake them in the plastic bag with the bread crumb mixture to coat. return the lobster meat to their shells. grill the lobster tails, shell sides down, on a rack 4 6 inches over glowing coals with some hickory chips added, turning from side to side but not turning over, for 10 minutes. cover and grill another 5 to 10 minutes until they are just cooked through.

inputs: butter, onion, boneless steak, mushrooms, thyme, salt, pepper, beef broth, flour, sour cream
targets: title: beef stroganoff ingredients: 3 tbsp. butter or margarine 1/2 c. chopped onion 1 lb. boneless steak, cut into thin strips 1 c. sliced fresh mushrooms big pinch of whole thyme leaves 1/2 tsp. salt 1/4 tsp. pepper beef broth 2 tbsp. flour 1/2 to 1 c. sour cream or yogurt directions: combine butter and onion in a 13 x 9 x 2 inch oblong baking dish. microwave, uncovered, at power level high for 4 to 5 minutes or until onion is fairly soft, stirring once. add beef, mushrooms and seasonings. microwave, uncovered, at power level high for 9 to 10 minutes, or until beef is cooked, stirring twice.

inputs: cinnamon, cloves, sugar, water, orange juice, lemon juice, boiling water, sugar
targets: title: russian tea ingredients: 1 stick cinnamon 1 1/2 tsp whole cloves 6 tbsp sugar 1 c water 3 tea bags 2 family size bags 2/3 c orange juice 1/2 c lemon juice 6 c boiling water 1 c sugar directions: boil water, sugar, cloves, and cinnamon for 15 minutes. remove from heat, add tea, cover and let stand for 3 minutes. strain. add strained lemon and orange juice, water, and sugar. put back on heat and turn to medium heat. lower heat to where the tea stays warm but never boils. keep warm for 2 hours, and it doesn t ruin.

inputs: pita pockets, turkey breast, swiss cheese, granny smith apple, celery, mayonnaise, alfalfa
targets: title: smoked turkey pockets with apple slaw ingredients: 2 pita pockets 6 ounces smoked turkey breast 2 ounces alpine lace reduced fat swiss cheese 1 granny smith apple 2 teaspoons celery 2 tablespoons mayonnaise 14 cup alfalfa sprout directions: peel and dice apples into very small pieces, fine dice celery. blend apples and celery together add mayonnaise. set aside. cut pita pockets in half fill with the turkey and cheese. top with apple slaw and alfalfa sprouts.

inputs: brownie mix, vegetable oil, milk, joy, almonds
targets: title: almond joy fudge brownies recipe ingredients: 1 box duncan hines chewy fudge brownie mix 19.8 ounce 3 tbsp. vegetable oil 1 c. eagle brand condensed lowfat milk 14 ounce pkg. miniature almond joy bars, coarsely minced 1/2 c. toasted almonds directions: prepare mix according to brownie package directions, except only use 3 tbsp. of vegetable oil. pour into a greased 9 x 13 pan. pour and spread 1 c. of condensed lowfat milk. sprinkle with minced candy bars and toasted almonds. bake at 350 for 35 38 min. let cold completely before cutting into 2 dozen bars.

inputs: all purpose, salt, garlic, onion powder, ground black pepper, eggs, buttermilk, barbeque sauce, worcestershire sauce, steak sauce, chicken, oil
targets: title: a southern fried chicken ingredients: 3 cups all purpose flour 1 tablespoon seasoned salt 1 tablespoon garlic powder 1 tablespoon onion powder 1 tablespoon coarse ground black pepper 2 eggs 4 cups buttermilk 1 cup barbeque sauce 2 tablespoons worcestershire sauce 1 tablespoon steak sauce 1 3 pound whole chicken, cut into pieces 2 cups oil for frying directions: in a large shallow dish, mix together flour, seasoned salt, garlic powder, onion powder, and black pepper. in a separate bowl, beat eggs, then whisk in buttermilk, barbeque sauce, worcestershire sauce, and steak sauce. dredge chicken in milk mixture, then in seasoned flour, alternating in each at least twice. heat oil in a large, deep sided skillet to 375 degrees f 190 degrees c . cook chicken in hot oil until golden brown on both sides, about 10 minutes each side.

inputs: ground turkey, pepper, nutmeg, egg, water
targets: title: low cholesterol breakfast patties ingredients: 3/4 lb. ground turkey 1/4 tsp. each pepper, basil, sage and oregano 1/8 tsp. each allspice, nutmeg, dill weed, garlic powder and chili powder optional 1 egg white 2 tbsp. water directions: combine all ingredients and mix thoroughly. shape into 4 patties and place on a rack in a shallow pan. broil 2 to 4 inches from heat 10 to 15 minutes. turn patties and broil 5 to 10 minutes or until done.

inputs: gin, lime, sparkling water
targets: title: gin rickey ingredients: 1 1/2 ounces gin 1/2 lime, juiced sparkling water lime wedge, for garnish directions: fill a highball glass with gin, lime juice and ice. fill to top with sparkling water. garnish with wedge of lime.

inputs: butter, cane syrup, pear nectar, vanilla, bourbon whiskey, orange juice, ground cinnamon, ground nutmeg, salt, sweet potatoes, bartlett pears
targets: title: baked spiced sweet potatoes and pears creole ingredients: 4 ounces unsalted butter 3/4 cup cane syrup 1/2 cup pear nectar 1 teaspoon vanilla extract 1/4 cup bourbon whiskey 1 tablespoon orange juice 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg 1/2 teaspoon salt 4 large sweet potatoes, halved lengthwise, cut into 1/3 inch slices 4 large bartlett pears, crisp, peeled halved, cored cut into 1/4 inch slices directions: preheat oven to 400 degrees f butter a 13 x9 glass baking dish. in a small saucepan over medium low heat, stir butter, cane syrup, pear nectar, vanilla, bourbon oj until butter melts. increase heat boil until mixture is slightly reduced, about 5 minutes, then remove from heat whisk in the cinnamon, nutmeg salt. arrange1/3 of the potato slices in the prepared baking dish, then top with half of the pear slices, then with another 1/3 of the potato slices. finally, arrange the remaining slices of potato pear on top on their edge, alternating potato pear, overlapping slightly. sprinkle lightly with salt, then pour the cane syrup mixture over everything. cover the dish tightly with aluminum foil bake until sweet potatoes are nearly tender, about 1 hour. uncover bake until completely tender, basting occasionally with the syrup, for about 20 30 minutes longer, checking with a toothpick or knife point to make sure the potatoes are completely tender. spoon the syrup over the sweet potatoes pears one last time serve hot.

inputs: vegetable oil, almonds, golden raisins, cloves, green cardamom pods, cinnamon stick, bay leaves, red onion, garlic, fresh ginger, ground coriander, ground cumin, paprika, ground turmeric, plain yogurt, lamb meat, water, salt, garam masala
targets: title: kishmish badam korma ingredients: 4 tablespoons vegetable oil 3 tablespoons halved almonds 3 tablespoons golden raisins 6 whole cloves 5 green cardamom pods 1 2 inch cinnamon stick 2 bay leaves 1 cup red onion, finely chopped 1 tablespoon minced garlic 1 tablespoon minced fresh ginger 1 tablespoon ground coriander 1 teaspoon ground cumin 1 teaspoon paprika 1/2 teaspoon ground turmeric 5 tablespoons plain yogurt 1 1/4 pounds cubed lean lamb meat 1 cup water 1 teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon garam masala directions: heat oil in a skillet over medium heat. fry almonds until pale brown, about 1 minute remove with a slotted spoon and reserve. add raisins to the skillet cook until plump, about 1 minute. remove with a slotted spoon and reserve. place cloves, cardamom, and cinnamon stick in the skillet. stir for 30 seconds. add bay leaves stir once. add onions, increase heat to medium high, and fry until they begin to brown at the edges, about 5 minutes. add garlic and ginger cook until fragrant, about 1 minute. add coriander, cumin, paprika, and turmeric fry for 1 minute more. spoon yogurt into the skillet. reduce heat to medium. stir and fry until the mixture becomes pasty and specks of fat appear at the edges, about 2 minutes. add lamb stir and fry until nicely browned on all sides, about 8 minutes. pour in water and add salt. bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, and cover. simmer until meat is tender, about 45 minutes. increase heat to dry out and thicken sauce, if necessary. remove skillet from heat, add reserved almonds and raisins and stir in garam masala.

inputs: sharp cheese, biscuit mix, sausage
targets: title: hot sausage pick ups ingredients: 10 oz. sharp cheese, grated 3 c. biscuit mix 1 lb. extra hot bulk sausage uncooked jimmy dean, etc. directions: melt cheese over hot water. add and work in biscuit mix and sausage. shape into bite sized balls. bake at 350 for 10 to 15 minutes, until golden brown. freeze unbaked balls. take out and bake as needed. when using frozen, baked at 350 for 20 to 25 minutes.

inputs: grape tomatoes, hearts, extra virgin olive oil, parmesan cheese, arugula, parmesan cheese, lemon juice, salt, freshly ground black pepper
targets: title: roasted tomato and artichoke flatbread pizza ingredients: 1 pint grape tomatoes 2 cups 1 13 3/4 ounce can artichoke hearts, drained and quartered 2 teaspoons extra virgin olive oil, divided 2 naan flatbreads or lavash 1 tablespoon finely grated fresh parmesan cheese 2 cups arugula 1/4 cup shaved parmesan cheese 1 tablespoon fresh lemon juice 1/4 teaspoon salt 1/4 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper directions: preheat broiler. toss tomatoes and artichokes with 1 teaspoon oil, and arrange in a shallow baking pan. broil, stirring occasionally, about 4 minutes or until charred and tomatoes are wilted. preheat oven to 450 . top each flatbread with half of tomatoes and artichokes. sprinkle with grated parmesan bake in bottom third of oven 10 minutes or until golden brown and crisp. while the pizza is baking, toss the arugula with shaved parmesan, lemon juice, remaining 1 teaspoon olive oil, salt, and pepper. cut pizza into wedges, and serve with arugula alongside.

inputs: brownie mix, oats, egg, water, banana chips, milk chocolate chips, marshmallow, walnuts
targets: title: banana brownie bars ingredients: 1 10 ounce package brownie mix 1 cup quick oats 1 egg 2 3 tablespoons water 1 cup broken banana chips 1 cup milk chocolate chips 1 cup miniature marshmallow 34 cup chopped walnuts directions: preheat oven to 325f lightly coat 13 x 9 inch pan with cooking spray. stir together brownie mix, oats, egg, and water. with floured hands, spread evenly in bottom of prepared pan. bake for 5 minutes. layer banana chips, chocolate chips, marshmallows and nuts over partially baked crust press down gently. bake 15 minutes. cool in pan on wire rack. cut into bars.

inputs: boneless sirloin, vegetable oil, garlic, tomatoes, noodles, onion, green peppers, grnd cumin, salt, pepper
targets: title: beef tips and noodles recipe ingredients: 4 lbs. boneless sirloin, cut into 1/2 inch cubes 1/2 c. vegetable oil 2 cloves garlic, chopped 1 28 ounce. can tomatoes, undrained and minced warm cooked noodles 1 lg. onion, minced 1/2 c. minced green peppers 2 teaspoon grnd cumin 1/2 teaspoon salt 1/2 teaspoon pepper directions: dredge beef in flour brown in warm oil in a large dutch oven, stirring occasionally. add in remaining ingredients, except noodles. cover and bring to a boil. reduce heat and simmer 1 hour or possibly till meat is tender. serve over noodles. yield 12 14 servings.

inputs: round rump, beef suet, onion, salt, pepper, flour, water, beef fat, flour, liquid, salt, pepper
targets: title: beef pot roast with gravy ingredients: 4 to 6 lb. round rump or chuck roast 1/4 c. chopped beef suet 1 onion, sliced 2 to 3 tsp. salt 3/4 tsp. pepper 1/4 c. flour 1 c. water 5 tbsp. beef fat 5 tbsp. flour 3 c. liquid meat stock, bouillon, water or milk 1/2 tsp. salt 1/4 tsp. pepper directions: wipe beef with a clean damp cloth. heat the suet in a heavy, deep saucepan or kettle. add the onion and saute until golden. rub salt, pepper and flour into the meat. brown it on all sides in the fat. lift meat and put a rack under it. add the water, cover tightly and simmer for about 3 hours. turn the meat occasionally. if more gravy is desired, add more water.

inputs: strawberry flavored gelatin, boiling water, apple juice, ground cinnamon, apple, celery, pecans
targets: title: apple crunch salad ingredients: 1 6 oz. pkg. strawberry flavored gelatin 1 3/4 c. boiling water 1 1/2 c. apple juice 1/4 tsp. ground cinnamon 1 c. peeled, finely chopped apple 1/2 c. finely chopped celery 1/4 c. finely chopped pecans directions: dissolve gelatin in boiling water. stir in apple juice and cinnamon chill until consistency of unbeaten egg white. stir in remaining ingredients. pour into an oiled 8 inch square dish chill until firm. yields 9 servings.

inputs: sugar, salt, eggs, baking soda, flour, fruit cocktail, milk, sugar, butter
targets: title: fruit cocktail cake ingredients: 2 cups sugar 12 teaspoon salt 2 eggs 2 teaspoons baking soda 2 cups flour 1 cup fruit cocktail 1 cup evaporated milk 1 cup sugar 12 lb butter directions: mix all ingredients until smooth. grease pan of your choice. bake at 350 degrees for 20 minutes or until done. for frosting mix and cook for 10 minutes at boiling. remove from heat and add 1 cup coconut and 1 cup chopped nuts. spread on cake.

inputs: chicken breasts, tomatoes, chili powder, oregano, cumin, garlic, onion, salt, pepper
targets: title: mexican chicken ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts 1 8 ounce can tomatoes and green chilies 1 teaspoon chili powder 1 teaspoon oregano 1 teaspoon cumin 1 chopped garlic clove 1 teaspoon minced onion 12 teaspoon salt 14 teaspoon pepper directions: pour ro tel into slow cooker. place chicken breasts on top of tomatoes and chilies. sprinkle on seasonings. cook in slow cooker on high or low until meat is tender and falls apart about 5 7 hours on high or 10 12 hour on low .

inputs: balsamic, thyme, rosemary, olive oil, rump roast, garlic, potatoes, packets, red wine, handful of porcini mushrooms, shot of espresso, truffle salt, honey
